comfort.issue_summary: 많은 구매자들이 착용감에 대한 불만을 토로하며, 발에 통증과 물집이 생기는 경우가 많았습니다. 이로 인해 고객들은 실망감을 느끼고 있습니다.
comfort.strength_summary: 많은 구매자들이 이 신발의 착용감이 매우 우수하다고 언급하며, 특히 아치 서포트와 메모리 폼 쿠셔닝이 발의 편안함에 큰 영향을 미친다고 보고하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: I fell in love with these shoes right away. The only issue I had at first was that it seems the size was almost half an inch larger than what I was expecting. I'm starting to try to lose weight, so I've been walking in these for the last month and then this week I've noticed something different about the shoes. The memory foam on the inside in both shoes had formed a hole all the way through right in the prime blister making spot the ball of your foot, near your toes . I'm not sure how that happened and how it happened so fast. It's too bad, because I really do love the shoes, and if I could I would return them for a new pair. But for now, I cannot wear these shoes anymore even just after a month of wearing them because the holes are causing blisters on both feet.

I bought these for walking. They are uncomfortable and the inside sole is not seen in correctly. I wear my Rocky cowboy boots instead as they are better than these shoes. I just use them for mowing my yard. Waste of money.
Shoe coming apart at toe and sole after 4 months. Poor product. I have owned probably 12 pairs of Skechers and never had them do this
The shoe fits well, but I have pain in my feet when walking. I really hoped the memory foam insert would relieve the discomfort. Unfortunately, it provides relatively little.

I like the fit and style of these Sketchers. The reason I bought this particular pair in August 2017 was because I had the exact same pair that lasted years under rigorous daily use. Unfortunately although these sneakers look and fits the same, the quality leaves a lot to be desired even though I have treated this pair more gently and wear them less frequently than the previous pair. Not sure if this is a one-off problem or indicative of diminished quality control in general but after about six months both soles started coming apart from the top part of the sneaker with the right sneaker being the worst see attached photo . I wanted to inform the manufacturer directly and give them an opportunity to replace this defective pair but there doesn't appear to be any way to share feedback with them except through this public forum.

Hurt feet after one to two hours of mixed standing, sitting and walking. I didn't expect them to be so hard. They aren't very flexible either. I ended up wearing my old New Balance that I bought them to replace. I wish I would have returned them before time ran out. But I was working part-time disabled and needed comfortable shoes. I thought they would break in comfortable but I gave up and started wearing my old shoes when I have to wear shoes. I need a pair of new shoes that won't hurt my feet and look neutral and stylish like these shoes. I love the way they look but they just hurt my feet and it's not worth it. They fit right. But I have high arches and maybe that has something to do with it. Tennis shoes with soft soles and even boots like the Swat Air 9" Tactical Boot is more comfortable. The air in the boot is like the swooshes brand made famous by the NBA's M.J. I guess some people can wear harder shoes without pain but I can't. I wonder what to do with them. I keep them for very short events where I need clean nice tennis shoes where I won't be on my feet but I can't wear them to work for four to six hours because they make work miserable. Softer soles please or better padding for the sole liner.

There is a hard plastic piece in the back of the shoe that started to stick out and in to my son's foot after only a handful of times wearing the shoes. They have caused a lot of discomfort and given him horrible blisters. I think there is something wrong with this particular pair but unfortunately I don't see any way to return them because it has been 6 months but he has only worn them a few times.
As a mailman these shoes fell apart quickly. I am an extreme walker though. 10 miles mininimun a day and these lasted 2 months

This is my third pair 2 years, and I won't waste my money on another pair. They all did the same thing, I just put the new pair on for 2 months and the insole is slipping away from the heel. The inside will soon fail and put my foot into a precarious position. I should have learned my lesson after the first pair, I don't know if these are factory rejects or seconds but they didn't work for me.

I have no idea why, but I've never had a shoe hurt my foot more. I walk 5 miles a day for exercise and have done so for 10 years. As such, I go through a lot of shoes. I thought this highly rated should would be good to throw into the lineup but it wasn't a good idea. Wore it around the house and it seemed fine. I went for my first walk and it started to KILL my feet. Waited a day and tried again. 2nd time it was so painful I took them off and walked the rest of the two miles home in my socks. Very sad. I was hoping they would turn out well. I have other sketchers that I love.

My husband loves the fit of this shoe however he already has a hole on the inside that causes him to get a blister. these are not his primary shoes. He wars his work shoes most off the time. We bought another pair just like them he saves for to wear for good. we are very disappointed in these shoes. We normally buy New Balance but thought we would try Sketchers because we have heard so many people say good thing about them. A VERY DISAPPOINTED CUSTOMER.

Had this shoe for less than 2 months and looks like this with a hole in the middle and wearing out at heel. currently it is uncomfortable. I work retail and am on my feet for long periods of time. This is not worth the price i would expect this from 20 shoes not 60 ones
One of the worst pairs of shoes I have ever had. At first, seemed okay, but after wearing for a couple of days they were very hard on my feet. They have been returned.

Waited a while to review this so I could actually see if it is a good pair of shoes. Had them for about 7 months now. Weekday use is for a two walks a day with the dog totalling about 3 miles on the sidewalk. Weekend use is normal grocery and around the house indoor tasks . Note that these are NOT my yardwork shoes. I use my prior tennis shoes for that to keep these clean. Now that that's out of the way... I would not recommend these shoes. While they are still in use and able to stay on my feet like expected, there have been many annoyances. 1 Beyond any shoes I've ever owned, these shoes fray. I have clipped off dozens of threads. More than any other shoe. 7 months in and still clipping. 2 The internal foam on the sole is wearing very unevenly. I know I'm going to have indentations where my heel is. Every shoe does. But again, more than any shoe before, the sole wear is not as expected and sometimes my foot feels lopsided. 3 From day 1, there have been random hard points on the edges of the soles. These jab my feet during walks until I go in and clip them. VERY UNCOMFORTABLE. I shouldn't have to clip the insides of my shoes! I've kept these shoes in hopes that the troubles are behind me. I keep getting disappointed... While not 'end of the world' horrible, I won't be getting them again.

Now my foot's sliding all around in it, and I'm peeved because they don't sell a smaller size. The insole is a pretty stiff memory foam, but it's all flat, for all the typical flat footed people, so it absolutely doesn't have any arch support. After a full day of standing and walking, my feet are fighting between the sliding against the foot, the lack of support on the foot, and the heavy shoes themselves making matters worse. Thank's Sketchers, for recommending my workplace for these shoes, because now I've wasted my money yet again

Very cushioned shoe, foam is super comfortable but after wearing about 2 months I can already tell the foam has worn and lost much of its support but I'm heavy 330 lbs so that may have something to do with it. I used to wear New Balance but their quality has suffered so much so I tried these. Still wearing them but I had hoped they would be supportive for at least a year.

I'm a senior, and in my younger years I was hit by a drunk on the highway... causing a great deal of damage to my left foot broken toes, total loss of skin on top and nephropathy . As I've aged, I find that this design is as comfortable, if not more comfortable, than specialized shoes prescribed by my doctor. Only one thing to be a little aware of. We like to hike, and the broad based and tapered sole of the shoe are great in reducing an ankle twists, but I have wedged the tapered sole a couple of times between two narrow spaces. Just beware if you you are hiking on other surfaces than flat, like through a lava bed trail...

I originally bought these shoes because my Dr. recommended getting something with good arch support since I was having issues with my feet. After looking at lots of shoes in the 120-150 range, I found these and thought I would try them for 50! Within a week my feet felt better! After a year the shoes started wearing out... the cushion support was gone, and the eyelets for the laces were ripping out. A few months later, the sidewall of the shoe starting giving way as well. So I broke down and bought a new pair and my feet feel fantastic. Tons of support and no more foot issues! Sure you could spend double or triple this price and maybe get something that lasts a little longer, but for bang for your buck, these are a great pair of highly supporting shoes. I definitely recommend!

These are extremely comfortable. The gel inserts feel really nice and the shoe itself comfortably hugs your foot. The grip on the bottom is outstanding! I wear these to lounge around in, ride bikes, mild hiking, and exercising. This is my second pair. I had the first pair for about 3 years and couldn't find myself getting anything else.
Very good support. I have narrow feet and it holds them very well no sliding from side to side . Great traction and comfort when walking.

The memory foam in-sole us very comfortable. The soles absorb impact well. One small caveat is that the laces need to be adjusted after wearing for a few hours because the foam compresses. Not a bug deal thiugh

This is the second pair we've purchased. 1st for our son because his first job requires him to stand all day. The 2nd for my hubby because he has diabetes and his feet can hurt if they are not in substantial shoes. Both of them rave about the comfort.

This sturdy but extremely comfortable shoe is perfect for the rough undeveloped trails I take my daily walks on. I settled for the color because the most appealing colors were 10-15 more in price but, I'm glad I bought this shoe.

After I had my baby, my feet got wider and bigger. I already had wide feet before and was having trouble finding a good work shoe. These are working great for work and I even use them on walks. Probably not great for hiking because they are soft, but perfect for walking on cement and standing at work.
Skechers makes some of the most comfortable shoes and this one is no exception. It fits great, it s super comfortable and would recommend these all day long.

I purchased these shoes a few weeks ago. I have severe arthritis in my right ankle. These are the most comfortable shoes I have worn in a long time. We spent 2 days collecting deadfall in our woods. Day 1 I wore different shoes, my ankle hurt so bad I changed shoes after a few hours to this pair. By day end my ankle didn t hurt as much as with other shoes and day 2 I wore only these. There is a huge difference. I like everything about these shores from the fit to the tread.

These are good everyday walking shoes- not for running or cross training. The inside heal area has a tendency to wear, and under the comfortable foam is hard plastic. I'm on my third pair because the quality does match the price. The last pair, however, seemed a half size too small.
I use these for work while on my feet 8hrs a day. Very comfortable and durable. I would recommend them

Great looking shoe-excellent fit-and memory foam gives great cushioning. I have bad feet from walking constantly on my job,bunion on big toe and occasional ball of feet pain on my other toes. This has been the most comfortable shoe for my issues.I recommend getting a half to one size larger than you normally wear if you have a wide foot and toe issues and get the extra wide width,it makes a huge difference. This is my second pair of the same shoe,Other shoe lasted 2years before wearing out.Price is fantastic. under 50.00 and the quality of shoe is top notch..

I bought these in 14 Wide and they fit well and are extremely comfortable. As others have noted, they are not that flexible and feel more like a boot than a sneaker. I bought them as a general use walking shoe. I hadn't intended to use these for hiking, but this past fall ended up with a group of friends on a hike in a state park in NH in the rain. These are not advertised as waterproof so I figured I'd have wet feet at the end, but to my surprise they remained remarkably dry. I have take them out for a couple of other short hikes since then and they've been great. Good traction, comfortable solid, and incredibly priced. I am hoping they hold up, but if not I will definitely buy more of these.

size.issue_summary: 사이즈와 핏에 대한 불만이 반복적으로 나타나며, 많은 구매자들이 불편함을 겪고 있습니다.
size.strength_summary: 구매자들은 신발 사이즈가 적절하고 넓은 폭으로 편안하게 맞는다고 반복적으로 언급했습니다. 이는 특히 발 폭이 넓거나 특별한 사이즈를 찾는 소비자들에게 긍정적인 영향을 미쳤습니다.

representative_reviews.text: I like the fit and style of these Sketchers. The reason I bought this particular pair in August 2017 was because I had the exact same pair that lasted years under rigorous daily use. Unfortunately although these sneakers look and fits the same, the quality leaves a lot to be desired even though I have treated this pair more gently and wear them less frequently than the previous pair. Not sure if this is a one-off problem or indicative of diminished quality control in general but after about six months both soles started coming apart from the top part of the sneaker with the right sneaker being the worst see attached photo . I wanted to inform the manufacturer directly and give them an opportunity to replace this defective pair but there doesn't appear to be any way to share feedback with them except through this public forum.

These shoes fit my wide foot, but not my toes. The big toe side angles in and my big toe points straight forward. It pushed my big toe in and rubbed it constantly. Otherwise, the shoe is well made and very comfortable for the rest of my foot. I was not able to return these in time and ended up donating them to a local charity resale shop. I'll go back to trying on shoes in the local stores and buying the first pair there.
As a mailman these shoes fell apart quickly. I am an extreme walker though. 10 miles mininimun a day and these lasted 2 months

The pair I selected turned out to be to small, and after having a close look at them I decided to return them and bought a pair of Columbia North Plains II and I'm really glad I did. They have a similar look but are much more comfortable.
Bought these for my son who works on cars. 5 23 2022 shoes are falling apart at the seams already. Want to return but it appears I cannot.

I've ordered these shoes in the past and love them. I have a wide foot and these are a perfect fit, good looking, and last a long time. Be careful however when ordering. The product you receive may not be what you expect. The product title states that the item has a 4E width "Skechers Sport Men's Fit Reprint Oxford White Navy 4E US" . At time of my order the only sizes listed were 8, 9, 10.5 and 11.5. None in the pull down menu had a wide, extra wide or 4E suffix which is common for shoes on Amazon. Shouldn't need the suffix since these are a 4E shoe per the title. I ordered a size 11.5 expecting to receive a 4E width and received a 11.5 Medium. These also appear to be old stock for clearance sale as the manufacture date was almost 3 years ago. If I had wanted a medium width shoes they would have been perfect. I returned the shoe and ordered something else.

I really liked the looks of this shoe but it's very stiff and rather heavy. The big problem though, was the fit. The size was right, but after 3 or 4 steps my foot would slide forward making the shoe feel too tight in the toe box. Even with the shoe tied uncomfortably tight my foot would still slide to the front of the shoe to the point that I could easily slip my finger inside the back of the shoe. The surface of the insole is very slick, maybe that's the problem. Anyway, I wanted to like these shoes but I finally gave up and returned them.

I bought these for walking. They are uncomfortable and the inside sole is not seen in correctly. I wear my Rocky cowboy boots instead as they are better than these shoes. I just use them for mowing my yard. Waste of money.
These shoes fell apart after just three months of normal walking on a sidewalk. The bottom sole separated from the top of the shoe. Don't waste your money on these.
This was not the same shoe we ordered last time. Appeared repacked and too small, laces weren't long enough.

The shoe is well made and has a great look however, the shoe description stated it was true to size and to order ones regular shoe size. All my previous shoes, both casual and formal have been a size 12, the size 12 for this shoe was too tight and my toes almost rubbed in the front. I had to return the shoes and now a size 13 is only available through other vendors without free Prime shipping and are 20 more expensive! Very disappointing.
Shoe coming apart at toe and sole after 4 months. Poor product. I have owned probably 12 pairs of Skechers and never had them do this

Fit fine, really nice shoes in that regard. But received July 28th and come mid September with every other day use not even daily used , they have holes in the soles and are breaking. You'd expect shoes to last just a little longer than 2 months. And of course it's past the refund return time so I'm out shoes and money. I would not recommend these to anyone. I would love to have Amazon contact me to fix this, but I don't think there's anything they will do. Buyer beware.

I typed in arch support shoes for men in the search and these came up as one of the favorites. Wrong!!! The only way these shoes should be in a sentence with the words arch support is if NO comes before them. My flip flops have more arch support. Biggest waist of money but I had to have something to ware so I had to use them. But if you don t need any arch support, they look great.

I researched this sneaker, as well as others like it before I decided upon giving them a try. I have heretofore only purchased New Balance, but was concerned after reading several reviews online, regarding a decrease in their quality. I am hugely disappointed. I have a wide foot, and with that in mind, selected an extra wide shoe. Sadly, the memory foam coupled with the tight toe box, made for an extremely unconfortable fit. They also lack any ventilation, which is a serious design flaw. I am a serious power walker, walking 3 to 4 miles daily. I cannot recommend these shoes, and am returning them to Amazon.
Great fit for my feet. Great room in the toe with wide width. My feet fill so much better. Worth the money. I'm on my feet all day long.
My husband liked treat this shoe is light and available in his size 14 . They go with everything and are great.
When I ordered the shoes I thought I was getting a regular size and they sent me a pair of wide shoes. They fit just fine like them
Ordered 1 2 size larger as with other trail-type shoes. Fits well, better than expected for my first Sketchers. Memory foam coupled with thicker sole are better at insulating feet from sharp stones.

I am so glad I looked on Amazon for some shoes. It's so hard finding shoes for me because my left foot is flat with no arch at all I have bone spurs. I went to a shoe shop and got my feet measured, found out I needed a 4E width, I also have plantar fasciitis. The guy sold me a pair of shoes that were 4E width for 175 and a insert for fasciitis for 70. RIDICULOUS!!!!! needless to say I took them back and found these shoes on Amazon, they are wonderful! Same 4e width and size. I am so happy with my choice. For years I have searched for the perfect shoe and I've finally found them, for only 50. my husband is happy too lol cause he would spend hours with me searching . I will definitely buy these again when the time comes.

Bought size 11 which should have been amply large enough. My Big Toes were cramped and rubbing in these. Ordered same shoe in 11 1 2 and they fit fine. No Big Toe issues. Per other reviews, they appear to run a 1 2 small. More than satisfied with the 11 1 2.

Bought these for hubby as he was having trouble finding a pair he liked at any of the stores close by. He was skeptical about getting shoes online without being able to try them on for size first. When they arrived he put them on, walked around in them and said "they're perfect." He has a shorter, wide foot and he said the fit on these was great. Has already asked me to get another pair to keep in his car.
First shoe in years to fit comfortably. I'm not sure the size is accurate though. This may be an aberration between US and country of manufacture.
Fit comfortably right out of the box, no break in needed. Excellent for those of us BLESSED with wide feet. No complaints.
Good fit. Very soft memory foam insert makes this shoe quite comfortable. This is the second pair I have bought and love it also

First of all this is a medium width shoe and not a wide fit. I needed medium fit as I have long slender feet, but this is not readily advertised. I have been buying these shoes ever since they started releasing skechers memory foam. The insole doesn't last too long with as much as a I walk, so I go through 2 pairs of a shoes per year. I have bought similarly advertised shoes from other vendors, which were both higher and lower in price, but I always come back. They are comfortable to walk in for long hours, and they have a nice lacing system. The tongue is wide enough that it doesn't dig into the top of my foot, and they breathe more than some other brands.

VIDEOID a22a50701857c4579cc433337c0886fb I work extremely long hours at the United States Postal Service where I have to stand all day and sort out packages. I cannot tell you how bad my feet used to hurt before this shoe. It has seriously changed the way I even feel about my job because before my feet used to hurt so bad I contemplated quitting, but now the comfort level of the shoe has literally made this job a breeze. Lightweight, 10 10 comfort, also I got the Wides.
Very good shoe for my big ol' feet. It has been very hard to find a good shoe until now, now I am set and the search is over.
Fits as expected. This is the second time I have ordered these shoes. It is hard to find a good large shoe.

First, I m a 70 year old male. I ve been wearing size 12 Skeckers sneakers for over 15 years. Over the last few years, my foot width has changed from D width to a little wider. I thought I would try a wider width sneaker, and am delighted that this Skechers 12-W fits my reshaped foot perfectly. They were comfortable from the first time I put them on. I ve been wearing them daily, and am verily pleased with fit, comfort, and style.

representative_reviews.text: I am very disappointed with the quality of these shoes. I owned a pair of these for years and when it came time to replace them, I figured I would just buy the same ones again. However, it appears that the manufacturing quality has gone down since the first time I bought these as the new pair we quick to start falling apart. After the first time wearing these, I noticed that the inner sole of the shoes were separating from the overall shoe appears to be sewn on . I returned those thinking they were just 34 defective 34 and received a new pair of the same shoes. But after wearing this new pair, the same thing happened. Now I am stuck with a pair of new shoes that have already started falling apart after normal wear. These used to be great shoes and having worn my first pair for year until they needed replacement, I would have easily recommended them. However, based on the quality of the last pair of these shoes I received, I will not be buying from Skechers again and I would definitely not recommend these shoes as they will not last.

Right shoe completely un bonded from sole. June 25 delivered, return window closed Jul 25 and guess what fell apart 7 days later on Aug 2nd. Never had this happen with previous orders. Was hoping to return the product but that electronic window is closed and other than leaving a bad review I couldn't find a contact e-mail to discuss the 30 day plus 7 failure of what used to be fairly decent shoes. Will follow this up if i hear from someone.
VIDEOID 8a36ddb8b1eaf8b5f86b7952295e6a35 Fits well, comfortable but falling apart. Don t know if it should get another pair that will fall apart of just try and get some glue.
Bought these for my son who works on cars. 5 23 2022 shoes are falling apart at the seams already. Want to return but it appears I cannot.

There is tons of reviews that state the same thing. The glue is garbage. Soles fell off in 45 days. I paid more for these that they cost at the shoe store and they still fall apart? I want my money back but they won't honor it... been to long

I am revising my original review from a five star based on the initial comfort level of the shoes to a 1 star for durability. After VERY light use, in a very short span of time..........both my husband and son I purchased two pair have had the bottom of the shoe separate from the upper portion. I went back after that happened to them and read a bunch of the bad reviews on here....and sure enough, this has happened to many, many others. They are inferior quality glue on their shoes and it is causing a problem. People spend good money on these shoes and Skecher should be completely ashamed of themselves not addressing this issue by now.
These shoes fell apart after just three months of normal walking on a sidewalk. The bottom sole separated from the top of the shoe. Don't waste your money on these.

I like the fit and style of these Sketchers. The reason I bought this particular pair in August 2017 was because I had the exact same pair that lasted years under rigorous daily use. Unfortunately although these sneakers look and fits the same, the quality leaves a lot to be desired even though I have treated this pair more gently and wear them less frequently than the previous pair. Not sure if this is a one-off problem or indicative of diminished quality control in general but after about six months both soles started coming apart from the top part of the sneaker with the right sneaker being the worst see attached photo . I wanted to inform the manufacturer directly and give them an opportunity to replace this defective pair but there doesn't appear to be any way to share feedback with them except through this public forum.

There is a hard plastic piece in the back of the shoe that started to stick out and in to my son's foot after only a handful of times wearing the shoes. They have caused a lot of discomfort and given him horrible blisters. I think there is something wrong with this particular pair but unfortunately I don't see any way to return them because it has been 6 months but he has only worn them a few times.
Shoe coming apart at toe and sole after 4 months. Poor product. I have owned probably 12 pairs of Skechers and never had them do this

The memory foam on these get hard and uncomfortable in short time. I had two pairs one I bought at a retailer it broke within a few days. I went to replace they didn't have in stock. The second on Amazon was ok but since the memory foam is hard backed they are not comfortable.

VIDEOID 77ebb5061c4d614b4eb449a8ebb53c23 It's really frustrating because I like the fit, the feel, the design. This was a versatile shoe to wear for many occasions. But 11 months later the glue between the fabric and the rubber is coming apart on the right shoe. The rest is still great the tread, the laces, all that. But the glue is making then unusable. I'm going to attempt to fix it with Show Goo, but haven't had great success with things like this in the past. I just wish the shoe was better, for 45.
VIDEOID 2023e0d09ba54edaea9c71ade4a832c1 The outer sole comes off very quickly and just few weeks I bouth them very disappointed

I bought these sneakers for my son. He's worn them for about 2 and a half months, and they're falling apart inside. The insole that the sneakers come with bunches up and it is also breaking apart with a big hole in it. Please do yourself a favor, don't buy these.
Shoes falling apart after wearing 12-15 times! I should have read the reviews better before ordering. Seems to be an ongoing problem. Oh yea, I have a 80 of the day desk job...

I had another pair of Skechers but the sole that curls around the toes started separating from the rest of the shoes. I glued it back and using it for yard work now they are very comfortable . So, I wanted another pair and came across this pair - nice design and had similar features., Wearing them regularly and they are very nice - lots of support and comfort. So far, so good. Hopefully the glue will hold!

I like the look and the fit of these shoes. They wear well and they still look good after they have exceeded their useful life. The only knock on them is that they don't seem to last a long time. I wear these to work and for everyday use. I am an IT guy in a production environment. I am pounding concrete for much of each day. They seem to last with everyday use for about 7-8 months. They are good enough hat I keep buying them but not quite good enough to enthusiastically endorse them. I am on my sixth pair...

I've bought these for my husband to work construction roofing in for many years but the last two pair I've ordered fell apart after a few days. The soles just peeled away! These same shoes used to last him at least 6 months of vigorous roofing but now just basic activities causes damage. Will not buy again.

While this brand and style have been my got to for work shoes for a while, a slight rip in the seam of one of the tongues points to inferior stitching, the last pair I had tore along the seam between the sole and shoes when I had hoped to get another six months of wear out of them.
I wear these everyday and walk my dog up and down asphalt streets and it takes about two years to wear out the sole. I would give 5 stars but the memory foam flattens after a while and forgets.

The insole and outer rubber sole are both extremely weak. The insole wore down within a month, with my heel tearing a pretty sizeable hole at the back of the inner lining. The rubber sole separated within just a couple of weeks and had to be glued back on. Once I replaced the insole with workman's inserts from Home Depot and took some Shoe Goo to the outer soles, they became some of the best shoes I've ever owned. Used some spray-on waterproofing and they're even good in the winter. Great grip even on ice and snow! If you don't mind some extra care, these can become some amazing work shoes. Highly recommend... If you have some good glue and inserts for them!

This is my 3rd pair of these afterburners and they all have the same issue that leads to their ultimate demise... The sole comes unglued starting at the toe flap. If they upgrade their glue these shoes would last me two years but as is I'm lucky to make it through the year. I'm hard on shoes, I have a tree trimming and lawn care business so for 9 months of the year I'm on my feet and climbing through some tough terrain. The shoestrings outlast the glue on the sole but otherwise a decent and comfortable shoe. Will buy another pair next year but would be nice if they would hold up until the tread was worn out.

My hubby needs a shoe that lasts, is comfortable and can be dried if wet. We've tried many different work shoes. He chooses the Sketchers because they're light weight, hold tread and are able to be dried in a boot dryer. Yes a he's a mail man and walks for a living and needs comfort, lasting, durability, price. We've paid higher for shoes that do not last, aren't comfortable.
Very good support. I have narrow feet and it holds them very well no sliding from side to side . Great traction and comfort when walking.
This is my 4th pair of these for work and I don t see me using anything else, I work hotel maintenance and as such can walk 5 miles a day and they hold up well.

This sturdy but extremely comfortable shoe is perfect for the rough undeveloped trails I take my daily walks on. I settled for the color because the most appealing colors were 10-15 more in price but, I'm glad I bought this shoe.
The last pair I had lasted for 2 years, I'm looking forward to a couple of years of great shoe fit and wear.

This is my second pair which tells you that I like it enough to buy again. The first pair's soles are separating after two years of medium use. So there's that. But again, I just bought this for the second time.

The memory foam in-sole us very comfortable. The soles absorb impact well. One small caveat is that the laces need to be adjusted after wearing for a few hours because the foam compresses. Not a bug deal thiugh

These are incredible shoes. I wore New Balance for years until their quality went down the tubes. It took a while to settle on this brand, but I'm sure glad I did! The shoes fit well, are very comfortable, breathable, look great, and stay clean looking with almost no maintenance. I love the memory foam on the inside. It holds up well and feels good around the toes, especially when you first put them on. I wear these all day to work and put on probably 4-6 miles per day walking. The only problem is that the soles wear out in about six months. This seems to be true of virtually all athletic shoes in this price range at least, that I've found , so just be aware. In any case, they are inexpensive enough to replace as needed. I hope Sketchers continues to make these shoes at the same level of quality, because they are my go-to shoe from now on. Update My last pair lasted exactly on year and still look good, but I replaced them anyway just because I wanted a different color.

representative_reviews.text: For the price, these are a decent pair of sneakers. For many people the big selling point will be the memory foam that is used to add cushioning. While that's a nice feature, it falls flat. They used a very soft memory foam. When you are going to be standing on it, you really need to use a firm dense memory foam to get the most benefit out of it. I'm not sure if anyone is buying these sneakers for their look, They are generic and there is a model of NBs that look exactly like them. The build quality is what you'd expect for a sub 50 pair of sneakers. I don't expect them to last a long time. Overall, they are decent when you consider the price you pay. They are comfortable enough, are not ugly, don't have any major flaws.

representative_reviews.text: Will never buy again. I may be hard on shoes because I walk my dog a few times a day. But I shouldn t notice the shoe is falling apart 10 days after the return NLT date has passed. Tired of the crappy quality that companies give us.
Very poor quality Chinese materials and craftsmanship. Uncomfortable. Very noisy and clunky. Soles are very dangerous when walking on any type of smooth surface that is wet.
Skechers does not stand behind their products. The only warranty is 3 months. When they fall apart at 4 months, you have no resources. I cannot recommend this product or this brand.

I ve been buying this shoe to wear to work for the past several years, but no longer. I ll admit that my job is not kind to a shoe, but the quality of the shoes has slipped to the a point of it being absolutely worthless. They are falling apart all over the place and it is now only fabric glue that is keeping them together. I will soon be looking for another shoe, but never again this, or any other Skechers shoe. Do not waste your money. Even if they cost five dollars, it would be five dollars horribly spent.

There is tons of reviews that state the same thing. The glue is garbage. Soles fell off in 45 days. I paid more for these that they cost at the shoe store and they still fall apart? I want my money back but they won't honor it... been to long

This is a comfortable and affordable shoe. It fits my son well, looks good, and does its job. The shoe is now 10 months old and still looks practically new.... except that the glue that holds the sole onto the bottom of both of these shoes left and right has failed! I will be able to glue it back on, because the shoe is in great shape other than that. But why? Why skimp on such a simple and inexpensive part of this shoe? Oh yeah, planned obsolescence.

I ordered these based on excellent customer reviews because the Reeboks I've worn for 20 years most recently the DMX model are no longer available. I used to buy them two at a time to combat potential obsolescence. Two pairs would last me for 1 year for my five-day-a-week 2-mile walks. Why do shoe companies kill a winner? Skechers are too large. I am keeping them because I can make them work by putting in an additional set of insoles to take up the space. The Skechers are also much more clunky. I am already looking forward to them wearing out so I can buy something else.

Great looking shoe-excellent fit-and memory foam gives great cushioning. I have bad feet from walking constantly on my job,bunion on big toe and occasional ball of feet pain on my other toes. This has been the most comfortable shoe for my issues.I recommend getting a half to one size larger than you normally wear if you have a wide foot and toe issues and get the extra wide width,it makes a huge difference. This is my second pair of the same shoe,Other shoe lasted 2years before wearing out.Price is fantastic. under 50.00 and the quality of shoe is top notch..

I buyed 3 pairs of this Skechers Sport Afterburn shoes some 5 and 6 years ago. Of the older just 1 is in some bad looking condition, another one is still usable not too bad looking and the third is in very good condition. Because this experience I recently ordered a new couple of pairs again that I full enjoy. Price was very good.

I like the look and the fit of these shoes. They wear well and they still look good after they have exceeded their useful life. The only knock on them is that they don't seem to last a long time. I wear these to work and for everyday use. I am an IT guy in a production environment. I am pounding concrete for much of each day. They seem to last with everyday use for about 7-8 months. They are good enough hat I keep buying them but not quite good enough to enthusiastically endorse them. I am on my sixth pair...

This shoe has become my husband's favorite and 1 go-to. Whenever he wears out one pair, he purchases another. He says the best part about them is the comfort. The memory foam makes walking in them a dream, instead of a nightmare like some can be. My husband does a lot of walking so comfort is the main priority. We highly recommend!
Really terrible misstep I took in my last pair wrecked them, so I bought another! Comfortable affordable, I only work out so often, but they do the trick and my previous pair lasted almost 2 years.

Well built, sturdy. Memory foam doesn t really seem to be very helpful, zero arch support. Have to pull laces up tight as uppers too wide or wear very thick socks . Walked 3 miles, feet were killing me when complete, esp balls of both feet. But for 38, they are good bum around shoes, good buy, just not for long walks. Will go back to Nike for my walks.

representative_reviews.text: VIDEOID 6699095905ac6375bf142a78dd881320 I've attached a video so you can hear just how loud these shoes are. This video is on hard wood, but it doesn't matter if you're walking on grass, carpet, or cement it makes this sound. At first they were great shoes, I've had them now about 7 months and the last three months they have made this sound. So for me, about 4 months in and they become noisy.
I've been buying Monarch's in Men's size 9 for years, but for some reason my last two pair caused blisters on my left heal

So I bought these shoes for work. I read they were jogging shoes so I assumed they would be perfect for me. When I received them I was surprised to feel how light they were. They were much lighter than my other shoes I use for work and I was excited to try them the next day. The next day I wore them for about eight hours and let me just say it was a very painful experience. The front part is way to narrow for my feet, but not only are they narrow, but there are huge bumps inside where the stitching is located. These bumps run across the shoe, starting from the area where my pinky finger is to the other side. After a few hours my pinky finger was in pain and it hurt every time I took a step. I first thought it was because they were new and I needed to mold them to my feet. After 3 weeks of wearing them for over 8 hours a day I called it quits. I was still in pain everyday with no end in sight. I wore them with all kinds of different socks, I loosened my shoelaces and even bought this tool to stretch the inside out. No luck. These are probably the worse shoes I have ever worn in my life and I use to wear big ass steel toe boots. If you are looking for comfortable work shoes do your feet a favor and look somewhere else.

These squeak so badly and i've replaced the insoles, no difference. Also, they make the top of my foot sore. Even after wearing them for 3 months. No matter how much i loosen them up, i can only wear them for so long, before the pain gets unbearable. Waste of money.
After wearing the sneakers about 7 or 8 times the nylon stap that holds the shoe lace broke making the shoes unusable. Poor quality shoes.

I have to say these are one of the uncomfortable sneakers I ve ever purchased. Period. I thought they would be good for Plantars fasciitis based on reviews but they didn t help at all for mine. Very painful to walk in.

I have very wide feet and normally a 4E is a perfect fit.. Well, ill be honest.. These are not what i expected from Nike.. They were not that comfortable to me, especially in the toe area. I got blisters for the first 2 weeks i wore them, which i figured was just because they were new.. Even after they were broke in, they were not comfortable to wear..I ended up selling them on craigslist and buying a pair of New Balance..
Overall discomfort. They felt like they were made for Frankenstein. And the sole was equally uncomfortable.

Left show rubbing on my instep and can't break them in anymore. Terrible shoe for walking. I can't imagine anyone using these for active sports. Uncomfortable and not recommended since there's thousands of other sneakers to choose from. I wish I could return them but I waited too long to finally start wearing them. I put them in the garbage.

So let me start with this, air Monarch are the shoes I have always bought for my work shoe but I always bought from store until I cannot find anymore. I put these on and had to take a double look to see if they were bootleg nikes. They do not show like they are fake and says sold by nike. But they feel nothing like nike, and more like pain on my toes and uncomfortable on my ankles.

I know I have unique feet in general being a 8.5 4E shoe size. The shoes I got fit mostly, but the right foot seems to have a very common manufacturing flaw that has a slight inward curve to the outer side of the shoe that rises up too high. This causes a pressure point on the outer blade of the foot and not too noticeable for short distance walking. However any distance walking and for me at about a half mile this pressure starts to create a repetitive stress injury and by the end of the first mile my foot is throbbing in pain. I've experienced this same defect with New Balance's 409 series so this doesn't seem isolated to this shoe alone. But, manufacturers should be aware that an inward curvature to a shoe is something that can and has caused injury to people buying their shoes for the purpose of exercise. It needs to stop and function and health safety should always trump fashion. So I'm giving this shoe a 1 star rating because I can't use it for the desired purpose of walking for part of my daily exercise routine. They are effectively paperweights with the swoosh logo.

Great comfortable work shoe. This is my second pair because of the comfort but the first pair started to come apart at the sole and it was past the 3 month return policy. The second pair had a small issue and I ask for an exchange and it was harndled promptly. I do think that the return time of only 3 months is ridiculous and I may not order again.
The shoes squeak loudly when The wearer walks in them. It started 5 days after the return time expired.
The tennis shoes are to very uncomfortable to wear because the material used does not flex at all. I still have the shoes unused in the box. I will never order shoes from Amazon anymore.
These shoes suck - can barely walk without taking a knee. If I hear the national anthem or see a flag the shoes heat up and force the user to act like a jack hole

These Nikes are currently my favorite athletic shoes, both for workouts and for general everyday wear. Excellent fit and cushioning, with just the right amount arch support for me, and increasingly rare these days with the arch support located in the right place i.e. not too far back toward the heel . I'm a big guy 6'4" 275 and I can be on my feet all day in these and come home without sore feet. I've had bouts of plantar fascitis in the past, so I'm always mindful of cushioning and fit for shoes I'm going to be spending lots of time on my feet in, and these are just fantastic. I like them so much I bought several pairs, in both the white silver and black white red. I especially like the black white red color scheme, super cool-looking. Only one pair had the infamous squeak, and it went away after a few days of break-in.
Solid construction, air cushioned from heel to toe, comfortable to wear for hours, reasonably priced.
I buy 2 pair of these a year and have been for years. Very comfortable. Gives me the support I need. I haven't found anything else that compares and I've tried a lot.
One thing I dislike was after 2 days the inside of left shoe had a lump just before heal makes it uncomfortable to walk on
I walk all day and need good support. I only wear these shoes. Tried others and started having foot problems. Went back to these and my feet felt better in a few days.

So comfortable. The classic dad shoe. Perfect for my daily walks, and when I'm forced to go shopping with my girlfriend I put these bad boys on for the ultimate swag and comfort. You don't have to be over 40 to rock these. Don't let the boomers tell you that these shoes are earned with age. They are just jealous you wear them in your 20's and they had to suffer in their 20's in their silly boots or whatever they had back in the dinosaur era.
My guy has tried many brands of athletic shoes, and he says these shoes have excellent cushioning and are very comfortable.
Love the extra padding in ball of foot. I use them for cross training and love the overall added cushion and support for the money.

Over a decade or so, this is my fourth pair of these shoes Nike Men's Air Monarch Iv Cross Trainer - that should say it all! They are the most comfortable shoes I've ever worn, and I usually wear them all day long, every day. No need for stinky memory foam inserts that make your feet sweat, these are comfortable right out of the box. As long as the shape of the shoe is right for you, the arch etc..., then you should find this shoe one of the most comfortable you've ever worn. I'm an athlete and I also do a lot of outside work building things, these shoes hold up for as long as can be reasonably expected and stay comfortable.
I am a driver for UPS and I got them for comfort and support bc I am on my feet all day long, this is the 3 pair that I got in 2 years and I am very hard on shoes.

I walked 8 miles in these shoes the first day, I fully expected to have sore feet from new shoes, to my surprise my feet felt great!!! I was amazed at how great these shoes feel, I have wide flat feet so walking for long periods is usually painful but not with these shoes, it s so great to get more than expected from a product. Thanks Nike!!!
Very comfortable, fits perfect, great air heel and the best looking Nike or any other brand I have owned.

Immediately felt that this shoe gives great support coming away from a work shoe that was killing my feet. This shoe gave arch and heel support just putting my foot in it. I feel this will be a definite repurchase and it was. I just bought my son a pair, too. And he loves them at 14 yrs old! 14 going on 40 Very happy with these purchases!!!
These shoes are everything!! Super comfy very roomy if you re wide footed I love them!! I also bought a pair for my dad as well. Girls can rock these just as hard as men s can.

These are a great walking cross training aerobic machine shoe. I think the "air monarch" refers to little air bladders in the undersole that cushion your foot, but I may be mistaken. Anyhow, they're comfortable and protect your feet, and I am a longtime user.

These Air Monarch IV shoes have not been available for a while. Not happy. A lot of money.

I was amazed on how well this size 11 4E Nike fit. Many shoes of this size do not have a good fitting toe box area.
These shoes are everything!! Super comfy very roomy if you re wide footed I love them!! I also bought a pair for my dad as well. Girls can rock these just as hard as men s can.

I have had these kind of shoes before and been totally satisfied. Could not find my size in a local store so ordered them online. They fit perfect and exactly the size and look and comfort I have had in the past. Totally satisfied!

It's important to know the correct size when ordering a shoe online. This shoe fits as expected. I got them for my grandson who loves them.
This shoe is great for walking It does a wonderful job of setting the foot up for the next step. And with it's strong heel box it takes excess strain off the tendons

Was looking for ankle support in an athletic shoe and this was the one i selected. Glad i did. Sizing is just right and the mid style is perfect for better ankle support. Not flimsy at all...structured nicely. Would recommend.

Arrived well protected and in original manufacture's box. I know my size for any Nike shoe and ordered accordingly fits perfectly as expected. Really like the black contrast material on toe tip, top and tongue area seems to show less wear and tear than my usual all white silver shoe I normally wear. Highly recommended!

Nice, light shoe. A little more snug across the instep than I'd prefer but otherwise comfortable. I ordered the 4W and they are still not overly generous in the width. As others have commented, they do squeak on smooth floors. For some reason this color was substantially less expensive than the others. Don't know if I'd be as happy if I'd paid 60 more.

I bought these for my husband and he is difficult to fit. But these fit him perfectly and he loves them. We will always buy these for him
Great tennis shoe. Had to exchange for larger size. Tight fit, I use 11 but had to change to a 12.5.

So I bought these shoes for work. I read they were jogging shoes so I assumed they would be perfect for me. When I received them I was surprised to feel how light they were. They were much lighter than my other shoes I use for work and I was excited to try them the next day. The next day I wore them for about eight hours and let me just say it was a very painful experience. The front part is way to narrow for my feet, but not only are they narrow, but there are huge bumps inside where the stitching is located. These bumps run across the shoe, starting from the area where my pinky finger is to the other side. After a few hours my pinky finger was in pain and it hurt every time I took a step. I first thought it was because they were new and I needed to mold them to my feet. After 3 weeks of wearing them for over 8 hours a day I called it quits. I was still in pain everyday with no end in sight. I wore them with all kinds of different socks, I loosened my shoelaces and even bought this tool to stretch the inside out. No luck. These are probably the worse shoes I have ever worn in my life and I use to wear big ass steel toe boots. If you are looking for comfortable work shoes do your feet a favor and look somewhere else.

I know I have unique feet in general being a 8.5 4E shoe size. The shoes I got fit mostly, but the right foot seems to have a very common manufacturing flaw that has a slight inward curve to the outer side of the shoe that rises up too high. This causes a pressure point on the outer blade of the foot and not too noticeable for short distance walking. However any distance walking and for me at about a half mile this pressure starts to create a repetitive stress injury and by the end of the first mile my foot is throbbing in pain. I've experienced this same defect with New Balance's 409 series so this doesn't seem isolated to this shoe alone. But, manufacturers should be aware that an inward curvature to a shoe is something that can and has caused injury to people buying their shoes for the purpose of exercise. It needs to stop and function and health safety should always trump fashion. So I'm giving this shoe a 1 star rating because I can't use it for the desired purpose of walking for part of my daily exercise routine. They are effectively paperweights with the swoosh logo.

Slightly unexpected but not a real issue. I don't know how long they'll last, but I'm wearing these about every 1-2 weeks at work Friday rotating with another pair brand of shoes I bought at the same time, expect to get no less than a year of service out of them. Occasional weekend wear as well, but again, rotating between these and the other pair. They have a shank to the bottom, so the sole is rather stiff, but coming from steel-toe work boots, it's kind of nice having that solid platform for support mostly noticeable when moving quickly, helps support the foot a bit...
Good fit and comfort at this price is incredible! I can buy three pair of these for the price of an expensive pair of other high end models and those 3 will last longer than the others!

I walk 40 minutes every morning on a combination of sidewalks and well-maintained dirt trails. I've had these shoes for a week, and had I not put 30 miles on them, I'd send them back. With each step I can feel the tread design on the sole, and if I step on a a rock, I can feel it as well. Needless to say, they make my feet ache. Not only that, for some curious reason my calves also ache after walking in them. I don't know if its the way they are designed or the way I tend to walk. Regardless, my feet kick and scream in rebellion when I put them on! That's the negative side. On the plus side, they fit as expected. They are definitely light and don't have clunky soles, so they are easy to walk in. And, I like the graphics! For me, they aren't the best shoe. If you buy them, I'd suggest you try them out on the type surface you're going to be walking running on. I didn't. I tried them on a carpet in my house and they seemed fine. Good luck.

I have flat feet my Chiropractor described my feet as 34 as flat as a brick 34 yet even my pathetic arches felt unsupported by these shoes. Thankfully, I have custom inserts they scanned my feet to determine exactly what I needed and they cost 150 per pair and they're so amazing I bought two pair - one for casual shoes and one for work shoes that I swapped in for the standard insert and all is right with the world. So, if you like the style, and you don't mind a shoe which offers little-if-any arch support, and you have a wide foot, order 'em! -1 star for the lack of arch support UPDATE One thing I didn't notice immediately is how not-ventilated these shoes are. My feet get SO hot and sweaty which is not normally something I deal with.

The sneaker looks great. The problem is that it's tight at the toes. Bought for my son who is 14. He does not have particularly wide feet at all. In fact he only weighs abouy 100 pounds. Because they looked so nice, I was disappointed and not ready to give up. I stuffed a lot of newspaper into the front of the shoe to try and stretch out the toe area. This seems to be helping and my son has been able to wear the shoes. However, as another reviewer mentioned, there is a crease that is already developing on the top of the shoe that goes around to the side. - Again, I love the way these shoes look, and after stretching them out my son says they are okay. But really they need to make these with a bit more toe room. UPDATE So after wearing them a few days they have stretched out and my son says they are comfortable now. I have revised from to 4 stars.
My lock laces fits well on it I love it! Not all shoes are compatible with my lock laces so I was happy with this one.
The the shoe fits well, it looks very good but it's not very comfortable. The padding in the heel and front is thin. Not very comfortable.

First pair had me walking on a cloud, i even wore them to work sites and they stayed nice, I bought a second pair.. within a month they were trash, have you ever had new shoes that came with a.secret su!cid door for your left pinky toe like the old 1930s gangster cars had... I have, the shoe also a place to hide my pinky toes Thompson, a crate of ammo, a couple hand greneds, and bottle of hooch, and then to flex, my pinky toe changed it's name to cALous Capone and sent four guys from the lefties to waxk the boss of the gang from the other side, but the hit on fat toenail failed and now all ten of my toes are at war! AWWWWWWWWW Thanks puma!

Size is true to it's number but the inside of the shoe has a plastic sole liner that's thin that covers the memory foam from being damaged. Problem is it will rip off within 3 months and the foam will start to wear out and rip out. For how exoensive these shoes are, they should have better construction.

I ordered these mostly because I thought they looked cool. Didn t read any reviews and honestly, my previous experience with Puma goes back to the 1980s. I ordered a 9 1 2 because that is my normal size. 43 in European sizes. The Euro size on the box is a 42 1 2. Looks like I ll have to send these back and exchange them for a pair of 10s. Other than how tight the toe box is on my big toe, these shoes seem quite well put together and the insole is super soft comfy. Still really like how they look too. Will update later if I m able to exchange them for the bigger size.

All I know is that this shoe fits my feet perfectly. Don't ask me about sizes or whatever. Numbers never mean anything to me, because from one brand to another, or one style to another, etc etc everything is different. I really don't appreciate it either. This shoe looks like it'd hurt your feet due to the thin sole and not much support, at least I think. That's pretty wrong though. I've worn these all day, even sweating all day. I've never had any pain at all. No fatigue, nothing. I've walked in water and rain and hours with soaked feet. Been out on blacked pavement in the worst heat for hours. Walked and ran over about every kind of terrain, hey comfortable shoes are hard to find. Very hard to find. I'll wear them no matter what. I even wore them when I spent a week in the woods building training shelters for missionaries. I'm not saying they came back looking new, but they didn't have any wear and my feets were nice and comfy. That's why I got 3 of them.

I bought these shoes for myself to wear to work at a local shoe store. I wore the inside of them out but they still look new on the outside. This is my second time buying the same shoe. Perfect for wide, flat feet. Comfy too.

representative_reviews.text: I have had these shoes for a little over 4 months and they are falling apart. I only wear them to work, where I have a sedentary desk job, and have never used them to exercise. Already, the sole is coming apart from the rest of the shoe. The right sole is only half attached and the left is just starting to come loose.

This is by far the worst pair of shoes we have ever purchased for my husband s work. He walks a ridiculous amount of miles each day. This pair of PUMA shoes did not even last two months. They literally began falling apart. The fake leather, or whatever it is supposed to be, pulled away from the cloth in no time at all! He literally has a little flaps of fake leather flopping from the sides in front of his shoes. The tip of the rubber sole that comes up the front of the toe has pulled completely away from the shoe. What an utter disappointment and waste of hard earned money.
I hate to say it, but these started coming apart immediately. Stitching in the sides and around the sole split pretty badly within the first week.
The initial shock of the comfortable gel insole was quickly overshadowed by the utter lack of support. Basically a sock with laces and a thin hard plastic base.
This is a sad review to write. These are sooo comfy. Started falling apart 2 weeks after wearing them.
The left shoe tore in just 3 months, very poor quality not sure if this is original or some defective piece.
I wore the shoes four time at work, a high school and on forth day hurt feet, tight and coming apart
It didn t even take 4 runs for the heel fabric to start to rip and the shoe to give me massive heel cuts and blisters. What a waste of money and crappy purchase. Don t waste your money.

I bought this pair of shoes at the beginning of the year. They completely fell apart within 4 months. The back by the heal wore thru and the plastic would dig into the back of my foot. As well as the soul of the shoe wore thru faster then the back.
good constructed shoe poor support after wearing and breaking shoe in no heel support causing foot discomfort and pain in the knee due to lack of support and cushion inside the shoe
I bought these shoes in July for school, and the soles have already come apart on both shoes after less than 6 weeks of wear.
My husband only had these for 3 months, they are dry rotted. With in a short time they are falling apart. !!

I bought this shoe August 10, 2020 for my son 20 who goes out of the house 2 times a week. Where he walks out of the house to sits in a car and walks into a building then sits for 3 hours to turn around and come home. So their maybe on his feet 7 hours a week. About 2 1 2 months after purchase he went to put them on and the tongue came out of one shoe. I contacted Amazon and because it was past the 30 day return window they gave me Puma's email address to deal with them directly. After 5 days, 6 emails and 2 phone calls it has come to a full circle where they are not responsible either. By the way contacting them gives you another BS run around. With the first two back and fourth emails I sent them the amazon receipt with pictures of the shoe and a detailed description of what was needed. They emailed me not once but, twice saying they weren't responsible for lost or damaged products coming from a different retailer. I take "damage" meaning in the mail ect. Not manufacturing related where the tongue wasn't sewed in right . Being I didn't purchase them directly from Puma.com. So with that said I am now out 54.99 and have a brand new pair of shoes with no warranty on the quality make of these shoes. Sadly when I bought these I still believed PUMA was a well made higher quality shoe. So BUYERS BEWARE they look nice, wear nice until they don't. Then no one is responsible for the manufactures error of quality control. I am still shocked that AMAZON WON'T HELP EITHER. STARTING TO WONDER IF THEY ARE GETTING TO BIG FOR THEIR OWN BRITCHES.

I have bought over 10 pairs of this exact style at different times and years. The first 6 pairs where exactly the same, after that I noticed a slight change bit by bit, the change was taking place, quite small to notice at first, but the last I purchase was definitely drastic. The material feels like it was made with the least expensive rubber band available. I loved this shoes so much this was going to be my set for life, but now "NO MORE". Quite upsetting. The support is horrible, I wear them for 1 hour and my feet hurt for 24 hours after that, I rather walk bare feet. I wish I could get a refund but I guess is too late.
Shoes need reinforced shoelace holes. The laces cut through the holes in three different locations after 3 months of use, making them un-usable and un-fixable had to toss them .

If you are looking for all black work shoes, look no further. Seriously comfortable soles and tough on outsides. The soles feel like small plush pillows in your shoes. The design looks nice, very clean cool look to them. Not made for running or athletic use because the outside material is pretty tough and doesn't have much flexibility to run or workout in them. If your feet run wide don't get them, pumas run narrow towards the toe. I also read people having issues with them running a half inch smaller which I agree they do but they didn't have a half inch size up option so just get your normal size, should be fine.
Lasted for about 4 months then they ripped out the sides but considering I work as a nurse this doesn t mean they won t last someone else longer as long as they re not on their feet 10-12 hours a day
Like the shoe have had it before. But the Suade doesn't let your feet breathe. Nice style and comfortable but gets hit after awhile.

This is my 3rd pair of these same shoes over the last few years and for whatever reason these are not working as well as the last 2. The tongue on the left shoe will not stay in place, after about 100 steps its all the way down on the side of my foot. I'm actually wondering if there is a defect in the stitching or something. This pair also feels very slippery on wet surfaces where I never noticed that before. Manufacturing changes? Knockoffs? I don't know, but i wont be buying them again.
I am still using this shoes . It is now also in very good shape after almost 2 years of extensive usage

I work in Law Enforcement. I ve worn these 14 nights a week for the past 6 months. I have not been particularly rough on them yet they ve still fallen to shambles after 6 months. Puma used to mean quality. Evidently it no longer does.

This is an amazing well fitted shoes. Perfect all black. Bought it in November 2022 and really started using in this March because of snow. 2 tears appeared on the outside of the shoes around the seams. Too bad

I bought these in hopes of finding a pair of arch-friendly sneakers...as advertised. But the memory foam sole doesn't have an orthotic. And then their foam insert is glued into the sneaker. So when I added my orthotics, the shoe gets pretty snug on my foot.

Bought this for work, had an older pair that held up well. The tread wore out before the shoe even started to come apart. That's a win in my book so I ordered another pair one size up cause my previous pair did run tight and the toe box was a little tight for my liking. So I would recommend ordering at least a half size up and you will be golden!

Puma has materials ahead of all comfort and durability. Awesome style. Purchased 4 different styles through Puma Site and found sales on Amazon. Incredible shoe and will exceed expectations. Review the side stitch color you like best. Green is a eye catcher. Solid black are cool. Red stitch is available.
These are not leather, but I like the look and usually get a few months out of each pair, so I but multiples.
Husband works 12 hr shifts in a factory and he loves the shoes they help his back and feet and easy to break in
Best shoes I've wore but the fabric holds footheat and moisture so beware. My feet never stank till I got these shoes

I have to say I was weary of buying this show since there's not a lot of sole, but it has been heaven so far. The innersoles feel thin but amazing and enough. I love how they look. I usually wear a size 12 boot so I went with a size 13 sneaker and the difference has been amazing for walking on concrete.
they look great and have some kind of extra padding that makes them extra comfortable so very happy with them! everywhere else the price was a lot more so I got a good deal too!

representative_reviews.text: I bought 3 pairs of this red white and black model Pumas that lasted 5 years so I know a little bit about them. I also have a gray and white pair that are nice too. They used to be a great shoe. That's why I bought 4 pairs in the last 6 years. I still use 2 of the pairs. When I put on my old pair bought years ago they are way better than my newest pair. They changed the look a little bit too on the new red and whites but that's actually OK, I like it. I'm not happy with the changes they made to the comfort and feel of the shoe. This latest pair is poorly made and uncomfortable. It feels like a cheap pair of sneakers now. They are clunky and awkward and the sole feels flat so I wont be buying and Pumas again. I'll go back o Nikes or Reeboks.
The quality is worse than a Chinese knock-off. The material is fake. I don t know any other way to describe it. I put the shoe on. Tugged the tongue and it ripped off. Do not waste your money.

1 star for horrendous craftsmanship. On one shoe the piece on the toe is so misaligned you can see it is wrong without comparing it to the other. There is also a bump next to the toe piece, it looks like the material was cut a little too big or as if someone pressed it so hard it stretched and deformed permanently. And all of this is clearly visible despite the shoes being a dark color. The package was not damaged nor did it have any dents. Absolutely no idea how this could pass quality test or maybe they send me a second hand sorting while still charging full price, just outrageous. Most rubbish and incompetent craftsmanship I have ever seen. I've been wondering for a some years why no local stores have Puma shoes anymore, that is why I came to amazon to buy them, but now i know why. Also, bought them half a size bigger than my other puma shoes that I bought more than 6 years ago because people said it was narrow, well it still feels narrow. The material also feels stiff and it is not comfy.

If you look at the photos you will see animal hair inside of the shoe and the last photo shows wrinkles Creases in the material I was paying for a new pair of shoes not a used returned pair of shoes these shoes were worn for a period not tried on and sent back The shoes themselves are what I was looking for style wise the size and color that I ordered was what was sent

well I really liked the look and the great price I got them for which was my biggest reason for this purchase feel a little loose in certain areas but nothing that I cant make do with overall great product awesome value for my money
I love the look of this sneaker. Doesn't look like the typical WIDE shoe. Pretty comfortable too. This is my second pair but diff. color

This is almos the same price I saw them at a Premium Outlet Puma store, and the shipping is free! Fits as expected, and they look a lot better in person than in the pictures. The color is a bit darker than the picture, but not all the way up to make it look like black. Will buy them again, maybe in other color to complete my wardrobe selections.

My kids school colors are red and black and I love these shoes. These are men s shoes so I just bought the size I would wear in men s and not women s. Wish they had these in women s but either way I absolutely love them!!!

Great product...have owned them before...Thought I was going a different route with colour. I was 100 sure I ordered these in Green and black Amazon showed that this was the colour I purchased but ended up getting them in black and white! Not sure how they mixed that up but none the less will keep them anyway because they are one the most comfortable shoes I have owned!!

They definitely look nice and the price was reasonable. They are however rediculously hard to clean once dirty not talking about mud and dirt, more so oil and splashes of dirty water from puddles, etc. . I have worn my pair off and on for about a month and they look positively disgusting. Tried everything to clean them up and the only thing that seems to work is Dawn Detergent and letting them soak for a day and then putting them in the washing machine.
Nice looking sneakers got around a year out of them Throwing the first ones out and just ordered my second pair there A good price 51 R-J--
Got a bargain from Amazon s Warehouse. like new was brand new in original box Nice casual walking shoe Fit is as expected

I personally hate how 99 of all running shoes look. I know appearance has nothing to do with function but could it really hurt for companies to come out with better looking shoes? These are one of the few running shoes that I actually like the way they look. I can wear them anywhere with anything and look good in them. Way to go Puma! Most importantly though these feel great. They fit like a glove on me size 12 and are very light. I recently ran a 5K in these and my feet felt great. No signs of them wearing out and they seem very well built. Will look to Puma running shoes for my future purchases.

My husband LOVES these. He has another pair of pumas that he favors so I found these in solid black and thought we would give them a try. They are awesome! He said they are very comfortable with memory foam padding on the inside. They look like dress sneakers, very sharp and easy to dress up.

For the price, they are a great looking, great fitting pair of shoes. Comfortable, just the right amount of snug, and the weight feels good. Hard to beat the value for the price, and the looks are second to none IMO. The reason for the 4 star instead of 5 is that I bought them to use a a cross trainer. The soft sole very similar to memory foam is quite comfortable for daily wear, but it is not a great option for an actual trainer. Too much give leads to variable performance during running and training, especially resistance training or crossfit style training where a sturdy base is imperative. Also, the outer material that offers outstanding appearance is not breathable compared to alternatives. Ultimately, it is a great looking and comfortable daily wear sneaker, with a neutral color that wears well with most anything. I just do not use it for any planned exercise activity.
they look great and have some kind of extra padding that makes them extra comfortable so very happy with them! everywhere else the price was a lot more so I got a good deal too!

Great style ordered men s bc they didn t have any pink and black in women s sizes which was very dissapointing. I bought these for work they run a bit big but with thicker socks they work ok. Being in my feet at work after five hrs plus every day not the best for comfort had to use shoe inserts which helped a little but over all not much comfort. Would not recommend using if you are in your feet all day better for style than comfort. Noticed when I walk they make a fake leather like squeak if you will. Overall good look great price! I work at a grocery store store in the mean and seafood Dept unfortunately as I have to wash down the floors each night with harsh chemicals I noticed only after 4 months of wearing my sneakers did start to flake off and got ruined. They were nice at first. Got great compliments as they are not def slip resistant which I m supposed to be wearing. I did order a pair of slip resistant shoes from here that will be arriving tomorrow night. Again great looking sneaker just don t wear them to work if your on your feet all day and def not slip resistant or water proof. Comfy sneaker too!

This is an amazing well fitted shoes. Perfect all black. Bought it in November 2022 and really started using in this March because of snow. 2 tears appeared on the outside of the shoes around the seams. Too bad
