representative_reviews.text: Edit Less than a year of using these, and alas, they are falling apart. I have to say, I was disappointed to see these last less than a year. I admit, I wear these around a lot -- almost all day, but for the price, I was expecting at least a year's worth of use. I think I'll just be buying a pair of slip-on shoes rather than slippers from now one. I'm a teacher so I'm on my feet a lot throughout the day. After about a week of wear, these slippers are definitely "broken in". They were comfortable the minute I put them on and I was very happy with the high quality structure of the arch and sole. I've gone through so many "house slippers" from 20- 50 and they've all failed in maintaining structural support. So far, these Clarks are still supportive, and have relieved a lot of knee and hip pain. Hopefully I can say the same 6-12 months from now. If these can last me a year, I'll be very happy.
The slippers were alright at first and after awhile they broke in half so yeah .I felt it so they hurt me

I was really looking forward to getting these shoes but I had to return them. There was no support around the heel cup, which is key for me. The only thing holding the foot in place is the soft knit fabric, which doesn't do it.

First, this scuff mule is NOT a slip on - which is what you expect from a mule type shoe. Also it runs small, another strike against a shoe that's suppose to comfortable. I wear a 6-6.5 shoe size, so for good measure I bought a 7 a little bigger works for this type of shoe a size 8 would have been much too large. Not only was it too tight at the arch, but it was very clear that the shoe was going to rub against the back of my heel. On top if it all, I must pay to return it. Very disappointed.
Both slippers started falling apart after 2 mos. There is no support nor cushion in the foot bed. I expected Clark's to be better quality. Will not buy again.

These are really cute but they seem to run big - my feet slide toward the front end and really hurt my toes. I haven t decided whether I am going to return them yet because they are so cute. Thought I d try a couple pair of socks!! Has anyone else had this problem?
The bottom of the shoe has completely fallen apart. I unfortunately had surgery and missed the deadline to return these awful shoes.

I almost didn t get these because of the sizing. It s the joy of wearing a half size. You know that if you go up they re going to be very loose. With these, go down. There is a definite heel, but the way they re designed even if they re a bit small you can work around it easier than the floppiness if you go up a size. What brings me here, though, is the suede. I ve had many suede boots over time. What I didn t realise was they must have been treated. These aren t. For your happiness, go right ahead and get something to treat them with in your shopping cart. Sincerely. I spilled some water on mine washing my hands and didn t expect the water stain I ended up with. Other than that these are nicely made, very comfortable slippers. They ve got enough of a sole to them to wear out, too. I hope this is helpful to someone. Thank you for reading.

Here's the thing. They have a nice fluffy inside and attractive outside. However, they do make my feet sweaty and they do not slip-on easy. I always have to lift my foot and use my finger to get the back end over my heal. If you live in a super cold climate then they are probably great as a quick run outside and check the mail slipper but for a general house slipper, probably not. The other thing is... I have had them for about a month. The sole of the shoe has a black, hard, rubber-like bottom but the "texture" bit of the sole are almost like pellets... and they are falling off. I am finding little black, hard rubber, pieces all over my apartment. Mind you, I am a small person who does not drag their feed so it makes no sense why the soles are coming a part like that. I am a little disappointed in these. I wanted an upgrade from my previous basic slipper but I will be going back to the old ones.
Lining has come apart inside at the heel, leaving a hole and rough spot. Sole is separating from upper part of slipper. Don t buy these!!!!

The slipper is not exactly what I have experienced from a product from the Clark Co. The slipper runs small so should you want to try it you might want to order up a half size. There is no arch support, if you are walking on carpet, they might work. In my case I should have returned them but thought they might work. They will be a one season shoe for me.
Was disappointed with these, not comfortable especially since I ve own several Clark s shoes. End up purchasing another brand.

I love these slipper shoes I wear them alot .I am diabetic so some problems with my feet . When having g bad day that's all I can wear. I wish it had better arch support and maybe alittle more cushion in the heel. My only other complaint is the soul on the side separates prematurely . The rest of the slipper lasts but that area comes apart after only about a month th of frequent use. I have 3 pairs and same happened to all three .

I was looking for a slipper with enough support for around the house plus warmth. My second order for slippers was depressing. I first ordered another brand that was terrible with a hard inside that hurt my heels. So I returned them and found these Slippers that I really like because of the appearance and sole that could be used to walk outside to the mailbox. It's the correct size 8 but slips up and down. The inside has a little softness but after a day was gone, the knitting around the top added a little more warmth but after a week has started to unravel. I am using them but probably won't last but a few months and I'll need new and different slippers. If you need support for your heels these are not for you.
Material does not allow feet to breathe so became smelly quick. Washed in washer and still smelly. Don t normally have smelly feet but these slippers seem to cause issues.

Very happy with these indoor outdoor clog slippers. I have to use orthotics and they don't always fit in shoes that I buy. These Clark's have enough give to fit the arch supports and still be comfortable for my feet. Reasonably priced as well -
Warm and cozy with no need to bend down to put on or take off. That is important in advancing years.
Very comfortable slippers. Warm, too! Not a lot of support, but it's a slipper...not a boot. Good looking, well made.

Nice arch support which I need . They Do not stretch out of shape. They are, warm and comfortable. A quality sole and supports well. My feet are pronated walk on the inside of my arch and these have held the shape and support which says a lot for my feet. HTH

Love these! Have been wearing them both in and out of the house. I have pretty achy feet and so far they have just enough cushion and support to feel good. I wish they were just a little more narrow for a bit more of a snug fit but other than that, I m super happy with them! I love the look and definitely recommend giving them a try!

I bought this second pair to keep in another house. Everything I said the last time prior review is still true Pros - Soft and comfy, look very nice, easy to get on not exactly slip-on but close very secure sole - Attractive appearance - They are so comfortable that I frequently forget that I'm wearing them and have gone out to the store without remembering to put on "real" shoes. Cons - Very little arch support I typically need more in all my shoes . But a small insert took care of that. - A little too warm in the summer
I wonderful slippers, warm and soft. Cons are no arch support and they are on the heavy side. Go half a size up at least. I did and with socks my toes touch the front.

I need a pair of house shoes with arch support and I need a bit of something around the heel so I don't walk on the back of my pant legs with my heel so regular mule slippers won't work . I had hoped that since these are Clarks that they'd have some sort of arch support but sadly, there is none. Otherwise, the slippers are fine. The insoles aren 't removable but since I sized up, I'm hoping that I can add an insole with support and still have them fit. If they had arch support, these would've been perfect.

These are perfect for those quick trips outside in winter. The furry interior keeps your feet toasty, and I like that they have a leather top. The tread on the bottom seems like it will give traction on icy or wet surfaces.
A great bedroom shoe for my fragile feet. My left foot has broken twice and my right foot once. I need a firm, yet comfortable bedroom shoe and this is what I needed.

I ve had these a little over two months and have worn them everyday. The bottoms are softer than I expected and there is no arch support. They keep my feet warm. My biggest problem is the soles are already coming off. For the price I would expect them to last longer than 2 months even with daily use. Soon I will have to glue them or toss them. I won t be buying this brand again.

My grandsons play A LOT of volleyball in several arenas. I'm there for many hours, and this winter I was looking for a boot shoe to wear and this was warm enough to go from the car to the gyms, but light enough to wear all afternoon.

I bought a pair of these slippers last year and loved them. I have wide feet and high arches and felt no discomfort with these. I wore them inside outside all winter. They wore so well that I bought another pair foe next year. I highly recommend these slippers

Very soft insoles with a sturdy sole, good tread, and cute trim. As good as you would expect from a pair of Clark's. If you're looking for stretch like a traditional slipper it doesn't have any. This is more like an Ugg boot. But, that's why I purchased it. So, if you're looking for something more like a supportive house shoe than a stretchy slipper, this is a great product.

These are very well made, comfortable and have a sole that gives support and perfect for quick trips outside. I like the fact they are a true size, not a combo. The lining is soft without being too thick so they are good for year round wear.

size.issue_summary: 사이즈 관련 문제로 인해 많은 고객들이 불만을 토로하고 있으며, 신발이 너무 크거나 작아서 착용에 어려움을 겪고 있습니다.
strength_keywords: does not slip off the heel
size.strength_summary: 구매자들은 사이즈가 정확하고 발가락 공간이 충분하다고 반복적으로 언급하며, 편안한 착용감을 경험하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: After reading reviews that these run large, I got a 9 and normally wear 9.5 so I thought that would be perfect, BUT they fit as expected. So too small for me. They are well built but they don t have the comfort you normally get from wearing a Clark s shoe. They aren t comfy and squishy like my husbands Clark s slippers. They seem hard and uncomfortable compared to his. Not up to par with every other pair of Clark s I ve owned.

These clogs fit fairly nice the first few times wearing them but stretched to large after a few weeks. Disappointed also in the fact they sent me the wrong color because it's too inconvenient to return them.
Lining has come apart inside at the heel, leaving a hole and rough spot. Sole is separating from upper part of slipper. Don t buy these!!!!

These are really cute but they seem to run big - my feet slide toward the front end and really hurt my toes. I haven t decided whether I am going to return them yet because they are so cute. Thought I d try a couple pair of socks!! Has anyone else had this problem?

I bought these shoes in my standard size and they were too large so I bought them a size smaller than my normal size. They fit perfectly when I received them but, two months later, they are so wide that they slide off my ankle and my foot slips back and forth. Of course, there is no return at 60 days!
Sizes are not as usual and much too wide. Disappointed with this Clark product and have at least 7 pairs of Clark shoes. Very very disappointed and know this product was not made in the USA.

First, this scuff mule is NOT a slip on - which is what you expect from a mule type shoe. Also it runs small, another strike against a shoe that's suppose to comfortable. I wear a 6-6.5 shoe size, so for good measure I bought a 7 a little bigger works for this type of shoe a size 8 would have been much too large. Not only was it too tight at the arch, but it was very clear that the shoe was going to rub against the back of my heel. On top if it all, I must pay to return it. Very disappointed.
They run a little short and much too wide. They are not as cushiony as I hoped. I will not buy these again. They look nice, the soles are sturdy.
Very small. I have had a pair of these a while back and loved them. These run very small, I will have to return and go up another size to even get my feet in them.
1st sent the wrong size, however, 1 shoe is noticeably larger than the other shoe. reordered and the inside was lumpy and too big..for 45 be better off with a flipflop
I ordered a size 10 and the shoe was to small. Order the size 10 if you wear a 9 or 9 1 2. Make sure you read the return information. I have to pay to send them back. I m still waiting on my refund.

I almost didn t get these because of the sizing. It s the joy of wearing a half size. You know that if you go up they re going to be very loose. With these, go down. There is a definite heel, but the way they re designed even if they re a bit small you can work around it easier than the floppiness if you go up a size. What brings me here, though, is the suede. I ve had many suede boots over time. What I didn t realise was they must have been treated. These aren t. For your happiness, go right ahead and get something to treat them with in your shopping cart. Sincerely. I spilled some water on mine washing my hands and didn t expect the water stain I ended up with. Other than that these are nicely made, very comfortable slippers. They ve got enough of a sole to them to wear out, too. I hope this is helpful to someone. Thank you for reading.

Fit great....look great too. She loves them and that was my goal..!! Wrote the first review because my wife loved them. But.....in only 3 months the material of both slippers is starting to separate on the side from the soles. Only 3 months and this is supposed to be a Clarks manufactured slipper. Of course it's past the return date, so she is pretty upset that there is no longer a return policy in affect. All her shoes are Clarks. Clarks has always made a great product so maybe these slippers are just defective. Was wondering if the manufacturer even reads these reviews of their products. Anyway, I'll keep an eye out for other negative reviews before she purchases other Clarks products.
They are warm but run small. I normally wear 8.5 in shoes. Bought a 9 and toes are pushing against the front.

My feet are size 10 or 10.5, but I always order a size 11 for room in the toe box. These slippers were pushing against my big toe, and when I compared them to my other shoes and slippers with a similar flat heel, they were at least 1 2 in shorter. They also had a weird, unattractive shape to them. They are slippers, so I didn't care about that much, but the tiny size was a deal breaker. Obviously cheap junk made in China.

This is a very comfortable shoe with a nice style, color and fit. The seller was very prompt and the ackage was well wrapped. Please support this nice man and his family and help him to continue with his online business.
Fits perfectly to size. 9 Perfect support. I get sore feet if I go barefoot around the house and these eliminated that problem. I even wear outside a little.

I bought these to wear around the house and I'm a very happy with them. The toe box has plenty of room and the width is definitely wider than a B width. Just note that when you first start wearing, the inside fleece lining will roll and shed. I waited a while to write the review to be sure that it was just because they were new, like a carpet will do when you first install it. So far so good. They stop shedding after the first multiple times of wearing them. Are great for house slippers or walking down to the mailbox. The souls are nice and thick made of a pliable non-skid rubber.

My wife needed a new pair of slippers. This is her review These slipper clogs fit beautifully with bare feet. If one had on thick socks though, the fit might be very snug. I have not worn them enough to discover whether they stretch out or not, so I cannot say whether they should be ordered a size larger to encompass the wearing of thick socks. They are so comfortable, I forgot to change into shoes, and went right out the door to go food shopping. No need to think that anyone would notice in the store though, as they are quite stylish. The rubberized sole provides a non-skid surface with good shock absorption, so they can be worn all day without fatigue or fear of slipping out of them. The clog covers the back of the heel, so it keeps one s feet warm. The knitted edge also provides warmth as well. I would highly recommend these slipper clogs to anyone

These fit perfect and are very comfortable and will keep your feet warm. I really enjoy being able to wear these inside and also wear them to go check the mail or get the paper regardless of the weather.
This my favorite indoor outdoor slipper I have ever had. Fits great, lots of toe room, does not slip off the heel, and has a sturdy sole but is still very comfortable. I ended buying multiple pairs.

Total comfort! Fit is true to size. Very comfortable, Nice soul that can go outside too. So comfortable, I wore them to the grocery store by accident. Lol and women complimented me on my shoes. Very Happy with these
A great bedroom shoe for my fragile feet. My left foot has broken twice and my right foot once. I need a firm, yet comfortable bedroom shoe and this is what I needed.

These replaced identical style and size Clark s that just wore out after heavy use. I ordered my usual size but they run small and tight in the toes. Kept them anyway in the hope they will stretch a bit

I normally wear a size 7 with plenty of wiggle room in them and because my feet are short but very wide then I have to order the size 7 just to get the shoes wide enough to fit my feet in the width because its very difficult to find shoes in a wide width in the size that would normally fit my foot in length which is a 5 1 2. So I ordered these in a 7 but when I received them they are very tight fitting on my feet in the width. I ordered a black pair and a tan pair of these shoes also but in a size 8 and the fit is perfect. The shoes are so comfortable and with my wide, short foot with a very high arch, it is difficult for me to find shoes that are this comfortable, especially ordering them online. Normally I can only buy shoes that I can try on in the shoe store and even then I never know what size is going to fit my foot. I have all different kinds of shoes and they range in sizes from a 4 to an 8 because every shoe is different in the way they fit my feet. I highly recommend these shoes as they are extremely comfortable and well made and they look great too. Just beware if your foot is not narrow then you may want too jump to the next size up if you order these.

Love me some Clark's! I'm a diabetic have worn Clark's for yrs. These "slippers" are wonderful. Toe box is sufficient, non binding. Width, for me, is good, arch support just right. They do run a tad bit large, but gives me room to wear socks...rather be a little big than too small. Yes oh yes I love my Clark's!!!!
fit as expected....sole appears rugged.....keeps feet warm...snug but not tight.......comfortable for troubled feet arthritis, bunions, corns and callouses ....good value

I love my slippers. I usually wear a size 9.5-10 and I ordered a 10. They run somewhat large I probably could have gotten away with a size 9 or 9.5 but I was too lazy to exchange them for a smaller size. They do not slip off my feet. I wear them mostly at home, on longer car rides and once in a while out running errands, so in other words a lot of the time. They look good. I guess some people might not wear them out, because they look like slippers but I am 61 years old and don t give a hoot what other people think. They are too comfy not to wear. I would buy them again and recommend them to all my friends.
Runs slightly large not enough to down size a whole size though. You can step in the back side or wear with the back up. Comfortable knit around ankle and durable non slip rubber sole on bottom.

Like comfortable, moderately supportive, good sole gripes , durable material, warm, doesn t stretch out, maintains size , appealing, actually a go anywhere shoe or slipper, very good value. Order a wide if you plan on using thicker socks or a slight insole. Otherwise size is true, but to me slightly narrow. I weal a 7 and I ordered 7wide and my feet are comfortable.

representative_reviews.text: Edit Less than a year of using these, and alas, they are falling apart. I have to say, I was disappointed to see these last less than a year. I admit, I wear these around a lot -- almost all day, but for the price, I was expecting at least a year's worth of use. I think I'll just be buying a pair of slip-on shoes rather than slippers from now one. I'm a teacher so I'm on my feet a lot throughout the day. After about a week of wear, these slippers are definitely "broken in". They were comfortable the minute I put them on and I was very happy with the high quality structure of the arch and sole. I've gone through so many "house slippers" from 20- 50 and they've all failed in maintaining structural support. So far, these Clarks are still supportive, and have relieved a lot of knee and hip pain. Hopefully I can say the same 6-12 months from now. If these can last me a year, I'll be very happy.
The bottom of the shoe has completely fallen apart. I unfortunately had surgery and missed the deadline to return these awful shoes.
Only 3 months in an they re falling apart. Which is so sad because I love them. Wish I could request a refund but I m out of the refund window by 3 days

Purchased October 2019. After may be a few times wearing stitching came undone on the sides where the suede meets the sole of the slipper. Well I liked the slippers and didn't want to return them so I cut the loose stitching off as it looked like the soles were still attached well. I should have returned them then, 4 1 2 months after my purchase one of the slippers the suede and sole came apart and has left a 3 inch hole. Bummers...maybe I can get my money back
They fell apart at the seam, They wore out very quickly and the trim turned fuzzy. I was very disappointed since Clarks has always had a great reputation. I have always loved all of my other shoes.
The slippers were alright at first and after awhile they broke in half so yeah .I felt it so they hurt me
This is the 2nd pair of these that I bought. The seam was pulled out from the sole on the 1st pair...now the 2nd pair is doing the same. Won't buy these again.
after less than of 2 months of wear, they stretched so much they weren slipping off and causing me to trip

The same holding the slipper to the soul almost came completely off one slipper and started to on the other. Too much of a hassle to send them back so I just glued them together and they re holding out pretty good now. They don t look as pretty, but they re stuck together.
I have had these only a short time and they are already coming apart where the upper and sole meet. They are comfortable but do not recommend purchasing.
These are fake Clark s that are made in China. Do not buy! They are tight across the arch of your foot and there is a tag sewn inside that tore the skin right off my foot.
In less than a month of use i found a hole inside the shoe. I d have to return it by tomorrow to get exchange or refund. Not enough time to return. I don t recommend this product or seller.
Lining has come apart inside at the heel, leaving a hole and rough spot. Sole is separating from upper part of slipper. Don t buy these!!!!

This is a comfortable slipper with a harder sole which is good for my plantar fasciitis. However I am dissatisfied that they are already falling apart at the seams. The sole is detaching from the slipper and I have worn them everyday just around the house since I bought them in March and it is only May.

I was really looking forward to getting these shoes but I had to return them. There was no support around the heel cup, which is key for me. The only thing holding the foot in place is the soft knit fabric, which doesn't do it.

These are very well made, comfortable and have a sole that gives support and perfect for quick trips outside. I like the fact they are a true size, not a combo. The lining is soft without being too thick so they are good for year round wear.
Super cute. Wore maybe 4 times and the sole is coming away from the shoe. I can glue them but shouldn't have to.
A great bedroom shoe for my fragile feet. My left foot has broken twice and my right foot once. I need a firm, yet comfortable bedroom shoe and this is what I needed.

I loved these slippers until this... I have never had a Clark shoe of any type not hold up for years...this is after 3 months!!! Which leads me to believe that this is a knock off Pelz Shoes is selling. I'm seeing the similar and or the same issue on other reviews as well. Furthermore no am extremely upset with this seller as I contacted them immediately after the year started which has since gotten a lot bigger and asked for a replacement pair not a refund a replacement and they stated they could not because I was outside the 90 days...8 days past the 90 days!!! Unacceptable!!!!

My partner has been buying slippers every year and goes through them quickly and they usually have no support. Again, she was looking at the less expensive ones. But liked these a lot. I do not consider them expensive, since I own Ugg slippers. I would probably go with these next year. I talked her into just getting them. They are by the door for when she comes in from work. She actually wore them out the other day to run in to get a pizza. Nice soles. Obviously do not have to take them off when she goes out with dog in backyard. Good traction support. It looks like they will definitely last more than 1 year! She is glad she spent the little extra, to get a lot extra!

My grandsons play A LOT of volleyball in several arenas. I'm there for many hours, and this winter I was looking for a boot shoe to wear and this was warm enough to go from the car to the gyms, but light enough to wear all afternoon.
I love this Clark slipper. Can be worn outdoors. This is my third pair. Very durable. I do order a half size up, because I wear with socks. Have washed them in the machine. Then air dry. Works great.
Great price for a replacement pair of these that lasted 2 years. I wear a 3 4 shoe orthotic and they fit great - went up a size for that reason.

These are solid. I love the suede uppers and the soles aren't noisy in the morning. They're not silent, but not clunky and they don't slap down on the floor. I have long toes, narrow feet, high instep and high arches. I also have "problem toes" from when I broke them a couple of years ago. These are comfortable and supportive. NOTE I bought a half-size larger than my regular shoe size. Also, my cat's claws can't penetrate them when we play.

I bought these for my wife. It is her second pair of these. The first pair started to separate between the sole and the upper after a few years of hard wear and has since been repaired by me. So she now has two pair of these. They keep her feet warm and she wears them daily.

The shoe was well made, a very nice product. I liked the way it was, my wife didn't like it due to the fact it was a size smaller than we ordered. We ordered an11 wide and got a 10 medium. She also felt that the back of the shoe looks lower online than in real life. She doesn't care for shoes with high backs. Otherwise the shoe is well made.

I have really high arches and foot issues so always have to wear shoes or slippers in the house. These are perfect house shoes! Very comfortable with great support and look cute too! I did have to buy a size down as the initial pair I bought in my regular size 8 were too big. Size 7 pair are perfect! Planning to buy another pair or two!

Owned a pair very close to these and had worn them out after nine years. Was beyond happy that Clark still carried them. They are so comfotable I find myself accidently wearing them on the way to do errands. They keep my feet, especially toes, warm in the fall and winter. Buy them, your feet will thank you!

Quality and feel is nice. I'll likely buy a second pair. The width was good and i have slightly wider feet. The length felt a little small for the size so if you are in between, definitely choose the bigger size
Nice looking shoes. Rubber sole that works indoors and out. Description suggests one order a size up due to the lining- did so and they fit just right!

representative_reviews.text: The wrong color was sent, I ordered Cinnamon and received tan - someone put tan in the box labeled Cinnamon - honest mistake- otherwise the shoes are great! SUPER WARM AND COMFORTABLE!

representative_reviews.text: Purchased for myself for Christmas. I only wore 2 times and the right shoe started to pull apart from the shoe. I thought I was purchasing a quality pair of footwear as Clark s are a well named brand. The cost of them was not cheap either. Returned back to Amazon.

Very poorly made. First button came off within a week. Second button a month after that. They feel cheap with little cushion. I guess I know why they were on sale. Would not buy again. And a disappointment from Clark s.
I loved these when I got them. I've had them for 2 weeks and already there's been a blowout. Not worth the money. Very disappointed.

Liked Thought the price was pretty reasonable for this brand since most other ones were more than 45- 95 for 1 pair of slipper, I got them for under 30! Keeps my feet warm, easily slip on off when have to let dogs out 3 GSD likes go outside frequently , and so many colors to choose from
I love these shoes. I have purchased 3 pairs over the course of 4 years and will purchase more in the future. Very commutable and warm.
Great quality house shoe. Perfect if u need to run outside for a minute to take trash out! I love them!!!!

representative_reviews.text: Are these genuine Adidas, or a knockoff? Puremotion Adapt, size 8.5 . The inner sock foot bed liner is much narrower than the inside sole of the shoes, leaving gaps on both sides for one's foot to slip off and slide against one side or the other while walking. There is a quarter inch gap inside on both sides, as soon as you pass the arch mid-foot area and going right around the toe front of shoe. The insole seems to be stitched in place, and fits fine from heel area about halfway down the inside of the shoe. Then it's like they fitted a triple A narrow insole into a regular width shoe, and left the crude stitching for our feet and toes to rub against without cushioning. This brand new pair causes my feet to dramatically pronate, just trying them on in the living room on the carpet. I need these for daily walking and feel certain they'll cause pain in feet, legs, back, etcetera. What's happened to Adidas quality? I have other Adidas and the sock insole is a full liner leaving no gaps.
No support- I ve been wearing on walks it feels like feet are directly on concrete. Definitely not ideal for working out.
Not good for walking and running on treadmill the bottoms are already wearing down and my toes hurt after wearing them.

These slip on sneakers were nearly impossible to get on. When they went on, the back insert folded over and you could feel it. There was nearly no cushion, especially on the front half of the shoe, and my feet hurt after one day of wear. I threw them in the garbage.
these are very tight and I could hardly get my foot through the shoe. the crisscross elastic is too tight
These are not meant for nursing ! They are not comfortable and so tight on the foot from the top straps . My feet were hurting so bad after a 12 hour shift
Sandly you feel your literally walking in the ground not comfy for your feets the sole is to hard. That needs improvement. The appearance is good just need to be upgraded for more comfortable.

If you have any arch in your foot at all, these aren't for you. After a month use they have completely messed my feet up painfully. They have absolutely no support are akin to walking on hard concrete. They're cute and they fit well, but they're not for walking. The only advantage they seem to have is the flared out portion of the soles that allow extra grip when running, and definitely help with squatting. Only buy these for leisure slipping on to run out to the grocery store.

I ve never had a poorly made shoe like this. How do you not complete the cushioned sole? As pictured, the cushion is subtracted a few centimeters each direction even on the toe area. As soon as I put it on which it was a perfect fit, the sides of my feet were landing on the black seams of the sole, not the cushion. Even on the toe part which when running you need a toe grip. I even have very thin feet and all sides were not completely cushioned.
Poor quality shoes. But I use them for the gym and or other things when I do not care about messing up my shoes. They crease super easy. And they are cheaply made.
Different than what i tired on in the store. No support and the cushion in the shoe was flat. Runs large so size down. Not a good pair to have if you stand on your feet all day or to use to work out.

These were incredibly uncomfortable. The insole didn t seem to fit the inside of the shoe well because I could feel exactly where the insole started and stopped. The bottom months of the shoe feel like it s made more of a firmer plastic opposed to rubber. I don t think there s anyway that I could wear these and be comfortable even just walking around
I wore my shoes in the rain one day which is quite normal and they turned yellow on the top and now it s to late to return them but just wanted to let ppl know I guess you can t get them wet lol
It may just be me, but they kind of make my feet look wider. Very comfortable, little loose across the middle of the foot. Fits you size.
Shocked that these shoes even have the Addis name. Extremely cheap, uncomfortable, and flimsy. Returned

I was on a time crunch to find shoes that would be good for our Disney World trip. I saw these and thought ok, no tying, easy to slip on, looks supportive. I was right!! They re stylish, comfy, supportive, and did not wear out at all after 40,000 steps in two days. I am usually a 6.5-7 and got a 6.5. There was a little wiggle room. Maybe size down half a size. Depending on your foot shape it may not have the arch support you re looking for, but I sure do approve of them!! I had the inevitable sore feet toward the end of the day but that s expected with that much walking anyways. They re definitely a good walking shoe.
Love them so comfortable!! An so soft on the inside! I order a size 9 which is my regular size an they fit great! So go with your regular size!

I was trying wraps to support my arches and exersizes for Plantar Fasciitis with little relief. I work on my feet all night and the pain was starting to affect my work. I discovered these shoes offer the arch support I need to prevent the pain. I own 4 pairs and rarely wear anything else.
Very comfortable, I bought for my daughter who works long hours on her feet. She loves them, they look great and fit perfectly

So this is my third pair of Adidas. I have always been a Nike girl but a few years ago, I picked up a pair of the Adidas puremotion cloudfoam shoes and fell in love so much that I went back and got another pair. Fast-forward a few years, decided it was time for a new pair and ordered this pair. These shoes have the same insole and midsole as the first 2 I got, the cloudfoam. Im an RN so of course I'm on my feet A LOT. But when I come home, my feet don't hurt at all... my back is a whole other story but my feet don't hurt! I chose this pair in hopes the material would stay cleaner than my other 2 pairs. But if you're needing a shoe that will provide comfort and keep your feet from hurting any Adida shoe with cloudfoam insole and midsole would be a great choice! Just got this pair in today and love the look! They'll be very easy to clean. I only have one complaint about the cloudfoam and that is he holds on to bacteria too well. Even through numerous washes. My 2 old pairs smell HORRENDOUS! I do not recommend letting them air dry after washing them bc the smell gets worse. I naturally have smelly feet and I use a foot powder in all of my shoes which has worked until I started wearing the cloudfoam shoes. So keep that in mind if you're like me and the stinch of your feet could knock someone unconscious.

Supposedly a running shoe but no cushion at all. This shoe is very hard to get on, certainly not a slip-on. I would not recommend this shoe for a runner. I walk over 7 miles day and not a good shoe for even walking

I wanted to share the gave me some good arch support and as a slip on. These are very comfortable shoes but a little difficult to put on at first until you get them broken. Having a better loop to pull them onto your foot would ve helped. But if you have difficulty bending over our reaching your foot, these are not the easiest shooter put on.

There is a lot I love about this shoe. It is extremely comfortable. I'm a nurse and im on my feet for hours. These offer a low-medium level of support around the ankle but still flex with the foot around the rest. What I DO NOT like, I bought these to actually RUN IN AND THEY DONT CUT IT. I run 1-3 miles about 4 days a week. These FLEX TOO MUCH and do not properly support you while running. My chiropractor, who was a actually a Nike sponsored marathon runner, hates these shoes and has told me to not even attempt to run in them again because I would be asking for trouble. If you just want a comfy, medium support shoe for hiking, weight lifting, or walking I highly recommend this shoe. I just do not recommend it for running.
I use these shoes while traveling and they are super comfy for long flights and running between gates the support is awesome and at the end of the day my feet is smiling!!

I have high arches so it s difficult for me to find comfortable shoes. Many arch supports in shoes aren t in the right position to support mine, and my arch makes my foot a bit taller so shoes can feel pretty tight. These fit great and are super comfortable. I used to wear Nike s Revolution 4 running shoes that fit really well, but I couldn t find them anymore for a decent price. They also had pieces of plastic or something on the heel to keep the heels up straight, which would sometimes give me blisters, especially when the fabric covering them started to wear out after a couple years. These Adidas shoes do not have that. They re a durable fabric all around and super lightweight. There doesn t seem to be plastic at the heel, and I ve never gotten blisters from them even after wearing them long distances. I ve had them for a few months now and wear them everywhere - school, grocery shopping, walks, etc., they re great. I also like that they don t have laces and are easy to put on. I recommend giving them a try, especially if you can try them in a store or use Prime Try Before You Buy Wardrobe.

I ordered these shoes when I was in a pickle rigth before a trip. I trust adidas as a brand and so i went for these simple yet promising shoes. I was not disappointed at all. I have walked for hours and hours in these during travel and sight seeing. the sole is soft and provides good cushion. definetly recommend for a daily walking shoe.

I love these shoes so much! I am pregnant and I have to be picky with the shoes I wear or my feet are sooo done by the end of the day. I wear these all the time and they have been heaven...might even buy another pair in another color. I bought a 9 usually I m an 8.5 or a 9 depending on the shoe . I do find these to run a little big but since I m pregnant and my feet are swelling and I still have a few months to go, I decided to keep the 9 and they have been great. If I wasn t pregnant I probably would have returned for the 8.5. Also bought a heel support insert because I do think the cloud foam gets worn down easy. With that they have been perfect!

Love these shoes! I have fibromyalgia and can experience a lot of body pain. I was able to walk with my kid on two college tours in one day, totaling 10.2 miles and my feet did nothing hurt one bit! Love the animal print and they are super easy to slide on. Initially they were very stiff and I had a hard time getting my foot into them. On e I wore them 3 times or so they had loosened up and ere easy to put on and off. I want to get them now in the other prints

1 good and solid arch support 2 easy to put on and take off 3 roomy toe box 4 high quality fabric rich pigment and good give stretch 5 vented so they re cool on hot days 6 sole has good shock absorption 7 very pretty and hard to find pastel pink that s not peach or yellow toned. A true pink For these reasons Buy with confidence!!
I really like the way this product hugs my foot so I feel very secure when walking or running. The iridescent logo is a great touch! I highly recommend this product.

I m so confused!! Ordered a 7 based on reviews that it runs a little big. I am across the board a 7.5. They felt a little small so I then ordered my normal 7.5. So confused because 7 is too small my toe just touches the tip of the shoe and the 7.5 is so much bigger!! It fits like an 8? So basically 7 was too small and 7.5 was way too wide. Idk if it s like this for everyone but I posted pics of size comparison. Left is 7.5 and right is 7.
Seems to run large in the area and tight around the strap. Debating about returning but I like the look.
I have several pair of Adidas and these run a full size too big. They almost fit like mens' sized shoes very wide and long . Sad to return them.

I run and decided to try a lower priced shoe this time since I saw some great reviews. Here are my thoughts.. -The shoe design is super cute -VERY NARROW. This shoe is not good if you have normal feet. -Runs very small. I am usually a 9 or 9 1 2. I bought this as a 9 since a few of the reviews said they were nice and spacious. NOT the case. -The shoe sole is hard. Very hard. With my Nike's usually with new shoes I feel like I am on a cloud. not the case. That was disappointing. I hope this helps for someone else. Please note, I have normal to wide feet. I am athletic build. I needed the shoes for running and constraining. I bought my son the men's version which are way more comfortable. I may try them out.
VIDEOID 5a8d1e158be3da22a009e41ecdb33c06 It runs a little big I m size 7 and this shoes fits a bit wide and loose probably if you want to order try to order 1 2 size smaller
sizing was a bit larger than the standard size. U have to wear thick socks comfort has been compromised. But build quality and design are good.

I have had these shoes purchased from the acidias store in the past and I am familiar with the size running smaller, as such I ordered a size 6 as I normally wear 6.5-7. The shoes are soo small they fit like a size 5 in my feet, these leads me to believe these are not real adidas as I have an old pair from the original store and the size do not match. The shoe box came completely destroyed even though the Amazon slip package had not much damage, which makes one question the shoes even more. Very disappointed.
It may just be me, but they kind of make my feet look wider. Very comfortable, little loose across the middle of the foot. Fits you size.

I bought these for a friend, as a gift. They opened them yesterday, and unfortunately these shoes look worn, and the right shoe fits significantly looser than the left shoe. I m very disappointed, as the return window has closed, so I can t return them and get my friend something else.
Not good for walking and running on treadmill the bottoms are already wearing down and my toes hurt after wearing them.

Are these genuine Adidas, or a knockoff? Puremotion Adapt, size 8.5 . The inner sock foot bed liner is much narrower than the inside sole of the shoes, leaving gaps on both sides for one's foot to slip off and slide against one side or the other while walking. There is a quarter inch gap inside on both sides, as soon as you pass the arch mid-foot area and going right around the toe front of shoe. The insole seems to be stitched in place, and fits fine from heel area about halfway down the inside of the shoe. Then it's like they fitted a triple A narrow insole into a regular width shoe, and left the crude stitching for our feet and toes to rub against without cushioning. This brand new pair causes my feet to dramatically pronate, just trying them on in the living room on the carpet. I need these for daily walking and feel certain they'll cause pain in feet, legs, back, etcetera. What's happened to Adidas quality? I have other Adidas and the sock insole is a full liner leaving no gaps.

I don t think the sizes are anything close to correct unless these are kids shoes and kids sizing, in that case disregard. If that s not the case either get prime s try before you buy or go up 2 sizes. I think with all clothes and shoes on here try before you buy might be the better option. You re most likely going to have to send 80 of clothes and shoes back anyway.
I've never had issues with Adidas fitting my feet. THESE are super narrow and so tight I can't wear them with the thinnest socks I own.

I usually wear a size five wide. I ordered a size 6, thinking it would accommodate for the width as it typically does for me in this brand. I couldn t even get my foot halfway into the shoe. It has no stretch. The inside stitching is questionable. Other than that, the shoes were aesthetically pleasing and arrived promptly.
Love them so comfortable!! An so soft on the inside! I order a size 9 which is my regular size an they fit great! So go with your regular size!

I was on a time crunch to find shoes that would be good for our Disney World trip. I saw these and thought ok, no tying, easy to slip on, looks supportive. I was right!! They re stylish, comfy, supportive, and did not wear out at all after 40,000 steps in two days. I am usually a 6.5-7 and got a 6.5. There was a little wiggle room. Maybe size down half a size. Depending on your foot shape it may not have the arch support you re looking for, but I sure do approve of them!! I had the inevitable sore feet toward the end of the day but that s expected with that much walking anyways. They re definitely a good walking shoe.
I have wide feet so I wasn't sure how these were going to fit. The reviews seem to flip flop about being for wide feet. Free returns so I bought them. The fit just fine and are very comfortable.
Perfect fit and super comfortable! Feels like walking barefoot on pillows. Great quality for the price.

True to fit, I wore them without breaking them in on a 10hr day I work in the medical field , my feet were not aching, no blisters like most shoes. Best spent money yet! They have room, they flex with your foot. New favorite! I hope the durability lasts a long time, I have high expectations!
Love the look , quality and comfort. Fits a little larger than typical sizing but if wearing with thick socks purchase normal size.

Shoes are cute maroon color but were probably a half size bigger than marked. I had ordered the same shoe in the same size in silver gray and it was too tight. This one was way too big. I would have kept it had it been sized properly. It is lightweight but probably not enough cushion for long walking.

As we all know, sizing varies based on the different brands of footwear. Here is some info to hopefully help you decide which size is best for you in this sneaker I am a 7.5 in Converse, Women Nikes, Skechers, and Keds. In old navy flip flops I go for an 8. In crocs I m a 7 I ordered these Adidas in a size 7.5 for a Run I m doing and they are a half size too big. I won t be able to get the correct size so I m just going to keep these. However, I provided a picture to show that I have about an inch of toe space from the top of my toe to the tip of the sneaker. A 7 would be perfect. I will update this picture with length measurement for better decision making for customers. Overall it a comfortable sneaker, very light on my foot, just the right amount of snug, and doesn t make my feet sweat.

I absolutely love these shoes and will buy more. They fit perfectly and as a 6 2 188cm woman I have particularly large feet and having the right size in a woman s shoe makes all the difference. Shipped super fast and living in Alaska that shocked me how fast they were here. Much appreciated. Anywho that s all just buy them you know you want to love. Treat yourself they are amazing.

These shoes are very comfortable. Takes awhile to figure how to put them on. I wear wide shoes so I went up a half size. They fit just right, despite struggle to get on. Really like that I don't have shoe laces to tie but if you're looking for shoes to slip on quickly, these might not be the best choice

I love these shoes. I ordered the animal print ones but I also have them in solid black. They fit great with a roomier toebox. I typically Where a 9.5 but always order up to a 10 in tennis shoes. I get compliments every time I wear them. I do wear them to work out , to work and with casual clothes. They don t have a tremendous amount of support so if you stand all day to wear them they might not be the best option. They are super comfortable though.
Love everything about this shoe. Very comfy, light weight and soft. Breathable material. Perfect fit.

I usually wear a 9 and the 9 fits a tad big on me BUT I wear super thin socks. Plus they re a bit of a trick to get on at first the heal loop is essential so sizing down might not help with that. Once they re on they re SUPER comfy. I have nearly flat feet with medium width, so anything with an arch usually kills my feet, so these being pretty flat feel great with my foot shape.

So I was expecting my foot to have a tight squeeze getting into my normal size shoe. So I ordered a half size up because I also have wide feet. Well, I have a lot of room in the shoe..but it is a slight squeeze to get my foot in the shoe. Which I believe could be normal . But they look great on my feet. This is not a support shoe which is why I gave it a 4 star. More so, just a fashion shoe.

Love the shoes but with having wide feet this shoes does snug on a bit tighter. I have one exactly the same but a different color and it fits perfectly and very roomy, this one is a bit tight. If you don t care for the tight snug then get your shoe size but if you have wide feet like me and like a little room to move around for comfort go a half size up. Overall i am satisfied with it.

These slip on sneakers were nearly impossible to get on. When they went on, the back insert folded over and you could feel it. There was nearly no cushion, especially on the front half of the shoe, and my feet hurt after one day of wear. I threw them in the garbage.

I LOVE LOVE LOVE my Adidas Women's Puremotion-Adapt Running Shoe size 9.5 that I ordered last spring, and pretty much lived in all spring and summer of 2022. They are still good shoes, and I still enjoy wearing them. They look good and are comfortable! This spring 2023, I ordered the Exact Same shoe in the Exact Same Size in a new color. OMG I am SO Disappointed !!!! These hurt my feet so bad. I wore these new shoes around the house to try them out. I cannot even wear them, 3 minutes. I could not understand why these shoes should hurt my feet. UNTIL I placed the shoe models side-by-side. I compared the bottom soles of the 2022 model against the 2023 model. The problem is OBVIOUS ! The outside footprint of the sole is smaller! There's much less supporting material extending from both heel and extending around the toe and all around the foot bed. The 2023 model is much more narrow than the 2022 model. SHAME on YOU ADIDAS !! YOU designed an AWESOME SHOE and then greedily reduced the shoe material , and called it the SAME NAME. GREEDY GREEDY GREEDY. To those who may say , "Buy a shoe size larger".... The problem is NOT not the size of the shoe. The Problem is the radical reduction of all the materials around the sole that supports the wearer. Sad.

Unfortunately I found the top of the shoe doesn't have a lot of "give." This made it impossible to get on. I had purchased these hoping they could compare to a similar shoe another company makes. However, this shoe is not stretchy. Not very flexible in my opinion. Bought two different colors of these shoes and neither worked for me. Darn the luck

I work in dental so having shoes with no shoes strings is perfect and they have the cloud sole so it s heaven on my feet

I wear these shoes to work I m a nurse I have worn these shoes climbing the Rocky Mountains, I have worn these shoes at the gym and just out running errands. They are my go to comfortable shoe for whatever I need. I have used them a ton and they still hold up great.

So this is my third pair of Adidas. I have always been a Nike girl but a few years ago, I picked up a pair of the Adidas puremotion cloudfoam shoes and fell in love so much that I went back and got another pair. Fast-forward a few years, decided it was time for a new pair and ordered this pair. These shoes have the same insole and midsole as the first 2 I got, the cloudfoam. Im an RN so of course I'm on my feet A LOT. But when I come home, my feet don't hurt at all... my back is a whole other story but my feet don't hurt! I chose this pair in hopes the material would stay cleaner than my other 2 pairs. But if you're needing a shoe that will provide comfort and keep your feet from hurting any Adida shoe with cloudfoam insole and midsole would be a great choice! Just got this pair in today and love the look! They'll be very easy to clean. I only have one complaint about the cloudfoam and that is he holds on to bacteria too well. Even through numerous washes. My 2 old pairs smell HORRENDOUS! I do not recommend letting them air dry after washing them bc the smell gets worse. I naturally have smelly feet and I use a foot powder in all of my shoes which has worked until I started wearing the cloudfoam shoes. So keep that in mind if you're like me and the stinch of your feet could knock someone unconscious.

I originally saw these at kohls and bought my first pair and fell in love. The cloud soles are so nice and the straps are perfectly snug but not to tight where it feels like circulation is being cut off. When they sold out at kohls I found them on good old Amazon I bought 3 pairs in other colors and a pair for my daughter.
The fabric they're made with washes very well. They're super comfy especially if you have any issues with your feet or ankles. They're also priced very fairly
I will purchase these shoes over and over again! They re so comfy, no laces, and super cute! Between working out, remodeling a home, and yard work, these are my go to shoes!
Excellent for balance in the gym. I do only weights and it s great. The flat sole is key. Comfy and true fit

These feel so awesome on my feet. I ordered these for 28. I just think these are knock offs for sure. The sole is silver in the back. I went to Adidas website because although they feel nice a coworker have a pair which inspired me to get a pair. Hers are black and really nice. This color is not on the website I even checked Khols. They seem real flimsy and the ones on the official website does not have silver on the back part of the sole foam. I ordered this 2nd pair used but in good condition they look brand new. I order used items and-have got great deals and the box might have just been opened and returned. I have to see if I can return these. I bought them for work I stand 6 hours and my feet must feel good. I ordered another pair new at the same price to arrived today! The did not arrive they are running late I ordered those first. . I will do a follow up in 2 weeks..I hope I am really surprised .
I use these shoes while traveling and they are super comfy for long flights and running between gates the support is awesome and at the end of the day my feet is smiling!!

Bought these for my daughter. She s had them a few months now. They have held up well she is 9 . Easy in and off and cute. Not the most supportive or the best for exercise but great fro every day run around. Would purchase again

The insoles of this shoe are weird. The cloud foam is not removable, and the insole does not go the full length of the footbed. I added insoles from my old pair of shoes on top of the cloud foam and that solves the issue. They also make my feet hot. They are stylish and I get a lot of compliments on them. I ordered in two colors and wear them a fair amount.

representative_reviews.text: I wanted to get a new pair of non-slip shoes for my restaurant gig, as my last ones have worn out. I love Merrells so I was happy when I saw that they offer a slip-resistant shoe. However, I quickly find out that these are NOT slip-resistant. In fact, they are probably the most slippery pair of shoes I have ever worn. I'm very surprised that no one else has reported this problem. DO NOT buy these for restaurant work, it is a death sentence.

I bought these in August and wear them one or two days a week. I walk a lot but these shoes should be able to stand up to just walking a little better. The lining over the big toe areas and both heels has worn out and left ridges of bunched material that gives me blisters. I really expect more than a couple hundred miles out of a pair of shoes.
it was too tight for me I guess i should have tried the wide but my son with a thin foot could not fit his foot in the shoe either i was hoping for a easy to slip on and off shoe

I bought my first and last pair of Merrells. I was told they are great for plantar fasciitis and what not, and are comfortable. They have no support whatsoever. The shoe feels like you are walking on a piece of steel. No padding or arch support at all. They are literally flat inside. Wore them for one shift at work and could hardly walk when done they made my feet hurt so bad. Won't go with this brand again.

I've only had these for about a month and of course I'm 2 days outside of the return window for Amazon and the toes start coming apart from the shoe. I think she should last longer than a month on light duty use and I'm hoping I can get in touch with Amazon to either return or exchange them. Buyer beware

Pictured shoe tread has a smooth diamond shaped pattern. This pattern does not collect small rocks, sand, and dirt like the more aggressive Merrill treads. The one received is the more aggressive tread that collects things, sticks to the shoe and tracks into the house and scratches hardwood floors. This has happened with several other vendors as well -- they just don't match the picture with the product sold.

I always wear men 9 and most of my regular shoes are supposedly not as comfortable as this shoe, but oh my god this was very disappointed for being very painful and annoying after only a couple of hours with my perfect shoes size! Unfortunately I don t recommend for people who look for comfortable experience!!!

Just started wearing my latest pare of Jungle Moc's. This is my 5th or 6th pair of them that I received a couple weeks ago. The back of the shoe has changed in a bad way! The heal collapses when you step into them. One of the great features has always been that you slip into them. Not any more, i have to reach down and help my heal get into the new pair. Also the sole has been getting worse! Last years wasn't pair wasn't great but this years is supper slippery. Just wore them out in the rain and the sole was super slippery and dangerous on basic side walks and outside the mall. What a bummer!! Not sure I'll be able to send these back after wearing them, I want to but dog gone it I'm not sure what i'm going to replace them with. Signed, Supper loyal customer very disappointed!!!
The shoes were stiff and there was not enough cushion inside. They were uncomfortable, I am returning them.

I purchased these because my original pair were finally nearing their end of life after more than a decade. I don't know what Merrell's done - but it's not good. These are just awful. I bought these a few months ago and finally got around to starting to wear them regularly they're very noisy and I can't quite figure out what the deal is it sounds like rubber rubbing against rubber with every step. It's not the sole making contact with a floor either happens even on carpeted surfaces. So much so, that people around me mention it. The comfort is NOT what it used to be either. Money poorly spent these are now in the trash bin.

I'm having a serious issue with these sliding on tile floors. I've cleaned thoroughly the soles but the problem persist. Will the seller please contact me to find out if I just got a bad batch or if this is a known issue?

I tried the shoes on and immediately noticed as soon as I take a step my feet slips out of the back heel. It seems like them made the back heel part too wide compared to the mid front part of the shoe which fits normally. My toes are snug in the front so I know it's NOT that the shoe size is too big. Actually I normally hover between a 9.5M and a 10M 9.5M being on the smaller end and that is the size I went with for these. Its too bad because I really like these shows especially the soles are well made, but if they slip off the heel when I walk that won't work. I could try going a half size smaller but I'm afraid it will then be too tight around the toes. The other thing is the suede material and shape of the shoe makes them look like house slippers.
Returned due to manufacturing defect of sole plate on left shoe, arch was 1 2 inch higher, not wearable. That same shoe also appeared to have been beaten up on exterior some. No idea why

These shoes are awful! The soles are so stiff I feel like I'm wearing cleats. Not even exaggerating. It feels like very hard plastic. Even the upper part of the shoes are painfully stiff. They formed to me feet after several days of wearing them. I have a long, narrow foot size 13 and these fit me perfectly. The arch support is great, not too much or too little. They have good grip indoors and outside. I have used them in rain and snow and they handle very well. I m not sure why they have little pieces of material on each side of the stretchy material across the arch? But that is just a small aesthetic weirdness and does not detract from the excellence fit and performance of these shoes. I will probably buy a second pair.

I wore them every other day for a while and realized on the days I wore the black pair my feet would hurt and the seemed tight fit. One the days I would wore the brown pair no problem at all. Well I figured out I got old stock of the brown which is made in China and the black pair is made in Vietnam. Needless to say, the brown pair is about wore out and the black pair sits in my closet looking nearly new. I few weeks ago I ordered another brown pair hoping the black pair was just a coincidence. No, they are just as uncomfortable as the black pair I had and yes, they were made in Vietnam. Merrell changed these shoes when they changed countries, they are manufactured in. Shame on them. Laces are for kids, it's part of their journey through life. I remember the very first time I successfully tied my own shoes, it was a joyous occasion. Laces are one of the original life lessons as it teaches a child that not everything is going to be simple, or straight forward. At times, even a bit confusing, but if you persevere and remain vigilant you will succeed. That was about 3500-4000 days into my life. But now I'm at 19,000 days and I'm damn tired of tying anything. I stopped tying my shoes well over 1,000 days ago. I've earned my keep in this world. I was doing things at 10,000 days that would make today's young adults shutter in fear and disbelief. I've rambled through my life dealing with issues and jobs and money and life stuff and the whole time, tying my damn shoes. Enough is enough, my reward, slip on shoes that are comfortable and make me look like a man-on-the-go. How much time have I spent over the years tying my shoes? Approximately, 3 Million seconds, that I will never get back. Well, a new day has dawned and its high time I get my reward!

Updated review after ordering a second pair 23 months after buying first pair I ordered my second pair and have just begun wearing them. The new pair so far seems good. However I made the mistake of ordering Gunsmoke Grey instead of the color of my first pair, Dark Earth. I HATE the Gunsmoke Grey color, which is just different enough from the appearance on the web page for me to hate. I've been struggling with whether to exchange them. I don't really want to return them, because the sale is over and I'll probably have to pay full price for a different color replacement, but I just do not like this color. Otherwise, however, the new Jungle Mocs are fine. They are comfortable, and they don't have the squeaking problem that my first pair had until I fixed it see my original review below for details . My first pair was becoming a very loose fit over time, not at all snug like they are new, but not too loose to wear. My plan when I ordered the new pair was to continue to wear the old pair as my daily at home shoe, and only wear the new pair for work. The first pair, which was Dark Earth, is discolored after nearly two years of daily wear, but not as bad as I feared they'd be after two years. But I do mostly computer work and meeting with people. If I did a different type of work, the shoes could look a lot worse by now. My new pair is Gunsmoke Grey, which I don't care for and regret ordering. I don't use them for hiking or other trail use - I prefer running shoes or hiking boots for that - so I have no opinion about how they hold up off pavement. Overall these are excellent shoes. First Updated Review After 16 months of daily wear, I'm still happy with these shoes, though I'm a little disappointed that they seem to be stretching, making the shoes feel looser. My big concern after buying them was the squeaking in one of the shoes, but the trick I described in my original review below did the trick. The shoe has never again squeaked. I still recommend these shoes. Original review The shoes have been fine since I found out how to stop them from squeaking. This is a problem many Merrell owners complain about. For me, only my right shoe squeaked. The left shoe has never squeaked. The right shoe squeak was barely audible at first, but after three weeks, it was becoming loud enough that I knew I could not live with it. I was ready to return them to Amazon, but fortunately I did some research first that allowed me to solve the problem. I've now owned the shoes two months and am completely satisfied. The way I solved the problem was to place two dryer sheets fabric softener sheet under the insole of the squeaking shoe. I was skeptical that it would work, but the squeaking stopped immediately and five weeks later, there's still no squeaking. I've read that another solution is to sprinkle some talcum powder under the insole. I bought the traditional round-lug Moc rather than the Vibram sole. If I used the shoe for hiking, I'd have gotten the Vibram sole, but I prefer a lace-up shoe for rugged terrain. I wear these as my everyday shoe. They're perfect for that. When I'm on the trail, I use hiking boots or running shoes. I bought the Jungle Mocs to replace a pair of imitation Jungle Mocs Hathaway Comfort Mocassins that I wore for six years and that held up well, but were never comfortable. The Merrells are a huge improvement in comfort over the imitations. I hope they hold up as well as the imitation mocs I was wearing before. I considered docking a star for the squeaking, but it was so easily solved that I decided to give the shoes a full five stars.

I ordered up half a size and they are a perfect fit. The most comfortable shoes I ve ever owned. I ordered a second pair in a different color.

representative_reviews.text: "I love these cloudfoam shoes from Adidas! They fit perfectly, they re light, perfect from working out, the tongue is built in so it doesn t move around while you workout. I highly recommend this pattern as well!" That was my review the day after I bought them. All was fine and well at the gym. After 3 visits to the gym, running on the treadmill for 15 minutes, going 7mph for probably a total of 7 minutes out the 15, and then lifting for 75 minutes, I started to experience severe pain in both of my knees near my MCL. I tried to ignore it, thinking it was just sore muscles from working out. Then started my L ankle pain. It progressively got worse, and eventually I couldn't even walk anymore. I started to assume it was the shoes seeing as there is ZERO support from these shoes. I ended up returning them, and continued to work out wearing different shoes. The damage was done, and things got much much worse. I'm a nurse, so I tried to just ice, take ibuprofen, and rest. That wasn't doing the trick so I went to my nearest urgent care. After 7 x-ray images, I found out I had severe tendinitis and swelling in my L ankle, and both of my knees. Thankfully it wasn't a hairline fracture, which I was thinking it may have been considering how excruciating the pain was. No gym for 2 weeks, ankle wrap, naproxen, rest, and icing was my treatment. Not a fun outcome seeing as I go to the gym 5-6x a week. IN SUMMARY Do not buy these shoes if you intend to use them at the gym.

I was very excited to try my new shoes. However, after my 45 min workout, I developed severe blisters under my foot which is strange. It seems like the shoe does not provide cushion and as a result my foot could feel the friction of walking on the treadmill. Thinking of returning them!

I would not recommend these shoes to anyone who would use them for a lot of walking, you will not receive any support.

Unfortunately, I returned them after using them just one time. If judging on looks alone, I'd rate it a 5 5 for the bright colors and casual style. Comfort drops it down to 1 5 though. Even though I got my usual size, this pair is VERY tight. It was a struggle slipping it on with or without socks. The length is probably true to size but the width is for very narrow feet. Exacerbating the problem is the stitching that goes across the front of the shoes, just below the laces. The stitching absolutely has no give and kept rubbing against my feet. I wore this to work and by the 6th hour, I was limping because both my feet HURT. Even in the pictures, you can see that the part with the stitches dips in and makes the shoes narrower in that area. My feet were red and swollen by the time I took off the shoes. Knowing how uncomfortable they were, I wasn't willing to keep them. These are also walking shoes so if you're looking for support for plantar fascitis, this pair is not for you. With how narrow they are, one would probably have to size up at least one full size to be able to fit both inserts and your foot in.

Loved the look of this shoe, but not as cushy as expected. On a scale of 1 to 10 regarding style, I would say a 10. On a scale of 1 to 10 on comfort, I would say a 7 average comfort . The shoe is extremely lightweight and has a thin layer of foam which was hardly noticeable in the ball of the foot. This could be seen as an pro as a light weight shoe for traveling or casual wear. I bought these hoping for a cushy running shoe, but did not use for running because the padding was so thin on the sole compared to my Nikes and Brooks. Heel did have padding, but still very light on the padding compared to a traditional running shoe. Ball of foot and toe area, little padding. I run anywhere between 1.5-4 miles 3-5 times per week and will also walk 1-2 miles on other days. The shoe provided more than adequate comfort for walking several miles and did well while walking miles upon miles in Europe. I did not have sore feet! So style was perfect, but comfort for any running activity beyond extensive walking may require a more heavily padded shoe especially if you desire arch support. I did use with arch supports in Europe and found the shoe to be a complete success in meeting my needs for 50miles if walking in 5 days. Again, shoe held up for miles of walking and was comfortable with arch support inserts.

My previous review was much too verbose. Basically JUST BUY THEM. I find that my feet are not as narrow as I age, but don t qualify as wide in shoes and these are roomy enough for someone like me. I own these shoes in 3 different colors. They ve been through nursing school, clinical rotations, work as an RN, amusement parks, hikes you name it, and have proved the most comfortable, faithful shoes thus far. If you like more OOMPH and cushion, I would recommend upgrading to Adidas Ultraboosts

I own about a dozen pair of Adidas shoes. I'm a true size 7 in women's and a size 5.5 in men's and youth. I saw this pair in my size on sale at Amazon warehouse and quickly ordered it. Unfortunately, I returned them after using them just one time. If judging on looks alone, I'd rate it a 5 5 for the bright colors and casual style. Comfort drops it down to 1 5 though. Even though I got my usual size, this pair is VERY tight. It was a struggle slipping it on with or without socks. The length is probably true to size but the width is for very narrow feet. Exacerbating the problem is the stitching that goes across the front of the shoes, just below the laces. The stitching absolutely has no give and kept rubbing against my feet. I wore this to work and by the 6th hour, I was limping because both my feet HURT. Even in the pictures, you can see that the part with the stitches dips in and makes the shoes narrower in that area. My feet were red and swollen by the time I took off the shoes. Knowing how uncomfortable they were, I wasn't willing to keep them. These are also walking shoes so if you're looking for support for plantar fascitis, this pair is not for you. With how narrow they are, one would probably have to size up at least one full size to be able to fit both inserts and your foot in.

representative_reviews.text: "I love these cloudfoam shoes from Adidas! They fit perfectly, they re light, perfect from working out, the tongue is built in so it doesn t move around while you workout. I highly recommend this pattern as well!" That was my review the day after I bought them. All was fine and well at the gym. After 3 visits to the gym, running on the treadmill for 15 minutes, going 7mph for probably a total of 7 minutes out the 15, and then lifting for 75 minutes, I started to experience severe pain in both of my knees near my MCL. I tried to ignore it, thinking it was just sore muscles from working out. Then started my L ankle pain. It progressively got worse, and eventually I couldn't even walk anymore. I started to assume it was the shoes seeing as there is ZERO support from these shoes. I ended up returning them, and continued to work out wearing different shoes. The damage was done, and things got much much worse. I'm a nurse, so I tried to just ice, take ibuprofen, and rest. That wasn't doing the trick so I went to my nearest urgent care. After 7 x-ray images, I found out I had severe tendinitis and swelling in my L ankle, and both of my knees. Thankfully it wasn't a hairline fracture, which I was thinking it may have been considering how excruciating the pain was. No gym for 2 weeks, ankle wrap, naproxen, rest, and icing was my treatment. Not a fun outcome seeing as I go to the gym 5-6x a week. IN SUMMARY Do not buy these shoes if you intend to use them at the gym.

Honestly, the Skechers were better when it came to offering both cushioning and support. Only a week after wearing these, I went out and bought expensive insoles. That's not a good sign. I'm disappointed.

They are so lightweight and the most comfortable sneakers I have ever owned. I didn t break them in before the trip, and found I didn t need to. However, for the first day or two, the tongue of the shoe did rub against the top of my foot ankle where my no-show socks didn t cover. But that didn t last long and I used clear ankle socks for the first day of a lot of walking and then didn t need to again.

The Adidas Cloudfoam Pure Running Shoes are shoes meant for any age and any activity. They can be worn for running, weight lifting, other exercising, or just as everyday shoes however, I purchased them for everyday wear. I am a college student who walks to class every day. These shoes have been perfect for that. My feet have not hurt one bit. I chose the black and white speckled colored ones to accommodate for comfortable, lazy-day outfits, or cute outfits with jeans! Neutrals are always a go-to in my opinion, because I am definitely one to want to get as much use out of a product as possible. This shoe wipes clean and doesn t stain which is amazing! I was worried living in Iowa, with heavy snow and rain, that the shoe would be destroyed quite quickly. I was surprised to see how easily they wipe clean. The Cloudfoam midsole and outsole are combined for step-in comfort and superior cushioning and the sock liner molds to hug the foot as well for extra support. I personally like the high ankle as it gives more stability. The Cloudfoam pure running shoes are super comfortable and lightweight and the fabric is a very breathable mesh. I appreciate that my feet do not sweat when I wear these shoes because of how breathable they are. I love the slick and clean look and that it feels like I am running on air, yet have plenty of support. They are super cute and come exactly as pictured. The shoes seem to run a half-size big, so I would keep that in mind when purchasing or prepare to wear a little bit of a thicker sock and or purchase an insole for the shoes. These shoes are more of a slip on shoe. There are laces on the shoe, but there is no tongue, so slipping the shoe on and off can be done quite easily. With that being said, you can pull the laces a little tighter if needed. I definitely recommend this product for anyone looking for a good tennis shoe, hence why I rated these shoes four out of five stars! I am quite happy with my purchase and cannot wait to continue to get use out of them.
