representative_reviews.text: Seemed OK for light walking but it is tight around toes. Long walks resulted in rubbing the side of the small toe and creating a blister.

I m very impressed so far with theses shoes. I m not entirely sure how to rate the width but they fit perfectly. I guess I have extra wide feet? Normally I would buy 10.5 or size 11 so that fact that size 10 fits so well tells me the other shoes are too narrow maybe. UPDATE 1 Oct 2019.... So a couple of weeks ago I noticed the stiff interior backing on my left shoe on the heel area began to rub against back of my foot casing blisters. Overall the feel of the shoes are comfortable still, though my feet do start to get sore after a while of walking. As for the the rubbing on the back of my left foot, i think its happening because the back part gets caved in when i try to slide my foot in. The whole reason I got these shoes is because its painful sometimes to bend over to put on shoes. I wanted something without laces that would just slip on but looked like real shoes. I have been using moleskin patches to protect the back of my left foot but I shouldn't have to if the who was constructed a little better. perhaps my left shoe is defective since my right shoe doesn't rub the same way but it also caves in sometimes when I put them on. I still don't regret buying these shoes because they are still comfortable, but in not sure i would buy them again. I probably will try a different model or brand next time. Update 13 Oct 2019 I ve added a photo of the affected area. It s definitely a design flaw that could have been avoided with cushioning that went all the way to the top on the inside of the heel. I m now using a heel liner on that spot since the bandages and moleskin is impractical for everyday use. I can t wear them anymore without something to cover this part. The heel cushion doesn t adhere to the inside fabric very well so I don t think this will be an effective long term solution either.

You'll see there is virtually no visible wear on the top, and there's almost no wear on the bottom on this shoe after moderate use. However, if you look inside the shoe's heel in the photo, and this happened on both shoes, the fabric wore off to expose a plastic heel component, allowing it to protrude. Once that happens, they go into the trash unless you like sharp edges digging into the back of your foot. With this laceless shoes, there can be some slight heel slippage that results in deterioration of the shoe, causing its failure long before the rest of the shoe wears out.
The inner heel support that is made out of plastic will quickly wear through the material inside the shoe causing cuts and blisters on your heel. Be warned!

I bought these quite some time ago, waited too long to wear them out and about...I don't know if I just got a bad pair or what. But there is a spot in the toes that causes a lot of pain on the large knuckle of my big toe after walking for more than 15 minutes. Also a lot of blistering. Thought I'd just needed to break them in, but they still never got better. The toe pain continued to last for days even when I wasn't wearing these shoes. I should have tried them on earlier instead of waiting, that way I could have returned them.

I generally really like Skechers. I bought these to walk and work out in. Very disappointed because I can t wear them for more than 15 minutes without starting a blister on my little toes. Didn t wear them in the first few weeks that I had them, so return period expired 30 day and I couldn t return them.
Very disappointed in the quality. Not much natural fiber s anywhere. Shoe exterior felt like rubber.

these broke in nicely but after less than a year i started getting rubbing on the heal of one foot. There is a stiff plastic support peice coming up from the heal that is digging into the back of my foot, making these shoes unwearable.I assume it's some sort of achilies support but it's not supporting my achilies, more like ripping my skin. It's wearing through the shoe fabric and has really made these shoes unwearable. Avoid these, buy something that will last.

These are made for slip on and of with ease. The 'shoe strings' that are on it are not tightenable. Is that a real word? For me these are more a slipper than a shoe. Once put on they seem to fit okay but when walking the heel lifted up. Making me think there may be blisters in the near future. This may be my size but I am average size 10 nothing special. They look very nice and appear to be built very well. If they stretch in the future then any form of current support is probably lost.

After a month and a half of normal daily use, the inside pad is worn completely away under the ball of my foot. The inside where the heel rests is worn out on both sides. The tread on the bottom is peeling away. Junk shoes. I can t return them even though they re crap. I missed the window by a couple weeks. Lame.

Update Updated to 3 stars. I threw these into the water and let them air dry. They no longer rub against my skin. I've been able to go about 20 miles in a day. Everything is great except the top of the shoe rubs against my skin and is causing blisters to form. I have to wear tape where it rubs to prevent that from happening. New shoes shouldn t require that already.

The hard plastic support behind the heel is tearing through the fabric and padding and rubbing sore spots on my heels. The toe area where the sole rubber attaches is pulling apart. I bought these on July 8th, 2021 and they get maybe 1-2 hours of wear on average through the week, more so on weekends. They are not quality made. I've had cheap Wal-Mart shoes outlast these.

The plastic backing in the inside heel area came out. It rubbed a blister on my son's ankle. Could have been a fluke, but I don't think I'll buy these again. The company wasn't very good at solving my problem. I would have spent more money returning them to the company than what they cost. I don't like to return to Amazon if it isn't their product.

I hate to do this because I have truly loved many of my Skechers shoes in the past. In this instance it was particularly painful because I thought I had found exactly what I was looking for. In fact they could have been great. Sadly, within the second or third time I put the shoes on, the left heel cup for the left shoe had folded over inside the fabric or the padding inside had bunched up and created a painful lump on the back of my foot. I have given a lot of effort to trying to smooth it out myself or get it back into place, all to no avail. The shoes are unwearable and a complete waste of money. I would return them, but I hate returning shoes I have worn outside. I don't think it's right, as I don't know what they could do with them after the return. Regardless, I am deeply disappointed and haunted by what might have been.
I disliked the way that it slipped up on my foot when I was walking. It just felt to lose and I definitely could not run in them

I found these shoes very comfortable and better yet they provided a lot of support. I am a big fan of slip-ones, but many times they lack much support around the ankle and mid-foot. Not true with these. I have to wear them 14 hours a day sometimes, and they meet the challenge.

The overall fit and feel of these shoes have generally met my expectations. I will not try to say they are perfect, but they are close so far. I was interested in obtaining a slip-on type sneaker to eliminate tying laces. Having had Skechers before, size was consistent. Being older my needs are different so I am not sure if heavy running or sports use would work for everyone. Shoes have cushioning and are great for walking.
Very comfortable, 2nd time we ve bought these for work. Standing on a cement floor all day, these really help

A comfortable, easy care shoe. I bought this pair to replace the previous pair when they finally do wear out. They are still going strong. I walk my dogs on sidewalks and pavement and the shoe provides good support and breathability in the warm weather. I threw them in the washing machine and they came out almost like new considering I ve worn them every day for a year and a half. This shoe works for me.
The memory foam is not as comfortable as I would have expected and one shoe's memory foam seemed to be over too far at the heel.

With high arches it is hard to find a pair of slip on's that fit without putting pressure on the top of my foot. These fit just right and were very comfortable. Wore them all weekend while I was on my feet for long periods. They felt great and with the arch support I didn't have any back pains at the end of the day. Very satisfied!!!

So I suffered from untreated diabetes until lately A story for another day . As a result, I'm the proud recipient of diabetic neuropathy. For those unfamiliar, this is an incredibly painful disorder that causes nerve damage through your legs, feet and arms. Walking can be excruciating. Standing is unbearable at times. It was recommended that I get diabetic shoes. I wasn't excited about sporting "Frankenstein" shoes as most diabetic shoes - let's face it- look horrible. And priced anywhere from 150 and up didn't light my fires either. Then I found these.... They weren't listed as "Diabetic Footwear", but I read reviews and they sounded like they might do the trick. And at a third of the price, I figured it was worth a shot. To my amazement- a DAY AFTER wearing these, I felt like running! It was like having a cushion or anti-fatigue mat strapped to my feet. I'm on my feet a good 4 hours a day at work and now my feet don't feel it at all. I still have the neuropathy. That's not going anywhere. But these Sketcher's have given me a relief I didn't think I'd get from a shoe. Solid fit, GREAT style shoe and ultimate comfort.

I started out this year by breaking my ankle and my leg ankle has never quite recovered properly. In addition, I coincidentally developed Morton's neuroma and plantar fasciitis in the foot with the broken ankle, and then ended up with it in both feet. Because of this I really need a weird combination of features in an everyday casual shoe. This is the only shoes I have found at any price that meets all my requirements. The toe box is wide but not too wide for the neuroma while the arch support is excellent for the plantar fasciitis , and the whole cushioned insole is incredible soft and padded for both issues . Being loafers they're very easy on off, but while I'm wearing them they stay in place very well like a lace-up sneaker. I will probably get these in all the colors they offer so I can rotate them and they'll last me a while.
If you have wide feet and you want a slip on shoe with good traction for active this is a great choice.

I've always had a problem because I have a wide foot and a high instep. These sneakers feel great, they feel snug but not tight. There seems to be plenty of support on all sides including the arch. I also like the ease of slipping in and out of them.

A comfortable shoe to wear all day. My only compliant is the sole makes a squeak noise when wet and walking on LVT flooring. Update after 5 months of wearing. The shoe lining is worn out inside exposing a piece of hard plastic in the shoe at the heel rubbing my right foot and making a sore. See photo.

This is the men's equivalent of the Skechers walking shoe I wear. I've had mine for 18 months, powerwalk 4-5 days per week up to 2 miles on asphalt so I would have thought they'd wear out by now but so far only the sole is just beginning to wear smooth. I ordered half size up for myself so I could insert an arch support insole - as with all of my shoes After my husband had a stroke, he was advised to start a daily exercise routine. I got him these shoes so he can avoid disrupting his day by taking time out for a gym because I know that will fade out. This way, he can take off out the door and because these shoes are so comfortable, there's less excuse to not go. He has not experienced any discomfort so far. Since he likes them so much, I'll order another pair just for running errands and daily wear.

Bought this shoe for my invalid husband. It satisfied his desire to look like a sports shoe, and the plus - it does not need lacing. He said it feels good and comfortable and its lighter in weight than what he was wearing. He can put it on and take it off without help. Exactly what we were looking for.
I walk all day and these keep my feet cool and are very comfortable. This also helps with my back too.

I ordered these for my 70 year father and he loves them! He actually wants me to order him another pair. He thanks me everytime I see him. He also says they are so comfortable especially for wide feet perfect fit and great arch support.

representative_reviews.text: Good fit for the first few hours, then they started slipping off my heels. Super uncomfortable to wear now. I wish I had the box to return them and get a smaller size.
The left shoe is slightly different than the right. The left is more loose than the right which fits great.
Do not fit way to tight and forget about refund its been almost a month and still no refund bunch of bull
Seemed OK for light walking but it is tight around toes. Long walks resulted in rubbing the side of the small toe and creating a blister.
I would recommend anyone ordering to oversize your regular size. I ordered size 11- never wear that size and it is too small Maybe go one size over and they may fit

Bought this shoe for use solely on my treadmill. Show for fit checks all the boxes. Beware though of poor construction. In less than 30 days the sewing on the top of shoe became unraveled. With slight flexing of the top and General toe area, the stitching started coming undone. Keep in mine the shoe was only worn while using our treadmill.

These shoes have such great reviews and I am befuddled. I tried the "wide" and regular and no matter what, it's the the front tip of shoes last 3" concave in and squish rub the rt side of foot. I tried differents socks, size etc and it doesn't matter. These shows literally hurt my feet, lol. I am unsure if I am even going to try and return but I am done with sketchers. I like the style, look and slip on with no shoestrings and could have handled small issues but these literally hurt to put on.
I love the styling of the shoe but even though I ordered at 12 4e it was still tight on the top of my foot. I could not stretch it for enough to make it comfortable.

The shoes were too long and too narrow. I had to pay 6.95 to return them. I thought if it was a fit issue you received a free exchange of size. My Mistake. I am awaiting the shoes I had to re-order. I hope these fit, I do do not want another 6.95 charge to return them. Very disappointed! Shoe Mall is or was rated F by the BBB. Gets over 100 complaints annually.

Second pair after the first wore out at the heel exposing a metal support that dig into the back of my heel. I like the idea of a slip on so bought another here as Sketcher stores said they don t carry because they have been discontinued. This pair are way too narrow for some reason so I had to cut the elastic straps across the top to allow a half way decent fit. One thing to know is that if your a runner and sweat that all the foam will absorb the sweat and get pretty funky after a while.

I've had several pairs of these shoes over several years. However, the last two pair have fallen apart in exactly the same way, The stitching comes loose and the rubber soul that comes up and over the toe comes loose, in less than 90 days. I was hoping to return them but noooooooo... I'm 71 years old. I don't jog or exercise in them or use them for work. This shoe should last a long time on an old fart like me. But noooooooooo. I used to love them but they are just a waste of money now.
Giant hole in the heel of left shoe only. The shoes have only been worn for 1.5 months! The other one is fine. And no, I don't have any Trump bone spurs on my left heel.

These are made for slip on and of with ease. The 'shoe strings' that are on it are not tightenable. Is that a real word? For me these are more a slipper than a shoe. Once put on they seem to fit okay but when walking the heel lifted up. Making me think there may be blisters in the near future. This may be my size but I am average size 10 nothing special. They look very nice and appear to be built very well. If they stretch in the future then any form of current support is probably lost.

UPDATE 6 months later Sole separated from shoe. Past return period. You might want to pass on these shoes I've been buying sketchers since there were sketchers and I've always been happy with the product. As I'm getting older and heavier it becomes harder to tie my shoes. So I wanted a pair tennis shoes that I did not have to tie but still fit better than the slip on. I was excited to find out that there was one and I purchased two sets of these. The first set of my regular shoe size I felt to be a little loose so I purchased the next size down and found to be way too small. So what I found was it takes a little getting used to wearing the the slip on where you were used to being able to really tighten down your gym shoes with shoestrings. What I found after about 48 hours of wearing them is that slightly looser fit is really super comfortable. What I perceived as a slipping up and down at first was just a looser fit and there is no slipping inside the shoe. I worn these with socks and without socks both very comfortable with the memory foam soul. So after a few days I like the fit, I love the look, and they feel great. As always the be an update in the next 30 to 60 days

These shoes do not fit properly. They are too wide around the heel and I feel like I'm carrying the shoes instead of wearing them. After a day of walking in them, my legs were hurting pretty badly from basically wearing ankle weights. I have another Skechers model of shoe that I love and are incredibly comfortable, that's why these shoes are such a disappointment. I have a normal foot and have never had this issue with a shoe. They are totally unusable.
Often have trouble sizing shoes, as I have long toes and wide toe spread. Fits my size perfectly, very comfortable to wear. About to get a 2nd pair...

The overall fit and feel of these shoes have generally met my expectations. I will not try to say they are perfect, but they are close so far. I was interested in obtaining a slip-on type sneaker to eliminate tying laces. Having had Skechers before, size was consistent. Being older my needs are different so I am not sure if heavy running or sports use would work for everyone. Shoes have cushioning and are great for walking.

I like this product very much. These are very good looking shoes that have an extremely comfortable memory foam footbed. Though these shoes are best suited for casual wear they have very nice soles that are aggressive enough to offer decent slip protection during most casual activities. Since I typically wear an 11 W in most brands, I was a bit hesitant purchasing shoes with an EXTRA WIDE foot bed. Thanks to the elastic strapping across the tongue area, this product fits perfectly with a lite weight sock. They slide on easily with the aid of a shoe horn and there is no slippage at the arch or the heal areas when walking. I couldn't be happier with this purchase. If they hold up for a reasonable amount of time I will definitely buy this product again.

I was going to drop this 1 star bc according to the pics the pebble is more tan but in real life this color is more green. It's like an army green or olive green. It is not brown or tan like in the photos. I will let that go bc these are comfy. Got the 9.5 4E which feels just a hair tighter than my other sketchers in the same size but these are laceless so maybe that's why. I'm talkin a hair so no biggy. Unless you are hiking or running no lace shoes are great. Easy slip on and off. And they stay put they don't flop off. Out of the box these are pretty good. UPDATE Almost 2 yrs later. Ordered another pair went a size up to 10x wide and perfect. Went with the blue gray white and they look good. The blue is darker in person than in my pics. Fits great plenty of toe room fits snug enough to where they don't slip off. No blemishes or defects. Will be buying more. UPDATE A few months later and I got the brown pair. 1 pic is inside 1 pic outside. In sunlight or daylight they look more brown tan. I normally wear a 9.5 wide but the 1st pair I got seemed to crunch my toes in certain situations as they are not a tie down fit so went with the 10 wide. The blue ones were perfect but one time as I went to put them on I scrunched the back heel portion and that made this plastic piece inside bend and it would rub against my foot which was uncomfortable so don't step on the back heel part. The blue ones seemed more comfortable for some reason. Not that the brown ones are not. Next color will be the light gray or the black ones but they seem to be out of black all the time and they cost more. Good walking shoes but if you order a little big they will fly off trying to run in them. UPDATE Bought another pair in different color. I think I've purchased 7 pairs of these. The price keeps going up. The only thing I don't like and you should avoid is bending the back part. People and myself have stepped on the backend where the heal slides in and the plastic there is not forgiving. One you bend it you can't bend it back and it will dig into the back of your feet making them unwearable.

Fit is tight when first put on with reasonably thin socks. If you want to wear thicker socks, increase the size by 1 2. I wanted them to walk to the mail box with very good lateral stiffness at the heel as I do not want to twist my ankle with slip-ins. They are very well made for the cost. The loop at the back of the shoe should be larger so you can get your finger int it to help pull it ups. It is way too small to do that. I may use a shoe horn to make the situation easier to deal with. There is a tradeoff between being tight and putting hem on quickly and easier. The shoehorn is the best solution in my case. A very well made shoe for the cost.
The fit was true to previous sketcher shoes I have worn. The shoes were light weight with maximum support for long walks. Very satisfied. True to size.

I ordered these for my husband, who loves Skechers. I ordered two kinds of sneakers and he has neuropathy in his feet and he needs a very wide toe box. I got these in two sizes as shoes cannot be the slightest bit tight on him. He loved the slip on idea as he has a bad back. However, the larger size, which felt better on his feet, he was afraid once they broke in they might be too tight so he chose to go with a Skechers sneaker that has traditional ties so he could adjust them.

You know right when you put a shoe on your foot whether it's right or not. I tried on shoes at a local store first to get the size right. The same size I wear in all my favorite shoes and boots fit perfectly. They're very comfortable and feel "substantial" without being bulky or heavy. Can't speak for wear yet, they're new. Living with severe back issues, good shoes are a necessity of life. These shoes are comfortable on my sensitive feet all day and keep my back fairly happy. The soles are firm without being stiff and the support is good. Since I live in the northwest I wish these shoes had Goretex or some form of built in water proofing. Other than that I love the shoes so far.
These shoes are great!! They are true to size, width is good!! Side note I just wish they were skid proof!! Other than that worth the buy!!
This is the only shoe my size 13, quad E ,flat footed husband can wear comfortably. I wish they had better arch support but we buy insoles for them.
This is the 4th pair from Amazon and they fit perfectly. I have found that this sneaker has the best support for my feet and they feel great.
Fits great as thought, although the heel achilies area is a little loose. Good for walks, probably for jogging, not so much for high impact running sports training.

There are times when I'm flying out the door and I don't have time to tie shoes. These just slide right on, and stay on. I was worried with a step in shoe that they might be a bit sloppy, but they are just right. I won't order the extra wide next time as it is a little too wide and gives my foot too much play.
Excellent shoes that fit great. Slide on very easily with shoe horn. Just what I needed after hip replacement surgery.
The shoe looked great and the quality seemed good, but, unfortunately, it was too short and too narrow for my growing son's feet.

Got the shoes and they looked great - tried them on and walked around a bit in my house for a few minutes - felt a bump or something in the left shoe top on the inside a bit above the big toe - figured it was my sock - wore them to go out for a bit the next day but the same thing - got home and felt inside and found an area where several materials are coming together and glued - one area was not holding and was coming apart which corresponded with the discomfort on the top of my foot - you can feel the glue and the frayed material edges - along with where it was coming loose - felt the right shoe and it really has the same poor cuts and gluing - it just wasn't coming apart yet - should be stiched - not glued and the edges should not be fraying on the material - it's not seen but is a sign of poor construction in my opinion - I won't try another pair - disappointment at 50 - Skechers sometimes delights and sometimes does not!!

This is the 4th pair of these I have bought for my husband. He used to love them... but they are falling apart after 1 month. Weren't worn everyday. Weren't worn in rain or snow. Just fell apart. What a waste if money quality has gone completely downhill. So disappointing.

I've been a fan of the Skechers brand for a number of years and usually get a new pair of slip ons every couple of years. This past November I purchased my new pair and here I am in January and I'm looking for something new. I don't know if it was this particular shoe type or something has changed with the overall brand, but the internal heel has worn out and is awful for a slip on by what I consider casual use, wear and tear. First lets talk about the slip on process, I've always just jammed my foot into my shoe, which pushes down the back of it, then either wiggle my foot or pull the pack lip back out. In this action with this shoe the plastic internal support quickly started tearing out and would routinely rub against the back of my foot, so not only is the heel ripping apart but they also become painful to wear and walk in. This just continues over use and as I said, it has been less than 2 months and I am already looking to replace the shoe because the deteriorating interior makes the shoes unwearable even though the outside is still like new. Would not buy this shoe again but will likely still consider another type of Skecher as a replacement.

Well made. Durable material. My second pair. Wear like iron. No laces but fit nice and snug. No bending to tie. You may need a shoe horn. With a long shoe horn you can put them on standing up. You may not need a shoe horn, due to my age and infirmities a horn helps. Great well made shoe and a great idea, sort of like an athletic loafer.

Fits great plenty of toe room fits snug enough to where they don't slip off. No blemishes or defects. Will be buying more. UPDATE A few months later and I got the brown pair. 1 pic is inside 1 pic outside. In sunlight or daylight they look more brown tan. I normally wear a 9.5 wide but the 1st pair I got seemed to crunch my toes in certain situations as they are not a tie down fit so went with the 10 wide. The blue ones were perfect but one time as I went to put them on I scrunched the back heel portion and that made this plastic piece inside bend and it would rub against my foot which was uncomfortable so don't step on the back heel part. The blue ones seemed more comfortable for some reason. Not that the brown ones are not. Next color will be the light gray or the black ones but they seem to be out of black all the time and they cost more. Good walking shoes but if you order a little big they will fly off trying to run in them. UPDATE Bought another pair in different color. I think I've purchased 7 pairs of these. The price keeps going up. The only thing I don't like and you should avoid is bending the back part. People and myself have stepped on the backend where the heal slides in and the plastic there is not forgiving. One you bend it you can't bend it back and it will dig into the back of your feet making them unwearable.

I've always had a problem because I have a wide foot and a high instep. These sneakers feel great, they feel snug but not tight. There seems to be plenty of support on all sides including the arch. I also like the ease of slipping in and out of them.

This is my sixth pair. In about 4 years, I wear them in every season. With alot of use the soles and insoles last about 9 - 18 months in like new quality. I had a pair for 3 years and walked the tread off them. I will continue to just slide my foot in them once I take off my work boot and walk on clouds.

I bought the 34 pebble 34 brown and black version of this shoe picture is accurate . I normally wear a 34 median 34 men's size 11 US shoe. I bought the size 11.5 M because I wanted to wear these with thick socks. I tried the shoes on with said socks and initially the fit was a little tight, but that should be expected with new shoes. I walked around in them for about 30 minutes and they appear to loosen up. I need a reinforced shoe like this for an industrial work environment where steel toed shoes are problem contain metal - and because of the current rash of disgruntled workers in the workplace losing it - shoes get checked for metal objects . I need my shoes to survive something falling on or hitting them and still be comfortable to wear with limited air conditioning, in this case the rubberized 34 bumpers 34 on these shoes would help. Although these are called 34 leather 34 shoes I don't see anything that is actually leather on them, it all looks synthetic man-made. These are brand new and I don't know how long they will hold up as I never owned this model before.

The overall fit and feel of these shoes have generally met my expectations. I will not try to say they are perfect, but they are close so far. I was interested in obtaining a slip-on type sneaker to eliminate tying laces. Having had Skechers before, size was consistent. Being older my needs are different so I am not sure if heavy running or sports use would work for everyone. Shoes have cushioning and are great for walking.

I have owned about four pair of these shoes and just bought two more because the price has dropped down A LOT I absolutely love these shoes the only problem I ever had with them is the bottom of the shoe actually starting to come off of the shoe just because wearing it so much and so long I guess but have to say a great shoe and nothing that a little bit of gorilla glue super glue didn't fix

Afterburn's are my favorite Sketchers shoe. They deliver comfort, consistant fit, and exceptional quality. They are surely made of high quality materials, as they seem to last longer than most of their competiton. These M.Fit loafers are no eception to what I have come to expect from this line style of sneakers. They seem to provide a good level of support and have held their shape, which is not always the case for "slip-on" shoes while eliminating the effort involved with laces. These are great for anyone who might have issues with arthritis or back problems that linit their ability to tie conventional lace-up sneakers.

I had a pair of the lace up version of this and they kept my feet from aching at night like Nike or UnderArmor did. These are solf memory foam and easy to slip on and off. No more tying laces. They fit nice and snug, but I use a long shoehorn to put them on instead of trying to wiggle my foot in. I believe this will help with the shoe lasting more than a year instead of six months. i had the tie laces version of this shoe and kept them tied and would slide my foot in. In about a year they broke down and aren't wearable anymore. These should last much longer and save my back from bending over and tying untying my shoes. I will update this is the shoes fail before the year is up.

Shoe material quality was good. He said it fit a little snug in the toes. He had hard time getting his wide foot in. He liked the arch and cushioning. He liked the idea of no velcro straps but the elastic did not give much to get foot in very easily. We decided to return. Would have tried a half to whole size bigger, but was afraid it still would be hard for him to get his foot in.
These shoes are amazing. This is my second pair in 5 years. I wash windows for a living, so always moving, wear and tear are huge factors when I buy shoes. These stand up very well.

I've owned these a couple of months now and they are easy to put on and very comfortable. They are my every day shoes so they are getting a lot of use. I am a little worried about the stitching as I've noticed a few places showing some fraying which shouldn't be happening this quickly. Thread quality in that region if the world has never been a strong point so it should not surprise me....hence 4 instead of 5 stars. Don't expect longevity, but all in all, still good shoes.

I husband of account holder really likes these shoes and have been using them for about 2-3 years. I own 3 pair. Just bought the 3rd pair for work .... literally, have only worn them once. For the most part they are rather comfortable, but as an all day work shoe the jury is still out. Use a shoe horn when putting these on to keep the back support from breaking. The shoe pictured are my very first pair 2 years old or so. As you can see they are in great condition so much so I don't want to throw them out. However, the back inside has worn and the plastic support has bent inward. Needless to say that then digs very painfully into the back of your foot and achilles area. Now before I put them on I have to forcefully bend the plastic piece back. Oh...the other thing...I don't know what the soles are made of but they squeak like crazy when wet and walking on certain surfaces.
I am extremely tough on tennis shoes. These shoes are great and fit just right for my feet. I was so impressed at the comfort that I bought a second pair of these. We will see how long they last.
Very well built,very sturdy,I walked 5 miles the first day I got them,No problem,great pair of shoes and I really like the way they look.

representative_reviews.text: These shoes are awful! They are tight in the toes and rub everywhere. I have blisters all over my feet from these shoes.
Horribly uncomfortable for walking indoors. My feet were killing me after a few hours. Hope to return.

I liked the look of these shoes, but the arch support was not sufficient for me since I have lower back pain. I tried adding an insole but then the shoes were too tight and still did not reduce the back pain. Unfortunately, I had to return the shoes.

While the shoes have sturdy soles and the side support is great, after only a few hours at work, my feet still hurt to the point I am limping. I purchased these based on other reviews I had read about how they had worked miracles on their foot pain that sounded similar to what mine is. I have given these over a month to get broken in to be able to review beyond just the typical "breaking in new shoes" pain. I am super bummed out that I spent so much money on these only to have them be my least favorite shoes I own.

A real disappointment in this pair. They are so narrow but says medium width.Wasted a gift card on these. Foot aches while walking and left with bad pain after they are removed.My other two pairs were the same color. Different color different fit??

I ve been an avid ASICS purchaser for years. After being diagnosed with CRPS in my foot, they were the only shoes I could wear that were tolerable on my foot. Which speaks volumes, because all other shoes are excruciating. Yet, over the years the quality has significantly declined. I ve repeatedly noticed that the inside padded portion of the heel will tear, exposing the hard plastic underneath. When this happens, I typically buy a new pair and use the worn ones as shoes for doing yard work. I was okay with this, because I really loved all of my ASICS and felt like I got enough wear from them. However, this pair literally lasted 2 weeks of walking 3 miles daily on a treadmill never worn outside before the padding wore through and the plastic underneath tore open the skin on my heels. I couldn t even wear them for yard work after this because the plastic was so sharp. I m very disappointed to have to spent this amount of money on a pair of walking shoes that I didn t even put 50 miles on.

I have always use these shoes I purchased these I am a nurse and work 14 hour shifts I love the shoes but the part that I received this time the toe is coming apart for the glue is I am so disappointed in this product I ve never had a problem I would like a replacement please

I ve had these shoes since 2021 and while the outside has withstood time, i have holes in the back of both shoes on the inside which are causing blisters. I ve patched with tenacious tape. I had to put inserts in to help with fit
The new ones are a little flatter style than the older ones. I'm not a fan of new design they hurt my feet

Previously, I gave this shoe 4 stars, but after using them 3 times per week to exercise, I ve developed a Subungual hematoma. It is quite painful. This is caused by the foot box of this shoe being too small. Buyer beware! If your second toe is longer than your big toe, do NOT buy these shoes! I would have given it a negative star if I could. Recovery time is three to five weeks...

I had heard good things about these shoes so I thought I'd give them a try. I can usually get by with an 8 1 2 in New Balance, but ordered the 8 1 2 wide in these to be safe. WAY to narrow! Sending them back... ETA I reordered in a 9 1 2 W and I thought they fit okay so I wore them. Still too narrow, after my first real run I got blisters but they were okay for everyday until I noticed the holes in the back of the heel's on both shoes today. Today is April 4, I got them Feb 22 and have not worn them more than 20 times. Sorry, but I can't figure out how to post pictures. 10 Walmart specials last me 3 - 4 months!!! I am SO disappointed in ASICS.
Not the color shown in the picture used them for a whole day and my feet hurt. Horrible shoe big waste of money!
Not all too comfortable and rubbed sores on my ankles. Hopefully they'll be better when broken in and I get some padding inserts.
my doctor recommended I can used brooks sneakers and oofos cuz of my plantar fasciitis feet problem .. Really nice pair sneaker not for my feet..

I felt these were stiff and not very flexible even after months. Most disappointed when a hole developed in the big toe spot in less than a years time. Not worn daily to warrant a hole developing that soon. They were roomy enough that my toes did not feel cramped.

I have very sensitive feet. Buying shoes has never been an enjoyable process. Having plantar fasciitis makes the search more difficult. I was very pleased to find a shoe that gives me the support I need. I wear them from the moment I get dressed and begin walking around. Durable - 100 Color vibrancy - 100 Longevity of support - 100 Great for working out, walking, climbing, standing. Shock absorbing is great. Easy to clean if I get them dirty.

I love these shoes! I've been having knee pains while running and needed to get a pair that better supported my underpronation. These were perfect, and I haven't had pain since. I run anywhere from 3-10 miles on a run, 5 days a week.
The bottom cushion is good condition not too soft or hard to walk. Fit my slightly wide foot and keep my arch comfortably. This is my favorite daily walking shose.
Good support and all day comfort. I have flat feet so I need good arch support. These Asics deliver!
The shoe has minimal cushion and arch support. These are not near as comfortable as previous styles.

I am someone who typically likes a sleek thin shoe. This is a bigger bulkier shoe with a plush tongue. It also has some height to it that I m not typically used to. If you re able to get past those things, they re a great comfortable shoe! I have kept and am using this shoe but most likely wouldn t have picked it from the store for everyday use. I would imagine that it would be a good shoe for hiking slippery surfaces. Also is nice for winter- my feet have been warm! I see myself buying a different pair of shoes soon, but they re an okay option solely based on all day comfort and color! I have the grey and like the neutrality of it.

Very comfortable! I've got bone spurs from standing for 10 hours a day 4 days a week.. so these are wonderful! My only complaint is the shoelaces are really thin and feel like you could break them easily.

I love this shoe. It s sometimes hard to find shoes for feet that supinate and have high arches. It was so helpful that the description included info for both of these conditions. I was glad I ordered a wide. I am sometimes fine in a medium width, but more often I need a wide. This was just wide enough. A minor but helpful point is that these cane with flat laces rather than the round so common now. These laces actually stay tied! The color description said black and silver which agreed with my order details. But the shoes are actually navy blue with teal accents. I think I like this better. I noticed other reviews that mentioned their color was different, too. The shoe is very comfortable and I ve found that I can do a shopping session in them without tired and sore feet. I m glad I ordered these.
Very comfortable and supportive. I cross train and box and my workouts last 2 hours at a time and I haven t had any foot pain or discomfort.

I just wrote a review of these after I sent back the chili red and tan version because I did not like the color. So let me start again here. I love the Mantle green Piedmont grey version that arrived today. A really good looking shoe. But I'm going to leave this review at 4 stars because of minimal arch support. Hard to understand because the Gel-Ventura 5 has a great arch support! I've never gotten the Gel-Ventura 6 so can't speak to that I have decided to keep them because I like the comfort of the toe box area and the heel fits perfectly and I can put in my own arch insert.

I tried them on when i got them. I love them. They fit. I got my normal size and they were neither too big or too small. The perfect amount of cushioning. I could see these lasting more than a few weeks unlike my more recent shoes. Heck the memory foam of my new balances barely lasted a day and that was only cause i had no other choice. I will never get memory foam again. This is my 4th pair of shoes in a month and i could see these lasting. Mind you the paces i put the others through many have had something to do with it too. I work outside for 8 hours a day, 5 days a week. I need something that is both comfortable on concrete and will last. The first pair were too big even though i got a 10. The second pair, were ok but i had already worn a hole in the sole by week 2. Then i tried the new balance and made the mistake of missing the portion of the description that said memory foam. That is my second pair like that and i hated both of them. Neither lasted more than a day. I would rather wear the holey shoes then those, so i wore them till these came in. The shoes would have probably been ok in normal circumstances. But didn t work for my work environment. Although the first two were same brand but different style and one of them did say slip resistant work shoes. Maybe it just didn t mean concrete environment. I hope these shoes work out great. I am tired of playing return the product so that i can try something different. I think the reason i was so ready to try those was because work requires black shoes. And the first two were all black and these are black with some grey because one of my coworkers said they barely notice the shoes and someone else suggested cross trainers for work. So i am hopeful these will stand the test of time.

I have severe patellar femoral chondromalacia and this shoes helps a lot! Its comfortable, light and matches my uniform too! Been looking for the perfect shoes to help me with my 12hrs shifts! Im glad i bought this!

Finding comfortable shoes has always been a challenge. I have a wide foot and a high instep. I had plantar fasciitis from not wearing shoes with adequate support so I am very picky. I recently retired from nursing after 30 years and recognize the importance of good, high quality shoes. I have had Asics before and loved them. These shoes are the same excellent quality as before. The width is just right and the arch support perfect. I can walk distance in them without pain or cramping. Love them. I highly recommend these shoes.

I love Asics for the fit, comfort and stability. This has been good for my overpronation wearing a slight insert . Love the color too it says black bur looks more like navy blue . I work in a doctors office and am on my feet a lot. No back or knee problems wearing these.
I love them. My arch has been hurting on long walks and since I changed to this shoe it has been great.

representative_reviews.text: At first these sneakers weren t bad. They felt as new sneakers should. But when I picked up the miles and also started running, they were hurting my feet. They are trail runners so I was a bit disappointed. I decided instead of spending another 50 on sneakers that might or might not fit right that I d go to a local shoe store and be fitted properly. I was right that I take a 7 wide as ordered but the higher quality running shoes fit SO much better. The toe box was too small in these shoes and come to find out, the wide isn t very wide. My new shoes, as fitted by a professional, feel so much better than these. You get what you pay for!
Both I bought for my daughter and she liked them but after wearing for a bit they ended up being to small in the toes.

My feet begin to hurt after just a short time wearing these shoes. This is the first time that I have had an ASICS pair of shoes that hurt from the beginning. I usually have to break a pair down completely before they hurt my feet and knees. I ordered the same size I always get in ASICS but these feel a bit smaller. I don't understand how a brand can have differences in sizes between different models of basically the same thing - they are all running shoes, after all. I won't get this style again. I may try to find the older model I had before but it has been discontinued so it is harder to find.

I am a true size 10 with skinny flat feet and mild bunions. Despite this, this shoe in size 10 was tight both width-wise and length-wise. Once I put in a modest orthotic, there was no room for my feet using a lightweight hiking sock. Also, I ordered the black silver. It is not black. It is a beautiful blue much like the photo. I ordered this to replace my ancient Gel-Venture 5 -which is also a size 10 and it fits my foot with the same orthotic and sock comfortably. The Gel-Venture 7 is a beautiful and well-made shoe. But I'd order a half-size up. Also, be aware that it is a small toe box that looks dainty and feminine but will be snug all around.

I run 5 days a week about 4 to 7 miles per run on gravel sand terrain. At first these shoes were fantastic. They fit well and supported my flat feet plus I loved the colors. But after about 120 miles about a month and a half of running in these shoes, they started to fall apart and lose support. Due to these shoes deteriorating so quickly, I ve suffered a minor injury and now have to take a break from my runs to allow myself time to recover. If you re serious about running and want to avoid injury, spend the extra money and get some quality running shoes. These are a rip off.

I had worn these same shoes for my walking routine and it was time for a new pair so i simply reordered. The pair received was the same EXCEPT for the sizing...they have never fit right...way too small. Have had them professionally 'stretched' and hoped they would eventually stretch some with wear, to no avail. Finally giving to local thrift store. Aggrevating.

A real disappointment in this pair. They are so narrow but says medium width.Wasted a gift card on these. Foot aches while walking and left with bad pain after they are removed.My other two pairs were the same color. Different color different fit??

I hate to think what their regular width us like. If you wear insoles or have a wider foot, buy another brand. I bought another brand marketed as, made for women by women, and the fit perfectly.

Extremely tight at the toe box though ASICS claims on their web site that Venture 7's are roomier than previous versions ...my feet hurt immediately. So they're going right back.

They fit true to size, no break in period, support your foot, have good traction... and a great price!

I ordered a wide shoe. These I would classify as perhaps a medium . Definitely not wide. Out of the box I had to wear a thinner sock. After a few miles they loosened up a bit but still not wide. Although the heel is quite wide. Actually these feel more like a men s medium. Other than that, they re fine for walking trails.

I had an older version of this shoe which wore out big toe hole, little toe crack so I got this new model. It is well cushioned. The heel support is solid, just like the older pair. I got the wide model as I need a larger toe box.

I love these shoes! I've been having knee pains while running and needed to get a pair that better supported my underpronation. These were perfect, and I haven't had pain since. I run anywhere from 3-10 miles on a run, 5 days a week.

I looked for a while to find best sport shoes for me. Ordered and returned some. But not this one. I m a true 8.5, thick foot towards ankle, not necessarily wide. I bought the 8.5W and fits perfectly. Feels good while running and playing sports. Very happy with the purchase. Thank you!
Love these. I usually have a hard time finding shoes wide enough for my feet, but these are a great fit!

This is my second time ordering the exact same shoe. Looks fits very well. The last time I ordered it was last year and the stitches are breaking around the big toe area .. but for the look, fit and price I went ahead and ordered it again!!
VIDEOID d9ce9d1bc0ab80aa4ac591dae4907170 Love the fit they fit comfortable I have swelling in my feet and I have enough wiggle room would buy again. PA

I do think these shoes run a bit on the snug size. I have wore them for awhile and notice the Gel did not hold up to everyday life. My heel hurts if I wear them too long. I will purchase my old brand of shoe the next time.

This is a really nice sneaker. I wish it would have fit. When I stand in a shoe, I should have a thumbnail space between the big toe and the end of the shoe, and I didn't. Had the toe box been wider I may have kept the shoe, but it wasn't, and I don't need my toenails all messed up, because I tried to wear it. I ordered the largest size for women, which is an 11. I wear a size 10 1 2, so I figured the 11 would be big enough. It wasn't. Also, to return the shoe to the company that I purchased it through on Amazon cost me over 5. Buyer beware.

These shoes are very comfortable. I wear them right out of the box without a painful breaking in period. They run pretty true to size. These are one of the brands of shoe my podiatrist recommended for plantar fasciitis.
Great shoe. Fits true to size in my estimation. Looks and feels great. Light and stable. Just what i was looking for.

Best shoe I've ever worn!!! I've tried Nike, New balance, , Skechers good shoes to you name it, but these are the best shoes ever I just did a 4-mile walk without socks, you do have to order half a size larger, I wear a nine wide I ordered a 9 1 2 wide fit perfectly so yes you do have to order a half size larger than you normally wear, and it fit perfectly, so yes you do have to order half a size larger, they are springy, the shoe is lightweight, it's 95 outside an my foot never got hot or sweaty stayed comfy, my toes are not squished plenty of box toe room, I have a wide foot I am a big girl 5'6, 200 lb country girl and they held up walking the railroad tracks the field the trail everything! best shoe ever made ! Finally after every shoe I could possibly try that's made in a wide I've even tried clarks, spirit, Earth origins, bear trap, any shoe made in a wide I've tried an none were totally comfortable, always had to suck it up in an uncomfortable part somewhere, but these every woman should own a pair of these! I have gone past the 30 day return. And now stuck with a brand new pair of sneakers that are falling apart But who would think wearing a sneaker for less than 2 months as casual wear. They are not worn to work or abused in any way!

I have bought three pairs of these Asics Gel-7 shoes for my pre-teen daughter. The first pair barely got worn estimated 4 months before she outgtew them. This first pair was the Amazon purchase at the end of 2019. Tge followingvtwo purchases were from another retailer online on 2020. The second pair originally bought for me but were too small , she wore about twice a week since the beginning of school. I ordered another pair for her to use in gym class at school. This pink and black third pair she has worn nearly every day for five full months. Size, fit, and comfort were spot-on and thess were great shoes until they started coming apart at the seams, soles, and the material has started to shread. I've not seem a pair of shoes fall apart so terribly and fast before. I've bought Asics brand shoes for over a decade and never experienced this level of disgust in their product. The grey ice blue pair bought second and worn twice a week or so indoors when her class gets to have gym has busted threads on the toe and the mesh material is ripping apart. The pink black daily wear pair has the toes exposed because the top has completely come undone and the soles are detaching. I've never seen a pair of shoes disengage like this, and I've raised an active boy into adulthood! Parents and anyone who actually uses their tennis running shoes should take a pass on these! If buying for the kid, know you will end up replacing them before the school year ends. Pics are provided to show extreme wear in short-term both for light wear and daily wear.

I love this brand of shoe, and I have had several pairs of this exact shoe. However, the last pair that I bought here on Amazon and not in the shoe as I usually do , has come apart at the toe. When I walk, the front part and come apart and tearing out of the shoe. Maybe these are seconds and not the higher quality you should get from this brand and for this high amount of money.

I had to pay for shipping to send them back. I don't have a printer so I couldn't print the return label. I tried wearing the shoes around the house but they are just to tight I really need a bigger size. I cant even give them away because they don't fit anyone that I know Just stuck with a pair of new shoes.

I have always loved ASICS for running shoes, but I made a huge mistake buying them from Amazon. First off, they are actually sold by a third party. They took 2 weeks to arrive, and are in poor condition. I don't know of these are knockoffs, or if they are the legitimate ASICS that have imperfections and therefore won't sell in stores. There is visible glue and gaps all around the front of the shoes. I read reviews from others saying the shoes did not last very long and after seeing these, I knew they would fall apart easily. And I have to pay 5 to return these, even though free returns were advertised! I'm going to stick to buying quality shoes from athletic retailers. Such a disappointment.
Not all too comfortable and rubbed sores on my ankles. Hopefully they'll be better when broken in and I get some padding inserts.

Cheaply made material. Fit way too small and I ordered my size. I Should have ordered half size up but didn't think I had to. I ended up returning because I found ASICS at Big 5 Sporting goods that cost a little more but fabric was much better and more support for my foot. BTW They're running shoes so I'm really fussy about the fit!
Bought 10 15 2020 and my toe already broke thru. Took my older ASICS over a year for this to happen.

While the shoes have sturdy soles and the side support is great, after only a few hours at work, my feet still hurt to the point I am limping. I purchased these based on other reviews I had read about how they had worked miracles on their foot pain that sounded similar to what mine is. I have given these over a month to get broken in to be able to review beyond just the typical "breaking in new shoes" pain. I am super bummed out that I spent so much money on these only to have them be my least favorite shoes I own.

So, I decided to give an updated review about these shoes. I originally gave 5 stars because they fit well and were comfortable from day 1. However, as you can see from the photo, these shoes I've had for less than 5 months have started to rip at the toe on each shoe. I was hoping they would last as long as my previous Asics which was YEARS , but as you can see they are not holding up well. I walk 4-5 days a week. I'm not walking through terrain that justifies these holes, and I noticed someone else reported a similar problem. So, at this point, I can no longer recommend this shoe. Look for another brand that won't fall apart so quickly.

They feel cheap and uncomfortable. The outsole is made of some unpleasant plastic and is uneven. There is not enough cushioning under the ball of the foot and the toe and much more on the other side. If you happen to have an overpronation, then this will probably make things worse. However, this model may be good for underpronation. Please, pay attention that Asics does different models. Unfortunately, in many cases, this is not explained clearly to customers. Many may not even know what pronation is and probably buying the wrong shoes. Also, models made for overpronation are for some reason the most expensive. This information is available on the Asics website. I actually mentioned overpronation on one of my feet after I was wearing Asics Onitsuka Tiger model for a year or two. So it may be a result of wearing the wrong shoes I guess. I think Asics need to add some tags with clear information about the model. Otherwise, they are creating possible orthopedic problems for us.

I love these shoes! I've been having knee pains while running and needed to get a pair that better supported my underpronation. These were perfect, and I haven't had pain since. I run anywhere from 3-10 miles on a run, 5 days a week.

I have very sensitive feet. Buying shoes has never been an enjoyable process. Having plantar fasciitis makes the search more difficult. I was very pleased to find a shoe that gives me the support I need. I wear them from the moment I get dressed and begin walking around. Durable - 100 Color vibrancy - 100 Longevity of support - 100 Great for working out, walking, climbing, standing. Shock absorbing is great. Easy to clean if I get them dirty.

Rubber used for sole does not have the flexibility of real rubber I got wide width, it s narrow for that I don t expect them to last as well as I would expect I could not ethically return them as I d worn them outdoors

I usually buy Asics brand because they fit best for my feet and offer great support. These shoes fit as expected, so that's not the issue. I have never had any pair of Asics prematurely wear out, matter of fact, I always retire my Asics to lawn work shoes because even though I need new ones with better support, the shoes are still in great shape for mowing the lawn and such. Well, I have one pair that are strictly running shoes and one pair for strictly walking. I used these for just walking. About 4 months in, I notice a a rip starting at the seam near the top toe area . It has gotten worse over time and there isn't really a way to just sew it back together. That's why I'm giving 4 stars, because it hasn't been a year that I have had these shoes and I can no longer use them. I can usually get by with my shoes lasting at least 2 yrs before I need fresh ones due to normal wear in the soles, but nothing externally has ever done this.
I have worn these all through the last few months of icy, snowy weather and they've held up great. I'd buy them again

First off ASICS wrongly named this shoe black silver, it s a definite mistake as it is clearly navy and teal. This shoe runs short in length so 1 2 it up a size. It has no removable inner sock. Not a lot of cushion and feels more stiff than most running shoes but is not a high end shoe to begin with. I got it for walking in the road and grass, hoped it was water resistant but it isn t. Tried many trail Gortex shoes and returned them all. Much too stiff, like wearing a block on your foot and hard to tie. I will keep these. They are nice looking with the navy and inner lavender with a bit of teal markings. Laces are unusually thin, but they do stay tied. Tried putting several orthotics in but because the sock liner doesn t come out, it raised foot up too high and my heel slipped. I found a flatter orthotic and that worked. This is just an ordinary shoe. Paid 54.

I had an older version of this shoe which wore out big toe hole, little toe crack so I got this new model. It is well cushioned. The heel support is solid, just like the older pair. I got the wide model as I need a larger toe box.

I love Asics for the fit, comfort and stability. This has been good for my overpronation wearing a slight insert . Love the color too it says black bur looks more like navy blue . I work in a doctors office and am on my feet a lot. No back or knee problems wearing these.

I tried them on when i got them. I love them. They fit. I got my normal size and they were neither too big or too small. The perfect amount of cushioning. I could see these lasting more than a few weeks unlike my more recent shoes. Heck the memory foam of my new balances barely lasted a day and that was only cause i had no other choice. I will never get memory foam again. This is my 4th pair of shoes in a month and i could see these lasting. Mind you the paces i put the others through many have had something to do with it too. I work outside for 8 hours a day, 5 days a week. I need something that is both comfortable on concrete and will last. The first pair were too big even though i got a 10. The second pair, were ok but i had already worn a hole in the sole by week 2. Then i tried the new balance and made the mistake of missing the portion of the description that said memory foam. That is my second pair like that and i hated both of them. Neither lasted more than a day. I would rather wear the holey shoes then those, so i wore them till these came in. The shoes would have probably been ok in normal circumstances. But didn t work for my work environment. Although the first two were same brand but different style and one of them did say slip resistant work shoes. Maybe it just didn t mean concrete environment. I hope these shoes work out great. I am tired of playing return the product so that i can try something different. I think the reason i was so ready to try those was because work requires black shoes. And the first two were all black and these are black with some grey because one of my coworkers said they barely notice the shoes and someone else suggested cross trainers for work. So i am hopeful these will stand the test of time.

These shoes fit well and are very comfortable. They are advertised as having "neutral" support I supinate. They're lightweight. They're sold as trail runners. I'm not a trail runner, but they work well for walking, and they were priced in the walking-shoe range. I like the gray outsole, which blends with grime better than white. I've only had them for a couple of weeks so I can't speak to durability, but they appear to be put together very well. One very small quibble - the flat laces. Why, outside of "style"? They have a blue and black woven pattern. I replaced them with oval laces, which are easier to tie and untie and usually last longer. One request Some lighter base colors, in the brown tan beige range.

I owned these shoes in the past and wore out the back of the shoe as I tend to do. But it was such a comfortable shoe and had good support that I decided to order another. No need for insoles since the shoe seems to have all it needs.

First off, I LOVE the colors and design of these. The fact that the bottom layer not what actually touches the ground but the foam part of the sole that you can see is gray rather than white is a huge plus. They don't stain and look old nearly as fast. However, these feel a lot more cheaply made than prior Asics that I've had. They are the perfect size for me, but the shoe kinda slouches a little when I step? Hard to describe, but it's like there just isn't as much structure to the sides of the shoe as there usually is. Also, the plastic part what would have been leather back in the day at the toe, has already torn really easily. Like it's just a thinner coating. So even though I really like the overall look of these, the quality is just not as good as typical Asics. And I just wear them as casual every day shoes, not for running, exercise, hiking, etc.
My perfect shoes. Here s the best part when I ve worn them to death, I come to Amazon and order them again, and they show up on my porch.

I wear these for work, often on my feet for 14 hours a shift. They did not need to be "broken in" at all, comfy from day one. Like the color combination. Shoes were shipped and received as promised. Would definitely purchase again.

After a couple of years looking for shoes that work for hammer toes, fallen arches and assorted other issues, I tried on shoes all over my local shopping area. I knew what to look for and what brands worked for me. So I went to Amazon, I searched out my styles, read reviews and stashed the potential best shoes in my cart. When I was ready, I pulled the trigger. They fit so well, I don't even need to insert my orthotics. Very pleased. Got the same shoe in two colors. Now I'm good for another two or three years. KL

Not the color shown in the picture used them for a whole day and my feet hurt. Horrible shoe big waste of money!

A real disappointment in this pair. They are so narrow but says medium width.Wasted a gift card on these. Foot aches while walking and left with bad pain after they are removed.My other two pairs were the same color. Different color different fit??

The new ones are a little flatter style than the older ones. I'm not a fan of new design they hurt my feet

Should have listened to a previous reviewer . . . . the Black Piedmont Grey is not have a purple tone as the picture's denote. It is a very dark blue including the side of the sole is very dark blue. No way that picture is this shoe. I am very disappointed and am returning. I"m giving two stars because otherwise these are great shoes and it arrived a day earlier than expected.

Shoes fit a little larger than my normal shoe size. But not bad. There s some discomfort in my ankles after wearing them for the frat day. But hopefully they need to just be broken in. My issue with these shoes is in the design. I don t buy shoes that often so when I do buy them I would like them to be worth every penny I spent. These shoes are not. They press on the top of my ankles and are not sized wrong not the worst things in the world and I could learn to live with these issues if it weren t for the discrepancies in the sewing if the pink trim. The pink inside lining of the shoes is supposed to extend to the second set of eyelets on the laces. On one shoe they are noticeably shorter on one side. On the other shoe, the pink part is already unraveling after just 4 hours of wearing them. It s almost like they are seconds. Like they didn t pass quality control. Just double check everything on the stitching before wearing them because most places won t take them back after they ve been worn. Or better yet. Look for a better quality shoe.

It gives me no pleasure to write this review as I genuinely really wanted the shoes to fit and be perfect, but sadly they will be returned. I usually wear a size 7.5 in shoe but with sneakers I am told to size up so I ordered an 8. When I put the shoe on my left foot my toe was touching the top part of shoe no wiggle room, and on the right foot it fit fine. In addition, it fit like a wide width shoe, but I did not select the wide width. The fit and feel of the shoe was not what I was expecting. The only thing right is the color of the shoe. What's sad is I went into Famous Footwear and bought the exact brand and size of a shoe and it fit perfectly. Which is why I felt comfortable ordering this shoe off line. I thought I knew what I was getting. I honestly got the feel I received a defective shoe. How can the right shoe fit like an 8 and the other fit like a 7? I cannot recommend this shoe. I got the black piedmont.

I love Asics for the fit, comfort and stability. This has been good for my overpronation wearing a slight insert . Love the color too it says black bur looks more like navy blue . I work in a doctors office and am on my feet a lot. No back or knee problems wearing these.

I purchased the gray shoes with rose gold pattern. On the website, the pattern looks more pink but the actual color is copper think pennies . I was a little bit disappointed but kept the shoes because they were comfortable and despite the color not being as described, they still look nice enough .
I really like the comfort and the size. I ordered wide and I'm very happy with them. The color is amazing with pink and gray.

They aren t great for fashion, but I find these shoes very comfortable for walking. I have plantar fasciitis, fibro, and MS. These shoes keep me comfortable for miles, although as much as I walk, I do have to replace them once a year. Received the same style in the picture.

Unfortunately I did not look at the reviews before I purchased because I ONLY wear Asics. I was excited when I saw lavender, named Piedmont Gray. When I received them, they are black. I do not want solid black. Why are you showing them as lavender? So very dissappointed!!
Ordered these based on previous sizes I have worn and they fit perfectly. Very happy with this product and seller.

This is the second pair of Asics running shoes that I purchased on Amazon. The first pair worked out well so I decided to buy another. I chose the Lichen Green Watershed Rose for its vibrant green color but when they arrived I was disappointed because they look more dark green gray. I checked the Asics website to make sure my monitor's color wasn't off and found that their website had accurate photos that matched the actual color of the shoes. The first image depicts what I received, the second image is from Amazon's website and the third image is from the Asics website. Lesson learned don't trust the color of product images on Amazon.
Comfortable, stylish, great colors. I can wear them all day with no foot pain. Feels like walking on air. I orders extra half size up, better for summer heat and swollen feet.
I had another woman wearing these and actually I thought they looked good. My wife loves the wide width she wears them with day dresses and jeans .

The shoes are beautiful - I got the grey and pink and they look like the picture. More importantly they feel wonderful and my toes can spread out. I ordered 8.5 wide, even though I have very narrow heels, because I have struggled for years to find shoes that accommodate my toes during running. These have enough cushion on the heels and enough lace holes to make them fit on the heels while still allowing room in the toe. They also have plenty of cushion on the soles. I love them.

I like how they fit and I've had good luck in the past with how long the shoes last. I do think they should change the color description as this is definitely not black silver but is more of a navy.

I entered the search fields on the Amazon site with the words "orange tennis shoes." This ASICS shoe In the color called Blue Expanse Heritage Blue was one of the first to be suggested. The rather salmon color on the very top of the laces is closer to the color in reality. The shoe light parts photograph as orange but IS NOT. I did love the way the shoe fit and its weight but I do not need this pink shoe base. 'Back they go!

I have owned few pairs of this brand and style, actually 3 pairs currently. One pair I had to go up a half a size seems to be slight variations in manufacturing. Two of my more recent purchases have shoe laces I don t like. They are thin flat and flimsy, starting to twist from being tied and untied. Will buy new laces. I like the shoe, importantly they fit my foot. Not expensive shoes, great value, better fit than the expensive ones I own.

So I had fallen for an ad on Facebook from ASICS about their new Adrenaline 13 s and paid about twice this much for them. When I got them they were pretty but the most uncomfortable shoe I had ever worn. I wore them to run to the grocery store and my toes were numb by the time I left the store. I promptly returned them. So when I saw these I was hesitant, remembering my past experience with this brand. But I ordered a half size up and let me tell you it makes all the difference! I m so happy now with these. They are extremely comfortable, and cute. I got them to go with a navy blue shirt and shorts that I got. I ordered the black silver hoping the description of the color was wrong and it was, these are navy blue and a teal color. So the seller might want to change that. I got the color I wanted so I m happy.
