representative_reviews.text: These shoes are not at all what I wanted. I'm a nurse and I work 12-hour shifts, I previously owned an older style of Presidio shoes from last year that I absolutely loved. Keen felt like they needed to modify the style, now the Arches are not in the right place, the heel is up higher, the ball area is narrower, and they have engraven the word Keen inside the shoe on the arch. So now when my feet are swollen from being on them for 12 hours the word Keen is engraving on them when I take them off. I wore these for just a little while around my house to check them out and I will be returning them. Very very very disappointed. I'm also angry that what is pictured on the website is not what I got in the mail. The older style has the pink flowers on the insole of the shoe. I looked on the picture to ensure that that's what I was getting and the flowers are there however, when the shoes came they were the newer style that I had seen in the store and knew I didn't like. Very angry.

I stand on concrete floors at work and thought these shoes would be comfortable. They seemed to be fine the first week. After the second week I noticed a lot of pain in my feet, mainly along the edges where the seams come together inside the shoes. Don't waste your money on these. My feet hurt every time I try to wear them.
Had to return these. They were very tight over the top of my foot and the leather is not flexible at all.

Updated. Updated AGAIN. BEWARE. They are advertised as 100 leather. They are not. The old style with the leather insole are wonderful and fit the way you'd expect from the old KEEN company. These are not the same. The insole is covered with fabric, and this is the second pair I've had to send back because the insoles are obviously malformed. It's not that the arch support is in the wrong place, it's that the footbed is uneven throughout the shoe, and left and right shoes are lumpy in different places. I can only imagine these creating back injuries and sore feet and legs rather than helping with them the way you used to be able to rely on Keen to do. I used to love this company for it's quality. I really miss it. I have kept trying, hoping to win the lottery and get a pair that came off the assembly line the way they should, or that I'll receive an older pair that's been sitting in some warehouse because no one liked that color or style. I don't care about that, I care about getting through a 8 hour day on my feet for the next 10 years. Few products in my life I truly lament the loss of. Keen is one of them. I am getting tired of playing shoe roulette with Amazon. Gotta work, gotta have shoes to work in. What's the answer, I wonder? I bought a second pair of the brown, supposedly 100 leather version of this shoe. The insole is fabric like the blueberry ones, and foot bed is lumpy and uneven, like the blueberry. I am truly sad. Buying shoes on Amazon is a waste of time unless you enjoy repacking and returning bad merchandise, and Mr. Bezos might consider taking some of his richest man in the world money and doing some quality control. I'll never buy another pair of Keen shoes unless I can try them on first, because the company does no quality control, and neither does Amazon, apparently. Quality is inconsistent between the different colors of this style. The brown version was perfect, the blueberry is bad. Inconsistent quality between the different colors of these shoes. These have to go back. I am sick at heart. Keen used to be the only shoe I would put on my feet for work. Now the quality is so hit and miss I could cry. For years the only shoes I'd wear to work KEEN Voyageur boots, but then the soles started falling apart literally, the different color lugs would just fall out. And then the sides would blow out in a couple of months. Desperate for work shoes I bought the Presidio style in brown, just to take a chance that a different style might be made better, and got a pair of old style reliable KEEN shoes. VICTORY! Putting them on is like hugging your feet. So when the Blueberry went on sale for 88, I bought a pair to put away and save till I have worn out the brown ones. I am on my feet for hours everyday, and walk miles, and climb and move constantly. I am getting too old to deal with inconsistent quality. The Brown Presidio have perfect arch support. Where it's supposed to be, in the arch. The cover of the insole is leather. The same style Blueberry have lumps in the soles at the ball of the of one foot, and the other just doesn't sit right at all. There is no arch support to speak of. The insole is fabric. This is advertised as the same shoe, but it's wrong. And it's going back. So buyer beware. If you can afford to play roulette with your health and your job, go ahead. It might be o.k. IF your back starts to hurt though, it may be the shoes. I don't know what I am going to do now. If anyone has any suggestions for a well made reliable work shoe, or how to tell which styles are worth buying for the price I am listening, because the only thing consistent about KEEN these days is the outrageous price. So disappointed.

I love my Keen hiking shoes but I do remember one time in a boulder field I hit a few smooth damp rocks and went down HARD - felt like I was on solid ice. Picked up these shoes for upcoming Europe trip and they fit GREAT, loved them except that they are a little too low around the ankle, my "no-show" socks even show and normal anklet socks look like I'm wearing crew since the show sits so low. So I wear them around the house for about an hour getting ready and they're great then I go in the garage to load the car and BAM! My feet go right out from under me on the concrete, and it wasn't even wet. We've had rains so there's a buildup of humidity, the floor was slightly damp, definitely not wet and I've never in 20 years slipped on that garage floor. I then head into town and go to a restaurant, walking back to my seat with a full tray of food drinks and hit their freshly mopped floor, BAM! I go down hard, bruises on both elbows, hips, and knees plus lost the tray of food and took out a 2 year old girl on the way down. Yes, the floor was wet, however, I was immediately surrounded by about 6 people all wearing normal shoes not non-slip and not a single one of them was slipping. When they helped me up I literally could not walk because the shoes were so slick, they had to carry me over to a booth. My son went out to the car, grabbed my old pair of workout shoes, I put them on and walked solidly back over that wet floor without a single bit of slipping. I called my mother who got another model of Keen's for the trip and she tested them out on her garage floor, went down like she was on ice and she's 73 years old. These shoes are downright DANGEROUS! I can't believe there are more complaints!
One shoe felt as though it was a different size. i love Keens, but this was tight in the toes and loose in the heels. My feet were aching by the end of the day.
The shoes disappointed me! The threading that holds the sides together came apart and the shoes were not cheap!

I ve had Keen shoes before and those were great but these are terrible. The tongue on the shoe is very sturdy stiff which lead to rubbing and swelling on the top of my foot. I was in a lot of pain by the end of a 13 hour day. Do not recommend

These were ordered from Amazon Warehouse and the description said scuffing on the bottom but they have been used lots. They even show evidence of a bunion on the left foot. I have never had this problem with Amazon Warehouse before.
These bruised the ever living crap out of my ankle heel area on both feet. And I don't bruise easily.
Not a quality comfortable shoe like it used to be! Stiff and rough edges, not soft and supportive like a few years ago.Now I cant return it?? Horrible

The heals have a ridge in them. They were not sewn in correctly. I just tried them on. Now I can't return. They have never been used. I have many pairs, this is the only one that has had a problem. I can compare with my other shoes and can see what is wrong.

I have previously purchased 2 pairs of these shoes and loved them, so when they started to wear out again, I reordered from the exact same vendor. These are not the same shoes. Smaller toe box, rubber toe protection does not go all the way around anymore, the material feels like crap, and it s not even the same shape. So disappointed.

This was my first pair of KEEN s and I just can t get comfortable in them. I have been searching high and low for a pair of brown loafers or sneakers if you will, that I can wear to work with jeans. Something that would look nicer than sneakers. A co-worker of mine has this super cute pair of brown Merrell s that look a little like a sneaker and she says there s extremely comfortable. Apparently Merrill doesn t make them anymore and this was the closest I found. They got good reviews so I gave them a shot. I found the shoes to be very stiff. I don t like my shoes tied tightly which is a good thing cuz these are so stiff I couldn t tighten the laces. I found them to be mostly comfortable I work in an elementary school with all concrete floors and I m in and out of my seat a lot . The major problem was that my right heel would constantly slip out of the shoes when I walked. The left heel did not. I tried buying gel insoles to fill up more space in the shoe, but it still didn t work. Every step I took, I could feel the shoe slipping off my right heel. I tried to make these work but I just can t. I think at this point it s too late to return them so they re collecting dust in my closet.

I bought them for work and they do seem to make my feet less fatigued, painful and have helped with my achilles tendonitis, so I am very grateful for all of that. I have high arches and while they do seem to give a lot of support, I do wish the shoes were a bit more flexible. Update, 8 months later They are VERY stiff though and I am always soooo relieved to take them off after work. They have been KILLING my hips, knees and feet. They are still so very stiff and they don't feel like they have any cushioning at all. I wish I could return them but I have decided to sell them and get some running shoes for work instead. I will never try Keens again. The shoes are very well made, durable and still in great shape, so I'll give them that. I need flexible shoes though, I've learned the hard, painful way . I had it this week when standing more than normal in them. I was in tears by the end of the work days. These are so awful for my body. So awful, I've started looking into a hot tub. - Funny, but not funny.
very good arch support. not the most beautiful shoes I have had but I can stand and work ten hours with no problem. only down side was one of the laces broke.

I did not buy these as a hiking shoe, that said they are very comfortable for daily walking. I would not use them on hikes with significant elevation gain or if the footing could be treacherous simply because they are a low top shoe offering little ankle support and being prone to slipping sideways and turning an ankle. The sole is not overly aggressive and hard so on loose dry dirt or forest debris surfaces does not have the traction I would prefer. On a couple of steep banks that I routinely travel while walking my dogs I have to speed up so I do not lose traction. I would and do use them on flat ground or hiking in town. Very comfortable for all day wear on concrete or asphalt surfaces.
As always Keen comes through for my feet. I do put in a gel arch cushion but that is all I need for a great fit!
Super comfortable, even slip on off well with laces tied because of the cut, which I love. Great for walking all over town, kept my arches happy on concrete. Highly recommend!
I have plantar fasciitis. These shoes are awesome! I work 40 hrs a week on my feet and these shoes are up to the job. I own several pairs of keens in all styles. They are terrific shoes.

I have an older pair of these I have had for years. They were starting to wear out and the arch support was not as good anymore. I ordered these as a replacement My old ones were real leather. They required a bit of "breaking in" but ultimately they were very comfortable and I took them on many vacations using them on daily hikes and in town walking These are VERY stiff even after wearing a few times I don't believe they will ever soften up because they are pleather I believe Keen has skimmed a bit off of the width and height on the toe box also. I've mostly gone back to wearing my old ones My advices if you are going to buy these-go to a store and try them first
I like the arch support and leather shoe. Had to break them in but I wear them all the time, not just hiking or walking.

Keens are easy on the feet and a durable shoes. I have worn keen for many years. When I started wearing them I did not have to wear my expensive orthotics and my feet were well supported no arch problems at all. Also it has a good size toebox if your feet are a little wider. That s the only shoe I wear for every occasion.

Bought for work, due to almost constantly being on my feet for 5 hours. For the last 7 years, these shoes are the best for being comfortable. I do not get back strains pains now. They are a bit pricey for a 13 hr job, but shoes are worth it.
I love this shoe. It is my second pair. It is comfortable. It has very good arch support with a wide toe box. It is my go to casual shoe.
This is my 4th pair of Keen shoes, including a sandal. My feet feel secure and comforting, even when I jump high forward or backward.....even sideways. I have a high arch, and it is well supported.
Great support for feet and back. Casual non slip treads work great on wet and icy surfaces. Real leather shoe that takes a short time to break in.

This shoe is so substantial, with a great support in arch and uppers, and a heavy grippy bottom. I'm surprised to hear it called a "sneaker" when it is to me obviously a hiking shoe. I will use it for city touring and daily use as I have "bad feet" which are short and very wide in the forefoot with neuromas bilaterally and a tendency to pronate. Most Keens work well for me but this design especially! I originally ordered the lavender pair, but it was an odd, grey-shark tone instead of a positive color so I returned them and got the absolutely lovely rich blue shade instead.

I stand all day at work and have relatively flat arches. This shoe has a wide toe box and a wide base on the heel. I can stand all day without pain. The Presidio is a very stable shoe that doesn't rock. The insole is really good but you can remove it if you need to put in your own orthotics. EDIT I buy these shoes over and over. I can't find better shoes. My last pair I wore the tread completely out. Not because they're cheap but because I wear them every single day for work and taking walks. These shoes are the best

I bought these to wear on motorcycle trips as opposed to my boots. I am wearing them more than I planned. The sizing was fine. I could have gone up a half size to accommodate thicker socks. They are comfortable and I haven't had any soreness. I have an above average arch and these provide good support.

size.issue_summary: 사이즈 관련 문제로 인해 많은 고객들이 불만을 토로하고 있으며, 신발이 작거나 좁아서 착용에 어려움을 겪고 있습니다.
size.strength_summary: 많은 구매자들이 넓은 발가락 상자와 적절한 핏을 칭찬하며, 신발이 발에 잘 맞고 편안하다고 언급했습니다.

representative_reviews.text: These run smaller then all my other Keen shoes, had to return the first pair for a half size larger. Thank goodness Amazon made this return very easy. I have always worn Keen shoes as my foot is very narrow and these always fit great but, Keen quality has gone WAY down hill. These are not all leather they are stiff. Come on Keen what happened to your quality? Probably my last pair!

These shoes are not at all what I wanted. I'm a nurse and I work 12-hour shifts, I previously owned an older style of Presidio shoes from last year that I absolutely loved. Keen felt like they needed to modify the style, now the Arches are not in the right place, the heel is up higher, the ball area is narrower, and they have engraven the word Keen inside the shoe on the arch. So now when my feet are swollen from being on them for 12 hours the word Keen is engraving on them when I take them off. I wore these for just a little while around my house to check them out and I will be returning them. Very very very disappointed. I'm also angry that what is pictured on the website is not what I got in the mail. The older style has the pink flowers on the insole of the shoe. I looked on the picture to ensure that that's what I was getting and the flowers are there however, when the shoes came they were the newer style that I had seen in the store and knew I didn't like. Very angry.

I thought I was getting a non-slip shoe. Boy was I wrong. Im slop sliding all over the place. I ordered 8w but they are a little looser than I prefer. I'm super bummed I missed the return window for something I can get no use out of.

This shoe runs a little bit small. I returned them due to size, but won t be re-ordering because the shoes looked too chunky for me. I m looking for a nice looking walking shoe for traveling one that is stylish and doesn t look like a tennis shoe. This one doesn t look like a tennis shoe, but looks just a bit too functional to be attractive. The search goes on!
The shoes disappointed me! The threading that holds the sides together came apart and the shoes were not cheap!

Very frustrating that the only company that makes shoes with TRULY WIDE toe boxes cannot make an oxford for the loyal customers who've been wearing their boots for years. People with wide, square toe boxes have almost no shoe choices. If Keen would make shoes that fit me other than the heavy boots, I'd be buying them! I do have the Kaci Winter clog and it's WONDERFUL. Unfortunately, the Kaci regular slip on is very rough and uncomfortable. So I am stuck wearing boots, even in the hot summer. I would LOVE a pair of sneakers or oxfords that really had room for my toes and looked nice at work.

I had such high hopes for this shoe. I've owned three pairs in the past--navy, red, and black. I ordered this in the same size 9 expecting no issues. However, you can see from my photo that they don't make the shoe as they did in the past. The toe box is much narrower and the black rubber ? that wraps around the toe isn't as large doesn't cover as large an area on the toe of the shoe as in the past. Keen!! We loved these shoes because of the design! Those of us with wide, upward-pointing large-toes found these the perfect shoe. Not in these days. Just know if you have wide feet the regular 9 fit me perfectly before , these will likely be too narrow for you. I don't know why they felt the need to redesign them. I guess I'll have to find another shoe company as my go-to in the future. Sigh! I don't do negative reviews, well, rarely. Only if I think it will truly help someone and not hurt the seller. But you need to be aware of this change, especially if you've purchased them in the past and you're trying now and expect the same results. Not true for me.

They're very attractive and appear to be comfortable, but these shoes are too short. I can't get my heel into the back of the shoe, even though the toe box is a perfect fit. The photo shows them between my size 9 Merrells, which run a half size small. My Ariats are 8.5 US .

I have been wearing Presidio shoes for over a decade, and these shoes are quite different. They are much narrower and the toe box is small. I returned them because I found them extremely uncomfortable. I used to wear Keen shoes only, but I guess I will have to shop for a new brand.

I love Keens. I have worn out several pair. I have a duck foot narrow heel, wide forefoot with toes that go straight across instead of angling down. These were to be a replacement pair for my work shoes I'm a nurse on my feet all day - Keens plus SuperFeet insoles are my go-to. I ordered the same size that I currently wear. I was hugely disappointed when they arrived - as they were huge! Keen, since when is a US 7 an Euro 39? My feet love your shoes, but please please please standardize your sizes - without making the toe box narrower like you did with the Targhee.
One shoe felt as though it was a different size. i love Keens, but this was tight in the toes and loose in the heels. My feet were aching by the end of the day.

I thought it would be convenient getting my shoes on amazon. Ordered the same exact size and style that I have bought in the store the last 4 times. These shoes were too narrow and too short. I can t wear them so they are in the closet and I had to go to the shoe store and get my shoes.
Have several keen shoes. Did not like the way these fit. Returned. Wish they would bring back the toyas they fit perfect and look just like these. These hurt when i walked.

I've ordered this style of shoe for years. The brown were out of stock so I ordered the black. They are not the same. At first glance they look the same, but the stitching across the top of the toe box is in a different place, which causes it to rub on my toe. The toe box itself is a slightly rounder shape - and smaller than the brown style. The heel is not as wide. The same size shoe is slightly shorter in the black than the brown. Not pleased. It's past the return window so I'm trying to stretch them a bit. If that doesn't work I will likely donate them.

I am a mail man for the United States Post Office. I purchased these shoes because out of all the ones that I had researched, these shoes met the requirements for OSHA. However, I have worn these shoes for seven months and they are falling apart. This is not a good work shoe. Never should have purchased this product.
My second pair of these shoes. Wide toe box and great fit right from the box. Support for people who need good alignment.

I ordered a 6.5, which is the size of my other Keen shoes. They fit great except for being slightly loose around the heal even though the length of the shoe is perfect. To solve the problem I plan on installing a pair of leather heel cushions. However I have worn them without the heel cushions while walking around the house and the slight heel slip is not uncomfortable. It is similar to the heel slip that is normal when wearing Klogs or Danskos so perhaps the heel cushions will not be necessary. Edit the heel cushion idea did not work, but what did work is changing out the sole insert to one that does not have as high of a profile. By doing this my foot sits lower in the shoe, allowing me to tighten the laces, which snugs up the shoe in the heel area.

Fits perfectly IF you order at least one size larger. I usually buy 1 3 size larger for Keen sandals but for this shoe I had to order a full size larger. I where these for 12-16 hr shifts on my feet and my feet feel great. Used them as my only shoe on a 10 day walking tour in Norway. We were allowed only a carry on luggage. Dressed up nicely with black sacks. No regrets at all! I will buy another pair so that if they stop making them I have another pair.
Awesome fit great for people planter bunions and hammer toes. Great arch support and nice roomy toe box.
This has been my go to shoe for the past several years for walking. Wide enough toe bed to accommodate my bone spur and my orthotics for my plantar fasciitis fit just fine.
Super comfy with wide toe box, which is perfect for me. Wear at work all day and am on my feet much of the time. Would buy again!
THis product has a larger toe box which is very nice for me as I need it for my foot that was injured and it works really well. If you have shoes that are too tight please try these.
This shoe fits like the Keen Woman's Voyageur hiking shoe and the Keen Women's Targhee 2 hiking shoe. The toe box is generous, not tapered. Very comfortable!

Right out of the box- these shoes were comfortable. The toe area is roomy, the width is just right. Usually I have to break my walking shoes in blisters! not these. They fit true to size and the arch support is ample so after wearing them all day my feet do not hurt. These shoes are worth every penny!

I normally wear a size 8 in Keen shoes, even though that size brings my toes to the front of the box. So, this time, I ordered an 8.5 and they were still too short, so I sent those back and ordered a size 9. Now, I have less than 1 2 inch between my toe tip and the front of the shoe box. It appears the box gets wider, the higher in size you go, but the length of the interior of the shoe bed remains about the same. I will have to live with these size 9s for now.

I have a narrow heal with a wide foot. I'm usually having to buy a child's shoe which never has the width nor comfortable insoles. However if this shoe came in a 5 I would give it 5 stars. The slight curve at the toe box makes you walk more like your supposed to which at the end of the day my back even feels great.
Great shoes ... perfect for walking and ya d work. Love this style ..roomy toe box yet fits my foot.

I really like this sturdy shoe. It fits my foot perfectly. Good cushion under the foot. Arch fits good and feels supportive. NIce roomy toe box but not too big. Love the way they look and I think I'm going to buy another pair in black.
They fit perfectly right out of the box and I wore them continuously for the next 2 days. I love these shoes!

Keen makes shoes for real feet. You know, not long skinny ski feet, but actual human shaped feet. They fit just right and last a long time. This will be my second pair of Presidios. The first ones lasted eight years.

durability.issue_summary: 구매자들은 내구성 문제로 인해 신발이 빠르게 손상되거나 찢어지는 경우가 많다고 보고하고 있습니다.
durability.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 내구성이 뛰어나고 쉽게 마모되지 않으며 튼튼한 고무 밑창을 가지고 있다고 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다.

Keen felt like they needed to modify the style, now the Arches are not in the right place, the heel is up higher, the ball area is narrower, and they have engraven the word Keen inside the shoe on the arch. I looked on the picture to ensure that that's what I was getting and the flowers are there however, when the shoes came they were the newer style that I had seen in the store and knew I didn't like. Very angry.

I have been wearing Keen brand shoes for over 10 years and they usually last a long time. I recently purchased a pair of Women s Keen Presidio style shoes and have been using them as dress shoes occasionally. I noticed a tear in the stitching recently and am I disappointed, especially since I just recently purchased them and paid over 100. Keen has always been a very well made and long lasting brand. I cannot afford to buy new ones right now, so I will try to repair the tear with shoe glue.
These bruised the ever living crap out of my ankle heel area on both feet. And I don't bruise easily.

After wearing 1 or 2 days at work, which consists of me mostly sitting with occasional walking, the rubber on the sides of the left shoe started detaching from the leather both sides, from front to back. Since I desperately needed them and couldn't wait to return replace, I used shoe goo to reattach. Right shoe is still perfectly fine after wearing daily for 3 weeks. Despite the manufacturing defect quality control issue, I love the look and fit of these shoes. So far, they have also proved to provide good traction on the snowy icy sidewalks and parking lots.

The heals have a ridge in them. They were not sewn in correctly. I just tried them on. Now I can't return. They have never been used. I have many pairs, this is the only one that has had a problem. I can compare with my other shoes and can see what is wrong.
Stitching coming undone between suede leather near laces, after 6 months. I use these shoes twice a week on a rowing machine

I am a mail man for the United States Post Office. I purchased these shoes because out of all the ones that I had researched, these shoes met the requirements for OSHA. However, I have worn these shoes for seven months and they are falling apart. This is not a good work shoe. Never should have purchased this product.

Just noticed that a seam is giving out on these already and I have only had them a little over a month. No way to return them. They are comfortable, but I don't know if I would purchase another pair of shoes from this brand if they are this poorly made
Extremely hard and non-forgiving. It would take a lot to break these shoes in. I sent them back. They are made well and would be nice for winter, but are so uncomfortable - I couldn't wear them.
Ordered a second pair, but they had a hole where there was supposed to be stitching. UPDATE ABOVE The insole has changed, no support at all. The shoe could use a better insole for a better fit.

When I purchased these I had done weeks of research. I liked the Keen brand because I have had a pair of Keen Betty Boot that I have worn for years in the winter for my outside volunteer job in Wisconsin. I wear my boots a lot for this job. So I wanted a great pair of Keen shoes for my other job at Starbucks. I wanted leather and an incredible sole for being on my feet. I work 3 shifts per week and sometimes 4 but I only work about 24 hours per week at the most. I wear these shoes exclusively for this part time job. I have never worn them for a anything else. Here we are, 6 months later and today the sole popped off! On my other shoes, which I also attacked a picture for, you can see the sole is also breaking. It s ridiculous! I m so so disappointed. And there is no way to contact them to complain. V I m so careful with what I buy because I want it to last but now I m going to have to come up with another pair of work shoes. How frustrating.

I have previously purchased 2 pairs of these shoes and loved them, so when they started to wear out again, I reordered from the exact same vendor. These are not the same shoes. Smaller toe box, rubber toe protection does not go all the way around anymore, the material feels like crap, and it s not even the same shape. So disappointed.
These shoes broke within 6 months! The bottom of the shoes split apart and separated! Not worth it! And my coworkers did the same thing within 6 months! Dont buy!
I ve been wearing Keen shoes for years and never had a pair break down like these, and I only wear them at home. There are rips along seams on both shoes where the foot bends.
I have worn KEENs for my job for over 15 years OR nurse They are by far the most comfortable, durable, and safe shoe that I have ever worn---and I have tried many!
Over the past 15 years I've had 9 pair these shoes. They don't wear out! Seriously I still have 5 pair for backups. Just bought a black pair and a Brown pair. Can't say enough!
My previous pair of Keens Presidio , had a leather interior lining footbed. Please update photo on Amazon!!!! I likes the leather better.
Came much more quickly than expected. Durable, well made. Kind of matronly, but hopefully that improves as I wear them in.
I work standing on cement floors all day and these shoes are the best I ve found. This is my fourth pair!
There is stitching visible on one toe that isn t on the other. It s not causing a problem necessarily, but it s a visible flaw. I don t see how it got through quality like that, to be honest.
This is the only style of shoe I wear on a consistent basis. They support my feet so well. Thank you for the quick shipment.

These shoes are fantastic for Michigan's fall season. They're rather comfy because the toes aren't scrunched. They're a little stiff the first week but they're still comfy. I like that the soles aren't smooth, they've got some tread.

I am very pleased with my Keen's Presidio. I have been looking for a new everyday shoe since my go-to Asics seem to have changed for the worse. I have a severe overpronation in one ankle and need a lot of support. I replaced the insole with Pinnacle Maxx and have been very pleased. It is also nice to have something that isn't a tennis shoe in the everyday rotation, but I wouldn't wear these to work. They are a little too casual. I ordered the brown and plan to order another pair soon.

Very interesting design in the top of these. The cross over look is different and I really like it. Very comfortable. I didn't want suade and am not sure how long these will look good but over all I'm happy.

I like this shoe a lot this is my second pair and wear them every day because they are one of the only shoes that has enough toe room for me and doesn t give me ingrown toenails. THAT SAID, I think Keen changed their design a bit and this shoe seems a bit more cheaply made than the ones I used to have. The laces broke almost immediately I m talking a week or two after I bought them , and now, about 5 months later, the sole is starting to separate from the body of the shoe so I have to be careful that I don t pull on them the wrong way when I take them off. The inner liner which used to be leather is now a scratchy polyester material. Also they discontinued my favorite color purple . They work well for my feet so I m sure I ll buy them again, but I just wish those small things were a little better.

I literally stand on my feet for eight hours at work. Experienced a two year case of horrific plantar fasciitis before finding these shoes. Hasn t acted up since. Soles comes out to use personal orthotics. I stretch it out to about one year before I feel it necessary to replace them.

I love the design of the shoes, in 2018 bought the first pair, but less than a year the front became opened, so I just wear it as working shoes in April 2020 I bought the 2nd pair, probably just a few months the front opened again, and if I continue wear it, sometimes was caught in rains, water would seep in and got my socks colored, so again just after a months, again I just wear it as working shoes you can see some paint drops on them . The quality of the shoes needs to be improved for this price. Though I still love this design, and its comfortable!

These are not the quality or comfort of my old beloved Keens. Fire the bugger who changed the shoe as you will lose your customer base. Sears dropped quality for the big bucks and look at them now! Perhaps you should make the old style and send each of us a pair to re-establish your good name! Otherwise, you've lost a lot of customers forever, including me.

They're Keens, I love them. What else can I say, I'm sold on this brand. They have a wider for box to give wiggle room to my toes! Very sturdy leather and durable cotton laces with sturdy rubber soles.

Keen has changed the inserts to be more "green". They are terrible. I will need to replace them or use the ones from my last pair of Keen shoes. These used to be wonderful shoes, but they are not made like they once were. So disappointed.

I am a huge Keen fan and own several pairs of their shoes and sandals including 3 different colored pairs of their original Presidio shoes. My original brown Presidios are getting long in tooth so I got these ones as a replacement. A replacement they are not! They are inferior in materials and the look with the weird textured leather against the smooth leather is odd. They got returned. Please Keen....bring back your original Presidio shoes!!!

I bought these based on the good reviews, expecting great things. I opened the box and thought these couldn't be the same shoes I'd seen in the pictures. From the top, they are just about the ugliest shoes I've ever seen. They make my foot look like a quadruple wide even though they're regular medium width. I put the shoes on expecting them to be supremely comfortable if people loved them so much despite their looks, but they're stiff and clunky like wearing a concrete block. They dug into the back of my heels without even taking a step. On the bright side, they look like they would last a really long time, if only anyone can bring herself to actually wear them. They're going back tomorrow.

Walking shoe, would love a lighter color or two tone- one lighter and one darker - want a Summer pair but don t want shoe to look like little old lady old man tan- off white and sienna....have black and brown ....but had to return blue because they rubbed back if ankle

Very interesting design in the top of these. The cross over look is different and I really like it. Very comfortable. I didn't want suade and am not sure how long these will look good but over all I'm happy.
I now own 6 pairs of Keens and this is the first pair that is all leather and stylish! I love them and can t wait to buy another pair but a different color so I have more choices!!
These are my go to shoes for work, casual night out, go well with jeans and khakis. Most importantly they're so comfy!

I love the design of the shoes, in 2018 bought the first pair, but less than a year the front became opened, so I just wear it as working shoes in April 2020 I bought the 2nd pair, probably just a few months the front opened again, and if I continue wear it, sometimes was caught in rains, water would seep in and got my socks colored, so again just after a months, again I just wear it as working shoes you can see some paint drops on them . The quality of the shoes needs to be improved for this price. Though I still love this design, and its comfortable!
Came much more quickly than expected. Durable, well made. Kind of matronly, but hopefully that improves as I wear them in.

Keen makes a great shoe, and this one was no exception. However, I was hoping to use this as a casual shoe, and with casual clothes it looked HUGE. I felt like Orphan Annie. Still, the quality was excellent, and I'm sad I had to send these back for aesthetic reasons. Returned.

My wife discovered this Presidio Keen shoe approximately 1999 in a sports specialty store selling inline skates while visiting in Evansville, IN. It was the perfect solution for an active elderly hard to fit foot with high arches, hammer toes, and degenerative arthritis. Living 700 miles away on the Gulf Coast subsequent orders had to be placed on line through the Keen Web site as the full spectrum of colors and Woman's sizes are not stocked in stores here. Since women enjoy color coordinating shoes am disheartened to discover that all online stores and Amazon are out of any colors but Brown, Black, and Gray in almost all sizes. They are missing many sales due to ignoring the long success of this unique shoe.

The structure and stability of Asics Gel Kayano have freed me to continue doing many of the things that have made me me. Though the life of the shoe has never been long enough, I m so grateful to Asics for making these life-living shoes. I m not sure how many Gel Kayanos I ve had over the years but it s more than 20. I invested in this most recent version again after reading Asics added more cushioning. The added cushioning is completely noticeable. It s really nice. However, after about a week of normal running in them, those old familiar pre-Asics Gel Kayano pains began. After 2 weeks, the pain and swelling expanded, as structural problems tend to do. Remembering the extra cushioning change in this version, I wondered if the cushioning, though nice, may have created a structural problem for me by lessening the stability that this shoe was designed to correct. These shoes are not inexpensive and after 2 weeks of wear I did not think returning them was an option. So I slid some extra arch supports under the insoles to see if it would re-structure the shoe, overriding the lessened stability issue. This helped immensely. Bottom line This should not happen in a shoe designed for stability. Though the extra cushioning is nice, it cannot come at the cost of stability in a stability shoe. Customers like me rely upon that stability. More testing should have occurred before releasing this version of this important shoe. Customers should not have to foot the bill for a failure to thoroughly test a change like this and a shoe that is designed to address a stability issue should not create one. I still love you, Asics! But you can do better.

This can of course cause some pain and numbness, but as the shoe breaks in this may settle better. The color is AMAZING. Finally offering some fun colors!! Do this more please ASICS. Runners are all about bright fun colors in shoes and clothing. The reason I gave this shoe a 4 star instead of a 3 is because of the springy bounce it gives. This shoe lost the firmness but gained bounce. It s hard for me to get good speed in a softer shoe, but the springy bounce gave it what I needed. The question is, will the shoe be able to retain that as the shoe wears? The thing about ASICS that stands above the rest is their ability to create a shoe that doesn t break down. It keeps its firmness, form, doesn t stretch out and doesn t get mushy or change. Only time will tell if this shoe can retain or not. I m training for a half marathon right now so I m keeping fingers crossed .

This was a terrible experience. I got the wide. I have a 'normal' foot width, not slim but not too wide either. I've read reviews saying Clark's run narrow, I had no idea how narrow. These were just awful. I had to struggle to get them on, they are that tight all around the shoe. I wear very thin socks yet due to the tight fit, my socks were all bunched up at the top. My feet could not slip into these shoes but I had to wrangle them in. Even so, I was very surprised that the heel portion was sliding up down on my heel area with every step. How can they be too tight all over yet the heel doesn't stay in place? I would have gotten sore spots if I had worn these for any length of time. The shoe itself is incredibly snug, perhaps just wide enough on the bottom but the rest of the shoe was like my feet being strangled. I cannot recommend this shoe for anyone. I will likely avoid Clarks from now on.

I ordered these shoes to wear on vacation, where I expected to do a lot of walking. Fortunately, I tested them first during a college campus visit with one of my kids. My feet have never hurt so badly as they did at the end of that day. My plantar fasciitis also flared terribly after wearing these shoes on that one day, and I've had no relief in the 8 weeks since. I do not recommend these shoes for any reason.

Received day before scheduled yea! However, I ordered an 8 Med but shoes were so very narrow I couldn't get them on. I loved the price but have to return shoes for a refund. I purchased the exact shoes cost more at a local store, 8 Med and they fit!
I m disappointed that the shoe is tearing. This is a very reputable brand and I don t wear them much so the damage is done and I can t return them or exchange them.

I bought these looking for an alternate to my go to Sketchers for restaurant work, but I quickly became unhappy with this purchase. These shoes are fine when it comes to slip resistance, but they are not comfortable for long term wear. Ive developed a weird callous on the middle of my feet from the support that hurts A LOT, I ve never had this happen from work shoes before. I ve had these shoes for almost two months, so they had their chance, but I will be switching back to buying Sketchers.

I was excited about the positive reviews and recommendations, so even though they did not have that instant 34 oh yeah 34 feel of comfort when I first tried them on I decided to give them a chance to 34 break in 34 . After 2 weeks of wearing these for work I find I am disappointed with the fit and they have not lived up to all the praise they get. These shoes were highly recommended for women who stand for work all day, which I do. They were praise for being great for people that struggle with plantar fasciitis, which I also do. After 2 weeks, by the end of the day I can't wait to take them off, I can barely walk, and my heel throbs with pain all night. The heel support of the shoe feels like it is compressing to become harder instead of providing cushioning. It is also designed as a centralized cushion under the heal, like a bubble, that does not continue to the outside edge of the lining. The size is not the best fit. I would normally wear a 7.5 wide. Because of all the recommendations to go up a size, I ordered 8 wide. They are slightly too long. The width is a good fit, though a tiny bit narrow. As they have 34 broken in 34 my foot had begun to slip forward and back. These are slip on shoes so they can not be tightened. They may be great if you use orthopedic inserts but I do not. I did add some gel heal inserts the last time I wore them which helped a little. I like the look of them but the inside cushioning and support does not meet my needs out of the box. They were a waste time and money. I will need to find more comfortable inserts or keep looking to find the right shoe for me.

I wish I could write a better review because I was looking forward to wearing these considering they had cloud in the name but it definitely didn t feel like I was walking on clouds. Maybe they could of put memory foam they would of been a lot better but like I said super disappointed definitely wouldn t buy these again and if you plan on being on your feet all day DO NOT WEAR THESE ! Sorry for the bad review but you couldn t pay me to wear these shoes again

I love the look of the shoe. However, the arch doesn't exist and the type of cushion just ends up making your feet hurt within an hour. Maybe have these as a style shoe but is in no way fit for working long hours. Returned.
I have skinny feet and I find it difficult to get my foot through the top. Once it s in I m fine, but then it s a hassle to remove. I don t even wear them anymore because of that

After three attempts I found a pair of insoles that help with cushion, support and overall comfort--but it's the insoles that make the shoes workable for me.

These shoes took some trial and error. I saw that they were generally too small per the reviews, so I measured my feet throughout the day. Once I had my highest among those measurements, I compared that to the size chart, and then ordered a size up. When I got my first set of shoes, they were still somehow way, way too small. I wore them a day or two to my job expecting maybe they just needed time to stretch or something I work retail so it consists of being on my feet for 8 hours and my feet were in excruciating pain. I couldn't do it. I sent them back. I then ordered two further sizes up because these were the most recommended shoes for standing on your feet a long time. And obviously based on my 5 star review I don't think they cause excruciating pain, right? These shoes fortunately were perfectly sized. And they feel like HEAVEN on my poor feet. They're cushiony and supportive and sure, my feet still hurt at the end of an eight hour shift of standing on hard linoleum but no longer is it to the 34 can't stand up straight, everything too sore 34 level that it used to be - it was easily cut down seventy five percent. I heartily recommend these shoes, just make sure you size up - possibly even multiple sizes!

I was looking for a comfortable, good-looking slip on off shoe for running my errands and found it in this shoe. There is not as much arch support as I'd like, but these shoes are very, very comfortable, practical and attractive. Good price good shoe.
Took along on a trip that included the Sahara. Stayed comfortable and supportive even though they were not broken in. Great travel shoes. Look good without bulk of trainers.

These are the most comfortable shoes I have ever had. I am on a concrete floor for 8 hours while at work and never once have my feet hurt. They hug your foot but have some stretch to them. I don't know what is used inside for cushion but damn they are a must! They don't look bad either!

They won't break the bank either. If you're on the fence about trying these I would say go for it, you won't be disappointed! And hassle free returns with clarks, ordered the narrow size on accident on one of my pairs and sent them back and got refund fairly quickly! Worth every penny!

These shoes are a Godsend for the pain I ve endured with Planters Fasciitis! The first time in 3 months that my feet have felt great! The arch support is perfect and the show is cushiony, but supportive. Love the shoes! I wish they were a little less plain, but they are SO comfortable.

I Love Clack shoes. They are so very comfy support my arch. I purchase them in two's in case they sell out.... I work two job, one is bookkeeping ,other job is a banquet server on my feet for 6 to 8 hour shifts. These Clark shoes are amazing. Highly recommend them

I picked up the package and put on the shoes before a day of shopping and for the first time in years my feet did not hurt at the end of the day - a miracle! I will be buying other styles and colors.

Clarks Black Cloud-Stepper slip in loafers size 10 M are exactly what I was looking for. I work in retail on my feet all day. I have been looking for a "comfortable" winter shoe. I usually wear a sneaker other seasons, but wanted something a bit more structured warmer for the Fall Winter months. These fit the bill perfectly. They are a suede type of material assuming they have a bit of weather proofing with a decent rubber sole w a bit of a wedge heel . The inside is "cloud" soft comfy. They slip-on fairly easily, but there is a tab the back heel to assist w getting your foot in. Assuming that with time, this will be really slip-on. The price was reasonable, as some of the other "name" brand slip-ons were very expensive. Hope they last a few seasons. I would recommend these.

These shoes took some trial and error. I saw that they were generally too small per the reviews, so I measured my feet throughout the day. Once I had my highest among those measurements, I compared that to the size chart, and then ordered a size up. When I got my first set of shoes, they were still somehow way, way too small. I wore them a day or two to my job expecting maybe they just needed time to stretch or something I work retail so it consists of being on my feet for 8 hours and my feet were in excruciating pain. I couldn't do it. I sent them back. I then ordered two further sizes up because these were the most recommended shoes for standing on your feet a long time. And obviously based on my 5 star review I don't think they cause excruciating pain, right? These shoes fortunately were perfectly sized. And they feel like HEAVEN on my poor feet. They're cushiony and supportive and sure, my feet still hurt at the end of an eight hour shift of standing on hard linoleum but no longer is it to the 34 can't stand up straight, everything too sore 34 level that it used to be - it was easily cut down seventy five percent. I heartily recommend these shoes, just make sure you size up - possibly even multiple sizes!

I absolutely LOVE these shoes. I work 10 hour days in retail, on concrete, all day. I've gone through plenty of shoes as they don't last very long when you're on your feet all day so I've gone through different brands and styles and have come to find that these cloud steppers are life saving! They won't break the bank either. If you're on the fence about trying these I would say go for it, you won't be disappointed! And hassle free returns with clarks, ordered the narrow size on accident on one of my pairs and sent them back and got refund fairly quickly! Worth every penny!
I bought this shoe to wear to work. Not sure how well it will hold up but so far doing good. I like that the toe box is roomy. I recommend that you use a shoe insert if your on your feet a lot.

I got these shoes for work as I work on thin carpet over concrete and they are ridiculously comfortable even months later. However, the first day I wore them I had to get down on the floor for a task and the toe scuffed. It turned shiny and that s fine. By weeks end the entire top foot of the front of the shoes was shiny. Unexpected, not a big issue for me but I won t buy this material again, but I love Clark s! So just be careful if you get them.

Love the fit, style, and comfort. I have plantar fasciitis and add an insert to these. They have been the only shoe I can wear comfortably. I do wear them a lot and walk a lot, but still think the heal should last longer. Longest I have gotten before tread was too worn to safely wear was 6 months. On my 4th pair and the picture is after 3 months. The shoe itself holds up, it is just the bottoms. Still the best for me.
I work retail management and the shoes are perfect for long hours they are so incredibly comfortable !

I have Multiple Sclerosis and am a large 6ft tall woman. I haven't had a decent pair of shoes in years and am mostly homebound. I dreaded the doctors office visits even because the only pair of shoes I have were worn and comfortable anymore and my feet hurt. I trip and fall a lot with this disease and have searched for years for a great supportive shoe and sole that did not look like an orthopedic shoe. I was overjoyed with excitement when I saw these shoes still in the box. They remind me so much of my 1960's-1970's years of great quality brown leather shoes. Nothing orthopedic about these puppies! Such a supportive and comfy soul and the shoe part fits like a glove, holds my foot well, makes me feel secure and the bits of elastic around the top edges helps me put them on so much. The design is so perfect in style and fit. They seriously make me feel young again, like those great brown leather shoes from my "hippy" years growing up. Modern but retro! Great quality shoes at an incredibly wonderful price! I have never volunteered before, but Clarke's.. I would write a testimonial for these shoes and will definitely share with the thousands of contacts I have who have multiple sclerosis as well as those who don't. I so want the black ones too but due to my extreme medical costs can not afford. Hopefully you will continue to make this shoe and I can get the black ones one day. Then I could have a pair to wear at home and when I go to the doctor. Please don't stop making or selling these before I can afford another pair. I've actually been crying tears of joy over how happy I am to finally have the first comfortable shoe in over 10 years. Thank you Clarke's!!! Dear Amazon seller, very dirty pool to jack up the price overnight by almost 20 bucks! Very nasty way to handle supply and demand and will make me hesitant to ever review anything on Amazon again. Way to ruin a great experience and prevent me from buying that second pair today that was already in my cart at 31 and today its up to 49! Very dirty way to do business and treat customers
I have another pair of Cloudsteppers and wanted a backup pair as I wear these everyday, they are great!!

I wear these to work, and I'm an ER nurse who rarely sits, and these feel pretty good and keep up. They also fit perfectly. I just wish the soles were about double the thickness.

representative_reviews.text: This is a minimalist-style shoe, with heel support. If you're into minimalist-style shoes, you might really like this shoe. If you're not, you'll hate it. It has pretty good heel support, but since it has absolutely zero support for the front half of your foot, the front part of your foot sits very close to the ground while your heel is up a half-inch, like high-heels. This awkward position makes your shins get worked really hard as you awkwardly walk around trying to keep your toes from up. It's probably something you'd get used to, but feels like it will cause shin splints initially. Toe box is also narrow shoe is narrow, and the "high heel" effect further causes your foot to slide down and forward, pressing your toes towards the end of the shoe. Pros Shoe looks nice. I would suggest these shoes as a casual about-town shoe but not necessarily a true running or workout shoe.

representative_reviews.text: The lace loop on the side broke after about 6 months. It s upsetting because these are really neat shoes.
They are too small and they hurt my feet, the insole is terrible and hurt the bottom of my feet. Have bought 2 pair and they both fit horribly

We bought these for a teenager about 3.5 months ago. These are his everyday shoes, used in PE at school but not for athletics. This is not a kid who abuses his shoes, yet they are already very broken down. The interior lining has frayed to the point of ripping open, and some of the foamy material inside the shoe frequently ends up on our carpet. The soles are more worn down than they should be at this point. Likewise for the interior support. We bought an identical pair of these shoes for another child from another retailer and had the same experience. I'm not quick to write negative reviews but these shoes were not a good purchase.

I dont wear these shoes very often except at home or to work on casual Friday. They are a great fit and very comfortable. That being said, the rubber on the sole at the heel of the shoe is coming apart on both shoes. This is the 1st pair of Pumas that I have owned that have been such poor quality.

These shoes looked great right out of the box. About 2 weeks after he started wearing them, the right shoe developed a hole around the toes. It is just on the outer layer of the shoe. It just gets bigger and bigger. Now the same thing is happening on the left shoe. This was a definite waste of money.

I bought these sneakers two months ago. After no more than 5 poses, these began to break near the seams. The holes, which are part of the design, intersect with the bottom seams and this increases the possibility of damage. I do not recommend them, very bad design. Very disappointed

Wore these shoes only 3 or 4 times and I noticed the stitching in the front started ripping away. I am not using these shoes for the gym or exercise but for maybe needing a pair of shoes to grab the mail.

Bought three pairs, correct size to my normal shoe size and have tried them for 6 weeks and the same issue with all of them... cannot get a comfortable fit from the ball of the foot forward the foot slips slides within the shoe causing the sock to wrinkle and discomfort if performing anything repetitive! They look great but no matter how many variations of tying the laces the same result. Exceedingly disappointed as I love the brand and the appearance but alas not the performance fit with this particular style. Looks like I will be having to find new shoes!
Returned after wearing for one day. The sole and padding on the front part of the shoe is so thin it felt like walking on concrete. Feet were hurting after a few hours.
I bought these shoes for my grandson Nov 24 2021 and today Feb 9th 2022 the whole toe ripped out! So in less than 3 months they are in the trash. Very disappointed with these.
The soles have holes in them and the bottom rubber part is detaching, I've had this shoes for maybe 2 months and this is already happening terrible shoes will never buy again.

Well I love the shoe style and size is perfect only thing is they look worn and even put a pic of the package to show outside package wasnt damaged but the box was like they have been returned then on some spots there is a black glue film that is nasty. Cant tell in pics of the glue stuff since its black but can feel the stickiness. Then the puma sign in back has runs in it like it was snagged these are also fresh out the box delivered 5 minutes ago and wow.
The shoe quality is terrible. This shoe has a thin rubber sole that supports the front end of the foot and weak sponge-like insulation inside that provides no protection from sharp objects.

The first one that I bought it was okay, the second one ended up in the trash , the material that they used now are sheap my foot was slippery inside the shoes, in my personal opinion they are garbage remember is my opinion.

One of the best pairs of shoes I have owned. I actually ordered another pair as a back up for when these wear out. They have been holding up without any issues and I get a lot of compliments on them. They are very comfortable.
Looks good, fits snug, and the inserts are very cushiony. All the stitching looks good too, so I assume they'll last awhile under normal use.

I am not a fan of the new style with the larger than life soles that go up the sides. These take the extreme opposite approach and you can barely see the sole in the front. Great looking shoe. Very comfortable memory foam type insole. The laces are a little tricky but if you just pull from the sides of the shoe instead of the top like traditional, you'll be alright.
The lacing setup provides excellent support for the whole foot, especially for someone who has narrow feet and or high arches. Definetly on my buy-again list.

I do a great deal of walking, and go to the gym a couple of times a week, and after about a month and a half of wearing these shoes I am very happy with them. They have what feels like a layer of memory foam on the insole, which I figured would flatten in no time, but so far it has held up. They also dry quickly, which I didn't think would be the case with that insole. A few times I've had to take a long walk in melting snow and figured I had ruined them, but a few hours later they're good as new When I first put them on, I noticed the outer sole was very stiff, and considered returning them for this reason because it felt odd. I don't know how much it has softened versus how much I've simply become accustomed to it, but now they just feel sturdy and I have come to appreciate this feature.
Shoe looks really nice, was a little tight, I got bigger laces and wear them untied knotted on the ends for work office .

Do not run, workout, or play a sport with these. Base is extremely comfy, like a pillow for your feet, but there is absolutely no structural support for the sides of this shoe. It's just fabric... If sidestepping fast you'll literally role your ankle or feel yourself stepping on the side wall of the shoe. Looks great though and get complements!

VIDEOID 6fcfdee14b43032bb1101db51624047f My review is admittedly askew in the sense that due to conditions they quickly became daily shows which I am fairly rough on by doing indoor and outdoor general labor handyman work. With that I'd say they were quite comfortable initially but I broke them in quick but the only issue I'd say is that I need to get some inserts as I've nearly worn through the padding inside at the ball of my feet, however still have tread on the bottom. Other than that, they've held together well. No holes or tears in the mesh. A little thread fraying but again I'd put that more of a result of quite vigorous daily usage. If they can be used as just running shoes or workout shoes then I think they'd have lasted much longer and remained in much better shape. Although looking at them after these last few months, I think they'd still look pretty good if I cleaned them up. You can judge in the video though.
Best shoes ever if you ve had heel fractures which my Dr said is similar to plantar fasciitis. Fit is narrow and a little short. Order 1 2 size larger than the size you normally wear.
Support for my Arch and comfort was better then Asics and I've been an Asics New Balance guy for Years Switched Shoe Companies NOW 2 PUMA.
I've got a wide foot AND a high instep. Some shoes ya gotta break in. Ten minutes and these were like buttah. Love them

I purchased this sneaker at the end of 2019 for 64.99, now it is going for 110.00 WTF sorry folks, definitely not worth 110.00 very little ankle support . However, the durability is good. Thanks for the inflation Uncle Joe!!!!

Got them yesterday, and honestly wasn t expecting them to come so quickly. I m ecstatic about it though because I ve been needing new running shoes. They look more beautiful in person than they did online. They are a little snug, but I expected that where they are new and need to get broken in. The soles are memory foam which was awesome to find out. Overall I m very happy with my purchase and will be ordering more pairs in the near future.

Look cool, feel fantastic, great support. Love these shoes. I have more than one pair I like them so much. Just be careful they can be really tight in the toes. I had to order 1 2 size larger. Took me a couple of tries to get the size right.
My husband has never , ever switched his style of shoes for 35 years until he met his pumas. Now he has new favorites. The pumas. He describes them.... like walking on pillows.

representative_reviews.text: These shoes are incredibly cute but VERY uncomfortable! I had blisters on the top of my feet with socks on because of the tongue of the shoe. There s no support either. The opening of the shoe is to tight - the shoe runns loose - it is a very stiff shoe no give when walking

I loved the look of this shoe, but they hurt my feet so bad. It s like walking around in cinderblocks. There s no movement in them at all. I was limping by the end of my work day. I assumed there would be some ankle blisters, my Vans do this as well while I m breaking them in. But these made my toes hurt in the worst way. They also rubbed red spots almost blisters on all sides of my feet. If you get them, I would definitely order a size up! I ordered my exact size. They were sooooo cute just super painful!

I had to return because they were extremely stiff and hard to walk in. The top part would hit my front of my ankle and formed a blister. They super cute and I wanted to keep but it was just too uncomfortable

Without a doubt the most uncomfortable sneakers I have ever worn. I wore them twice. Both times they tore up my ankles and bruised the top of my feet. I had blisters and cuts. Walked a couple miles each time. The second time, I even used moleskine around the spots where they rubbed and they still gave me blisters. I waited too long to return them, so they're getting donated. Maybe someone else will have better luck.
These kicks are cute but the tongue of the shoe is weirdly long? This causes it to rub on the bottom of my shin bone and blister, ugh. I still wear them but not if I m walking very far.

This shoe was so tight and narrow. My toes hurt after a few hours of wearing. I couldn t wait to take them off. The tongue of the shoes also rubbed the top of my ankles raw. I ve never experienced a more stiff shoe in my life. Maybe after continuous use it would loosen up but I just couldn t bare the pain it was causing. I has immediate relief once I took them off. I m not sure if I have a thick foot but it felt like there wasn t enough of the shoe to completely go over my ankles and so when I walked it felt unsecured. My ankle felt like they didn t sit in the shoe all the way, I ve not experienced that in another shoe. I returned them, I just couldn t handle how bad they were designed. I DO NOT recommend.
Really disappointed with this purchase. These shoes are very uncomfortable. They are very narrow and have no arch support. I would not recommend these to anyone. Save your money.

These may look nice, but put them on and feel how UNCOMFORTABLE they are! They are absolutely horrible. Very narrow in front so my foot is squeezed. And my heal is falling out the back even though they are my size. Don t ever think I will get another pair of pumas if this is how they feel.
Should have listened to the reviews. These shoes are stiff, uncomfortable and constantly slip on and off the heel while walking. I don t ever plan to wear them again. Should have sent them back.

I may update this review later if my feet get used to these shoes, or the other around when I started wearing them the tongues were really hurting my feet too long and too hard, putting way too much pressure on my lower leg . However after wearing them for several days, the tongues somehow stopped hurting, or way less. Another source of pain when I wear these shoes is the joint between my toes and the rest of foot at every step it especially hurts when I walk more than 10 minutes in a row, and it s very painful. I ll keep wearing these shoes a bit to see if things get better, but as of now I am quite disappointed at these even if the sole seems to be quite comfortable. I m glad I got a good deal out of it because they are certainly not worth much if it s too painful to wear them.
The material is rock hard. Only tried oneday, my feet were painful on every step and when i took off the shoes, i saw my skin worn out by them...
I'm not sure why but when my foot bent as I took a step, the inside of the top of the shoe hurt the top of my foot. I returned them even though i loved the look of the sneakers.
Cute shoe but had to return bc the back of the shoe is too short and my heals slipped out as I walked around in them.

I love the look of these and the quality is good. Price was fantastic. I'm disappointed that I found the fit to be awkward and potentially problematic it was tight and stiff through the ball and middle sections but wider in the toe and heel. Even when tied, my heel popped out while walking which could easily result in blisters.

These are beautiful but the fit is a little weird. I went with my bigger size 8 instead of a 7.5 . They are tight in the middle, as other reviews mentioned, BUT my heels also tend to lift up out of the back. I've never had that issue before. It almost drags my socks down which is annoying enough to take a star away. I have high arches - I'm assuming that's the cause. They're breaking in nicely though. I feel like these are more comfortable after a few weeks of wear and the tightness will be minimal after a few more weeks. I sprayed them with Scotchgard Fabric protector before wearing to prevent stains and provide a little water resistance. I'd 100 recommend that if you get the white versions too. I also noticed the California style being sold on Free People for 90 so I feel like the 32 I paid was an extra good deal now.
Good feel if you have wide feet. Not so much if you have flat feet, I used with Dr. Sholls insoles. Great look. But got an ankle sprain wearing these.

I am very dissatisfied and disappointed with this shoe. The shoe fits my foot and all but they are very uncomfortable, to say the least. I've worn them for a week or so, in my house and out and about, you know, to "break" them in, but they did not give anywhere on the shoe. There is no arch support or cushion in the shoe, and isn't that a concerning factor in shoe shopping? By now I think Puma should know that but it seems they don't boooooo ! Guess I got what I paid for

I bought size 8.5 because it is the size I wear and the feedback indicated that it should fit me well. It is a shoe with a beautiful combination of colors, I am not a fan of the brand but I am always willing to try brands and this time I allowed myself to buy some comfortable shoes to wear with different styles. The front shape is somewhat strange, maybe it's just that I'm not used to this model, it looks like a duck head. Something that is very important to me is that the leather is not too stiff, this one is quite stiff, in addition, the model is for a narrow foot very narrow , my foot is not wide but roomy shoes are better for me. This model is quite narrow, it is felt especially in the front part where the laces start, my toes fell asleep in a couple of hours and without wearing socks, I will need very thin socks or I will simply wear them without socks. The sole is quite comfortable, although a bit stiff. After all, you can see the good material and they look durable, despite everything, I hope they soften with some use, I really trust that hahahaha

Kind of remind me of some of my early 2000s skate shoes . They tend to scuff up pretty easily but so far they haven t been too much of a pain to clean, I ve just been scrubbing them with a damp washcloth and a bit of soap.

It could just be my feet though I think it s still worth a try considering the price.

I love the look of these shoes so I keep wearing them despite the super snug toe box. Hoping they break in a bit over the next few wears.
