These shoes are nice and takes ne back to my HS years. If you have a short wide foot then you should go a half size up regarding the width across the widest part of the lower foot. I had to take out the inside cushion to wear a thin seamless sock or wear without socks... I still love them and they are comfortable with those adjustments.

Love the look, but quickly realized it hurt to walk in and is tight enough on your feet to slowly get uncomfortable as the day goes on. Ordered half a size up from usual and it fits fine at first but definitely not functional for long days. Cant seem to loosen it enough to be comfy and it would be too big if I went up a size. Have had better luck with other puma shoes for that balance between comfort and style
Awesome looking shoe! They re a little tight and have a narrow width but there s enough room for my toes. I wear a size 7

I bought these thinking they would fit fine and be as comfortable as it said. I was sadly mistaken, firstly they run tight across the foot and the stitching for the tongue of the shoe rubbed the top of my foot so bad, first day wearing left me in agony thru my 8hour nursing shift. I placed two cans inside to widen the top and loosened and relaxed the laces, it's better now but I would advise to buy a size larger than your regular size.

Order 1 2 size up!!! Unfortunately I didn t and have to send back. These really are a great deal at 34! I used to pay 65 for the same style back in the 90 s. Only reason I left off a star is because something is off with the fit. I ve always been an 8 in this style but these I could barely get on, too narrow. The arch support is high and comfy but makes heel feel like is barely on.... if that makes sense? You may risk heel slipping if you size up... maybe this shoe is best for narrow footed person in their regular size possibly replacing insole with something lower? Wish they fit, quality is high. Came brand new in box as described.

Love the look of the shoe! The price was great! Shoe does run on the narrow side and has a more narrow toe box. I have average feet. I don't own any wide shoes - have never had to. If wide width is an option I would recommend getting the wide. Otherwise, nice fashion sneakers for sure.

I wasn t sure about these at first.. the tongue of the shoe was extremely stiff and dug into the front of my ankles when I would walk. However, about a month later I can say that they have softened up considerably and I really enjoy the look of them.. a little more dressy than regular sneakers. Kind of remind me of some of my early 2000s skate shoes . They tend to scuff up pretty easily but so far they haven t been too much of a pain to clean, I ve just been scrubbing them with a damp washcloth and a bit of soap.
I love these shoes! They are perfect fit, true to size. And not cheaply made at all. They are made very good and my favorite shoes to wear now.

I'm sooo excited! I just received the white puma's. I wear a U.S. womens 9 my feet are a little wide not wide enough to order a wide shoe I ordered a women's 9 the fit is perfect. They are in perfect condition. I read in a previous review to spray them with scotch guard I'll do that before I wear them. Plus I'm pretty rough on shoes. I ordered it on May 13 it gave me an arrival date of May 19 -21. I was surprised to see it outside early in the day on May 15. I was a little hesitant because it wasn't a prime product but Shoebacca did a great job. I will order more in the near future. Happy shopping !

durability.issue_summary: 구매자들은 내구성과 관련하여 재질이 너무 단단하고, 착용 후 피부가 손상되는 문제를 경험했습니다. 또한, 밑창이 움직이지 않아 불편함을 초래하고 있습니다.
durability.strength_summary: 구매자들은 내구성이 뛰어난 소재와 품질에 대해 긍정적인 반응을 보였습니다. 이 신발은 쉽게 청소할 수 있어 실용적입니다.

representative_reviews.text: With the exception of the tongue of the shoe, these would've been perfect. However, there is a giant, hard plastic Puma tag sewn onto the tongue that digs into the top of your feet... at least they did mine. I tried them a second time, thinking maybe they just weren't broken in. Sadly, that was the incorrect assumption. The return is taking forever. I've contacted Amazon and the seller directly. So far, nothing.
The material is rock hard. Only tried oneday, my feet were painful on every step and when i took off the shoes, i saw my skin worn out by them...
Shoes are incredibly cute but painful to wear, can t break them in. Sole does not move and tongue cuts into the front of your ankle.

I bought size 8.5 because it is the size I wear and the feedback indicated that it should fit me well. It is a shoe with a beautiful combination of colors, I am not a fan of the brand but I am always willing to try brands and this time I allowed myself to buy some comfortable shoes to wear with different styles. The front shape is somewhat strange, maybe it's just that I'm not used to this model, it looks like a duck head. Something that is very important to me is that the leather is not too stiff, this one is quite stiff, in addition, the model is for a narrow foot very narrow , my foot is not wide but roomy shoes are better for me. This model is quite narrow, it is felt especially in the front part where the laces start, my toes fell asleep in a couple of hours and without wearing socks, I will need very thin socks or I will simply wear them without socks. The sole is quite comfortable, although a bit stiff. After all, you can see the good material and they look durable, despite everything, I hope they soften with some use, I really trust that hahahaha

I have worn these mant times and they just don't seem to be breaking in like other shoes. The rub on the top of my foot so I had to undo some of the laces at the top. The sole is pretty inflexible. They look super stylish and get compliments, just not as comfortable as they look.
Love these sneakers! Cute and perfect for the spring summer. The leather is a little stiff and will need to be broken in good quality .
Well cant complain except just needs to be broken in because leather at first can make the shoes stiff and uncomfy which is normal.

I really like the look of the shoe the gum soles sold me! I moved up a half size and they fix well. My others are a bit short. The shoes are very, very stiff and will require quite a bit of breaking in. The tongue is very short, and stiff as well, and it hits a spot on the front of my ankle when I walk to the point of slight bruising. I wouldn't buy this style again, but I like the other Pumas I have.
Cute shoe, simple, comfortable. Firmer sole than I expected but they seem durable. I'd buy another pair.

I absolutely love Puma brand shoes for the styles, the colors and the comfort. I am in disbelief that I found a cute pair of GENUINE LEATHER shoes at this price. I am always looking for quality shoes and these definitely hit the ball out of the park. They fit great and are comfortable as with all other Puma shoes I have owned. Room for the toes, the heel is cushioned and the sole is comfy as well. They do fit a little snug on the top of my foot because I have a bone that sticks up from a foot injury, but I don't see this being an issue for anyone without this weird bone issue. I must mention-They are a little stiff at first because they are leather, but they gain flexibility as you wear them and move around. Definitely worth having in your closet!!
Absolutely love these shoes! They take a few wears to get broken in, but they are fabulous! Easily cleanable and comfortable!
I returned them because the sole was a little than I prefer. Other than that, there was nothing wrong with them!

I owned a pair of these in high school, and at 41, I wanted another pair. Gorgeous and stylish, yet, my heel was constantly sliding and the shoe wasn't too big. Something strange about the back sole of the shoe, its too high. It was very uncomfortable and there was no way I would be able to walk in these for any period of time. If that issue was fixed, I would gladly buy another pair. I read other reviews where people had the exact same problem.
Shoe is cute but a bit narrow and dedinitely stiff. I am confident though, that once they are broken in, they will be just right.
LOVE these sneakers. I got them a half a size bigger because I like to have room in my sneakers. The off white with the white combo is DOPE not to mention the rubber sole. Good price
Good feel if you have wide feet. Not so much if you have flat feet, I used with Dr. Sholls insoles. Great look. But got an ankle sprain wearing these.

price.strength_summary: 가격이 합리적이라는 긍정적인 평가가 반복적으로 나타나며, 소비자들이 가성비에 만족하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Great for the price they are hard to clean a little but still look great will order again go up a size bc I have wide instep and the 9 1 2 was good

product_name: ASICS womens Gel-nimbus® 23

urgent_issues.summary: 구매자들은 내구성 문제로 인해 신발이 빠르게 망가진다고 불만을 토로하고 있습니다. 여러 리뷰에서 소재의 결함과 분리 현상이 반복적으로 나타나고 있습니다.

comfort.issue_summary: 구매자들은 착용감에 대한 불만이 많으며, 특히 통증, 물집, 아치 지지력 저하와 같은 문제가 반복적으로 발생하고 있습니다.
comfort.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 뛰어난 착용감과 아치 지지력을 제공하여 발의 통증을 줄여준다고 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: This is my probably 12th pair of Aics that I've purchased and they are the only pair I've ever bought that are uncomfortable. I literally have blisters on both of my small toes. It's really too bad because these are such a great looking shoe and all the reviews say that this is the absolute best running shoe for people with plantars fasciitis. I'm really bummed they did not work out and now it's back to trying to find something else. So disappointed with these shoes because Asics have always been my absolute favorites.
Heal started pilling and it was wearing out at the ball of my foot in less than a month. Disappointing because it s the only shoe I found that helped with my Achilles pain.
These shoes arrived dirty and used with gum or something stuck to the bottom waste of my time to wait for these and receive in this condition not to mention disgusting.

The 23 s do not fit like any of the previous gel nimbus there have been subtle changes over the last 15ish years I ve worn them, but nothing like this . The outside of the sole seems larger and is uncomfortable. I didn t notice the difference for a couple days, but the more I wear them the more uncomfortable they are becoming. I am a nurse, and it is disappointing that my go-to shoe is no longer sufficient.

I wanted to find running shoes with more cushion. They do have more cushion, but every time I wear them, my feet have pain and my toes go numb. At first I thought it was because the laces we too tight, but still happens when they are loose. Just not the shoe for me. For now I guess I will have to stick with insoles on my other shoes.

I got these shoes for the support and in less than 3 months the arch support has flattened. The entire inside has flatted and I'm not overweight. VERY DISAPPOINTED especially for how expensive they were. The warranty is only 30 days. Total waste of money.
I bought these because they were supposed to be good for plantar fasciitis, but they are not. My feet are still incredibly sore working out. Disappointed.

I love how cushioned these shoes are so I bought 5 pairs in a row. The first pair held up for about 4 months and the left shoe outer sole started peeling off. I didn t think too much of it and switched to another new pair. After one wear the same spot also on the left shoe peeled off. I started getting a little concerned. Then same with the third pair. And the forth pair I didn t even wear yet already cracked open on the outer sole. Either this is magic that all pairs have the exact same issue or it s poor quality control. Do not recommend.

Not made correctly caused my foot to roll to the outer edges of my foot - supination. I purchased 2 identical shoes, and both were the same. Made my knee hurt due to rotation. I've been buying this brand type of shoe for years and never had an issue.

This shoe gave me immediate shin splints. I usually purchase brooks but decided to switch it up after reading high reviews of this shoe. I was definitely disappointed. Runs small. Narrow toe box. There WAS a lot of padding which I usually prefer but this shoe was just a miss. I run on the treadmill and outside around 30-40 miles per week for reference.

Why did you shorten the back heel of the shoe so that it feels like I could walk right out? Also, these shoes feel cardboardy compared to the other Asics 21 i've worn. Where is the cushioning? So disappointed! Especially for the price.

While this product offers great support and comfort ...whatever material they put in the insoles is awful! They squeak with every step I take and it drives me and my husband nuts. I finally had to toss them out, what a waste of money for a comfortable annoying sneaker. I would like to try another pair, but cannot afford to waste the money.
ordered this shoe half size bigger and like it EXCEPT the toe box is very narrow and it doesn't come in wide.
One shoe was the expensive version, the other shoe was the cheap version. One was so soft with the extras in the sole the other had none. Not alike. Very disappointing

I've been wearing asics gel nimbus for years, since the 12's....this is the worst shoe ever. The gel nimbus has NEVER made my feet and arches hurt, but I had these on for less than a minute testing them out and my arches started to ache. Makes you feel like your are walking on the outside edges of your feet, which you're not supposed to do when you have high arches! Guess I have to switch to another brand, disappointing.

I love ASICS Nimbus. They are the most comfortable athletic shoes on the market. They re kinda expensive but well worth it. My doctor recommended ASICS to help with planter fasciitis. I only buy ASICS. The cushion in these shoes are just what I needed.
It s comfortable and helped my feet to breathe and not feel strained even after 8-12 hours of being on my feet
Definitely an improvement from last pair which offered no arch support, these are better but thought it'd have more arch support.. but overall Im happy with my purchase
The very first walk I took in them was perfect. No blisters, super comfortable, great arch support and they are really pretty.
I have high arches and have been a waitress for 40 years. I was looking for a shoe with support, cushion and comfort. These are wonderful

These shoes are so comfortable and supportive. I had been having pain in my knee replaced . Within two days of putting these shoes on my pain was reduced by eighty percent. My previous shoes were very worn and causing the soreness and pain because they were no longer giving me the support I needed. Check the wear on your current shoes and replace if seriously worn.
Needed to find a comfortable shoe for everyday wear. This is it. Have to be on my feet for hours at a time on a varied amount of surfaces. These shoes provide the comfort and support that I need!

I have been a recreational runner for about 20 years. I have always leaned toward Asics for a running shoe but sometimes go for something a little less expensive. I have noticed that the older I get the more my hips and knees have started to ache after a run. I decided to splurge and buy these to see if they made any difference in my achy bones. Boy, what a difference! I could immediately feel the difference in the cushioning as soon as I put them on. It was like running on a cloud. I have read some reviews by other runners who say that they weigh too much and it cuts into their overall running time but as I am just into recreational running and not concerned with time these are perfect for me. Would definitely recommend to anyone who wants a cushioned, comfortable running shoe.
I have sciatica and a plantar fasciitis. I wear these and feel nothing but comfy cushions. They are almost weightless and my aching hip loves them! Really beautiful shoes.

It's hard to find an athletic shoe with good cushioning these days and that is what I like most about this shoe. It's also hard to find a wide width shoe in an attractive color combination. The grand shark digital aqua color is fabulous -- matches with so much of my active wardrobe. This Gel-Nimbus isn't as supportive as my old Gel-Nimbus 14s but it is very acceptable. The arch is minimal but adequate for my arch height. There's not a whole lot of bounce when I run but it's very comfortable. They're great for aerobics. The tongue is nicely padded. The laces are stretchy and help achieve a snug fit. There is plenty of room in the toe box for my toes. These shoes aren't perfect but I've tried 6 - 7 pairs and I decided these were the best.

I love these! I've been dealing with plantar fasciitis for several years. I'm finally on the mend after several months of physical therapy. I'm used to wearing inserts in all of my shoes for additional arch support. I tried these shoes with my arch supports at first and didn't care for them at all. I ended up trying without my arch supports and they actually feel great!!! I've worn them most of the week at work I work in a hospital and I'm on my feet most of the day and to work out in and my feet are doing great.
Extremely comfortable with cushioning in all the right places for me. I also received many compliments on them...look nice and are very comfy!
Shoes did not have much padded along the sole, nor much arch support. Find another style or a different brand for the price. I ordered an 8 and 8 1 2 and could not get a good fit with either

I love these they are so comfortable. I have bad joints and severe back pain and good shoes really do help. They are like a cloud, but for long amounts of time walking on hard surfaces I started to feel it in certain areas in the ball of my foot. I use these for everyday use and the cumulus for long distance hard surface use. Size up 1 2.

I'm a walker and walk about 4 miles daily. I have worn another established brand for years and decided I needed to try something new -- so I purchased these. I generally wear a 6.5 in regular shoes but buy shoes for walking up a half size so I bought a 7. They are the most cushioned and wonderful shoes I've ever worn! They provide great support and even though I have a bunion on my right foot, I have no trouble with these. I've worn them for about a month now 104 miles and I love them more every time I wear them. Additionally, they are just so cute! I'll be purchasing another pair!

size.issue_summary: 많은 구매자들이 사이즈가 작고 발가락 부분이 좁아 불편함을 호소하고 있습니다. 이로 인해 반품이 잦고, 구매자들의 실망감이 커지고 있습니다.
size.strength_summary: 구매자들은 사이즈가 적절하고 발에 잘 맞는다고 반복적으로 언급했습니다. 특히 발가락 공간이 넓어져 편안함을 느끼는 경우가 많았습니다.

representative_reviews.text: These were too small. I typically wear the same size in all diff types of shoes. So had to return and ended up buying a pair of running shoes at the shoe store diff brand
ordered this shoe half size bigger and like it EXCEPT the toe box is very narrow and it doesn't come in wide.

This shoe gave me immediate shin splints. I usually purchase brooks but decided to switch it up after reading high reviews of this shoe. I was definitely disappointed. Runs small. Narrow toe box. There WAS a lot of padding which I usually prefer but this shoe was just a miss. I run on the treadmill and outside around 30-40 miles per week for reference.

I wear a size 6 in regular but usually size up to a size 7 for running shoes. I read that these shoes ran small but I thought I was okay with ordering a size 7. I should have listened and at least gone up a 1 2 size Ugh they are small and kill my feet. I tried to wear them but it is so painful by the second mile.

The 23 s do not fit like any of the previous gel nimbus there have been subtle changes over the last 15ish years I ve worn them, but nothing like this . The outside of the sole seems larger and is uncomfortable. I didn t notice the difference for a couple days, but the more I wear them the more uncomfortable they are becoming. I am a nurse, and it is disappointing that my go-to shoe is no longer sufficient.

This shoe runs very small. I have never had to size up or down in shoes but this one is entirely too small. I had to return it. Returning was somewhat inconvenient, couldn t return in my normal Whole Foods spot since it was not an option. I had to physically pack, print the label, tape the label and return to a UPS. First world problems

Two and a half months after purchase, they're worn though in multiple spots. Very disappointed because I paid a lot for these shoes. It will make me think twice about buying Asics ever again. Ran small and have a very narrow toe box

BUYER BEWARE IF YOU HAVE WIDE FEET I ordered these in half a size up and the width seemed perfect. These shoes are VERY cushy when you walk run. However, getting to the reason for my 1 star review.... I have been alternating these with a pair of brooks since mid-January of this year, and today I noticed that they are literally falling apart at the seems. 150 for a shoe that doesn't even last a couple months of normal use. Pathetic.
Love them. They are so comfy and great to run in, BUT after only 2 months, the soles are starting to tear up. I only wear them in the gym and street running. Very disappointed

I bought these shoes after trying them on at our local Dick s sporting goods store. They were very comfortable and looked good. They didn t have my size at the store so I saw them on Amazon and bought them there. After only a month of using a hole developed on both shoes in the toe area where the big toe hits. So frustrating!
I ve always loved gel nimbus but this pair has a narrow toe box. I kept thinking they would get better with wear but didn t, and now I ve missed my return window.

I wanted to find running shoes with more cushion. They do have more cushion, but every time I wear them, my feet have pain and my toes go numb. At first I thought it was because the laces we too tight, but still happens when they are loose. Just not the shoe for me. For now I guess I will have to stick with insoles on my other shoes.

This is my probably 12th pair of Aics that I've purchased and they are the only pair I've ever bought that are uncomfortable. I literally have blisters on both of my small toes. It's really too bad because these are such a great looking shoe and all the reviews say that this is the absolute best running shoe for people with plantars fasciitis. I'm really bummed they did not work out and now it's back to trying to find something else. So disappointed with these shoes because Asics have always been my absolute favorites.
Just like when they went from the 18's to the 19 20 and 21 too narrow and then they brought the wider toe in the 22. Loved them again and now they have messed with toe again so toooo narrow.

These are so small my toes curl and crutch into the toes. I have at least 25 pair of size 9 Asics shoes that all fit. These in size 9 are way too small. Ridiculous and I am angry. If I could have returned them I would have. I will never order shoes from Amazon again because I ordered a brand I wear every single day in the correct size and they are no where near fitting. I think I would need a 10.5 for these to fit. In fact, I ordered 2 other pairs of Asics size 9 with these and the other 2 pair fit.
Love the shoe look and feel. Great arch support! Toe box is still more narrow than before. Ordered half size up to accommodate that.

I love ASICS Nimbus. They are the most comfortable athletic shoes on the market. They re kinda expensive but well worth it. My doctor recommended ASICS to help with planter fasciitis. I only buy ASICS. The cushion in these shoes are just what I needed.
These are perfect to fit my feet. They are not too narrow nor wide. They are very cushioned which makes my runs smooth.

Thanks to other reviews I'm glad I bought a size up. I normally wear a 7 but I bought an 8 and it fits perfectly. It's a little snug around the pinky toe so I will see how they do after a whole day. They feel very comfy. I cannot wait to wear these to work. I work in a hospital on hard floor all night.

I sized up after reading a bunch of reviews and they ended up being too big. At first I thought they were just right because the tongue and collar are so padded it felt like my foot was cradled. But my heel was slipping outward while testing them in the house and I realized they were too long and wide. I usually wear an 8.5 and sometimes need a wide for bunions although wides can be too wide in the heel. I originally bought this shoe in a size 9 and will be returning for an 8.5. The dusty rose is super cute with the beige soles. The cushioning is amazing and I'm hoping the smaller size won't have the side-to-side heel slippage for my supination.
Very comfortable shoe. Real test will be when I'm on my feet for 10 hours a day. Be sure to size at least a 1 2 size up. I wear a 10 and got the 10 1 2 and they are perfect.

Beautifully designed shoe but despite the representation that they run true to size, I found my normal size snug. I ordered and am waiting for a 1 2 size larger. I have not found size to be a issue with other manufacturers.

The shoes arrived on time. They look new but the box arrived damaged, and it seems that these shoes were with someone else, because all the tickets were not tied to the shoes, but thrown in the box. In addition there is a small defect in one of the shoes. I have not worn them yet, I am trying to find a way to talk to the seller, before I ask for a refund. Because I'm really interested in shoes but am afraid that this flaw will develop into something bigger.

I purchased this shoe for the gel insole. I also ordered the Contend 7 in the same size and it was a bit shorter and didn't provide the same support. I will be additing Spenco gel heel cup and it will be perfect.
Very happy with this shoe. Toe box is roomier like my 19s and 20s unlike the more recent ones . Ordered same size as my 19s and 20s and the 23s fit almost the same.
Bought same size as previous 3 buys. Fits a good bit smaller. Shoe is very well made. Great support. Good for hard surface running.

Going from a job where I sat a lot to standing my whole shift made my plantar fasciitis act up, and an old knee injury flare. These shoes have really helped give me a better foundation and eased my pain a lot. They're a bit above my usual price range, but I'll definitely repurchase. I'd say they fit pretty true to size. I had to get used to how plush they are around the ankle, but now I like how stabilizing it feels.

I bought these to replace a pair I've had for a few years. I didn't realize how worn down my old ones were until I put these on. I love them! I walk 5-6 miles every day, and have very high arches. These are very comfy and the fit is just right. Other reviewers mentioned that the toe box was narrower than older models, but these are exactly the same as my old ones. I'm very glad I bought these.

Shoes fit firm and cushion through instep and balls of my feet. I was pleasantly surprised with how much cushioning and support is in this shoe. I haven t felt the need to go out in search of insoles. The color is not so wild that I feel it doesn t go with anything. Pleasant to wear all day if I want.

I really like the fit and comfort of these shoes. I'm on my feet most of the day, and these helped keep my feet from hurting. One suggestion would be the tongue needs a slot for the shoe string to help keep them in place. The left toungue slides to the left at times.

representative_reviews.text: I love how cushioned these shoes are so I bought 5 pairs in a row. The first pair held up for about 4 months and the left shoe outer sole started peeling off. I didn t think too much of it and switched to another new pair. After one wear the same spot also on the left shoe peeled off. I started getting a little concerned. Then same with the third pair. And the forth pair I didn t even wear yet already cracked open on the outer sole. Either this is magic that all pairs have the exact same issue or it s poor quality control. Do not recommend.
Wore once and shoe string ripped. I d like to get a replacement, but I m not sure how to go about that without returning the shoe?
I bought this for my wife and only after 2 weeks of using it, it tore in the front. And also the shoelace are starting to frizzle out. Very disappointed. I hope to get a refund for this
These only lasted almost 2 months and they are already falling apart.. for the price I expected them to be nicer quality unfortunately they are not.

I have been an AVID Asics fan for the past five years-especially the Gel Nimbus. I have never had a pair of shoes do what these have done in barely 2 months!!! I walk around my neighborhood as my exercise after a partial knee replacement last December. I bought these shoes on September 21 from Amazon because I loved this colorway and no store around me had it. They have been fantastic!! Unfortunately, I noticed yesterday that on each side of my foot-the knit is creating tiny holes. And it is not even where my pinky toe is!!! There is literally no reinforcement in the knit fabric. I have normal shaped feet. I bought 1 2 size bigger as I always do. I can not figure out why the fabric is ripping. I am really disappointed in this quality and hope that Asics pays attention. I know that knit wears down over time-but this is waaay too fast. Just a heads up for anyone else out there!! I have high arch insoles which I could put into these sneakers, but it is debatable whether they are more comfortable than the cushy insoles you get with these sneakers. I've been ordering sneakers, trying them on and then returning them. I'm very happy to have found these! I ordered a size 9 and a size 9 1 2 so I could try both. I went with the nine and a half so I will have a little bit extra room for my big toe. I spent 80 for these and they are way better than the 150 Brooks sneakers I bought. I think these are really going to help my plantar fasciitis!

Love these shoes that have great support with the cushioning working well with my personalized insoles. Love this!

Hoping the sellers see this. I don t know if it s just a defect in the production or some kind of quick rubber seal that doesn t match the rest of the rubber. They are too short for genuine comfort. That s not the worst of it. The inside of the straps make my foot itch from the roughness I wore them one day to try them out, but the irritation of the whole combined problem has them just sitting in the box.

I needed some water shoes, and my feet aren't going to grow anymore 40yo and no more babies thank you very much so I wanted to get a proper pair that will work for creeking and rafting canoeing and swimming in the lake ocean, but also for playing disc golf with my husband and light trail hiking, and will last for the next 5-10 years at least. I started off by heading to Cabela's FYI, I have a local Cabela's, Field and Stream, and Duluth all within spitting distance of each other, and out of those three brick and mortars, Cabela's had the best water-hiking-shoes selection, BY FAR . In the store I tried on the KEEN Newport Hydro, the KEEN Whisper mostly they had KEEN and their store brand, Worldwide Sportsman...or something like that , and a few of their Worldwide Sportsman brand. I did not find any Merrell water-hikers in-store at any of the stores . Anyway, out of the ones I tried at Cabelas, I quickly decided against the Worldwide Sportsman as they did not fit well loose on my very wide feet, but tight on top and jamming into my leg at the top of my foot . So that left the KEEN. Both the Whisper and the Newport fit well, but I wanted something sturdy and hefty, and the Newport fits the bill on that. If you are looking for cuter and lighter, the Whisper is that. I chose the KEEN Newport Hydro...but they didn't have any in my proper size size 10 womens, with a wide foot . I bought a half-size down still fit all right and went home 100 . I really wanted to try something other than KEEN, so enter Amazon. I proceeded to order the exact same KEEN in my proper size 10 and a different color 100 , the Merrell All-Out Blaze Sieve in a 10 75 , and the ATIKA All-Terrain Orbital in a 10 31 . I made sure they all had free returns before purchasing, and waited patiently to try them all before returning the rest. Here are my thoughts on them all KEEN Newport Hydro PROS -Cute -Very sturdy sole -Fits firmly but still has lots of room in the toe box excellent for wide feet -Seem to fit okay in my proper size and a half-size down. In fact, when forced to choose, I would choose the half-size down -Larger cut-outs seem as though it would be easier for water to drain from shoe. Didn't try in water so just my assumption -Excellent and substantial toe guard CONS -Expensive -Back strap is less comfortable than other options -Heavy OVERALL OPINION Great shoe. Comfortable. Heavy. Expensive. Merrell All-Out Blaze Sieve PROS -Cute -Fits like a dream -Very sturdy sole -Very comfortable to walk in -Back strap has an extra layer of padding compared to others I tried and it makes a huge difference when walking. Much more pleasant than KEEN -Cheaper than KEEN -Neoprene webbing around foot has less gaps in tongue area compared to the others CONS -Not as cute as the KEEN just my personal taste , but still very very cute -Smaller cutouts compared to KEEN...not sure but my initial assumption is they would take longer to dry than the KEEN when creeking -Not as substantial guard in toe area OVERALL OPINION Great shoe. Very comfortable. Pretty expensive. ATIKA All-Terrain Orbital PROS -So inexpensive! -Cute -Very comfortable CONS -Fit is a bit weird. The bungee on top needed to be tightened a lot to fit on my wide foot, yet they were a touch short. Where the back of the sole comes up to hug your heel was jutting into my heel a bit and while not a big deal, it would likely be a big deal after wearing all day. Would prob need to size up half a size. OVERALL OPINION Surprisingly great shoe for the price. If price is your leading factor in deciding, or if your foot is still growing hey girls your feet get bigger when you have a baby...I used to be a size 8 before my four kids , this would be a great shoe for you. In the end, I'm going with the Merrell. I expected to like the KEEN best, but was surprised at the superior comfort and the sturdiness of the Merrell, and at a cheaper price tag, I'm sold.

These are supportive and cradle my foot, so no pain for me. I absolutely love them. My left shoe fits perfectly, but my right foot needs some adjustments to the shoe to be comfortable. I got two different sizes and both of them fit my right foot exactly wrong. I was able to fix it by adding padding to the back strap of my right shoe, and now it fits as it should. I don't know if this is helpful to anyone else, but here I am telling you.

I have 4 pair of Keen shoes size 8 and NEVER have I had a problem fitting them...thus the reason I ordered online. But these ran really small. Struggled to put them on. Very disappointed
I have been wearing this sandal for over 15 years. Now Keen has decided to change the fit. The toe box is smaller and they rub at the heel. So disappointed. Not sure where to go from here

Hello-I wanted to exchange, however, the window has closed by 4- days. I just went to wear these and one sinless is bigger than the other shoeThe left shoe seems to be smaller than the right-though both say 9.5 which is what is needed.
I ordered a full size up, based on reviews, and they were STILL too small. The colors are beautiful, and they have "industrial strength" soles, but they are not true to size.
I ve had many of these Keen sandels, and love them, these for some reason were very tight- narrow in length. Maybe they changed the style. I already bought 1 size bigger. Returned them.

This shoes are very nice, nice color, good quality and everything buuuuuuut it does not have anything to be able to open the shoe so you can wear them. These shoes are not made for wider feet cause they are just impossible to wear on dry so won't work even less on wet... And yes... IT IS MY CORRECT SIZE, it's just too tight when trying to put them on

These fit my feet perfectly and are so comfortable. I was worried about the straps digging in, but they don't. I have a wide toe box and these are wide enough for my feet. I also love the coloring, they'll match just about everything.

I needed some water shoes, and my feet aren't going to grow anymore 40yo and no more babies thank you very much so I wanted to get a proper pair that will work for creeking and rafting canoeing and swimming in the lake ocean, but also for playing disc golf with my husband and light trail hiking, and will last for the next 5-10 years at least. I started off by heading to Cabela's FYI, I have a local Cabela's, Field and Stream, and Duluth all within spitting distance of each other, and out of those three brick and mortars, Cabela's had the best water-hiking-shoes selection, BY FAR . In the store I tried on the KEEN Newport Hydro, the KEEN Whisper mostly they had KEEN and their store brand, Worldwide Sportsman...or something like that , and a few of their Worldwide Sportsman brand. I did not find any Merrell water-hikers in-store at any of the stores . Anyway, out of the ones I tried at Cabelas, I quickly decided against the Worldwide Sportsman as they did not fit well loose on my very wide feet, but tight on top and jamming into my leg at the top of my foot . So that left the KEEN. Both the Whisper and the Newport fit well, but I wanted something sturdy and hefty, and the Newport fits the bill on that. If you are looking for cuter and lighter, the Whisper is that. I chose the KEEN Newport Hydro...but they didn't have any in my proper size size 10 womens, with a wide foot . I bought a half-size down still fit all right and went home 100 . I really wanted to try something other than KEEN, so enter Amazon. I proceeded to order the exact same KEEN in my proper size 10 and a different color 100 , the Merrell All-Out Blaze Sieve in a 10 75 , and the ATIKA All-Terrain Orbital in a 10 31 . I made sure they all had free returns before purchasing, and waited patiently to try them all before returning the rest. Here are my thoughts on them all KEEN Newport Hydro PROS -Cute -Very sturdy sole -Fits firmly but still has lots of room in the toe box excellent for wide feet -Seem to fit okay in my proper size and a half-size down. In fact, when forced to choose, I would choose the half-size down -Larger cut-outs seem as though it would be easier for water to drain from shoe. Didn't try in water so just my assumption -Excellent and substantial toe guard CONS -Expensive -Back strap is less comfortable than other options -Heavy OVERALL OPINION Great shoe. Comfortable. Heavy. Expensive. Merrell All-Out Blaze Sieve PROS -Cute -Fits like a dream -Very sturdy sole -Very comfortable to walk in -Back strap has an extra layer of padding compared to others I tried and it makes a huge difference when walking. Much more pleasant than KEEN -Cheaper than KEEN -Neoprene webbing around foot has less gaps in tongue area compared to the others CONS -Not as cute as the KEEN just my personal taste , but still very very cute -Smaller cutouts compared to KEEN...not sure but my initial assumption is they would take longer to dry than the KEEN when creeking -Not as substantial guard in toe area OVERALL OPINION Great shoe. Very comfortable. Pretty expensive. ATIKA All-Terrain Orbital PROS -So inexpensive! -Cute -Very comfortable CONS -Fit is a bit weird. The bungee on top needed to be tightened a lot to fit on my wide foot, yet they were a touch short. Where the back of the sole comes up to hug your heel was jutting into my heel a bit and while not a big deal, it would likely be a big deal after wearing all day. Would prob need to size up half a size. OVERALL OPINION Surprisingly great shoe for the price. If price is your leading factor in deciding, or if your foot is still growing hey girls your feet get bigger when you have a baby...I used to be a size 8 before my four kids , this would be a great shoe for you. In the end, I'm going with the Merrell. I expected to like the KEEN best, but was surprised at the superior comfort and the sturdiness of the Merrell, and at a cheaper price tag, I'm sold.
Love these shoes. However, I did have to order a size larger than I normally wear. Great walking shoe!

I have 6 pairs of Keen boots and love the roomy toe box for my wide feet. These sandals were constructed incorrectly and the right foot upper was attached to the lower off-center making for an unwearable sandal. After reading some of the reviews, I fear this is like a factory seconds outlet for Keen.

I have had foot surgery on each 2nd toe on each foot this year. The box toe is large enough for them not to be squashed- they will take a year for the swelling to go down. I have a smart toe implant in one and they don t hurt to put the shoe on. The soles are hard enough so they don t bend too much. My other pair is 10 yrs. old, I wanted to get a new pair if my gait changed because of surgery. They are great for walking in Disney World in the rain.

I'm in love with these shoes! I have medium width, high arch, long toed bony feet. I wear a size 6b, but ordered the 6.5. They fit perfectly! Great cushioning and arch support. My first Keen purchase, definitely not my last.

I tried these on in a brick-and-mortar store for fit. They run a half size smaller in many cases so I got a half size larger. Very comfortable with socks. Without socks, your feet will need to become accustomed to the plastic-like feeling of the foot bed. My feel need to toughen up a bit as they feel tender after a few hours barefoot in the shoe. So as not to slip off easily, inserting your foot is snug so I use the loop in the back to pull them.
Fits great, love the color combination. Exactly what I was expecting from a pair of Keen river shoes
This is a perfect shoe! Loved it so much! Except my feet were just a little to wide to wear for an entire day. Had to return, sadly.

I am extremely happy with this purchase. The keen sandals fit true to my size. The soles are molded to my foot and of a nice thickness . Love the color and is just as pictured This was my first Keen purchase but many more to come!!
True to size as always! Used these to walk around Miami and the Florida Keys deep sea fishing and even a MLB game! Amazingly comfy as always!!

I found out they do NOT fit actual size. I had to return them and reorder a WHOLE size bigger. After wearing them for around 12 hours, they became a little uncomfortable. The hole openings on the sides of the shoes are not evenly made so my pinky right toe tries to poke out but my left stays in ok. They are a little tight vertically so I have a hard time sliding my feet in and they pinched my feet a bit. But they really look cool though! I attached a pic to show that the shoe side openings are not made the same. The left side is much narrower than the right.

This water shoe fits well..keeps my toes protected covered but still allows air to circulate. I hate feet by the way. I find nothing cute about them. I keep the toes especially covered as much as I can.

Love the color and the style of these shoes. Be prepared to break them in because the sole is so firm, it s going to hurt your feet for a bit until they are broken in. Definitely runs about 1 2 a size too small. I got the same pair for my son and his has velcro, but this version doesn t. You have to slide the strap over the back of your heel and it is realllllly hard to do that if you don t have that extra size up.

I love these sandals! Super colorful and comfortable. Great arch support too! I usually wear a size 8.5 gym shoe and got a size 9 in these. The fit is perfect! However I would suggest that those with wide or swollen feet go up half a size to 1 whole size. The reason is because there is no Velcro on this shoe. You can t open the shoe to slide your foot in, you have to stretch the elastic on the shoe and wiggle your foot in. If you have a fatter foot it would definitely make putting these on a challenge. Sometimes when my feet are damp and I try putting these on it does make it a challenge, but once they are on they fit very comfortably.

durability.issue_summary: 구매자들은 내구성 문제로 인해 신발이 빠르게 망가진다고 불만을 토로하고 있습니다. 여러 리뷰에서 접착제, 봉제, 찢어짐 등의 문제가 반복적으로 나타나고 있습니다.
durability.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 내구성이 뛰어나고 고품질의 소재로 제작되었다고 반복적으로 언급하며, 오랜 사용에도 견딜 수 있는 신뢰성을 제공합니다.

representative_reviews.text: Not the same size or quality of my previous ones. Back in 2014 they were "American Built" see photo of US and imported materials. These are made in Cambodia. I'm OK with that, but I wear a 6.5 or 7, so based on other reviews I ordered a 7.5 - they were still way too tight - but the right length. The black stretchy part, under the laces of the retro, was so tight that I could hardly slip the shoes on and then when I loosened the elastic strings, the strings were sagging, but the black was still way too tight. My toes could never go under the black toe covering. I have never had sandals or shoes on my feet this tight. Compared to my other Keens, the sole on these is a different texture - my old ones weighed 10.8 oz 301g new ones 11 oz 313 g . Already printed the return label. What a disappointment. Did Keen change the pattern or factory. Oh Keen what happened????????? P.S. I even tried these on early the next morning to make sure my feet weren't swollen, but it wasn't my feet. Sad, sad, sad. What is this world coming to when you can't by a new pair of Keens for the spring.
Made in Cambodia ... glue is showing After a week...I find them very comfortable....the glue hasn't come apart ....hope they stay ok, as I really find them comfortable...
I wore these for one week and unfortunately they fell apart during our river trip. Very disappointed in the lack of quality and inability to exchange them for another pair!
I have a high instep and could not pull on the back strap. Lots of toe room but not worth the effort to take on and off.
Only had them for 3 months and they are falling apart! The ones i had before i got from nordstom rack lasted way lonfer only reason i got new is i lost one.
I absolutely loved these shoes when I first got them, they are cute and comfortable, but they fell apart after less than 2 months of wearing them. I'm do disappointed, 100 for 2 months?!

I have owned these Keens for one year and 2 months, but I did not use them for the first three months. I did use them for a whitewater trip to the Grand Canyon in the summer of 2019 and they were great. Just recently I kayaked on a tributary of the Amazon river, and yes, there was some mud, but the shoe just fell apart. The left side of the left shoe pulled out and was flipping in the wind. It often caught on roots and rocks, making for really uncomfortable kayaking and hiking. I have used Teva and Chakos sandals for many years of constant use on kayak trips and never had them fall apart like this.

As others mentioned, these are not the original, well made Keen s. They literally look and feel like a cheap pair of Crocs. Ordered a size up and they were still off and made in Mexico! Cheap and disappointing. Stitching already fraying and so many details OFF! There was no Velcro in the back so difficult getting on and off The pull string to tighten was too long and flopped when I walked They rubbed in the back on one show as the pull off tab was sewn in wrong The front and soul looked like awful Crocs Very plastic and bulky feeling Wow a long time fan of Keen s so disappointed Returning PS looks like a lot of people returned this actual pair....writing on box wearing off and subtle dings

Hoping the sellers see this. I don t know if it s just a defect in the production or some kind of quick rubber seal that doesn t match the rest of the rubber. I don t want to send back because this was the last size in this color. I am also going on a float trip next week . Size and style look great, just not happy with the random black splotch almost looks like a quick fix for a messed up rubber sole .

I was so excited when I found these rainbow tie dye Keens. I LOVE rainbow everything and Keens have been my go-to for years. These are WAY too small, and not nearly the quality that I expect from Keens. I had a pair of H2 Venice sandals that I wore until they were falling apart 15 years later. I have a few other styles, too. I've literally worn them all over the world. This pair is just nothing like they used to be, and I'm so bummed out. The sole is no longer made by Vibram, and it just feels... gross I don't have any other words to describe it against my skin. And it smells terrible, too, like an old tire. The upper webbing is ridiculously tight while the laces are still loose. Even though I bought a half size larger than I usually wear, my toes are still crammed against the end of the shoe. And because they are so inconsistently made, the left one is noticeably smaller and tighter than the right one. What happened?!
Sadly I had to return these. They re beautiful and sturdy and really really well made but one of the openings in the side lined up just right with my little toe and made them hell for me to wear.

I have worn these 3 time!! And they are ripping already!!. I have had them barely 1 month and can't return them now. These are crap. I am so disappointed. For the amount if money spent, you should at least get 1 summer out them. My last ones lasted 6 years. What a rip off. Dont waste your money!!
Took forever to break in. Were very comfortable when they lasted unfortunately, they didn't last very long. Wore them in and around water a few time and the sole of the shoe came completely out.

They are too short for genuine comfort. That s not the worst of it. The inside of the straps make my foot itch from the roughness I wore them one day to try them out, but the irritation of the whole combined problem has them just sitting in the box.

These were the worst keens yet. The first pair the fabric was so stiff and had no flex. They didnt fit to size. The second pair to replace them had the same stiff fabric but one sandal was smaller than the other. The glue continues to deteriorated quickly and the sole detaches. I give up on trying keen. Too expensive for crappy and inconsistent quality.

Very well made from a great footwear brand. Wonderful fit! Looking forward to years of wearing them.
I love everything about these, except the upper part of it separated from the sole after only one summer of wearing them.

My Hoka OneOne walking shoes were causing my knee to hurt. Got these, and my knee doesn t hurt like it did. Very durable and good for wet or dry weather. Gives my feet the support on bottom I need. Ordered another pair to be sure I have a spare pair after this pair wears out. But they are were long-lasting soles.

What s not to love about these awesome tie-dye Keens? I haven t loved a color they have put out since 2004 when I got my original red Keens. These top the chart, though. Keens did change their sizing over the last 2 decades, so I now order a half-size up than my original Keens. I feel that Keens have gotten back to making a solid, sturdy sandal with all the basics one needs again. For a while in the early 10s I felt their product quality was slipping. My 2004 Keens are still wearable, while a pair I bought in 2014 aren t because they have fallen apart. I am hoping these will last me as long as my original pair. I like the color so much that I bought a second pair for later. Because I know when I find a shoe I like, it ll immediately disappear. Keens are good for folks with wider feet, too. The wide toe box in all their designs is really comfortable.

Most comfortable sandal I have owned - with no break-in time! Saw some reviews saying that there might be a problem with tightness if you have a high instep, but I have an extremely high instep and the lacing system was able to accommodate it without any problem or discomfort.

My second pair of this style and I went up a half size which made the fit perfect for work first pair is still holding strong after 4 years These provide awesome comfort all the way around and remain comfortable if you re on your feet for long periods Great toe protection as well Love KEENS

The materials are very high quality. Also, they are put together VERY well. It makes me crazy when shoes start falling apart, especially if they're relatively new. These are STURDY shoes and I love that. What I don't love is mostly a personal preference, but I'll share in case this matters to someone else reading the reviews. I have been wearing minimalist footware for two years now and the toe box of the shoe is not wide enough for my new natural foot shape. I figured as much before the purchase but I went ahead and pulled the trigger anyway because the shoe offers what no minimalist sandal can - protection even when running on a rocky PNW riverbed. All in all, the squeeze isn't terrible and I'm satisfied with the product and the purchase.
I adore the faded denim color, and of course the comfort. A very sturdy and waterproof shoe to wear all year here in Florida.

I've had several foot surgeries and I finally found a shoe that is comfortable. With the exception of one pair that I'm stuck with that I didn't try on, I've been able to wear every one I've ordered. They feel good right out of the box.

This is my second pair of Keen's sandals and i love them. Super sturdy, super comfy and stand up to everything i toss at them. If they get dirty i just toss them in tbe washer then let them air dry. Highly recommend these for hiking and every day ware.
Had my last pair for about 4 years. Hiking, kayaking, rafting, rock climbing. Best shoes ever. Bought a second pair ad back up

I own an older version of this shoe in hot coral and got these new ones in black rose for replacement. I also got the magnet hot coral color to try. I own the whisper style as well. Size fit Beware the black rose color fits 1 2 size smaller than the magnet hot coral color. Also, the insole for the black rose is a harder rubber while the magnet hot coral insole is cushy rubber. The black rose looks very stylish and would look good with a casual city outfit as well as out adventuring. The magnet coral looks much sportier. I have skinny feet with high arch and these can be cinched tight all around your feet but can also stretch to accommodate wider feet. Sole these are the most protective keens, which cups your feet all around with rubber edges so you don t have to worry about scrapping the side of your feet on rocks. The arch on these shoes are also the highest compared to other models. The rubber bumper in front is also the most robust and covers the entire front of your feet toes. For serious adventuring, l love these shoes. The tread is sticky even on wet rocks. There are 4 thick straps on top that protects my feet without leaving too much open space best protraction . When I walk in rivers where my feet might get stuck between unseen rocks, these shoes protect my feet very well. The whisper is a much slimmer and more leisure walking sandals, which I use for casual everyday use. I m returning the black rose size 9 for a 9.5 but going to keep the magnet hot coral in size 9. Your choice on whether you prefer a stiffer sole or a cushier sole. I didn t get the other colors, so not sure how those might fit. If you do primewardrobe, you can get several colors and sizes to try for no charge for 7 days I think and return the ones you don t want.

I have 6 pairs of Keen boots and love the roomy toe box for my wide feet. These sandals were constructed incorrectly and the right foot upper was attached to the lower off-center making for an unwearable sandal. After reading some of the reviews, I fear this is like a factory seconds outlet for Keen.
Great price for great footwear! Longtime fan of Keens, this is my 15th pair! Comfortable, long lasting and supportive!

These squeeze my feet too much. I loosen the straps as much as possible and that helps some. I'm sad that these are either knock offs which happens too often nowadays or Keens has changed their product.

I thought this was very comfy but my kids screamed at me and said I was not allowed to leave the house in it. they said if the sole toe were more colored like the shoe it would have been ok but the extremely light sole and toe made it like a sneaker trying to be a sandal or a sandal trying to be a sneaker. also the laces didn't match the canvas part or the rubber which was odd. all in all a good idea and a pretty design but badly executed. sticking with my boring old black newports, thought I'd try something cool but this wasn't it
I adore the faded denim color, and of course the comfort. A very sturdy and waterproof shoe to wear all year here in Florida.

love these keens, multi color look is so cute! I know several people said to order up a half size but I didn't and they fit perfectly. The other thing I was a little concerned about the quality since they were manufactured in Cambodia instead of the USA but they arrived with no issues.

I purchased 4 pairs of Keen Women s size 9 closed toe sandals to compare. I chose the SOLR HighPerformance Sport Closed Toe Water Sandal, Black Steel Grey, the Newport Retro-w Sport Sandal, Original tie dye, the Venice H2 Sandal, Black Neutral Gray and the Ravine H2 Black Dawn Pink. I am planning a vacation trip to Portugal and I wanted to be able to reduce the number of shoes I planned on packing. I have a pair of Keen s hiking boots and I already know how much I like them. I wanted something that would stand up as well as a hiking boot but weigh less like a tennis shoe for a lot of walking. I wanted something that I could wear to the beach and get in the water. I wanted something that was casual and might go with some of my summer dresses. Finally I was hoping that if the shoe was water proof it might also serve as a shower shoe. So to recap, I am looking for one shoe to rule them all, hiking boots, tennis shoes, sandals, water shoes, shower shoes and a casual summer dress shoe. I know it is a tall order but just think of how much room I will save in my bag. An additional constraints that I have that play into my decision are that I have a AAA foot and AAAA heel. The Keen hiking boots I have wear are a little wide and a little short but they were a better fit than any other boot I found which makes me happy. With the boots I can add inserts, with sandals that is not going to be an option. I have also previously broken my ankle in several places and had several operations on it. I do better in a shoe with at least a little higher in the heel than the toe. I can also be sensitive right under the bone on the inside of the ankle. I loved the rainbow color of the tie dye shoe. It was the only model that offered the rainbow. I have to tell you know I wanted the tie dye shoe to be the winner just because of the color. Some of the other models do offer a variety of colors to choose from just not rainbow. I was looking forward to trying on the Ravine H2. It is the only one of the four that has an adjustable heel strap. I have not had a sandal with an adjustable heel but my husband has several pairs of sandals with the adjustable heel and he raves about them. I was hoping that it would help make the shoe fit more securely and not slide around. The adjustable strap did give a good fit on the heel. It was the first shoe I tried on and if it had been the only shoe I tried on I would have loved it. In the end the adjustable strap was one of the main reasons I did not choose it. I was thick and hard. The other 3 models all had very soft and comfortable heel straps. The SOLR Sandal looks like it might be adjustable in the heel but it is not. The Ravine H2 is the only one with an adjustable heel. If this is important to you this is the choice for you. Keep in mind it wasn t uncomfortable it just wasn t as comfortable and in the end I did not feel like it offered the benefits I needed over the comfort. The next big thing I was looking for was whether I could secure the shoe enough that it didn t slip around on my foot. I did wear a pair of extra thin socks when trying them on and I will most likely wear them with socks when out and about but not at the beach. The Ravine H2 and the Venice H2 did not lace up as snuggly as I was wanting on my foot. I think for the average foot they would have been great. The SOLR and the Newport Retro both felt very snug around my foot with a much better ability to lace up. This being said I think that both the Ravine H2 and the Venice H2 have more breathing room but they all are pretty open. In the end the Newport Retro rubbed right on my scar on my ankle that ruled it out immediately. My favorite looking pair was eliminated due to an old injury. Both of the H2 models did not feel snug enough on my feet and the Ravine H2 heel strap was not as comfortable. I have been wearing the SOLR sandal for a couple of days now and they are wonderful. I can loosen up the lacing elastic and wear them as slip ons around the house or tighten them up for some real walking. When loosened up they are sure to be very comfortable on a medium size foot and I could see a wide foot being comfortable. There is a lot of stretch in the neoprene type fabric used in the shoes There are several features that I passed over that were present in all of the shoes. Every last one of them was comfortable. I am sure the Newport Retro would be wonderful for everyone without a scar in that particular place. Even though the Ravine H2 was comfortable I just liked the SOLR better. All of the soles had different treads but they all had a .?micro perforation that is not visible until the sole is bent and then it opens up to provide better flexibility. I looked at the stitching and connection points on all of them and they appear to be really well made. I give them all 5 stars. I hope this helped you so you don t need to buy four pairs of shoes. All of the models are great picks.

They need to start making this style again. Comfortable, and it s super lightweight and great for packing!

I tried to get away with cheaper walking shoes but finally ended up with these and I couldn't be happier. They are super lightweight and the top is an open-weave knit that is pretty airy. I especially like that the weaving has sort of a heel cup effect at the back without a rigid piece of plastic, which has been my packing downfall in the past. They pack super well, have great cushiony soles, and I can go for an honest exercise walk in these or walk around a theme park all day with no problems. And while I wouldn't give them up, they can rub a bit in the heel, at least they do for me. Wearing them without socks makes them cooler and the heel not move as much, but I find them more comfortable with socks. There is a heel lock hole that kind of helps with the shifting, but the laces are too short to keep them laced that way - I dunno, maybe I'll keep trying. And the biggest issue, the only real issue, is that the soles collect gravel like crazy. I first happened to wear these in places with gravel paths and the shoe will collect and hold gravel until you dig it out. I've started keeping a screwdriver in my car to dig out the rocks. You might want to be careful if you're tracking gravel into your house and across any nice flooring.

I have been a faithful Aiscs buyer for years and this is the first pair I've purchased that were defective and just a case of shoddy workmanship. Because I removed the tag I am stuck with them and cannot return them. The problem is that the insole is not flush with the sides of the shoe. This creates spaces for one's foot to get serious blisters. I wore them once and now cannot wear any sneakers until the blisters wear off. I will stay away from this brand from now on. I have learned that I cannot return these and am seriously upset. Very disappointing and an expensive mistake to have counted on ASICS.

So I bought these for my job where I stand on very hard floors all day because every other pair of shoes I have absolutely killed my feet, legs, and back. I bought a size 6 because that is what I wear, well to be completely honest Adidas in size 6 are too big. Out of the box these shoes looked small, compared to several other pairs of size 6 athletic shoes they were visibly smaller, but I put them on and somehow they seemed to fit. The first week I wore them at work my feet and back stopped hurting, I loved them. Then around 2-3 weeks in I developed a painful bump on the top of my foot that I know is from these shoes because that was all I had been wearing. I loosened the strings as much as possible but the bump never went away. If I could go back I would order a half size up. These are good shoes, even the pair I have that are too small have saved my lower back and stopped every inch of my feet from aching after work, they have just caused a bump on the top of one foot because something is rubbing there. The back and sides are very solid so I don't think they'll break down in those areas, they are very lightweight, the soles are good and are not slippery on wet floors. If the size ran normal and they hadn't caused the bump on my foot I would probably be rating them 5 stars right now.

I wanted to give these shoes a solid three months before reviewing to make sure my feet adjusted so here I go. I run 4 to 5 miles a day. My previous shoes were ASICS and they gave me the perfect support for my high arches. I had them for five years and would have loved to purchase the same model but I bought them in 2015. I bought my current shoes on Feb. 18th. The first thing I noticed was that the laces kept coming loose when running. I would have to stop and retie a few times a week during my run. The second thing I noticed was that the tongue of the shoe would not stay in place offering ankle support. I linked this to the shoe lace problem. After switching laces I noticed my left foot continued to slide forward when I ran. Today I took out my old shoes to compare and I realized that the fabric on these shoes are too thin. Overall it s very cheap compared to my 2015 pair. Today I also realized that each shoe also had a tear in the same spot on the inner part of each shoe. My old shoes never tore. I would not recommend these shoes if you are a serious runner who needs arch support. I wouldn t even recommend them to anyone who needs walking shoes unless they have 160 they are looking to flush.
I love this shoe but I have only had these shoes for a little over 2 months and it is already showing major wear of the fabric near my ankle??

I have worn Gel-Kayano shoes for many years. My last 2 pairs were 22's. I regularly participate in high impact workouts and find that these shoes provide great support in the heels and balls of my feet. All my Gel-Kayanos have been a size 8M regular shoe size 7M . This is a great shoe and, in my opinion, worth every penny. I've let friends talk me into buying other, less expensive, shoes over the years and in every case ended up replacing them almost immediately with a new pair of Gel-Kayanos. As I write this review, I have already worn these shoes for several workouts and find that they live up to my expectations. At first I was hesitant to buy a newer model of Gel-Kayano due to some of the reviews about fit and quality. To help provide input into your decision, I buy Softsole performance inserts and replace the inserts that come with the shoes. I am of slender build, in my mid-50s and have exercised in some capacity since I was a child read many years of pounding on my feet . I have heel spurs, and know when it's time to buy new shoes when the balls of my feet start bothering me. I hope you find this review helpful. I have attached a picture of my last 2 pairs and me wearing the pair I just bought. UPDATE ADDED OCT 11, 2019 Have now had these shoes for a month.
