I got this shoe because it got great reviews for arch support and heel support. It was perfect. The width was perfect and I can be on feet for 10hrs for work and my feet still feel great.
Great looking shoe but it was a little small. I normally wear a 9.5 but returned my original order for a size 10. The size 10 fits perfect.
A little narrow tight fitting at first but after time, just right. Ordered 1 2 size larger - perfect fit. Comfortable and very supportive. Will buy another pair

I had high hopes for these shoes, given that I literally wore my previous ASICS flat and the fit was wonderful. But the toe box in these are smaller than I had previously - my little toe was severely pinched and hurt just walking around briefly in the house, so I had to return them. Well made shoe, but not good for those of us with bigger toes who need a roomier toe box. I went with Brooks which feel fantastic.
Sneakers are comfortable, provide support to my heel, and I followed recommendations I read and ordered a half size up. They fit well.

I purchased my first pair of Gel-Kayano 26's during Covid quarantine, as I was walking a lot. They are so comfortable, I purchased a second pair as a back-up. They do run small, so go a half-size up. I normally wear an 8 1 2 and the 9's fit perfect. Roomy toe box and lots of support.

Unfortunately I had to reutnr these. The toe bed was too narrow and my big toenail was hitting the top. Very uncomfortable. BUT, the shoe is beautiful and very comfortable in all other ways. If you don't have fat toes like me you'll love them!

I ve purchased the Gel Kayano sneakers time after time since version 16 after they were recommended by my Podiatrist. While I don t have a wide foot, I do prefer a wider toe box in my walking running sneakers and these are perfect and accommodate my custom orthotic insoles.

durability.issue_summary: 구매자들은 내구성 문제로 인해 신발이 쉽게 망가지고, 사용 후 빠른 마모가 발생한다고 불만을 토로하고 있습니다.
durability.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 매우 내구성이 뛰어나고 오랫동안 사용할 수 있다고 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다. 또한 발을 잘 지지해 주어 만족감을 주고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: What has happened to my favorite shoe? Ive been wearing Kayanos for years. They've always been the best for me after having major surgery on my leg and foot. These newest ones have decent heel cushioning, but it's like they made the rest of the sole out of a worn out door mat. They run slightly small, as well, and with these two issues combined, I couldn't wear them longer than 5 minutes before I was in pain. So disappointing! If you're having the same problem but are loyal yo ASICS like me, I suggest trying Dynaflyte2 instead. They are amazingly comfortable!
For the price I pad shoes should last more than 3 months. They are literally falling apart and no one will stand behind the shoes. Buyer beware!!
The top of the left shoe rubs on my foot wrong and hurts! I can t wear it. I ve changed out the laces, kept them super loose, and nothing helps. It s a faulty shoe and now I can t exchange or wear it

Wearing Asics for years, however with my last purchase, Asics appears to be compromising quality of the product with cheap insoles made of post consumer rubber material that does not provide quality support, material breaks down with use decreasing support and causing injury to feet. Rubber material limits breathability and makes it very hot while wearing, causing major compounding sweat odor issues. Bad product - not like it used to be, very disappointed.

I am a big Gel-Kayano fan and I love the color of these. They run a bit on the small side compared to my previous Kayanos, but are comfortable. The problem the top, soft fabric that wraps around the padding that goes around my ankle up to the shoelaces ripped. There is nothing for them to catch on the shoe, and I didn't snag them. They just ripped. Small at first, but ever-growing with wear, so I don't like wearing them because you can see the white padding underneath it. This happened the first 3-4 weeks during COVID and I was rarely outdoors. At that time, my Amazon account was hacked and Amazon closed it down for well over a month, so I couldn't return these and kept thinking my account would be open again soon. This has never happened before and I've been buying my Gel Kayanos from from ZAPPOS and AMAZON. I'm hoping Amazon Customer Service can do the right thing and allow me to exchange these for the same shoes. Thank you.

So I bought these for my job where I stand on very hard floors all day because every other pair of shoes I have absolutely killed my feet, legs, and back. I bought a size 6 because that is what I wear, well to be completely honest Adidas in size 6 are too big. Out of the box these shoes looked small, compared to several other pairs of size 6 athletic shoes they were visibly smaller, but I put them on and somehow they seemed to fit. The first week I wore them at work my feet and back stopped hurting, I loved them. Then around 2-3 weeks in I developed a painful bump on the top of my foot that I know is from these shoes because that was all I had been wearing. I loosened the strings as much as possible but the bump never went away. If I could go back I would order a half size up. These are good shoes, even the pair I have that are too small have saved my lower back and stopped every inch of my feet from aching after work, they have just caused a bump on the top of one foot because something is rubbing there. The back and sides are very solid so I don't think they'll break down in those areas, they are very lightweight, the soles are good and are not slippery on wet floors. If the size ran normal and they hadn't caused the bump on my foot I would probably be rating them 5 stars right now.
I love this shoe but I have only had these shoes for a little over 2 months and it is already showing major wear of the fabric near my ankle??

I will be the first to admit, I am not active in the pounding-the-pavement-while-running kind of way. I am a professional woman who wears high heels during the majority of the workweek and running shoes at night and on weekends to keep my feet from hurting while running errands. Because of this, my running shoes have always lasted longer than average. I have bought Asics Gel Kayano shoes for years because they have extra support for my pronating ankles. I was unpleasantly disappointed by this pair. Although the shoe itself is the color and fit anticipated, the durability of these shoes is questionable at best. With merely walking a couple of miles during the evening about every other weekday and during my weekend errands, the mesh over the forefoot has already worn through. My exercise routine has not changed during this pandemic--only my location of employment, i.e., I worked a 40-hour week from home, instead of the office. The foam heel has already begun creasing and losing support. The ankle support has already begun losing much of its supportive structure. This is especially disappointing since I have only had this pair of shoes since the end of March the 26th, in fact . I hope I received a fluke poor pair. I would hate to think about the quality of my favorite running shoe manufacturer has decreased so drastically.
Shoe lacks sturdy structure and foot slides around inside. Wish I could return but they have been worn. Pretty dissatisfied since I normally love ASICS

I have been a faithful Aiscs buyer for years and this is the first pair I've purchased that were defective and just a case of shoddy workmanship. Because I removed the tag I am stuck with them and cannot return them. The problem is that the insole is not flush with the sides of the shoe. This creates spaces for one's foot to get serious blisters. I wore them once and now cannot wear any sneakers until the blisters wear off. I will stay away from this brand from now on. I have learned that I cannot return these and am seriously upset. Very disappointing and an expensive mistake to have counted on ASICS.

I have been wearing this sneaker model for years. I bought my first one in a store after trying on a ton of pairs and the rest online after that. This would have been my 5th pair and I'm disappointed to say that something has definitely changed. The shoes were so tight that my feet were in pain after 5 minutes of wearing them. I thought it was the laces so I took them out completely to restrap and they were even causing pressure with no laces in. Even though they say they are the same size as my previous shoes, they are significantly shorter than my previous pairs. There is something definitely defective happening here. I haven't lost hope in Asics completely given our history but we will see.

After wearing out my Gel Kayano 23s, which were the best runnimg shoes I have worn, I was very excited to renew them. Completely dlfferent shoe- cannot feel any gel at all. Feels like cardboard. Also they heated up my feet for some reason. The lining must also be different material

I am a big fan of the ASICS running shoe but not of this style and shape unfortunately! After trying them out, I find this shoe very uncomfortable and does not fit very well. I would like to return them back to ASICS but the window to return them has passed! 159 purchase now just sits in my closet!

I bought these shoes for work. I spend 8 to 10 hours a day on my feet while working in a busy hospital laboratory and need good shoes. My last pair of Asics had great support without being hard on the inside. I figured the next shoe in the series would be the same. Everyone keeps telling me they just need to be broken in. I'm sorry but I've wearing them 40 hours a week for several weeks and they are getting more uncomfortable.

This version of the gel kayano does not live up to the standards set by its predecessors. I have worn gel kayanos for over 15 years. I have watched as they have steadily increased in price. For the cost of the shoes I would expect stellar performance and support. Not so. In brief, they have all the support and structure of a basic generic shoe you could pick up at a big box store for less than 50 bucks. Out of the box the support was weak. After a few miles I noticed the toe box starting to lose integrity. The IGS I depend upon to keep my plantar fasciitis in check is hardly noticeable. It feels like a minimalist shoe but it isn t supposed to be. In short I haven t been this disappointed in a shoe since the last Nikes I purchased over 20 years ago. I may be in the market for a new brand.

I have worn Gel-Kayano shoes for many years. My last 2 pairs were 22's. I regularly participate in high impact workouts and find that these shoes provide great support in the heels and balls of my feet. All my Gel-Kayanos have been a size 8M regular shoe size 7M . This is a great shoe and, in my opinion, worth every penny. I've let friends talk me into buying other, less expensive, shoes over the years and in every case ended up replacing them almost immediately with a new pair of Gel-Kayanos. As I write this review, I have already worn these shoes for several workouts and find that they live up to my expectations. At first I was hesitant to buy a newer model of Gel-Kayano due to some of the reviews about fit and quality. To help provide input into your decision, I buy Softsole performance inserts and replace the inserts that come with the shoes. I am of slender build, in my mid-50s and have exercised in some capacity since I was a child read many years of pounding on my feet . I have heel spurs, and know when it's time to buy new shoes when the balls of my feet start bothering me. I hope you find this review helpful. I have attached a picture of my last 2 pairs and me wearing the pair I just bought. UPDATE ADDED OCT 11, 2019 Have now had these shoes for a month. Have exercised in them 3-5x a week and still love them.

I ve been wearing ASICS for the last 7 years and these have been one of the most comfy ones I have tried. Cushioning is amazing and they look great. They re not as dark as they look in the pictures I took. They re gorgeous! Update I loved them so much that I got a second pair!!!

Within 3 times of wearing this, the bottom of the shoe start coming apart... nothing a little super glue couldn t fix, but still. Annoyed that such an expensive shoe fell apart with barely wearing it.
Shoe was comfortable and great for my plantar fasciitis. However, the soles developed holes in less than 2 months.
These sneakers where beyond my expectations y all about confortable they are one of the best I ve ever wore
Love this shoe! They are light and using thin running socks makes then perfect. Supports my feet perfectly.
I m still breaking them in. I have tender feet and I m working in retail so I m standing for hours. I expect them to get more comfortable.
my wife like it so much she reordered a second pair one week after we purchased the first pair how's that for a review
Good quality of pronation and overall heal fit. made for smaller ankle with m-w feet. I'm not sure that wide is as "wide as New balance" or "boc", but it falls somewhere in between m and their wide.

I have worn this style in the past and was excited to see availability at such a good price. At age 64, it was important that the shoe be supportive but still comfortable so that I could maintain my daily jogging practice. From the first day I received these, I was able to run without any break in period. I am very satisfied with this purchase.

Purchased this brand on the recommendation of my podiatrist after fracturing my foot in 3 places. Had orthotic insoles made and they worked great with this shoe. Since I've purchased 2 pairs of Asics, I have comfort with or without the insoles.
Love this brand this is my second pair because the last almost forever. So comfortable and light on the feet

I love the Kayano Asics!! But this one pair with the mesh on the right shoe it starting shredding on the side. There is no way to stop it from continuing. So this is very upsetting considering I wear these to work only at the hospital. I have several pair of the Kayanos and love them.
I have overpronation, and these shoes support my arches really well. I haven't had any running injuries since buying them!

I m not an expert on shoes, but these feel great. I have a weird combo of VERY wide feet, a high arch, and a high vamp. I also have a lot of metal hardware in one ankle from breaking it in 8 places. I can wear these all day and my feet still feel great. Glad I got them.

price.strength_summary: 구매자들은 가격에 대한 만족감을 표현하며, 이 신발이 가치 있는 선택임을 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: This shoe is well worth the cost, I have used the others for quite a while and decided to step up. A GREAT shoe
my wife like it so much she reordered a second pair one week after we purchased the first pair how's that for a review
I love this brand of sneakers. For walking, running or just being casual. I wear them everyday and they look great.
Best shoes, I have 3 pair in different colors, great for running and walking. Little pricey this time
Great for daily hour-long walks on pavement. Bought for arch support and plantar fasciitis. So far, very helpful and comfortable.

urgent_issues.summary: 구매자들은 내구성 문제로 실망하고 있으며, 특히 벗겨짐, 접착제 문제, 스트랩 파손이 반복적으로 발생하고 있습니다.

comfort.issue_summary: 구매자들은 착용감과 관련하여 불편함을 호소하고 있으며, 특히 라벨, 물집, 그리고 아치 위치 문제로 인해 불만이 많습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Unbelievable! A perfectly comfortable shoe RUINED by an unnecessary, badly stitched label on which the right heel rests. These are going back. It s like a cheap shirt with a scratchy label against your neck. You are always aware of it but you can t remove it.

My old green crocs clogs have been with me for 7 years. They are the best and I remembered that I got them from big discount from ebay like 10.99. Since they are too old and the outsole is slippery, I have to buy new one. The only problem of the new one is one size smaller than my old one. As pictures showed, they are same big but size are different, that was why I returned smaller size and bought this bigger size. Other than that, no complaint, very comfortable as my old one and love them a lot! Update after 2 days I had 2 little blisters on my feet. I think the outsole is not soft as my old green clogs. So I need to give them up

Not so sure footed in these. Slipped and fell on the deck of the boat.....nice looking comfortable shoe but misleading in the super grip statement....manufacture note Crocs to produce soft, comfortable, lightweight, superior-gripping, non-marking and odor-resistant shoes

This used to be my favorite winter casual slipper shoe. I buy a new pair every 2-3 years once my old ones wear down. Unfortunately, the pair I reordered this year felt different immediately when I put them on. They are considerably more narrow than my previous two pairs. When I hold them up side to side it is very noticeable. My feet begin to hurt ache after wearing these for an hour or so. I m super disappointed that I ll have to find another brand now.
This shoes really smell after you wear it for a week. I bought 3 of them for me and my 2 kids but we all have the same problem. bad bad smell. Do not buy it.

I have been on a mission to find a pair of winter warm slippers houseshoes that don't hurt my feet back. I finally decided to try Crocs. They may be fine for younger people, but for someone older who has plantar faciitis at times and needs more stability in shoes, these did not work for me. I do quite well with Aetrex slides, they seem to hug my feet and provide the stability cushion walking and standing that I need, but they aren't very warm for winter. I could wear socks, but then they slip around and since they fit well without, I don't want to stretch them by adding more bulk. I'm sure for most people these are fine. I wear a 9-9.5 and without using the backstrap the fit is fine. But like another reviewer mentioned with the backstrap--which, of course, adds more stability to the shoe--my toe was right on the end--without socks. Also, there really is no arch support to speak of. I tried adding some of my orthotics, but really? I decided to return them.
These are ok. Very durable and fit well. I like the adjustable strap. However, the shoes put a blister in my foot after only a few hours of wearing them.

I have bought Crocs FOR YEARS. I wear my black no lining Crocs every day. They are my house shoes. I went through buying a few slippers on Amazon with lining and they all hurt my feet...the lining would crush down and I'd be left with nothing to pad my feet. So I decided not to re-invent the wheel and buy these with lining as my slippers. Bad idea! Same thing. The fur crushes down and the actual shoe is not malleable like my other Crocs. They are stiff as a board, no give. Hurt my feet wearing them! So what happened? Why are they not comfortable like my other Crocs? Why is the shoe so rigid? Something is up. This fur lined Croc is not the Crocs I know. Really disappointing.

I liked the idea of fuzzy lined slippers. Since I strongly dislike the feel of hard plastic against my bare feet, fuzzy lining sounded perfect. They fit comfortably, but in less than a month, the fuzzy lining was all matted down, my feet were sweaty inside, and the slippers started to smell. It didn't seem to make a difference whether I was wearing socks or not. Airing them out didn't do diddly, and washing them did alleviate the smell but did nothing to restore the fuzziness nor the discoloration of the lining. They took forever to dry several days and are already starting to smell again. I don't have naturally sweaty or smelly feet - this is a "fuzzy lining clog" issue, unfortunately. I cannot recommend these slippers.

I love d these!!!! I thought I'd found the perfect pair of indoor slippers that I could walk outside in. Nope. The tag in the heel...who thought that was a good idea???? These would be perfect without that tag! Why do they need the tag? No one ever sees the inside of the shoe and Croc is clearly marked on the shoe already. Really disappointed and very thankful I can ship them back.

I have an extremely narrow foot so I didn't expect a good fit. They work but would be better with a surface on the sole that doesn't attract debris you have to constantly pry out and flattens immediately, losing its promise of a cushy, soft sole

VIDEOID 83bf8760738ac322c346a58dae901acf These have been worn and are dirty as soon as I opened the package I could smell they smelled like feet. They have scuffs and dirt on the bottom and sides as well as some kind of red clay in one of the toe box holes. I paid full "new" price for these and they are gross! I want a new pair, cuz that's what I bought!

Ive been wearing crocks for years. Replaced a fleece lined pair with this pair. Arrived yesterday and was very disappointed in the cheap platic like outside. The fleece inside is thin and poly like. I would return these, but I wore them outside. The plastic like outside is also going to be very slippery in the winter. I'll probably end up wearing indoors like a slipper-but the cheap poly lining makes my feet sweat. Very Disappointed!!!

I wear a 10 women's and got the 8 men's 10 women's size. They are fine without the heel strap but a tiny bit short with the strap. The footbed shape also doesn't quite work for my foot the arch seems to be in the wrong place, which makes for a sort of awkward fit. Fine for gardening and garage work although it's kind of annoying when dirt gets in through the holes , but I would not walk around in these. My husband loves his, so it really just depends on your fit.

I have an old pair of Crocks, size 12. My foot is 11-3 4 inches. The guide shows size 12 Men s to be 11.73 . Close enough for me. The actual internal size of this shoe is 11-1 4 at best. Too small I ve requested an exchange for size and will update this review once that is complete. The return process seems to be quite easy. Update. I got my size 13's and they're still a little snug but acceptable. I jumped into my old 12's without thinking, with socks on with no problem. No way I could do that with even the 13's. I think I may truly need 14's but they don't make them in this style. Oh well, hope they break in and stretch out.

Crazy fast shipping! Adore the lining in these shoes especially in comparison to its standard rubbery no lining base standard model. I use these Crocs as house shoes due to their ease of slipping on and off, coupled with the 1 of support they sport. Normal slip on house shoes feel as tho I m walking on the bare floor. Not sure why slippers are synonymous with no sole ?! I do not wear socks to bed, so it s incredibly handy that these come with a lining in them. If you re a 1 2 half size, go up in size with Crocs, not down, as these are only Made in whole sizes. You ll appreciate the extra room, as opposed to your heel sitting on the back lip of The shoe because it s too small for Your foot lol. Quick Note throw your fav pair of these Crocs into your Amazon cart and let them marinate there for a few days. Ensure your amazon notifications are turned on, as to alert you when the price changes for items in your cart . The prices on these shoes are CONSTANTLY changing. At some point their price will drop and if you don t mind waiting a hot Minute, you can save a handful of Coin on them as well! Great fit! Great price! Fast shipping! And no More walking around with cold achy feet!
I remember a bit more arch support. Maybe it's just this model. Other than that perfect, delivery, perfect.

My husband has problems with his foot after having had a stroke several years ago. These are perfect for him. He can slip it off when needed, walk with sufficient support and it keeps his always cold foot warm. Don't know if it was ever meant as a therapeutic shoe, but it's working!
Ordered a size to small I wear a 8.5 in women s I got a size 8 over all comfortable but not good for people that s flat footed it has no arch support

Very comfy, just like standard Crocs. I use these as slippers around the house to help with arch support and they are great for keeping my lower back happy! I used to get moderate lower back pain when working from home and not wearing anything on my feet . I tried some basic slippers, but those just didn't have enough support- they helped, but only moderately. Now that I've been wearing these around the house during this COVID quarantine, I've noticed almost 100 relief of my lower back pain! These lined Crocs are plenty warm, as others have mentioned. If your feet tend to run hot, these might be a little too much for you. I find that wearing them with a very light sock helps to keep my feet from getting too sweaty.

Oh my lord these are the most amazing things ever! I have had a lot of lower back pain and recent sciatic pain from wearing the wrong type of shoes that do not give me the support I need. While these might not be the most glamorous shoes in the world, they truly are the most comfortable. I have literally stopped wearing all other shoes!! So far they have held up incredibly well as I wear them for my daily 3 mile walk with no issues! I can not describe the comfort that these things give me. I literally forget that I am wearing shoes because it just feels so amazing! I have wider feet with high arches and the bigger toe box does wonders! It also has amazing arch support, something that I was not expecting. Please do yourself and your body a favor and buy these right now. Don t even think twice about it. I have never been happier with a pair of shoes in my life.

This is my second pair of Crocs and my first pair of lined ones. I like them. They are soft and comfortable. The lining is ample but not too thick, so wearing them with socks works fine. These new ones, however, don't seem to have the same level of arch support the older ones had, which is a disappointment. I need a more arch support in fact, I have doctor prescribed orthotics in all my other shoes. But these are good, just not great. If they had more arch support, they would be perfect.
Very comfortable, And receiving products from Amazon in the mail received much quicker than any other store I have used online
These are SO comfortable. I prefer these instead of my slippers. Wear them all the time, especially when my feet are hurting because they help relieve plantar fasciitis from running.

I have a secret I love these ugly things. They're reasonably comfortable, they seem to last, and they don't cost a whole bunch. They just look awful. I'm a Men's 12 Regular, but I prefer shoes with wide toe boxes. I bought true to size but they were just a little bit on the loose side. I heated them up in the dryer to shrink them, trying them on every few minutes to check the fit. It took about 10 minutes to nail it. I expect them to shrink with heat and UV exposure, but heat and fitting can stretch them back out again. I have what I'd call a pretty standard arch. These fit that arch just fine.

I was looking to replace the houseshoes that I loved. I have plantar fasciitis and have solid tile flooring throughout my house. I was on my 2nd pair of the same houseshoes but they wore out around the 10 month period, and my feet were always hurting. When searching Amazon for houseshoes that accommodate plantars I came across these and figured I would give them a try. Mind you, this came under much scrutiny, as I've always made fun of my wife for having these shoes and those that wear them around that aren't doctors. I know, I know. However, when I got them, I fell in love. They have just the right amount of arch support. So much so that my feet do not hurt as much as they used to. I am starting to realize that the memory foam in my prior faves was only providing support at first but quickly wore out and I was basically walking around on a solid floor without the support. Something that you really shouldn't do. In any event, get past the stigma that unfortunately often surrounds these shoes and get them for you or your loved ones. Yes, I ended up back on here and purchased a pair for my wife. She doesn't rub it in much .
Really love them. Very comfy and nice and warm. Easy to walk with, very light and you can even wear sock with them.

If you have hardwood or tile floors, these are foot, knee and back savers! They provide more than adequate cushion to wear all day, with enough support to keep your feet happy. If you have plantar fasciitis, Crocs will save you an immense amount of pain. Add in some foot stretches and exercises and it can all but go away! Most of the time you'll find yourself wearing them as slip-on clogs, but when you need a little extra security, you can just flip them into "four wheel drive mode" with the heel strap down. Just as comfortable! I've been a fan of Crocs for a long time. I had a pair in my 30's but back then I was still susceptible to what people thought so I was a "closet Crocer". 20 some odd years later and I'm still a huge Crocs fan. The difference is now I don't care. I'll happily wear them to the grocery store, the hardware store, a walk around the neighborhood, I'll mow in them, I'll wear them to the beach, I'll wear Crocs with socks I have them on as I write this review - whatever, I ain't scared! Don't get me wrong, I'm a man of style and care about how I present myself, but if someone I don't know is bold enough to comment on my less than stylish but supremely comfortable footwear I figure that has more to say about their own insecurities than mine. The style conscious people closest to me, my wife daughters still do what they can to keep me at home when my feet are wrapped in glorious supportive synthetic shells. HOWEVER, I'm winning them over to the Croc side. More on that battle later Our house has mostly hard surface flooring, and walking around barefooted with all the wear and tear my body has seen isn't a comfortable option. We also have 10 grandchildren under the age of 5 that visit frequently. Obviously, some of them are "crawlers", so we try not to wear the "outside shoes" in the house because face it, shoe soles are disgusting! The BEST solution based on comfort, affordability, variety of color and just sheer awesomeness is Crocs! But how to win the rest of the family over, because as we all know, logic doesn't always win. Ah! Indoctrinate the younger generation! I bought the oldest granddaughter little kid size 6 pink Crocs to wear when she visits. They're so easy to put on and take off, and she LOVES them! Of course what one wants they all want, so now we have quite the collection! Colors don't matter, little kids don't care, they just want epic footwear to protect their little tootsies! Besides, baby everything is cute, for crying out loud even baby snakes are cute! I knew the cuteness factor would go in my favor with the females of the family! Now that the children are wearing them, and I'm still evangelizing every chance I get what happens? YES! One of the son-in-laws puts some very stylish "army green" Crocs on his Amazon wish list. Of course he got them for Christmas! That started the slippery slope, and we've had an avalanche of Croc purchases since then. The fleece lined "winter Crocs" are the latest and greatest to be added to the collection. Mine are in black, and since I m currently working from home, they're like dress shoes right? My wife's first pair are white with stylish contrasting grey fleece. The daughters also caved and got some "Just to wear inside on the hard floors you understand". Mmm-huh I'm working on the rest of the adult children. I expect full compliance by summer. Buy some - join the Croc revolution of comfort. All the cool kids are doing it!

These shoes are the best, no doubt. Super warm and cuddly and soft and great in all respects. But, after many months of wear they get less great and then you think, "I think I should wash them and then they will be good again." So I did that. I first researched and found that even though some said, do not do this, others said the manufacturer says hand wash and hang dry and all will be ok. So I washed them in the sink with cool water and wool soap and gentle motion and hang dry. After three days of checking the hang dry status I said, this will take forever to dry, so in the sun they went. This is Florida, so when I say sun, I mean it. Two days later, still wet, so I give up and put them on a shelf and four days later come back to check. Still wet somehow under the liner, and no, the liner does NOT come out regardless of whatever someone said. And there is a strange and rather unpleasant odor coming from the liner that seems to not at all like being washed, and the soap did not smell like that and the fresh air and sun did not smell like that and my shelf did not smell like that. So I got out the wife's hair dryer and gently dried off the remaining wetness and finally got it dry. But they still smelled and still smell to this day one week later. And the liner is all compressed, no longer soft, no longer cuddly, and also in places somewhat scratchy. So... My opinion, FWIW, is to under no circumstances wash these clogs. Do not follow the manufacturer's recommendation or the recommendation of anyone on this site who says otherwise. DO NOT WASH THESE. These slippers capture water under the liner, so it is stuck between the liner bottom which seals it between the sole and liner and ruins these shoes. Accept, I know it is hard, but accept that these are single use shoes. Wear them for some time and when they get too yucky, chuck them. Buy new. Or ignore what I said and try it for yourself and write a comment under this telling me that I am all wrong. And then with a smirk, chuck em.

After tripping repeatedly while wearing my Skechers Women's Go Walk Joy Walking Shoes, I am tossing them. I own a good number of shoes - from heels to hiking boots - and have not tripped while wearing any of them. The soles of the Go Walk shoes are super grippy and as a result do not always move off the ground when your legs and feet are ready to move. The men s Skechers that we own - Skechers Men's Expected Gomel Slip-On Loafer - do not cause a tripping problem but the soles of the Gomel Slip-On are vastly different. Please see the attached photos of both pairs. I am terribly disappointed because the Go Walk shoes are super comfortable, but I am not going to risk falling for comfort. It is too late to return the shoes via Amazon so, sadly, binning them is the only option.

The black shoe black bottom size 8.5 wide. They fit accurately. But I'm now shopping for another shoe and can ill afford it.

Skecher's memory foam walking flats have been my go-to everyday comfy shoes for many years. I always have at least a couple pairs on hand because I just grab cute colors during sales instead of waiting for them to actually wear out. I've been quite satisfied with my Go Walks overall, but the finer details vary just enough that I've slightly preferred some models over others. I wouldn't change a single thing about these though! I'm a super consistent 7, especially in Skecher's, and these fit like a dream. They have just the right amount of toe room and hug my ankles securely. I'm very picky about how high flats are in the back because my heels are absurdly sensitive, but these feel so natural that I'm barely aware of them. They stay in place perfectly with every step, with or without socks, yet they never feel too tight or leave marks. The cushiony insoles have excellent arch support too. Although they're certainly great for walking, I wear these year round on all sorts of occasions. The breathable fabric keeps my feet cool and dry in warm temps, but it's also stretchy enough to work with thicker socks in cooler weather. I only really avoid heavy precipitation and icy muddy situations, so I consider these shoes quite versatile. They're super comfortable all day long and go with tons of outfits. The memory foam holds up very well for several seasons of heavy use, so even though I'm a frugal shopper, I view these as a good investment.

I got the taupe and it will go with absolutely everything. I also love that the sole is a close match to the color of the shoe. These shoes are comfortable like slippers. Not much support but chushiony and good for distance walking. I wear a wide shoe and can rarely find this size, so very happy to find it.

I am very disappointed in these shoes. They are nothing like my real sketchers. I own several pairs and compared them. They are not real very poorly made and appear to have been previously worn. I tried contacting the seller and they never responded. Warning! These are plastic and FAKE Not real sketchers. Sole is hard plastic - heel is cardboard!

Skechers is not known for consistent sizing, and I have, and have tried on, many many pairs. This is the first time I have purchased from Amazon and I did so because they have a nice color selection in wide, which neither Skechers website nor Zappos does. Why is this? Shouldn't Skechers website have the greatest variety? This shoe is much larger than other Skechers of the same size. It is OK for a wear-around-the-house shoe, but too roomy to wear for walking outdoors. The linings are starting to bunch up and I have had this pair only about two months. And the soles are starting to peel.

I got these 2 months ago and the bottom of both shoes are peeling. Plastic peeling thin layers it's gross. Idk why they are doing this. I am mostly at home on carpet. I'm not hiking or scratching them on rocks. Also noticed if they get wet, the black dye runs. Maybe I got sold a pair of knock offs. But I bought from right here. The black shoe black bottom size 8.5 wide. They fit accurately. But I'm now shopping for another shoe and can ill afford it.
Shoes looked like they had been wor. Numerous times . Someone had glued insoles inside of the shoes and they were dirty as was the sole of show ,, very dirty .

I have worn these shoes maybe 15 times and the soles are wearing out already. The cheapest, low quality sneaker I have ever worn. Sketchers call this a "walking" shoe sneaker well forget about it. You can walk around the block but that's it because of lack of support. I have bought Sketchers before that were much more expense and they were great but they failed on this shoe. I would call them disposable shoes. Don't buy you will be disappointed.

The first pair I accidently stepped on a banana my baby left on the floor and couldnt clean well enough to return them. Oddly one shoe was wayy wayy bigger than the other even though both marked the same size. on top of that I ordered a 7 1 2 and they were more like and 8 and 81 2. So I dared to buy another pair and went down a size to a 7. The second pair were ALSO 2 different sizes, both tagged inside as 7's! the right so lose I couldnt wear it and the left perfect. I returned them sucessfully and cant bother trying again which is a da shame because the one out of 4 shoes that fit perfect was the most comfy shoe I can remember trying in a long time.

This shoe was comfortable at first wearing out the box. After several hours, my foot was slipping out of the shoe. It, apparently grew while I was walking. I am size 7.5. Shoe is now approximately an 8.5 in size. I had a total knee replacement in October 2020, reviews stated this was one of the best shoes to wear for such surgery. It is not! This shoe is wide and extremely loose. Not a medium size 7.5. With inserts, shoes is not comfortable enough to wear securely. Want a REFUND!

I am livid! Not knowing these were used, I picked them up with my hands not knowing where they have been! This is unacceptable. If something was returned, IT SHOULD NOT BE SOLD AS NEW WITHOUT CHECKING TO SEE IF IT HAS BEEN WORN!

I've owned these for about 5 months. I wear them every day to work or out for errands. They're soft, light, cushy. They stretched out a bit too much and became loose, but I still wore them. Sadly, they have proven not to be very durable, as the insides are already coming apart and there's a hole near my pinky toe now. A pity that such comfortable shoes didn't last even 6 months!
I like the fit and support it gives just what I need I'm a dialysis Technician and I on my feet a lot on concrete floors

After purchasing at least 10 different styles of Sketchers, I finally realized that heavier folk like me should NEVER purchase the memory foam insoles. NOW I look for the Gogomax Sketcher insoles. These are perfectly wonderful! I don't understand why Sketchers continues to risk lawsuits from the foot, back and leg injuries from those horrible memory foams. Gogomax made me a Sketchers fan again!

Before you buy, I am a perfect, flat floot size 7 1 2. I first bought the 7 after reading the reviews. DI NOT GO SMALLER BECAUSE THEY RUN LARGER!!!!! I had to return all 3 pairs and reorder 7 1 2. They are easy to put on look great and feel wonderful. I have spurs and plantar faciaitis. I also need good shoes because of my back problems. These are wonderful. I have walked the stairs, gone outside and walked my one acre yard, hung clothes out to dry and felt AWESOME. The only slip on shoes that ever worked were expensive Keens. The others would buckle funny around my non-arch and not only love ok funny but be uncomfortable. I might order more as back ups as I m sure I will wear them out fast. They work with everyday, dress up or as slippers with PJ s.

I have had increased problems with my feet and also my knees in recent years and it has been a challenge to find shoes that are comfortable and supportive. I need a wide toe box since I suffer from bunions and also high arches. I am on my feet quite a bit at work elementary school and it is important to have something that can get me through the day. I have been very pleased with the fit of these shoes I can actually get them on which is a plus for me and the soles provide a nice support. I love the mesh fabric as it gives both some stretch but also some support. And of course, I think they are very cute too! I am very pleased with my purchase and will probably order some other colors too!
I liked the shoes so much that I actually bought another pair before the original purchase pair has worn out

With white soles, I don't think they would be white very long if worn outside. But inside on a clean floor, they would do very well. They don't have a lot of arch, so may not be good for flat feet, but for normal feet, it's probably enough. They are really comfortable otherwise for walking around home and sitting watching TV. Haven't washed them yet, but they look well put together.

This pair of shoes is lightweight, compresses well when packing, and best of all for travel TSA they are slip on. They got me through 6 days of theme park walking without an issue, and when we got caught in the September rains of FL, they dried quick and held up well. Perhaps my only gripe comes down to design, they are not good shoes to wear socks with. Which, for my needs was mostly fine. It did cause some trouble with TSA because I had to walk on bare feet. But really that is a personal gripe and not sketcher's fault!

First of all, when I find something I like I buy two of the same. Since I have been wearing Skechers for nearly 10 years, you will not find another brand in my closet. When I broke my foot in 2009, I tried to find a shoe that would fit comfortably, had support, that I could walk properly, didn't cause any blisters, etc. I couldn't wear heels anymore, nor my favorite sandals. Forget about flip flops!!!!!! I found Skechers and I was totally hooked. I ditched all of my really expensive heels, loafers and slip ons, my running shoes and was left with Skechers. I even got my husband wearing them. I went to a retail store to find out which size suited me best, and then just started ordering them from Amazon. If I wanted to wear knee highs with slacks in the cooler months, I would order a 10. All of the other times, I would order 9 1 2. I will say, that after a while of wearing them I do get them out of shape. I frequently wash them in the washing machine, and never put them in the dryer. One interesting point, I developed plantar fasciitis and was in a tremendous amount of pain. I tried every shoe support I could find for plantar fascitis and finally after a few months it went away after lots of PT and ice. I did get quite used to the support inserts and I just kept wearing them in my Skechers. I look around and I see many knock offs of Skechers but I know I have the real brand. You are probably wondering what I do about getting dressed up. I don't own a dress, but some very nice slacks. You can find Skechers that have little sparkles on them that are all black. They are the dressy ones, and of course if you look hard enough you can find some black suede. I would be embarrassed if you were to look in my closet and count how many pair I have. They are pretty much the same style, color and pattern. To keep the pairs together, I use clothes pins and snap them. Love my Skechers.

The last pair of black slip on sketchers lasted over 12 years being worn just about daily, except hot summer days with sandals. Started to see a tear in the toe area and the soles were worn down to leaking when it rained - Hated to get rid of them... So glad these are comfortable, similar to the last pair, professional enough to wear on the job, fit well and soft. Thank you Sketchers for the design and Amazon for having these ready to purchase. Plan to get a couple of more to go with wardrobe colors. - THX
Love this shoe. I have bunions and bone spurs. This gently cradles the foot. Soft and pliable but stays in place, without painful pressure.
This is my second pair of these and I love them! They fit great right out of the box. Comfortable. Washable. What more can I ask for?

These shoes are perfect for working where I stand for 6 hrs a day as a cashier. My feet no longer hurt and I can walk for miles. Hips are worn out and the pain is usually there after 3 hrs, but not when wearing these shoes. They fit better than I expected. The material keeps them cool even though I wear socks. Living in Florida with the humidity and heat, i find these shoes to work out well for me.

I've had a sever fracture of my foot ankle. Every sketcher I have purchased have given excellent support are very attractive. I remember the time when sketcher brands didn't enjoy the concern of buyers. Now the the best shoes available.

No break in period. Put them on and they're comfortable. That's why I have a closet full of Skechers. I couldn't resist the tie-dye look but really, Skechers shoes are almost all basically alike. They wear well - I have some that are ten or more years old.

representative_reviews.text: I own 3 pairs of these Go Joys and I must say that they are not all the same. This latest pair with black on black are made incorrectly or should I say imperfect.... the material that we would call the tongue area of this shoe is way too tight almost pinching and causing my foot to hurt all day. The other 2 pairs have a very defined tongue loafer look and comfortable feel. Its almost as though the material was sewn at the wrong angle leaving no room for your foot to flex step as you walk. Terrible construction and because I didn't wear them until now I can't return them !

Skechers is not known for consistent sizing, and I have, and have tried on, many many pairs. This is the first time I have purchased from Amazon and I did so because they have a nice color selection in wide, which neither Skechers website nor Zappos does. Why is this? Shouldn't Skechers website have the greatest variety? This shoe is much larger than other Skechers of the same size. It is OK for a wear-around-the-house shoe, but too roomy to wear for walking outdoors. The linings are starting to bunch up and I have had this pair only about two months. And the soles are starting to peel.

I expected more of a rose color but it is beige and shiny. I bought it for my exercise class so it s fine but I won t wear it with jeans etc. The bottom was a bit slick which was a bit of a problem in class on a wood gym floor

Sketchers GoWalk is a known great brand for lightweight, comfortable shoes. It was great to see them come out with the Joy model, which is all black and has a mesh top. I was looking for an all-black shoe including the bottom to wear to work business casual and I wear these every single day. I call them "invisible" because they call zero attention to themselves - they don't look like athletic shoes or dress shoes - just purely functional and incredibly comfortable, and work fine in a professional setting with pants, at least - I don't wear skirts . It's surprising how many women have asked about them, which suggests others may be looking for something similar. If so, this is the one.
I wore these on vacation, they were great for travel. Even new there was no break in needed, comfortable and I wore them through the airport and all day. I also loved that they are washable

In the photo and person, I wasn't expecting so much texture. But that's my fault for not really paying attention to the type I ordered. It'll do for now. They fit and feel so comfortable, just not my style taste. I thought it was the canvas ish style.

Great light weight shoe! Very comfortable and stylish. I have plantar fasciitis and these will take my insert but I find I don t need it. I m 60 years old and I feel these are stylish for younger ages as well. My 36 year old daughter complimented me on them the other day! The taupe color is more of a soft gray in my opinion and I love them. I also bought the tan pair and love their versatility as well.
Very very very comfortable. I will definitely buy in other colors. Best sketcher I ever had. Thank you very much.
This is my second pair, love this shoes! Will most likely buy another one in different color. They are very comfortable.

From the reviews, I thought they would be a bit loose but they were the opposite. They're snug and comfortable. My fiance doesn't think they're very stylish but with the right jeans, I know I can make them work. I really wanted them for walking and exercise anyways. The bottoms were a bit dirty but the rest looks clean and new. Not sure what's up with that. Overall, I'm satisfied with my purchase.
They look like grandpa's slippers with a pink piping but are warm and comfy on cold floors in winter. Stay on my feet perfectly when climbing narrow, steep stairs in my old log house.

I like the look of the shoe I got black and they are comfortable but no where near as cushy as the Go Walk 5. I did walk all over NYC 12 miles in a day! and had no problems except that the shoes ran a little big. I usually wear an 8 in Skechers but could have ordered these in a half size smaller. I would still buy them again!

We are a Sketcher family, sold on this comfort ever since our first pair. My wife requested all black so she could wear them to work as she wears business attire. I was able to located an all black pair in her size and the price is lowest found anywhere. She loves them and will be wearing them 40 plus hours per week.

I bought a navy pair and LOVED it. It fits so well I ordered a black pair, same size. It's not! The black pair is definitely more tight than the navy pair, so much that I have to return it. Trying a different color, hopefully it's good this time round.

Really light and very comfortable sneaker. I wear size 10 but it took me three times to order to get to the right size. I had to get size 9. My foot is never in between so I would recommend ordering 2 sizes to try them on. They offer 7 day free try on. I only wear them around the house but they would be comfortable to wear them anywhere all day long.
Love the fit, color, comfort. Standing and walking on warehouse cement floor is much better with this shoe. Thanks for offering it in large sizes!

I honestly did not expect these shoes to be as good as rumored but to my surprise they are so I purchased 2 more pair! I am running around on my feet all night at work and needed something light, super comfy, fits well, provides support and just overall a good shoe to hit the floor running in. Oh and of course I don t mind spending a little money but the fact that these are so cheap they became an instant winner in my book! I hope they last but, if not at least I will have 2 others to spread out the usage. The look of them is okay but I didn t buy them for looks so I don t care much about that. I suppose it varies from person to person your reasoning for buying them. To make a fashion statement maybe no but if you want to feel like you walking on nice pillows well this is your shoe!

It's almost like Sketchers ruined a perfectly good shoe to save a buck by using cheap materials. They definitely weren't worth the price I paid. And they were uncomfortable. I returned them.

representative_reviews.text: I so wanted to love this shoe. Great support, nice toe box, super fit, everything you expect from Merrell but it also came with unexpected yet consistent lower back pain. I tried breaking them in, swapping shoes, wearing them for limited times, changing the inserts, etc. I'm a month in and each time I wear them results in lower back pain. Never had this experience with another shoe or Merrell product. If you buy them and start with lower back pain return them immediately, it's not going to go away. It's the shoes not you. UPDATE - It is the shoes Spoke with Merrell. These shoes have a high lug depth rise from heel to toe was the explanation most shoes only have a lower lug depth, including many Merrells. The shoe's design is known to result in lower back pain for some people lug depth or arch placement. Merrell was very helpful and replaced the shoes for me. Very impressed with Merrell they really do stand behind their product.
The arch is in the wrong place for my foot. I should have worn them sooner, now I cannot return them.

The heel is built up in an odd way which, for me, makes it very uncomfortable. I ended up with pain in my knees, hips and back after walking in them only for a short period of time. Perhaps they could work for someone else but definitely not for me.

I bought these based on the awesome reviews although I beg to differ. There was a lump in each shoe right where the pad is on the front of the shoes. Ouch!! But I decided to go on an 8 mile hike anyways thinking I just needed to break them in. First off, these have no grip at all!! Very scary! I climbed onto some huge boulders in the middle of a river and I was so close to falling in. My regular old gym shoes would have done better than that! I m glad no one saw me almost fall multiple times! And by the end of the day, I could barely walk my feet hurt so bad.

I was thinking i would switch to these from keens as the keens don't seem to last very long anymore however..., the toe box is constricting, shoes run at least a half size small in length and are very tight fitting for height. Also the arch support is to far back. Very uncomfortable out of the box.

I ordered my usual size 8.5. They hurt my toes very terribly. I thought the shoes might stretch eventually but it never happened. I have had the shoes for 3 months now and my toes still hurt like hell when I wear these shoes. I have to get rid of them. Bottom Line Would Not Recommend
I purchased these Merrell Women's Moab 2 Vent Hiking Shoes size 9 US this spring. They are great shoes but they now have this annoying squeak even when dry.

Merrill replaced these with warranty. 6 months later, same issue. Backs of inside of shoe degraded to the point ankle rubbing on outside of shoe. I am buying another pair on sale. The arches fit my feet. I do use an arch support inside. If I can get 6 months for less than 60 I am happy to not have hurt arches. Price point and arches are my most important. If Merrill would make inside back of foot fabric less likely to break down, this would be a five star review. Purchased Feb 2022, wear on daily walks. Inside heal is worn out and coming apart on my socks. The last Merrill s did this after a year which was disappointing. I will be shopping for a different brand.

I ve worn Moab2 for years and I ve had no problem wearing all day right out of the box. Not anymore! This new design is narrower with more of an incline from heel to toe. The toebox is narrower. The first pair I bought was defective, so I tried another pair but it was exactly the same. Then I tried buying it in wide and that s what I realized it has a completely different foot bed. Walking in them felt off from the start. My feet starting cramping and then my knees hurt! Why would Merrell change a foot bed that works so well for so many people for years? Who are the idiots in charge? They should have changed the name of the shoe along with the design! As always though, kudos to the Vibram non slip sole! In the original Moab 2 I ve spent hours every two years standing on my concrete tile roof power washing and have never slipped even with moss on tiles.

The quality of these shoes is horrible. For YEARS I only wore these shoes. Every. Day. These shoes were great for my lower back issues, and my torn meniscus. Wearing these shoes helped me STOP needing cortisone shots every 3 months. They WERE great support for very long days and nights on my feet. In the past I would replace them every year to keep that firm, strong support. Once I ordered new ones, I would wash them and give them to a local charity. In 2021, I felt something had drastically changed. I had to try a different size than what I d worn for years. I noticed the material was breaking down faster AND seemed like they were not stable enough for climbing or providing firm support. The overall quality was gone. But. I continued to buy the shoes. Then my knees started hurting REALLY bad. I felt like my feet were sloshing around as if they were too big. I noticed the structure of the shoes was breaking down easily. My ankles began to hurt and swell. Then my knees started hurting more and more. Then my back started hurting again. It has been YEARS without any issues. I suspected the shoes. At the nudging of my Ortho doc who had commented that he personally was noticing issues as well with his Merrells I stopped wearing them and went into a different well known shoe. Within DAYS all my pain STOPPED. But I love my Merrells.. so I went back and ordered a smaller size. Within about 2 weeks my ankles started hurting, my knees were swelling and hurting, and then my lower back started hurting. Took the shoes OFF and within days pain went away. Put the shoes on.. pain came back. So did the visits back to the doc to get cortisone shots. I will never buy myself another pair. My first pair lasted me 2 years and still looked great! I realized I was replacing these shoes every 6 months and the truth was they were causing me issues within a few weeks. The size is NOT consistent they don t last they don t hold up and they have ZERO support. Save your time, money, and body.. go with another brand. I got my last pair in JULY 2022.. and they already need to be replaced or thrown out . I won t even give them to the charity.
The pair of shoes came in an Amazon bag without a box to protect it from any wears and tears during the delivery. The bottoms of the shoes look worn and dirty. Disappointed

The boots arrived on time and looked fine, but as soon as I began testing them out indoors in preparation for a big hike, it became clear that they don t have the arch support or cushion required for the serious hiking I need. Unfortunately, when I tried to return them, I was refused one day after Amazon s return date had passed. Don t buy these online. I ve wasted my money on these boots and hope to help you avoid doing the same.

I really like these shoes except the arch support is positioned more toward the heel, and it was pushing in so hard it was hurting. So, I bought a softer cushioned support and tried it with them too. It's better, but because the way the shoe is made, the arch support doesn't support the arch of the foot, it pushes up more toward the back of the foot, which hurts the heel. I am still working on cutting the new inserts and moving them around to feel better and make it to where it doesn't put pressure in the rear of the arch. I may end of returning these, but I'm also willing to try and make it work because I really like the shoe itself. If you don't have problems with arch support, the shoe quality itself is great. I think these shoes will last for a long time if I can get them to fit properly.
Wore these hiking for the first time today in the mountains. My feet were sliding all around especially at the ankle. Have never had this problem in the past with other hiking shoes.
Odd shape. Too wide at the arch and heel. I did not pay attention to the June 16th deadline for return and am stuck with the awful shoes. I've donated them to a homeless shelter.
Great supportive shoe for hiking - looks great with good arch support. However, the foot bed isn't very cushiony so I'm not sure how it will feel after hours of hiking. They do run small so size up!
Perfect for hiking or long walks. Good supportive high arch. Just what I was looking for at a great price!

Before purchasing these directly, I tried three pairs of other womens hiking shoes through Amazon's Try Before You Buy program Adidas Terrex, Columbia Crestwood ankle height , and Eddie Bauer Thielson. My husband tried on different options, one of which was the men's version of the Merrell Moab 2. I was originally leaning toward the Terrex, but I just wasn't sold because they weren't comfortable enough. They were my top choice of the three tried. Then, I asked for his thoughts on the Merrell Moab 2, and I am so glad I did! He talked about how comfortable they were all around his foot and the fact he could really feel the arch support. As someone who has been wearing shoes with good arch support or adding inserts since 4th grade, that sounded perfect. So, I took a leap of faith and just ordered the womens version. The moment I put the first shoe on, I could tell it was a slam dunk. My foot feels surrounded by cushion on all sides. The arch support is pronounced, but I know my feet need it. Also, I've got a nerve between two toes that is pinched by scar tissue thanks to an old break. I've had to be really careful in the past year to find shoes that don't irritate those toes or make them go numb. The other three hiking shoes I tried definitely didn't feel comfortable on those toes and would have required a metatarsal pad hate having to use them . Meanwhile, the Moab 2 hiking shoes do not. What a great shoe! For additional context, I'm in my early 40s and normally wear a size 8.5 or 9 depending on the brand. For these, 8.5 is perfect.

Comfortable, tough, great arch support. The soles are thick and lugged idea for hiking rocky terrain. Weirdly, these shoes cured my knee pain on a gravel bike my doctor thinks maybe because they have such good support and keep my feet from "collapsing inward" and putting pressure on my knee. Surely this is a truly freakish personal thing, but if your knee hurts on your gravel bike, maybe worth a try.

Most comfortable shoes I have ever worn. I have wide feet high arches and lean on the outsides of my feet. I also have fibromyalgia and one longer leg. These are the only shoes that I don't feel pain in after a 8 hour day standing!!
Comfortable right out of the box! They fit true to size. The support is amazing. These are fabulous hikers at a very fair price.

I live in the country. I'm outside 365 days a year doing chores, tending to animals, working in the garden or orchard, you name it. The summer months are very busy. I close all the rings on my iWatch just by doing my normal day, often by 2 or 3pm. I've long sworn by Merrells for hiking and general comfort they're well made and super comfortable. But lately I'd tried some other shoes, and I began having shooting pains in my left calf, as well as general leg fatigue before my day was done. I don't have a choice to sit down and rest when I'm tired or sore. I need to make sure I never get tired or sore. I figure it like this. Every step we take, we cause impact that goes up the leg in waves. This can cause concussion in the knees and hips and if the joint isn't evenly loaded, over time it can cause pain. I see this in horses all the time. Due to poor trims or shoeing or just poor conformation, one part of the joint ends up carrying too much of the concussion, and that causes soreness. I'm not a doctor or a vet, but I'm a very experienced horseman. I see nuances in movement that others miss. I was messing around with other shoes. Cheaper ones, ones that feel like socks, ones that don't offer the outstanding base of support that my Merrells do. And I began to experience aches and pains before the day was done. My life is hard on shoes. I was sort of saving my Merrells for good, instead of allowing them to get a little muddy, mucky, or poopy. That was a mistake. I decided to have a sacrifice pair, and replace them once a year. And when my new ones arrived, I chose a pair from my stash to be the sacrifice. I now wear them every day except when schooling horses and the aches and pains are gone. And by the end of my day, I'm just tired. Not sore. My grandfather was an orthopedic surgeon. He always insisted that while we could cut corners on clothing, we had to have the highest quality footwear. How your feet feel influences how the rest of you feels. Merrells are my go-to brand for work, hiking, and hanging out. They have never, ever disappointed.

Edit, I actually did miss the deadline to return them and recently i had my other shoes gone bad so i used this ones and i can say they are very very comfortable and even though they are heavier provide better support for my arch. So I am happy with them now. They are good looking and comfortable but they are really heavy shoes. They are not great for long hikes or work, they add unnecessary weight to your feet and just get you tired faster
I like that there is arch support and room in toe box...have not worn hiking yet but they are comfy when I tried them on.

These shoes are awesome. I bought them for a multi national park vacation. I'm not a serious hiker, but I'm walking hiking about five miles a day over varied terrain. First, they grip. They grip well, but noticeably so on bare rock, rock covered in wet sand, and rock covered in dry sand. Where other people were slipping, I was not. As for the support, it's great. I have plantar fasciitis and if I don't have good arch support, I can't walk the next day for the pain. My feet haven't hurt AT ALL. The sizing is great. I have wide feet and have a hard time finding women's shoes that are wide enough. These are wide enough. All in all a great shoe.
Really hard inner sole. Tried different cushy hiking socks, but still needs a thin layer of memory foam.

representative_reviews.text: I so wanted to love this shoe. Great support, nice toe box, super fit, everything you expect from Merrell but it also came with unexpected yet consistent lower back pain. I tried breaking them in, swapping shoes, wearing them for limited times, changing the inserts, etc. I'm a month in and each time I wear them results in lower back pain. Never had this experience with another shoe or Merrell product. If you buy them and start with lower back pain return them immediately, it's not going to go away. It's the shoes not you. UPDATE - It is the shoes Spoke with Merrell. These shoes have a high lug depth rise from heel to toe was the explanation most shoes only have a lower lug depth, including many Merrells. The shoe's design is known to result in lower back pain for some people lug depth or arch placement. Merrell was very helpful and replaced the shoes for me. Very impressed with Merrell they really do stand behind their product.

i really love these shoes, but i should have gone with a smaller size, they fit rather big and clunky even with an insert and fat socks. i was headed to New Mexico, so i didn't have time to return them.

I was thinking i would switch to these from keens as the keens don't seem to last very long anymore however..., the toe box is constricting, shoes run at least a half size small in length and are very tight fitting for height. These shoes require breaking in. They hurt at first since they have a harder sole for walking over rocks. I suggest buying one 1 2 - 1 size higher if you will be hiking up and down steeper, rocky trails because no matter how tight you tie them your foot slips forward and toes bang up against the front wearing your normal size. But, are comfortable on flatter surfaces. The toe is wide and comfortable for bunions. Kinda cute. Did a good job preventing dirt rocks from getting into the footbed.

I have recently taking up hiking to lose some weight, and needed a good pair of hiking shoes to accommodate my daily walks through a local trail. I read several reviews and decided upon the Merrell Women's Moab 2 Vent Hiking Shoe. The reviews said it was true to size so I ordered my normal size 7, since I usually wear medium weight cotton low rise socks to walk in. When my order came, I put them on immediately and they indeed felt very comfortable. I set out on a 2 mile walk for a test run, and sadly they became less comfortable as time went on. Oddly, it was not my big toe or pinky toe that started to hurt first, it was my ring finger toe not sure what else to call it, the toe next to my pinky toe . This was on my left foot. As my walk got longer my right foot started to ache a bit, so I came home and boxed the shoes up for a return. I have ordered a size 7.5 and I am hoping that the slightly larger size will make a difference, since I really like to appearance and general comfort - I think the size 7 was just a wee bit too small.

I ordered my usual size 8.5. They hurt my toes very terribly. I thought the shoes might stretch eventually but it never happened. I have had the shoes for 3 months now and my toes still hurt like hell when I wear these shoes. I have to get rid of them. Bottom Line Would Not Recommend

The quality of these shoes is horrible. For YEARS I only wore these shoes. Every. Day. These shoes were great for my lower back issues, and my torn meniscus. Wearing these shoes helped me STOP needing cortisone shots every 3 months. They WERE great support for very long days and nights on my feet. In the past I would replace them every year to keep that firm, strong support. Once I ordered new ones, I would wash them and give them to a local charity. In 2021, I felt something had drastically changed. I had to try a different size than what I d worn for years. I noticed the material was breaking down faster AND seemed like they were not stable enough for climbing or providing firm support. The overall quality was gone. But. I continued to buy the shoes. Then my knees started hurting REALLY bad. I felt like my feet were sloshing around as if they were too big. I noticed the structure of the shoes was breaking down easily. My ankles began to hurt and swell. Then my knees started hurting more and more. Then my back started hurting again. It has been YEARS without any issues. I suspected the shoes. At the nudging of my Ortho doc who had commented that he personally was noticing issues as well with his Merrells I stopped wearing them and went into a different well known shoe. Within DAYS all my pain STOPPED. But I love my Merrells.. so I went back and ordered a smaller size. Within about 2 weeks my ankles started hurting, my knees were swelling and hurting, and then my lower back started hurting. Took the shoes OFF and within days pain went away. Put the shoes on.. pain came back. So did the visits back to the doc to get cortisone shots. I will never buy myself another pair. My first pair lasted me 2 years and still looked great! I realized I was replacing these shoes every 6 months and the truth was they were causing me issues within a few weeks. The size is NOT consistent they don t last they don t hold up and they have ZERO support. Save your time, money, and body.. go with another brand. I got my last pair in JULY 2022.. and they already need to be replaced or thrown out . I won t even give them to the charity.

Summary these are amazing shoes if you don't get sent a crappy knock off! But I have to review what amazon sent me. I was shocked at how this shoe felt completely different! I have a narrow foot with high arches and these shows didn't feel like they had any support where my other boots are amazing . It felt like the back of the shoe was dropped lower then the front so that I was sinking backwards. And my foot slid around to the point of walking out of the shoes. Why do these, the Vent, look exactly like the waterproof ones, but are 50 cheaper? I did the market research. Comparing these Merrell Women's Moab 2 Vent Hiking Shoe Smoke to the Merrell Women's Moab 2 Waterproof hiking shoe Drizzle Mint I use these A LOT. I bought the waterproof ones and loved them, wore them out. In May 2022, I bought these cheaper ones, the Vent, to see how they compared to the more expensive waterproof ones. Same size, 8.5W. In August 2022, I saw the waterproof ones for 93, so I bought a new pair. SPOILER BECAUSE I PREFER THE WATERPROOF ONES. 1. Out of the box, I wanted to, but I didn't like these, the Vent, as much. The shoe is longer and the toebox was very roomy. They felt too big, but still comfortable, even brand new. Almost returned them, but started wearing them instead. I wear them now, and I really like them. I wear it like a roomy shoe, slip on and off. 2. Somehow, the Vent's sole support is just different. Maybe it's mental, but the more expensive waterproof ones felt more expensive. 3. Over time 3 months, daily use , even though the Vent felt too big at first, they started to mold more and almost seem to shrink to my foot. I noticed that the waterproof ones also do this. 4. Visually, I cannot see the difference between these two shoes, but the Vents were bigger and seemed a little less supportive. I shellacked my non-waterproof Vents from every angle with waterproofing spray from a can. In tall wet grass, they seep at the seams anyway, but water beads off on the surfaces. Verdict damp sock. Personally, the waterproof ones have been waterproof for me, despite what many reviewers have said. I've stepped in the creek not fully submerged with the waterproof ones and had dry sock. Advice if you don't have the extra 50, don't sweat it, order the Vents, but personally I would have ordered them a half size down. Overall though, despite the higher price, I do like the waterproof ones better.
