Warning!!! They literally tore the skin off my feet in multiple areas. I m retiring then for a larger size in hopes that would solve the problem. There s a mesh lining on the underside of the strap that just eats away at your skin. I ve never experienced such discomfort and bleeding from any footwear.
I bought them for the arch support they have. Was not disappointed. They are very comfortable as around the house and yard shoes. Thich and padded soles.
Super comfortable, there's I've never tried any other ones this comfortable. The only I would say is that if you have wide feet you might want to consider ordering a full size up.

I've got flat feed and plantar fasciitis, so my days of walking around my home in bare feet are now 100 over unfortunately. I need to have footwear on that supports my arches at all times now, but wearing shoes or sneakers at all times and indoors gets old quickly, and in some cases where I am asked to remove my shoes indoors, I have to have something on to support my feet. It took awhile to get used to never going bare foot, but these slides helped me with that issue tremendously. These are very "cushy" feeling, but are made of a strong enough material to support my weight and my collapsed arches and keep my feet from hurting. I bought two pairs and keep one for exclusive inside wear, and one pair I wear outdoors. The top strap is very soft feeling inside of it and it does not irritate the top of my feet like other slides have in the past. The top strap and length of the slide fit my size 14 feet very well. Be advised Not all Adidas slides are built the same... you need to make sure you're buying the "Adilette Comfort Slide" to get the supportive comfy ones. I mistakenly bought the ones labeled "shower slides" and they are a completely different product... much more rigid, and not comfy at all. Looking further, Adidas sells a whole range of slides, so make sure you get the ones labeled "comfort". Very happy with this purchase, they will serve me well, especially in the summer.
Very soft cushion under your feet! Had a pair for the longest time, lost one and bought another pair. Lost those and had to buy yet ANOTHER pair!

1. SIZING Ok, based on previous reviews, I was SUPER CONFUSED on what size I should purchase. My husband wears a size 8.5 and many reviews were conflicting, some saying to size up to a 9 and others saying to size down to an 8. Well, after literally reading every single review, I decided to size down and I was left disapointed when they arrived. IF YOU ARE A HALF SIZE, I RECOMMEND SIZING UP. As you can see in my attached picture, they barely fit. Because these are a "slipper" type of shoe to be worn mostly around the house, a hair too big would have been the better choice. My husband has to stick his foot ALL the way in as much and as tight as he can, so his heel isn't sticking out the end. 2. FIT Some reviewers were complaing about the front flopping or getting stuck, which is another reason I almost skipped this purchase. This has not happened to him at all. Initially, I thought maybe it was because we sized down, but that can't be the case because when I borrow them, they are definately too big for me, and it doesnt happen to me either. 3. COMFORT These are the most comfortable pair of slides I have ever encountered. After his current pair ripped, I decided to switch my husband to Adidas because we are now an anti-Nike home but that's another story and I could not believe the difference in comfort. Excuse the bad analogy, but the only way I can think to describe it, is like you're walking on marshmallows. Literally. They even have like a ball in the middle of the shoe for your foot arch, and it adds to the comfort in a unique way that you can't really explain. 4. STYLE I thought the black on black looked a little tacky and cheap, but I knew my husband preferred solid basic colors. These were an xmas gift So I went with it anyways, and when they arrived I was pleasantly suprised. They look way more sophisticated and good quality than they appear to be through a computer screen. If my husband needs to run a quick errand, he pairs them with a pair of black socks and he gets away with it easily. 5. OVERALL If you're buying these for only one person in the household, be prepared to guard them. Honestly, anytime we need to run outside, my kids and I all go straight for his slides and he is constantly having to ask us to "please take off his slides" lol. I have asked for a pair for my birthday, and my kids have both asked for some as well. Which I checked and verified they do come in womens and kids My son's exact words were, "How come my slides are all hard, but dads are so soft? I want some like dads. " Trust me, you will not regret this purchase!

OMG, best product ever. I still where them on a daily basis. Oh, can walk miles before my feet hurt. Way more comfortable than any of my other shoes. Foam fitting, there's no one can compare to it. Today they still look and feel brand new after a year of every day use. I'd give ten stars if I could.

Super comfy, and just enough support for my weak arches....I went to multiple stores looking for a pair of slides that were cushy and still offered some support....for some reason most slides today have hard flat insoles with no arch support at all....sure glad I found these! Next best thing to going barefoot better actually Love the black cammo too! I wear a 9 1 2 shoe, and got the size 9 and they fit me great!
These shoes are incredibly comfortable. Feels like I'm walking on clouds, yet they are very supportive. I will definitely purchase these again and they come highly recommended.
The support arch is a little farther foward then i like but after 2 days breaking them in they are pretty comfy.

The footbed is very cushy. Much different from the regular Adilette slides. My only complaint is the bigger size compared to my other regular Adilettes. I buy a size 11 as my usual habit but these turned out longer. Adidas should be more consistent, considering this range has been produced for quite a few years now.
My first addidas slippers. It's nice and soft. Arch support is good. Better than similar nike slippers. Recommended

Order these for my husband who is extremely flat-footed. He said they were super comfortable and gave him very good support. He is a little bit of a wider foot but they still fit perfectly. So far they are working out great.
They are super comfortable, but lack arch support. This is my 3rd pair. Only real complaint is they don't last long before they start falling apart.

These sandals are very soft, and the most cushioning I have found so far for my feet, even compared to tennis shoes. I wear them in my house, when I go fishing on my boat, and try to get away with wearing them out and about my wife thinks they are too casual for going to the store in . I was having heel pain and started looking for shoes with the softest soles, and came across these sandals at DSW. I haven't had any heel pain since, so I purchased this second pair on Amazon as a backup pair. I have been kneeling down on them a lot and I am surprised they have not ripped, strong so far. These are the "cloudfloam" sole. They are permeable, not the "shower" sandal model which have a harder sole and coated with a harder finish to prevent water absorption. I like these the best because they are the softest Adilette model. They are perfect for around the house and standing and fishing on a boat all day long. I have somewhat normal feet on the flatter side, no large arches, and they fit me perfectly. Thankfully these don't have the exaggerated arch support that the traditional Adidas slip on sandals have.

My husband Age 37 has neuropathy so walking bare foot or with bad shoes can really hurt. He wears these around the house when he s home and wishes he could wear them at work too. They are super comfortable!

representative_reviews.text: Other reviews informed me this sandal runs small. No problem, I ordered a size larger. They still didn't fit. My foot couldn't go all the way in. Since the strap isn't adjustable who's bright idea was that? they were useless. EPILOGUE I bought a comfy pair of sandals made by Under Armor - size 12 - and they are a little big AND have an adjustable strap. Under Armor is my new go-to sandal now.

They looked nice, but the strap across the top of the foot really dug into my foot, it had a really coarse sharp edge. Unwearable, so I had to return them. They did look cool though. It might ve just been my foot, but I think I have pretty normal size shaped feet.

I bought a size 9 for my 4 year old, following the size guide for 6.5 foot length. The sandals that arrived are a men s size 9, not a child s. They are way too big for my daughter and myself and too small for my husband. Will return them for something that fits correctly. They feel nice and comfortable though, like marshmallows.

Simple design which is odd for Adidas sandals flip flops slides usually pretty stylish. Width Length also short changed. Needed a new pair as my Teva Slides were totally worn down so, decided to save me the trouble of returning. Might just give them away.

Terrible sizing. These slides will fit you if you have flat feet... any other type of feet and you ll have to squeeze your foot into the sandal and it ll choke your foot every step of the way. Terrible. You ll have to buy 2 sizes up ... unless I got a defective pair which I highly doubt
I m so disappointed! These are way too small! I ordered my husbands regular size 12 and he couldn t even fit his foot into the slide. Returning asap
The strap across the sandals digs in to the top of your toes really bad. Had to return them after trying in both a size 11 and then a 10.

Given all the positive reviews, I expected this to be pretty good. Fits a little narrower than most, but it's stretchy if you have a wider foot. Inexplicably, it is irritating both flops on the tops of my feet. Has the feeling you sometimes get when a T-Shirt label rubs the back of your neck. After a couple of weeks, I passed them on to my son.

I've bought nearly identical looking Adidas sandals for years. This one is so far below the quality of any other I've bought that I really have to wonder. The band is not adjustable. It's hard and has sharp bits that poke my feet. The sole is thin and hard, again unlike any Adidas sandal I've ever bought. Very, very poor quality, and since it was shipped from Europe, not returnable. Unless you really want something similar to a knockoff you could buy at a discount shoe outlet, don't spend your money on this.

unfortunately i have wide feet so they didnt work for me. if you have normal feet, i would recommend

If you have wide feet or even a human size instep these will not fit!!!!

I have bad ankles, knees, and back and I had a pair of these and they were magical for wearing around the house. I couldn't recommend them higher. I go to replace my worn out pair, and come to find out, they reduced the width of the slides by almost a centimeter! Please someone let me know how I can get these in wide again! Only buy if you have very narrow feet.

Ordered these for my grandson. They were a little big. But he said it didn't matter. He wore them on all summer.

Overall, super comfy.! WARNING! For anyone buying these I wear size 11 for most shoes, Nike, adidas, vans, and work boots. I ordered size 11 and they are a bit loose even with socks on. I have a pair of Nike slip ons and they are size 11 with a fit that is much more snug. I would advise going down half a size. My foot measures at 10 7 16 length and 4 1 8 width. The slip on measures 12in length toe to heal and 4 3 8 width these were measured from the highest points . The Sandle strap arch insert is 2 1 4 high where ur foot goes in and 1 1 4 where your toes come out. Keeping in mind the arch strap is made from a flexible elastic type rubber or plastic very comfortable . Overall it is still nice and I don't really mind the fit, it's just not as snug as my other Slip ons. Some may want a more loose fit which then I would recommend going with your normal shoe size. Hope this helps.

This is a simple stylish and comfortable Slide that is perfectly sized on length but runs a slightly half size large on the height vertical thickness of the strap part if you are looking for a secure fit. Its fairly secure right now even if it's a bit large but it's to be seen if it stretches out over time. That said since the length is perfect I'm not sure I could go a size down for the tighter strap fit as my toes heel might hang out. That all said this slide is 5 stars and exactly what I was hopping for! It's great for relaxing at home a quick trip to the store, taking out the trash or a trip to the beach. The footbed is very supportive with a perfectly squishy foam to hug your foot.

Arrived on time and exactly as advertised. After reading maybe a few dozen reviews on various sites I went with my true measured foot size -11. As a man with not wide feet, I wear sizes 11 to 11 1 2 in most Nike and Adidas shoes slippers and the size 11 worked perfectly for me. It is 'True to Size' fit for some breathing room and super comfy. Weird synthetic smell out of the box that disappeared quickly. Get yourself a pair!

Straight out of the box- these are the most comfortable slides I ve ever worn. Very glad I read the reviews about size. I normally wear an 8.5 but ordered a 7 and I m glad that I did. They fit my feet perfectly! Enjoy!

Bought them as house shoes -- my husband was developing a very painful corn on his one foot and we have hardwood floors. He said these have saved his feet, and he's not usually that emphatic about anything. So I'm buying a pair for myself!

Product was very soft sole shoe little bit larger than Nikes but a lot more comfortable for constructive criticism I would take out the part in between the big toe people who wear slides don't tend to like things between their toes

Very comfortable pair of slippers. I also know them under the name of Adiletten from a friend. They fit as expected with the exception of the strap. I wear a size 9 9.5 shoe, but had to order these in an 8 for fit. Otherwise, they are great indoors and out.

I immediately fell in love with these sandals the first-time I wore it. Perfect size as well for a male US size 9. I was recently diagnosed with plantar fascitis and these sandals instantly alleviated the pain.

I ordered my 11 year old son these slides in size 5. He wears a size 4 in youth size but I wanted it to last more than just the summer and these are perfect. They fit well and have an inch to grow. He wears them to from baseball which is nice. He says they are super comfortable. I wear a woman's size 7 and my feet fit snug in them. If I was to get a pair for myself, I'd get the size 6 . I meant to take photos of them brand new but forgot, but u get the idea! These are awesome!!

The strap placement near the toes is were your foot bends so it hurts. One shoe had a hard part too that rubbed on the inside of the strap.

I'm keeping the old ones, still in great shape as "back ups" but currently enjoying the fit and comfort of this new pair. I couldn't recommend them more highly.

Very comfy for the foot and yet provides support and the rubber type helps makes it quiet walking around the house for downstairs neighbors too . quality will last years like anything that comes from Adidas. Had these for a while now. Im 270 and still work great not flat smashed and i wear every day at the house.

Bought them as house shoes -- my husband was developing a very painful corn on his one foot and we have hardwood floors. He said these have saved his feet, and he's not usually that emphatic about anything. So I'm buying a pair for myself!

My problem with the Adidas Slides is that not all of them are constructed the same. Some have stitching, some dont. I took this pair to a local shoe shop to add stitches... these areas were originally glued only. My wife's pair was stitched together though. The picture is where I added stitches and extra glue.

I've got flat feed and plantar fasciitis, so my days of walking around my home in bare feet are now 100 over unfortunately. I need to have footwear on that supports my arches at all times now, but wearing shoes or sneakers at all times and indoors gets old quickly, and in some cases where I am asked to remove my shoes indoors, I have to have something on to support my feet. It took awhile to get used to never going bare foot, but these slides helped me with that issue tremendously. These are very "cushy" feeling, but are made of a strong enough material to support my weight and my collapsed arches and keep my feet from hurting. I bought two pairs and keep one for exclusive inside wear, and one pair I wear outdoors. The top strap is very soft feeling inside of it and it does not irritate the top of my feet like other slides have in the past. The top strap and length of the slide fit my size 14 feet very well. Be advised Not all Adidas slides are built the same... you need to make sure you're buying the "Adilette Comfort Slide" to get the supportive comfy ones. I mistakenly bought the ones labeled "shower slides" and they are a completely different product... much more rigid, and not comfy at all. Looking further, Adidas sells a whole range of slides, so make sure you get the ones labeled "comfort". Very happy with this purchase, they will serve me well, especially in the summer.

I've been wearing a version of these since 1978. This is the best one yet. The original was good with a firm sole. The massage one with the bed o' rubber nails was not so good. The velcro top Superstar, meh. This and the cloudfoam are definitely the best.
Great fit and super squishy. Look even better than the picture. Comfy adjustsble straps and great self molding soles.

OMG, best product ever. I still where them on a daily basis. Oh, can walk miles before my feet hurt. Way more comfortable than any of my other shoes. Foam fitting, there's no one can compare to it. Today they still look and feel brand new after a year of every day use. I'd give ten stars if I could.

representative_reviews.text: I have never had a problem with foot pain caused by a shoe before. As soon as I stopped wearing them, my foot got better. Couple weeks later tried wearing and foot stated hurting again! Weird. They felt fine fit wise. Too bad as I cannot return now
All these straps were very tight. The strap that goes around the ankle does not stretch and would cause a blister if I attempted to wear.
The Rose Keen sandals have been my go to for years. I am disappointed Keen has put out such a poor product. My feet ached in them.
generally the feel of the shoe is not comfortable, but this may be what one gets for this price? I would return it but I have passed the return date

These sandals have no arch support. I sent them back because I did not feel they would give the support I needed to wear them hiking or as an all day pair of shoes. I wore them around the house for an hour and they hurt my feet. Very cute and lightweight. I was very disappointed as they claim to be very comfortable.

I was so disappointed in these sandals. I had previously written them off... as I didn t like the look of the sandal... until I tried a pair on in store and loved the wide toe box and lower arch support. I have flatter feet and a neuroma in my left foot so those are my two criteria for comfortable footwear. When I received these, I immediately noticed that I wasn t able to wiggle my toes like I had in the shoes at the store. Secondly, I noticed that they were rubbing on my left foot at the top of my second toe. I had no issues with that on the other foot. This is all from just trying them on and walking from one side of my house the other After I started really inspecting the shoes I noticed that the two are different. The straps meet the shoe at different places and that s what is causing the rubbing one one foot and not another. I would have never have expected anything like this from Keen. I have bought my husband a new pair of Keens sandals every two years for a decade plus and he LOVES them. I also own the Lana style of sandal and have no issues. If you have Morton s Neuroma and are looking for a sandal, I would say try them on in store and buy that pair if they work for you. They will not work for anyone looking for arch support. There is none, but that may work for you if have low arches.

These are not good shoes for hiking. The front of your foot slips all over, causing blisters. When they get wet the front little straps stretch and don't hold your toes. Also my toes are blue from the dye running even after a few times getting wet. They are cute looking. But not for any kind of walking more then a city block!

First off the strap around angle is not adjustable. So too tight and hurt. Standing for long periods caused extreme pain on balls of feet and one thing I never experienced in footwear. So not good support. Maybe bc synthetic not leather they did not give and my feet were very swollen. Actually worse shoes for my particular feet ever! Threw out my back and knees took a couple days to recuperate. Keen just not for me! I don t think the next size would have been any better. I wear a 7.5 and these were 8s. Obviously I returned but not after giving them many hours of trial.
The item is tight to pull up back sling, it's not a orthopedic shoe. The material is cheap china style. Should only sell there.

I purchased these shoes to use when we went to Disney World. Wore them to Hollywood Studios this past week . The temperatures were over 90 degrees. By the end of the day,my feet were very sore. Was starting to develop blisters on the bottoms and sides of my feet from the rubber soles. Certainly did not meet my expectations. Very Disappointed!!
I have wider feet, it was too narrow for me. I dislike the fact that you couldn't adjust the back strap as it was all one piece. Cute shoes too bad, my friend however loves hers.

This almost aches me to write a review like this. I m a hard core keen fan and usually gets the Clearwater cnx which I have taken to many countries and rugged vacays and has served me well. So when it was time to get a new pair, I thought of getting this Rose one which is a little more on the feminine side which will allow me to wear with skirts and dresses on vacays, so I thought. I gave it a trial run in the house and wore it for a few hours a couple of days ago. By night I developed a weird pain in my ankle where the ankle strap sits. I put the sandal away and the pain vanished. Today I tried again and wore it for a couple of hours and at the point where the strap sits, the same weird pain started. I tried to make the strap loose then I feel like I am carrying the sandal as it is not snug anymore. But having said that, the arch support and overall cushioning is much better than my Clearwater could be that my Clearwater workhorse is old and been using it for a good 4 years old and I wear almost 15 days a month! I want to love this sandal so bad and I feel it will be the girliest that it can ever get in this type of all purpose sandals with good arch support. Maybe it s just the shape of my feet, But since I ll be walking a lot in this, unfortunately I ll be returning them and just get my trusty Clearwater cnx version of the same keens.
Did not like the smell. Couldn't wait to put them back in the box after I tried them on. Rinsed my feet off.
My feet ache at the end of the day. I have other sandals that are way more comfortable and half the price. I won't buy Keen again.

I really liked the shape of the sandals, it looked more feminine and thought it would be comfortable. However, the foot needs to go through a rather tight strap that is very tight and you are not able to adjust it to feel comfortable. I initially got the 7 1 2, but felt it was tight. So I returned it for a size 8 - but again the same problem existed. Keen needs to get rid of that ankle holder and replace it with adjustable straps on the top and for the securing behind the ankle area. That makes more sense and any person can adjust it to their foot, so it is comfortable. As it stands now - your feet will become increasingly swollen as you walk with it. Sorry, I really wanted to love this sandal but I have to return it, a second time for good. Requesting a refund.

I had a month long trip to Valdemarsvik, Sweden I'd had been preparing for and I needed to pack light. I wanted a good pair of shoes that would be comfortable, not make my feet hurt after hours of walking hiking, be able to swim in the rocky fjord and protect my toes, but also look good when I dressed up for a nice dinner or classy occasion. These shoes were perfect. I have really high arches so these might be the best sandal type shoes that I've found for arch support. I got the black and they look great in everything! They even look good with socks. They have great grip on the bottom of the shoe for dry land and also for swimming around like an otter near rocky shores with slippery seaweed. Also, this shoe cradles your foot so your toes, or foot, never slip out like they sometimes do with swimming with other classic strappy sandals. My foot breathes and my toes are very well protected. I'm normally a US size 7.5 and sometimes an 8 when products run small. I tried both sizes and the 7.5 was just a tad too small, so I went with an 8 and they fit perfectly. I will keep these shoes with me, or keep buying them until the day I die. 10 10 worth every penny.
Super comfortable! Good for long walks, hiking or just plain strolling in parks or amusement centers.

I am rating this sandal 4 5 stars as it is a nice sandal and should fit most women. However, I have a wide foot with a high instep and these shoes were just a tad too tight due to the non-adjustable ankle strap. I read about this potential con before purchasing but because they looked so nice, I still wanted to try them on to see if they would work for me. They technically fit on my foot without trouble the strap was just a tad but too tight for my comfort level. The strap would have probably loosened up had I had worn them around for a little while, but at 80, this wasn't a risk I was willing to take. I also ordered a pair of Keen Bali Strap sandals at the same time and those fit better with the adjustable ankle strap. Unfortunately, because of a product defect, I have to return those too. Note I've included a comparison of the Bali vs Rose sandal below since I wished I could have found a detailed comparison review for the two before purchase. Overall, these sandals are cute and functional hard combo to find! . The sole is supportive and the sandal would be extremely comfortable if it weren't for the non-adjustable ankle strap. Again, I think this wouldn't be a problem for the vast majority of women. My feet are very wide, very high instep as a loving family member once told me...I have 34 man feet 34 and they almost fit me, so they should fit most women just fine. KEEN Bali Strap vs Rose Comparison -Rose has non-adjustable ankle strap Bali has two adjustable straps at the ankle area. -Rose straps are made of softer material against the skin. It feels velvety as opposed to the typical cloth material of Keen Sandals. Both are comfortable but if the Rose straps fit me better, I would prefer their material. -Rose feels more secure because the toe straps go up higher on the foot. -Rose has a more cushioned sole. Bali Strap has a more contoured sole. In my opinion the sole of Rose would be better for long distance walking on relatively flat surfaces. Bali Strap sole would be better for climbing, or walking in rocky unstable areas as the contoured sole gives the foot a better 34 feel 34 for the ground under the shoe. -Bali Strap has an awkward opening near the small toe which can allow the small toe to 34 escape 34 especially if there is a manufacturing defect making the opening larger than it should be see my Bali Strap review . The straps on the Rose are closer together, which effectively keeps those rouge little toes contained. If both sandals had fit me, I would have definitely preferred the Rose. However, the Bali Strap is the better option for my feet.
These are so comfortable. I wore my last pair of Keens for about 10 years, so it feels great to be in a new pair with good sole support.
I love that my arches and my heels are well supported when I m wearing them. I brought them to Disney World, and easily walked 20,000 steps each day without any discomfort.

I developed a case of plantar fasciitis this summer, and needed more support in a sandal. This sandal is very comfortable, and it looks good with casual sundresses too. The fit is perfect, and this color is versatile. Sturdy for biking and walking.

Have owned keen hikers for years and love them, was nervous about sandals because it looked like less thick sole and arch support. I love these! I mainly wear to work but they re great everywhere. If I m going on longer hike I prefer my hikers, but these are still good for shorter hikes

Most comfortable lightweight fun and functional closed toe summer sandal I have ever worn. Walked 9 miles per day on a recent trip and my feet felt supported and were pain free. Very durable and high quality materials and construction.
Went on vacation and wore these shoes every day, walking to many places and the shoes were comfortable, and had traction when needed in wet environments.

I have been shopping for Keen, Teva or any kind of sandal that I can just slip on, has a natural arch, a closed toe and can fit with my orthotic brace on my right foot. I have shopped at REI, Famous Footwear, Nordstroms, Zappos, etc. and have not found anything until I got a hit with those parameters on Amazon. I teach PE and live in California, so I needed something I could walk and be cool in. They are attractive, comfortable, orthotic, and have enough sole to absorb cement but flexible soft enough to provide comfort. I am very picky, rarely write reviews but got this request in my email, so I had to chime in . Good luck.

I had my knee replaced 3 months ago and wanted to go on a week long hiking trip with my students in 8th grade, I bought these to hike through the forest every day and they were great! Comfortable from the moment I put them on.
I have never written a review, but I ve never bought a shoe so comfortable right out of the box. Thank you!!
Absolutely LOVE these! So comfortable. I have hiked some rocky terrain in these as well as just an easy afternoon stroll.
These have to be the most comfortable sandals! They have just enough arch support and cushion. Easy to hike in and ok to get them wet for stream crossings. Love them!!
I am in love with this shoe! It s super comfortable, fits true to size and is made very well. I enjoy water trails when hiking and this does well over rocks. highly recommend.

It barley covers my big toe and doesn t cover the others. I worry about my toe nail catching on it. The toe cover is like a stretchy piece of fabric in the shoe.
I love Keen shoes but these sandal's are to narrow and a bit short. I always order a size nine and these are a small 9.

It is extremely difficult to get anything but a very very narrow foot into the shoe. It has an exceptionally limited space between the heel and the first strap and it doesn't open up fully. This is the second time I've tried ordering this in both times even moving up to sizes my daughters foot could never fit into that space and she doesn't have an exceptionally high arch. This issue simply does not keep up with any of the standard shoes that should be sold by this company or on this site.
I bought these Rose sandals for a wide toe box I had in my old sandals. I even purchased a half size bigger. These sandals are more narrow and did not fit

I used to love Keen brand shoes and have owned many pair over the years. These sandals do NOT fit! I cannot even get my foot all the way in them and they are the same size I always wear. I tried to find a way to return them and have come up with nothing - cannot return to Amazon, Keen calls simply go to recordings . . . . I am so disappointed!

I have bought many pairs of keen shoes. I bought these for a boat vacation. I have a long foot, but not wide size 11 . These shoes are tight over the top of my foot, especially on the left where I have a small bunion. Im very dissapointed in this style.

Size 7 bought in color gargoyle. No arch support in these. Tight at the instep. In just minutes my upper foot felt strangled. The toe box is lined with neoprene that caught on my toe. What a bizarre design, where taking a step moves the little toe over the lining. I am not sure these were tested on people. Note each color fits different. Returning.
The strap across the top of my foot was too tight even if I loosened the velcro. Had to return. Well made shoe and comfortable except for that issue. I have a small skinny foot and ankle.

I have never had a problem with foot pain caused by a shoe before. As soon as I stopped wearing them, my foot got better. Couple weeks later tried wearing and foot stated hurting again! Weird. They felt fine fit wise. Too bad as I cannot return now

Inconsistent sizing. I had bought these same exact pairs Keen Rose last summer in magnet gargoyle from REI, size 8.5 which fit perfectly out of the box. I wore them all summer hiking, bouldering, rivers streams, etc. They worked out great. Easy to slide on off. Roomy in the toe. Unfortunately, with a lot of life in them at the start of this summer, we took them to the beach and lost one pair. Not liking the current season s colors at REI, I found my original color off Amazon and I bought them immediately in the same exact size. The size felt very small especially at the toe and as other reviews have said around the ankle strap. I wore them for a few minutes around the house hoping it would stretch comfortably but I could see my poor feet swelling from lack of circulation. I sent them back and got next size up of 9. The sandal seemed well-built but seemed different from REI. The look and feel seemed a little off and of course the size. Maybe REI for theirs from a different Keen factory? I ll send an update once I get the bigger size but it seemed like a whole different shoe maker made the size 8.5 shoe from Amazon compared to the one I bought from REI last summer.

These are not adjustable. The ankle strap makes it extremely uncomfortable since it s just for appearances and not actually adjustable. Getting a bigger size wouldn t help considering my toes were already loose. There isn t enough any arch support either. I ll have to return these.

Really cute feminine sandal. However, the toe box opening is not sufficient for anyone with a thicker foot. I normally take woman's 7M. I ordered a 7.5 to make sure I had a little extra room for my toes. Toe box is wide enough, but just not deep enough. Couldn't get it on as my feet were slightly swollen. Reordered a size 8 in two different colors.....neither one fit any easier. Had to return all three pairs. Also, the permanent non-adjustable strap ends up making them hard to get on. I think they need to be redesigned or start making them in a Wide width for those of us that don't have skinny feet. I really love the style.

The sizing on these Keens is really off.... I have many pairs of Keens in different styles, all of them size 8. I tried size 8 and 8.5 with these, and both of them were too tight around the ankle not adjustable to bigger and also around the top of the foot and toes, very tight again not adjustable . These shoes are not meant for people with ANY flesh on the top of their foot and ankle. I am pretty small boned and not really fleshy in that area, so it is weird they would be so tight.
These are beautiful, but as someone who consistently wears a 9 medium, these are exceptionally tight across the ball of the foot. Length is fine. Color is beautiful.
I have ordered this sandal in this color before and they have fit perfectly. The sizing on this pair was way off and much too small

A little disappointed when these arrived and I practically had to grease my foot up to get it to fit. Felt like Cinderella's step-sister trying to wedge in my foot. The shoe was long enough, just REALLY TIGHT. I've worn them quite a bit and they have stretched out some, but they are still a bit uncomfortablely tight. LOVE Keen's quality and roomy toe box. Worth keeping. Hopefully, I will have them stretched out before summer hits.
This sandals fit perfectly my feet are size 11 so normally the shoes are to wide these are a normal width. With a good solid sole and just enough arch support. I highly recommend
1st time a keen shoe fit my narrow foot. Very comfortable and great toe coverage. I bought a 2nd pair.
Room in the toebox, straps fit well. The ankle strap is pretty short so if you have thicker ankles I can see this digging in. Not too heavy and good grip for light hikes.

I was super excited for these to be my summer shoe, they are super cute and match everything. Unfortunately, they don t fit. I am average size 5 8, 150 lbs. so my feet aren t fat, and they still don t fit. These shoes are made for people with narrow feet. You can tell the second you take them out of the box. I have to return them.
Very comfortable, perfect fit. Saw shoe on bus passenger and asked for brand name. Keen ordered shoe online.
Wears well and fit is good. Can be hot but bare foot does not slip around in shoe. Keeps toes protected from rocks and trash.
Using Correct Toes inside these sandals makes them into a five-finger style shoe without being obvious.

My mother lives in Florida. She wanted a pair of shoes that covered her toes, had a strap in the back, and let the air in. When she saw me wearing a pair of these, she told me that they were exactly what she had been looking for for a long time. I ordered a pair for her right away and gave them to her for Mother's Day. She loves them! She put them on right away. She said they were a perfect fit and wore them to the restaurant we were taking her to that day.

I ordered these closed toe sandals for an upcoming trip to Egypt. I have a small foot and it is hard to find good does that fit. These came sooner than expected and the fit is perfect. In addition to feeling great they are also cute on! That can be unusual for good walking shoes. These are my new favorite walking shoes. Thank you Keen.

Size perfect half size bigger than I usually wear , comfort is excellent, and style is a bit dressier than more utilitarian sandals. Toe-in sandals is what I wanted and these are even better than I thought they would be. I love these shoes!

I found my size on these Keens a few years ago and now just come back for more. I have a wide foot and by going up one European size, the shoes fit perfectly. I love that they are airy but toes are covered and I love the thick protection on the toes. Exposed toes in summer can lead to someone stepping on you in a subway or bus or crowded area after all. So these are cute, airy yet supportive.
This is my fourth pair of keen rose sandals. I love the the wide toe box and toe protection. I walk everywhere in these sandals. I have 4 different colors.

I was excited when I received these as I have them in black and this color matched one of my favorite summer outfits. Unfortunately this pair fell apart on my 3rd time wearing them. I m very disappointed. The insole came unglued and flaps from the outsole.

These are falling apart. They are worn by my daughter who has been in a wheel chair for the last 5 months. She has not been hard on them. I would like a replacement. I thought Keen had a better quality than this.
I really wish you would bring back the rose strapless slide sandal. These are too much work and too tight.

I have always worn a size 9.5 in these and my last pair lasted three years. But something is wrong with the pair I received today. They are way too tight and the straps are too small. The right shoe ankle strap is much shorter than the left one and it doesn't close properly at all. The left toe also has a dent in it. Oh and the package itself arrived two days after the Prime "guaranteed delivery date". So I'm not too happy about it at all. I have requested a replacement and I will edit this review when the new ones arrive.
The strap across the top of my foot was too tight even if I loosened the velcro. Had to return. Well made shoe and comfortable except for that issue. I have a small skinny foot and ankle.
The Rose Keen sandals have been my go to for years. I am disappointed Keen has put out such a poor product. My feet ached in them.
The quality has changed. I bought a pair in 2018 and they are sturdy and you can walk all day. Returned these. Very narrow and lighter thinner straps.

I really wanted to love these shoes. Everything about them was exactly what I was looking for in, comfort, style and functionality! Unfortunately it seems there is a recurring manufacturing flaw in the right shoe on the strap that is along side the pinkie toe. The first pair I ordered had not only a gap double the width of the left shoe, it was also bulging up so to speak. Amazon did send me a replacement which didn't have that strap bulging but the gap was still double the width and my toe basically pokes out which is an accident waiting to happen. I ordered these 4 times hoping I would get a pair that wasn't defective and unfortunately the quality was lacking in every pair. For the price point I can't justify settling for such a huge flaw

I love Keen shoes. I have worn them for years. I have Never had an issue with quality control, until these sandals. The placement of the straps on the right shoe was not attached at the correct location. I could clearly see an indention in the footbed where the strap should have been located and it was not properly located. I do not know how this got past a quality check. I returned and reordered only to find the same problem with the second pair as well. My husband normally obvilous to such things even commented on the issue. This resulted in my toe protruding from the shoe. Sticking completely out of the shoe. A Really Uncomfortable and Ugly thing.

This issue simply does not keep up with any of the standard shoes that should be sold by this company or on this site.

I hope it will loosen after wearing for a while. the sandal is sturdy so doesn't need this tight strap. I have it adjusted to the loosest velcro. After some consideration I have returned these sandals for 80 refund... I have had a couple pairs of this style, but this latest 3rd pair has a big difference with the tight ankle strap. I can feel my foot throbbing under the strap. It just won't work especially in hot summers when my feet need space to move not be stuffed into tight sandals sweating! I also like to wear with socks traveling, impossible with the strap already so tight. I had to force my heel in with a lot of effort could imagine the strap rubbing the top of my foot irritating my bare skin walking. I hope this size change will be changed back, but do not expect it by any means. Really disappointed that a good quality nice looking sandal changed for the worse. Like so many things quality declines with price going up.

These look beautiful, and are very comfortable, EXCEPT there is one spot on the instep of the left sandal that nags at you, like it's angling to scrape away the skin on your foot. It hurts. It's a very slight irregularity where the inner and outer soles meet that transforms an awesome pair of shoes into a return. I want to try again to see if maybe it was that pair, but my experience with shoes is that problems like this are mass manufactured.

First off the strap around angle is not adjustable. So too tight and hurt. Standing for long periods caused extreme pain on balls of feet and one thing I never experienced in footwear. So not good support. Maybe bc synthetic not leather they did not give and my feet were very swollen. Actually worse shoes for my particular feet ever! Threw out my back and knees took a couple days to recuperate. Keen just not for me! I don t think the next size would have been any better. I wear a 7.5 and these were 8s. Obviously I returned but not after giving them many hours of trial.

I am rating this sandal 4 5 stars as it is a nice sandal and should fit most women. However, I have a wide foot with a high instep and these shoes were just a tad too tight due to the non-adjustable ankle strap. I read about this potential con before purchasing but because they looked so nice, I still wanted to try them on to see if they would work for me. They technically fit on my foot without trouble the strap was just a tad but too tight for my comfort level. The strap would have probably loosened up had I had worn them around for a little while, but at 80, this wasn't a risk I was willing to take. I also ordered a pair of Keen Bali Strap sandals at the same time and those fit better with the adjustable ankle strap. Unfortunately, because of a product defect, I have to return those too. Note I've included a comparison of the Bali vs Rose sandal below since I wished I could have found a detailed comparison review for the two before purchase. Overall, these sandals are cute and functional hard combo to find! . The sole is supportive and the sandal would be extremely comfortable if it weren't for the non-adjustable ankle strap. Again, I think this wouldn't be a problem for the vast majority of women. My feet are very wide, very high instep as a loving family member once told me...I have 34 man feet 34 and they almost fit me, so they should fit most women just fine. KEEN Bali Strap vs Rose Comparison -Rose has non-adjustable ankle strap Bali has two adjustable straps at the ankle area. -Rose straps are made of softer material against the skin. It feels velvety as opposed to the typical cloth material of Keen Sandals. Both are comfortable but if the Rose straps fit me better, I would prefer their material. -Rose feels more secure because the toe straps go up higher on the foot. -Rose has a more cushioned sole. Bali Strap has a more contoured sole. In my opinion the sole of Rose would be better for long distance walking on relatively flat surfaces. Bali Strap sole would be better for climbing, or walking in rocky unstable areas as the contoured sole gives the foot a better 34 feel 34 for the ground under the shoe. -Bali Strap has an awkward opening near the small toe which can allow the small toe to 34 escape 34 especially if there is a manufacturing defect making the opening larger than it should be see my Bali Strap review . The straps on the Rose are closer together, which effectively keeps those rouge little toes contained. If both sandals had fit me, I would have definitely preferred the Rose. However, the Bali Strap is the better option for my feet.
My second pair. First lasted 6 years. Could hike without socks with no problem. Dried quickly when wet
These are so comfortable. I wore my last pair of Keens for about 10 years, so it feels great to be in a new pair with good sole support.

I bought these to have a durable shoe with air flow. I love them and have gotten a few compliments as well. They've been hiking, shopping, traveling, and around for any other activity I have done for a month now. Buy the shoe

Wear 7.5M in shoes usually 7 in sandals Sketcher's Clarks for example but needed a 7.5 in these. I love the fit, the feel, the color fabric, the toe scuff guard, the comfortable foot bed. Was able to wear them out of the box without a break in period for hours at a time. The reason for the lack of 5 stars was the non-matching color of the ankle strap it's way darker - I'm looking for a ribbon to sew over it to fix this problem but, more importantly, the quality precision of the construction. The crisscross open spaces were markedly different from left to right foot there was a buckle in one of the straps in same area. Even ordered another pair to try to see if I could get 1 matching pair but could not as the 2nd had the same problems on the same feet as the 1st. Seems who ever sewed the left feet weren't checked against how the sewer of the right feet was doing them - which boils down to management quality control, which I attribute to overseas manufacture. The same shoe in Blue Bell was not as bad but the price was higher and the color light enough I felt it would get dirty too quickly. Amazon wound up giving me a good discount when I told them about this problem so I kept the 2 that were the least far apart. At a much reduced price it was easier to live with the inferior cosmetic quality. The the shoes ARE really comfortable I really wanted them. Fortunately, most people aren't looking that closely at my feet. At the full price of 75 - 90 which they were selling for at time of purchases it was unacceptable. Keen makes comfortable shoes but for their high prices, they need to up their game on quality, color matching.

Keen shoes are the best. That is why I ordered these with confidence. The footbed is typical keen style with total comfort, durability. Lasts for years. The top part was made out of very flimsy material. Even though the fit was perfect, I returned them for the much more durable Venice h2.

My mother lives in Florida. She wanted a pair of shoes that covered her toes, had a strap in the back, and let the air in. When she saw me wearing a pair of these, she told me that they were exactly what she had been looking for for a long time. I ordered a pair for her right away and gave them to her for Mother's Day. She loves them! She put them on right away. She said they were a perfect fit and wore them to the restaurant we were taking her to that day.

These shoes have 0 break in time. They have great support. I am Diabetic with neurophy, I particularly like how my toes are protected. The straps are supportive too. This is the 2nd time I've bought this style. Love them.

I have several pair of Keen Rose Sandals - was very pleased to be able to get a pair in a GREAT color at a very reasonable price. These things FIT, and they support feet far better than one would expect sandals to do. I have worn mine hiking in the TN mountains just.. not on truly primitive trails! where there were stream crossings and sections of rock fall. They served my old feet well - and came out looking almost like new. They can easily be washed, and hold up quite well. My first pair, black, has seen me through four summers of hiking, wading, and walking around town - and worn to work as well. Unless you turn them over to check sole wear, they look no different from my nearly-new black pair. I expect these gorgeous raspberry-looking sandals to hold up just as well.

GREAT VALUE! EASY transaction, TRUST this vendor! I love this model of Keen with its easy drying uppers, light weight, excellent support. Transitions well from rocking small boat, to wet landing on sand and slipperyn rock, to beach, then hiking over uneven rocks and steep trails. Kept a smaller size of this sandal, but this vendor offered excellent pricing, better than the shoe I ended up keeping. Return was easy, efficient, professional! A

My two pairs that I ve given hard use for 8 years was time to replace. I was so happy to see that Keen still had the same style and selling on Amazon. I ve had foot surgery with hardware in my foot. These are the best!!!
Great for people with leg or back pain. Toes are covered enough for when my students try to damage my feet, but airy enough to keep cool.

Bought two pairs in black Brindle Shitake of this shoe for a trip to Costa Rica. Wore them with socks on the plane. Wore them barefoot to the beach and into the water. Wore them on a hike through Manuel Antonio National Forest. Wore them every day and every evening. They were very comfortable and still look brand new. My Good Feet inserts easily fit into them. The only con is that they do take a long time to dry out, which is why I bought two pairs. If they hold up, this will be a regular purchase item for me.
Very comfortable soles for long days on your feet but band across top of foot is not adjustable and so is a bit too tight. Can t adjust it for end of day foot swelling.
I now own about 5 pair of Keen shoes. I love them, especially the Rose Sandal. They are very sturdy, and almost never wear out. The comfort is also great.

representative_reviews.text: I love Keen shoes. I have worn them for years. I have Never had an issue with quality control, until these sandals. The placement of the straps on the right shoe was not attached at the correct location. I could clearly see an indention in the footbed where the strap should have been located and it was not properly located. I do not know how this got past a quality check. I returned and reordered only to find the same problem with the second pair as well. My husband normally obvilous to such things even commented on the issue. This resulted in my toe protruding from the shoe. Sticking completely out of the shoe. A Really Uncomfortable and Ugly thing.

They are ugly-cute ! I wear them even with my nice clothing, and I am a fashionista. Love the green color which is more delicate than the black. Sometimes I prefer them to my oc tennis shoes. There is nothing more important than comfortable shoes. Have used them for an hour walk around the neighborhood. The advantage is that they have a thick sole and support the foot very well. When shoes with thin soles are too painful due to planter fasciitis, Keens cushion the foot . Wore them even in the Zone 3 winter. Will be my go-to casual shoes. Will buy them in colors especially blue and red. Waiting for glittery ones for dress up occasions.

Amazing!!! I wear these every day at work and they have not lost their shape or have faded in 6 months. I work in the water which is usually pretty harsh on my shoes, but not these ones. They fit perfectly and I'd buy again in a heartbeat!
Have this same Keen sandal 5 years old and knew they were faded. New pair is like walking on a cloud!
I purchased the same size as my original keen Newport s. Love these as they are not as bulky but still fit great as I have wide feet. As usual very comfortable.

I love how these sandals feel, and can walk and stand in them for a very long time. Everything is perfect- except they are not very attractive. The toe area could be less bulky. I d like to wear them everywhere but some places require a cute, smaller sandal and this is not it. It s a 5 star for comfort, but I gave it a 4 star for need of more feminine appearance.

I m a nurse in a hospital and work 12 hour shifts. My friend had talked to highly about these work crocs for nurses so I thought I would try them. Halfway through the day, my feet were hurting and my back was hurting. I was so busy that day running around I didn t have time to change into the backup shoes I brought. By the time I got home 14 hours later, my back hurt so bad I thought it would never recover. The next day I wore my regular shoes and I felt a little better. I have to say very disappointed in these shoes and I do not recommend for long nursing shifts. Now I can t return them because they have been worn, so off to the thrift store they go.
Very uncomfortable. Tight across arch and top of foot cutting off circulation. Feels like rubber pins on bottom and no arch support at all. Terrible. No ventilation either.

I had to take them off 10 minutes later because there were awful pains in my foot and shooting up my legs. I had to drive shoeless after scrambling desperately to remove them while behind the wheel. So dangerous but I had no choice it was clear something was very wrong. Also, one shoe sits lower than the other. The left foot sits lower than the right foot in this pair which is so weird. The left shoe seems fine, it will stretch enough like they usually need I'm sure. The right shoe is awful though and clearly not made properly. They say made in Vietnam and seem authentic so I don't understand what went so wrong with this right shoe. This is my first pair from Vietnam so maybe they make them differently? My right foot swelled up after and it hurts. The skin is red on both sides and looks imprinted. My right leg hurts up to the top of my thigh too which I find weird and alarming. I ordered from here because the Crocs site hasn't had a size 7 available in many months. There also aren't any locally in that size and the stores all say they've been waiting for almost a year for certain sizes to be sent to them. My other Crocs Bistro all feel normal and comfortable. I'll only be buying from Crocs site from now on for Crocs. Too risky and apparently dangerous buying them from anywhere else.

I like that my feet dont hurt anymore...they have the comfort i was looking for...however i almost fell when i entered our walk in freezer at work...no traction what so ever in our freezer...im not sure why but everywhere else in the restaurant im fine. They are true to size.

I bought these as everyone said crocs were the best footwear when visiting the magic kingdom. After one day the little button nubs on the side? Left me with blisters. I'm diabetic and had 3 more days in the park and had to be careful with my feet. Far from home and not much room for more in my luggage I just tossed these horrible foot holsters into a trash can and bought some Teva's. Out some money but still have my feet. lol Don't belive the hype.

Worst pair of non slip shoes I've very bought. Literally like walking on ice. Bought these because ones almost exactly like it I e bought at Walmart just weren't comfy. These were comfortable... When I wore them on carpet. As soon as I walked in a kitchen and behind my bar could barely walk because of how slick it was. I slipped on the smallest amount of water from an ice cube that had melted and threw my back out. Horrible investment and so upset these are marketed as non slip. Thanks Crocs, not only did I waste my money. Now I have to spend extra at the chiropractor this week. 4 days before Xmas. Awesome.

The clogs didn t breathe at all, and made my feet sweat. I put some small holes in either side of the toebox and that s all the problem. Can t rinse the shoes off while wearing them, or put them right back on after rinsing them, Because my socks will get wet, but I can deal with that.

I work at a busy restaurant that requires me to walk on my feet A LOT. A few of my coworkers made the recommendation of these Crocs to me when I mentioned my feet hurting. I ordered and waited for over 2 months for these shoes to finally arrive but it s a total disappointment. I ve tried wearing them at work for 2 weeks now but my feet hurt even more than my older Skechers work shoes! I d say they re very light-weight but unfortunately they don t provide any arch support, which is probably the reason why my feet have been hurting so much from wearing them. I feel like if I didn t have to walk so much they re still comfortable shoes to wear to work, so I ll keep them. However, I d really like to let those who are also flat-footed to not expect too much of arch support out of these Crocs.

Left these crappy hard rubber sandals on my patio for a couple of days after wearing them around the yard. They warped and are unusable. Don't leave them in the sun, or you too may need to throw them away. I regret my purchase.

We ordered these shoes in February 2022. My partner works at a bistro and needed some comfy work shoes, and so low and behold, in my infinite creativity, I looked for bistro shoes. Bazam, she had shoes. These shoes fit good for about 3 days. Then something miraculous happened They began to shrink. Shrink you say? What do I mean? Well normally a shoe gets worn in and if anything gets a little looser. These did the opposite. The more she wore them, the more elements they were exposed to, the shoes shrank. Behold, a miracle of demonically defective proportion unfolded. Shoes just little tighter you wonder? Perhaps a big snug around the toes? No. Shrink the shoes did, and much. The shoes shrank about 1 size in the first month, and then half or a full size more in the second month. My partner literally cannot get her heel into the shoes anymore, it is like trying to put on your 8 year old's shoes, a joke and a half. Well didn't her feet just grow? Perhaps she's had a growth spurt, all in the feet! While possible that a 34 year old woman had her feet grow 2 full sizes in 2 months doing nothing out of the ordinary, I am riddled with doubts about this theory. How does the story end, or how could it? The ending has yet to be written. Crocs Amazon please make right by us about these shoes. We didn't know they had such a shrinking ability. Also, please explain what the heck happened to these shoes. Is it cold? water? grease? What could possibly have done this? - The guy who got blamed for buying shrinking shoes.

These shoes are comfortable as heck for someone working 12-15 hours a day recommend getting inserts but only having them two months and the nonslip peels off? Crocs, get at me with that refund or replacement, please!

I also use a gel heel cup which helps with foot support after long days. However it rubs against the footbed and makes it sound like I fart when I walk. Which i m okay with.

I ve worn a previous pair of crocs for 20 years and they're still good A little tight to put on, has bumps inside that grab socks when I'm sliding into them but also makes them a firm fit, no slipping.

My husband has back knee joint pain he wears them like house shoes and out about outside he loves them , they help support him from falling

Bought for girlfriend for work, she loves these shoes! Very comfortable, and non-skid bottom are a great plus as a nurse!

I bought these for my clinicals but find myself wearing these things at work and everywhere else because of how comfy they are, there are also two tiny holes on the strap part and you can fit croc charms on them, the holes don t effect the shoe at all, they are still leak proof!

Custom orthotics are 500 per pair plus Dr's fees, scans, x-rays an additional 1,000 . They are easy to clean. Just rinse them off. I like to buy 1 size larger to accommodate socks in the winter. Don't leave them outside. I forgot mine for an hour. It shrank 1 size. After 2 years, they are still supportive not compressed down . I've tried the slip on sandals, Freesail, classic, etc. None supported my feet like the Bistro.

These do not fit as well as I had hoped. I'm normally a sz 8 and they run a tad small. Also they are not as cushiony for the bottom of my feet. After standing for 3 hrs my feet actually hurt. So I'm not wearing as I intended, instead only for short times around the house and not out anywhere.

I like that my feet dont hurt anymore...they have the comfort i was looking for...however i almost fell when i entered our walk in freezer at work...no traction what so ever in our freezer...im not sure why but everywhere else in the restaurant im fine. They are true to size.

ABSOLUTELY needed to add inserts insoles so be comfortable and for that reason should have ordered one size up for more room. Just beware they are not very comfortable support and sometimes my toes get sore which I think it s because the inserts causing it to fit more snug

I followed the advice to buy a size smaller, if a half size, and I really regret that choice. I wonder what it would be like had I bought up a size. Sadly they don t allow exchanges. As it is, the back of the shoe hits right on my achilles tendon and causes pain. I have standard size feet when it comes to width and that feels okay but the height is too snug so I feel like Cinderella s stepsister when putting them on and I don t even have high arches or anything like that. The slip resistance is nice and the durability seems decent. And really if you are among the few people the shoe fits I imagine you ll find them comfy. They just don t fit my average feet.

I should've tried these on when they first arrived, I would've returned them straight away, but I still had a little mileage left in my old pair so now I've missed the return window... I ordered the same size I've been wearing comfortably but they're very tight much smaller, they also are not near as slip resistant as the last pair, in fact, they feel slip-prone!

Didn't realize the Bistro is basically an indoor sole. It's rubbery with small lugs. It also fit VERY large. I have regular crocs in a 10, and these were huge in the same size. I ended up buying the Specialist II, which fit true to size and has the normal lugs for general outdoor use. See pics of all thee models regular, specialist II, and Bistro side by side, plus photos showing how much space I have at heel when pushing my toes to end. Pics also show the sole of the Bistro vs. Specialist II.

bought in 2018. After leaving out in sun for a day, they shrunk 2 sizes. I am size 11 and they absolutely do not fit at all. They originally were slightly big on me and were fine if I wore socks. They are now 2 sizes narrower.

I got these on sale for 19. As a pro chef, I love these shoes. Even buy them for my cooks as gifts. Whereas danskos make my feet feel like hoofs, birks don t last like they used to, and other company s don t fit well... these feel great on my feet. The only con is the swamp foot I get from them. They make my normally not-too-stinky feet smell bad. Bad as in unrecognizable, who left their corpse foot in my shoe, that can t be me?! kind of smell. I also use a gel heel cup which helps with foot support after long days. However it rubs against the footbed and makes it sound like I fart when I walk. Which i m okay with.
Fit perfectly, has held up well after many hours of heavy use, and hasn't slipped. That's all I expected and the shoes have met my expectations.

I wear a 8.5WM I got a half size down and my toes have just enough wiggle room. Not the kind that s too big or too small but kinda perfect I was shocked by that my crocs either run to small or big. This is not the classic clog I have a slim foot not wide and this shoe secures my feet even without socks in them. Will do perfect for work and is slip resistant.
Plenty of room in toe area but the arch over foot is too tight and begins to hurt after a short time, exchange was simple and as easy as dropping off the return.

When i opened the box, i thought they would be too big and too wide but after i put in two sets of arch supports, they fit just right. If i purchase another pair which i probably will , i will purchase one size smaller, i think. I have issues with knee and hip pain and these gives me some relief with the extra support i put in them . They are handy for around the house, especially at night when i have to get up a couple of times. Now i don't have to retie laces all the time. I either use these with the heel strap around my heel or else flip it up on top of the shoe. Either way they are very comfortable. I like the idea that they will prohibit slipping and falling which i have done a couple of times in my sneakers. I like mine.

I have bought several pairs of shoes recently after developing pain in my left great toe. This shoe has a big enough toe box that my toe never hurts, while wearing them, even with socks. The sole is very good at preventing slips, and of course the bed of the shoe has the famous Croc's little bumps that feel so good. I'm so satisfied, I've bought it in a second color. Great for people on their feet all day, like medical professionals.
Deep heel well, stays on without using strap, non skid, feels like memory foam but does not bounce when you walk. Excellent buy.

Shoe is very comfortable. Fits true to size. Need to wear sock liners so feet won't slide inside shoe as they are plastic and can cause feet to sweat and there are no holes in shoe. The non slid bottom are really non slid as shoe has good grip.

I m 5 10 150 lbs and wear shoes that are between size 10 and 9.5. But I m more often a 10 and prefer a little space for my toes so they aren t snug up against the end of the toe box. I needed to size down to a 9. They re generally comfortable. But my toes get a bit damp after prolonged wear since the upper material has zero breathability. I plan to get a pair of Bistro specialists with the side vents. I m using these as winter house slippers. I ordered a size 9 for a family member and was surprised that it fit rather loosely on me. The footbed and heel strap are about the right length but are a bit on the sloppy side. Without socks, they re pretty loose around the midfoot. But I can slip into them without using my hands and there s no heel slip with the heel strap keeping the shoes in place. With socks, I have to use my hands to get them on. And the overall fit is much improved. I ve only been wearing them inside for about a week. So I can t speak to the durability.

Very confused I order these multiple times and each time I ve been sent a shoe that is my size that don t fit , okay so I ve come to conclusion that one say China the other says Vietnam I can t fit the pair that says China although they are both men s size 7 women s size 9 idk if they are knocks offs but this should be stated in the description to avoid errors each time I order I have to do another order to get the pair made in Vietnam as shown in pictures on tags .
I got this for my mom. She is size 6 but has swelling due to a health condition so i got a size bigger. Unfortunately it still didn't fit her. I love mine.

I thought these would fit like the original croc but they are actually a little snug at first. I would say it took about 2 weeks for these shoes to stretch out and fit my foot comfortably. I m a ER nurse, so I like how they protect my feet from fluids and sharps, and are easy to wipe off at the end of the shift. I can now say I like the fit and comfort more than my most expensive sneakers. I can make it through a whole 12 hours on my feet without much pain. Although just know with no holes there isn t much ventilation so air your hooves out often throughout the shift, throw some foot powder on, or plan to be stinky.

Looking for a shoe I could wear while doing chores around the house. I was wary of wearing my house slippers when cleaning cat litter, mopping floors or using cleaning agents. This was the ticket. They fit well, a little large, but not something that could not be corrected with heavy socks or sole liners. After putting in the sole liners, they were even more comfortable and the strap in the back is a bit stretchy, so it does not hang loosely around the heel. You can wear these with the strap around the heel or across the top of the shoe for a slide in. Versatile and the perfect shoe for performing household chores without fear of ruining your shoes.

I love the no-skid sole on this shoe. I took a chance as I normally wear extra wide shoes. This fit perfectly so for normal folks they may be a bit big . As far as length-wise - if you normally wear a half-size, I highly recommend getting the lower whole size.
I have big feet and usually wear 10W-11W. I ordered these in size 10 and they fit perfect. I love that they're easy to clean.

I have no idea what is wrong with this pair. I buy a pair of these in size 7 every 8 months because I wear them for work. They are always comfortable and fit loose because I sized up. This pair is the tightest shoe I've ever worn. I put them on in the car as we were running late and drove to take my kids to school. I had to take them off 10 minutes later because there were awful pains in my foot and shooting up my legs. I had to drive shoeless after scrambling desperately to remove them while behind the wheel. So dangerous but I had no choice it was clear something was very wrong. Also, one shoe sits lower than the other. The left foot sits lower than the right foot in this pair which is so weird. The left shoe seems fine, it will stretch enough like they usually need I'm sure. The right shoe is awful though and clearly not made properly. They say made in Vietnam and seem authentic so I don't understand what went so wrong with this right shoe. This is my first pair from Vietnam so maybe they make them differently? My right foot swelled up after and it hurts. The skin is red on both sides and looks imprinted. My right leg hurts up to the top of my thigh too which I find weird and alarming. I ordered from here because the Crocs site hasn't had a size 7 available in many months. There also aren't any locally in that size and the stores all say they've been waiting for almost a year for certain sizes to be sent to them. My other Crocs Bistro all feel normal and comfortable. I'll only be buying from Crocs site from now on for Crocs. Too risky and apparently dangerous buying them from anywhere else.

We ordered these shoes in February 2022. My partner works at a bistro and needed some comfy work shoes, and so low and behold, in my infinite creativity, I looked for bistro shoes. Bazam, she had shoes. These shoes fit good for about 3 days. Then something miraculous happened They began to shrink. Shrink you say? What do I mean? Well normally a shoe gets worn in and if anything gets a little looser. These did the opposite. The more she wore them, the more elements they were exposed to, the shoes shrank. Behold, a miracle of demonically defective proportion unfolded. Shoes just little tighter you wonder? Perhaps a big snug around the toes? No. Shrink the shoes did, and much. The shoes shrank about 1 size in the first month, and then half or a full size more in the second month. My partner literally cannot get her heel into the shoes anymore, it is like trying to put on your 8 year old's shoes, a joke and a half. Well didn't her feet just grow? Perhaps she's had a growth spurt, all in the feet! While possible that a 34 year old woman had her feet grow 2 full sizes in 2 months doing nothing out of the ordinary, I am riddled with doubts about this theory. How does the story end, or how could it? The ending has yet to be written. Crocs Amazon please make right by us about these shoes. We didn't know they had such a shrinking ability. Also, please explain what the heck happened to these shoes. Is it cold? water? grease? What could possibly have done this? - The guy who got blamed for buying shrinking shoes.

i liked that they arrived fast and packaged very well. i don't like how uncomfortable and painful they are to wear to work. they sont feel as supportive as my previous pair. Shrunk after a few weeks in the southern heat. Getting blisters on feet from poor shape. Safe to assume these are not crocs as advertised at Amazon as usual is lying.

They are a bit big but that is okay. I don't want them to shrink. The customer service person was excellent in helping to resolve the issue!

Halfway through the day, my feet were hurting and my back was hurting. I was so busy that day running around I didn t have time to change into the backup shoes I brought. the quality gotten really bad. it's like they made it out of cheaper rubber lately. it shrunk on me. barely fit my foot into it. I will file a complaint.

Will be buying more colors since I m hooked - definitely recommend!
ugly but comfy thats the crocs logo whites will stain but these don't have the vent holes the other models have so they are much better in wet places.

Ugly as sin but what a good shoe. My girlfriend had them first and I was totally judgey for how ugly they were. Me coming from fancy leather dress shoe land I was blinded by their function. Going in and out with leather dress shoes is not fun. Having to constantly taking them on and off is a burden. Thus the crocs parked next to the dress shoes were always a victim of my quick run out and get the mail ect ect. After doing this a few hundred times I had to have them. The whole shoe is a deal. The comfort was unmatched. The shoe is waterproof so I could do all the water activities I want to. They're lightweight so my calves don't get as tired from straining. Case and point Red wing boots are good boots but they can be really straining over time from lifting them up and down. Shock displacement is huge on these shoes. You can feel the shock of your step being dissipated the shoe which keeps it from going to your bones. Which to me if I was elderly is a must. All and all an excellent shoe with easy to clean up too!
I bought these in late summer and wear them three days a week for work. Almost six months later, they are holding up great. They are very comfortable and are super easy to clean.

These surprised me with how well they fit, and the comfort was beyond my expectations. I originally couldnt stand Crocs when I saw them, but they have really grown on me. I wear them all the time now.

I bought these for work and they are great! I bartend so I am on my feet for very long periods of time and these are my savior. I broke and shattered my right foot a year ago and have tried several expensive sneakers and none cut it like these. They are light weight and for the most part skid resistant. I love how I can wash them and sometimes I ll even wear them in the shower when I m out of town staying in a hotel if I remember to bring them. I will purchase these again when they wear out but so far I ve been wearing them for 6 months and they look and still feel new. I highly recommend these for anyone in the service industry.
