I have several pairs of Clarks. These are not supportive. They have a little 'squish' which feels nice, but it is an even layer across the sandal. There is no arch or sculpted heel cup. For those you saying they are a little short in length, this is the reason. Shoes with arch support raise the middle of your foot, thus shortening the 'length' of your foot covering the length of the inner sole. If you are looking for a sporty looking sandal not one that you could actually hike in-these are for no more than walking and lounging , these are for you. But for 30, they don't offer a lot more than 10 flip flops do. I returned the pair I ordered because with my high arches, these hurt within 10 min of wearing them in the house.

Summer time with plantar fascitis is always tough. I never look forward to the roulette of finding the right support before my feet are screaming and burning in pain by night time. I was hopeful about these because the reviews were good and the price was right. I could even buy another pair and still stay on budget. Good thing my "backup" from another brand are now the preferred pair. These are in a pile of non-working shoes... My issues... The STRAP and little arch support. I did not like that when the strap was adjusted for a wider foot, it left the velcro hooks exposed and would stick to my son's road rug when I would play cars with him, ruining the rug each time. Also, the very little bit that would hook to the velcro would stop working and I can no longer wear them because they do not stay on. I bought another brand that is all one piece and features good arch support for flip flops, and they are the winner so far. If you have a slender foot, these might work, especially if you also have a high arch. Pretty Barbie feet- yes. Flat Fred Flinstone feet- no.

I ordered these in size 10 and found the insides to be extremely comfy. They are firm enough for enough support, but also soft. The soles seem fine for being on slick surfaces, but I've yet to try that. They are also very cute, and I got a lot of compliments when wearing them out. I do like that the straps are adjustable by velcro, but disappointed that there is not a lot of adjusting that can be done b c the strap isn't long enough. I have high arches and wide feet, and my feet are right on the edge of these flip-flops. I have the shoes adjusted as loose as they possibly can be, but my right foot feels bruised internally just from wearing them around the yard due to the pressure it puts on the top of the foot. I wish these came i in a wider size and that the strap was a tad bit longer, but oh well. If you have a wide foot or a high arch, please take this into consideration.

Just received today and just took out the box and theyve been worn. The tag on the bottom of shoe shows its been worn plus the other shoe heal has dirt and a big strand of hair stuck in its grooves. You can also feel the indent from toes. How Disgusting! Never did they state these are someones returns.

I have another, similar pair of Clarks that are a few years old that I bought in a stor. I love them but they are wearing out. These look identical except for the pattern on the insole but are way different as far as construction goes. First of all, the material is very scratchy, especially around the toe post. If I tried to wear them I'd get sores immediately. The other problem is that they have no give at all. I don't know how to describe it, yes they are soft but the shoe itself doesn't flex at all. These shoes are also almost 1 2" narrower than my old pair which are the same size. Highly disappointed. I don't know if this means they aren't true Clark's or that Clark like almost everyone else, has let quality slide.

These flip flops are super cute. I like that they are adjustable able to give a secure fit that doesn t leave me feeling like my shoe will go flying off I can run in them if need be. has good arch support. However just one of the shoes can find any fine piece of hair on the top of my foot to pull irritates me like crazy. I m disappointed in the quality of the foot bed, particularly how the white pattern rubs off onto my feet, how they make my feet super sweaty pretty quickly how they magnify odors. I seriously have to wash them after every couple of uses to keep it under control. This started happening after just a week of wear. This is the major reason I won t be purchasing this item again in the future.

This particular sandal looked better on a small sized foot, not my BIG 9 1 2. It felt quite stiff and I didn't care for the very "PLASTIC" look of the fake animal print. It was most convenient to just send it back. It is getting impossible to find real leather for shoes anymore, so be sure you know what you want. It looks better in the pictures than it did on MY FOOT.

I just want you to know these are extremely comfortable! Also, they have a very cushy insole which is very important for those of us whose feet aren't what they used to be! I'm 70 yrs. old and have a condition called Fat Atrophy of the Footpad. The fat that cushions our feet is between our skin and our bones. Mine is dwindling which makes walking on a hard surface very painful. It feels like I'm walking on marbles. I found Happy Step insoles for my shoes which help a LOT. However, sandals are a different story. These do the trick. The insole gives enough so my feet are not painful even when I wear these all day. I hope you find this helpful if you have painful feet!

Bought these in part because I saw reviews or question answer mention it had good arch support. Under the arch is actually the thinnest, weakest part of the sole, where it comes off the ground between the ball and the heel. The sole isn't quite rigid enough to provide any support in this area, and in fact, I can feel where the sole hits the floor at the end of the ball and start of the heel as slight lumps under my foot. Besides this, they are fairly comfortable and easy to adjust for a custom fit. I don't dislike them. I just wish they had better arch support.

I have plantar fasciitis and have been searching for a sandal that is comfortable enough, but not hideous or obviously an orthopedic sandal. These are it! They're super comfortable, I can wear them all day without any arch pain. Kind of feels like I'm walking on marshmallows! I purchased them in taupe shown in photo and black, but will definitely be adding other colors to my collection, and probably back-up pairs! Package arrived on time and in great shape!
Very comfortable the best. I have plantar fasciitis and they don't bother me at all lots of support. My 2nd pair. Love these!

I was having a lot of foot pain because of a bunion on my left foot. Since I have flat feet, my podiatrist recommended I buy some quality shoes with arch support because I mainly wear flip flops or flat sandals in the summer. If arch support didn t work, I would have to have foot surgery because the pain had become unbearable. So I bought these Clarks to take the place of my flip flops and started wearing them anytime I was on my feet, including in my home. I have worn them for a month non-stop except to shower and sleep. I am thrilled to say that I am no longer experiencing any foot pain. I am going to be buying Clark brand shoes from now on. And I m ordering another pair of these because they are so comfortabl, and I m wearing them so much I am afraid I am going to wear them out! Having said that, considering how much time I have spent wearing them in the past month, they look great and are standing up to heavy use. Great quality!
bought for my mom. She loves it. Comfy straight out of box. Cushioned sole, soft, nice fit...snug but not tight she has slightly wide feet, I purchased a reg. width.

These sandals are best for arch support. I always have pain on my heels but wearing these sandals helps a lot. They provide good support and I can walk all day without any pain or discomfort. Very happy with my decision.

I have 3 pairs of Clarks Cloud Steppers in different colors. They are so comfortable, I have issues with one knee and going barefoot makes it more painful. When I wear the Cloud Steppers I feel the cushiony support helps quite a bit.

I Purchased these to take on a trip. I walked 12 miles one day in them and I did not have any fatigue and my feet. They were very supportive very comfortable. I get a new pair every year. Love, Clark s.

Originally bought a pair to wear only indoors as slippers too bulky if any support involved. So comfortable I forgot to change them for outdoor shoes when walking out the door! Bought two more pair, one only for indoors, because they are incredibly comfortable. I usually only wear Vionic for the arch support but these are less than half the price and just as comfy!

Let me begin by saying that I am very picky about my sandals. I basically wear sandals year-round, unless I am doing sports or walking in snow. And even then I switch back into sandals once indoors. So I go through my share of sandals! I wear a women's size 11 wide, not because my feet are really wide, but because my arches are high and therefore the top of my foot needs more room. So shoes are always a difficult process for me to find. I am quite satisfied with these sandals! Pros 1. These are quite comfortable, for thongs. The memory foam is supportive, but not so soft that your foot just sinks into it. The arch support is noticeable. 2. They look really sharp. Due to the size of my feet, I often have to give up style for comfort, but not with these! 3. They are adjustable! The well-concealed Velcro strap on top allows you to adjust the shoe so that it fits your foot properly. 4. The bottoms of the shoe are made of a sturdy rubber, which makes them good for outdoor use. 5. They fit true to size!!!! Holy bananas, can it be hard to find women's size 11 wide that just fit my foot, but these do! 6. They are flexible and don't do that clunking thing that thongs sometime do where it feels like the heel gets left behind when you walk. 7. They are durable enough that I expect them to last through at least a year of constant use, but light enough that they don't feel awkward. Cons 1. You have to be careful to get the top strap positioned just right for the height of your foot, or you run the chance of it rubbing you raw a little. My right foot had no problems whatsoever, but my left foot had to wear a band-aid for a while. 2. Similarly, the strap that goes between the toes can also rub you raw until it is broken in, but it does get better.

Secondly, due to it being so tight it rubbed across the top of my foot a bit. So, if you have really flat or low rising feet these might be perfect for you. They're also very classy looking for a pair of thongs.
Love these and so comfortable and soft. I have a narrow foot so was so glad to be able to tighten them up a little with the Velcro strap.

Did not receive anything free for a 5-star review. I really do like these shoes that much! Had a special event coming up, and wanted a really spiffy pair of dressy sandals to wear. I flinched at the price but decided I was worth it since I hadn't bought any new shoes this year. OMG...these are like the best sandals ever!! Pure comfort on my feet. About my feet...size 10.5 and wide. Not especially fat, but oh my, do I have big, old feet. And I don't like the totally flat styles, but I have a bad knee and can't do a higher heel anymore either. Not only are these great fitting and very comfortable, but they also look surprisingly dressy. And an adjustable strap for those swollen feet times...Win-Win! Love them so much I ordered another pair in dark blue and they fit just as nicely! My toes come further down when I'm standing up.

I haven't been able to find a suitable slipper to relieve my plantar fasciitis so I needed something I could wear in the kitchen until I do. These are so comfortable and help with the pain. I will never buy any other flip flops and will order another color for sure. Clarks for the win! For reference - I wear a 7M usually unless reviews say that a shoe runs narrow and then I order a wide. These were true to size for me.

I purchased the size based on the product dimensions. I normally wear a 9 in sandals and these were spot on. Very comfy! No breaking in. I wish there was more arch support since I have high arches, but the footbed had plenty of cushy comfort.

Recommend. Very cute!! Just like pictures. I wear a size 10, ordered a 10, but returned for an 11. The 10 fit, but exactly at the heel. Like no wiggle room at heel, your heel hits right at edge. I don t like that look, so sized up. The 11 was perfect, still fit in front great, but left a few centimeters in back and looked better. If they didn t have the 11 I would have definitely keep the 10 though. The front on both is great. I love how you can tighten or loosen the strap and it still looks great. Definitely getting another pair in other colors.

Well...thanks to Clark's Sea Breeze I finally found a pair I can enjoy wearing. I'm a size 8 in every shoe and they seem very true to size. Great comfort and support. I'm thoroughly pleased and will be buying another pair I think. Highly recommend especially if those have had issues with toe posts. Give them a try.

However, sandals are a different story. These do the trick. The insole gives enough so my feet are not painful even when I wear these all day. I hope you find this helpful if you have painful feet!

The Good I own several pairs of Clark's Cloudstepper Breeze Sea sandals. They are the most comfortable sandals I've ever worn. They're well-made and stylish, and I love that the strap is adjustable. The Bad Although this pair was purchased as "new," it clearly was not. It arrived in a plastic bag that had been scotch-taped shut no box . The white size tags visible in photo were so dirty that I was unable to read the size. Also, the soles had tiny bits of embedded grit. The print on the bag said "Ready to Ship." My guess is that I got a gently-used return. This sandal was on sale, but was listed as new. The listing says the product was sold and shipped by Amazon.

I am writing this review for a pair Clark s that I bought three years ago I have since bought 6 more pairs . The pair that are three years old are still holding up strong. This season they have been through a lot and still in good shape. Today I needed to soak them in bleach I mowed a 1 2 acre in them . They were so grass stained, they were almost black. And I must say, they look almost new. I am very impressed!!! They do run big. My left foot is almost 2 sizes bigger than my right. So you can imagine the issues I have with shoes, especially ones without backs. but the adjustable strap makes the fit almost perfect. They are super comfortable. I even wear them in the winter with toe socks.
I love these sandals so much, these are my third pair. No breaking-in period needed they re comfortable right out of the box.

I'm not one to write bad reviews, but these shoes created such a bad day for me I have to share. I walk my pooch daily at a intercoastal park that we love visiting. My regular shoes were wet so I grabbed these. Everything was fine until we got to the farthest point from the car... my right heel started aching, so I looked down and sure enough... the heel from the tennis shoe had rubbed my short sock all the way down without me knowing it. I pulled it back up and thought this would be the end of it. Nope. On our way back to the car, the shoe kept rubbing the sock down... every 50 feet or so, I'd have to stop, reach down, pull up the sock, continue forward. It was annoying but ok. After a few times, my puppy was getting antsy from having to stop, and now I had to pee as this was taking significant time. She would start walking into the woods, getting herself tangled on trees, and I'd undo the leash. After about 5 more minutes I couldn't hold it anymore, and this is a fairly open and busy woods, so I couldn't just pull off to the side and pee I'm a girl, too! So the next time I reached down to fix my sock, I peed. First a little.. then the next time a lot. My puppy, getting into trouble and tangled in the woods. Now I'm wet, my puppy tangled, I try to get her untangled and she sees a pile of fairly fresh poop and rolls in it. So now, only half way back, I'm full of pee, my dog has poop mushed in her fur, and the blister is really stinging... at this point I want to just take off the shoes, but it's about 40 . I eventually took these little bastards off, and was just so angry. The my pants are now wet and cold and my dog is confused as to why I'm so not nice at this point. We finally made it to the car, I had her jump in the back, looked for a towel to put on my seat and something to wipe her fur off with, and she hops into the passenger side because she's worried about me... spreading some other dogs poop all over the seat and passenger door. I was happy to finally get home and throw these little m.f.s into the garbage. Moral of the story... unless you want to fully pee your pants and have poop smeared all around the front of your car, don't buy these shoes.

I will start off by saying my feet don't really sweat. I mean, if they've been in construction boots or winter boots for hours on end, of course, they do, but in the course of a day, my feet are stink-free. I mean, not to brag, but my feet are healthy. All of my little microbes do their job so that my footsies don't have to stink like hot anus. These shoes do not let me keep up my streak of non-odorous feet. What did I do in order to get this malodor? I walked. I'm a walker. I walk like any person who lives in a city. In fact, I've walked for years in various shoes and never, since I was a teenager, had my feet stink. Until now. The shoes were pretty. They were affordable. They went with my outfits. I loved the courtset but they are becoming a dying breed, so I decided to go traditional. That was my mistake. Did I look to see if they were breathable? No. Did I think I would need to based on the aforementioned non-odor of my size 10s? No. I should've. Now I'm no saint, I'm only human. Of course, being human, you will have various odors emitting from your body. We, as humans, do what we can to mitigate them. These shoes exacerbate them. If you walk, at all. If you move for longer than 20 minutes a day, if you would generally prefer not to have your feet produce 3-Methylbutanoic acid - I'd say stay away from these. However, if you like your feet to smell like ripened cheese, by all means, get 'em while the gettings good.

I love the styling, cloud foam insole, and the fit of these shoes but not the color and I feel the listing for these shoes is deceiving not descriptive enough when showing the color. Shipping was fast.

UPDATE I ordered a pair of 9s from the adidas site -- and had the same issue with the tongue on the left shoe tilting toward the left. Don't know if it's my foot or the way they make the shoe, but it seems sewn in crooked. Also, the ones from the adidas site were larger, and flopped when I walked, rubbing my heal, even with socks on. I'd agree with the reviewers that say to size down with those ones they were the black striped "essentials" ones, not the grey ones ordered here . I wish I would have kept the ones I ordered here! Plan to just reorder, since they're more affordable here. The adidas site wants 65 plus shipping unless you sign up to be a member. I was really excited for these have wanted them since I was a kid in the 90s ! I ordered the ones with the grey stripes the description says "Dove Grey Bright Yellow Champagne Metallic" even though they're just white with grey stripes... I crossed my fingers and hoped they would match the photo . They were the right color, but the grey stripes were really shiny like plastic, even though the photo makes them look like they're more matte. I ordered my size 9 instead of sizing down like everyone in the reviews said, and they fit perfect, just enough room for some socks. They looked cute and felt pretty comfy. But one of the tongues was really crooked and pointed to the side. I couldn't adjust it, it would just slide back to the left. Before I noticed that I was tempted to keep them, but I'm nitpicky like that, especially if I'm treating myself to shoes I've wanted for like 20 years. I'm just gonna order some more from the adidas site even though they'll be more expensive.

I ordered pink stripes. They sent me metallic pinkish color stripes. Kinda uncomfortable fit not for walking for long and I needed them for an upcoming trip. Will return and keeping the triple kick Keds I purchased at the same time. They are way more comfortable, add a bit of height, and they actually sent the right color.

firstly, it's fake i checked the numbers in the tounge and they're the same one way to tell they're fake also its not a nice design its too rounded and matte, and if i remeber correctly it had a small stain on them otherwise it was fine i took two stars off one for the lack of asethetic beauty, and one for the little support it seemed to give in any case it was too large for my feet so it could be that it would support your feet it just didn't seem to be super supportive in a nutshell if you don't mind not getting the real thing as long as everyone else sees the logo its a fine fashion shoe read not sports or running shoe

The pictures are misleading. The shoes I received only had black stripes on the outsides, the stripes on the inside of the shoes were white. Ran about half a size too big and I have never had that problem with Adidas sizing before. Returned.

We purchased these shoes twice. The first pair ran large. The second pair fit perfect but came with one clean white lace and one ugly yellowed lace. Booo. Bad on this product. So disappointed in Amazon. Where is the quality control.

These shoes are clearly fake. I had the same shoes for 4 years before needing to buy a new pair so I am very familiar with this shoe. They are light and cheaply made. The color is slightly off, there is exposed foam on the tongue, the insoles are thin and uncomfortable. They slide around on my feet with clearly a different fit. And they scuff and get dirt way easier than the real ones. This is clearly a scam. Not sure why Amazon allows these to stay up for sales when other reviews are mentioning the same thing.

I love the way these shoes look but they are defective. Both said size 9, which is what I ordered, but the right shoe was clearly a size bigger - to the point I couldn't even keep it on my foot. I was wondering how I managed to score a pair of Adidas for such a good price...now I know. I hope my pair was the only pair that was defective but I suspect, at that price, that I'm not alone in feeling duped. They sure looked like authentic Adidas but I suspect they were counterfeits.
Love them get so many compliments. Not a huge sneaker van but they match so well to my black and white wardrobe
This item is very comfortable, perfect to pair with summer dress. I received a lot of compliments from my co worker . Highly recommended
They go with everything - dress them up, casual wear - whatever! They go right back in the closet after wearing so they stay brilliantly white. Love them, 100 recommend.

From way back when, I've been using Adidas on and off. The diversity of colors are a bonus. They will always be fashionable. They are not bulky and goes perfect with skinny jeans, relaxed pants or even a long summer dress. They have a comfortable foam inside which makes them comfortable to walk all day. I don't suggest them for working out or running. Since they tend to be a bit pricey, I usually wait for a price decrease for the other colors. They are true to size. Fit as expected. Completely recommend.

I'm not that into trends and if when I finally do like a trend, I'm usually on it 6-9 months after it's over lol These sneakers are everything I could've imagined and then some. They literally go with everything! If you're looking for a white, low profile sneaker to pair with jeans, leggings, skirt, dress, or shorts, this is IT!

So adorable! I have worn these maybe 10-15 times at my very casual office. They fit great, I got my usual size and they re nice and snug. The white cleans up nicely when I get dirt on them and I have weight lifted in them before and they do fine for that, no running for sure. These are awesome and obviously so trendy!
I know orders always look good in the picture, and that's the case for these sneakers as well. However, they ARE comfortable and look like they'll last a LONG time! Recommended!
Hard to see but the orange is very fluorescent! Toe bed fit fine but otherwise too big, slipped off my heel even though I have thicker socks on.

These are awesome! Stylish and comfortable! My toddlers have the same ones and I love matching them - dorky but true. I can feel cute and comfortable chasing kids which is what I'm going for with these.

Love my Adidas Grand Court 2.0 - I purchased the leopard stripe last year, and loved them so much I wanted the classic black stripe pair. Such a classic shoe and goes with all my casual outfits. Excited to wear these in the spring and summer time!
I thought these would be similar to my classic black and white cloadfoam adidas but these are less comfortable

I bought these sneakers in black first I just love them so I had to buy the white ones too. I love the finish on them. They have a nice sheen that highlights the white on white design. They are extremely comfortable fit true to size. Very cute sneakers. I can only hope they don t have anymore cool colors. Lol! High recommend!
Everyone compliments my cheetah print adidas. They are so comfy and so cute. Easy to match with anything.
I bought these on sale, but they are super comfy and match any outfit just as much as the Nike Air Force ones. Same white leather shoe vibe, without the 100 price tag

This sneaker was everything I hoped for and so much more. They are now my favorite shoe. The leather wipes clean, the width is roomy but not too roomy, the inside of the shoes are like a pillow for my feet. The arch is not really supportive but I'm wearing them as a casual shoe, not for working out. The only actual issue I had was a one day break in of the heel of the shoe. It was rubbing the back of my heel. I solved it by pulling back on them several times throughout the day and they were perfect from then on. I want more colors. Buy this shoe!

product_name: Skechers BOBS Women's Keepsakes - Ice Angel Slipper

urgent_issues.summary: 구매자들은 내구성 문제로 인해 신발이 빠르게 망가지는 경우가 많아 실망하고 있습니다.

comfort.issue_summary: 많은 리뷰에서 착용감이 불편하다는 공통된 문제가 나타났습니다. 특히, 단단한 내부와 부족한 쿠셔닝으로 인해 발에 통증을 유발하고 있습니다.
comfort.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 뛰어난 아치 지지력과 편안함을 제공한다고 반복적으로 언급하며, 발에 대한 통증이나 불편함 없이 착용할 수 있음을 강조하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: These look nice and the support is great. They are not super cushy but I want support more so I was happy. Then, after just a few days, something became exposed inside the left slipper and it irritated my foot. It did not raise a blister nor break the skin but it is very uncomfortable, even sitting. So, for a few more days I wore the slippers with socks inconvenient, yes, but less inconvenient than no slippers but now I can feel whatever it thru the sock. Back it goes, and I m not sure if I ll order another pair to replce this one.

I tried so hard to like these shoes. I did. I bought a smaller size as people suggested. I tried to wear socks with them. I tried to pretend that they were not slipping and sliding on my feet and getting looser each time I wore them. But they were. And its not good for my feet to wobble in them. I am in the process of multiple surgeries for my hip and just cannot have shoes unsafe for my feet. I love Skechers. And I want them to fit more than anything, because they felt so comfortable. But they just wouldn't fit. And I know I cant return them now. I dont have the box and I dont have the physical means to. I am sorry.

I really wanted to be able to give these slip ons a five star rating, but it's not possible. I wear a 7 1 2 wide shoe. I ordered these in an 8 because 1 2 sizes weren't available. For me, the shoe is loose. The lining feels nice, but the shoe is loose. The real issue, and the reason for the 3 star is due to the two labels that are sewn in to the inside of each shoe. One label is sewn in where my heel sits. The other label is sewn in to the underside of the roof of the shoe where my little toe bumps it, even when I'm just sitting and relaxing. On the left shoe, both of those labels rub my foot. I even have a blister on the top of my little toe from that label that's sewn in under the roof of the shoe. The crazy thing is, you can't even see that label!!! Why? Why would you sew in a label where you'd need a dental mirror to even see it to read it? And why if you're going to put it in such a place, did you not ensure it would lay flat, and why not use label material that would be soft?? And why on earth would you sew it in??? I'm hoping that I can remove it with a seam ripper, without doing harm to the shoe. If you're going to buy these shoes, they do seem to be well put together, aside from the over abundance of label corners sticking up to prick your foot. They are warm shoes, and are anti slip on wood and tile floors. For me, they did run large.

I m an 8 1 2 wide and that s what I ordered. I should have ordered a straight 9 because the toe box on these are narrow and it s definitky not a true size 8 1 2. I wore them hoping they d stretch out but they haven t done so. My foot pushes against the front very uncomfortably in order to fit the back on my foot into the shoe. Very unhappy with this but can t return it. The thick smoke is about the only nice feature on them. It doesn t feel like memory foam is the footbed. It s very hard. Bearpaw makes a much better product
I have had for 2 months the inside at the toes is coming apart making them uncomfortable. Only wear to take dog out in the morning.

This is the second one I got with the same defect. Don t know if the second photo does it justice but the inside seam is coming apart. It is sticky and you feel it every step. Like I said I already order one and returned it for the same reason. This one is even worse as the last one it was only the left shoe the inside heel of the right insole is also peeling and there is fraying on both of the shoes where the rubber outsole meets the upper. They are comfortable but I don t think I will try a third time.

What a disappointment! I was so excited to receive these. I read the positive reviews, saw the range of sizes and widths these come in and ordered a pair. I have a hard time finding slippers that fit me well. I had an injury on one foot that left me requiring orthopedic surgery for a severely pronated ankle. Since these come in wide widths, I ordered them and hoped for the best. These slippers would be absolutely the most comfortable, stable, perfect slippers I d ever found except for one thing...the tags! There s a sewn in tag on the inside sole. I removed those easily with sewing scissors. But there s another tag that s sewn into the fur of the upper. It is incredibly itchy and uncomfortable. It s plastic and I believe the stitching is also. I don t have sensitive skin or feet but this tag has driven me insane! It is so uncomfortable! I tried everything in an attempt to fully remove them they re on both feet. I tried using a seam ripper and sharp sewing scissors. The placement of these particular tags makes it nearly impossible to remove them. They re securely sewn into the faux fur upper. I can t really see or reach in there. I ended up hacking and snipping until I got most of the label out. Now there s a hole in that spot and the fluff is kind of falling out but at least I don t have stiff plastic stitches and a tag irritating my skin though there are still a few uncomfortable bits left in there, probably stitch remnants. I would ve bought these slippers in every color if not not for these horrendously uncomfortable label tags. I m so confused as to why others aren t bothered by these! Why were plastic labels sewn into faux fur uppers - WITH plastic thread? It s just intolerable! Are others wearing these with socks? Is that why people aren t mentioning this issue? If not for the itchy, stiff, scratchy, nearly impossible to remove plastic labels sewn into the faux fur uppers, I d rate these five-stars. But with the labels - these end up getting a most disappointed one-star rating from me.

The top of this slipper is not soft. It s hard. The arch support rubs the bottom of your foot at the inner edge making it uncomfortable. The memory foam is hard. Not soft. And it s such a thin layer. So I returned. This would be a great slipper if it was revised. Top should be soft. Use thick real memory foam. Arch support needs help! Runs a little small.
Super heavy I will only wear them around the house now or to go get my male. Long walks in these would really hurt my ankles and feet.

I read several reviews that said these slippers were uncomfortable because the inner soles were very hard. I wanted to try them anyways because they are cute I like the thick rubber sole because I often go out back to check on my animals forget to take off my slippers. Well, I should have listened to those reviews. The inner sole was HARD AS A ROCK.. Plus, they slipped right off my feet when I tried to walk in them. I am really disappointed.

I have wide feet with a high instep so I was excited to find a wide slipper with a sturdy sole as I wear my house shoes all the time, in the house, getting mail, carrying out trash, etc. I started with 8W which was too long, sent those back and ordered 7.5W. The right foot seemed a little tight across the top but I thought I'd give it a day or so to see if got better, it has. Just a small amount of give but not stretched out. It has fake fur which seems slick however my foot does not slide around. Using my hand I do feel a cushion in the bottom of the slipper similar to a Dr. Scholl's double air pillow insole however wearing these I don't feel that soft cushiony feeling I did with first putting on my old Dearfoams. Dearfoams used to have a good deal of memory foam, now whatever s in their slipper seems to bunch up in a short time, hence trying Sketchers. I ll give these a 3 as they don't have much memory foam, also if I stand in them for a while the bottom of my foot feels like I m standing without cushion, just hard. Would I buy again, maybe as I have such a hard time finding a slipper I like, but they are pricey in my opinion.

I love Skechers, but am not satisfied with their slippers! I ordered these exact slippers from HSN, but returned them because the footpad rolled up at the toe and caused an irritating bump under my toes. I thought maybe HSN got a deal on slightly irregulars? BTW...I'll never buy from HSN again, they charged me over 7 S H to return these DEFECTIVE slippers! Anyway, I got my second pair from Amazon, and the bottom edge is sticky like the pad wasn't lined up correctly when it was pressed down, like the other pair I returned. I'm hoping the sticky-ness wears off as I continue to wear them. I really like these slippers otherwise, and hope I don't have to return these, too!

The worse slippers I have ever purchased. I never write reviews but my feet hurt from wearing these and it makes me cranky. No cushioning at all, like walking barefoot on a cement floor. Unfortunately I threw the box out or I would have sent these back immediately.

These are comfortable and have great support and keep my feet very warm. I work at home and I wear them around the house during the day. That being said I'm not really going outside a lot or anything like that but the bottom of them started to fall off after the first week I had to hot glue it. Now they have separated so much that I've had them for about a month and a half and I'm shopping a different pair of decent house shoes. I'm a big Skechers fan, disappointed in the quality of these. And unfortunately because I've worn them I cannot return them. Don't waste your money

I bought a pair of these way back when the fur wasn't as soft and fell in love with them so much so I bought a pair for my mother. That was probably in '16. Since then I have had 3 other bobs not includding this most recent pair. Each time I purchased the quality of the foam got a little less supportive and thin. I just took my most recent pair out of the box, and have worn them no less than 20 minutes and I am sending them back. These shoes are very, very painful. It feels better for me to walk around barefoot. I really wanted these to work out, because I remember how lovely the first pair were, but my feet have found no comfort in just fond memories.

VIDEOID 1976a43d71e126e24def2d1e9aeb651d These are the best slippers I have ever had. They fit snug and don't fall off. There is amazing arch support. They are warm no need for socks and they look good. These are a 10 wide. You can see my high arch in the photo. I have RA and it has caused my feet to be deformed. It's hard for me to find a comfortable shoe. They are firm but supportive. I wouldn't want anymore cushioning. Thanks Sketchers , you've done it again ! I love your shoes !

My sketchers arrived a day early. I bought two pair one for me and one for my daughter and I have to tell you I have since ordered another pair or not because these are worn out just because I wanted to have an extra pair. They are so comfortable these are the most comfortable shoes I have ever worn or bought. You can wear them outdoors to the store or just around the house. The cushioning on the shoe is very soft and helps my feet because I suffer with diabetes and sciatic nerve and these shoes. I wear all day long and my feet hurt less than they ever have. The inside of of their sketchers are very well cushioned and provide great support. I recommend these to anyone men and women if you want something that s comfortable that you can wear indoors and outdoors and that help your feet not to hurt that have therapeutic support This is the shoe for you.

I really like my Bobs however, when the description said, "Memory Foam", I expected there to be more than what is in the footbed. I expected to have a soft, sink-into-the-slipper feeling, and there isn't. It's a VERY think layer of foam, and unless you really push down hard with your toes, you can't feel it! I have pain in my feet all the time from neuropathy. It would have been nice for these to be a little more "squishy." I did buy a size bigger and a width wider, which accommodates my thicker socks, and the fit is fine with the socks on. They are very pretty and nice looking, and I love that I can go outside to take the trash out, etc. The sole is nicely treaded for that reason.

I have previously owned multiple pairs of more expensive house slippers. They have each lasted a year or two before needing to be replaced. This last pair did not last that long and began to cause pain in my feet from breaking down unevenly. I couldn't stand or work around the house without the lack of support making it not worth wearing them at all. I searched for too long to find a great pair! These are it! The sole of the slippers are rather thick. They handle running trash outside, stomping through the yard to catch a runaway dog, up and down stairs, cooking dinner, washing clothes, anything I've thrown at them, they've taken it. The interior is soft. They have shed a bit but overall comfortable. The only complaint I have is that the tag is placed directly under your heels. If you are not wearing socks, this can be annoying. Otherwise, fantastic purchase. I'm considering purchasing another pair as back up.

I love these shoes! I bought them when i broke both my legs and these were comfy enough to wear with my braces. I continued to wear them, and its been over 2 yrs. They still are in great condition and i wear them daily. Bought my 80 yr old mom a pair this yr and they are her favorite now too! Buy these! They are the best comfy shoes to run outside, to the store, or almost anywhere! These are my dailys.

I bought these to wear around the house while cooking and cleaning because all my other slippers would hurt my feet after hours of standing. I have plantar fasciitis and arthritis. Only been wearing them for a week, They're quite comfortable! They have a small amount of lift, they offer some arch support. I was surprised how heavy they are. I do find them more like shoes vs slippers, partly because of the weight. They have a huge toe box, even w socks the toe box is large. I ordered a 10 wide, which is typically my normal size depending on the brand and they are a bit big. Even w socks on my heels flop out a bit, but that's ok. I am a bit disappointed that they aren't warmer. I thought the fuzzy faux fur lining looked so cozy and warm, but my toes still get cold. Overall I really like them and I'd probably order again- I have yet to find any house shoes that offer good support like these.

I have problems with achilles tendonitis. So I need great arch support. Since I started buying sketchers memory foam athletic shoes, my feet have never been better. I found these Bobs slippers for a good price and I'm so happy! Regular slippers never worked for me. Too flat, no arch support but these have sketchers memory foam and the fur is very soft. Thick sole and a small heal. Perfect to wear at home after a long hard day. They are warm and cozy and you can walk outside without having to change shoes! They are comfortable and cozy! LOVE LOVE LOVE!!!
Had surgeries on feet and knees. High arch, need good fit and arch support. These fit well and great arch.
Comfortable with good sole support. Liked that I could get in a half size so they fit better-not too small or too big

I can't wear these w out feeling terrible pain with every step, it feels like I'm walking on a frame of an empty shoe with nothing inside it. These aren't good for anyone with neuropathy that's for sure, even while just sitting or laying down having these on I still feel nothing but pain very uncomfortable. I wouldn't recommend these to anyone that has any kind of problems with their feet. I'm pretty sure they would still feel just as uncomfortable if I didn't have neuropathy too, they're just not made very well I'm shocked because I usually love Skechers!

Quality is okay for the 25 price, but the footbed was not quite as cushioned or supportive as I was hoping for as it touts memory foam, but because of leg and knee injury I look for more than probably most people.

I never can seem to find any house slippers that I like to wear due to me having plantar fasciitis Achilles tendonitis. But, these are just the best! Just look at the quality of them in the pictures I ve posted. It even has memory foam inside and feels great on my feet not at all too soft or too hard on my feet. I normally wear a size 7 in everything so that s what I ordered and the fit was perfect. I highly recommend if you want a good strong comfortable pair of house slippers would feel comfortable enough wearing these out as well.

Right and left are the same. Not enough contour in the structure initally to know if you have them on the correct feet until you have worn them many times. Cushioning is good and super comfortable other than the log shape.

I purchased this product a few weeks ago, and can honestly say these are my "go-to" shoes for everyday wear. Although I work from home and am inside most of the day, these shoes have a thick sole w traction, so you can wear them outside to walk the dog, to the mailbox, or look cute and stylish at the market or mall. because they have really good support. They are also very warm, so you can wear them with or without socks. The only minor issue I had is that they run a little large, so instead of a 6W, I will probably order a 6M or 5W for my next pair.
Super soft and keep my feet very warm. I wish the back was a little higher, so they didn't flop when I walk. Consider sizing down a half size, maybe?

The sole is coming loose and it s probably going to come out entirely eventually. Just had these shoes for a couple of months. Very disappointed
Just got these today. I am usually a 7.5 but they are a bit loose for me, but I do have narrow feet too. If I continue to like these and order again, I will go a half size down.

I bought these for my teenage stepdaughter and she said they slipped off her heel. It s like they were falling off when she walked. She Has wide feet. She thought she Maybe needed bigger size. I then tried them on, I have narrow feet and a little smaller than hers so they should e fit me but they did the same thing to me. The way these are built it s hard to keep them on your feet. It s like you have to curl your toes to keep them on when you walk. Would not recommend or buy again.
I bought three pairs in size 5 all defective returned but a five and a half also defective but past return and sketchers is ignoring me for a return of the fourth defective shoe all on the right foot

Shipping took longer than expected so I was even more disappointed that I had to wait extra time to receive the shoes only to have to drive them to the UPS store, return them and end up waiting MORE for another pair to arrive. I read the reviews and ordered a smaller size than I normally do because people said they run big. That is an understatement----they run RIDICULOUSLY BIG!! I usually wear a 9W and ordered an 8 1 2W....even going 1 2 size smaller, the shoe slopped off the back of my foot and there was about 2 inches of space from the end of my foot to the end of the toe. Torn---I really like the shoes but now I have NO idea what size to order. The 8 1 2 W were HUGE.....but with nothing to compare sizes with I may have to order a different shoe.

I am going to be honest about these slippers. When I first got them they were tight and not comfortable at all. I decided to wait before I returned them because they are memory foam and they would form to my foot. Well now we have gone to the other extreme! They are now loose and I find myself slipping out of them regularly. However, now it is too late and returning them would just be wrong. They are true to size length wise but not in the fit overall. They were delivered quickly and all that but the slippers are just awful. Try another pair.

I wear a 5.5 shoe and that s what I ordered they came and felt like a size 5 so I exchanged them for a 6 and they kinda but squeezed my foot and I have skinny feet not to mention the so called memory foam felt more like a brick ..these are the most uncomfortable shoes ever don t waste your time or money and I usually like Skechers too so disappointed

These are cute, imo. They are also a wee bit more narrow than one would expect for a wide fit. After some serious work I was able to stretch them and make them ok without socks. Even a thin sock makes them uncomfortable. The traction is good. Could be worn outdoors if needed because the bottoms are pretty thick. The biggest disappointment was the furry liner. After only 3 days of wearing them the liner is done! No more softness at all! I literally feel the bottom of the shoe. Definitely won t be warm and toasty in a cold PA winter. Not what I d expect from Sketchers.
Loved the look and feel of them, but they're too small in the length, feet keeping slipping off the back.

The fit and everything else was true to size. But when I would slip them on and off to go into the garage because the floor was too cold to barefoot on, I started noticing that the bottom inside sole was starting to peel back up by the toes. I put them on and I can feel a clump of material under my toes and it is almost peeled back to the middle of the bottom of my foot, very uncomfortable to wear now, even if just putting them on for 1 minute. I have always bought sketchers and never had an issue like this before. I am very highly disappointed in the quality of the workmanship. Never had a pair of slip on slippers that fell apart so quickly especially when I am not wearing them in the house or when I leave the house. I strictly use them just to walk out to the recycling bins in the garage. If this is the type of quality work that they are doing now they Will lose me as a customer forever. I have never been so disappointed in a company like I am now. I always loved the different types of shoes they made, but this is just horrible workmanship! Very disappointed customer!

Looking at the picture, I thought the back of the slipper came up higher on the heel. They are nearly a mule and hard to keep on. I worry about the stability as they have a platform sole, loose over the instep, and feel like a misstep is going to lead to a fall. I have been trying to wear them around some to get used to them. They are very warm. The fleece lining is very slick adding to the sense that they could fly off my foot rather easily.

I purchased 2 sets of these in 2 sizes just to be sure because the price was so good I didn't want to miss out. They arrived yesterday. Well, let's start with the boxes. They look 2nd hand. Like they took donations for skecher boxes in any condition succeeded. Next, the sizes. I'm normally a 5.5w or regular 6 in skechers. I bought 5.5w 6. These were both abnormally large. Here's the best part. Both sets of shoes are made of completely different material. The 5.5w is made of a soft rabbit hair like material that your foot won't stay in. You walk you're losing your shoe. Slides off like butter. Never seen anything like it before. The 6w was a rough synthetic plastic troll doll feeling hair. Foot stayed in fine. However the shoe is so huge for it's size I need the 5.5w that slides off.... NEXT! The metal buttons are all different! I mean some painted some not painted others just a completely different size than the rest! They both feel completely different inside than each other even the soles are different. I am beside myself with these! Returning both pairs paying full price skechers! Photos included of all!

The only problem was the imperfection was on the right slipper big toe on the outside. Looks like the stitching was pulled to tight or was snagged in production. I'm going to keep them because I can't wait for another pair. This is my 2nd pair, they are comfortable and wear well

SIZING ADVICE if you want to wear these slippers with bare feet only, get your usual size. If you want to wear them with socks like I do in the wintertime, order UP a half-size. I live in snow country in Colorado I wear medium-to-heavyweight wool-blend socks with the shoes I wear outside in the winter. When I come home, I remove my snow-covered shoes and need slippers which I can easily slide into WITH MY SOCKS ON. My floors are cold even with good carpeting and padding, so I never walk around in just socks or my bare feet in the wintertime. I also need a true shoe-type sole on my slippers so I can go out on my deck to shovel off the snow refill the bird feeders, or run something out to my car if there isn't 2" or more of fresh snow on the ground. I found these BOB's while clicking around on Amazon's website and they appeared to meet my requirements for some new winter slippers. I originally ordered my usual size 8M since some reviewers stated they ran large once they arrived I tried them on I realized they fit me ONLY if I wore them barefoot. They were too small when trying to wear them with socks - even jamming my toes as far as possible into the toe box my heels barely fit into the back end of the slipper. I could tell the furry lining would not 'pack down' enough over time to allow an easy fit with socks. Thanks to Amazon's easy 'free exchange' program, I returned the size 8M at no cost to me and ordered a size 8.5M of the same slipper, same color. They arrived today and ta-da - my sock-clad feet fit perfectly inside! Despite an outside temperature of -1F and cool floors my feet are staying nice toasty-warm tonight. - There is some arch support in the insole probably sufficient for use as slippers for 2-3 hrs day. However, on my days' off I sometimes wear my slippers all day I may have to put a 3 4-length arch support on top of the insole to add the extra arch height my feet would require for prolonged use this slipper's insole is not easily removable .

VIDEOID 1976a43d71e126e24def2d1e9aeb651d These are the best slippers I have ever had. They fit snug and don't fall off. There is amazing arch support. They are warm no need for socks and they look good. These are a 10 wide. You can see my high arch in the photo. I have RA and it has caused my feet to be deformed. It's hard for me to find a comfortable shoe. They are firm but supportive. I wouldn't want anymore cushioning. Thanks Sketchers , you've done it again ! I love your shoes !
I like the way it feels on my feet. I ordered a size 10 wide and it fitted well. Its a very comfortable shoe.

Desperate for a comfortable slipper to fit my Fred Flintstone feet, I hit Amazon hoping to find a hard sole slipper that might work. I measure a 6-6.5 but because my feet are so wide a 7 W or 6.5 extra wide typically fit. Found these. Hmm, cute. 7W available but so is a 6.5 W. Bought 6.5 W, tight on my weird left foot, perfect on the right. Not so tight that I should return. I'll break these in. Came back ordered the 7W. Not only were they a perfect fit but sooo comfy. Started wearing the 7s to run errands lol. Met friends for lunch or drinks, decided to wear them. The compliments, an unexpected bonus! I am so happy with this find and definitely, definitely recommend!

I never can seem to find any house slippers that I like to wear due to me having plantar fasciitis Achilles tendonitis. But, these are just the best! Just look at the quality of them in the pictures I ve posted. It even has memory foam inside and feels great on my feet not at all too soft or too hard on my feet. I normally wear a size 7 in everything so that s what I ordered and the fit was perfect. I highly recommend if you want a good strong comfortable pair of house slippers would feel comfortable enough wearing these out as well.

I love the room for toes! I have been wearing tapered shoes at the toe area and I think because my toes don t have enough room that they are starting to become hammer toes. These have space for my toes to stretch out. I will be buying more.

I purchased this product a few weeks ago, and can honestly say these are my "go-to" shoes for everyday wear. Although I work from home and am inside most of the day, these shoes have a thick sole w traction, so you can wear them outside to walk the dog, to the mailbox, or look cute and stylish at the market or mall. because they have really good support. They are also very warm, so you can wear them with or without socks. The only minor issue I had is that they run a little large, so instead of a 6W, I will probably order a 6M or 5W for my next pair.

The came boxed in original Brand box. All tissue and contents were in place. They have amazing stitching and the soles are nice for Step outside wear. Nicely lined. I am very pleased and so glad I ordered 2 pair right away! The price was amazing so I had to! Note I wear a size 11 wide and they fit perfectly.
My favorite house shoe! So comfy looks great highly recommend. They run big. I would go down half to 1 size Fast shipping, no problems.

Bought them for my wife and she really like them except they put a sew in tag on the inside where the top of your foot is and she said it irritates her foot so she has to wear socks in them, no idea why they would put tag there anyway you can t even see what it says believe it s probably just size idk

I really like my Bobs however, when the description said, "Memory Foam", I expected there to be more than what is in the footbed. I expected to have a soft, sink-into-the-slipper feeling, and there isn't. It's a VERY think layer of foam, and unless you really push down hard with your toes, you can't feel it! I have pain in my feet all the time from neuropathy. It would have been nice for these to be a little more "squishy." I did buy a size bigger and a width wider, which accommodates my thicker socks, and the fit is fine with the socks on. They are very pretty and nice looking, and I love that I can go outside to take the trash out, etc. The sole is nicely treaded for that reason.

I have large feet. Size 12 is too big and 11 is too small. I love that these slippers came in a wide. I purchased 11w and these are the best fitting slippers I ve ever owned. My feet fit in them perfectly, they don t slide off, arch support is decent, and I have room to wiggle my toes. They also have a hard bottom which makes it nice if you forget you re wearing slippers and walk out to get the mail. I d highly recommend

I bought these to wear around the house while cooking and cleaning because all my other slippers would hurt my feet after hours of standing. I have plantar fasciitis and arthritis. Only been wearing them for a week, They're quite comfortable! They have a small amount of lift, they offer some arch support. I was surprised how heavy they are. I do find them more like shoes vs slippers, partly because of the weight. They have a huge toe box, even w socks the toe box is large. I ordered a 10 wide, which is typically my normal size depending on the brand and they are a bit big. Even w socks on my heels flop out a bit, but that's ok. I am a bit disappointed that they aren't warmer. I thought the fuzzy faux fur lining looked so cozy and warm, but my toes still get cold. Overall I really like them and I'd probably order again- I have yet to find any house shoes that offer good support like these.
A little large on fit but still very comfortable. Also tread on bottom is bonus so can wear them outside too.

This product was good overall, warm, strong rubber sole. However, they wear a little big and my foot is not comfortable unless I wear with socks. Otherwise, my feet come out and have almost fallen several times. Order a size down and then I think they will be perfect.

representative_reviews.text: I tried so hard to like these shoes. I did. I bought a smaller size as people suggested. I tried to wear socks with them. I tried to pretend that they were not slipping and sliding on my feet and getting looser each time I wore them. But they were. And its not good for my feet to wobble in them. I am in the process of multiple surgeries for my hip and just cannot have shoes unsafe for my feet. I love Skechers. And I want them to fit more than anything, because they felt so comfortable. But they just wouldn't fit. And I know I cant return them now. I dont have the box and I dont have the physical means to. I am sorry.
First time wearing and the glue's started coming out of the seams. Very uncomfortable to walk in I would not recommend to anyone.

After about a month and 1 2, and worn about a dozen times, the insoles are peeling out! Shouldn t fall apart so soon. They are comfortable, so I m disappointed that I can t wear them anymore. I wouldn t buy again.

What a disappointment! I was so excited to receive these. I read the positive reviews, saw the range of sizes and widths these come in and ordered a pair. I have a hard time finding slippers that fit me well. I had an injury on one foot that left me requiring orthopedic surgery for a severely pronated ankle. Since these come in wide widths, I ordered them and hoped for the best. These slippers would be absolutely the most comfortable, stable, perfect slippers I d ever found except for one thing...the tags! There s a sewn in tag on the inside sole. I removed those easily with sewing scissors. But there s another tag that s sewn into the fur of the upper. It is incredibly itchy and uncomfortable. It s plastic and I believe the stitching is also. I don t have sensitive skin or feet but this tag has driven me insane! It is so uncomfortable! I tried everything in an attempt to fully remove them they re on both feet. I tried using a seam ripper and sharp sewing scissors. The placement of these particular tags makes it nearly impossible to remove them. They re securely sewn into the faux fur upper. I can t really see or reach in there. I ended up hacking and snipping until I got most of the label out. Now there s a hole in that spot and the fluff is kind of falling out but at least I don t have stiff plastic stitches and a tag irritating my skin though there are still a few uncomfortable bits left in there, probably stitch remnants. I would ve bought these slippers in every color if not not for these horrendously uncomfortable label tags. I m so confused as to why others aren t bothered by these! Why were plastic labels sewn into faux fur uppers - WITH plastic thread? It s just intolerable! Are others wearing these with socks? Is that why people aren t mentioning this issue? If not for the itchy, stiff, scratchy, nearly impossible to remove plastic labels sewn into the faux fur uppers, I d rate these five-stars. But with the labels - these end up getting a most disappointed one-star rating from me.
The sole is coming loose and it s probably going to come out entirely eventually. Just had these shoes for a couple of months. Very disappointed
After wearing these for two days, the lining on the inside is separating from the sides. Since I ve worn them, I can t return them.

Ordered these slippers on 2 17 20 less than a month later they're falling apart! I initiated a return today, 3 13 20. The "fur" lining is rubbing off pulling away leaving the foam exposed. I only wear these in the evening after work so it's not like they're getting heavy use. I've gotten more life out of cheap off brand slippers from a certain big box store. Quality is terrible for 45 slippers that are less than a month old!

The only problem was the imperfection was on the right slipper big toe on the outside. Looks like the stitching was pulled to tight or was snagged in production. I'm going to keep them because I can't wait for another pair. This is my 2nd pair, they are comfortable and wear well

This is the second one I got with the same defect. Don t know if the second photo does it justice but the inside seam is coming apart. It is sticky and you feel it every step. Like I said I already order one and returned it for the same reason. This one is even worse as the last one it was only the left shoe the inside heel of the right insole is also peeling and there is fraying on both of the shoes where the rubber outsole meets the upper. They are comfortable but I don t think I will try a third time.
I bought three pairs in size 5 all defective returned but a five and a half also defective but past return and sketchers is ignoring me for a return of the fourth defective shoe all on the right foot

These look nice and the support is great. They are not super cushy but I want support more so I was happy. Then, after just a few days, something became exposed inside the left slipper and it irritated my foot. It did not raise a blister nor break the skin but it is very uncomfortable, even sitting. So, for a few more days I wore the slippers with socks inconvenient, yes, but less inconvenient than no slippers but now I can feel whatever it thru the sock. Back it goes, and I m not sure if I ll order another pair to replce this one.
I have had for 2 months the inside at the toes is coming apart making them uncomfortable. Only wear to take dog out in the morning.

I really wanted to be able to give these slip ons a five star rating, but it's not possible. I wear a 7 1 2 wide shoe. I ordered these in an 8 because 1 2 sizes weren't available. For me, the shoe is loose. The lining feels nice, but the shoe is loose. The real issue, and the reason for the 3 star is due to the two labels that are sewn in to the inside of each shoe. One label is sewn in where my heel sits. The other label is sewn in to the underside of the roof of the shoe where my little toe bumps it, even when I'm just sitting and relaxing. On the left shoe, both of those labels rub my foot. I even have a blister on the top of my little toe from that label that's sewn in under the roof of the shoe. The crazy thing is, you can't even see that label!!! Why? Why would you sew in a label where you'd need a dental mirror to even see it to read it? And why if you're going to put it in such a place, did you not ensure it would lay flat, and why not use label material that would be soft?? And why on earth would you sew it in??? I'm hoping that I can remove it with a seam ripper, without doing harm to the shoe. If you're going to buy these shoes, they do seem to be well put together, aside from the over abundance of label corners sticking up to prick your foot. They are warm shoes, and are anti slip on wood and tile floors. For me, they did run large.

I bought a pair of Bobs in January 2016 and I LOVED them and wore them until I finally had to order a new pair. I ordered them on March 7, 2022, and I had to wait until May 2nd to receive them. I was so excited to get them. About 2 weeks ago I noticed a spot inside the left slipper was irritating my foot, so I stuck my hand inside and this is what I found. For some reason the fur is pulling away from the side of the slipper, and the hard edge of the insole is exposed, and it HURTS!! Of course my window of return closed on June 1, so I'm stuck with 32.00 slippers that hurt my feet... Really disappointed skechers

Super cute and warm, supports a great cause. I had gotten them mostly because my apartment is so cold in winter layers of socks isn't cutting it and wanted something warm and cozy. Only these are missing the cozy I'm on my feet all day at work and when I put these slippers on my feet hurt even more which shouldn't even be possible ! Either sketchers are falsely advertising these by saying they're made with memory foam or the quality is going down fast. I used to LOVE this brand because the memory foam had lasted two years of constant use, but the shoes I bought a couple months ago only lasted two weeks and then I had to put in inserts and these slippers feel like they have NO MEMORY FOAM. I am now searching for new slippers. Again.

I have previously owned multiple pairs of more expensive house slippers. They have each lasted a year or two before needing to be replaced. This last pair did not last that long and began to cause pain in my feet from breaking down unevenly. I couldn't stand or work around the house without the lack of support making it not worth wearing them at all. I searched for too long to find a great pair! These are it! The sole of the slippers are rather thick. They handle running trash outside, stomping through the yard to catch a runaway dog, up and down stairs, cooking dinner, washing clothes, anything I've thrown at them, they've taken it. The interior is soft. They have shed a bit but overall comfortable. The only complaint I have is that the tag is placed directly under your heels. If you are not wearing socks, this can be annoying. Otherwise, fantastic purchase. I'm considering purchasing another pair as back up.

I love these shoes! I bought them when i broke both my legs and these were comfy enough to wear with my braces. I continued to wear them, and its been over 2 yrs. They still are in great condition and i wear them daily. Bought my 80 yr old mom a pair this yr and they are her favorite now too! Buy these! They are the best comfy shoes to run outside, to the store, or almost anywhere! These are my dailys.
Better than expected great in the snow I can shovel the driveway in these and they keep my feet super warm

I used to buy expensive sheep lined leather mules, but these are much more comfortable and afordable. I would definitely buy them again - except they are lasting so well!

This is the second pair purchased. The quality was such that I had no problem buying it when asked to purchase a replacement. The reason for replacement was not due to wear, etc. I would say the price seemed a bit high, but then it seemed a bit pointless to nit pick on this and try something else when the user was so pleased. I mean, if the cheaper ones didn't rate as well, then maybe cost has something to do with the quality difference. We've definitely had other slippers that were not in this class. The tough sole on these is a tremendous boon to longevity. The raised back is also a feature that affected this purchase. It helps the slipper not slip off at awkward times.

representative_reviews.text: I needed comfortable walking shoes for my upcoming Disneyland trip, but as soon as I put these on I knew they were not the right pair. They re fairly heavy, not lightweight at all. They also have a strange fit. The front toe part is tight, but the back ankle part is loose to the point that my socks would slide down off my foot. These would definitely cause blisters. I also sized up one based on reviews so the sole part fit, but like I said the overall structure of the shoe doesn t work. It s too bad because the shoe itself is really cute. I m very impressed! I have no back knee pain even after 12 hour shifts. These are much more affordable than other brands, are easy to clean, and provide moderate arch support. I highly recommend these shoes!

Review for the black multi floral - Use these Crocs clogs for warehouse work. Long hours of standing so good support is a must. Initially, it took a day or two to break in. They were tight across the foot when worn with socks. First night or so I had to remove my socks for them to be comfortable. Now they are comfortable with or without socks. Some sweating is to be expected because of the material but for me it has not been excessive. Wearing with socks also helps to keep sweat to a minimum. I could not tolerate working with sweaty feet. The arch support is excellent. I have plantar fasciitis so that support is a must. I do not need to wear any additional orthotics when I wear these clogs. I was opposed to the concept Crocs i.e., rubber shoes that are comfortable but I thought these were cute and they are a lot cheaper then Danskos. I still love Danskos but these work well too and fit my budget a lot better then Danskos.

I just got my shoes yesterday then walked 5 miles for my hospital security shift. My feet did NOT hurt and I have a high arch, am used to wearing 2 sets of insoles in my shoes, and have plantar fasciitis. The shoes were not as breathable as I would have liked which I read in other reviews, so I am giving 4 stars. So far, I would buy these shoes again!

If I wore these all day I'd have to find another shoe that has half sizes.
I got this shoe to work in the yard and garden. it is more comfortable than i expected, and i am very pleased with this purchase.

The only reason why I give it four instead of five stars is because they do make my feet hot because they are completely sealed to be waterproof. However, that is something I m willing to put aside for all that this shoe offers. They also have memory foam making them comfortable to wear. I have one knee that I ve popped out of place before, and these shoes are stable enough for my knee. The soles are also removable if you don t want them or need to replace them. I strongly suggest these shoes no matter what field you are in. I also wear these when it s rainy or snowy outside of work because they are waterproof and nonslip.

These boots are heavy duty but light enough to wear for long periods. They have a steel toe. I prefer a composite toe, but at least your toe is protected. Some people may feel these are a little wide in the toe bed, but if you have never owned a steel toe or composite toe boot, you don't want your toes rubbing against the hard toe enclosure. In a regular shoe there would be some "give" but in a steel toe there is not--so you need a little extra room. Size I had to go a half size up. I'm a 7. I went to a 7.5. I have a very wide foot, but the regular M width was perfect. Comfort There is NO arch support. All work boots should come with an arch support but for some reason, they no longer do. In a work boot your foot needs to be supported both at the arch and the ankle. I still have the arch supports that came with my late 1990's Sketchers work boots, so I will use those. The foot bed of these boots is Memory Foam. It feels ok. The only thing I worry about is the gel in the memory foam can sometimes get cold if it is really cold outside --then your feet will feel cold. The Ankle is a little high on these. The front part of the ankle could have been more padded. They might need a little breaking in. This boot will rub on the front of your ankles. I guess thicker socks will help? The Shoelace will probably will not last too long. The old Sketchers came with 2 sets of REALLY GOOD work boot laces in two different colors. I may still have a pair stashed in the back of a drawer somewhere that I can switch with these. Waterproof I have not yet had the chance to see how they hold up in wet conditions. I may just water- proof them myself to be safe. I guess they just don't make things like they used too. But compared to any other women's work boots out there these are tops.
