representative_reviews.text: Most reviews are from right out of box and don't really give real indications of durability just "it looks durable!" To be fair though me and my job are pretty demanding on footwear. The fit and comfort were great, still are, I didn't even need insoles. They're comfortable enough to sleep in. Up to about a month ago everything was still going well, tattered on the toes but hey they still have a layer of steel to get through. Then the plastic in the back of the heel broke and last night I found a tear in the leather just at the base of the sole. I was not struck by metal or anything in that area it just looks like a rip in the leather. The rest of the boots are still in great shape so I'm going to stick them up and try to get a bit more use out of them cause I did really like them out of the box.

The memory foam when new makes it feel like you're walking around in wet shoes all day. It's absolutely awful. Then, the night of the first day of wearing them, I get home and take them off just for the memory foam to somehow get stuck to my sock and completely come out of my shoe... I wasn't able to return them because I HAVE to have steel toes in order to enter the building and I could not afford to sit out another week or 2 waiting for replacements... so after about a month of wearing them, the memory foam is completely flattened out. No more wet shoe feeling, but also absolutely no support. My back feels absolutely terrible all the time. This was such a waste of nearly 100. First photo is the first night the memory foam slipped out of place Second photo was taken today. It has tape on it because the end ripped open and started getting stuck on my sock throughout the day.

Major disappointment. I bought these shoes just over a month ago for work. Randomly one day, the sole started to come off, so I used some shoe glue to fix it. Then, that wore off and it broke again. Had to buy a new pair from Walmart. wasn t worth the 80 in my opinion.

These shoes were stiff and very heavy. Ankle cuff rubs right on ankle bone. They cut off circulation as they move around on ankle. I can t wear them. I doubt they will break in . I would return but window has passed.

Not sure if I got a defective pair or if they're all the same but the design of the boot is potentially flawed. The area inside where the 2 parts meet juts out so it rubbed my tendons raw even with thick socks.
This shoe put blisters on both my ankles and the back of my heals. And they made the bottom of my feet hurt so bad

Came scuffed. They're so wide they're clunky. Added heel inserts to keep my feet in place and avoid more heel blisters. Steel plate is curved and low can't really move toes, so they're always sore. Super weird fit. No breathability whatsoever.
The shoe itself is made well but the insole are not any good my feet are hurt especially my toes and I bought a large enough size. It s just from standing all day.

After wearing good expensive work boots, with support, these were a real let down after reading the reviews. I wore these for a 9 hour bartending shift yesterday and my feet were killing me at the end, and my plantar fasciitis flared. This isn't a breaking in thing, these boots just have no support, and don't work for my feet.

If I had realized they were not returnable I would never have purchased them. They fit very strangely, the boot seems short, my toes hit the front but my foot slides around side to side. They say relaxed fit which I thought would give room for thick socks but these are more like a Wide. The customer service representative I chatted with acted like the non-returnable information was easily seen. I had to hover my mouse over a small line on the product page to have a little box come up saying it was not returnable. So now I'm stuck with boots that don't fit me. The quality isn't great, the seam where the boot meets the sole is glued only and not smoothly so they will split with wear. The cushion on the boot seems like it will get hard over time but is spongey new. I can't speak to what their long term wear will be like because I can't stand them as is.

First off, I put in on average 116 hours every two weeks for warehouse work. I am on my feet 10 hours a day. The memory foam insole that comes with the boots were useless the very first day. I had a very difficult time breaking these in and the metal plate started to sink and rub against the top of my toes causing blisters and skin to go missing. After 6 months I am in dire need of new boots but it will not be this brand. The steel plate that goes on the bottom of the boot is broken and the interior is deteriorating. I am only giving it 1 star instead of zero because the safety toe does work. Still don't buy these boots.
Not very happy. A month after the purchase of these boots and a day past the return time, the steel toe in one of the boots started poking into my foot.

I was excited to try out these shoes because of the amount of good reviews. I was highly disappointed. They started falling apart after barely wearing them for two months. I work in construction and they just couldn t keep up I guess. The back heel of the right shoe has worn completely off as seen in the pics and now rubs and puts holes in my socks. Would not recommend for work in construction.

I bought these boots for work, thinking they would last me at least 6 months. I bought a similar pair a few years ago and they were great for 2plus years. This pair are just falling apart on the inside and hurt my feet enough for me to cringe at the thought of having to wear them while on my feet all 8 hours of my shifts. I will not be purchasing these again.

First let me say I love the fit of these boots they are very comfortable. I have been wearing them to work just short of 5 months now and the inside heel area is falling apart. The lining has worn through and the insulation between the lining and the outer leather is gone....I have had work boots that lasted over a year, this is ridiculous. It's both boots, exactly even. Don't waste your money if you truly need a steel toe work boot. I have actually made a complaint to Skechers, I am really disappointed in the quality.

I dont typically write reviews but I want to help some sisters out. I had a hell of a time trying to find decent work boots and all the reviews I read on every boot I looked at were NOT helpful. So hopefully this one will be. I am a tile installer, I'm on my knees every day and put SO much wear and tear on shoes. After my last boots were pretty gross I looked high and low for a new pair and came across these puppy's. So here's my breakdown of these boots. I'm typically a 7.5 for flats and an 8 for heels. I ordered a 7.5 and they were roomier than I wanted but they still fit fine. I was use to a tighter boot but after getting use to it and some cheap insoles just to life my foot up a bit they were totally great. THERE WAS LITERALLY NO BREAK IN!!! from day one these boots were SO comfy. Omg! The padding in the boot is like a little pillow. I never had ONE blister or sore feet!!! I was seriously thrilled. Even with being roomy and the steal toe they are seriously comfy boots. I've had them since last September. They still look great and have held together so well! The leather isn't even close to exposing the steal, and all the seams are solid. Theres extra leather where you bend at the toe and the sole is nice and thick. It has been really hard for me to find a true womans work boot but I'm sold on these for life. I will absolutely buy them again. They are comfy and sturdy and I couldn't ask for anything else....oh and they're also kind of cute in an ass kicking way.
I work in all weather, they are comfortable to stand in for a long time and they aren't falling apart

Wore these 5 days week on construction site for about a year. Continue to wear them at least once a week now. Held up well, all-day comfortable, not too heavy. Could use a little more cushion inside, but overall a good buy.
Sturdy comfortable leather boot with non-slip sole. My last pair lasted many years of heavy use. Thank you Sketchers for a sturdy woman s boot.

Have worn these shoes for the past 2months while working at a greenhouse and they've held up well. They have held up well dealing with water havent torn or dented very much from gravel and me tripping on things one warning though For those of you with high arches like me be aware that there isn't much support and you'll have to tie the laces pretty tight if you don't want you ankle moving around in the shoe

Love them on my feet as a ups driver and they work great. I can see why some people say the support isn't that great. I think that it could be fixed by making the foam a bit more ridged. Over all they are good.

The shoes are well constructed and have a professional style. I am not a sporty person so I like the business look. Thank you for a good pair of shoes, and I continue to appreciate your excellent business.

Very good quality. I got the dark brown and I love that it hides the oil stains. I love the memory foam but over the past few weeks, it's become more squished so I may replace with a better insole. Very happy as I work 10 hour shifts on concrete. Good deal!

Great material and super comfortable. I work in construction and I'm up all day. These boots offer a lot of support and I didn't had to break it in, that's how good they are, also they are really affordable.

I bought this boot for my warehouse job. I ve had them around 5 months so far, and they ve held up well. They are showing scufffing and knicks but nothing polish cant help. They re comfortable, well built, and look very nice. With the wear and tear i it on them daily I expect them to last around 9-12 months.

Bought these for work as in an engineer on the floor and needed the steel toe. The memory foam in the sole is sooo comfortable, makes me love wearing them. I also get asked if they're timberlands all the time lol the shoe is very good quality and well made especially for the price. Props to sketchers.

I have been using these boots since Feburary of 2019 I am writing this review at the end of October. It is an amazing work boot and the steel toe is none like any other, especially for a women's shoe from SKETCHERS of all places! It keeps insulation pretty well for those cold days and isn't too humid on hotter days. BUT I have been working at UPS, centering my time in a factory warehouse setting. Although the comfort of these shoes is incredible, it does not last very long. I am about to purchase my third pair of boots because of the wear and tear I have had on the inside of the shoe. The most common places for wear and tear are the heels, which result in plastic chipping off the inside, and the memory foam literally dissipating. Although this can be annoying, I am still loyal and committed enough to the comfort and usefulness of this shoe to buy a third pair! Just be ready to replace about every three to four months depending on your level of use!

I wear these every day on my job site, so it's important that they're comfortable and light. Very happy with the way they fit and the way they feel on my feet- not too heavy or chunky. They do a good job of keeping my feet dry clean even when I walk through mud puddles. This is my second pair and I'm very happy with them. My only complaint is the sole wears down and really affects the wearability is that a word? BUT it's an easy fix to replace and make them last as long as possible!
Not good on cement floors! Flat feet people need shoe soles! Don't work more than 8hrs in these boots.
I am a geologist on a rig and these boots have seen a lot of wear and tear in the short time I've had them, but they have been amazing.

Don t waste your time. I bought these to do yard work in. 2 hours of raking leaves and the inside has fallen apart. I got more longevity out of my 30 pair from Wal-Mart. I d give a negative 5 stars if it were possible. Ridiculous.

Very good quality. I got the dark brown and I love that it hides the oil stains. I love the memory foam but over the past few weeks, it's become more squished so I may replace with a better insole. Very happy as I work 10 hour shifts on concrete. Good deal!

the shoes is very good made The bonus they also look nice they re very comfortable to where I would definitely buy again I m on my feet all day with and I have no complaints about the boot I also had to do a bit of work where there was about 3 to 4 inches of water in my feet was dry as a bone didn t seem to have any problems with that so all in all it s a really good boot. Thanks

Great material and super comfortable. I work in construction and I'm up all day. These boots offer a lot of support and I didn't had to break it in, that's how good they are, also they are really affordable.

representative_reviews.text: I purchased these shoes a couple of times. Every pair has an issue with the plastic support frame around the heel. The plastic gets exposed through the inside fabric and rubs' against my foot causing a blister. This happens after just a few times of wearing them. Maybe just my foot does it, just letting people know

After wearing these shoes in the house for a few weeks during the return period I used them outside. I had pain in my large toe and just ignored it, thinking it was due to an old injury, however, I wore the shoes during a long drive and the toe was really hurting. when I took the shoes off and wore some old Brooks Dyads same size the pain was relieved. Quite unfortunate for me as the return period has lapsed and I am stuck with shoes that are sized wrong.

I have used Gel Nimbus for many years buying every new version. I typically put on 250-300 miles before retiring no issues at all. The 22 gave me top of the foot pain and after 25-30 miles and once at 100 full Foot Extensor Tendonitis. I reached out to the seller, Amazon and Ascis and they all told me there is nothing they can do. We runners count on the shoes staying the same thats why we tend order to keepo ordering what works. I guess its time for a new brand after retiring over 15 pairs of Asics. Any recommendations? I need neutral that can fit orthopedics.
The toe box was to narrow and there did not seem to be much cushion under the fore foot. I expected a softer experience, and ended up having a sore spot on the ball of my foot after a 3 mile walk.

The pros on this are few. I really liked the color of this shoe and its appearance After that, there's not much to write home about. Shoes are a bit narrow snug. There is a lot of shock absorbing rubber at the sole, but the inside of the shoe was a nightmare for my heels. I have plantar issues, and the heels in these shoes seemed designed to remind me of that with every step. As someone else mentioned in another review, it seems as though the heel in the left shoe is particularly painful. For the price, the upper is poorly finished. My 40 skechers were way more comfortable and durable I just wouldn't run in them, as their soles leave something to be desired . I bought these shoes, because I needed something that would be easy on my heels. These are definitely not that, and I suspect that the positive reviews are from folks who have no pre-existing issues with their feet.

This shoe is a little small, hurts my feet and seems to force me to walk jog on the outer edges of my feet and is now affecting my back. I'm having back problems from wearing these shoes. Unfortunately I did not wear them often enough to find out the problem in time to return for refund. I'll be throwing these new shoes away.
Hardly 6 months of occasional use and the right shoe is already worn off with a small hole on top right

They are very comfortable and supportive shoes and relieved me of most of the pain caused by over supination and Plantar Fasciitis, but after just 3 months of normal use, the outer mesh started to rip from more than one place. This never happened with my previous Asics. They are obviously too flimsy on this one.

These are the worst shoes I ve ever purchased. I walk 6 miles a day. These are advertised as very cushiony, just the opposite. I wore them 3 days straight. Giving them the benefit of doubt. The toenail on my right big toe will probably fall off. They are shorter in length than my standard 11.5 shoes this creates friction with the big toe. My knees, feet, ankles and back hurt from walking in them. I m sending them back. Going back to my Hoka One One s.
This the 3rd pair I bought of the same kind but first time this ever happened but the shoe is the most comfortable walking shoe I ever bought.
After only two months of casual walking this shoe has ripped would not recommend. Unfortunately my date to return has just passed in Jan.
This is a decent and comfortable running shoe. It has thick cushioning. It fits a little large for its size though.
The left shoe fits and feels great. But bottom of the right shoe is warped and causes foot pain. Never again.

I got these based off reviews solely since most stores were not open to try them on. The fit and cushioning feel great. But after about 2 miles my feet start BURNING. It may be the insoles they have with them, so Im going to try other insoles. But so far im not thrilled with what they came with.
These are terrible running shoes. I ve had them for 3 months and there are tears on both shoes. These used to be great shoes and now the quality is beyond awful. I am very disappointed.

Soft, cushiony, comfortable, and great for concrete or other hard surfaces. My gripe though is that this really feels like it was designed for heel striking. As I tried to stay mid foot to running on my toes I noticed that my knees would begin to suffer, something that doesn't happen with my free run 5.0s. If you're in to low profile lightweight shoes I wouldnt recommend this, but if you're used to or need a shoe that's very absorbent and bouncy this is for you.
Cushioning has never been the same since the Nimbus 17. Now with the 22, it's finally back! Hopefully Asics will keep it that way.

My last Gel s were shot and my feet and arches started to ache. Ordered these as replacement and the ache s went away. Love my Gel s! We walk about 20 miles a week and I wouldn t do it without them. Fit perfectly!

Nice shoe but the arch seems too high which causes my foot to lean outward. It feels as though my foot is on an angle and the tread under the shoe is worn toward the outside edge. I believe this is due to the high arch design. It s comfortable.
Great arch support here. I typically alternate between ASICS and Brooks and I am very happy with these.
Everyday wearing for work , I am a vet tech and am on my feet for 12 hours aday on concrete and I am a big guy at 270lbs best shoe I ve had in years.
Exactly what I wanted, fit well, good support and look good. Use them daily for walking and running. Will buy again.
Shoes are very comfortable. I bought them bc I have plantar fasciitis. They help tremendously with comfort and support. I will definitely buy again!
Perfect for high arches! Feels like I have good support for once. I transitioned from the Keyano and am very satisfied. Same size worked! Oh toe box feels very open and free, I like it!

I've put a few hundred miles on these Nimbus 22's, and they're just as good if not better than the previous versions of the Nimbus that I've owned last version was the 14 . I read a LOT of reviews before buying this version, and honestly it seems like dedicated Nimbus runners are 50 50 split on this version of the shoe. Some people LOVE them because they're similar or better to past versions of the Nimbus, others swear that the Nimbus shoe has gone downhill since version 17 18. Personally I've owned 3 pairs of Nimbus since my first pair of 11's, and they've never failed me. ALWAYS worth the 150 spent, and I'm usually able to put a few thousand miles of road running on these before they need replacing. I compared side-by-side with the increasingly popular Adidas UltraBoosts and this shoe wins for true running hands-down. I even converted a friend from Ultraboosts to Nimbus after he tried mine on and ran a lap around the block. Ultraboosts are very comfortable and have a lot of "cushion" underfoot, but simply lack the support and structure that really makes the Nimbus shine as a running shoe. I've tried every Nike, Adidas, Brooks, Saucony, and Asics shoe over the last few decades and the Nimbus continues to rule them all. I'm now a part of the cult following! Keep in mind that since Asics is a true running shoe brand and not a fashion brand their shoes are created to custom-fit your foot based on your level of pronation. I attached the Asics chart to help illustrate which shoes are designed to fit each level of pronation. Have a look and take advantage of Amazon Free Returns to try a pair on!
These have a little more cushion than the Kayano. I ve been using this make and model for 3 years now, replacing once a year. Comfort, look, and performance all 5 stars. A runners best friend.
Only had these for one short run 3 miles , but they do provide very cushioned support. Fit seems good too. Upgraded from my previous Gel-cumulus shoes to see if more cushioning would work.
Love this shoe! The fit is very supportive cushioning superb. My sensitive left knee is so glad that I m using these during workouts!
I have terrible calf pain and and these were perfect ankle support to combat that. Ran 5 miles first time in a while.

The shoes arrived in their original packaging and looked exactly as pictured. There's a ton of cushioning around the ankle, and the same is true for the sole. The arch support wasn't quite as pronounced as I had expected, but I haven't had a chance to go for a run yet and determine if this affects my endurance.

size.issue_summary: 사이즈 관련 문제로 인해 많은 구매자들이 불만을 토로하고 있으며, 신발이 너무 크거나 작아서 불편함을 겪고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: This is a decent and comfortable running shoe. It has thick cushioning. It fits a little large for its size though.
Fell apart after 4 runs. Not pleased. Must be a knock off because I have never had a pair of ASICS do this after four runs

After wearing these shoes in the house for a few weeks during the return period I used them outside. I had pain in my large toe and just ignored it, thinking it was due to an old injury, however, I wore the shoes during a long drive and the toe was really hurting. when I took the shoes off and wore some old Brooks Dyads same size the pain was relieved. Quite unfortunate for me as the return period has lapsed and I am stuck with shoes that are sized wrong.

I have always found that Asics shoes run small so I have bought the next size up. My recent purchase was no different and still they didn't fit so I sent them back, too small, too narrow. If I'm paying that kind of money for shoes they better fit like a dream.

Had purchased the Gel Excite 7 previously in a size 9. Great fit. Ordered the Nimbus in a 9W since I would be using it more for running. Toe box is smaller than the 9 regular of the Excite 7. If you need a wide fit, think about the Extra W size.
These are terrible running shoes. I ve had them for 3 months and there are tears on both shoes. These used to be great shoes and now the quality is beyond awful. I am very disappointed.
The toe box was to narrow and there did not seem to be much cushion under the fore foot. I expected a softer experience, and ended up having a sore spot on the ball of my foot after a 3 mile walk.

The fit is a little funky. The insert is contoured in a way that doesn't follow the form of my foot very well. The only way I get get it to fit well is to make sure the heel is locked into place. Kind of unforgiving in that sense.

Fit too long tall, too squishy, tread too likely to catch trip and collect dirt, fabric and lace holes seem prone to tear as other reviews say with no metal reinforcers, and color design in the black tiger stripe not neutral enough for varied use. My shoes size is 7. But Nimbus 15 had to use 7.5. Just tried model, Nimbus 21, and the 7.5 length was good but since upper part of lacing was narrow, I had to exchange for a 7.5 Wide. This model, 7.5 length a bit longer, toe box higher, so may need a 7. Standard width was sufficient. If you like squishy and more height to sole, this model is good. If you like firmer, 21 is better.
These sneakers are super comfy! Great for working out however at the top it is a bit narrow I am hoping that they will stretch with time.

This shoe is a little small, hurts my feet and seems to force me to walk jog on the outer edges of my feet and is now affecting my back. I'm having back problems from wearing these shoes. Unfortunately I did not wear them often enough to find out the problem in time to return for refund. I'll be throwing these new shoes away.
This shoe looked great. It was both too short narrow so I cannot go into any comfort description. They were returned within 24 hours
Was a half a size to small. I bought a second pair of The same exact shoe that I already own. Same size. Lack of quality control.

Unlike many others, I do not use these shoes for running and have them for normal everyday use as I have with multiple prior Asics shoes that have all lasted 1.5-2.5 years before I need to replace them. Currently in only the right shoe I have a quarter sized hole appearing as the fabric for the toe box is tearing apart. I cannot recommend going with this particular shoe and will instead replace it with a different model of Asics shoe that is more durable. Avoid this model of shoe if you can. I love Asics and they are my go to for everyday and my workout shoes, but this one can easily be skipped.
After only two months of casual walking this shoe has ripped would not recommend. Unfortunately my date to return has just passed in Jan.
Love the fit! Snug on the instep and roomy toe box. Neutral shoe that can be very stable with Superfeet insole. Used to run in them, now I walk in them.
True to size, although soles felt firm. Ultimately decided on brooks glycerin for comfort and breathability of shoe.
Perfect for high arches! Feels like I have good support for once. I transitioned from the Keyano and am very satisfied. Same size worked! Oh toe box feels very open and free, I like it!
It is snug...with thin socks expected with 10.5 w..wide..maybe 2 w might have been better..if i could try them on..in store fitting hard to find w let alone 2 w...but fine for now..fk
My boo s got fat feet and a neutral step and he says these are porn for his feet. If yo mans got wide fat feet definitely get that wide. He says the previous models ain t got nothin on these. BUY EM!
Fits perfect, best walking shoe ever. I usually wear a 9 wide in womens, but this men s 71 2 is perfect for me!!
Fits true to size, great shoe and this is now my 3rd pair of ASICS and my go to shoe. Excellent support, comfort and quality shoe!

I ordered the wrong size. Guess what, I have been wearing the wrong size for years, it turns out! These shoes are great, and reviews of their quality and support were accurate. They look great and feel like the high quality I had years before.
Great shoe. Son wears size 14 extra wide and fit can be difficult but not with these shoes. Good looking and worth paying up for. Well built!

My size 13 narrow feet with a medium-low arch have made it difficult to find the right running shoe. I tried on several other Hokas, New Balances, and Brooks shoes. Nothing felt like a good fit, but these ROCK. My heel is just locked in perfectly without needing to overtighten the shoe, so my toes have a great amount of movement up front. I did swap in a pair of Superfeet insoles, which made it this the perfect recovery, supportive shoe.
The shoe was not as comfortable as I would have liked. Also I needed a size bigger so needed to send back.

Are you tired of working out in poorly made shoes that make your feet hurt? I have long and wide feet and it's incredibly difficult to find shoes that are actually made to fit my size and width. These ASICS fit like custom made shoes. No more sore feet after running for an hour. I like them a lot. And I appreciate that ASICS makes long and wide shoes. So I just bought another pair. Ahh . . . . !

First things first. These run atleast a half size too small. I am usually an 8.5 wide.. I had to step up to a 9 wide for the fitment..however, for those of you who are patient enough to find the right size... this is a very rewarding shoe. It feels like I am walking on a snug cloud.. They feel fantastic. I worry about the mesh on the shoe holding up long term but only time will tell.. My feet are very very happy.. This will be my new everyday everything shoe..

No issues with the quality. Regarding sizing, due to its top being soft and roomy you can go for true to your size or half size up for roomier toe. The midsole is very stable and plush. Like walking on clouds Ok for midfoot strikers.

My husband got a pair of 22's after I had purchased two pair, already. The only thing you have to be aware of is the fact that they do run a bit small. Therefore, we always order up a full size to give us room in the toebox. Otherwise, these are great shoes. Wish Asics would fix their sizing issues and go back to their extra cushioning. Then their shoes would be outstanding!!

representative_reviews.text: The back heel on one of the shoes is partially collapsed so that the fabric and cushioning folds in on itself. Not what I expect from new shoes. Asics warranty return website page is broken, so I can't get a replacement
Fabric covering tow box tore in first two months. Light use and failed. Poly fabric holds dirt like a microfiber towel. Second pair with problems as well. Sole separated in one month on other pair.
Fell apart after 4 runs. Not pleased. Must be a knock off because I have never had a pair of ASICS do this after four runs

After wearing these shoes in the house for a few weeks during the return period I used them outside. I had pain in my large toe and just ignored it, thinking it was due to an old injury, however, I wore the shoes during a long drive and the toe was really hurting. when I took the shoes off and wore some old Brooks Dyads same size the pain was relieved. Quite unfortunate for me as the return period has lapsed and I am stuck with shoes that are sized wrong.
I purchased these shoes in mid December. They have less than 150 miles on them and already the shoe is falling apart on a material seam on the shoe. Don't buy!!

Overall I give this only 2 stars b c durability is no longer present in this product line. I've been wearing the Asics Gel Nimbus line of shoes for the past 9 years. The Nimbus 22 appears to be made from cheap materials. This product line used to be very durable, with no issues in the uppers or the outsole until the Nimbus 20, when I started to notice the uppers would slightly tear at the toe box near the little toe. But, nothing too major. But, my 22's have suffered not just a tear in the upper at the same location, but also the padding at the heel collar near the Achilles tendon bunches up over time with usage and starts to bulge at one area, causing discomfort and a heat spot to form at the bottom of my Achilles tendon. I work out in these shoes five days a week, running about 12 miles a week, lifting, and HIIT training. The problems started within a month of usage and after three months, I've decided to toss them.
Hardly 6 months of occasional use and the right shoe is already worn off with a small hole on top right

It's as if the uppers are melting. I've had the 2 months and they are starting to look worn out. The material is simply fragile. Like with so many products substance is sacrificed for hype. Thinking about Chuck Taylor's. Canvas. I would just like the shoes to last awhile.

Sadly it seems all athletic shoe makers have gone cheap with their materials. Unless you want to pay 200 a pair. Less than impressed for 100 shoes. They have no support, it's like wearing a sock with a rubber sole.

I'll never back to buy them again please see the pictures after less than 3 months using they are broken on both shoes sides !!! Amazing !!! I really would like the money back or at least a replacement!!! Do you think this would be possible? Thanks

I purchased these shoes a couple of times. Every pair has an issue with the plastic support frame around the heel. The plastic gets exposed through the inside fabric and rubs' against my foot causing a blister. This happens after just a few times of wearing them. Maybe just my foot does it, just letting people know

The quality and strength necessary to hold the shoe together is an embarrassment. My shoes were unable to last two months, even with shoe armor. The ability to withstand wear is nonexistent. The top and sides to keep from wearing out is impossible with the paper thin material. These were used to walk a dog several hours a day, good luck if you are a committed runner. Unfortunately , I will need to switch brands.

The top mesh on my shoes completely disintegrated after a bit more than a year of wear. I previously had very good experiences with Nimbus from ca. 2013, which lasted many years - so I wrote to customer service asking if there's a way of getting just the mesh repaired - and if not, which of their current line of product will be lasting more than 18 month, since I'd be interested in buying those. I don't need ultimate breathability, but I can't afford 165 every other year on running shoes. The response I got from customer service was a template to start a warranty claims process. I replied, stating that I had bought the shoes more than a year ago - repeated my questions , and asked for a confirmation they indeed wanted me to go ahead with a claim. To this I got another template-response telling me that they will assist me in obtaining a replacement product. So I finally gave in and submitted the information they asked for the claims process. To which I receive a reply telling me that "your shoes do not meet the criteria for a warranty, as you are outside the warranty period". tl dr the top mesh on these will fail way too soon, and the company is unable to tell me which of their current products won't have a similar issue
Only used these shoes for 2 weeks and already multiple rips in the shoe! Will be returning them and will write back if they do anything about it.
Loved the shoes, however, after only four months of light workouts, the fabric on the top of the right shoe has a tear. My last ascis pair lasted ten years. Very disappointed.
Great shoes so far, super comfy, great support and stylish, but it s only been a week. Get back to me in a couple of months

User of 10 yrs of this model. Great performance for running in terms of cushion and response. However the sole wearout is incredibly faster, it lasts around -40 previous models and the top mesh is very fragile easily breaking with some time.

I've put a few hundred miles on these Nimbus 22's, and they're just as good if not better than the previous versions of the Nimbus that I've owned last version was the 14 . I read a LOT of reviews before buying this version, and honestly it seems like dedicated Nimbus runners are 50 50 split on this version of the shoe. Some people LOVE them because they're similar or better to past versions of the Nimbus, others swear that the Nimbus shoe has gone downhill since version 17 18. Personally I've owned 3 pairs of Nimbus since my first pair of 11's, and they've never failed me. ALWAYS worth the 150 spent, and I'm usually able to put a few thousand miles of road running on these before they need replacing. I compared side-by-side with the increasingly popular Adidas UltraBoosts and this shoe wins for true running hands-down. I even converted a friend from Ultraboosts to Nimbus after he tried mine on and ran a lap around the block. Ultraboosts are very comfortable and have a lot of "cushion" underfoot, but simply lack the support and structure that really makes the Nimbus shine as a running shoe. I've tried every Nike, Adidas, Brooks, Saucony, and Asics shoe over the last few decades and the Nimbus continues to rule them all. I'm now a part of the cult following! Keep in mind that since Asics is a true running shoe brand and not a fashion brand their shoes are created to custom-fit your foot based on your level of pronation. I attached the Asics chart to help illustrate which shoes are designed to fit each level of pronation. Have a look and take advantage of Amazon Free Returns to try a pair on!
Great fitting, comfotable show. Very light, but with good support. The only negative is the strange black spray paint on the sides of the sole.

Tried these on at local sporting goods store, found them on Amazon for 40 less. I wear Brooks and Asics, these are the best Asics that I ve owned, very light, durable, and the cushioning is excellent.

I used this shoe in a retail environment since I do 10,000 steps on most days. It felt like walking on clouds. The mesh made it very cool. Far superior in comfort to my previous Asics Gel Venture 5. This shoe didn't last me six months. The mesh upper is very thin and is bare of any outer layers on the most vulnerable areas. Once snagged the tear will progressively get worse. I can't see this being viable for any unpredictable environments.
I have been having problems with my shins and knees hurting when I run on cement. A friend recommended these shoes and I love them. Played tennis for an hour and a half pain free.

No issues with the quality. Regarding sizing, due to its top being soft and roomy you can go for true to your size or half size up for roomier toe. The midsole is very stable and plush. Like walking on clouds Ok for midfoot strikers.
Everyday wearing for work , I am a vet tech and am on my feet for 12 hours aday on concrete and I am a big guy at 270lbs best shoe I ve had in years.

I found this line of shoes years ago when I was a runner. They're the only shoes that I've found that I'm comfortable in. I wear them as my every day shoes now and typically stick with them until I walk holes in the soles. For me they last between 2 and 3 years. I would have preferred the all black color option this time around but it was out of stock and I needed new shoes fast cause, like I said before, I walked holes in the previous pair after 2 years .
An Ascics wearer for 20 years. Trying new models after discontinuing the original 2000 series. These are a good option. Running days are declining but shoe is very adequate

I needed a high quality sneaker to use during long work shifts on a hard floor. These are absolutely amazing and provide me with the comfort and support I need. I am going to buy another pair for work and 1 for personal. Very Happy!!

I must admit, this is the BEST Running shoes I've ever owned in my whole life. Very light and gives that extra bounce. Also the foot support and stability that I need especially after a long run or walk.
This is the second pair of ASICS Gel-Nimbus I have owned. Very good cushioning sole and comfortable. Fast delivery.

Been wearing ASICS for a few years now ever since I got shin splints real bad from another well known shoe company. I went to a store and got fitted for my gate and never went back. This is my 3rd pair of ASICS. I still have the other two pair. the only reason I replaced them is because the gel and tread has worn down from use. I still have them though as there are no tears in the shoe.

representative_reviews.text: These shoes hurt my daughter badly - hiking in the Sierra in July. She said shows were the worst part of her trip - uncomfortable and made her feet bleed w blistards. Terrible shoe!
The gel sole insert is no longer being used and these did feel like my favorite Merrills. They hurt my feet. I returned them.

I waited to write this review so I would have a well formulated opinion. Unfortunately a few days too late to return them. These shoes are designed like sneakers. The sole is not hard it is flexible. That causes the 'heal" they designed as part of the sole to jab into the bottom of my foot when I walk. This causes pain. They are also so hot that it is uncomfortable to wear them indoors for any length of time. I had to buy insoles to make them more comfortable but that didn't help much. They are some what waterproof but not really as I found out on a slushy day. So these are not great shoes.

Tried it for the first time on a hike and my toes were squashed by the end of the hike. Can t return it because it s outside the return date. The toe box is small and the curve over the foot is too low resulting in squished and painful feet.

I needed hiking boots so I could be prepared for any surface. The boots are wide and insole is hard with no support. The back of the boot rubs on my Achilles tendon. I inserted an insole and heel lift and loosened the ankle area. Seems to help. The boots perform well on the trail but they hurt my feet.

I had the original version of this wonderful boot for many years but this version has an awkwardly placed uncomfortable arch support that had me removing them immediately. The color was mauve instead of the described blush or lavender, as shown online. The boot is attractive and seemed like it would serve it s purpose but the arch support is situated to the inside of the foot and felt like a stone. I have a high arch, but would have preferred no arch support to this, so I returned them.
Just a bad shoe, stiff no support.. I will never buy Merrill again! Two days later my feet still hurt.
product came defective. both soles were damaged. I noticed because they hurt my foot as soon as I put it in the shoe

My first trip out hiking in the boots and the top of my left foot still hurts 2 weeks later but my right foot is fine. I believe the "tongue" of the left boot may have been defective since I keep trying to put them back on and it hurts in the same place. None of my other shoes or my older hiking boots aggravate the area. So I am still on the search for new hiking boots and am super bummed these didn't work out.

I bought a half size bigger than I normally wear so there would be extra room, but after wearing them for 6 miles today, my toes hurt. I removed the insole because the arch support on the insole is so high that it made the boots painful to wear, and I have included a picture of the inside of the boot without the insole. It isn't even finished. I don't know how long these will hold up. I have stuffed the toes with rolled up socks to try to increase the toe area, but I don't know if that will work. I can't return these because I have worn them, so I'm stuck with an expensive boot that I can only wear on very short walks.

I bought these shoes after seeing them on several websites' lists of the best hiking shoes plus Amazon reviews. Initially these shoes seemed comfortable and had good grip on uneven terrain. The problem is the sole has virtually no flex, which puts a lot of pressure on your heel since you can't roll forward onto the ball of your foot as part of a normal walking gait. This unrelieved pressure on the heel causes foot problems. After a 7-mile hike in these boots, I was considering taking the boots off for the final mile to stop the aching in my heels. Returning these shoes.

I really don't understand the hype for the shoe. I bought a pair, and there was an annoying lump under my heel, almost as if the arch started too soon. I ordered a pair for my daughter, who has very differently shaped feet than I do, and she had a similar problem. Something about the design is off.

One boot is arch or material bad hurts my feet will return I always buy this brand. I thought this style was great deal. No way killing my left foot? I got 2 pairs at home diffent style lasted 2 years and 3 year hard use. Not these?

Great sturdy shoes... after a few hours my toes start to pinch. I don t think it s a toe box issue as much as something with the shoe soul padding. My husband says the same, he says his are broke in after a couple months of occasional wear. Ugh I m gonna keep them but no do overs in the future for sure.

Shoes arrived 10 minutes ago. As soon as I took them out of the box, I saw dry dirt on the bottom of each shoe. Sides of shoe are worn so obviously these were previous owned my somebody who changed their mind and sent them back. Sending back myself since I prefer clean, unworn shoes!!
Not sure if I like the arch support. Over time on a hike, I think it might feel like a rock in my shoe boot. Sof outside shell feels comfortable and hugs foot nicely

I usually wear an 8 in regular shoes and an 8.5 in hiking boots. I ordered an 8.5 but the Moab 2 felt tight plus the toe box felt restrictive. Since there was conflicting information in amazon comments size up 1 2 size, size up full-size I decided to go to a Merrell outlet store to figure out the right sizing Right sizing was up 1 2 size above your normal hiking boot size . So instead of an 8.5, I needed a 9. Perfect fit. The employee was very knowledgeable and helpful. Here's what you need to know about these boots. 1. Merrell makes this model in a non-waterproof style. This one, the waterproof Moab 2, "feels tighter" on the foot she said, than the other model, due somehow to the waterproofing technology used. 2. The toe box is smaller in style tapered than some of Merrell's other footwear like the model I link to below , but if you get the right size in Moab 2, it should just take a little bit of breaking in. Indeed, only part of one day for me. 3. The Moab 2 has a bit of a heel and a shank. That offers extra grip when on slippery slopes. It also has pronounced arch support. My experience of this is my foot feels ever-so-slightly like it's aimed downhill when I am standing on level ground. The employee confirmed it may feel this way. She also said that typically this style of sole fees good to people with medium-to-high arches. I have a low arch and am somewhat flat-footed. I would up buying the Moab 2 in a size 9. I like the Vibram sole, pronounced support in the sole, and I want to try something different. My experience of the Moab 2 is I feel sometimes a slight readjustment in my spine and even my hip muscles. It feels ever so slightly sore sometimes, but it may just be stretching those muscles. The employee confirmed the design is to optimize your spine posture. So I figure my other footwear may not have been supporting my frame properly. The employee also showed me a Merrell mid hiking boot that she said people with low arches like. Plus it has a roomy toe box. The Chameleon 7 Limit I decided to also buy a pair of those too I'm happy with my purchases. Thanks, Merrell!

I developed plantar fasciitis and Achilles tendinitis in the last year and have had to find new shoes with arch support and cushioning. These boots are perfect right out of the box! I struggle to find shoes that are comfortable and don t cause additional foot pain. You can feel the arch support as soon as you put them on. I ve worn them all day and still no foot pain the next morning. If you re looking for good hiking boots, I d definitely buy these.

I wore these to the shelter walking numerous dogs a total of 6 miles today through snow, ice, and slush with temperature max 35 . My feet were warm enough and DRY. Toe box wide and deep enough to be comfortable but not sloppy. Lots of tugging from the dogs today but my feet stayed in place without sliding forward and getting crammed in the toe.
I bought these to go on vacation to Montana. There were comfortable waterproof. I hiked all day in the snow. My feet were dry comfy. I like the arch support. I like the grey color.
these hikers have been a go to for myself, they are comfortable, this is the second time purchasing these,they are the moab
Hiking with Merrell's is always the best for me. Comfortable, good ankle support and arch, look great, soles are firm and well textured for all types of walking and hiking.
Wore these brand new out of the box for hiking and they were perfect. Nothing sore, just enough extra room to be super comfortable. Great ankle support and super stylish!

Good traction. Good fit. Enjoy the added height during rugged hikes. I use custom orthotics and foot bed removes easily for this purpose. The quality of the boots is excellent. Only comment would be to add some extra cushioning for the long hikes.

I also require a wider toe box than normal and this shoe provides that for me. I have worn these all day long and pleased to say my feet were comfortable all day. I haven't had a chance yet to go hiking but with the nice grips on the bottom I am assure I will have the security of stability while hiking.
My researched proved good love it very comfortable didn't feel like I was wearing anything light and easy i could run it it.

I definitely recommend this boot!

The grip was fantastic and no sand got in them either. My only complaint is the smell of my feet that began after about day 4. I was wearing them for at least 10 hours or day and did so for 12 days. I started spraying my feet with deodorant and that worked like a charm. No more smelly feet. Highly recommend these.
I love these boots. I took them out of the box put them on my feet and hit the trail. Super comfortable, good support I have a high arch and wonderful traction.

1 week before Puerto Vallarta and I realized I didn't have any hiking shoes! I tried to order them from a store first, but they dropped the ball on that one... So, luckily Amazon had it! I'm a women's size 9 wide, with wide toe box and collapsed arches. So finding the right any shoes is difficult. These fit perfect. Good arch support although, I still had to add extra, but less than other shoes . Toes fit fine, no cramming or cramping. Nothing went numb over time. Width was spot-on. The high top version this version of the Moab 2 really was awesome while hiking through the jungle. Little twigs, leaves, and who knows what else didn't get into my socks! We went through a couple watery areas, I don't think water got on them... But they definitely kept traction on slippery surfaces. Oh, and I can't say I recommend these for tight rope walking. I'm pictured in the back, definitely freaking out . But they will work!

It's a struggle finding shoes when you're a size 10.5, so I went up to an 11 and there's just enough room in the toe box for thicker socks. I'm in love with these shoes, so comfy!

It s not often that I purchase shoes that fit perfectly. I have wide feet and wanted to order 9W but they were not available. I ordered 9 regular. I have plenty of room around the toe area even with 2 socks. I also have high arches. Because of this I have problems getting my foot in a boot because the opening is not wide enough. I didn t have a problem sliding my foot in and the arch support was a pleasant surprise. Great arch support. Roomy toe area. Very happy with these Merrill s.

Update on previous review . Ordered when price came down . I ordered a half size up because of needing room for heavier socks . The fit is perfect. I ordered wide also . I have very wide feet . Great fit . Also very good quality. Very happy.

Ordered a half size up and they fit very well. Toe box feels great. Wore them today on a three mile hike, it was cool out and my feet stayed warm. So comfortable, no break in period needed. They are fairly light weight. I have a high arch and added an insert for extra arch support but actually it seems satisfactory without the insert. Not sure yet how they will work in the wet, first impression is they are a nice product. Seller shipped quickly and product is as described. Really like the granite color and accent colors.

These are my all-time favorite shoes. They were recommended to me after an ankle injury 12 years ago and I've worn them ever since. The arch fits my foot exactly plus they are roomy in the toe box. They are comfortable for everyday wear and for walking on pavement and uneven surfaces.

I have trouble getting wide in anything and having the toe box roomy enough. This shoe offered the 1 2 above what I usually wear so fit perfect. No break in was needed, shoe is comfortable and perfect for a hike
I wear a 7 sneaker and a 6.5 in a dress shoe. This US 7.5 boot fit perfectly. My foot is on the narrow side so it was roomy I just laced it tightly and it was a snug fit.

I have very sensitive feet when it comes to shoes. My feet are very flat and slightly wide and these were perfect! I purchased these in 6.5 true to size in both wide and regular and found the regular fit fantastically with my wool socks. I wore these for a week in Iceland and they were truly waterproof in streams and they kept my feet comfortably warm. I would highly recommend these!

I bought the wide toe box for my wide feet and the boot performed exceptionally for that! Unfortunately I can assure you they are NOT water proof. This I am very sad about. They maybe water resistant at best. Overall I love the boot and its performance.

durability.issue_summary: 구매자들은 내구성 문제로 인해 제품이 쉽게 손상되거나 고장나는 경우가 많아 실망하고 있습니다.
durability.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 뛰어난 내구성과 편안함을 제공하며, 착용 후 즉시 사용할 수 있다는 점을 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: These shoes hurt my daughter badly - hiking in the Sierra in July. She said shows were the worst part of her trip - uncomfortable and made her feet bleed w blistards. Terrible shoe!

The shoe box arrived this afternoon. Brand new shoes. However, as soon as I took the boots out, a piece of metal fell. It is the metal hook for the laces! See picture. The manufacture quality was so bad the metal hook did not even stay on the shoe.
The gel sole insert is no longer being used and these did feel like my favorite Merrills. They hurt my feet. I returned them.

I ve worn Merrell for about 10 years. All of those purchased at local shoe stores. They have always been amazing, very cushioning and supportive and never needed a break in period. Until this pair bought through Amazon. These feel like knockoffs. Right out of the box they squeak and don t feel like the insole is cushiony at all. The toe cover is much cheaper material than my previous pairs. There seems to be a sharp plastic thread or something that pokes the top of my foot in the right one. I can t seem to find it to clip it out. If this is the new and improved Merrell, I ll never buy another one. The last pair I bought was 1.5 years ago locally and those were as exceptional as the first pair I ever bought. These new ones literally feel like a 20 pair of Payless shoes. Sadly disappointed. I ll keep them to wear to work because my last ones were too worn out, but I won t be hiking in them. I ll try Keen or Solomen.

I am so upset with this purchase. As soon as I took them out of the box and tried on ONE shoe and the eyelet broke immediately when I tried to lace it up. I heard really great things about this brand so I m pretty disappointed.

I bought these boots because i was going on a 2 week long road trip where we would be hiking Zion, Bryce Canyon, arches, and the Grand Canyon. We even walked through a couple of streams and no water got through, awesome! They felt really good I was able to break them in pretty quickly and overall liked them. After hiking the Grand Canyon though I noticed they had started to break a little. I wasn t exactly expecting these to last me 10 years, but already breaking after only 2 weeks of hiking? This is supposedly a really great brand, my boyfriend has the exact same shoes and he recommended that I buy these. He s had his longer and this isn t happening to his.

Very unhappy with hiking boot fit never worn but was a few days past return date policy and thought I couldn t return them however fantastic customer service in person at r local Amazon store and with a live service rep they understood my delay in returning boots and refunded my money and set me up on how to send them back

I love the feel of this boot, however it is falling a part already, the front area at toes has come unglued and I have only worn them twice. The window to return is now closed, so I can't even return them. I was away on vacation and did not get to really wear them, except for the two times I mentioned, and they should certainly hold up better than this!!! Very disappointed!!!!!

I bought this pair for my daughter un December 2018. Seven months later, while she was out hiking, a wedge of the heel, about an inch wide and two inches long, broke off the heel. Pretty disappointing for Vibram soles and Merrill boots.

I waited to write this review so I would have a well formulated opinion. Unfortunately a few days too late to return them. These shoes are designed like sneakers. The sole is not hard it is flexible. That causes the 'heal" they designed as part of the sole to jab into the bottom of my foot when I walk. This causes pain. They are also so hot that it is uncomfortable to wear them indoors for any length of time. I had to buy insoles to make them more comfortable but that didn't help much. They are some what waterproof but not really as I found out on a slushy day. So these are not great shoes.
Just a bad shoe, stiff no support.. I will never buy Merrill again! Two days later my feet still hurt.
product came defective. both soles were damaged. I noticed because they hurt my foot as soon as I put it in the shoe
Very disappointed! Was breaking them in for a huge hiking trip and close to the trip date they started leaking. Only hiked in them 8 times or so

Shoes arrived 10 minutes ago. As soon as I took them out of the box, I saw dry dirt on the bottom of each shoe. Sides of shoe are worn so obviously these were previous owned my somebody who changed their mind and sent them back. Sending back myself since I prefer clean, unworn shoes!!

I purchased these boots for my wife. She loved the fit and support. However, there is a serious DESIGN FLAW that can cause wearers to fall and be injured. At the top of the lacing eyelets are metal hooks. These hooks are much wider and more open than those on typical work boots. The hooks can catch the tied laces of the opposite boot. This resulted in falls causing serious injuries. Beware, if this happens once, the hook is likely bent outward making it more likely to catch the laces again. Consider removing the hooks to avoid this tripping hazard.
This is the best product!! I had a pair for 9 years and I finally had to replace... I use them for hiking and in the barn sometimes.. highly recommend... one thing I would have a bit more shoe lace
Made well, not flimsy. I wasted money on Hoka's and Altras. I have osteoarthritis in my right foot. Really helps along with the carbon inserts.
Sturdy fit with good ankle support and excellent grip. Wore it after snow storms and was able to walk confidently
My wife loves them, they are like putting on a perfect fitting glove. virtually no break in, also not the first pair we've had. Sole has excellent traction on wet surface, snow and especially ice.
Loved these shoes. The colors are nice. The only concern I had no support for feet. I bought a thin spongey insole to put inside. Did the job. Made it softer without cramping toes.

Trying to wear down my 12 month old Beagle pup and decided we would start running together. We run on forest trails, no pavement. These shoes help maintain balance on rough, steep trails, the tread helps prevent slipping on muddy trails and there is sufficient ankle support to prevent twisting. The fit is my regular shoe size, the arch is sufficient comfortable my toes have adequate space to move and flex. I'm really pleased with these running shoes, they clean up well after my runs through the mud. Can't tell yet how long the shoe will hold together but for now I'm really happy with them.

My previous hiking boots another brand were worn out after 10 years and I needed new ones for my trip to dig smoky quartz in Nevada. I bought these Merrells and they were super comfortable and durable with no break-in period. Someone else on the trip had the same boots and she loved hers too.

I love the quality of this shoe. It is a well made shoe and is advertised as waterproof which has proven to be true. I walk through a great deal of water and it has protected my feet very well. It is also highly protective of my feet and has great traction. The only downside to the shoe is that I do have high arches and I have found my feet are tired after wearing them for several hours. They do not seem to support my arches. Also, I will need to buy comfortable inserts so that the balls of my feet are supported as they seem to hurt after wearing them. I am on my feet for 4-5 hours whenever I am wearing these shoes so maybe something with memory foam, not sure. Other than that, they are a good, well-made product.
Love them right out of the box! Great fit, comfort, and look. Very stable. Used on dirt and in snow. Very happy with the purchase.

Perfectly comfortable right out of the box. I had tried several pairs before I found these and had no time to 34 break then in 34 . I got theses the day I had to be on the range on my feet all day for 3 days in a row.
Love look and boot quality, but it ran slightly too short in length of footbed compared to my other boots . I may try the next size up if it goes on sale.

I love these boots! I have a pair for summer that's vented, and these are perfect for winter. The inner sole is removable and there is plenty of room for my orthotics. The ankle support is welcome and the outer sole is grippy and secure in wet weather.

It's hard to find well-made, good fitting shoes these days. While these are better than nothing, they still don't fit or walk as well as Merrells used to before they moved production to China. sigh. The inserts flatten very fast had to replace them almost immediately and the overall construction of the shoe is just a little on the ill-fitting side and not built for any measure of comfort. Too bad--Merrell used to be awesome and now, 3 stars is generous.

I bought these for my job. I work 12 hr days on concrete floors these boots are absolutely perfect. My feet never hurt. I didn't even need to buy insoles. One of the best pair of work boots I've ever purchased.
Good shoe. Good traction. Other reviews said size up half size and I disagree. Even with thick socks it is to big the half size larger.

representative_reviews.text: My girlfriend likes the color, the look but unfortunately she has to return it because the right shoe inside sole is defective

I really coveted a greenish hued hiking boot and spent hours searching for one. Sadly the pic is not true to colour at all and I received a dull grey shoe. Being situated in SA it is not an option to return as I will lose out on almost 150 in shipping costs. Really disappointed and frustrated and feel cheated.

I bought these for an upcoming trip to Ireland and so far, I love them. The boots are sturdy, lightweight comfortable. Looks like a well made and quality product. Fit true to size and comfortable right out of the box. Would love to see more color combinations available. Will likely buy another pair in a different color.
My researched proved good love it very comfortable didn't feel like I was wearing anything light and easy i could run it it.
My wife loves her new shoes. Wants me to replace more of her wardrobe since I seem to get it right ordering the correct sizes...
I love Merrell s. So comfortable and great support. I wasn t expecting the dark purple vs. the lavender advertised, but keeping anyway. Good thing I like purple!

Merrill s are consistent, affordable and do what they say they do. I do a lot of hiking and messing around in crappy New England weather and I never wish I had worn other shoes. The color variety was a nice addition. I say go a half size up only if you plan on wearing thicker socks. Otherwise these probably fit as expected, but I intended to use these mostly in the winter months.
Love the color design, the style, comfort and fit. Waterproof too! I wore them all day to break them in, before wearing on a hike. They were completely comfortable from the minute I put them on.
Love look and boot quality, but it ran slightly too short in length of footbed compared to my other boots . I may try the next size up if it goes on sale.

I love Merrell shoes. They are extremely comfortable the first time you wear them. Color is perfect. I usually wear Timerlands, but I saw these and had to get them. I have several pair s and love them all Thank you for making such well made shoes that feel comfortable from the first time they re
Used Merrel hikers for years...this model was not at all like previous quality. Uncomfortable right boot seemed irregular in the seams.

I have a very old pair of Merrill shoes....wanted boots....ordered Columbia.....big mistake......kept going back to this pair "should I spend this?".....I put them on as soon as i could....worked, outside..inside...inand ou of a car......many changes of terrain, turning feet to get in car.....if I was like my little daughter I would have worn them to bed..........great choice.......very good product.
Love these, right out of box. Cute color! And outstanding lateral and ankle support. Am very fussy with shoes boots since plantar fascia issues, and find these boots very good. Have boots, will hike.

I work in merrils so I figured these would be good and I am very impressed. I put them on when they arrived and walked 2 miles. Had them on all day today. They were comfortable, true to size and very light. I highly recommend for hiking or just running errands in the rain.

I've been wearing Merrill for years, quality excellent as expected. The fit was fine, but this boot is just a bit clunky and heavy for me. Still wear them, but have another couple of pairs is back up depending on the hike.
Merrell always has quality goods and fit well. I have the same pair in men s and my gf loved these. Her first pair of hiking boots and she has been putting some miles on them.

I bought these to wear everyday at work and to hike in. They were comfortable the first time I put them on. I chose to buy these bc I have really wide feet and these were offered in wide width. They are super comfortable, wide and supportive. I will never buy another brand. I also loved the color. I got the gray blue. They are more vibrant in person, which I was happy about. I definitely recommend this boot!
