comfort.strength_summary: 많은 구매자들이 이 신발의 착용감과 쿠셔닝에 대해 극찬하며, 발의 통증을 완화해주는 효과를 경험하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: This is my first time purchasing shoes from Amazon, was happy to see these Adidas slides at such a good discount compared to the price on their official site. Not going to lie, was worried about the possibility of receiving a pair of knockoffs, so I compared them to another true pair and, yes, they are definitely real! I normally wear a size 8 8.5 in athletic shoes, but since these are open toe slides, I like them to fit more snug, so they don't go flying off my feet. I ordered a size 7, they fit perfectly and there's still about 1 2" space in the front of my toes and behind my heel. I also have wide feet, yet I can still comfortably wear a pair of socks without them being too tight. So you may want to keep this in mind when ordering and possibly order a size down, like I did. The design is super cute, I love slides but am always on the search for more feminine ones, and not ones that look like my husband's. Love Adidas brand and was ecstatic when I saw these glitter slides. The description on here and the official site says "Grey", not sure why, because the base color is definitely more of a Rose Gold in the photo and in person, and not Grey. That is exactly what I was looking for so I'm happy, but if you are visually impaired, you might be disappointed to learn that they are not, in fact, Grey. Though the iconic 3 stripes are a Light Grey glitter, as described. These slides are listed under their "Swim" category on the official site, so safe to assume they are waterproof, but I have yet to test that theory in the rain or by the pool. Will update if there are any issues. Without a doubt, my most comfortable pair of slides. The Cloudfoam is super comfortable, my feet just sink right into the sole, unlike other slides where it feels like you're just standing on top of a hunk of hard plastic. The outer band is lined and cushioned on the inside, as well. So happy they took this into account because I've had issues with other slides digging into the tops of my feet, making them sore and causing red marks and blisters. Highly recommend these slides, whether you choose to use them indoor outdoor, they are very kind to your feet! UPDATE Loved these slides much, but after only a couple months of wearing them mostly just around the house the glitter stripes started to peel off. They did not have any contact with water, either, seemed to have started to peel where the band bends when walking. Very disappointed, expected them to last way longer than this. Was instructed to contact adidas directly regarding this issue, so not sure how it will go, but I will update accordingly. Though I definitely DO NOT recommend the slides after this and will not be repurchasing, unless they correct this issue in a future design. UPDATE 2 I contacted adidas regarding this issue and I have to say their customer service is absolutely amazing. Communication was very easy, and within just a few days they emailed me a return label for the slides and informed me that they'll be sending me a gift card to replace them. Very happy about all of this, I love the brand, but this just exceeded my expectations, I understand sometimes these things happen, so will definitely be a continuing customer. Thanks!

So I ve only had these 2 weeks, they got wet while I was watering the garden last night. We got in the car this morning for a 3 hour drive and 3 min in to the road trip all we could smell was rotten stinky feet stench. IT WAS THE SANDALS. So my husband pulled off at next gas station and threw them in the trash These are comfy but don t let them get wet!!!

Did not fit well. The left foot fit nice the right foot too big in width and little too long. The top part of the slides is also very uncomfortable plastic that cuts into my feet on the left. Poor buy.

The sole of the sandal is fine. They are lightweight. But the part that comes around the top of your foot awful!! I got these delivered and I put them on and went on a short walk to try them. I ended up getting 2 very painful blisters on the tops of my feet from the top part rubbing against my foot. My feet were nearly bleeding. Waste of money!

The strap SUCKS. it completely pushes your foot out and I had to return both pairs I bought. Size 9 my size was too big, size 8 can still fit in sometimes was too small. Super uncomfortable and hurt my ankles BAD. Please, just skip on this.

The original ones are very comfortable. These make my feet feel like they re twisted and cause blisters. I love the original Adilette ones. These are horrible. Wish I would ve tried them on sooner. Now it s too late to return.

I was really excited about these because I know how comfortable they are from other people, and again I have the same problem I always do. First, I have narrow feet, so I went down to a 7 when I m normally a 7.5 or 8. Length wise they fit perfectly. The soles are super comfy and I love that they re lightweight. But they are very wide on me. Even with socks they re almost falling off. Not just that, both sides of the band, front and back, dig into my foot with every step. I have sensitive thin skin so it gets irritated easily with certain sandals. I m hoping I can wear these a bunch with socks and break them in and hope they get better. Edit Broken in but now falling off completely even with socks. Narrow foot problems...you normal sized feet folks should be fine.

I wanted to love them, but I don't. The front of the slipper cuts right into your toes as you walk. The first time I ordered these, I got a 9. I'm usually an 8.5. Everyone was saying that they run big, so I figured that'd be fine. When I got them, they were basically an 8.5 9 and not as big as I had thought they'd be. They hurt a lot to walk in. So I returned them and purchased a size 11. However, they're still painful. I don't know how people aren't feeling the straps dig into their feet, but I definitely do. I felt this way with another pair of adidas slides that I attempted to wear. So, once again, I am returning them. I will not be buying them again. That's quite a shame, since the actual foot of the slipper is soft and comfortable.

Bulky looking shoe that uncomfortably rubbed the top of my foot where the top front wide strap fit too tight close to the foot with no padding there. The Nikes have padding in that top wide strap so they don't rub. For me overall, these athletic slip ons look way too big and bulky on me and the instep was way too high for me.
For some reason, the Simpsons slides are of a much poorer quality. Unlike every other pair, no padding underneath the straps!! Wth? Returned immediately.

Very disappointed with this purchase. They are either not authentic adidas or they are used and refurbished. Although they looked new enough, the slides arrived smelling very strongly of terrible foot odor. So strong it stunk up the living room. It went beyond regular stale packaging plastic smells. For the odor to be so strong these shoes must have either been worn a lot and refursbished but sold as new or someone with a serious foot condition wore them. Repackaged for a return refund as I do not feel confident buying a replacement from the same seller. They are back in the package and the smell is still so strong in the room.

These are different than the ones I got at famous footwear. They re a little more narrow and the strap is like half a centimeter more toward the toes than my other slides if that makes sense? They re definitely more snug and my heel is at the end. They re both size 7. I have two from famous footwear and they fit great. Won t be buying slides on here again.

Love the Lisa Simpson design, hate the actual feel of the slipper. Too mushy and my feet slide out too easy while wearing socks. I should have returned it but I thought I would get used to it. Never did though.

Not for wide feet. I wear a size 12 W and this shoe does not stay on when I walk because I cannot get my feet in all the way and they then slip off when you walk. Its a pity as i love the pretty bright candy pink colour and they are soft

I returned these. I opened the box, and the smell was overwhelming. Like fish vomit. I would expect some kinda rubber smell like new car mats or tires, or whatever, but this was horrendous. Still I put one on my foot just to see how they were and it was way too big. I usually take a size 8 sneaker boot and sometimes a 7.5 shoe. These were size 7 and would probably fly off my foot if I walked in it. Anyway, I put it back in the box, and my hand that I used to handle the shoe smelled! Closed it up and left the room. Came back into the room a few minutes later and the stink! Mutant! So I put the box outside until I could send it back the next day. Sad because I would have tried a size 6 had they not had that smell.

These adidas Adilette's are super soft and comfortable. They feel just like you'd imagine those candy orange Circus peanuts would feel like to walk on, lol. And the orange color looks like them even. I ordered a pair specifically because another reviewer said they took care of his plantar fasciitis. My podiatrist said to never walk around the house barefoot, but I couldn't see wearing my sneakers all day. I don't like my feetsies all closed up for hours! I hadn't found slippers that were supportive enough in the arches so thought I'd try a soccer slide. I tried a Nike one and some other off-brand one. Both had no arch support and were either too hard or otherwise uncomfortable. These particular adidas I feel like were meant to be indoor slides. They are very soft, yet very supportive. The only issue is they are HUGE. Luckily I listened to every other reviewer who suggested ordering a whole size down and they are correct. I wear a size 8 regular so ordered a 7. They are perfect length but still just a bit wide, though not so wide that my foot slides around the arch support keeps my feet in place. My size 8 feet are very average width never wear a narrow or a wide in any shoe. Hope that helps people. Order a size down! UPDATE 2 I ordered another pair, but for my sister this time. She wears a size 9 and I ordered her an 8. Perfect fit. She likes them a lot, though also said they are super soft, perhaps "too soft." UPDATE Okay so 3 days later, I've worn them just all through my house like slippers. I can feel them getting softer and even more flexible, so that now they are a bit TOO soft and flexible. My podiatrist said to wear stiffer bottomed ones.

Great! EXTREMELY comfortable and great cushion . Totally surprised by this purchase in all the right ways. Highly recommend . Update Just ordered another pair bc they stretched out. So beware! Original pair bought in May.
Unbelievably comfortable!! Stylish...super soft sole. I have purchased this style by top designers...Gucci...Givency. The price tag was huge and they hurt like hell! Highly recommend these slides
Holy soft, cushiony footbed!! I m a bartender so when I get off work my feet usually HURT. These are my go-to sandals for around the house when I get off. So so soft!

I purchased two different patterns of these shoes. These are the most comfortable shoes I have had in a log time. Provides the right amount of arch support. I would definitely recommend you give them a try.

I have goofed on folks for wearing these for years and I was wrong and repent. Not only did I get these, I got a pair for my boyfriend and he likes his too. These are better than flip flops because there is no strap between your toes or over your foot. They are comfortable. They are soft and squishy yet firm. They aren t hard plastic. They fit as expected and are slightly molded to fit the foot comfortably. They re true to size. I recommend these as house slippers because they aren t hot and sticky during the summer. They don t smell super bad yet. They re pretty inexpensive and I d assume they re easy to clean. I wouldn t wear these out of the house because at least three times one slipper has yeeted itself off my foot but your mileage may vary.
I wish there was more padding on the toe part but other than that I love these sandals. Very comfortable heel and arch! Definitely good for the price!

My husband has an Adidas cloudfoam slide sandals and he swears by it. So by the time I was looking for comfortable sandals to wear at home or on lazy days, he told me to try this one and it did not disappoint. This is the most comfortable slip-on I have ever purchased! I usually get heel pain when I walk or stand for a prolonged time, but I can walk with this pair the whole day with no problem very comfortable! . It s very light, soft, and at the same time supportive. I like its simple design and the trace maroon color like a pastel rose pink color, so feminine! . I definitely recommend this product and I will purchase it again in the future.

My podiatrist recommended these for my tired feet. I have 6 young kids. I run 12 to 20 miles a week, and do Tae Kwon Do. So my feet see some action! These shoes have great cushion and support! I use them as a house shoe since being advised I shouldn't live life barefoot anymore. They will likely be my go to sandal in the summer time as well.
Relief at last I had planters fasciitis and these super cozy slides saved my life. I even purchased a pair for my friends husband and a pair to travel with!

While this may be a little bit wide for my narrow foot, it is my go to when I come home from work with aching, painful feet. This is the ONLY shoe slide on that alleviates the pain, allowing me to stand! It is SO incredibly comfortable!!!!

I love this cloud foam technology! Really comfortable even when walking distances! I had to send back the first pair because they were WAY TOO LARGE even though that would be the size I would have normally used. No hassle return and then ordered a size smaller and perfect!

I bought these originally as something quick for errands or taking the dogs outside. They are SO comfortable, I may just use them as house shoes instead. The footbed is very soft, and provides arch and toe support while walking or standing. Absolutely recommend!!

I have a lot of pain and it's really hard to buy shoes that offer the right support AND are comfortable. Especially in sandals! My teenage daughter actually owned a pair and she's the one that highly recommended I get them for myself......I definitely owe her one! These are so immensely comfy that I was able to wear them all afternoon with now problems. Can't wait to take these on vacation! They do run a bit big so size down if you're a half size. I'm typically a 9.5 10 and the 9 in these is perfect!
My second pair of Adilettes. If I could wear them 24 7 I would. I put them on when I wake up and when I get home from work. My heels hurt with anything else and these just bring instant relief.

representative_reviews.text: This is my first time purchasing shoes from Amazon, was happy to see these Adidas slides at such a good discount compared to the price on their official site. Not going to lie, was worried about the possibility of receiving a pair of knockoffs, so I compared them to another true pair and, yes, they are definitely real! I normally wear a size 8 8.5 in athletic shoes, but since these are open toe slides, I like them to fit more snug, so they don't go flying off my feet. I ordered a size 7, they fit perfectly and there's still about 1 2" space in the front of my toes and behind my heel. I also have wide feet, yet I can still comfortably wear a pair of socks without them being too tight. So you may want to keep this in mind when ordering and possibly order a size down, like I did. The design is super cute, I love slides but am always on the search for more feminine ones, and not ones that look like my husband's. Love Adidas brand and was ecstatic when I saw these glitter slides. The description on here and the official site says "Grey", not sure why, because the base color is definitely more of a Rose Gold in the photo and in person, and not Grey. That is exactly what I was looking for so I'm happy, but if you are visually impaired, you might be disappointed to learn that they are not, in fact, Grey. Though the iconic 3 stripes are a Light Grey glitter, as described. These slides are listed under their "Swim" category on the official site, so safe to assume they are waterproof, but I have yet to test that theory in the rain or by the pool. Will update if there are any issues. Without a doubt, my most comfortable pair of slides. The Cloudfoam is super comfortable, my feet just sink right into the sole, unlike other slides where it feels like you're just standing on top of a hunk of hard plastic. The outer band is lined and cushioned on the inside, as well. So happy they took this into account because I've had issues with other slides digging into the tops of my feet, making them sore and causing red marks and blisters. Highly recommend these slides, whether you choose to use them indoor outdoor, they are very kind to your feet! UPDATE Loved these slides much, but after only a couple months of wearing them mostly just around the house the glitter stripes started to peel off. They did not have any contact with water, either, seemed to have started to peel where the band bends when walking. Very disappointed, expected them to last way longer than this. Was instructed to contact adidas directly regarding this issue, so not sure how it will go, but I will update accordingly. Though I definitely DO NOT recommend the slides after this and will not be repurchasing, unless they correct this issue in a future design. UPDATE 2 I contacted adidas regarding this issue and I have to say their customer service is absolutely amazing. Communication was very easy, and within just a few days they emailed me a return label for the slides and informed me that they'll be sending me a gift card to replace them. Very happy about all of this, I love the brand, but this just exceeded my expectations, I understand sometimes these things happen, so will definitely be a continuing customer. Thanks!

Did not fit well. The left foot fit nice the right foot too big in width and little too long. The top part of the slides is also very uncomfortable plastic that cuts into my feet on the left. Poor buy.
I know Adidas usually runs a little big for me. I'm a 6.5 so I ordered a 6. I totally could have used a 5.

Not for wide feet. I wear a size 12 W and this shoe does not stay on when I walk because I cannot get my feet in all the way and they then slip off when you walk. Its a pity as i love the pretty bright candy pink colour and they are soft

I bought these to be able to wear as a very casual, running around slide, something to slip on real quick to run out the door. They are very cute and comfortable but they run very large and wide. I bought my normal size of a 9 and they are way too big on me. I could very easily have gone down to an 8. They are so large on my feet that they came off while I was walking! It it too late to return them and it is a shame because they were exactly what I was looking for.
These shoes were fine...until they broke 3 mo the after purchase. I ll be contacting Adidas about this.

The sole of this shoe is incredibly comfortable, but while this is supposed to fit a woman's foot, it feels the same as the men's slide fits me that I purchased for my son. loose around the top of my foot The upper part of the slide also cut into the tops of my toes as it's not a smooth, finished edge. It's more like a "cut" edge. I don't wear socks with them So I'm slider-less, but my son has made out like a bandit and now has 3 pair.

These are different than the ones I got at famous footwear. They re a little more narrow and the strap is like half a centimeter more toward the toes than my other slides if that makes sense? They re definitely more snug and my heel is at the end. They re both size 7. I have two from famous footwear and they fit great. Won t be buying slides on here again.

I bought a women s size 10M and the tag said 43 cm and sized 10. Those two things are not the same! I was measured recently on a shoe store and I was 40.5 cm and a women s size 10...these are at least a size 11! The arch support doesn t even line up. They are very squishy but the arch which is kind of like a rubber ball under the ball of my foot, only pushes my foot up under the strap, not under my actual arch.

Nice comfy sandals. Three sizes too large. Never had this issue. Can see maybe one size off but this was ridiculous. Gave to my daughters boyfriend who wears them and he is a men s size 11. I ordered a women s size 9

I was really excited about these because I know how comfortable they are from other people, and again I have the same problem I always do. First, I have narrow feet, so I went down to a 7 when I m normally a 7.5 or 8. Length wise they fit perfectly. The soles are super comfy and I love that they re lightweight. But they are very wide on me. Even with socks they re almost falling off. Not just that, both sides of the band, front and back, dig into my foot with every step. I have sensitive thin skin so it gets irritated easily with certain sandals. I m hoping I can wear these a bunch with socks and break them in and hope they get better. Edit Broken in but now falling off completely even with socks. Narrow foot problems...you normal sized feet folks should be fine.

First, these adidas run a size large. I usually wear size 8 and had to return for a size 7. Be sure to downsize. Second, this light pink slide is made from cheap plastic. I will only be wearing it around the house. Third, after my first attempt to buy these slides in multiple colors I had to return all of my them and order a size down. Although, the website says they are returnable the company that sold the original pair of the mauve color makes you pay for return shipping. I found the same color for less from Amazon and ordered the pink as a replacement so I wouldn't have to pay return shipping. The material the pink is made of is nothing like the material of the other colors I purchased. It's not as comfortable as the others as well.

Would be 5 stars if they ran true to size. I ordered a size and a half smaller and they are still WAY TOO BIG. Am not returning because I no longer have the box, but if I did I would be getting another size down.

I've worn Adidas for most of my life and this is the first time I've ever had a pair not fit. I always wear a women's size 7 but in this shoe, it's too large. The footbed is comfortable but the overall sizing and styling are a miss for me. Overall appearance is too wide and the strap is too loose.

EDITED There also seems to be a stain on the right foot that is a deal breaker. I received a left foot size 8 and a right foot size 9. I'm super sad about this. I ordered a size 9 bc I saw the reviews said they ran big I'm usually a size 9.5-10 . The variance seems slight enough that I won't go through the trouble of shipping it back. These are really comfortable. Wish they were both the same size though.

Got these in half a size larger than I normally ware as I have flat, wide feet. They fit perfect and are super comfy and cute. Highly recommend, just size up a little! The color is gorgeous and the quality is great.

I am a 6 1 2 in heels and and 7 in sneakers but went with the size 6 slides and they fit like a glove.. they were tight the first time I wore them but after the second day they were sooooo comfortable..they are my fav slides rn

I have goofed on folks for wearing these for years and I was wrong and repent. Not only did I get these, I got a pair for my boyfriend and he likes his too. These are better than flip flops because there is no strap between your toes or over your foot. They are comfortable. They are soft and squishy yet firm. They aren t hard plastic. They fit as expected and are slightly molded to fit the foot comfortably. They re true to size. I recommend these as house slippers because they aren t hot and sticky during the summer. They don t smell super bad yet. They re pretty inexpensive and I d assume they re easy to clean. I wouldn t wear these out of the house because at least three times one slipper has yeeted itself off my foot but your mileage may vary.
I wish there was more padding on the toe part but other than that I love these sandals. Very comfortable heel and arch! Definitely good for the price!

This is just what I was looking for! Very comfortable and offer more support than a flip flop type sandal. I can slide these on quickly and they go with shorts, leggings, capris and causal shirts. I will say that they run large. I normally wear a size 8 in adidas sneakers and they fit perfectly. I ordered these in a size 8 and I have about an inch extra behind my heel. I recommend sizing down if you want a better fit!

I ordered my usual women's size 9 and they fit perfectly. I've been wearing these nonstop. They are incredibly comfortable and versatile. Look identical to the photo. The material is cushiony and good for walking. I did get a blister on my toe the first day, but I think I'm getting used to them now. They go with everything and I'd super-recommend them.

Im really delighted with my order. These slides were true to size, I can t wait to wear out. Not to mention, the insole is cushion which makes it very soft and your feet and comfortable. Would definitely recommend. Mines came in the adidas box too. I will certainly be getting more.
Shoes fit perfect, I went a half size down and they are better than expected. Super comfy and I love the way they look!!
Product arrived very fast, My daughter loves the soft sole and has been wearing them non stop, very welll made and fit is perfect

While this may be a little bit wide for my narrow foot, it is my go to when I come home from work with aching, painful feet. This is the ONLY shoe slide on that alleviates the pain, allowing me to stand! It is SO incredibly comfortable!!!!

A little wide and big on my foot. To be expected. I was unsure if I was ordering the right size. I ordered a size 8. My normal size is 7.5-8.. so if this is similar to your shoe size, I would order down a size!

I was worried these were going to be too large and the strap over the top would be loose but it fit perfectly! I ordered my size according to the Adidas chart online. These were also the exact squishy comfortable thing I was thinking of to deal with hardwood floors in the house. My feet don't hurt every day anymore. The name cloudfoam to describe the sole is spot on, it's perfectly springy and squishy! Very comfortable!
Very comfortable slip on shoes. Great quality. They do run large. I m a 7.5 and based on the comments, I purchased a 7. They fit perfectly. I would highly recommend these.

Wow! Very comfortable slides for kicking it around the house or some mild walking for errands. I was used to wearing the Adidas sandals with the rubber beads on the footbed and those would kill my feet. These things feel like marshmallows when you slide them on. Give em a go you might like them! I wear a 8.5 B in sneakers and ordered an 8, and still have plenty of wiggle room. Note Only downfall is the there is no adjustment strap across the top, so it could be a little inconvenient for narrow or wide feet in terms of adjusting. They seem to feel true to size on the medium width

The shoe is a bit shinier than expected which I wish I would have known before ordering. It's not crazy though, so I can live with it. After all, I'm just wearing them around the house. I sized a half size down, fits perfect. The footbed is comfortable in an odd way... it feels like standing on a fat person's back, if you can imagine. It feels fleshy, and I enjoy it. I am NOT a cannibal, I just sound like one.

representative_reviews.text: The strap SUCKS. it completely pushes your foot out and I had to return both pairs I bought. Size 9 my size was too big, size 8 can still fit in sometimes was too small. Super uncomfortable and hurt my ankles BAD. Please, just skip on this.
For some reason, the Simpsons slides are of a much poorer quality. Unlike every other pair, no padding underneath the straps!! Wth? Returned immediately.
It started falling apart after wearing it for a few weeks. I would think Adidas product would perform better
I love these shoes but I have had them for a month and the toe has already ripped. I missed the return window by 3 days and I'm so bummed that I spent money on them and now they're unwearable

Normally, I can sacrifice some comfort for fashion, but since I wanted to wear these as slippers, with the benefit of keeping them on if I had to run out for a quick errand without looking like I'm wearing slippers, these needed to be comfortable but they weren't. I have another pair of Adidas slides, but they are the B W striped ones. They are super comfy and I wear them every day as soon as I get home. They are getting worn so when I saw these with the fun design, I was excited. They are cute. The bed of the shoe was soft and squishy just like my other pair. But the strap placement was different and cut into my toes when I walked. I really wanted to keep these because the print is so cute and fun. Maybe if you wear them awhile, they'd get broken in but there are too many other reviews that say that doesn't happen. I just couldn't take a chance and I didn't want to endure the pain to test that theory. Sadly, I had to return them and will be buying the boring but comfy B W striped ones again.

I ve bought these years ago and wore them constantly but needed to replace my old ones and found my new pair to be larger and not same quality. Are they made in China? Seem to be of lesser quality than my old ones

How do I return them. I like the sandal, it said if you wear a half size to order the next size up. Since I wear an 8 1 2 I ordered a 9. The 9 is too big and they don t stay on. Really like the color.
The shoes ran a bit big and I kinda feel like these are a knock off because they came in a plastic bag? I was really hoping for better, very disappointed in this product.

So disappointed. I was excited to finally get my first pair of Adidas slides. Many people in my family have them and absolutely love them! When i was saw this cool splatter paint design, and knew i had an amazon gift card, i couldn't resist. Although these shoes are incredible comfortable, after only wearing them a handful of times the design is peeling off!!! I have only owned them a month, and only gotten to wear them maybe 7 or 8 times, in nice weather, and they are peeling. Im so bummed that I finally gave into the price, and they didnt even make it until Summer.
They sort of cut into the top of my feet. I m hoping they just need to be broken in. I ve bought other Adidas slides that were more comfortable.

Nice comfy sandals. Three sizes too large. Never had this issue. Can see maybe one size off but this was ridiculous. Gave to my daughters boyfriend who wears them and he is a men s size 11. I ordered a women s size 9

I immediately loved everything about these shoes. They are SO comfortable, and the cushion seems to be holding up well. Unfortunately, after only a few days of wearing them, the color on the footbed started to come off in small pieces. I ve had them for 2 months now, and this is what they look like. I don t do anything crazy with them either... mostly just wear them around the house yard. I was hoping it was just a defective pair, but my 8-year-old daughter s have done the same thing.
I wanted to love these, I got the black with gold letters, but they are SO uncomfortable! They slip off and feel sweaty, I will see if they need to be broken in but they shouldn't. Phooey

Very disappointed with this purchase. They are either not authentic adidas or they are used and refurbished. Although they looked new enough, the slides arrived smelling very strongly of terrible foot odor. So strong it stunk up the living room. It went beyond regular stale packaging plastic smells. For the odor to be so strong these shoes must have either been worn a lot and refursbished but sold as new or someone with a serious foot condition wore them. Repackaged for a return refund as I do not feel confident buying a replacement from the same seller. They are back in the package and the smell is still so strong in the room.

I wear these as my around-the-house shoes and I can't say enough good about them. They are comfortable yet supportive enough to withstand hours of cooking. I've had them for a little over a year now and they are still going strong. Will certainly buy again in the future when they eventually wear out!
Product arrived very fast, My daughter loves the soft sole and has been wearing them non stop, very welll made and fit is perfect
THE BEST SANDALS EVER. I ll never buy any other sandal. These literally feel like i m walking on clouds all day and seem to be extremely durable. i can t wait to get a new pair or two every year!

I love these slides. I bought them replace a pair of slides that I used only in house. They are most comfortable pair slides I have every come across. I smile every time I put them on. Rubber on bottom of the shoe is hard, I am assuming for durability. The foot bed of the slide is soft enough to yeild but firm enough not to be compressed under my own body weight after 2 days walking around the house 160lbs . I have noticed compression of the material and I bought these in Nov. 2018.The material feels like a cross between silcone rubber and memory foam. Again, I am only been wearing these in the house so, I don't know how much the foot bed would hold up with the average everyday use. I bought a 9M and I still have a little space at the toe and heal of my foot. Also, some wiggle room around the band but not too loose. Any one who has wide feet or instep these may not fit. My whole house has hard would floors and there no issue with slipping.
Look good. A little stiffer than a previous pair when new. Overall theyre great. A hint big. But sizing down is too small
Unbelievably comfortable!! Stylish...super soft sole. I have purchased this style by top designers...Gucci...Givency. The price tag was huge and they hurt like hell! Highly recommend these slides

I got these for my wife. I've been wearing a version of these since 1978. This is the best one yet. The original was good with a firm sole. The massage one with the bed o' rubber nails was not so good. The velcro top Superstar, meh. This one is definitely the best.

I was worried these were going to be too large and the strap over the top would be loose but it fit perfectly! I ordered my size according to the Adidas chart online. These were also the exact squishy comfortable thing I was thinking of to deal with hardwood floors in the house. My feet don't hurt every day anymore. The name cloudfoam to describe the sole is spot on, it's perfectly springy and squishy! Very comfortable!

They are a tad big but they still fit good! good to the point where I refuse to return them! They are AMAZING ! Super comfy !!! Hoesntly I was nervous with the pictures because I was worried they would be too flat but they are better than perfect ! I m so happy with them that I asked my hubby for an outside pair because these are my house shoes !!! I can t wait to live in these !!! I previously owned Nike slides that I paid 50 for they were okay but not super comfy. I had them for 5years and had to scrub mold off them MaNy times they would get splashed during kids bath time and I hated that my house shoes that were plastic would get that nasty over something that small.....This last time I was done having mold on my feet and tossed them out. IM SO HAPPY I GOTTHESE !
I love these fun shoes! The metallic is adorable and I wear them everywhere. I like them so much that I bought another pair. I also gave a pair to my daughter. She loves them too!

Wear any of these models of Adidas slides and you're bound to get compliments. Honestly. I get a TON of compliments any time i wear my white black or metallic rose gold pair around campus. I recently bought the White White Black model that looks like a paint splatter design, and now i get compliments for that one too. They are just super comfortable, can clean easy, and can be worn in a variety of scenarios if you live in South Florida, like I do. For reference, I am a size 7 1 2 in shoes, so I bought these in 7 for a snug but comfy fit in bare feet. If you want to wear these with socks, then I'd advise to maybe go up a size.
I wish there was more padding on the toe part but other than that I love these sandals. Very comfortable heel and arch! Definitely good for the price!

The foam on these sandals are unlike any other. We've tried many many sandals slides, these are great for comfort, average on durability. The memory foam ones suck, over time they become nothing, and its hard to wash! The more solid ones are less comfy. These have a nice plush foam feel but do not significantly degrade like the memory foam or softer foams out there. I would say life expectancy is 2 years of normal wear, then the color starts chipping off and it starts looking old in high contact areas. 2 years is perfectly good with me because my feet leave a permanent stank on sandals anyway tip use body powder while wearing in the summer and once in a while soak in vinegar bath, or put in ziplock bag with some baking soda and freeze it overnight .

I bought these to wear indoors. Very comfy. I love them. My only advice is to be careful on the stairs if you tend to run up and down stairs quickly they could easily become a tripping hazard. This is not due to a flaw in the shoe, I think it s an issue for any open toe slide.

LOVE these slides! This is my third pair and not because they wear out but because I wanted variance of colors. The only reason I did not leave 5 stars is that the top band of this particular shoe is not padded as the first two were and the soles appear slightly thinner. Though still comfortable, the padded band of the other two made them just a touch better. I am a cheerleader for Adidas "cloud" type shoes. Unlike other brands with "memory foam" shoes, the clouds do not break down. Super comfy and stay that way.

representative_reviews.text: The color faded from the slides quickly. The paint is chipped and it looks like they re dirty. Being that it s Adidas I expected more. I m not happy about its longevity.

I thin all slides are hideous I never thought I d own a pair let alone love them, but these have completely changed my mind! I still think slides are ugly, but I am unable to wear flip flops anymore due to an injury. The rose gold pink is very pretty, not too little girlish or tacky. And oh my gosh, they are the most comfortable shoes I ve ever worn. The memory foam type footbed is so incredible, I even wear them to clean my house now!

representative_reviews.text: Gave me blister on my toe next to small toe on right foot. I have regular width feet, but shoe rubber rubbed against my toe. Not fun. Very hurtful.
My god I have never worn more uncomfortable shoes then these in my life. They will rub your feet raw and make them sweat like crazy, which makes your feet slide around in the shoe causing sores.

If flats generally hurt the back of your feet causing blisters, unfortunately this will do the same. Arch support is good but if the product came in half sizes, that could be beneficial as there is a gap, which can cause the shoe to slip off.
I really liked the fit of these crocs, unfortunately they left me after one shift with some brutal blisters from the rubber. Will try bandaidinh the area until healed and write a further review.

this shoe started out comfy, but soon i got the most excruciating blisters on my pinky toes and my heels rubbed raw and bleeding. i tried KT tape, bandaids, sheer socks, everything to help but it still hurt very badly. very disappointing. would not recommend.

Toe area is tight and causes MAJOR blisters on all parts of foot- back, side, bottom, toes, etc. Tried with and without the little socks. No change in blisters. Makes my feet extremely sweaty and then slides around like crazy from the rubber material.

The right shoe is very painful and is rubbing against my toe as I type this. Unfortunately I am traveling and cannot change my shoes until I get to the hotel, so I am stuck and in a lot of pain. The shoes felt fine this morning when I put them on but by the time we drove to the airport and I started walking at the airport they started rubbing my feet, literally within a half an hour they were causing me discomfort.

I got these for work. I m a pastry cook and on my feet for 8 hours a day. The arch support is great and my heels don t hurt but the toe box is a bit too tight for my liking. My toes hurt after just a few hours of wearing. I end up taking them off and standing on top of the shoes while working. Wish these would have worked out better. Maybe a half size up would help? The non slip and support are great though.

When I first wore these shoes I thought they were a win... comfy and stylish. As a restaurant manager I struggled to find an affordable cute shoe that could be business professional. But, after a week I began to get blisters on my left foot. One month later and I can t wear my shoes anymore without bandaids which fall off every shift I even had to wear socks with them one shift because it hurt too much I looked pretty stupid . I ve ordered another pair of shoes elsewhere. I do work 50 hrs per shift so Maybe if you don t work much or aren t on your feet that much these will be better for you. I ordered a size 7 which is what I normally am, I think size 8 would ve been too big.

I got these for something easy to throw on for walking the dog and short shifts behind the bar. I ve worn them 3 times and have horrible blisters all over my heels. I ordered my standard size and they felt fine at first, but after an hour my heels were raw.

I ordered these as a replacement for my favorite non-slips which are no longer sold they re from Payless which has gone out of business in my area . I ordered them in 8W. Now, I don t have the widest feet per say, but I usually do get my work shoes with a little extra wiggle room because it s more comfortable for me. When they arrived they were in a clear plastic bag which I thought odd. After taking them out I noticed that there was a slight difference in the shape of the opening of the shoes where your foot slides in. The right one had a wider opening than the left. I didn t think much of it and wore them to work that night. I kept wearing them for about a month and a half. My feet usually don t hurt after work, but with these shoes they were killing me. I started getting back pain where I didn t have any before which I assume was from the lack of support in the shoe. The shoes were DEFINITELY not wide and pinched my toes together so much so that my toenails started cutting into my skin and before I knew it they were swollen and red all of the time and tender to touch. I ve never had an issue like this before. Since I had already worn them I didn t think that returning them was an option, and I wore them for so long because shoes aren t cheap and I had to wait to make enough money to replace these things. If you re on your feet for more than a couple of hours at a time and don t have extremely narrow feet I would highly recommend Crocs bistro shoes. I got them as a replacement for these and have no complaints at all!
They hurt my pinky toes and the top of my foot for the first two weeks. I expected them to be extremely more comfortable.
The shoe advertising says shoe runs big. Not true. Shoe is very tight in the toe which causes the rest of the support to be off. Feet hurt at the end of the day.

Not a fan of the holes on the sides. They did it for package purposes - but it makes it a defective product in my view. The material is comfortable but the toe portion seems...slanted. Like regular flats they re straight on your toes but these are more angled inwards. They also put pressure on the back of my heels and gave me blisters.

These tore my feet up. They re hard rubber, not soft like crocs. They re stiff as heck and it hurt to walk more than 20 minutes in them. The shoe slips off while hiking. The elastic loosens making the too loose. The heal is too small and comes off
These are a total waste of imo. Not real comfortable, cheap imported junk. They smell like you have dead animals on your feet after a few hours of wear in the heat. Way too pricey for what you get.

Update I contacted Keen directly and asked what type of glue to use. The recommend using BARGE contact cement. I used on my old pair of shoes.. so far so good. You can buy on Amazon. However, I had to trim the loose rubber sole when I was traveling so I would not trip. I was given a link from KEEN for a warranty application. Within 5 days it was approved and I ordered replacements from Keen for free. Shoes cam in only two days. Good recovery by KEEN First I ordered 1 2 size smaller than normal due to other reviews. This was the right call. This is my third pair of walking sandals from Keen, but first of this style. I like this style as it has better support. I have worn them up to six mile hikes and all is good. Note I have Keen hiking boots and had have three pair of steel toe loafers along with three pair of sandals. After a lot of wear the black bottom always starts coming loose. The glue process is not the best. My issue with these is after only about four months the black bottom started to peel off the right side. This is too soon for this to happened. I used contact cement to glue back to the shoe. I love Keen and will continue to buy, but wish they would improve their glue or process

This is the second pair of Keen sandals I've purchased in about 10 years - the first pair was fantastic albeit slightly too narrow for my toes, the little toe used to stick out through the webbing at times. So, I bought a second pair to take over once the first had worn out which they only did 6 months after I bought the second pair. I found to my horror after wearing the new pair for a couple of weeks that the right foot heel collapsed on the inside, causing my foot to become pronated, causing me immense back pain. Unfortunately, it was too late to return them so am stuck with them now.

Firm sole makes wearing uncomfortable. Steps feel stiff. No cushioning or shock absorbing qualities. Fit as expected. If walking on soft ground, they may be fine. I didn t experience that. Walking on hard surfaces as I did, they were not comfortable. Exchanged them for Keen Newport H2. Better comfort, but only heel strap instead of full heel protection.

I've known people who used Keens for years my wife and kids among them . They've always been happy with them, it was my turn. By reputation, they're great river shoes, sturdy and comfortable. I purchased these shoes specifically because I was going on a camping canoeing trip with my son's Boy Scout trip. According to this plan, I'd wear these great shoes getting in and out of the boat on the edge of a river. They're guaranteed to get wet and muddy but they'd be easily cleaned. On the last day of our trip day 4 , I was trying to figure out where a particular odor was coming from. Which one of our sons had a hygiene problem, if our trash had started to rot, or whatever. I was unable to figure it out, until I took my Keens off in the tent that evening. Found it. So, it turns out all the Keens I'd seen before had this plastic footbed that bacteria doesn't like. These Keens have a leather footbed, and it turns out bacteria like that. I've since put them through my washing machine 3 or 4 times good news, they hold up in the washer , but they just smell less bad. I've given up expecting them to smell nice.

The first thing I noticed is that my feet sweat a lot in these shoes. Also the heel slips a lot. My fear is that it will develop a blister on my foot. I'm afraid to go hiking a long distance. I originally bought size 12, but went with a smaller size 11 1 2, but it still slips. Even when I tighten it all the way down. I will keep wearing them and hopefully break them in so they fit better after breaking them in. They are made out of leather so I've heard if you get leather wet and wear them till they're dry they will be broken in very well.

I usually will offer my opinion when asked. I love Keen Sandals. This pair is my sixth pair and all have performed to my expectations. When I opened the box I noticed the holes near the small toe are really big. The other holes are about the same size but the hole are big enough you can stick your thumb through them. Weird. However, the lace is cotton and not the normal "bungee lacing system". I didn't know until now that the bungee lacing system makes all the difference. The bungee lace allow the sandal to give a little while staying snug. The cotton lace is tight all the time and doesn't give. This is a game changer and though I like the sandal and it looks like it will work for a light trail hike the regular cotton laces don't work at all. Keen must have imported this one.
I wear these sandals to work three days a week. So not a very strenuous schedule. But still, they didn't even last two months. The sole of the left heel is already coming off.
I expected more from these sandals with occasional usage. The sole fell off within 6mo. Still plenty of tread and life in these sandals. In great condition otherwise, but glue failed.

After just 2 months of daily wear, including some moderate hiking and occasional lake and river dips, the smell of these sandals was unbearable. My running shoes never stink anywhere near this bad, even after hundreds of miles of sweat and mud. Tried spraying, washing them and running them through the washing machine to no avail. I can t keep them in the house and won t wear them anymore in public because they stink so bad. I like the look and feel of these sandals so it s incredibly disappointing that I ll be throwing them out after just 2 months of use.

Good support and comfort for multiple types of adventures, like hiking or beach walking. I specifically got them b c I have custom orthotics and they have a removable footbed so you can insert arch supports or orthotics. My new favorite sandals.

I m a big Keen sandal fan, owning numerous pairs and styles. Newports are my favorite. I bought the Arroyo II because of the removable insoles I replaced them with custom inserts . The Arroyo II fits much like the Newport style with one important exception. The Arroyo has non-elastic laces. What was Keen thinking!? The lack of elasticity makes for uneven pressure across the top of the foot and as they vacillate between too loose or too tight, depending on how tight you try to snug them. I replaced these horrible laces with Stout Gears Reflective No Tie Elastic Shoelace Lock System, and now the Arroyo II s fit like my comfortable Newports. At first, I tried another brand of elastic laces, but the were too flimsy to do the job. The Stout brand offers a thicker bungee material, much like the stock bungee laces on Newports . Buy the Arroyo II s, but replace the laces. Also, these definitely run one-half to one size large. I normally wear a size 13 in most all Keen sandals. For me, size 12 in the Arroyo fits fine. Hopefully, Keen will go back to bungee laces on this otherwise really good sandal.

First off this is my second pair. I bought the first pair about 2 years ago, and in fact i still wear the first pair. I wear the shoes almost daily from April to October November. I wear them in the office, i wear them hiking , i wear them biking, i wear them in the water, on the kayak, fishing, i wear them gardening. I have replaced the laces once. The positive profile on the sole is almost gone, but the shoes are still in good shape, so it looks like i will still utilize these first pair for a while - at least until this winter. Ordered the second pair as kind of reserve . I like the look, i like how easy to put on the shoes and to tighten them. I like how comfortable they are. I like that after a hike in the dirt i can just spray them and they look like new. I'm just lucky that i have not experienced any problem with the sole coming off .... For 100US pair i would also think twice before ordering the product but with my experiences and utilization , it is fair price and sometime you are lucky and get the shoes for a lower price.

I bought these to replace some 5 year old leather keen sandals that are similar, but no longer made those still have some life in them, but I wanted another pair to trade off with them. These are my daily wear shoes for work. They have great arches and I love the breathablity of the shoes once they are on, I forget they are there because they are so comfortable. I run not in these! and a few years ago I got plantar fasciitis, which I was able to slowly get past over a period of months. The arch support in my Keen shoes really helped relieve the pain and I'll give them credit for helping my recovery and keeping me PF free since then. Great, comfortable shoes!
I enjoy this brand a lot. I own a traditional hiking boot as well. The hiking sandals and the hiking boot feel very much the same. Great having a summer hiking shoe with grip and comfort.
My first pair of KEEN shoes and they are comfortable and offer great arch and heel support. Will buy more styles!

I bought this product for some light hiking and some support for my feet. The shoes are very comfortable and wear great! the heel area does warrant concern as the material does not appear to be very heavy duty or durable. However, after two months of moderate hiking and daily wear, they seem to be doing great. I do allow some extra attention when putting them on as a precaution to be gentle to the heel strap. And s far, no issues. I am very happy with the product so far, very comfortable.

This shoe is my summertime go-to shoe. Some sand gets in but not as much as with an open toed shoe. It offers good arch support which is good for me as I have high arches. It is rugged and won't fall apart easily.

I bought my first pair of Keen Arroyo sandals over 10 years ago. I need arch support and weighing over 200 lbs also need a rugged sandal. The Arroyos fit the need in every way. I wear them almost every day, even in our mild SF Bay Area winters and get about two years use out of a pair. Along the way, I have tried one other model from Keen but continue to come back to the Arroyo.

Awesome for rivers and rocky lakes! Great tread, you can hike comfortably for several miles in these. due to the somewhat open design, some dirt and pebbles make their way in... very comfortable and highly recommended. Be warned, I had to order mine 1 to 1.5 sizes smaller because they are sized larger than other shoes.
I love my keens and these will be used when I golf. They have some tread which will help but I use the swing easy philosophy when playing . Very comfortable to walk in.
Super comfortable, and did much better than expected with lots of walking, almost shoe like fit and the sole is exceptional and gives sure footed grip across a variety of surfaces terrains.........

This is the second time I've bought this sandal. The arch support is outstanding and the sole is just as soft as it needs to be for my planar fascitis to be happy. Overall, I put in about five miles a day on city streets in these sandals. A pair lasts me about a year, mostly, again, because of my feet being so sensitive to sole wear. For a normal person with healthy feet, these should last longer, even with extensive use. Overall, well worth the money.
Great amphibious shoe, I hiked the Narrows for 5 hours in them, great traction on land and in the river beds. East the wear and great support.

I ordered these in preparation for a summer trip. I have had keen boots and several Newport sandals, as well as competing mid- and high-end brands, so I have a pretty good baseline for judgment. My overall review is they are great superior, even for the price. I spent about a month hiking through 4 national parks in WA Olympic and N. Cascades , MT Glacier , ND Badlands and MI throughout the Upper Peninsula . Not hard core hiking up to mountain peaks, but substantial walking hiking through trails and some rough terrain. I didn't use them in water like you can do with the Newports , but almost as hiking shoes, often with socks. Pros I have pretty wide feet, and my bridge is very high, so I often have trouble finding comfortable shoes. These things are super comfortable. The sole is very soft, so it bends easily. Yet, it's also rugged, so you have a pretty decent grip. The sandals are wide enough for most people, yet not extremely wide. The adjustable laces and elastic upper allow you to tailor it to your foot's width and height. Although the inner soles are a bit thin, they offer enough support for moderate hiking. Cons I suppose the cons derive from some of the pros. When compared to the Newports and other more rugged sandals, these feel too soft. I don't know the long term durability of the sole, but I imagine that comfort has to come at a price. Other than that, I have no complaints. Overall, I think the Arroyo II are a fantastic sandal, especially if you get them for under seventy dollars, like I did. They are comfy, yet offer support and enough grip for light to moderate hiking. You can wear them barefoot or with socks. Consider them a very light hiking shoe. They seem durable enough. I think I will order a new pair when these wear out.

size.strength_summary: 많은 구매자들이 사이즈가 정확하고 발가락 공간이 넓어 편안하다고 언급했습니다. 이는 신발 착용 시 편안함과 지지력을 제공합니다.

representative_reviews.text: I had to return these. Heel is way too wide. Even tried a half size below my usual. Still too big and too wide.

I usually will offer my opinion when asked. I love Keen Sandals. This pair is my sixth pair and all have performed to my expectations. When I opened the box I noticed the holes near the small toe are really big. The other holes are about the same size but the hole are big enough you can stick your thumb through them. Weird. However, the lace is cotton and not the normal "bungee lacing system". I didn't know until now that the bungee lacing system makes all the difference. The bungee lace allow the sandal to give a little while staying snug. The cotton lace is tight all the time and doesn't give. This is a game changer and though I like the sandal and it looks like it will work for a light trail hike the regular cotton laces don't work at all. Keen must have imported this one.

I usually wear size 11 shoe, and these seem to run a little large. The larger size wouldn't be an issues however, if the lacing system was working better. The device that stops the laces from moving around doesn't seem to hold very long. I went on one medium-level hike and I found myself constantly tightening my laces the entire time. I like the shoes but unfortunately I can't hike with shoes that don't hold the laces so I will need to return them.

Basically the hybrid of the Newport sandal and targhee hiker. But, as a person with narrow heels, the style doesn t fit. Only true problem is the huge loop on the heel, which constantly touches your Achilles.
The shoe slips off while hiking. The elastic loosens making the too loose. The heal is too small and comes off
Shoes are much wider and heel is exceptionally wider than past models. Lace cinch will not hold and is constantly having to be re-tightened.

Shoe is great quality as per normal Keen standard. Size is also good. However, the heel is not designed properly in that the bracing tightening band at the back of the shoe is too low just below heel bone . This means that no matter how tight you tighten the shoe, it will always slip off your heel a better solution would have been to extend the heel a bit to around where the ligament starts . Really too bad because make is good and shoe is expensive.
Bought these and another pair of similar Keens Newport H2 to replace old pair of Keens. All were nominal size 11.5. These were a good size larger than either of the other two pairs.
I bought it last March, and did not wear it a lot. After 6 months, I can see some small gaps of the sole and heel. It was not glued well. So, the sole has some opens. I was very disappointed.
Nice looking shoe. Very hot. Feet sweat. Not pleased! Would have returned if I had kept the box. Will never buy Keen again.

Shoes arrived as scheduled but the box was damaged and the top fabric eyelet on the right shoe was defective. The eyelet was not stitched properly. I planned to return and replace however my size was not available. I opted to take the shoe into a shoe repair and got a quote for 18 min chg to repair. Decided to take my chances as the color and size for this model Keen Arroyo II Slate Blake Bronze Green appears very hard to find. I have previously had 2 pairs of the Newport and in both cases the seams holding the heel strap came tore so I will not ever buy the Newport again.

This is my second pair of Keem sandals. My first pair I bought a size 16 and they fitted very well. I ordered this hiking sandal in the same size 16 but this sandal was way bigger than the one I bought previously. It is so big that my foot slides all around and sometimes even comes out in the back. Not at all comfortable because of this. Extremely disappointed so much so that I wish to return them for a refund.

There s a lot to like about these sandals - overall really high quality - but I had to return them. 5 stars to Amazon s return policy. NOTE Unless you re going to an official UPS store don t use Amazon s new just have UPS scan the code and print the label thing. Most UPS drop off places like Staples can t scan that code. Print the label yourself . It s funny had 2 pairs of these sandals a size 11 too tight and a size 11-1 2 too loose . Turns out I am a size 11-1 2, but they fit really loose and had way too much flex for a Performance sport sandal . This is due to Keen s skinny little bungee bindings and no rear adjustment strap. I ve worn Sketchers old style fisherman sandals discontinued for years. They had a great knobby sole, and really strong bungee bindings a rear adjustment strap. You could wear them loose most of the time, but tighten them up for light trail stuff. Can t do that with these sandals. And, unlike my Sketchers old style fisherman sandals, which I could wear equally with or without socks, you have to wear socks with these sandals because the side openings have rough edges which cut into your skin. Maybe over time that would lessen, but then without thick socks you can t get a satisfactory fit, resulting in a lot of heel rubbing and chafing.

I really like these Keens, but it looks like a problem in the manufacturing has created a problem with the heel. The photos attached show a heel collapse - primarily on the right shoe, but the left shoe has the same problem. I have owned several pair of these and have not had this problem before. I like the shoe, but the manufacturing problem is a deal breaker. Until Keen fixes this, these shoes are a bad buy.

I've had these shoes for 2 years now and have overall been satisfied until I put them to a serious test on the AT for a good 20 miles uphill and downhill. I even bought my wife a pair for this hike, but the lace system kept loosening repeatedly throughout the hike and the foot for was too loose. We both ended up midway through the trail with blisters on our feet. I still think these are good for the occasional day hike but for long hikes, I'm looking elsewhere. If you're still dead set on these order them small if in any way you you feel your foot loose and are thinking of a serious trail return and get your money back. Don't end up with blisters....

I m a big Keen sandal fan, owning numerous pairs and styles. Newports are my favorite. I bought the Arroyo II because of the removable insoles I replaced them with custom inserts . The Arroyo II fits much like the Newport style with one important exception. The Arroyo has non-elastic laces. What was Keen thinking!? The lack of elasticity makes for uneven pressure across the top of the foot and as they vacillate between too loose or too tight, depending on how tight you try to snug them. I replaced these horrible laces with Stout Gears Reflective No Tie Elastic Shoelace Lock System, and now the Arroyo II s fit like my comfortable Newports. At first, I tried another brand of elastic laces, but the were too flimsy to do the job. The Stout brand offers a thicker bungee material, much like the stock bungee laces on Newports . Buy the Arroyo II s, but replace the laces. Also, these definitely run one-half to one size large. I normally wear a size 13 in most all Keen sandals. For me, size 12 in the Arroyo fits fine. Hopefully, Keen will go back to bungee laces on this otherwise really good sandal.
Purchased these for my husband, he wears these shoes all the time. They have great support and wear for a long while. These are a normal width and fit true to size
This is more of a shoe than a sandal. Wide toe box. Typical Keen fit. Sole is same as Keen uses on low-cut hiking shoes. Superb combination of features and well made.
Nice shoe. Fits perfect size 8. I did buy stretchy laces and they do make the fit even better. Removable insert for easy cleaning.

First off this is my second pair. I bought the first pair about 2 years ago, and in fact i still wear the first pair. I wear the shoes almost daily from April to October November. I wear them in the office, i wear them hiking , i wear them biking, i wear them in the water, on the kayak, fishing, i wear them gardening. I have replaced the laces once. The positive profile on the sole is almost gone, but the shoes are still in good shape, so it looks like i will still utilize these first pair for a while - at least until this winter. Ordered the second pair as kind of reserve . I like the look, i like how easy to put on the shoes and to tighten them. I like how comfortable they are. I like that after a hike in the dirt i can just spray them and they look like new. I'm just lucky that i have not experienced any problem with the sole coming off .... For 100US pair i would also think twice before ordering the product but with my experiences and utilization , it is fair price and sometime you are lucky and get the shoes for a lower price.
One of the best sandals I've ever had. The tiny thing that holds the lays to tight up on the left shoe is lose. So I have to do few tricks to keep the left on in my foot.
If you are looking for a shoe that fits you just right and has the support that you need for your feet. Then here you go. Worth the money.
Everyday wear. Great fit even with a wide foot. Keen footwear is good if you are on your feet for many hours.
Info says to order size bigger. Don t. Ordered the size larger and had to send them back and order my normal shoe size. Comfortable sandal. Been wearing them every day all summer.
Fits true to size and very comfortable...can wear for hours. Didn't like the way the laces are tightened...didn't stay tight...so I now tie the laces. But other than that, great shoes.

Bought these for my husband who only wears work boots and he loved them. He said he had never wore a shoe with so much padding in the heel. He usually wears a 11.5 EE in work boots and a size 11 in these fit perfect. No complaints of squeezing his foot. He says they are rooming and comfortable.
Little tight and back very rigid. Otherwise a fine shoe and would recommend,but need a shoehorn to put on
Fits great purchased a half size small as recommended Shoes are comfortable and lighter than my old Keen sandles. Walked about two miles today with no foot pain at all Love them.
My husband has a high arch and wide feet. It s very hard to find him shoes that fit. These are perfect and he says they feel great.

These are great sandals. I use KEENS for all my footwear boots, hiking shoes, sandals --they have the best arch support and room in the toe box area. If you like to wear socks, you may want to go 1 2 size up from your regular size shoe. The sandals have bungee ties to adjust the fit---Great KEENS products!!!

durability.issue_summary: 구매자들은 내구성 문제로 인해 제품에 실망하고 있으며, 특히 솔 분리, 끈 파손, 봉제 불량 등의 문제가 반복적으로 발생하고 있습니다.
durability.strength_summary: 구매자들은 내구성이 뛰어난 제품을 반복적으로 언급하며, 오랜 사용에도 불구하고 변형이나 손상이 없음을 강조하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Update I contacted Keen directly and asked what type of glue to use. The recommend using BARGE contact cement. I used on my old pair of shoes.. so far so good. You can buy on Amazon. However, I had to trim the loose rubber sole when I was traveling so I would not trip. I was given a link from KEEN for a warranty application. Within 5 days it was approved and I ordered replacements from Keen for free. Shoes cam in only two days. Good recovery by KEEN First I ordered 1 2 size smaller than normal due to other reviews. This was the right call. This is my third pair of walking sandals from Keen, but first of this style. I like this style as it has better support. I have worn them up to six mile hikes and all is good. Note I have Keen hiking boots and had have three pair of steel toe loafers along with three pair of sandals. After a lot of wear the black bottom always starts coming loose. The glue process is not the best. My issue with these is after only about four months the black bottom started to peel off the right side. This is too soon for this to happened. I used contact cement to glue back to the shoe. I love Keen and will continue to buy, but wish they would improve their glue or process

One of the lace loops on these broke within a week of having received it, after wearing it only maybe three times, and that was just wearing them around town, not hiking or other challenging circumstances. Amazon did replace the item for me right away, and the replacements have been good so far, but I was disappointed that they broke so quickly.

Keen used to have quality products. My husband s previous pair of Keen sandals lasted for three years. The specialized ties on this pair broke before one month. The second tie tore within two. Keen said their warranty doesn t cover the specialized ties. I should have returned them rather than try to deal with their customer service.
The shoe slips off while hiking. The elastic loosens making the too loose. The heal is too small and comes off

I expected more from these sandals with occasional usage. The sole fell off within 6mo. Still plenty of tread and life in these sandals. In great condition otherwise, but glue failed.

After only two months of wear the sole of this shoe is falling off. I contacted keen for warranty support and have not heard back for them to warranty this product. Definitely would not buy them again.

At first these were great! The laces broke within the first few weeks and have only had a couple months and the bottom tread is coming off. Very bummed I spent so much money, I was under the impression these are supposed to last.

Had a old pair of cork sole keen sandals that lasted years without issue and are still wearable. Decided to upgrade and stay brand loyal but I can already tell these aren't going to last very long stitches are already popping in critical areas.

Not the Keens I used to know. Terribly upset and feel I ve been had. After only four weeks of home and garden use, the stitching came undone in five places. The laces were so long, they can not have been designed for these shoes, as they extend beyond even the front of the shoe they also had zero elasticity and the clasp didn t hold the laces, so, essentially there was no way to tighten the she. So much for hiking in them.... Also the insoles were dollar-store quality, with no support or cushioning after two weeks I had to buy other ones. As for design, a person cannot hike in them for sure they also were terribly hot, with little aeration. After weeks of hassle back and forth with the company, they agreed to send me other laces. Thanks a lot. I went back to wearing my four year old Newport s. Ditch today s Keens. Find another company....

I bought these simply because I bought a very similar pair and loved them. In addition to the great fit and feel, they lasted for 6 or 7 years off reasonably heavy use. NOT SO WITH THE NEW ONES! The soles on both shoes started peeling off after less than a year of use. Consulting the interwebs, this seems to be a fairly common problem. CAVEAT EMPTOR!

I never had sandals cause so much pain, not even cheapest 17 Walmart ones. These are simply unbearable, badly rubbing on back of the heels, bridges, toes, everywhere. After 1 day of wear, my feet are sore, even new inserts did not help. I'm giving up and discarding them, too bad the return window has closed, I should've known better. Don't want to include photos of my feet, but you can imagine red rubbing marks, swollen heels, all that stuff.

Very bad shoe laces. Keep loosening up. Not recommended for hiking. Did not feel like returning since I used them for couple of time. This was a very bad purchase. Very high price for poor quality laces

Comfortable with good support. Great for wet days fishing or on the boat. Great customer support. I had a problem with the stitching. I contacted Keen and sent photos. I received a new pair without having to return the defective pair. I have had them for over a year and they are going going strong.

This shoe is well made. The fit and quality is amazing. This is my 3rd pair, and each pair has lasted for 2 years of wear. To me, well this is absolutely amazing! Thank you for great product and for the try b4 you buy.

I've worn these sandals daily for years and have never seen a need to try anything else. They fit as you would expect and are comfortable to wear all day long. The one drawback to these sandals, and it's been true of every pair I've owned, is that the glued-on components mostly of the soles come loose and always at the wrong time. I've found that the best thing to use to reattach then is contact cement, but for a product this expensive this shouldn't be necessary.

I got these for my roommate as a birthday gift as he wears them every day and his other KEEN sandals were coming apart. These have a very thick durable sole and hug the foot comfortably. I will definitely buy again
These are great I ve had them three years and have worn them close to 1000 days over those years they are still going strong.
Best shoe I ve found in an airy sandal-like design, with good support and made for outdoor use in a smart way. Highly recommended.

I've had these shoes for just under 2 years. They've been in summers in the Palouse, camping, on the beach at the Sea of Cortez and in the water there , around Rome, up Vesuvius, to Loreto, and around the Pacific Northwest. They are comfortable, and took an orthotic insole really well. They do run a little bit wider than I'm used to, but with the insert they helped with my plantar fasciitis. As you can see from the first photo, they are still externally in great condition. The soles not pictured have held up well, and I've worn them a fair amount. They are very comfortable. Or rather, they were until I realized something was scratching at my ankle. The photos show what happened to both shoes. I tried to use a heel grip but even glued on with superglue, they wouldn't stay in place. This seems like a bit of a design flaw - it's essentially where the cord for pulling them on or off, or holding them, is threaded through at the back, and it has clearly worn faster than the rest of the shoe. I had bought another pair of these because I liked them so much, but for the money, they really should last a bit longer than just under 2 years. It's not as though I was wearing them in the winter either. SUMMER 2019 UPDATE So the second pair I started wearing in the summer. Then I noticed at the end of the summer that the orange material is already worn out on one, and wearing out on the other shoe. It seems that the hard plastic in between the orange and the back leather material is wearing from being slipped on and off. This appears to be a design flaw. I will credit Keen customer service, they sent me a voucher for replacement via their warranty, but I think the shoe needs redesigning a bit.

Pros Great fit, comfortable from day one with no break in period. Great lug pattern for rocky terrain, Stiff sole but still flexible. I really love this product. I threw these in the washing machine and came out fresh and clean. Con After a week wearing them, they had a terrible stink odor and had to put them in a plastic bag before i put them in my luggage for the trip home. Washing machine safe though and after a cleaning they smell good as new!

If you like an fit that's good for a pair of socks heavy or light an with out socks .shoes are still more then warable on flat or tough trails .P.S. shoe string shoe laces not alastic,makes it more vercitle.

keen has always been my number one brand on outdoor footwear used it for years i have come across a defect in some shoes but giving how many have gone though i would say keen is a way to go never disappointed and put them to the test

I have been buying Keen sandals for years. The Arroyo is the best design I have had so far. I never gotten much over a year out of them but I wear them all summer for work. I like this design the best due to fact that rocks and dirt don't are less likely to finds it's way under your foot. Support is good to excellent

The only shoe I needed in Costa Rica. The sole is stiff enough for long day hikes, we did 9 miles of beach, muddy jungle, and gnarly root and rock terrain. Construction was solid. Nothing peeling, no seams coming undone. The sole held up well. About 3 weeks in and the shoe has held up well. I'd expect the same for the next few years depending on use.

I've been wearing these and past versions to hike in rough terrain, mainly in the Shawangunk and Catskill mountains and the Hudson Valley for many years. They're great and survive water and rocks and a lot of rough treatment. A pair usually survives two seasons with me. I should really take a picture of my old worn out stinky pair but I'm lazy about things like that. I normally don't buy shoes without trying them on but circumstances change and I found the old box to make sure I had the right size and the fit is perfectly consistent with the last pair, which was a different color. These sandals are great and durable and they put up with the grinding rock of trails in the Gunks and beaches and rocks of the Hudson River and highlands. If you want to wear sandals instead of hiking shoes or boots like I do these are great. I haven't found any other brand that work nearly as well or hold up as long. The only part that tends to fail for me are the laces, which are easily replaced with accessory cord.

I will have to return it reluctantly because of the width. Finish is exceptional and I was pleased with Amazon's delivery.

Liked the design and built. Similar to the one I ve had for many many years. Wore it everywhere even in water fishing and crabbing until the straps broke and heels peeled separated. Ordered As closest the same model since I am very much satisfied to wear these comfortably.
