Another pair that I wear everyday in my woodworking shop, working in the yard, and all my regular life-stuff as an active, newly retired guy. And a nice pair for wearing out to casual dinners, gatherings in the neighborhood etc. I just love these shoes. And yes, I do add socks in the winter - comfort over style for me. Just saying....
Best all round sandals I have ever owned. My second pair in 10 years. Rugged yet comfortable. Wear all day all summer. Work,play, rain, shine.
My husband has many pair of Keen sandals. These were just ordered and we were not sure about the color combination with the orange but they look great and feel good too.

I bought my fist pair Arroyo and I did love it and decided to buy another pair of curse different color I love both to them I will recommend I have been use it everyday 8 hours for work very comfortable just get half a size smaller to have a perfect fit they Come a little big.
Great look great fit and they hold up very good second paid with this brand i seeked them out and was not disappointed!
These are great I ve had them three years and have worn them close to 1000 days over those years they are still going strong.

WHY did you ruin a perfectly great shoe with NON-elastic laces elastic laces were on a previous pair of Keen sandals I previously bought . The shoe is great, easy to put on, comfortable and stylish, but those lousy laces ruin it. Please send all of us a pair of elastic laces for these shoes which would make it a FIVE STAR product easily.

Worth the price. I used to wear the Newport but the opening isn't big enough to get my foot in. These are made differently way more adjustable. I walked 7k steps in them this afternoon. Great hot weather walking shoe. My feet are wide and tend to swell in hot weather and are happy in these sandals!.

I ve been a fan of Keen products for about a decade now. My only complaint is that the only wear is on the outside of the heels, where you feel like you re walking uphill in a perfectly good pair of sandals.

Fits great and looks great. I have worn it on the beach, river and local parks. It s very comfortable. I love that it is snug so it lets me have more control when I am hiking or fishing in the river. And I usually wear it around town.

representative_reviews.text: I got these for work and they were great for about two weeks. Now they are horribly uncomfortable and hurt my feet. Wish I could return as I can't wear them at all now.
This shoe insole is not memory foam therefore the bottom of your feet starts feeling the hard structure of the shoe in a few days and it hurts

This shoe is comfortable, fits great and looks great on my feet. The only thing is it fell apart after only wearing it three times. The seam on the side of the shoe tore. It makes me wonder about the authenticity of the brand as Clarks shoes are supposed to be really strong shoes.

I received my shipment of 9.5 and the toe was too narrow, so I needed to exchange for a 9.5 wide. In addition the inner sole was not as pictured and advertised, which is the whole reason I chose to purchase these shoes. I have tendonitis in my Achilles and Plantars Faciitis, I work at Disney as a tour guide and spend 12-14 hours a day walking our parks. I NEED shoes that support my arch and have cushion that will hold up for hours on my feet. I spent quite a while researching shoes and this shoe came up a lot on many different sites, and the soles received high praises from airline flight attendants. So I bought them. When I received them the soles were not as pictured. They are flat, there is no cushion, and no arch support. See my picture attached I returned the 9.5 and exchanged them for 9.5 W, when the replacement came..... they sent 9.5 instead of 9.5W and it was the same basic inner sole. They are not shipping the shoes with the cushioned support soles as pictured. Returning for a refund and will just order direct from Clark s website

I want to love these shoes. Overall, they're incredibly comfortable. I am a size 10, normal width kind of gal, but I noticed a few weeks ago in the inner seam of the right heel a small area where the shoe is separating. It's only gotten worse. I've had these shoes for 2 months and have worn them 3 4 time of a full time job where most of my hours are spent sitting, and this is what's happening. A shame for the price I've paid. I really want to love them.
Good looking shoe however, my heels hurt after the first week of wearing them, currently in the market for a comfortable shoe insert

I previously tried on Clark s inside big Dept store so I knew what size would fit. However, I was surprised these caused a blister on the top of my foot, the rounded opening toward the toe. Very strange. Hoping my 2nd wear will alleviate this issue.

So I am generally a 7.5wide and these girls great in the respect. Plus I m super pregnant and they still fit great despite the feet swelling. Super comfy, only heels I can wear when I m this pregnant. But the smell! I using anti fungal spray on shoes and my feet before every wearing and I ve been treating them with every thing I can think of even soaked in laundry detergent. They smell SO TERRIBLE. And my feet smell so bad after wearing them. So it really sucks - these are by far my best pregnancy shoes for work, but the foot odor is so terrible I m incredibly self conscious about wearing them.
the right leg is done something wrong.I work as a cashier all day.I feel a supinator or a suture, I don't know.leg aches in the evening.

Although they looked well made, I never got the chance to find out because they were too tight and too narrow. It was my first pair by this brand and will likely be my last. The instant I put them on I knew walking more than a few steps would lead to blisters. I wouldn't even attempt to "break them in". After a few steps, I realized these were shoes that someone else would love and I promptly reboxed them for return.

I was required to purchase these shoes as part of my uniform as a cocktail server. They re not comfortable, but tolerable, despite walking in them all day. They fit true to size and the toe box is on the larger side to accompany wider feet. There s not much arch support though and I ve bought 2 sole and ball of foot support pads to help but it s still rather uncomfortable. The girls I work with all same thing and we wear an extra padding of tights or socks to cushion. Your feet will hurt by day 3 if you work and walk in these. The back of your ankle doesnt charge against the shoe though. I would suggest trying a wider size to allow more padding and maybe it will feel more comfortable. I would definitely never wear these if they weren t required for my work uniform!
I ve only had these shoes for a little over a month and I noticed that they were floppy and I looked down at my feet and I noticed that my shoes were coming apart

After a brief walk in damp grass, the water spotted the shoe toe. While the description describes 34 leather uppers 34 I have not seen leather react to a short exposure to dew such as this. After drying, I used polish on these brand-new shoes hoping to increase the damp-resistance. The large strap over instep makes these shoes somewhat hot and less breathable. The shoe size 34 appears 34 to be different between left and right shoe...something to do with the way the upper is cut.

I have purchased this shoe before, so I didn t try it on just put them in the closet for when school starts. I put them on this morning and there was instantaneous sharp pain in both feet. The insoles have sharp edges and cut into the sides of my feet. Very disappointed- should have tried them on- ugh!
There is a nail poking through the heel of the left shoe inside I want to exchange. Otherwise perfect.

I m a flight attendant and bought these shoes because everyone said to get them due to them being so good to your feet. I m on my feet all day sometimes and have no issues with wearing these shoes for hours. They re very comfy. They go well with pants or skirts. The price wasn t too bad at all. I ve had them for almost 3 months now and they re still in great shape, compared to the cheap shoes I bought from Kmart. I ll be buying more of these when the time comes.
I usually use lower heals than this for back comfort. Needed something a little higher for a wedding and this worked fine since I was not standing or walking very long.

These new Clarks fit very nice. Comfortable on my arthritic feet. They are a wide this time to give my feet more room to spread out more. One thing they do need is more arch support which i will add. Happy with my purchase.

PERFECT! 55yo runner just recovered from a long stint of plantar fasciitis so was very concerned how these would work out. These were SO comfortable and not too high and not too flat. The arch was moderate I never felt like I was putting stress on the tendon. I bought some no-show cushioned dress shoe liners to go with these shoes. I stood and danced all night long and never felt like me feet were tiring. FYI, when it says it's true to size that's true to regular shoe size and like many runners I buy a size up from a regular shoe.
comfortable soft leather and great for wide foot sizes. no need to break in comfortable all day out of the box
I have tender feet that have a low tolerance to walking. I was pleasantly surprised with the comfort.
Perfect stand all day walk no problem full support work at the airport and these give ne an elegant look with no pain

This shoes is so comfortable very light on my feet. It has a soft insole support non slip sole. I highly recommend this shoes it's the most comfortable shoes for all say support u wont regret it. I bought a wide width .

This is the shoe that I needed all this time. Neuropathy is a beast but it feels like walking on air. The heel and arch support is excellent. I love the color and the fact that I can use them as my everyday shoes is a new kind of freedom for me. I wi will buy again in Maroon.
Excellent product! Sturdy, secure construction and closure.. Comfortable after wearing all day in heat. Nice design. Thankful to have found. Zero complaints.

Most comfortable shoes ever! I wear them almost every day either to work dress clothes or with jeans. I have plantar fasciitis and this is the only shoe that makes it feel better. I wish they came in a lighter color for summer, I don t feel like I can wear black or dark brown with my summer clothes.
These shoes are perfect for work . Stylish and comfortable all day . I feel these shoes help my posture as well

I needed a good dress shoe that I could wear to a recent conference where I was a presenter, so I knew I d be on my feet a lot. I struggle with flats and they always eat up my heels, so I hoped a shoe like this would work. This was SO comfortable. The sole is a little squishy so it was very comfortable even after a 10 hour day with lots of walking. It doesn t have much arch support but it fit my foot well. I didn t get to break them in beforehand and had no issues at all. The straps are Velcro adjustable so it was easy to get the perfect fit and adjust as needed.

Well padded, does not apply pressure on toes or heel, and is attractive on my feet also easy to put on as the strap across the top of the foot has a Velcro closure. I really like this shoe and I know that I can wear all day long, do a lot of walking and standing in it, and at the end of the day my feet will not be sore.

LOVE these! Classic look with amazing comfort! My daily routine has me on my feet most of the day. I also have to traverse stairs quite often. My old shoes made my back ache on busy days. These NEW shoes are so comfortable! So glad I got them!

The shoe was way too large and unfortunately I opened the box too late to return the shoe. O well. I am almost always a 7.5 W but this feels more like a 8.5 W.

The toe box wasn't wide enough and the size was too small. My toes were pressed against the front of the shoe while standing and squeezing toes together. The arch didn't support either the feet. I was disappointed in the shoes.

I want to love these shoes. Overall, they're incredibly comfortable. I am a size 10, normal width kind of gal, but I noticed a few weeks ago in the inner seam of the right heel a small area where the shoe is separating. It's only gotten worse. I really want to love them.

I previously tried on Clark s inside big Dept store so I knew what size would fit. However, I was surprised these caused a blister on the top of my foot, the rounded opening toward the toe. Very strange. Hoping my 2nd wear will alleviate this issue.

I m writing a review after 3 days 6 hours each day of wearing these for work. I ordered a 5.5 which my normal size for heels but I have wider feet. When I was ordering a 5.5, they didn t give me an option to go wide so I just ordered 5.5. My feet hurt so bad. So if you re thinking of getting these, make sure you size up if you have wider feet. My ball, heels, ankles, toes, all hurt from wearing them
Its a nice shoe, looks great but i could have bought a 1 2 size smaller. But with socks i think it will manage
Good looking shoe however, my heels hurt after the first week of wearing them, currently in the market for a comfortable shoe insert

I ordered this shoe to wear to the funeral of my best friend because I didn't have any shoes to wear with a dress. It was an emotional time so when they arrived and were so ugly, I put them aside and decided to wear pant with casual shoes. I finally got around to returning them when I discovered that the return deadline was May 1st. I am so frustrated that I can't go to a store to buy wide width shoes and to see them up close and try them on. I am angry that I just waisted 53 on shoes that I will have to donate to the Goodwill.

Returned because the wide size was too wide. My foot is right on the edge of normal and wide width, so sometimes it just takes trial and error for me to get a well-fitting, comfortable shoe. No issue with the product itself, just wish the medium width 7 had been available or I d have bought it.

I like the style and usually take a 8.5 with my other Clark shoes, however this style runs large and my feet keep slipping out when I tried it on and took a few steps. I will be exchanging it for a smaller size 8.
One shoe is already falling apart at the seam. Would like to get it replaced but need to call to see if Amazon will assist.
Literally wore these shoes twice and the have already burst open on the side. Very disappointed and not what I expected from "Clarks".

I have problem feet, especially since I had surgery last October. I bought these a size bigger and they feel wonderful. The toe box is not tight, and the width is perfect. I ordered a W . Looks dressy casual and can be worn for either look. The heel is not too high, and offers good arch support for my flat feet. I would highly recommend these. Thank you.
Perfect fit! Nice leather shoes to go with casual clothing. Very comfortable, too. I felt as though I had slippers on, not shoes. Love Clark's shoes.

I m a flight attendant and bought these shoes because everyone said to get them due to them being so good to your feet. I m on my feet all day sometimes and have no issues with wearing these shoes for hours. They re very comfy. They go well with pants or skirts. The price wasn t too bad at all. I ve had them for almost 3 months now and they re still in great shape, compared to the cheap shoes I bought from Kmart. I ll be buying more of these when the time comes.
I am a regular size 6, leaning toward the need for a wider toe box. These shoes are comfortable all day at the office and look nice with business apparel.

You know that shoe you've been looking for, not flats, not heels, dressy-ish but to wear with your everyday wardrobe? This is it! Incredibly comfortable right out of the box. I got the 10W for my Fred Flintstone feet. These are generously sized, wide is actually wide, unlike so many other brands. I like having a little bit of a heel and that it's more substantial than flats, but still comfortable. Great value for the price, hopefully they will stand the test of time.
Just slightly.larger than I expect, so sent back for 1 2 size smaller.....perfect! Heel is just a bit softer than I'd like with a little bit of a heel, but typical Clark's. Comfy!
Fit is perfect and tts! I wore these yesterday straight out of the box to work. I was on my feet alot and they never once hurt my feet. They are super comfy with cushioned areas in the sole.

This shoe fit just as expected. I am a 7.5 normal width size and that s what I ordered. It fits very well. I have just a small bit of slippage at the ankle, but the cross-over strap really helps. No need to break this shoe in. Perfect fit, no blisters, no returns or exchanges. I am just relieved to order a shoe one time and it fits!!!
Love that dressier shoe comes in wide width. Hard to find quality wode width dress shoes. Wold like a little more support but very comfotable. Good fit.
I was glad the shoe fits me lest the hassle of returning it. Fits me nicely but yet to wear it for 1 whole day.

I ordered these for work because I needed a pair of comfortable heel type dress shoe that goes with everything. I am on my feet a lot and walking a lot during the day. These are real leather and the wide width is perfect even in the toe box area, no pinching, rubbing, squeeking or anything like that. Very comfortable all day. Def order them if you need an office work style low heel to go with suits, skirts and even jeans!

I just ordered another pair of box toe in 9W from another company and they were unbearably painful and narrow. Clark's shoes are the same size, but they feel completely different! I love how comfortable these are. I'm not a big fan of showing my feet, but I wish people would include what their foot looks like when they leave shoe reviews. As you can see sorry, hope the paleness hasn't blinded you , my feet and toes are wide, but I don't have fan toes. If someone has wide feet with fanned out toes, this shoe might not work, but if you have wide, rectangular feet, this shoe will prob work for you. Cheers!
The shoe is super comfortable I bought this chunky heel for my daughter and she loves it she wore the shoe all day with no complaints.

I took a chance on purchasing this shoe since I have a very narrow foot. I take a SLIM size! However, I have purchased sandels from CLARKS and they are 'the best.' The fit is good except for the heel. My heel is slim, too. Shoe makers must think that a slim foot pertains to only the front of the foot with a normal size heel. WRONG! Thankfully, the strap helps to keep me from walking out of the shoe. I love the style of the shoe! Thanks you for the prompt delivery. rpb

I have a wide foot and have trouble finding the right shoe. Love these! Bought for a holiday party. Put a little bow on buckle to dress up. Typically wear an arch support but did not need to with this shoe. I wore straight from the box and walked and danced without thinking about my feet. so happy!

representative_reviews.text: Came apart at the seam. Fell apart after only about 8 wears, owned them just under a month. Poor quality, I should've trusted the other reviewers whose shoes also fell apart in the same spot.

I ordered these shoes to wear as a flight attendant. These shoes fell apart on my first trip!! Literally was my first time wearing them! The stitching on the strap came apart, so the strap is detaching from the shoe. A friend of mine ordered the sand pair and the exact same thing happened to her shoes! Very poor quality!!
I ve only had these for 3 months and the stitching is already coming apart. Disappointed in the quality.
I got these for work and they were great for about two weeks. Now they are horribly uncomfortable and hurt my feet. Wish I could return as I can't wear them at all now.

I really liked these shoes until about a month in when the strap broke while I was walking at work. Unfortunately I'm three days past the amazon return period. They are unusable. I have owned Clark shoes in the past and they always lasted for years. I'm very disappointed.

Just started wearing these shoes to work and one week later the stitching came apart. I requested a refund and the seller sent me a label which I have to pay my own shipping!!! Not good service, very disappointed.

I really want to love them.

I wore them twice and they came apart at seam. Finally took them to shoe repair shop. Was told they are definitely not leather - cheap imitation not worth fixing...

I saw maybe two other reviews that said the shoe tore apart but thought hey maybe it's wear and tear. I've only worn the shoes twice and it's already tearing the same way as others, I sit at a desk all day so thia shouldnt be...nevertheless it is very comfortable but now it's not going to last and Im nack at square one, finding a good comfy shoe for work!

The Velcro once again gave out on these shoes. It s happened with the last couple pairs I m so frustrated. I love the comfort but the right foot now fits loosely because it s not adhered properly. Also, the leather is pretty soft so it does rip and chip in the toe.
I bought this shoes to return to work after vacation I bought one size up. It fits well but it hurts my heel, and after 3 wears the straps is bursting.

Wore once and realized left strap was a lot shorter than the right strap. Unfortunately, I am unable to return because I waited too long to wear them and now I am stuck with them. It is ashame because the right shoe was so comfortable and I could not even keep left strap in place.

I ve had them for almost 3 months now and they re still in great shape, compared to the cheap shoes I bought from Kmart. I ll be buying more of these when the time comes.

I bought it in Wide because I was planning to insert an additional insole and it was a great idea. they feel great. The leather is soft and comfy. I think the manufacturer should use a more comfortable insole. Something like the memory foam that comes with tennis shoes.The material of the outsole rubber is not a good quality. I have used them less than 10 times and the heel outsole looks worn out. Fortunately there is a shoe repair close to home. If the manufacturer provides better quality outsole and a insole, the shoes would be perfect.
I love this shoe it s very comfortable for being on your feet all day but it s starting to rip in the stitching!
Excellent product! Sturdy, secure construction and closure.. Comfortable after wearing all day in heat. Nice design. Thankful to have found. Zero complaints.

I have been a fan of Clarke's shoes for some time. They last forever and I was thrilled to find some that were more on the dressy side. The tops are leather which can be polished over and over throughout the years.
comfortable soft leather and great for wide foot sizes. no need to break in comfortable all day out of the box
Theses are nice shoes. But I m a bit heavier and needed even more in the construction . Returned without trouble

I ve had 2 pairs of these and they ve both lasted about a year. I m on my feet all day at work as a flight attendant. They re cute and plain. The cushion only lasts so long. I m a true 6 and the toes are always tight at first but since it s leather they will eventually stretch. The heel height is comfortable. But like I said, after a year or even 8 months the cushion will wear down and inserts might be needed. When they get scuffed you can polish it to fix it.

The quality of the shoe is as expected from a company such as Clark. I have used their products for a very long time and have always been satisfied with the look and feel of their shoes. I will continue to buy from them for the foreseeable future.

Love these! Ordered them for flight attendant training. Now everyone from my class has ordered a pair, too! It feels like I'm wearing tennis shoes. I wear a 9 in sneakers and usually an 8-8.5 in heels, and I ordered an 8.5 so they're a little roomy, but the strap keeps me in tight. I'm not worried to do drills or evacuations in these at all. I wore them for 2 weeks at my elementary teaching job, too. Having shoes with support really makes a difference when you're chasing kids around for 8hours! The only thing I'm unhappy about is that the leather on one shoe it cracking already and one shoe has a scuff in it after about 2 months. Take care of your shoes and you'll be fine! Don't drag your feet! I'm sure a little shoe polish will fix it right up.

I love this shoes. As someone who moves around a lot during my work day, I needed a more comfortable shoes that would protect my feet and withstand a downpour of rain. I found this pair of shoes that was within my budget, and I did not regret purchasing it.

I ordered these Clark s for my Halloween costume. I did a try before you by with 6 pairs of similar style shoes. These were the most expensive, but by far the most comfortable. Wore for several hours right out of the box. The heel height is perfect stable. I have high arches these provided adequate support. Great quality. I wear an 8, sizing is perfect. I ll definitely be wearing them again with skirts or wide leg jeans.
These shoes are great right out of the box. No break in time. Very comfortable. I'm wearing them every day for work. Stylish for office attire.

These were purchased to help with my plantar fasciitis, so I was willing to pay a little more for quality. For a short period of time, they are alright. However, after wearing them all day for work, my feet were killing me.

I got these after absolutely killing my pair of black suede Clarks that I fell in love with and couldn't find anything to replace them. This is a beautiful shoe. Great rubber sole makes for easier walking on concrete or hard floors. Plus, no clippity clop nose as you walk down a hallway.

Mary Jane's! So hard to find. These are my work shoes. They look great with both pants and dresses. I can walk all day in them.

I wore these walking and dancing around Helen, Ga all day during Oktoberfest. They went perfect with my dirndl too!

representative_reviews.text: These are the most uncomfortable shoes I've ever wore in my life they hurt my toes they have no support and those soul inside is so big that it squished my foot and rubbed against the inside causing a blister

Initial impression, they fit just like the orginal style crocs! I feel secure in the mid and upper foot and the design gives enough room in my toe box for swelling. The heal is supported with a quarter inch insert and an additional foam I get from the shoe itself. I absolutely love the crocs brand and their durability. I work 5hrs standing and walking at a restaurant and will test the grips on these. Update my shifts are usually between 5-6hrs and within the first hour I felt pain and feet fatigue. I tried it once with the original insole and felt that the arch support was too high and was pushing against my heel. Within 40 mins felt sharp pain and aches in my arches. I removed the insole and the flat foot bed didn't relieve any pain. Next day I swapped out the org insole to a Spencos brand insole, and it helped a little. It was atleast a little bit more bearable and comfort maybe lasted 2-3 hours before my feet needed a break. do I recommend? no, I'm knocking them 3 stars because they're not that comfortable for extended wear.
Just 3 hours wearing this product then felt pain in my foot, just returned. not recommended for work at all

I'm one of the lucky humans where my 2 feet are different sizes. My left foot is about a half size larger. Also, again, very fortunate, my 2nd toe is longer than my 1st. My left foot is a size 13 in every brand of shoe I've purchased for 30 years. These shoes are unbelievably uncomfortable. On the left bigger foot, my 2nd toe rams the front of the inside even though the outside of the shoe looks like it's a Birkenstock-type foot bed. On the right foot, my big toe rolls around to where I've developed an injury that's only now healing after 2 weeks of not wearing these shoes. Add to this, upon forgetting that these trashed my feet and trying them for a short outdoor walk again, the hard reinforced lip around the ankle went straight through "blister" to "raw" and now I have to peel my socks off a scab every night. Spend real money on decent shoes. I'm almost 50, and the sole sign of age is how much I now have to baby my feet. These are not good shoes, even for weekend kick-around slip-ons. They hurt my feet.

I really wanted to like these shoes, but they quickly gave me blisters on the sides of my feet. PROS Very sturdy. Can be cleaned by hosing them off. Perfect for gardening. Nice insole. CONS Odd shape. Very large toe box, but tight around the ankle. Cannot be slipped on. You must use your hands to pull the shoes around the ankles. Material used around the ankle is stiff and caused scrapes on the sides of my feet. If they had a softer material around the ankles and could be slipped on as advertised, these would be perfect for gardening. The size fit well so that wasn't a problem. But after wearing them for a couple of hours, I had gouges on the outside edges of my feet where the black part hit and I do not have wide feet, just normal . More than a week later, I still have scabs from where the shoes scraped my ankles. I had to return the shoes.
Felt great for a few hours but the rubber securing the top of foot began giving me a red ring and sore. I don't know how someone could make it a day in these things.
If you have a job were you walk and stand for 8 hours these are not for you I had to add 2 insoles in them which cause bruising at the top of my feet from the bc it's tight at the top of the shoe

I got these based on decent reviews, still seeking a good shoe for my life in the kitchen. Monday they were great. Tuesday I start to feel the right upper starting irritate the top of my foot. Wednesday the pain starts, why do they fit this way? I try to stretch out the upper and put napkins band-aids and cotton balls to try to ease the pain. Thursday, shooting pain after the 1st hour of work, starts to radiate throughout my foot. I had to cut the upper 4 different times to relieve the pain which lessened the overall support and stressed my foot even more. Friday, wore my old shoes.
I wore these around my house for an hour and even with a dr scholl insert, my feet were already hurting, The sole is so hard it feels like walking on a hardwood floor.

The shoe fits tight across the top of the foot. It creates a painful pressure the longer you wear it. Additionally, there are 2 small holes on the side to allow for airflow. This is just not enough. By the end of your shift your sock is soaked and your feet feel pruney. Not what i expected from crocs
Left shoe seems smaller my second toe was getting squashed. Wore them once to work. I would return them but not sure you can return worn items.

Love the Crocs, but I can feel the holes inside the shoes on the bottom of my feet. They feel weird. Also the top part where the bone is at, is too tight. It hurts. I tried using thin socks, still hurts. I wish I can find a gel cushion inside pad that fits that does not have holes. I told you so! I removed the gel pad from my sticky shoes and I inserted them into my Crocs and they are thinner, so now I can use them to work. They are not tight on the top anymore. Those gel pads that come with the Crocs, are too thick. Remove them and try a skinnier gel pad.

The item description claims that this is a good shoe for healthcare workers and people who work on their feet all day. I am a nursing assistant and I liked that the crocs are waterproof and easy to clean. I would clean them daily with bleach wipes. However I discovered that these are not good for walking in all day every day. Because they are slip on and have no shoe strings or adjustment strap to secure them once you put them on, they slide and rub your feet as you walk. I developed a bunion from wearing theses at work every day and from the shoe rubbing against my foot constantly. I had no foot pain before the bunion developed so there was no warning that was going to happen. Now the bones of my have become deformed and it is only reversible with surgery. I do not recommend this shoe for people who work on their feet all day and I wish they weren t advertised for that.

I buy wide shoes, and I saw so many people where I work wearing these I thought, I'll give them a shot. The insoles felt really good, if a shade low for my arches, and the material looked durable and wasn't flashy. Honestly, apart from the wide toe, they look fine in a close-to-professional on-your-feet environment. Walking around I found the ankle wasn't steady because the collar wasn't very high, and I'm used to brands with more there. I adapted fairly quickly to a slightly different walking motion, which may be problematic after some time, but I didn't get to find out because... They hurt when I'm not walking. Specifically they hurt because the throat is too tight on the top of my foot. Some days I spend 7 hours on my feet, others just a few because I get stuck behind a computer at a sitting desk. These shoes hurt like the dickens after about an hour sitting down, so I ended up wearing them while walking and not while sitting, but I can't get away with that often. I'll give them more break in time, but after exploring the material I don't expect them to "come in" without a lot of foot pain in the meantime. The annoying thing, besides the tightness that causes the pain, is that these otherwise fit great. Width and length are good -- as good as my very expensive brand fancy shoes I normally work in. Cushioning while walking is very good. So these shoes are a mixed bag for my foot, and you may want to try them in person or with a return policy and see how they work for sitting. I'll keep trying to get these to loosen across the throat, and if they loosen I'll update this review. I cannot say I'd tell anyone to buy these, but they will certainly work for feet that aren't shaped like mine!
Just not what I expected. Had them on for about 20 min they hurt my feet took them off. I purchased them because I'm an OR nurse can't imagine wearing these things.

I have WIDE flat feet that look like flippers. These were an A fit for me but no one has my feet. I have them in roation with a few shoes. I do 12 hour days 6 days a week and have gotten 6 months out of them. That's GREAT for me. I personally think they look...GOOFY but they are comfortable. As I slip them on, I wonder what happened to THAT guy I was in high school but whatever. Considering my next favorite work brand is Dickies, I just accept the fact that these look better than thsoe corrective orthopedic shoes. With that said. I highly recommend these shoe especially to men that are already married, just don't care or are seeking women with low fashion standards.
Low arch support and tight across the top of my foot. Same tread as clogs I have been wearing for 2 years or more. Like that the heel is not a loose fit like the clogs.

Shoe is comfortable But, that s only if your not going to far and you can stop and sit for a bit. That being said. I work in the hospital in the ER and I do 12 hrs so even though they may be comfortable but there is absolutely no joint support. At the end of the day your joints knee, thighs, buttocks and lower back will be aching. You will be sore. Things to keep in mind before you buy for that kind of work.

Lets face it gentlemen there are few choices for male nurse shoes. You ladies have a plethora of choices where we are left with the bulky, clunky, ugly NBs. These are First and formeost comfortable. Second they clean well. This is important for if you imagine ALL of the substances that can come out of a persons many holes, either there from birth or recently added by Smith and Wesson, being able to wipe scrape and clean these shoes is important. Are they attractive? Not particularly, BUT they handle a 12.5 hour shift on floors made from what I can only describe as a hexagonal diamond material and not cause me to limp off the floor. I did wear them once without socks and they made a faft sound when I walked and I think thats funny. Im an ER nurse, farts are funny.

These shoes are totally worth it! I'm a PCT at a dialysis clinic and we have to wear close toed shoes for our protection. I've had these for several months now and I love them! I can wear them for 12 hour straight without hurting my foot. I have wide feet and these fit perfectly! I can't really tell if it has any arch support because I'm flat footed. They're also pretty durable and super easy to clean. Overall, I would definitely recommend these to anyone who does a lot of walking standing at their work place.

These are super comfortable and very effectively non-skid. I work on a floor that is often splashed with water or grease, so that's important. They look nice, too, with no holes, laces, or straps. They are slightly loose in the heel, but they don't rub when I walk. I bought the black and will soon be buying the white. I wish they came in more colors, at least a beige or gray.
The best shoes i have ever owned for work!! So comfortable it feels like i can walk all day and never get tired! Amazing i promise!

At my wits end with all the plantar fascia pain. I am a bartender, on my feet 6 hours minimum per shift. A couple of the Gen Z girls on the floor have theses and swore they are amazing. I gave in and ordered my true size. Six weeks in and my PF is seriously healing. No pun intended! What a relief! Maybe those kids are right about skinny jeans and side parts too!

I work in a meat department where we have to blast lots of stuff throughout the day to clean it. My pair of Snibbs shoes developed a hole in them so my feet were getting soaked every night. I first bought a size 10 pair of these Crocs, the size I normally get. They were huge! I returned them and got a size 8 which are still even a little too big, but not too much so to return them. In practice, the non-slipness isn't as good as the Snibbs but is enough to not worry much on a wet floor. They feel comfortable enough although I'd consider an insole for arch support because there's basically none. But most importantly, they're a simple, inexpensive shoe that gets me through the days. I recommend spending more to get a higher quality shoe if you can but if you just don't wanna, then these aren't a bad way to go.

Before I ordered these I ordered a pair of orthopedic work shoes. They were good on the first day and that was that. Everyone I work with said these were the most comfortable shoes to work in. I was reluctant at first but I saw more and more people wearing them. I jumped on the band wagon. Let me tell you these things feel like your on a cloud at times. They breathe, the insole is very comfortable, and they take a lot of the stress off my back. They are extremely slip resistant. It s been two weeks now and the insole doesn t feel like they are completely compressed. The right side feels a bit compressed but they are still very comfortable. And with amazons try and buy makes this a no brainer.

This clogs made by the Crocs company is one excellent pair of clogs! It's true to what it claims to be very comfortable wearing it if you're in the healthcare industry being a nurse or a doctor or any job that you're on your feet all day! Yeah... It's that comfortable! It's actually more comfortable than the regular crocs and apparently they focused on the level of comfort when your feet is in it and it feels like your feet are stepping on a pair sponges! This footwear is a must and can save your feet walking all day because this is what I felt, I rode my motorcycle wearing this then I went to beach and walked on sand with it. I can't really say enough about these and I might buy another pair! A highly recommended footwear!

These shoes are very comfortable, as are all the croc shoes I have owned. I really like that these have a small profile. Compared to the bistro these are less bulky. They have an insole that is fairly thick and provides a lot of cushion. These feel somewhat smaller than the regular crocs, in part because of the closed heel. I ve had to put them in the dryer to heat them up and stretch the toes out for better comfort. My regular crocs loosened up after some use as well, so I hope that happens with these as well. The nonslip sole works great, I have traction when going from wet ground to a tile floor. They are easily cleaned with a rinse and wipe. These are great shoes for working the floor of the hospital or the restaurant.

So I got these to battle the much outside the house where I live. I have to walk the dogs constantly, and I wanted something I could slip on that would keep my feet dry as it is very muddy and wet around here. The first thing I noticed in the pictures, and on wearing them, was the nice, roomy toe box. This is an excellent feature and one of the reasons I purchased these! I then took out the insoles, which are very comfortable and inspected the shoes. There is good padding for the heel, and a strange line about where your toes would touch, corresponding to a line in the tread. Nice grippy material on the underside of the insole and a nice bumpy pattern on the inside of the shoes. The shoes are a bit hard to slip on, you will have to use your finger. Tight at the mid-top of the foot, loose at the toe end, likely slightly longer than needed for the size. I never know what my size it, it could be 12, 13 or once, even 15! I ordered the 13s, and I feel that with bare feet, using the insoles, it is just a bit longer than needed, but otherwise nicely fitting all around most of the foot. Please note that the back of the heel part is a little loose and your heel may slip out occasionally. I would've like more height around the ankle, but it is OK as it is. If I take the insoles out I can feel the ground more, which I like, but the shoe becomes very loose. It would be easier to clean this way, except for one issue I will mention soon. If you are going to use this barefoot, without insoles, get a size smaller and try that first. If you are going to use them with insoles and socks, get a size larger. Use half-sizes if they have them, but I do not recall seeing them. If you are going to use socks but no insoles, stick with your normal size. That should insure you get a good fit. I like the materials, the stretchy stuff where you sip the foot it, how everything seems like it is one piece - very good quality as far as I can tell. I am concerned with the two little holes for breathing, that I will step in some water-saturated ground and get wet feet. We shall see. That said, you should know that these are NOT outside shoes! The biggest issue I have with these "On The Clock" shoes is the tread pattern. It literally sucks up mud and grime, and is nearly impossible to easily just hose off. It is a pattern of tiny squares cut in half or quarters - can't recall which. On coming inside tonight I found a lot of mud on my shoes, and it is not easy to remove. The material itself is fine - it will dry quickly and water will not permeate it. But the pattern makes removing mud and soil very difficult. So use these shoes indoors only. If you need muck shoes, you will have to find something else, unless you want to spend some time scrubbing off all the caked in mud and dirt every time you go outside and come back in. I will likely keep these, even though I will struggle with cleaning out the tread. Maybe I will find something better later.

I have a lot of foot issues, my feet are exploding. I have a bunion on my left foot that isn't too bad but this shoe presses on it. It's not just the pressure, the shoe fits on my foot crooked because of the bunion. That means the left side of my foot is more pushed into the left side and left front of the shoe. I got the same size I get in regular strappy Crocs but my size in this shoe is not big enough. Regular Crocs are a little big on me but these have a snug tailored fit. My instep is high and these shoes are so flat and tight that when I put the shoes on, my socks get dragged back and squish my toes. I try to put like an inch of slack around my toes so my sock will slide up and fit correctly but it doesn't really work. I'm afraid I need to buy another pair of these in the next largest size but I know it will be too big. They need to offer half sizes if they're going to make tailored shoes. I am wearing these while doing a LOT of walking and driving, running up stairs etc. They're very nonslip which is awesome, they've changed everything. I used to slide all over. But if you're doing anything active like this, especially stair climbing, there likely won't be enough support in the sole. It's very, very flexible. My feet get tired now. These are for more standing and moderate walking on an even floor I think. There are only two little ventilation holes on the inner side of each shoe which for me is a good thing. The shoes are essentially waterproof if you don't step in any big puddles. Even if you do step in water, not very much gets in. It's cold outside so I haven't worn these in the worst weather but they do seem to get way less swampy than my 6" XtraTuf boots. They're not bad at all even though my feet are always sweaty in any shoes. I was surprised. Sometimes they make farty noises though Really wish they had these in half sizes or had a relaxed fit version Eta I still need a half size bigger but I found a way to keep my socks from getting dragged up my feet. I put a heavy duty quart Zip-Loc bag over the whole top of my foot with the zipper toward my ankle , slide my foot into the shoe with the back of the shoe pressed down while trying not to touch the bottom of the shoe, pop the back up over my heel then pull the bag out. The bag is like a shoehorn for the top of my foot lol. I think something like a piece of plastic cut from a 3 prong folder might be better easier but I haven't tried it yet. Now I can even wear relatively thick winter socks, I just have to bring a quart bag if I go anywhere and plan to take my shoes off. And sometimes certain socks stick to the bottom of the shoe so they get dragged back a little anyway. Still 1000 times better!
Left shoe seems smaller my second toe was getting squashed. Wore them once to work. I would return them but not sure you can return worn items.

The first pair I received came in a crocs plastic bag and had all the tags on it. The pair I got from the return were a little different.. no tags and no croc bag I thought no biggie. But once I took a look at them they had debris on the soles like someone took them for a stroll. I tired them on to see how they fit and one was soo stretched out my foot slips out of it. So I pretty much paid 40 for a used pair of shoes.
Felt great for a few hours but the rubber securing the top of foot began giving me a red ring and sore. I don't know how someone could make it a day in these things.

These are the most uncomfortable shoes I've ever wore in my life they hurt my toes they have no support and those soul inside is so big that it squished my foot and rubbed against the inside causing a blister

After 4 days, the heel cushion came off both shoes. Also the width in the to box is on the pinkie side. Not helpful if you have a bunion. I did not return them, but instead just pulled off the heel cushions to make them work because I really needed something now. I could not contact the seller to request a replacement as there was no option for that online.
I had to take out the extra layer of comfortable sole that it had and it felt uncomfortable working while standing for long periods of time. Also didn t like the styling.

I ordered size 12 in these, but the whole where you put your foot in, the opening look like something on a child's shoe about 10 years old. There is no way that a man with a size 12 ft could fit their foot inside of that at least I don't see how they could. It looked to be well padded with a nice insole but I'll never know. I read that you can heat these and stretch them but all mine did was shrink even smaller so now they're about a size 10. Afterwards I ordered a size 13 thinking maybe it was just a particular ones I got but no there was the same problem again. Both times I contacted Amazon and Amazon refunded my money and told me just to keep them. Amazon has always had stellar customer service and anything that I've purchased from Amazon they have stood behind and refunded my money if it were defective. They didn't even make me send it back.
Just not what I expected. Had them on for about 20 min they hurt my feet took them off. I purchased them because I'm an OR nurse can't imagine wearing these things.
If you have a job were you walk and stand for 8 hours these are not for you I had to add 2 insoles in them which cause bruising at the top of my feet from the bc it's tight at the top of the shoe

I buy wide shoes, and I saw so many people where I work wearing these I thought, I'll give them a shot. The insoles felt really good, if a shade low for my arches, and the material looked durable and wasn't flashy. Honestly, apart from the wide toe, they look fine in a close-to-professional on-your-feet environment. Walking around I found the ankle wasn't steady because the collar wasn't very high, and I'm used to brands with more there. I adapted fairly quickly to a slightly different walking motion, which may be problematic after some time, but I didn't get to find out because... They hurt when I'm not walking. Specifically they hurt because the throat is too tight on the top of my foot. Some days I spend 7 hours on my feet, others just a few because I get stuck behind a computer at a sitting desk. These shoes hurt like the dickens after about an hour sitting down, so I ended up wearing them while walking and not while sitting, but I can't get away with that often. I'll give them more break in time, but after exploring the material I don't expect them to "come in" without a lot of foot pain in the meantime. The annoying thing, besides the tightness that causes the pain, is that these otherwise fit great. Width and length are good -- as good as my very expensive brand fancy shoes I normally work in. Cushioning while walking is very good. So these shoes are a mixed bag for my foot, and you may want to try them in person or with a return policy and see how they work for sitting. I'll keep trying to get these to loosen across the throat, and if they loosen I'll update this review. I cannot say I'd tell anyone to buy these, but they will certainly work for feet that aren't shaped like mine!

I'm basically living in my standard classic Crocs right now due to a foot injury, but the holes aren't a great feature in our wet and cold winter weather. Bought these hoping to replicate the feel and fit of the standard Crocs and have a better option for outdoor activities - But these just don't fit or feel the same as the regular Crocs, possibly because they are heavier. The inside has a really nice cushion, which isn't the issue. They are just too big. My foot tends to move around in them and my toes have to grip to keep them on correctly - since it is a toe injury I'm dealing with, this isn't ideal, and it is a huge pain on any non-level surface, so I can't even wear them to go check the mail. They are just too big on my feet, but are the same size I get for classic Crocs, and fur lined classic Crocs, so not sure why they aren't working. They do have a rubber boot feel to them once on. Would have sent them back, but wore them outside, and now they just sit in my closet. Just know they do not look, feel or perform like classic Crocs clogs. May seek them out in a brick mortar store to see if the next size down feels better.
I received a clearly used or refurbished pair of shoes. The treads underneath were full of dirt, and the outsides are scuffed and marked up.

I'm one of the lucky humans where my 2 feet are different sizes. My left foot is about a half size larger. Also, again, very fortunate, my 2nd toe is longer than my 1st. My left foot is a size 13 in every brand of shoe I've purchased for 30 years. These shoes are unbelievably uncomfortable. On the left bigger foot, my 2nd toe rams the front of the inside even though the outside of the shoe looks like it's a Birkenstock-type foot bed. On the right foot, my big toe rolls around to where I've developed an injury that's only now healing after 2 weeks of not wearing these shoes. Add to this, upon forgetting that these trashed my feet and trying them for a short outdoor walk again, the hard reinforced lip around the ankle went straight through "blister" to "raw" and now I have to peel my socks off a scab every night. Spend real money on decent shoes. I'm almost 50, and the sole sign of age is how much I now have to baby my feet. These are not good shoes, even for weekend kick-around slip-ons. They hurt my feet.

I have WIDE flat feet that look like flippers. These were an A fit for me but no one has my feet. I have them in roation with a few shoes. I do 12 hour days 6 days a week and have gotten 6 months out of them. That's GREAT for me. I personally think they look...GOOFY but they are comfortable. As I slip them on, I wonder what happened to THAT guy I was in high school but whatever. Considering my next favorite work brand is Dickies, I just accept the fact that these look better than thsoe corrective orthopedic shoes. With that said. I highly recommend these shoe especially to men that are already married, just don't care or are seeking women with low fashion standards.

1 Construction My pair seemed to be well built, and light in hand. I did not notice any rips, cracks or other separations in the components of the shoes. They are moderately flexible, more so if you remove whichever of two style inserts yours came with. More on that, later 2 Fit The toe box on these is big and roomy, as a good shoe should be. I did notice a tight spot on these shoes, though this might have to do more with my individual physique than with the product A slightly tighter fit between the inside tops of my feet and the shoes, especially when wearing thicker than average thickness socks. I was able to remedy this with a file bit for my drill, and gently filed away about 1mm of material from inside the top of the uppers of both shoes. I can now still wear them comfortably without socks, or, with socks of any thickness. 3 On the Move These are NOT Merrells or Danskos! But they are an economical alternative with at least 70 percent of the arch and overall support I need at work, or for a mile-long walk around my neighborhood. I have tested them with and without the included inserts, and have not experienced a whole lot of rubbing in most combinations. For me, if I go barefoot, I will leave the bottom inserts in. With my thicker socks, I can wear them with or without the inserts in. Wearing my thickest Icelandic 30 belows, I can wear them without the inserts, on my leisure days when it is cold outside. I also own Crocs Lite Ride sandals, and can say that Crocs does know 'a thing or two' about orthotic support ergonomics. And it has translated to the experience in these On The Clock clogs. 4 Finally.. The SWEAT Factor! I've read a lot of reviews from wearers who state that their feet got really hot, and or sweaty and smelly in Crocs On The Clock. I would say that is true in my case - but only when wearing my thickest socks - the Icelandic 30 Below wools. After a few hours in the Crocs Icelandic combination, when I remove the Crocs, the bottoms of the Icelandics are indeed warm and wet! But not squishy wet. And that leads me to my final section, regarding the title of this review... 5 Two Flavors of On The Clock Clogs I bought, from this page, the version with the dark spongy support inserts with fabric on top, and with small holes punched through the forward toe box section for breathability. That might explain my lack of the squishy-squeaky soaky experience I read in so many reviews here. There is another version, which looks externally exactly like mine, top to sole, but, it has the red or orange? insert that is just plain rubber, and has the same pattern as my aforementioned Crocs Lite Ride flip flops. Now in a shoe like these On The Clocks, even with the small holes they do come with, a solid rubber bottom, or insert if that's what that is, is what I would understand to be a recipe for really irritably hot, sweaty soles, with or without socks! And that excessive sweat is what can lead to the squaking, pardon my french, 'farty' sounds of a thoroughly drenched foot against the rubber bottom of such a shoe. I would suspect that most of the excessively 'hot n sweaty' and squeaky complaints are coming from wearers of that version, which I have yet to review. I may be wrong. Please let me know, if there is a reply function to these posted reviews. Overall, for under U.S. 50, they are a relatively light, comfortable, and supportive shoe for, as they are named, on the clock at work, or at home or out on the town. Update - 2023-March My two pair of Crocs On-the-Clocks, the regular originals and the ones with LiteRide insert, are so laid back, semi-formal, and easy to wear that I often just put one pair on or the other without thinking too much about it. Most folks are surprised when they find out these are Crocs! And I have to say that the "non-Literide" black fabric insert version is definitely the sweatier of the two versions. Last week I wore them barefoot to a mall, and walked a few laps around the main concourse, an hour or so before the stores started opening. Even as I arrived at the mall, my feet already felt quite warm in them, and a little damp, even thogh it was only a few degress above freezing outdoors. After half a mile walking four laps around the main axis of the mall , my feet were squeaking around in them, and my soles felt drenched in sweat. Sounded like ducks quacking with every step, lol! I had to sit down somewhere I could slip them off and let my feet cool off - and dry off! - before resuming my tour of the mall. One of this mall's many sofas scattered through out served the purpose. I guess the fact that these Crocs do keep feet so warm, with or without socks, is a plus in New England or the Northwest, where sub-freezing temperatures are a regular winter guest. So yes, you can wear either version of On-The-Clocks work clogs without socks, but remember, your feet will likely sweat more in the fabric insert original? version than in the orange rubbery lined Literide version. So, wear socks with the regular version if you plan to wear them for more than just a garbage or mail box run, longer than an hour, or plan to walk around alot, for work or leisure.

I write reviews either when I'm very satisfied or when I'm very dissatisfied. There's hardly in-betweens. I'm glad to say that I'm writing this particular review because I'm very satisfied with the purchase. The size is perfect, and from the first day of wearing it, it's more comfortable than I could've expected. I've worn it while taking a walk, worn it while driving, etc. And because it's croc, immersing it in water for cleaning and putting it back on is even more cool. I needed something like this to complement my regular shoes when I spend long time in transit, and this one delivers. What is yet to be tested is how long it will last.
We have had so much rain, my back yard is like a marsh. I bought these to wear when I m in the yard so as to not ruin my athletic shoes.
My husband is a chef and he loves these shoes. Being on his feet for long hours, he says these support pretty nicely.

Before I ordered these I ordered a pair of orthopedic work shoes. They were good on the first day and that was that. Everyone I work with said these were the most comfortable shoes to work in. I was reluctant at first but I saw more and more people wearing them. I jumped on the band wagon. Let me tell you these things feel like your on a cloud at times. They breathe, the insole is very comfortable, and they take a lot of the stress off my back. They are extremely slip resistant. It s been two weeks now and the insole doesn t feel like they are completely compressed. The right side feels a bit compressed but they are still very comfortable. And with amazons try and buy makes this a no brainer.

Lets face it gentlemen there are few choices for male nurse shoes. You ladies have a plethora of choices where we are left with the bulky, clunky, ugly NBs. These are First and formeost comfortable. Second they clean well. This is important for if you imagine ALL of the substances that can come out of a persons many holes, either there from birth or recently added by Smith and Wesson, being able to wipe scrape and clean these shoes is important. Are they attractive? Not particularly, BUT they handle a 12.5 hour shift on floors made from what I can only describe as a hexagonal diamond material and not cause me to limp off the floor. I did wear them once without socks and they made a faft sound when I walked and I think thats funny. Im an ER nurse, farts are funny.

If I had went along and believed everything I ve read about these crocs negatively I won t have owned a pair of my own . I work in the medical field and my days are built on standing from 8-12 hours. Wearing these has been a sigh of relief! The non slip sole comes off with wear and tear, but I ve applied crazy glue and it s permanently intact now . You won t regret buying these for sure .
They are very comfortable and has much better traction in the soles, however a little lining would make them even better.
Was looking for an all white shoe. Unfortunately these have a black sole. That wasn t apparent in the pics

Great product. UNFORTUNATELY my husband stands on his feet for 12 hrs and didn't really find them comfortable for him.Were gonna.just keep them for yard work.or something that he can do when he doesn't have to wear for long hrs..

I work in a restaurant and stay on my feet. I also have plantar fasciitis which has sent me on a shoe shopping spree to find shoes that will keep me safe and out of pain. There is a break in period with these shoes. At first, the ankle was tight and I was worried I had wasted more money on shoes. After about 3 shifts, they loosened up and now are perfect. I've been wearing them for about 2 months and can highly recommend these shoes. As far as how long they will last, I can't say. But, for 28 they are worth the investment.

No surprises is the best I can say about this shoe. I will continue on my quest for the perfect professional kitchen shoe. Oh- and the pebbly texture? It holds dirt and products like flour....difficult to clean.

I love these Crocks! After wearing steel toed boots at work, these are my happy time shoes. They are sturdy enough to even wear in cold weather. There s no holes so your feet stay dry. More importantly, they do have traction soles that are firm enough to walk around with confidence. They do have full heel protection, not just a strap. Most importantly, they re still Crocks, and they make my feet feel happy!

Sort of heavy for plastic shoes. Bought these for "camp shoes" at then end of a long day of backpacking. No holes, keep the morning dew off my feet socks. Every ounce counts, not sure why these are so heavy

It s is hard to find clothes that look good with these bad boys... they are ugly, but soooo freaking comfortable! These are great for my long days off kitchen work. Some shifts are 15 hours long. These are great for those.

I have a job that requires minimal walking unless I choose to do more. My dress code requires black shoes that can be polished .. these are comfy and give just the right appearance, not too dressy, but not too casual against my uniform. Great design, and they come in nice insoles. However buy one size up if you plan to wear these with socks.

So ugly, but soooo comfortable. Baught these to be worn as house slippers and love them. I purchased them a size to big in order to make them easy t slip off and on and they still fit tight over the top of my feet. They are fine if the insole is removed, but the insole makes them so awesome to walk around in. Next time I will buy 2 sizes to big.
These are amazing!! For the price, they are the best kitchen shoes ive had so far. Spent 90 on a pair of mozzos and they were nothing like these.

Love them a lot! They are way better then the shoes I was wearing previously, this is my first full day wearing them to work and they feel pretty great, the crocs logo is worn off already on the sole but that s no biggie, and they have a bit of scuffs but they are white so that s not an issue either. I only do pharmacy work so this isn t a review from someone who is working in a very fast paced active job, but for what I do they work well. They were cheaper on Amazon then the actual croc website so you save about 5 which was cool. Over all a good buy in my opinion, I think I m also gonna grab the black ones as well.

If you are a half size, order down. Not quite black, more like a very dark gray. The color resembles old tires. I love the removable insole. Very comfortable as my feet are often swollen from neuropathy. Definitely makes walking more comfortable.

I have a pair of traditional slide style Crocs in this pattern that I love. I usually size down in Crocs, but with this shoe style, sizing is accurate, don't size down. These fit more snug over the arch and do come up higher on the heel. Other than that, they wear similar to traditional style Crocs. They are seamless with 2 very small vent holes at the inside arch of each shoe. I love the vibrant colors, each shoe deliberately doesn't match the other exactly, so don't be obsessive about that. They are really cute and think they'll keep my feet dry in the rain.

Well they are ugly. I hate the way they look. But they provide relief for my injured foot, and I can wear them for extended periods of time. I have spent the past several years making fun of people that wear crocs in public, and although I still think that is a valid critique, if you need them, then I guess you get a pass. I know most many people will disagree, but those of us who don't want to look like we just spent the night on a strangers couch prefer to look a bit more refined and composed.

These are perfect for my job as a CRNA. I wanted something super comfortable that wasn t 100 or more. I m calling these my marshmallow cloud shoes. They are cute and are going to look great with my black scrubs. So excited to wear these bad boys tomorrow!
