representative_reviews.text: These are the most painful hiking shoes I have ever owned! I took them out for a short 6.5 mile test hike . The insoles are SO hard with zero cushion, by the end of the hike the balls of my feet and bottom of my heels were in such pain I thought they were going to have giant blisters. I have never had ANY type of pain in the bottom my heels, so there is no question it was caused by these shoes. The heel box is also quite wide so I had to tie the shoes extra tight to keep them from sliding around which was also uncomfortable. Also very little arch support, so if you have higher arches you will feel it. I typically do 13-15 mile hikes and am so glad I did a shorter hike first - I physically would not have been able to go longer due to the pain. Aside from the heel box, the fit of the shoe was nice and true to size. Went through several steams, puddles, and snow piles with zero wetness so waterproofing seems to be on point. I don t know how they managed to make the insoles so painful, but they did! Highly recommend taking these out for a short spin before attempting a longer hike. Highly recommend the Ls Sportiva Spire. A little more pricey but worth it if you are doing long miles on the trails.

Terrible design where tongue is attached to shoe, there is a rough seam that presses and rubs on the top of my foot, causing blisters. Not sure what went wrong older version of this shoe has a smooth rounded tongue without a seam in this location. My bad I missed the return window while I was hiking in Nevada WITHOUT these shoes that were intended for this trip.

Unfortunately I had to put thick moleskin pads on the right heel area only. Walking the first time caused a massive blister on my right heel from the back of the shoe moving up and down. Of course this puts my toes closer to the toe box so the right foot is kinda squished. The left shoe fits well. This never happened before with sneakers or any kind of hiking shoes winter boots. I was going to return but with this fix I can use the shoes. Disappointed as these shoes got great reviews.
Seam at heel was rough and caused a blister. I did get a prompt refund when I returned them. I normally have had good luck with this brand.
These boots have poor arch support. They must have been sitting in a hot warehouse for a while for the rubber coming off after two times wear. I wish I could return them.

I tried these on immediately, and oh boy did they hurt my feet. I wear an 8 and bought an 8. My little toe was rubbed and I could not walk in these at all. There was no give. Shoe was like wearing concrete. Had to send them back.

Stiff and poorly contoured to the natural flex of your feet. Poor ankle support and lack in cushion. Feels like walking with a board strapped to the bottom of your feet. I was unable to wear them for more than 30 mins without pain in my feet and ankles for days after. They don t make it easy to return. I will never order shoes from Amazon again.

I appreciate the roomy toe box. These did take probably 2 weeks to break in as tgey were tight across the top of my foot. I wish the arch support was better and gosh, the heels need cushioning. My feet really hurt after standing in these most of the day.
I was totally disappointed with this shoe! The shoe was horribly hard with no support. The collar of the shoe dug into my ankle.

They are very uncomfortable they hurt the top and bottom of my feet . You cant put the tight because of the tongue is attached to the sides and it leaves a fold between the tongue and the sides that hurts .i will never buy again. They are very uncomfortable.

I wish these had fit. They were too narrow and stiff for me so I had to return them. I don't know if an extra wide would have worked better for my feet. Unfortunately, since I broke my ankle in two places a year ago and I have had issues with this type of shoe. They were also too tight across the top of my foot and rubbed under the lacing.

Preparing for a trip to Ireland and purchased these shoes for hiking. I ve walked 3 miles in them twice to be sure they would be comfortable for hiking. I m very happy with them. No blisters, great support. Laces don t stay tied to well but otherwise they re great!!

I ve always liked Merrells. I don t know what is wrong with these shoes but they cause me intense foot pain. I ve tried and tried to wear them but each time, I am left in near crippling pain. It s not the fit. It s something about the design that perhaps either doesn t support my foot or doesn t flex enough. I dunno.

The shoes are comfortable but I wore them hiking in Shenandoah and they caused plantar fasciitis. I've never had it before and it has been so painful for weeks. It all started with these shoes and it's the only difference. There isn't a lot of support and my feet hurt like they never have been after only one day.

I made the mistake of assuming this pair would be just like the previous pair I have had for several years which were comfortable right out of the box and never caused pain or discomfort. I neglected to try them on before taking them to a birding conference where I was outdoors from 7 am to 3 pm daily. After just an hour or so each day, my heels began hurting and did not stop until I took the shoes off in the afternoon. On a good note, they are water resistant and kept my feet dry. Overall, I'm disappointed in the shoe and wish I could return them to try something different. Update 1 31 21 I wear these shoes a lot now with little discomfort.

I was very worried about finding a hiking shoe that is lightweight, waterproof, and most importantly wide enough for my extra wide feet, especially when wearing them with thicker socks. I need a very wide toe box and this shoe delivered on all of the above. PLUS they are very comfortable. To test them out before using them for my trip, I wore them to work, doing massage therapy. I need a light and fairly flexible shoe to work in and this shoe did it for me. I have collapsed arches, which also means I need some kind of support. This shoe delivered on that as well. I still have to add a bit of an arch support insole for long walks hikes, but for day to day, they work just fine. So, review Fits well for extra wide feet, flexible, comfortable, light weight, waterproof, and supportive.

Supportive and cushions impact. Flexible to comfortably move in them and lightweight. Fantastic stucture and stability in the footbed. Appears to be very well made. I wear these for 10 hour days standing and they have saved my back. I have more energy and less pain when I wear these. I love them!

I walked for miles in these in England and Scotland. They were warm enough, comfortable and lightweight compared to other hiking boots . The arch support was great and I appreciated how they felt truly broken in immediately.

I like the interior padding of the tongue and around the back of the shoe. It feels comfy during hour long walks and helps to keep your foot dry if you are walking in wet weather. The sole of this particular Merrell shoe is rubber and the upper part suede for warmth and comfort.

Great shoes! Have owned Keens for a while and decided these were my next option. Great choice was made. They are supportive and comfortable after 2 to 3 days of breaking in. They do have a higher arch than I'm used to but it has reduced my back pain from my standing job. Kudos! Will be looking into this company more for what they have to offer.

I have high arches and struggle with tendonitis in my achilles. For this reason I exclusively wear Vionics, but they don't have much selection for hiking boots. I read the reviews that Merrells provided good arch support, so took a chance and very happy. Broke them in around the house and neighborhood walks. Just completed a very difficult hike that gained almost 1000 feet in elevation on a rocky path with high steps. Everything in my body hurt except my feet! Very happy.

The most comfortable shoes ever!!! You may put it on and go hiking right away without worrying to have a blister or tired feet. Gold medal to this wonderful brand. Over ten years experience. The best. Thank you Merrell!

These shoes are comfortable right out of the box. I have difficulty finding shoes that give me the support and fit I need. These helped me hike on our trip to Colorado without any pain. I also use them to just walk in the park. Great hiking or all around shoes!

I purchased these shoes for a trip to Ireland and Scotland. I needed waterproof shoes that were both practical and comfortable, and I needed to be able to use my orthotic inserts with them. I selected this style after reading the reviews of others who had purchased this shoe and had good results. I wear a size 7, and purchased the 7.5 based upon customer reviews. The 7.5 gives me adequate toe room, and I am glad that I ordered that size. Although I have not yet been on the trip for which I purchased these shoes, I can honestly say that I could not be more pleased. I have worn them around town in both wet and dry weather, and my feet have stayed dry. As several of the other reviewers stated, they were comfortable right out of the box, and a break-in period was not necessary. I have not yet used my orthotics with them, because they have been very comfortable out of the box. However, I plan to take them with me on my trip in case I need them. I am happy with these shoes, and so far, would buy them again.

The best hiking shoe ever! I always get a pair of these before I go on vacation overseas. This pair went hiking in Wales and England this time! There s absolutely no break in Period! The arch support is heavenly. I ve never had a pair of shoes with so much support in them! I turned my old shoes into my work painting shoes are in. I can stand on my feet for 10 to 12 hours without any pain at all.
I love the balance. It aligns my hips and back reducing pain. Soles grip well giving me more confidence when hiking and climbing. Keeps my feet warm and dry in the rain and snow.
I have very problematic feet... bunions, no arches. I can put Merrills on and wear them right out of the box. The arch support is sturdy and the toe box has plenty of room to move.

I bought these for a trip where there ll be different terrain. I wanted to make sure that my feet will be comfortable. I need higher arch support and heel support due to bone spurs plantar fasciitis. I tested these on regular walks with and without my arch support. I find that these are a bit awkward in the arch, but not overly uncomfortable. They re supposed to be water resistant so that s why I bought this pair. They do seem to grip but I ve yet to test in muddy rainy environment. I m hoping they re not too hot. I think they need to be worn in a little since they feel a little stiff. For reference I use size 9-10 US size depending on brand and I recommend a W if you don t have narrow feet for a comfortable toe box. They feel sturdy and good quality and I bought the gray with turquoise detail since they were on sale but are a nice medium gray color.

This is my second pair. After purchasing the hiking boots in a store, I immediately ordered a second pair on Amazon. Yes, they are perfect for hiking, but also for walking in general. I had suffered from leg pain which instantly went away after wearing these shoes. I can't stress enough, how wonderful these are. I will never buy another brand as they are the only ones that offer great arch support.
A very supportive, well built shoe. All day comfort walking on concrete floors. A great shoe but the soles lose traction when wet.

size.issue_summary: 많은 구매자들이 사이즈 문제로 불만을 토로하고 있으며, 특히 발뒤꿈치가 미끄러지거나 발가락 박스가 너무 작다는 의견이 많습니다.
size.strength_summary: 많은 구매자들이 이 신발의 사이즈가 정확하고 발가락 공간이 넓어 편안하다고 평가했습니다. 이는 다양한 발 모양에 적합하여 사용자 만족도를 높입니다.

representative_reviews.text: I have a narrow foot and can sometimes wear a medium width. This fit fairly well except the heel slipped and made it uncomfortable-tried thicker socks but still had the problem
By the time I tried the shoe and realized it is not an original, it was too late to send back. The toe box is very tight compared to the original.
I like these shoes overall, but they run a little small. I returned an 8 1 2 and will order a size 9. Nice arch and support in the shoe.

I had to go up a 1 2 size because the toe box was way too small for the size I normally wear. The back also rubbed a big blister on my heel. When I ordered a 1 2 size up the width is now too wide but the toe box fit better. These shoes are also NOT WATERPROOF. Maybe waterproof for a light drizzle but for a downpour your feet will get soaked. Will never buy these shoes again.
Seam at heel was rough and caused a blister. I did get a prompt refund when I returned them. I normally have had good luck with this brand.
I liked the looks of this shoe know Merrell is a popular brand. Unfortunately the Wide was too tight in the toe box and they just weren t as comfortable as my old New Balance hikers.

I am very disappointed in this shoe. Been trying to break them in before my hiking trip in June. They hurt my feet in the ball of my foot. I really don t know if I will be able to wear them. I ordered a 10 wide width. Very disappointed.

I am pretty much a true size 6 M. These press my toes and get uncomfortable fast. Had I gone a half size larger, they may not have fit in other places. I should have gone to a store and tried shoes on but because 9 out of 10 times I wear 6 M I figured I would be good to go and I had run out of time to get shoes for a trip.

Unfortunately I had to put thick moleskin pads on the right heel area only. Walking the first time caused a massive blister on my right heel from the back of the shoe moving up and down. Of course this puts my toes closer to the toe box so the right foot is kinda squished. The left shoe fits well. This never happened before with sneakers or any kind of hiking shoes winter boots. I was going to return but with this fix I can use the shoes. Disappointed as these shoes got great reviews.
Ordered 1 2 bigger and still too small. Also slips on heels. First pair of Merrells that don t fit right.

I've had the Merrell Siren 2 Sport in the past, but looking for a waterproof hiking shoe for an upcoming trip to Alaska. Went up a full size greater 10.5 medium than my shoe size to accommodate a thicker sock, because my Siren's have been feeling too tight I've washed them several times . I was really disappointed in the Moab 2 Waterproof because my toe was touching badly even in a thin sock and they were too narrow. It is painful and I've only worn them in the house. My foot is on the narrow side of medium width. I measured my foot at a shoe store just to check and yes they are still size 9. When I place my foot on the outside of the the shoe there at least 2 inches to spare. Something is taking up all the room in the inside and it's not the packaging. I tried on my sister's Moab 2 Ventilators-same size and there is plenty of room.

I have small feet. I was so excited I found shoes in my size. However as soon as I put them on I slipped on ice. And there s no support for your ankles. For merrell s I thought they d be more comfortable.

I ordered these a half size larger and they still felt too narrow. The insoles didn t have much arch support and were hard. The shoe was stiff to walk in and felt too uncomfortable to keep after only 15 mins.

I have a pair of the Merrell Women's Midcalf Waterproof Hiking Shoe and the shoes fit great and are very comfortable. I ordered a women's size 11 Medium. I ordered these Merrell woman's hiking shoes with the lower calf shoe and the fit was too small. I wear a women's size 11 and I ordered a women's size 11.

I wish these had fit. They were too narrow and stiff for me so I had to return them. I don't know if an extra wide would have worked better for my feet. Unfortunately, since I broke my ankle in two places a year ago and I have had issues with this type of shoe. They were also too tight across the top of my foot and rubbed under the lacing.

I was very worried about finding a hiking shoe that is lightweight, waterproof, and most importantly wide enough for my extra wide feet, especially when wearing them with thicker socks. I need a very wide toe box and this shoe delivered on all of the above. PLUS they are very comfortable. To test them out before using them for my trip, I wore them to work, doing massage therapy. I need a light and fairly flexible shoe to work in and this shoe did it for me. I have collapsed arches, which also means I need some kind of support. This shoe delivered on that as well. I still have to add a bit of an arch support insole for long walks hikes, but for day to day, they work just fine. So, review Fits well for extra wide feet, flexible, comfortable, light weight, waterproof, and supportive.
It fit me well. However, I did get my shoe size checked at a store that carries the shoes REI beforehand.

A touch small. My toes go right to the end of the shoe. I have another pair of Merrells and they fit much better length wise. But, for my use they kept my feet warm and dry while out herding in the fields.

All companies have their own last so it s just a matter of finding your size. Normally I wear a 9.5 or 10 with this shoe a 10 Wide is perfect and super comfortable. Nice fitting heal with a comfortable toe box. I will definitely be purchasing more of this brand .just going with the wide instead of having to return and reorder. The quality is excellent as is traction and style. Super cute and comfortable!
Product was exactly what I expected and fitted true to size. Once I broke them in the stiffness faded away.
Great fit and comfort! Shoe ties are large diameter and easy for my hands to work stay put when tied. Tred is perfect for the trail. Comfortable on my old feet from the start.

I purchased these shoes for a trip to Ireland and Scotland. I needed waterproof shoes that were both practical and comfortable, and I needed to be able to use my orthotic inserts with them. I selected this style after reading the reviews of others who had purchased this shoe and had good results. I wear a size 7, and purchased the 7.5 based upon customer reviews. The 7.5 gives me adequate toe room, and I am glad that I ordered that size. Although I have not yet been on the trip for which I purchased these shoes, I can honestly say that I could not be more pleased. I have worn them around town in both wet and dry weather, and my feet have stayed dry. As several of the other reviewers stated, they were comfortable right out of the box, and a break-in period was not necessary. I have not yet used my orthotics with them, because they have been very comfortable out of the box. However, I plan to take them with me on my trip in case I need them. I am happy with these shoes, and so far, would buy them again.

Great shoe.. got it for work.. has good support.. The only problem., which is with most shoe manufacturers. A woman's shoe should be made for a woman's foot.. I have a problem especially with Merrell shoes, getting them wide enough in the toe small enough in the heel. My heel comes out of most of my shoes when I walk but my toes usually feel cramped even in a wide width. Wish somebody would please fix this!!! otherwise the shoe is working out well for me despite to much room in the heel.
True to size, very supportive extremely comfortable. I have a very hard time finding shoes I can wear all day recently changed over to hiking shoes boots. For me no break-in time was required.
These shoes fit well I ordered 1 2 size larger for thick socks. Have only used them to try out but so far they're perfect..
This was a top notch shoe, but the wide width was not nearly wide enough to wear with a wide foot. Toe area still curves in...feet do not.
I have very problematic feet... bunions, no arches. I can put Merrills on and wear them right out of the box. The arch support is sturdy and the toe box has plenty of room to move.

I read all the reviews and ordered a 1 2 size larger than I normally wear. I wear a 9W and ordered a 9-1 2W, just enough room in the toe area and they are comfortable right out of the box. Did a test walk with them on my treadmill!!! They were great. Bought them for a trip to Alaska, I am sure they will be a perfect shoe for that trip. They are also very comfortable.
These shoes are stiff. The heel slips often. I'm hoping they break in but they're not cushy or comfortable
These really are awesome right out of the box. I have plantar fasciitis and I can wear these all day while on my feet. Just order up half a size.

issue_keywords: defective when they got to my house
durability.issue_summary: 구매자들은 내구성 문제로 인해 신발의 밑창이 분리되거나, 불량품을 받는 경우가 많아 실망하고 있습니다.
durability.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발의 내구성이 뛰어나고 오랜 사용에도 잘 견디는 것으로 평가하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Seam at heel was rough and caused a blister. I did get a prompt refund when I returned them. I normally have had good luck with this brand.

Full price shoe came without original packaging and damaged, with a note left shoe has kink in insole. What?! This was not an outlet purchase. They are unwearable. Returning!! As a loyal Merrell customer, I m really disappointed I won t have these for an upcoming trip.

I bought these shoes for my job as a doggy daycare boarding kennel attendant because the job involves a lot of hosing down runs and kennels. First, the pros They took a week or so to fully break in, which was fine, since after they were broken in they have been very comfortable. And for the first two months they were very waterproof, to the point I could spray them off or spill a bucket of water on them without worry. The cons They don t have great traction indoors on wet floors, but that s not a huge fault since they were intended for hiking. The biggest issue is that this morning, two months after ordering them, the waterproofing failed. A dog had peed all over both shoes, so I gave them a good hosing down while wearing them as I ve done several times before. This time, though, the toes soaked through within seconds, leaving my socks sopping wet. I had to ask a coworker for extra socks and shoes to wear the rest of my shift. I am very disappointed because this happened without warning after relying on these shoes daily to keep my feet dry. If there d been no shoes to borrow, I d have had to wear wet shoes all day in below-freezing weather.
I was totally disappointed with this shoe! The shoe was horribly hard with no support. The collar of the shoe dug into my ankle.
The folding parts on the top are too thick and scratch my skin badly. Too painful to wear and walk with them.

I have had several pairs of the original Moab but this is my first pair of the Moab 2. I knew that I need to order a half size larger, so I did. I've gotten new Moab's right out of the box and walked 2-3 miles with no pain so I ordered the Moab 2's to take with me to a trip to NYC because I knew I would be doing a lot of walking. I don't know why Merrell had to change these shoes but taking them on a trip was a mistake and actually after having them a month I feel the purchase was a mistake. The half size larger is now still too small and they aren't as wide as they used to be. I keep wearing them hoping eventually they will feel good but so far no luck. I will never buy another pair of the Moab 2.

Received on September 9th, First wore these hiking shoes on September 16 and about 6-8 days since then. I noticed the sole separating within two weeks of wearing them! Waiting to hear from the vendor for a resolution. I ll share an update soon to let you know if they stand behind their merchandise. Update vendor promptly responded and offered a refund
They were defective when they got to my house the insole was crumpled up inside and was unable to return so now I m stuck with 100 pair of shoes that I can t even wear

Received the shoes and fit my wife perfect good new . Every step she took they made a noise not good news . It seems that the inner liner and outer must have some sort of adhesive that have totally come loose. If you squeeze the shoe from the top of the ankle rim, you can feel a pocked of the outer and inner shoe want to "stick" together but them come apart. This was on the full interior area around your rear foot area to the base. Like taking two pieces of tape and sticking...unsticking...sticking...unsticking. Sadly had to return but the sound was no-doubt faulty workmanship on the construction. Forgot to mention the box it was shipped in, the actual box, had a gash rip full length
We love Merrell shoes and have bought them for years. This time we got some bad ones. The sole is separating at the toe and starting to peel off after one summer of use.

These fit like a dream. However, the third time that I wore them in regular conditions the sole of one of the shoes came unglued. Because it was just past the return window and I am on vacation in Japan, this negatively impacted my trip. I have already emailed Merrill directly and will update my review once the situation has been rectified.

I made the mistake of assuming this pair would be just like the previous pair I have had for several years which were comfortable right out of the box and never caused pain or discomfort. I neglected to try them on before taking them to a birding conference where I was outdoors from 7 am to 3 pm daily. After just an hour or so each day, my heels began hurting and did not stop until I took the shoes off in the afternoon. On a good note, they are water resistant and kept my feet dry. Overall, I'm disappointed in the shoe and wish I could return them to try something different. Update 1 31 21 I wear these shoes a lot now with little discomfort.
By the time I tried the shoe and realized it is not an original, it was too late to send back. The toe box is very tight compared to the original.

I so wanted to like and keep this hiking shoe. I tried three different sizes, but none of them worked for me. The problem was that the arch insert felt wrong somehow, as if it was in the wrong spot and too high. I have high arches, so that should have been ideal, but instead my entire foot felt out of alignment. I tried wearing them just around the house to see if I'd get used to the insert, and after five minutes, my feet were aching. I think this is a problem with how my arch interacted with the shoe's construction. The shoe was well-made and otherwise comfortable, and I was really sorry to have to send it back.

Terrible design where tongue is attached to shoe, there is a rough seam that presses and rubs on the top of my foot, causing blisters. Not sure what went wrong older version of this shoe has a smooth rounded tongue without a seam in this location. My bad I missed the return window while I was hiking in Nevada WITHOUT these shoes that were intended for this trip.

I purchased these shoes for a trip to Ireland and Scotland. I needed waterproof shoes that were both practical and comfortable, and I needed to be able to use my orthotic inserts with them. I selected this style after reading the reviews of others who had purchased this shoe and had good results. I wear a size 7, and purchased the 7.5 based upon customer reviews. The 7.5 gives me adequate toe room, and I am glad that I ordered that size. Although I have not yet been on the trip for which I purchased these shoes, I can honestly say that I could not be more pleased. I have worn them around town in both wet and dry weather, and my feet have stayed dry. As several of the other reviewers stated, they were comfortable right out of the box, and a break-in period was not necessary. I have not yet used my orthotics with them, because they have been very comfortable out of the box. However, I plan to take them with me on my trip in case I need them. I am happy with these shoes, and so far, would buy them again.
I love how these feel great right out of the box. My last pair held up like iron. Merrell makes a great shoe!!

This is my second pair of this model. With an ankle issue, I do swap out insoles for my specific issue, but the arch is in the right place, and the soles are long lasting. The mess on the upper allows them to breathe so my feet don't sweat as much. Never had a problem with the mess fraying in the many Merrills I've had.
A very supportive, well built shoe. All day comfort walking on concrete floors. A great shoe but the soles lose traction when wet.

I have been trying to be better about spending more money on quality items, so I went ahead and got these rather then some Colombias that where a little cheaper with slightly worse reviews. And it was totally worth it!! These things are super sturdy and comfortable. They have a wide toe box, order at least a half size up if you like to wear thick socks. I have been wearing them them to take the dogs out in the forest up and down a steep gravel drive way, and honestly I feel like I could walk up the side of a cliff in these things. So far well worth the money, we will see how they hold up.

Got these to replace the boot version I had for many years and many miles. I expect these will hold up just as well. Comfortable out of the box, but recommend sizing up 1 2 size especially if you plan to wear thicker socks.
Kept my feet warm, comfy, and going while jumping out to see the sites and walking the many trails along the two week Blue Ridge Parkway vacation I recently took. Great shoe. Love Merrill.

I have broken both ankles and have been buying these hiking shoes for a very long time! They generally last about 4 years before I have to buy new ones. The inside of the shoe wears out before the outside. The tread looks like it's still brand new. I wear them every day! Totally suggest these to anyone who needs support and durability!! Definitely worth the price!!

Great shoes! Have owned Keens for a while and decided these were my next option. Great choice was made. They are supportive and comfortable after 2 to 3 days of breaking in. They do have a higher arch than I'm used to but it has reduced my back pain from my standing job. Kudos! Will be looking into this company more for what they have to offer.
Very well made shoes and they are waterproof. Very sturdy with good soles. I m very happy with them.

The tongue of the shoe is attached and had a wrinkle that was quite painful. I like the shoes otherwise so I just cut off the portion of the tongue that was causing the problem. Simple enough solution and the rest of the fabric for the tongue has remained intact even though I have put several hundred miles on them.
I bought these for work. I needed something that would hold up and keep my feet dry. They are perfect. Not to heavy and comfortable. I work in a garden center and I highly reccomend.

I like the interior padding of the tongue and around the back of the shoe. It feels comfy during hour long walks and helps to keep your foot dry if you are walking in wet weather. The sole of this particular Merrell shoe is rubber and the upper part suede for warmth and comfort.

I had gotten a pair of these from a shoe store many years ago and thought they were the most comfortable shoes I ve owned in a long time. Since I recently started hiking I thought I would get another pair. I have a pair of insoles which makes it even more comfortable. I ve been wearing them for hiking where I go between 5 to 7 miles and they ve held up really well.
Love these I have a wide foot and got the wide width andclove them ! Great support and fit great in there snow!!

design.strength_summary: 디자인에 대한 언급이 없어 긍정적인 요소를 찾을 수 없습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Product was exactly what I expected and fitted true to size. Once I broke them in the stiffness faded away.

product_name: Skechers Sport Women's D'Lites Slip-On Mule Sneaker

urgent_issues.summary: 사이즈가 맞지 않거나 너무 크고 넓어 불편함을 호소하는 리뷰가 많습니다. 이로 인해 고객들이 신발을 착용하는 데 어려움을 겪고 있습니다.

comfort.issue_summary: 구매자들은 착용감에 대한 불만이 많으며, 특히 발뒤꿈치 통증과 물집이 자주 발생하고 있습니다. 이로 인해 많은 고객들이 신발을 착용하는 데 어려움을 겪고 있습니다.
comfort.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 뛰어난 아치 지지력과 푹신한 밑창 덕분에 매우 편안하다고 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: These shoes look good but they are not comfortable. My heals hurt so bad after 2 hours of wear. Very disappointed as I am a life long Skechers fan.

Now w the weather warmer I am walking my dog daily. Halfway thru the walk my legs hurt in the shins so bad I am forced to cut my walk in half. I wish I had used them before their return date. Now I am stuck w shoes I won't wear.

I bought these on 10 05 22 and as of today 11 22 22 there is a hole worn into the sole of one of the shoes. I wear these almost daily for work in a medical office, so I'm on my feet 75 of my day. There has not been any option for support or option to talk to anyone about a replacement. Very disappointed.

I purchased the original pair of shoes on the far right at a local retailer. Size 6 1 2. Loved them. They became dirty so quickly I checked Amazon and purchased another pair same size. I receive them and after wearing them for several days found that I had a blister on the lower part of my heel almost a soul of my foot since there is no back. They had been worn for a while so I attempted a second purchase thru Amazon ordered size 7. They are also too small. Idk how diff sizes can be same

Do Not Waste Your Money! My heels are so sore I can hardly walk after wearing these sneakers! I even tried go up a size and they are still horrendous.....with and with out socks my feet slide out onto the heel of the sneaker and caused so much heel pain it's ridiculous!

At first, they seemed super comfortable. But the more I wore them, the worse they got. It s like wearing a slipper to go walking. I got terrible blisters on the balls of my feet because they won t stay on and my foot is constantly sliding a little bit out of them. There s no way to tighten the front part of the shoe so the more you wear them and the looser they get, your foot moved around more and more until they feel so uncomfortable and unstable. I would give them another try if they had laces so I could clinch them down but as is, they re terrible.

I love these shoes. They are most comfortable but, but.....I walk out of them and actually fell because of it. My foot slides out when touching the gas or brake pedals. My own fault, I didn't notice there was no back at all. So I would like suggestions on what I can do to add something to be able to wear these shoes. I bought two pairs, not knowing what I thought was black was blue on one but when I wished to exchange I was told to keep the blue ones so you can see this company is the best in Cutstomer Service. Now if someone can come up with a clue how to add something so my foot remains in shoe....I actually fell walking out of them when entering someone's house. Other than my mistake...these shoes are great but remember, they have NO back at all, more designed like slippers. Help please.....if seller is reading this, is it too late to return all three pairs to you for credit? I have three pairs of excellent, for others, shoes sitting unused in my closet. Or if you sell regular shoes with high back would you be willing to exchange the black and the white pairs? I will still return all three if you agree. I need new shoes desperately so please let me know if anything can be done. I understand if you cannot help me.

Feels great when you put it on but as a few hours go by, the center of the insole sole seems to just collapse and offer no support. I use them to slip on around the house for chores or to check the mail. I would NOT buy these.

these shoes are extremely wide! I've bought these in the past and never has any issues with the width. I'm thinking they have a stock of wide ones to get rid of so lucky me... I got a pair! I ordered in Aug 2022 and took them out of the box of late and found out now that I cannot return them due to the 30 day window of return. This is not right!

I always get the white slip on sketchers. I needed black ones for my work. Same style. These however, are not as comfortable and do not offer the same support as usual. Not sure why. I m disappointed. If they changed this styles comfort, I would have liked to know that before I bought. Next I will go back to white. If it fits the same, I will send them back and try a different brand.

I only wear Skechers due to problems with my feet so was super excited to see these new slide ons. They run HUGE and I mean HUGE I bought medium width . I tried adding a sock - nope - didn't help at all. I tried a pair of the same ones on in the store - same problem - so it's not a defect - it's just the way they make them. If you have very large feet not just wide - but on the "bulkier" side - these might work. Wanted to love them - but ended up disappointed.
I LOVE these shoes and I am on my second pair but I cannot get my last pair to stop squeaking. It's not a quiet squeaking but a very LOUD squeaking from both shoes. Please help

this is my third par of the same style and size shoe. this pair are just loose and the tounge seems longer cause it rubs my ankle. i love the way my others fit and wore dont know whats up with this pair. have not wore thm out yet just around the house, in case i want to send them back

Originally these shoes were such a nice surprise and so comfortable. In the short time I have owned them I noticed today that they are pulling apart at the toe! I don't live a rugged life by any means. I have only worn them around home or for a short run to town. I looked to see if there were any return options and apparently there aren't as I didn't see any. I guess I will be thinking twice. I have purchased two pair and alternate wearing them so this pair hasn't been worn a lot. Disappointed and had thought they would last longer.
The top of my sneaker at the toe has a hole. I m 67 I don t drag my feet. The shoes are less than 2 months old.

I need shoes with a good arch support. I have bought several pairs of shoes in the last six months hunting for some I could call comfortable and that I could wear longer than a few minutes. I have had to give some of them to my daughter because I could not wear them longer than ten minutes. Then I found these and they are just what I needed. I now have a pair for outside and a pair for inside. Very comfortable for me and my problem feet!
So nice for the price! Comfortable and I love that I can slip them on and off. I can't bend over or squat so these are perfect for me

These mule sneakers are very comfortable. I am on my feet all day and my feet don t hurt. I have a problem with tendon on back of my foot so I needed an open back shoe and this sneaker does the job. I would recommend.

Love these shoes and loved the price. Really comfortable. Cushiony sole, arch support and width is perfect. Slip on makes it very convenient. Only thing I don't like the way it looks so they are my house shoes.

Would prefer more arch support but padding makes them comfortable to wear. The right shoe's heel area keeps collapsing so I'm constantly having to readjust my foot so my heel doesn't go on top of it. It would help if the heel area was a little higher to prevent the heel from landing on top of it.

To start with, these shoes are amazing for plantar fasciitis. My last pair, the white ones, were great for inside and out. The heal wore down from wearing them inside on the wood floors so I bought the black and pink ones. They didn t stretch out after a week like all my other Skechers do and the top of the tongue kept digging in that I ended up with pain at the top of my foot where it curves. After a week, I gave up and returned them. I prefer the black shoes but will try the white again. Hopefully they didn t change how they make them.

I wear them almost every day, and when they wear out I buy another pair just like them. SO comfortable, with excellent arch support. I'm on my feet a good bit for work and these Skechers keep me mostly pain-free. I wish Skecher made insoles so all my shoes could be this comfy.

Was looking for a comfortable walking shoe. This one is perfect from day 1. The memory foam is wonderful to the feet. Was hesitant to buy a shoe that is slip on, but works great so far. I walk 3 dogs 3-4 times daily and another mile or so by myself.
I m a big fan of Sketchers and these did not disappoint! Very comfortable arch support. Highly recommended!
Arch and shock absorption after knee surgery. Great looking comfy and easy to put on and take off. Love them. I have 3 pair and recommended to 2 other people who bought them as well
These shoes are so comfortable! If you have an injury have difficulty bending ovef, these are for you. The sole grips well- no slipping! Look great with workout clothes. White- ever gets dirty.

I was looking for an athletic shoe with no back slip on for post- surgery use. I had achilles tendon repair surgery 4 months ago. I'm looking at one year recovery. The back of my foot and lower ankle is so tender that I can't get a regular shoe on my foot. This shoe is perfect. I like that they look like a regular athletic shoe. The foot bed has very good cushion and is so comfortable and feels great after working and walking all day at work. I'm seriously considering purchasing another pair.

My wife purchased these and she has told me at least 10 times already how awesome they are. She said they're like walking on pillows but still have great arch support and makes her legs, hips, knees and back all feel better. She's a nurse and plays close atte4ntion to comfort and support in all the right places. I suggested buying a 2nd pair to put away she likes them so much.

This shoe is a good fit, good length, heel fits into the the heel cup very well and does not hang over or sit on the rim. I purchased a size 9 in regular width. Good amount of cushiony memory foam Very light weight. It is not a tight snug fit but very comfortable and would still be okay if one chose to wear socks with it. Well made, great quality. Arch support is moderate, I would like to have had a bit more arch support and deeper heel cup. But overall it's a good shoe, I have the symptoms of plantar fasciitis, flat feet and ball off soreness when standing for long periods of time. This shoe helps with all of those issues, just could use a little bit more arch support.
Love the shoe. Very cute and fun to kick around in. However, I tried a mile walk and found them uncomfortable for that length of time. My advice, wear good hikers and wear these shoes for casual fun.

representative_reviews.text: these are not like any other skechers I have owned. They are not true to size, loose and uncomfortable
I usually wear a size 5 in the brand. Too big, not comfortable. My foot slipped around so not a good walking shoe.

I have owned a pair of these before that fit perfectly, light weight, slip-on's. I loved them. I had to return this pair. The left shoe fit my foot just fine, very comfortable, just what expected. The right shoe, however, was visibly cut low and short in the heel so I had to return them. Very disappointed.
Too wide and loose around top, so they slip off. Laces not adjustable. Was sent different style of shoe. Does not match photo in posting.

I only wear Skechers due to problems with my feet so was super excited to see these new slide ons. They run HUGE and I mean HUGE I bought medium width . I tried adding a sock - nope - didn't help at all. I tried a pair of the same ones on in the store - same problem - so it's not a defect - it's just the way they make them. If you have very large feet not just wide - but on the "bulkier" side - these might work. Wanted to love them - but ended up disappointed.

this is my third par of the same style and size shoe. this pair are just loose and the tounge seems longer cause it rubs my ankle. i love the way my others fit and wore dont know whats up with this pair. have not wore thm out yet just around the house, in case i want to send them back

Do Not Waste Your Money! My heels are so sore I can hardly walk after wearing these sneakers! I even tried go up a size and they are still horrendous.....with and with out socks my feet slide out onto the heel of the sneaker and caused so much heel pain it's ridiculous!

I am not sure why did happened but first couple of days I wore this shoe to work, they turned brown. I work indoors and couldn t figure out how this happened, so I decided to wash them, no luck. I am keeping the shoes because my old pair is really out of shape but will not buy again or recommend.

these shoes are extremely wide! I've bought these in the past and never has any issues with the width. I'm thinking they have a stock of wide ones to get rid of so lucky me... I got a pair! I ordered in Aug 2022 and took them out of the box of late and found out now that I cannot return them due to the 30 day window of return. This is not right!
These shoes look good but they are not comfortable. My heals hurt so bad after 2 hours of wear. Very disappointed as I am a life long Skechers fan.

I purchased the original pair of shoes on the far right at a local retailer. Size 6 1 2. Loved them. They became dirty so quickly I checked Amazon and purchased another pair same size. I receive them and after wearing them for several days found that I had a blister on the lower part of my heel almost a soul of my foot since there is no back. They had been worn for a while so I attempted a second purchase thru Amazon ordered size 7. They are also too small. Idk how diff sizes can be same
I had a pair of these I wore for 4 years. I bought this pair in august and they already have a huge hole in the side of the toe area

Been wear sketchers for many years. the size 9.5 I received was a wide despite being marked as medium. Went to a sketchers outlet store and purchased a 9.5 medium that fit as expected. If you don't have a wide foot don't purchase these as they will barely stay on your foot. Not cool shoemall, I'll be thinking twice before buying from shosmall again!
The sizing is way off. Too large. And this is a heavy shoe. Plus I couldn t find one like this on the Skechers website???

I love these shoes. They are most comfortable but, but.....I walk out of them and actually fell because of it. My foot slides out when touching the gas or brake pedals. My own fault, I didn't notice there was no back at all. So I would like suggestions on what I can do to add something to be able to wear these shoes. I bought two pairs, not knowing what I thought was black was blue on one but when I wished to exchange I was told to keep the blue ones so you can see this company is the best in Cutstomer Service. Now if someone can come up with a clue how to add something so my foot remains in shoe....I actually fell walking out of them when entering someone's house. Other than my mistake...these shoes are great but remember, they have NO back at all, more designed like slippers. Help please.....if seller is reading this, is it too late to return all three pairs to you for credit? I have three pairs of excellent, for others, shoes sitting unused in my closet. Or if you sell regular shoes with high back would you be willing to exchange the black and the white pairs? I will still return all three if you agree. I need new shoes desperately so please let me know if anything can be done. I understand if you cannot help me.

I love these Skecher's D'Lites! I have high arches, Morton's toe, Plantar Fasciatis and generally painful feet on balls of feet, arches and instep. These shoes are plenty wide enough in wide width and big enough in toe box. They do not rub or irritate my feet or toes. The memory foam insole is very comfortable. I can wear these most of the day and my feet are not hurting like with other sneakers. I saw many people say these ran big and wide, so I was a little unsure what size to order, but went ahead and ordered my usual size 11 and I ordered a wide. I find they fit very true to size unlike the Skechers relaxed fit knit GoWalks which slip up and down on my heel in an 11M, if I had ordered a size down, I think my heel would have hit the heel cup instead of resting inside it

this shoe is not a true fit. it's at least one full size to small!! they were a gift so by the time I received them I called to get an exchange but was informed that too much time had passed. I tried to explain I had been in the hospital for a period of time , but they didn't care. I am stuck with a pair of my favorite brand of shoe THAT I CAN'T WEAR!!

First I ordered Size 6 Wide, and it was too big, so returned and instead I ordered Size 5.5 medium width. It was nearly perfect. I felt my right foot was little tight but I think it will be better after a few weeks.

I have always loved sketchers been wearing them for years even before they became super popular. I wanted a sketcher that I could slip in and out of easily and wear for hours without any discomfort My criteria included wide width, A toebox that doesn t pinch, yet not bulky looking but would not fall off my feet with regular activity. This shoe fits the bill perfectly! It s true to size and I really love the little lip it has at the heel that holds you a nice and snug for a perfect fit I could not be happier!!!

I took photo of these size 37 regular with my usual size 7 sandals. They looked the same size. I m a size 38 in sneakers with quite wide feet. Originally I ordered a 37.5 wide one, however, they were way too big and wide and looked huge!! So I returned those and ordered a size 37 regular and it fits perfect!!
Following an accident and surgery on my ankle I needed a shoe I could slip on. These shoes fit perfectly and feel so good.

Fit perfect when they were new out of the box, but after just a few days they stretched out to be a bit loose. I've been wearing two pairs of socks to get that secure feeling they had when they were brand new. They are super comfortable. Not really for working out or running because they are slip ons and they come off easily, but they are great for around the house, getting the mail, running errands. I used a black permanent marker to cover the turquoise stripe on mine so they would match more clothing. I like them and plan on wearing them until they fall apart.
The shoes I ordered come in excellent condition. Fit as expected. Had a lil delay in shipping one place but came very close to time expected. Would highly recommend ordering from them!!

I usually take a 9W and had ordered that in this shoe but had to send it back bc it was too large. I really liked everything else about the shoe so I ordered the 9 regular and it fits very. comfortably. I am so happy that I made the change. Comfy slip on and very good looking.
Fits my flat arch hammertoe feet perfectly. Very comfortable with or without socks. D'lites are delightful!
The wide widths are very wide. Unless your foot is like Fred Flintstones foot I'd get the regular width.

I am glad I made this purchase. I was hesitant at first because I had an older pair that I loved and I was convinced that no shoe could take the place of my old faithfuls, but I was wrong. The width and support was just right. Sometimes when I first get home I find that I m still wearing them and believe me my shoes are usually the first thing I take off! Highly recommended.

I love these shoes! They re very comfortable and they are exactly what I was looking for. The size fits great. I have a high arch and these shoes are very comfortable with great arch support.

representative_reviews.text: Very disappointed. This is my second pair and althought they are very comfortable they ripped in the same spot again. Wrote to skechers and they refuse to send me a free shipping label to send them back. I am on a very limited budget and can not afford to pay the price of shipping but they didnt care. Went to the shoe maker and was told they couldnt be stitched they had to be patched. And wanted to charge me 15.00 dollars. Needless to say i am very disappointed and frustrated.
I hardly wear these. I am disabled and do not go very far. I don't understand how these could come apart like this. Very disappointed.

Now w the weather warmer I am walking my dog daily. Halfway thru the walk my legs hurt in the shins so bad I am forced to cut my walk in half. I wish I had used them before their return date. Now I am stuck w shoes I won't wear.

I would love to give these a better review as they are good shoes, But after 2 months they are falling apart. There is a whole in the bottom on the inside and one of the rubber pieces on the bottom is starting to come off. I dont do anything strenuous in these shoes I got to work and sit at a desk all day come home and take them off. I expect shoes to last longer if I pay 50 dollars for them.

Feels great when you put it on but as a few hours go by, the center of the insole sole seems to just collapse and offer no support. I use them to slip on around the house for chores or to check the mail. I would NOT buy these.

I bought these on 10 05 22 and as of today 11 22 22 there is a hole worn into the sole of one of the shoes. I wear these almost daily for work in a medical office, so I'm on my feet 75 of my day. There has not been any option for support or option to talk to anyone about a replacement. Very disappointed.

Originally these shoes were such a nice surprise and so comfortable. In the short time I have owned them I noticed today that they are pulling apart at the toe! I don't live a rugged life by any means. I have only worn them around home or for a short run to town. I looked to see if there were any return options and apparently there aren't as I didn't see any. I guess I will be thinking twice. I have purchased two pair and alternate wearing them so this pair hasn't been worn a lot. Disappointed and had thought they would last longer.

I have purchased these same shoes one pair oer year since 2011. Last time I wrote how a size 8.5 B fit snuggly when brand new BUT that as I wore them and the inner cushion compressed and they became too large. The more the insert compressed, the larger the shoes became This time I ordered a size 8 B. The insole is not as thick as last year.5 With this thinner insole sadly I see no difference in the fit from the 8.5. This 8 is too large. Thankfully, Amazon accepts returns. I have now reordered these identical shoes in a 7.5. I have worn these same d'lites for 10 years...the size just seems to get larger and larger. UPDATE The 7.5 arrived today, perfect fit! Downside, who knows what size I will need to purchase next year. If only the rest of my body wore a progressively smaller size each year, lol. The shoes are a FIVE STAR, the difficulties is obtaining a proper fit, 3 stars.

I've always bought the slip on sketches tennis shoes, and they lasted for years! Not these. I've had them for a few months, normal wear, and they have disintegrated! Toe areas completely ripped open on both shoes, around the seams. Complete junk material used. It's sad what has become of a once good product. Shame on Sketchers.

I am an elementary school resource teacher. I live in sneakers. I have worn a slightly different pair of Skechers every year. This year I decided to try a different color. The blue sneaks arrived and the fit was not quite as good from day one. They went into high rotation at the end of August with the beginning of the school year, but I have not worn them nearly as often as I did my white ones because the fit was not as good and they were just not comfortable. Not even 6 months into my school year and these are trashed. The insole is about 40 gone and I am walking on the sole and killing my feet. I would not recommend these if you need a sturdy pair that will last. My other Skechers have all lasted at least one school year and with much more use than these have seen.

Extremely disappointed. I have had these shoes for just over a month and the insides are already falling apart. I have not misused these shoes and have only worn them for normal daily activities. The shoes fit well and were comfortable however, the insides began deteriorating a few days ago. I have never gotten theses shoes wet, the outside of the shoe still looks new, and there is no reason the inside lining by the toes should be coming apart. Amazon will not replace or return them due to their 30 day policy. These are my first pair of Sketchers. I had always heard the company was highly recommended, but I have to question this based on my personal experience.
My wife bought two pairs of these. The first pair she walked about 50 feet and one of the eyelets fell out. For the brand name skechers the quality should be much better than that.
These shoes look good but they are not comfortable. My heals hurt so bad after 2 hours of wear. Very disappointed as I am a life long Skechers fan.

I bought the previous version of this shoe back in the 1990's I believe and found them too hot and heavy for everyday wear so they were just the shoes I slipped on when needing to go out in the yard to do something. That pair of shoes has traveled with me across several states until I found they worked out very well surprisingly in the desert winters. I wore that first pair out but have gotten my moneys worth when top part began separating from the sole and only balked a little at price of new pair. They are sturdy, good support on sand and rock, and easy to slip on and off as needed. If they last only half as long as last pair they are well worth the price. I like the fact they no longer have laces as the first pair did because they kept coming untied when they really were not necessary to begin with. I did also order a size larger than I normally wear as I also wore through the toe of last pair.

My favorite sketchers for the barn. I ve tried several of their similar shoes but this is the one with the strongest some, and the most sturdy material at the back of the foot. There s another one that looks similar, but it s really easy to bend down the piece at the heel. These wear really well and have good traction. They re also cut a little smaller than the other similar counterpart by Skechers. Good with no sock on.
These shoes keep their shape longer than other styles I've tried. I've been wearing them for ten years.
The shoes allows me to wear my custom orthotic that I need to wear forever since having foot surgeries. I love the thickness of the sole.

8 years ago, I broke my foot badly. Surgery and a titanium brace were necessary. If you have a brace like mine, you know about the screw that is raised above the bone and brace, on top of the outer, metatarsal bone. MOST SHOES, EVEN WIDE WIDTH, PRESS, PAINFULLY ON THAT SCREW! The D Lites, tie sneakers in wide width, also work! For slip-ons these shoes give me a pretty stable foot bed. Even many slides that don t press on that confounded screw are not stable enough to walk on. My feet tip sideways, and I risk more broken bones! These work so well that I bought a second pair. The white is easily soiled, of course. The dirty pair, I wear around the house and out to the mail box. It s so easy to slip them on and move around, feeling safe. For heavy house and yard work, I do wear tie sneakers, however.
This is my fourth pair, I hope they don t stop making this style. Comfortable, slip-on, super well-made.

This shoes is extremely comfortable. Although it is a mule my foot does not slide out of the shoe. The sole gives you outstanding cushioning when standing for long periods of time on a ceramic tiled floor. I wear it daily and have for over a year , but it looks like new.

I can t give a proper review for support bc these don t fit me right. I was so excited to finally get my slip-on sneakers I started wearing them right away! I realized they were to big wide but my hubby convinced me that with thick socks AND inserts they would be fine wrong! I will buy these again but in a size smaller not in wide, even though all my other sneakers are wide.

These looked good in the picture, and feel awesome on my feet! I have back problems and need something that really cushions my step, and these Skecher's do just that. Plus, that the way the 'slip-in' part is designed, it feels like lace ups, but without the hassle. The older I get, the farther way my feet are, what's up with that??? I have the blue ones, and they look great with my jeans.
The trim always wears out easily. Wish they could improve on it. I love the style though and the fit.

I have not been able to wear tennis shoes or similar shoes since I blew my knee. These are not only comfy they are a great support. Love these and can t wait to buy another pair in a different color so I can have some fun and walk again

Fit perfect when they were new out of the box, but after just a few days they stretched out to be a bit loose. I've been wearing two pairs of socks to get that secure feeling they had when they were brand new. They are super comfortable. Not really for working out or running because they are slip ons and they come off easily, but they are great for around the house, getting the mail, running errands. I used a black permanent marker to cover the turquoise stripe on mine so they would match more clothing. I like them and plan on wearing them until they fall apart.
I have been buying this shoe for 15 years. I have only needed 3 pairs. They are made well. Fit exactly as ordered.

I wanted this for work as a medical assistant, as I wore them they got harder and harder to keep on my feet as the inside was just too slippery with socks.... I may wear them in the summer if I m allowed to go without socks but the soles are a linen type material that lets your slide and that s not good when you need to hurry and end up walking out of your shoes and I love crocs so I usually love this kind of clog shoe but not these
I've purchased this shoe several times over the years I've never had to break them in they always fit perfectly.
