representative_reviews.text: The shoes are too tight on the top of my feet. The version of this shoe from two years ago fit me perfectly. These are uncomfortable size 13 . That being said if they did fit me well these shoes are so light and comfortable with excellent support.

These shoes were really comfortable and light. Could get a great run in on a treadmill, except i do more street and some occasional trail running. Biggest downside to these is the tread they are magnets for small rocks or pieces of sticks or acorn pieces or other pieces of debris. They get stuck in the little middle pieces of the hex shape but the worst is in between the actual hex cuts in the tread that basically act like little teeth vacuuming up dirt as your foot flexes and the treads opens up. The other thing is that I've only had these for about 3-4 months now and the tread is starting to wear down significantly, in some spots its worn through the white tread and showing black tread.
Always spring for the fly knits. On longer runs the toe box causes friction and blisters. The fly knits fits much better and last much longer. They re worth the money.
It fits to tight around the toes and the toung of the shoe is noticable youll feel it pressing against you very annoying

Part of the appeal of these is the light weight and flexibility. These shoes do both excellently. These pros lead to one con for me. Lacking any internal support over the top of the toe box, the fabric rubs across the top of your toes. This rubs on my toe nails and can cause pain during extended wear. With other shoes that have had this, I have solved it by going up a size or two. Possibly this would help me with these, but based on the construction, I doubt it. The other con is that the sole. The siping and Y shaped openings are an absolute magnet for pea sized gravel. Old worn down asphalt produces tons of this pea sized gravel. It is everywhere near where I live and work. Every day I wear these outside I pick 6 to 8 rocks out of the soles of each shoe. As such, I have stopped wearing them outside my house. For me, they might not have been the best shoe for the way I want to wear them, but they are a great show to use an all day slippers around the house.

As an athlete I ve worn many different types of shoes and different brands. This is the worst I ve ever owned. My heal is constantly coming out of this thing and it feels like there is little to no support. If you re wearing them around the house they re fine, but as soon as you do any physical activity you ll literally feel like your feet are coming out of the shoes and they often do when doing physical activity. They tried to be innovative with a flex back heal of the shoe and it just makes for instability and the shoe falls off really easily when you move quickly or make sudden movements. Would not recommend for any moderate physical activity. Go with a lace up shoe or ASICS in my opinion.
Sole of the shoes are already separating and I just bought them this past March. What a waste of money.

Love the feel and fit of this shoe BUT they make a terrible squeaky noise when I walk and it s just so bad that I can t wear them. I wore them once and won t wear them again and can t return now. Don t buy !

Beautiful pair of shoes that look at the shoe is gorgeous but the way you describe when I put them on is like Lego blocks very uncomfortable can only walk in short distance from them and I m in my early 40s. I was shocked at how uncomfortable they were, and I m in good health so that s all I have to say.

It was so tight that my wife had to help me put it on. The way the tongue is connected to the inner shoe makes it a problem to put on. The arch was so hard that after walking just ten minutes my feet hurt so bad it was unbearable. I had to take them off. Then and there I knew I had to return them for a refund. I would advise not to buy shoes on line. Only buy shoes you can try on before you purchase them. Disappointed!

Shoe is too tight in the toe area. It appears that they tapered the upper material at the toe where it tapers down to meet the sole. I'm not sure if all the shoes are this way or if I just got a defective pair. I am going to return and try a half size larger.

So sad. As you can see, the first thing I noticed from the shoes was the dirt on the bottom. The description says new but dirt on the bottom does not mean near. I wear a size 8 Nike and I have for years. This shoe was WAY too big. My feet were swimming in the shoe. I like the shoe itself so I am so sad these were not as described.

Two big issues here with these shoes. First, they get dirty VERY quickly. God knows what kind of material this is, but just normal INSIDE wearing walking gets these things filthy...it's like dirt and skin oil gravitates to these things. Second, and more annoying, is they are noisy when one walks on sidewalks concrete...specifically, they make a squishy spongy noise. People look at me when I walk in them because of this constant noise, and it is incredibly, incredibly annoying. I am tossing these in the garbage.

At first I thought this shoe was amazing, i used it for school, for running, for practice everything! But as I been using them for long runs and races they quickly started to show the downsides of the shoe. My balls of my feet started aching after every running and during every run. These shoes are not meant for racing or mileage like I would ve thought. These shoes are terrible for Cross Country and track so do not ever buy them if you re training for mileage.

First let me say that I love this style of sneaker. While I walk a lot and they do wear out quickly, they are very comfortable so I'm ok with that....mostly. It's a one start because the ad shows a black sneaker with white sole and white swoosh. I've ordered them a number of times from Amazon, did not think I had to go through each single picture in the ad.....but apparently I did. Sneakers arrived. Black sneaker with black sole and black swoosh. Nothing like the product picture on the ad....so disappointing. They will be going back.
First of all super light and comfortable. The feels when you walk made me second guess if i had my shoe on. Cushion is nice and soft. Great for running. A shoes.

Love the feel the weight and support for my high arch. Have had then a week and gone hiking in them once for about an hour. So far very happy with these even though I normally don t spend this much on tennis shoe.

As this is a product review and not a sellers review, I received the product pretty quickly considering the circumstances. As I take the shoes out of the box I couldn't help to notice the upper portion of the shoes felt like a neoprene type material instead of a fabric like material. As I slipped them on they felt like water shoes. With this being said, I did try them and went for a run. They are very comfortable, and your feet stay secure with minor slipping or movement within the shoe itself. Very shock absorbent and flexible when it needs to be. Overall, the running shoe does perform to standard. Great shoes but I do not see them lasting long in my environment and may have to switch to a more durable all around running shoe. I've been buying free run shoes for about 4-5 years now and they have always agreed with my style of running. This style of shoe however has changed that and may have to start seeking other alternatives.

Extremely comfortable Nike shoe that I literally do not like to take off, even when I am walking around the house. I am an active individual in my mid-twenties and this shoe is exactly what I was looking for. My only complaint would be that some of the fabric is frizzing a little bit around the edges but overall happy with the product.
This has to be the lightest shoe I ever had. Feels like you are wearing a second pair of socks. One thing is that they seem to run a half size small so go up if you order.
Comfortable! Easily the Best shoe I have ever owned. You won t regret buying this shoe. Anyone who gives it a negative review must have been paid.

These shoes are the COMFIEST sneakers I have ever owned. I m on my second pair. I am a nurse so am on my feet a lot, my boyfriend also is on his feet a lot. These are our favorite shoe. It feels like you re walking on a little foam cloud. 10 10, buy them.

I purchased these for my son, who for his job, is on his feet for hours on end. They offer great support and are stylish. This is the second pair he has had because he liked the first pair that much. They held up very well, but he wore them out. Highly recommend.

The Nike free run shoe is the most comfortable shoes I ve ever experienced. I can walk around all day in these shoes. I ve bought them for several years now and I have 5 pairs in different colors. It s my go to shoe for every day wear as well as any long walking I do in a city. These shoes aren t good for trail hiking and the grip is not conducive to that type of terrain. But if you are walking on paved roads or sidewalks, these are your shoes! They are also great for running.

Dang. I bought another 4 pairs of these. Comfort heaven straight out of the box. The only issue is that the shoe strings cannot stay tied for anything - even in double knots...it's very odd - and this is the case on all the pairs. Other than that, wow.

Frankly I loved everything about this shoe and it was exactly what I was looking for. My 2nd, fun job, at the golf course I m on my feet for 5-6 hours a day and this is a great and very light shoe that won t add to fatigue from extra weight. Feet still feel great after work and the traction is really good even on wet concrete.
Been wearing these the past 2 summers, really comfortable, but only on a sunny day cause they get dirty really easy. Really enjoyable to wear.
Fits great and lightweight but not good for running as the bottoms are cut for flex but stones get caught in them. Not as much support as I like in a running shoe but great to kick around in.
I like the comfort of wearing, def great work shoes clinic setting . Not nice enough looking to wear with regular clothes out and about.
This is my sons second pair of these shoes. Comfortable and easy to slide on and off with soft back.

size.issue_summary: 많은 구매자들이 사이즈가 너무 작거나 발에 맞지 않아 불편함을 호소하고 있습니다.
size.strength_summary: 구매자들은 사이즈가 정확하고 편안한 착용감을 제공한다고 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Good shoes that breath well but are way too tight for people with wide feet so they where a return for me
Although the size 10 size was appropriate lengthwise, the width of the shoe was too small caused pain after wearing it for a short while for my 16 yr old son.
Shoes fit small. Also sole pattern has tiny holes that keep getting small stones stuck in them. Would mot buy these again.

At first I thought this shoe was amazing, i used it for school, for running, for practice everything! But as I been using them for long runs and races they quickly started to show the downsides of the shoe. My balls of my feet started aching after every running and during every run. These shoes are not meant for racing or mileage like I would ve thought. These shoes are terrible for Cross Country and track so do not ever buy them if you re training for mileage.

Shoe is too tight in the toe area. It appears that they tapered the upper material at the toe where it tapers down to meet the sole. I'm not sure if all the shoes are this way or if I just got a defective pair. I am going to return and try a half size larger.

The shoes are too tight on the top of my feet. The version of this shoe from two years ago fit me perfectly. These are uncomfortable size 13 . That being said if they did fit me well these shoes are so light and comfortable with excellent support.
Always spring for the fly knits. On longer runs the toe box causes friction and blisters. The fly knits fits much better and last much longer. They re worth the money.

beware the soles of these shoes get pebbles, sticks, junk caught in the openings in the flex soles I mean a lot of debris gets trapped end up picking out debris after every run on the plus side the uppers are comfy, but the soles are poorly designed

I believe the shoes I ordered Run Free RN 2018 were 'knock-offs' from Amazon. They didn't come in a Nike box, they were sized wrong, they just felt wrong. They were made in Indonesia. I find it difficult to fathom that Nike would produce such a low quality shoe. It was compared to the original 2018 I still have. I sent them back to Amazon and buy a pair from the Nike Store!
I ordered the size I have worn for many years. However, the shoe was not long enough and the width was too narrow. I am returning them. I recommend trying them on in a Nike store.

Comfortable and nice fit, good arch, but we expect that from Nike. My beef is that this tread picks up and holds a small stones then when you walk into house those stones scratch flooring. They are designed to have the most annoying tread that is possible. These nikes are going into trash can. Bye

Love the feel and fit of this shoe BUT they make a terrible squeaky noise when I walk and it s just so bad that I can t wear them. I wore them once and won t wear them again and can t return now. Don t buy !

The shoe performs great when running, but the quality control is so bad. Loose threads and glue everywhere, I thought it was a fake at first, but then realized Nike has bad quality control. Running performance is great tho.

These shoes were really comfortable and light. Could get a great run in on a treadmill, except i do more street and some occasional trail running. Biggest downside to these is the tread they are magnets for small rocks or pieces of sticks or acorn pieces or other pieces of debris. They get stuck in the little middle pieces of the hex shape but the worst is in between the actual hex cuts in the tread that basically act like little teeth vacuuming up dirt as your foot flexes and the treads opens up. The other thing is that I've only had these for about 3-4 months now and the tread is starting to wear down significantly, in some spots its worn through the white tread and showing black tread.

I've been wearing Nike Free Rn 2017's daily since 2017 I have two pairs . While they are fully machine washable, understandably, they're worn and I wanted to replace them. The 2018's looked like a good bet. However the size is 1 2 size shorter. I know this for certain because I bought another pair 1 2 size larger and they're the correct length. However, the toe box seems a bit tighter than in the 2017 model. Could be that mine have loosened up over time, but I think it's more of a shoe construction issue. Finally, the sole looks far more vulnerable to punctures from sharp objects. Unlike the 2017, which has a solid sole with gridded slits, this one has many patterned thin areas in the sole that look particularly vulnerable to nails, glass shards, or in my case, bougainvillea clippings whose long thorns are frequently but harmlessly imbedded in my 2017's. WHY COULDN'T NIKE STICK WITH THE REAL WINNER THEY HAD IN THE 2017 MODEL. That was a shoe masterpiece! Alas, the engineering quality of every model in that line since 2017 have continued to deteriorate. C'mon Nike! You did better once. Do it again!
This has to be the lightest shoe I ever had. Feels like you are wearing a second pair of socks. One thing is that they seem to run a half size small so go up if you order.
This was a great purchase. They re very comfortable with a true fit. I will definitely keep purchasing these styles of sneakers, and I highly recommend this seller.

I have wide feet. Seriously, like hobbit feet. Normally have to look for a wide in trainers, especially in Nike and will sometimes have to get a longer shoe than I need for width. These are fantastic. They're lightweight, sturdy and very comfy. I prefer to be barefoot but if I have to wear shoes, these are my favorites.

As this is a product review and not a sellers review, I received the product pretty quickly considering the circumstances. As I take the shoes out of the box I couldn't help to notice the upper portion of the shoes felt like a neoprene type material instead of a fabric like material. As I slipped them on they felt like water shoes. With this being said, I did try them and went for a run. They are very comfortable, and your feet stay secure with minor slipping or movement within the shoe itself. Very shock absorbent and flexible when it needs to be. Overall, the running shoe does perform to standard. Great shoes but I do not see them lasting long in my environment and may have to switch to a more durable all around running shoe. I've been buying free run shoes for about 4-5 years now and they have always agreed with my style of running. This style of shoe however has changed that and may have to start seeking other alternatives.
I ordered a size 5 and received a size 11.5. I definitely can t wear them, but luckily my brother needed new shoes too. They re great shoes, but wish I would have received the right size for me!
Comfortable! Easily the Best shoe I have ever owned. You won t regret buying this shoe. Anyone who gives it a negative review must have been paid.
Fit is great as expected and true to size. Gifted to a avid runner for the holidays and they loved it.

Dang. I bought another 4 pairs of these. Comfort heaven straight out of the box. The only issue is that the shoe strings cannot stay tied for anything - even in double knots...it's very odd - and this is the case on all the pairs. Other than that, wow.

As my title says, I bought these same exact type of shoes 5 years ago and they finally started breaking down. They fit the exact same way as when I first got them and just as comfortable. The toe area is a little bit loose but that was true with the first pair as well. I have wide feet and these form perfectly to them without being tight. Its too bad Nike cant release a waterproof resistant version of these.
Fits great and lightweight but not good for running as the bottoms are cut for flex but stones get caught in them. Not as much support as I like in a running shoe but great to kick around in.
Perfect fit comfortable wear. Shoe laces were slightly short for my liking but that isn t a big deal

This is my second pair of the exact same shoe. I had been looking to re-buy these shoes for await. The shoes are unlike many others in fit, I was glad to see this listing again. Fit is very natural I would get one size larger than your normal size. I would also get good inserts for better standing and walking support and replace the original inserts.
I m not the most experience running shoe buyer but these shoes fit very snug and comfortable. They are really light and offer a nice bounce back whenever you step. Super easy to slip on and off.

Was worried to purchase because of past reviews! It came in good condition and very quick. I ve been looking to gift these shoes for some time- they are sold out in the size everywhere! Found them on amazon and I m glad I purchased them. Thank you.
I purchased these for myself, I just got a smaller size for female. Fit perfect and so comfortable. I stand on concrete floors 8 hours a day and these shoes make it easier.

I got the pair of shoes, one of the shoe has some dirt mark at the back, as if it was used. And finishing looked bit rough, like some threads lose at corner. Not sure if it is defective or used one.

As an athlete I ve worn many different types of shoes and different brands. This is the worst I ve ever owned. My heal is constantly coming out of this thing and it feels like there is little to no support. If you re wearing them around the house they re fine, but as soon as you do any physical activity you ll literally feel like your feet are coming out of the shoes and they often do when doing physical activity. They tried to be innovative with a flex back heal of the shoe and it just makes for instability and the shoe falls off really easily when you move quickly or make sudden movements. Would not recommend for any moderate physical activity. Go with a lace up shoe or ASICS in my opinion.
When I first got the shoes they worked awesome after wearing them a couple times both of them kill my feet after at least 5 minutes on the treadmill

Getting back into running and found these. Ordered a half size up on advice of reviews and it was still small, so I'm now in a full size up currently men's 12 . Wearing them around the house for a break-in week not going outside at all . So far they look feel great I got white, for anyone who cares . Feels like waking on a cloud. You should expect a slightly different experience with these - you don't just slip them on like standard sneakers because of the heel support design you'll have to pull them on like a pair of socks, and the tongue is fixed. I've seen reviews about the shoe falling apart, but I haven't worn them long enough to see. Can't wait to start running in them - will report back after I get some miles on them...REPORTING BACK!!!...Previous paragraph was posted Jul 2 It is now Aug 25 and I have logged around 50-60 running miles. The shoes are still very comfortable and holding up well - no signs of damage and no wear beyond what would normally be expected. One review complained of disintegrating outsoles after about the same mileage - perhaps they got a bad pair that escaped QC, I don't know, but this pair is still going strong see pic . I will say that the shoes easily pick up little bits of debris in the between the honeycomb pattern of the sole see pic . The bits can begin to separate the hex shapes if you don't take the time to pick it out. I would definitely recommend the shoes to anyone.
Had this show for over a year now and is still holding up with no rips or tears. Amazing quality and so comfy

I hope Nike never stops making these shoes. There are a couple of minor negatives. The soles are prone to pick up pebbles and the sole wears quickly. Even so, the 5-star rating is well deserved. The shoes are the barefoot feel type. I'm starting my third consecutive pair since 2013. As long as these shoes are available, I'll never wear anything else.
just got them so i can't say to much. i needed something very comfortable for pickle ball. i love the fit. i will keep you informed on durability.

I purchased these for my son, who for his job, is on his feet for hours on end. They offer great support and are stylish. This is the second pair he has had because he liked the first pair that much. They held up very well, but he wore them out. Highly recommend.
I like the comfort of the shoes so much that this is my second set. The heel of the sole compresses perfectly.

I bought my diesel mechanic boyfriend these to replace his old ones that we wore to work for years. They are amazing and although he gets diesel and oil on them everyday they still look clean as new! He had the exact same shoes when he was in high school which was about 5 years ago and continued to wear them until recently. Moral of the story these are AMAZING and last a long time!
Shoe is extra lite as if you are not wearing any shoes... Soles are not substantially thick, but will work for short distances. I am digging the Freedom.

Love the feel the weight and support for my high arch. Have had then a week and gone hiking in them once for about an hour. So far very happy with these even though I normally don t spend this much on tennis shoe.
Had a pair of Frees a few years back that lasted a long time and I liked a lot. I can tell these will last even longer and they are more comfortable than my previous pair. Great shoes for the money!
I ve been wearing these for a couple months now and I ve decided that they re the most comfortable shoes that I ve ever put on my feet.

I am not usually able to wear many Nike styles due to the more narrow width and smaller size overall. However, I tried these on at a store and later decided to purchase them. I have been wearing them every day and have run in them a couple of times. Really comfortable and seem as if they will hold up.well.

issue_keywords: arch support starts in the middle
comfort.issue_summary: 구매자들은 착용감과 관련하여 아치 지지대 위치, 발바닥의 뜨거운 점, 통증 및 마찰로 인한 불편함을 반복적으로 경험하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Sadly I have to return these. The arch support starts in the middle of my heel. After one hour in my house, my heels hurt and my toes fell asleep. They are an attractive shoe and my husband loves his but I will go to a store and try before I buy. I live in the boonies and it's a hassle to return them so if I have to go to town I may as well go to the mall.

I was looking for a new pair of hiking shoes for my backpacking trips since my columbia ones gave me many blisters and after reading some reviews on this one I thought I'd try them. I normally wear a 7.5 for running shoes and my columbia hiking shoes, and usually have room at the toe. However, when I tried these ones my toes were so crammed at the end that it was difficult to put the shoe on. I normally buy regular sized shoes for width since the toe box is perfect but these shoes are not the same.

I have so many Merrell shoes, sandals, boots.... I have the Merrell Moab hiking boots that I have worn out, I hate to throw them away when they wear out because I can use them for yard work or painting. But these, no matter how I try to wear them, I get hot spots on my foot pads and my toes hurt, inserts didn't help. I LOVE Merrell shoes, but these and another pair I purchased at the same time never have worked out for me, I tried doing yard work in them but they just hurt to much. This will be the same review on the other pair I purchased at the same time. Sad

I bought these for an upcoming trip to Great Smoky Mountain National Park. I made sure to wear them a couple of times before I went, and they were great on the basic dirt trails in the park by my house. However, they started to fail me in the smokies. I went on a trail with a lot of rocks, and while the traction was great, I had zero support. I felt every single rock. To make matters worse, I got a few blisters, which oddly enough were on the sides of my feet. I gave it a couple of days, using my old hiking shoes, and went back to these on our last day to give them one more shot, and they were still bad. Very, very disappointed.
They feel flimsy, no way they can be used as hikers. Also squeak and left front foot was getting painful rubbing sensation after a short walk around the house. Too narrow toe box. Will go back.

Suuuuper cute hiking shoes. I thought I would love them because I've had good luck with a pair or two of Merrell shoes in the past. Sadly something fit weird in this foot bed and I think would've hurt a lot in the course of a lot of walking or hiking. It felt like the arch support was hitting part of my heel. It started to hurt just standing around in my house to test them out.

These shoes are incredibly comfortable, BUT after I've worn them for a maximum of maybe 20 days over the course of 2 months, THEY SQUEAK! It is driving me insane! I can walk on my toes, no squeak, but the heel where most of the cush is is very noisy. Aside from the squeak, it appears that the glue or whatever binds the sole to the sides of the shoe is already starting to wear in some places mostly the fabric areas, not the reinforced spots . Overall, I typically love Merrell and their quality, which is why I bought these since my last Merrells lasted years before this type of wear, but I think I will stick to their low profile styles from now on because the added support and cushion lead to noisy, obnoxious, squeaking! Totally bummed

Everyone was raving about this brand, second time I ve tried them and my feet kill. The shoes never seem to break in and get comfortable. I m on my feet way more than most people everyday and I just ended up in pain for a few weeks trying to wear these. I threw them out. Ended up with much cheaper basic sketchers and those broke in with in a few days. It s a bummer to pay a lot for something and they just don t work, I wanted long lasting quality and all I got was very painful swollen sore feet for a few weeks.
I wore these shoes to work 3 times before they started to peel away from the sole. So disappointed. Very comfortable but not made well at all.

I've had several pairs of Merrell's before. Hence I purchased these. I've been hiking in these for about 2 weeks now. Approximately 4 miles 3-4 times a week. They are already starting to breakdown on the outside where the toe bends. These shoes are very comfortable and I have only gotten one tiny blister on my heel. However, I purchased these for a trip to Peru this summer and now may have to purchase a different brand due that I'm worried they will continue to break down quickly.

I received these on March 26 . I have done mostly street walking in them since I received them. I wear an 8 or 81 2. I got these in a 81 2. As you can see the dark blue part of the shoes is coming off. That s because it s more like a sticker then rubber. I m very disappointed. It s only been two weeks and this part of the shoe is rubbing off. It leads me to believe that perhaps these are not the really thing. Had this not happened I would have given it 5 stars.i wonder if they are really waterproof. Buyer beware.

I like this shoe but the heel is not snug enough. This results in heel slippage. I have tried many trail sneakers and always end up back with ASICS. They seem to be the only walking lite to moderate trail shoes that fit my heels!

Come on, Merrell. You can do better than this. This Merrell is very stiff -- maybe it would feel a little more comfortable after wearing a few times but out of the box, they feel and look like junk. Gluing on all the details instead of being stitched makes it look like a shoe that you would buy in the clearance rack at a discount store. The insole feels like a cheap piece of cardboard. You will definitely need to replace the insole to start with. Just do yourself a favor, find a better hiking shoe. Merrell has always been my go-to brand. Not anymore.

The shoes are very comfortable. I bought these to wear in China knowing I would be doing a lot of walking and climbing Great Wall, rice patties, etc . I love my Merrell Sandals they are amazing. A warning for those that plan to use these for walking, VERY SLIPPERY! No grip at all!! We walked on uneven steps, slate steps very very slippery! I slipped and fell several times. Twisted my ankle so beware. Do not buy these for hiking or walking very dangerous.
Owned last year s model and ordered these in the same size. Cramped up my toes being too narrow and short. Returned them after they made my feet and back sore. Disappointed.

ASIN B01HFTBXGS Merrell Women's Siren Edge Hiking Boot, Faience, 8.5 M US So I was a little concerned about buying these shoes because of some of the negative reviews. I'd been shopping for a pair of hiking or approach shoes for several months. I really wanted a lightweight shoe that I could use for trail running in a pinch. When I found these shoes, they had all of the featured I was looking for and I didn't have any excuse to not try them since, with Prime, there were free returns. I've had them for a few days and wore them walking around town for a full day. They are very comfortable and fit as expected. The toe box it roomy compared to my running shoes and they seem VERY WELL MADE despite what others have said. The arch support is really good and they have nice thick tread. I can't really think of anything that I don't like about these shoes. See all the pics to see quality.
It seems very comfortable! But I will try on my hiking trails to see if it's still the same after several hours.

Wore right out of the box on a trip to Yosemite. Did moderate hiking and quite a bit of walking and biking. Comfortable, light. The arch support is a little off for my foot a little far back but it never bothered me. After some walking hiking I noticed my big toes were hitting the front of the shoe a bit, but I never had pain or discomfort. My feet did not hurt at all after wearing these, which rarely happens. Usually I have some bone joint pain, but not with these. I ordered my usual size. Recommended!
Could use a little more cushion inside the shoe, but this is my second pair and I will keep buying them. Excellent traction!

I am not a hiker but look for quality shoes as a nurse on my feet for 12 plus hours a day. I wore these shoes out of the box for 2 shifts in a row and have no complaints. They are not a cushiony shoe, which I prefer because the cushiony shoes hurt my knees, so if you re looking for a soft feel this is not the shoe for you. I ve worn Shox for the last 15 yrs to work and am used to a stiff heel non cushiony foot bed and these were a somewhat comparable feel. Can t Find Shox anymore . The ball of the foot could use a little more padding for my liking but I was used it the feel by day 2. The tow box is very roomy. I normally wear a 6.5 and bought a 7 based on reviews but feel that a 6.5 would have fit me just fine. I m really liking these and will purchase again. Not dissapointed!

Comfortable support, good tread. This style is no longer produced, so I was happy to find these available. Love my current pair, still looking and feeling good after 2 years use! Pair just purchased will be my backup.
I'm a nurse that works 12 hour shifts. These shoes make me feel like I'm walking on air. Great arch support also. I bought a second pair in a different color.
I love these shoes. Super comfortable and I am really happy with the color. I can be on my feet in these all day. Great arch support. And they are waterproof

Love these shoes ,,, I'm 58 my feet, hips, back ,, was killing me I have RA , and 2 weeks ago I had shots in my SI joint... took a chance with this style shoes because of the number of 5 star review...WENT to eBay and bought more Merrell shoes ! PS I have wide feet and swelling edema , 1 2 up did the job with room for socks.... no one has paid me or given me a discount... Ty Tammy
Super comfy right out of the box! Received the day before we left on a week long hiking trip and ended up wearing them everyday of the trip with no problems! Good traction and great fit!
These are very comfortable to hike in, however, they don t keep my feet completely dry in wet grass. I would still buy again.

First time ever wearing these, I hiked 7 miles of uphill rocky terrain and my feet didn't hurt once. Even my knees which usually start aching by mile 4 didn't hurt at all during or after my hike. And the cushion for shock absortion in the heel was amazing! These live up to their name and I'm glad I bought a pair just for hiking.

We just went hiking and I got to fully test these. They fit great! Moderate arch support, not much padding under the foot though. I'll be getting an insole for next time. It has great grip!! We went down somw hills with clay mud and my shoes gripped GREAT while my husband's slipped. laces stayed tied perfectly. They never came undone. my feet stayed dry even walking through puddles and wet grass. I would definitely recommend these shoes. Very happy with my purchase.
The shoe is comfortable, great treads and wore them working out although will be using them for hiking.

I walk two miles or so every day with my German Shepherds. I was going through walking shoes fast. I tried the memory cushion type and other well known brands but had huge foot issues. These Merrell provide a ton of support and they hold up to lots of walking. I have three pairs and switch them around to give each a chance to air out. Highly recommend these if you need more support in a walking shoe.

size.issue_summary: 사이즈 관련 불만이 반복적으로 나타나며, 많은 구매자들이 신발이 작거나 좁아 불편함을 겪고 있습니다.
size.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 사이즈가 정확하고 발에 잘 맞는다고 반복적으로 언급했습니다. 특히 발폭이 넓거나 좁은 경우에도 적절한 핏을 제공하여 편안함을 느낄 수 있었습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Ran large and the fit was off. The width felt narrow but the shoe length was long. The cushioning felt uneven and stiff. Not sure if this would have improved after breaking them in but returned them.
Great shoe! Runs small in size. I chose to order a size 8 but could ve used an 8 1 2-9. Wanted to exchange for an 8 1 2 but not available.

Too narrow small. Do not buy if you are even a little wider than normal. Recommend sizing up 1 2 size even if foot is normal width. Otherwise good quality construction as I expect from Merrells. Will be returning.

Shoes run small. Not sure why Merrill has problems with sizing. I ve returned as many shoes as I ve kept in last 2-3 yrs due to sizing. Returned for credit. Will replace with the MOAB Vent, true to size.

These shoes have fantastic soles, and for that reason I almost kept them - I can see how nice they would be on a slipper surface, but the toe box was so narrow I couldn't wear them. I guess either get a wide width, or possibly size up. Such a bummer, because it's a beautiful shoe that I had hoped could also double as a trail runner.
Owned last year s model and ordered these in the same size. Cramped up my toes being too narrow and short. Returned them after they made my feet and back sore. Disappointed.

The fit of the shoe was true to size and it looks good. But this shoe HURT my feet. Less than an hour into a hike and I was very aware of the shoe and slipping on surfaces that my running shoe had no traction problems with. I m baffled that this costs so much and is supposedly from a very reputable brand??? Big nope for me, sent back and looking at local stores.
Wanted to love these! I have other Merrell shoes I love. For these, the fit is very tight and they sound crinkly like they have cellophane inside. I'll have to look for a different option.

Ordered a half size larger than my usual, but was still too small. Felt short, but also was very tight across my forefoot. I love my old Merrill s. Really wish they made a wide version of their vegan trail shoes.

Sadly I have to return these. The arch support starts in the middle of my heel. After one hour in my house, my heels hurt and my toes fell asleep. They are an attractive shoe and my husband loves his but I will go to a store and try before I buy. I live in the boonies and it's a hassle to return them so if I have to go to town I may as well go to the mall.
I read previous reviews they said true to size but I normally fit 7.5-8 and these shoes size 8 were definitely more like a 7.5. My toes hit the end and was definitely a more narrow fit.

I have read several excellent reviews of this shoe, and when they arrived too small, I tried some on at a sporting goods store to see if the next size up would work before returning exchanging. Next 1 2 size up was very comfortable, and I can see why it's a top seller, but I also tried on Oboz and loved them, so that is that!
Like the style Size too small. I exchanged 1 2 size larger, it was still too tight. I end up returned both.

Fit as expected. However, the color in the picture I ordered is a nice golden brown color, but what I received was a really ugly gray color. Not even silver, more like dish water gray. Also, the tread has zero grip whatsoever so they are very slippery in the rain or on a smooth surface. I would've given one star except they fit comfortably and did not need breaking in.

My mom has the exact same sized designed shoe bought from a local store but that exact same shoe ordered for my sister from Amazon somehow ended up too tight on the toe. Same 6.5, same design, same person . I guess it has factory inconsistencies. Same serial numbers

ASIN B01HFTBXGS Merrell Women's Siren Edge Hiking Boot, Faience, 8.5 M US So I was a little concerned about buying these shoes because of some of the negative reviews. I'd been shopping for a pair of hiking or approach shoes for several months. I really wanted a lightweight shoe that I could use for trail running in a pinch. When I found these shoes, they had all of the featured I was looking for and I didn't have any excuse to not try them since, with Prime, there were free returns. I've had them for a few days and wore them walking around town for a full day. They are very comfortable and fit as expected. The toe box it roomy compared to my running shoes and they seem VERY WELL MADE despite what others have said. The arch support is really good and they have nice thick tread. I can't really think of anything that I don't like about these shoes. See all the pics to see quality.
I took a half size larger in this than usual, to be sure my toes had enough room, and it was perfect.

I have a narrow foot and since I wear size 11, finding the perfect fit is a challenge. These shoes were a perfect fit. However, if you have a wide foot these will not fit you. They were comfortable right out of the box and required no break in. Days after they arrived I left for a trip to England that entailed a lot of walking - these were absolutely perfect. Love them!

Bought these to replace my old Merrells that were similar to these. I need room in the toe box for toe issues and these have that room. Comfortable but sturdy and a much better price here on Amazon than the price I paid in a sporting goods store for the last model just like these.

Love these shoes ,,, I'm 58 my feet, hips, back ,, was killing me I have RA , and 2 weeks ago I had shots in my SI joint... took a chance with this style shoes because of the number of 5 star review...WENT to eBay and bought more Merrell shoes ! PS I have wide feet and swelling edema , 1 2 up did the job with room for socks.... no one has paid me or given me a discount... Ty Tammy

I love this shoe! I bought it half a size bigger and it fits just right because I have wide feet. The only thing I don't like is the shape on the front of the shoe. It's kind of straight, I wish it was a little more pointy
These shoes are very comfortable, right out of the box!! I ordered my regular size and they fit perfectly. Side bonus They make my size 10 feet look less huge LOL

I was nervous that the toe box would be too tight on my 5th toe .... but suprisingly it is perfect I can wiggle my toes and when walking no pinching! I usually go fir a widd shoe because I hate when I cant move my toes! I also wear the Merrell Moab which i comparable in fit. This shoe has a lower heel than the Moab, more of a sneaker fit. Slimmer looks not as chunky as the Moab. Good grip for walking not for hikes.

I just bought these and they look great on! They are light weight, have great tread, perfect insoles and fit well around the ankle, heel and arch. Unfortunately the toe box is small. The top of my toes hit the top and just hit the end of the shoe. I would suggest ordering these a 1 2 size up. I am an eleven in every shoe but needed an 11 1 2 in this shoe. Other than the sizing it is a GREAT shoe.

I love these shoes! I have a narrow heel and have a difficult time finding athletic shoes that do not slide up and down on my heel, but these shoes fit perfectly. They are lightweight and comfortable. I couldn't be happier with this purchase.
Good walking shoes, comfortable and good-looking. The toe box is a bit small, had to pressure-enlarge it for maximum comfort.
great support, sturdy sole heel construction. able to remove ibsole and use my custom RESA insole, at my regular size.
Had to return because they were too small. I love Merrill shoes But these were possibly sized incorrectly.

The shoe fits true to size, it is lightweight, well made, has protection over the toe area and laces stay in place. The tread is rugged. Time will tell as far as the holding up, but I truly like them and could wear them all day the first day... I hike in the woods.

In order to get these to fit me, I walked around for a couple hours in them with socks on in the house. After two hours my feet went numb so I took them off. Two days later I put them on with no socks and wore them 8 hours. They're now somewhat broken in, so I'm going to keep them, they just rub a little on my left heel now. They should be broken in the rest of the way soon .. I'm hoping.

durability.issue_summary: 구매자들은 내구성 문제로 인해 신발이 쉽게 벗겨지거나 찢어지는 경우가 많다고 불만을 토로하고 있습니다.
durability.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 내구성이 뛰어나고, 지지력이 좋으며, 견고한 구조로 오래 사용할 수 있다고 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Come on, Merrell. You can do better than this. This Merrell is very stiff -- maybe it would feel a little more comfortable after wearing a few times but out of the box, they feel and look like junk. Gluing on all the details instead of being stitched makes it look like a shoe that you would buy in the clearance rack at a discount store. The insole feels like a cheap piece of cardboard. You will definitely need to replace the insole to start with. Just do yourself a favor, find a better hiking shoe. Merrell has always been my go-to brand. Not anymore.
Like the style Size too small. I exchanged 1 2 size larger, it was still too tight. I end up returned both.

These are not the same Merrill Siren Edge that I've ordered and have loved through the years. I have 3 other pairs that are wonderful these are stiff and just feel cheaply inferior. I've worn them thinking I need to just break them in. They don't break in..At all. !! Wish I could just send back but I can not do that having tried wearing them so many times. These Merrills will be going to Charity. Hope some one can be happy with these stiff cheap shoes. Won't be. buying Merrills again.
These look very durable although I didn t feel they supported my feet enough. They also were quite bulky so I returned them.

I received these on March 26 . I have done mostly street walking in them since I received them. I wear an 8 or 81 2. I got these in a 81 2. As you can see the dark blue part of the shoes is coming off. That s because it s more like a sticker then rubber. I m very disappointed. It s only been two weeks and this part of the shoe is rubbing off. It leads me to believe that perhaps these are not the really thing. Had this not happened I would have given it 5 stars.i wonder if they are really waterproof. Buyer beware.

I have so many Merrell shoes, sandals, boots.... I have the Merrell Moab hiking boots that I have worn out, I hate to throw them away when they wear out because I can use them for yard work or painting. But these, no matter how I try to wear them, I get hot spots on my foot pads and my toes hurt, inserts didn't help. I LOVE Merrell shoes, but these and another pair I purchased at the same time never have worked out for me, I tried doing yard work in them but they just hurt to much. This will be the same review on the other pair I purchased at the same time. Sad
I wore these exactly one time, on a hike in Colorado. There s a hole ripped in the side. I will be returning.

Cheaply made. Mostly vinal material with a very small amount of mesh. This makes for a hot environment. The soles say Vibram but they are not good quality. Perhaps Vibram makes different grades. They run small the toe box is not roomy as you'd expect from a hiking shoe. Laces are really cheap come undone easily. I own three different Merrill shoes that I live are all perfect fits comfortable. However the Merrill Siren Edge is by far the worst shoe that Merrill offers. Is Merrill just another company going downhill by cheapening the brand? Save your money . i dont recommend.

I bought theses for a 2nd time because the first pair were so comfortable. I have had these now for several months , right away they squeaked. I called Merrell and they said put a dryer sheet in the shoe and and that would stop the squeaking. The squeaking stopped but I should not have to do this if it is a known issue. As time goes on they seem to be more uncomfortable. Needless to say I have been very disappointed with these and will be looking for another brand.

I bought these for an upcoming trip to Great Smoky Mountain National Park. I made sure to wear them a couple of times before I went, and they were great on the basic dirt trails in the park by my house. However, they started to fail me in the smokies. I went on a trail with a lot of rocks, and while the traction was great, I had zero support. I felt every single rock. To make matters worse, I got a few blisters, which oddly enough were on the sides of my feet. I gave it a couple of days, using my old hiking shoes, and went back to these on our last day to give them one more shot, and they were still bad. Very, very disappointed.
I wore these shoes to work 3 times before they started to peel away from the sole. So disappointed. Very comfortable but not made well at all.

Everyone was raving about this brand, second time I ve tried them and my feet kill. The shoes never seem to break in and get comfortable. I m on my feet way more than most people everyday and I just ended up in pain for a few weeks trying to wear these. I threw them out. Ended up with much cheaper basic sketchers and those broke in with in a few days. It s a bummer to pay a lot for something and they just don t work, I wanted long lasting quality and all I got was very painful swollen sore feet for a few weeks.

I've had several pairs of Merrell's before. Hence I purchased these. I've been hiking in these for about 2 weeks now. Approximately 4 miles 3-4 times a week. They are already starting to breakdown on the outside where the toe bends. These shoes are very comfortable and I have only gotten one tiny blister on my heel. However, I purchased these for a trip to Peru this summer and now may have to purchase a different brand due that I'm worried they will continue to break down quickly.

CUTE style, happy to walk the dog in them in the rain. Definitely water proof. However, I wore them in Alaska for a whole day around town in the rain and my whole body died that evening and the next day. From my neck to my feet there was pain. The soles of these shoes are hard as bricks and I don't know if this is something that will break in. I don't know if I will be able to wear them enough o break them in bc the memory is still too painful. Maybe some insoles will do the trick.

So I bought these shoes needing shoes with good support that were waterproof. While they fit well, they got soaked through instantly from walking in wet grass. So I wasted 50 on shoes I can t use. Incredibly pissed and will make sure not to buy this brand again. Honestly, I may try and get a refund.
Fantastic quality, great support for high arches and the grip soles are the best of any of my other hiking shoes boots.

I didn t even need to break them in! The first time I wore them was to go hiking! Really comfortable and they stick to dry surfaces. I was running and jumping down rocks in Arizona no problem! Wet surfaces however are very slick!
This shoe has minimal break in time, just days and provides comfort, stability and support. I would like abut more cushion in the ball of my foot but overall am very satisfied with my purchase
Really comfy w good support given it s basically a sneaker. Seems well made. Stitching is intact. Great colors.
I went to my previous orders and ordered my second pair of these. I m so glad they were still available. I am a server, and the shoes serve me well! They hold up well also.
The support is great, construction sturdy, looks great, grip is excellent but the insole is harder than what I would like...guess I will just look for cushier socks.............

Love these shoes ,,, I'm 58 my feet, hips, back ,, was killing me I have RA , and 2 weeks ago I had shots in my SI joint... took a chance with this style shoes because of the number of 5 star review...WENT to eBay and bought more Merrell shoes ! PS I have wide feet and swelling edema , 1 2 up did the job with room for socks.... no one has paid me or given me a discount... Ty Tammy

The shoes were very cute and held up for a while. My daughter is outside everyday climbing on rocks. The sole held up well but the rest of the shoe was not durable enough. If you are a casual hiker..Once a week or less..these may last. If you are looking for a durable trail shoe. ..not so much.

I purchase the Merrell Siren Edge to wear on a 9-day trip to Scotland. I had previously bought a non-waterproof pair of Keens and was all set to wear them. However, the Merrells fit like a dream right out of the box and had a much nicer profile than the Keens. They were roomy in the toe box without looking so clunky and the sole was actually more cushioned than the Keens. They were also very lightweight. Sometimes shoes run short, but this sizing was spot on - a true 11M. My foot isn't particularly wide and they fit well with moderately thick socks. This is an ideal shoe for walking on a variety of paved paths and trails compacted dirt small rocks . For significant mileage off trails, I would probably want a more stable hiking boot.

I have spent a ton of money on shoes in the past with Sketchers, Ascics, New Balance and Clark's. I found these shoes give me the best support and value for the money. I actually bought two pair, one for everyday and the other for work. Love them.

When I saw that Merrill had discontinued my favorite shoes, I checked out the replacement but the toe box was goofy for me. I went online and bought several pairs in different colors. I am probably set for life. These shoes are not leather, but a tight mesh. They are very comfortable and I have an orthotic that I can easily fit in them.

I really enjoyed these shoes. They fit great, felt comfortable for all kinds of activities, and they provided a great pop of color. Unfortunately, I have had the shoes for 9 months, and they have started to deteriorate. They have gotten a few tiny holes in the insole. But the biggest problem is that the detailing has started to peel off, because it is glued on. Now the shoes looks like trash.
So sturdy! Keeps feet where they are suppose to be!! Love but they were a little small for my foot so I am giving them to my daughter! I know she will love them too!
Right out of the box, without even breaking in, probably the most comfortable hiking shoe I've ever purchased.

Love these shoes boots! I got them them the day before heading to Utah, so no breakin period. They were great, very comfortable, good traction on scrambling up rocks, lightweight. I wore these all day every day and they still look good. They won t get stored with my hiking stuff, I anticipate using them throughout fall and winter.

design.issue_summary: 구매자들은 사진과 다른 색상으로 인해 실망하고 있으며, 디자인에 대한 불만이 반복적으로 나타나고 있습니다.

Not even silver, more like dish water gray. Also, the tread has zero grip whatsoever so they are very slippery in the rain or on a smooth surface. I would've given one star except they fit comfortably and did not need breaking in.

issue_keywords: blisters on the ball of my foot
comfort.issue_summary: 많은 구매자들이 착용감 문제를 겪고 있으며, 특히 발의 통증과 불편함이 반복적으로 나타나고 있습니다.
comfort.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 착용감이 뛰어나고 발을 잘 지지해준다고 반복적으로 언급했습니다. 특히 장시간 착용 시 편안함을 제공하여 만족감을 높였습니다.

representative_reviews.text: The memory foam felt great the first wear or two but the first real walk of more than 1 2 mi in them and my feet were sliding and rotating around. I had blisters on the ball of my foot and anytime the ground wasn t perfectly level, my foot would turn inside my shoe. They re probably good shoes for light work or standing on hard floors but I couldn t even wear them to walk my dog without me feet sliding around and feeling unstable. I have wide feet and like a roomy toe box, these were too wide and allowed too much motion to feel safe.

First off, to me these are true to size. I am normally a 7 in Nike running shoes, but after reading other comments, I ordered these in a 7.5. The 7.5's were way too long, and just loose overall. Ordered the 7's and they fit perfectly. I do kickboxing once a week, and three times week I do full body HIIT style weightlifting workouts main lift, followed by supersets . I wanted shoes that could do both as changing shoes halfway through my workout was getting annoying. These definitely get the job done. They are shock absorbing enough for the HIIT workouts, but the sole is stiff and firm enough for squats and deadlifts. I prefer squatting in these to my converse! However, two things made me take off the stars. First, the toe-box is very narrow. My toes can't spread at all, and I don't feel very stable when doing kickboxing or other cardio moves that require jumping because of it. Second, they are HOT. They do not breathe AT ALL. Halfway through my workout I want to rip them off of my feet. To me, this is a total deal-breaker unfortunately, so I will not be keeping them.
I had to return these shoes. They fit very tight around your feet. I couldn t walk after wearing these!

Bought these after seeing them score well for cross training. But what a MISTAKE!!!! The heel is WAY too high and stiff, will cause blisters if you are doing any sort of lateral movement. I wore them for about 20 minutes of an indoor class, took them off as soon as I started feeling the INJURY shins, arches, and blisters and went to start return process. Following the directions on Amazon, I contacted Puma BIG MISTAKE!!! . After sending them pictures of my red ankles and describing the pain these shoes caused after only 20 minutes AND going through multiple channels in their customer service process, PUMA's CUSTOMER SERVICE a joke of a name said that there was no fault in the shoe and DENIED my return since I wore them for 20 minutes which I could have lied about since there was NO wear and tear to the shoes . They said there was no design flaw in the shoe and I was SOL my words in this case . I will NEVER buy from Puma again!! Save yourself the horrible process, keep scrolling and buy another pair of shoes. Side note Thank you AMAZON customer service!! They know how to treat their customers and how to KEEP their customers and will be processing my refund. Puma could learn something from Amazon!!

I work in retail so I m on my feet 8hrs a day, this shoe is the worse thing ever..an hour into my shift and my feet are literally throbbing, there s no arch support, the material isn t flexible at all, it s too narrow I feel like my toes will fall off..I bought these In June and didn t get to wear them till November so the return window closed on me so I can t get my back Do yourself a favor n save your toes from the pain, these shoes are definitely not worth it

Within a month of wearing them this happen to the toe area. The tongue on the shoe never stays in place. Not as happy with them as I thought I would be. I have glued them2 times now. Don't waste your money

I am still wearing these for my fitness classes since I can't return them and in hopes that they will soften up and be less stiff. I have the following issues with them - Imitation leather material is hard and hasn't broken in to conform to my foot there is no give like with a fabric shoe. Also does not offer ventilation resulting in hot feet. - Outsole is hard and does not offer much cushion insole has some memory foam but it is a thin layer. I may try insoles to improve the cushioning. - They feel clunky and thick it seems like my toes feet can't get a good read on the floor when doing, say, a STEP program.
I really wanted to like these because they are nice looking shoes, but they hurt my feet and cut into my ankle bone so I had to return them.

I attend a daily cross training class at my local gym and had read great reviews about this shoe. It appeared to be well made and I was excited to feel the foam cushion in the bottom. This shoe has a wide and stable base for cross training, however it is very flat with absolutely no support. My feet hurt after wearing them inside my house for a few hours. If you suffer any foot pain such as plantar fasciitis I do not recommend this shoe.

These claim that they have a soft insole but it feels like you're standing on concrete when you have the shoes on.Toe area is extremely narrow and there is no arch support.I would not recommend these shoes.

Idk if it s a design flaw .... or memory foam issue, faux leather maybe? I m truly a size 8 1 2 with a narrow foot, this shoe dug into my little toe. The right side more noticeable... I read reviews about ordering a 1 2 size up but most complaints were that it ran narrow. So they re going back. It s a cute design and I m hoping better luck with a 9. Unfortunately unavailable from this same seller as they offered quick delivery at a better price.
Didnt even have for 2 months and the heal blew out of it. And all I wear is pumas so not sure if it was just this type of shoe or what

I m so disappointed I wore these shoes a handful of times . At first I figured they need to be broken in ... but that s not the case . There is a plastic piece on the back of my right food that digs into my heel .. only on the right shoe so I m guessing it s not suppose to be there . Have to buy new shoes now and my feet are killing me the toe is very narrow also

I am a nurse and wanted something that was not mesh. I tried this on in a store before making my purchase on amazon. Gave these shoes several days to break in and they just simply hurt my feet I couldn t wait to get home to take these off.
Ndrmally this product is great but as my foot changes thru the years t his shoe is no longer for me.
Bought this shoe with the hope of getting comfort since I have flat feet. However I will have to purchase an arch support with the hope of being able to walk long distances with this shoe

Extremely comfortable, best fit and highest quality material. Support my feet during exercise at every movement especially when planking, walking, jumping rope and bike riding. And they look good. I will buy again! And I recommend

I have had MANY different athletic shoes but I always had cramping in my feet and toes. Then a trainer at my gym mentioned that it looked as if I had over pronation in my feet. He suggested looking into seeing a podiatrist and possibly getting orthotics for my shoes. In the meantime, I went on the Internet and researched the best shoes for overpronation and theses Pumas were in the top 10. I chose these because the price was right and they looked cute. I normally I wear a nine so that s what I ordered but they are about a half a size larger than what I would like but since I ve been wearing them I have not had the cramping in my feet that usually occurs during all exercises so hopefully this continues.

I wore these for the first time to Caprock Canyon State Park. We walked everywhere. They did rub the back of my right foot for a bit, but it didn't blister or anything. They were fine after a few hours. I did hear mine making some noise like a spring bouncing as I walked, but there is an arch support spot on the bottom so I think that is the reason. I really liked these. I didn't think I would when I tried these on, but wearing them made the difference. I'm a plus size person and these were very comfortable and support hiking the trails and climbing the ridges. The colors are a plus too very attention grabbing.

I am a healthcare worker and purchased these for work-8h days on your feet at the hospital requires comfortable shoes that are also easy to wipe clean, and so far these are doing great! I have had these now about 2 weeks and I am very happy with them, especially the foam insole-it's so soft like walking on pillows. It hasn't sunken for me as of yet. The arch support is OK but not the main supportive factor-I have low arches and don't have arch pain to begin with, but I still find these shoes supportive. However, if you have arch issues, I would find a shoe with better medial support and arch support.

Not the most comfortable shoe, I have another pair of pumas and the arch support was so much better than these. I ordered because they said they re cross training shoes which I needed for the type of workouts I m doing, but I probably wouldn t buy these again due to comfort.
I walk or run long distances and these have really helped with comfort for those long hard workouts!

I absolutely love this shoe. It fits just right. I feel great support even with my prolapsed arches. Comfortable wearing all day and doing a lot of walking. The color is more of a charcoal gray. I absolutely love them! I wear a size 8 and ordered a size 8 and it fits perfectly! I will probably order another pair in another color! Great price!
They are so comfortable feet don't hurt after a 8-9hrs shifts on cement floors I would recommend that them to anyone

For ladies doing light exercises like me, this is comfortable, supportive and feels light on the feet. Its stylish as well that you can wear it when beading to the city etc. It can withstand rain and all the other elements you will encounter on you jogs etc. Helps to elevate back pains when exercising as well.
I like the comfort and light weight. I work 10 hours a day 5 days a week. These shoes are amazing. They are better then my slip proof shoes .
Love it. My last sport shoe lasted 7 years and was looking for something stylish which will provide me arch support. The soft foam is amazing. True to size and for many complements.

I'll start with the obvious, it's a Puma and it's a gorgeous shoe aesthetically. I bought a 6 1 2 and it fits like one. Hugs my foot, not tight even though with putting on a bit of weight my 6 1 2 may be a little thicker than usual. I find the shoe a bit stiff for a cross-trainer hence the 4 stars. It's supposed to have a cushion gel insole but I can barely feel that. I have only walked with it through 2 airports, no exercise yet so this review might change with more usage. I have a very high-instep and deep arches, breaking shoes in is a challenge for me and I suffer a bit. I did have a little bit of arch soreness after wearing this for 8 hours but not as much as I expected considering the stiffness of the shoe's soles. When I start using in on an elliptical machine, I'll know how comfortable it really is. I can already tell that they are not bad for walking, did I mention I expected more gel in the insole?

A great product for someone with feet like mine. Narrow and severely arched. Feet caused me a lot of pain standing at work on concrete floors all day until I got these shoes. They treat my feet great at the gym too.

representative_reviews.text: When I first got these, I was in love. I love the idea of Rothy's but can't afford them. These shoes are Skechers' answer to Rothy's so I took the plunge. These fit true to size and don't rub. I didn't get a single raw spot or blister. Narrow feet might drown, though, so keep that in mind. These took a couple of weeks to get stinky and I threw them into the wash with great results. They came out looking like new. Fast forward to the second wash the insole fell to pieces and one of the shoes now has pilled fabric. They're still wearable, but even with intact insoles you could feel every bit of the ground under your feet. Now that the insole is chewed up, it's very uncomfortable to walk on anything other than flat ground. I'll continue to wear these, but I won't be replacing them. If anything, they've convinced me to save money for Rothy's. Away least those you can buy new insoles for when needed. I'm glad I bought these Skechers, but I honestly don't know if I'd recommend them.

These shoes are not uncomfortable but when you walk the toe area turns in. They make your feet look very strange. I have only worn these shoes in the house to try them out. Every time I think I'll wear them, I put the back in the box because they are so strange. I would return them, but I have passed the window of time.
These are meant for very narrow feet. The wide width was still very narrow. The insoles are not very cushy either.

I ordered this shoe after hearing rave reviews saying it is one of the best commuting shoes out there after the Rothy's and a third of the price . Starting a job with a long commute involving buses, subway and a whole lot of walking I thought this shoe would do the trick. Unfortunately the shoe runs very small. I ordered a 1 2 size larger, with the idea that pointed toe shoes tend to run a bit smaller, nut I don't think ordering a a size and half larger really would have made a difference. There's also a piece of plastic in the back that was rubbing uncomfortable the few minutes I tried it in my home I can only imagine the pain during a commute 9. If your looking for a Rothy substitute, try something else or just invest in the real deal.
I bought both size 8 and 8 1 2. Neither fit well. Toe box too tight, support was lacking and too large in the heel

Cute, and fit comfortably at first. But within a block the right one rubbed on my heel so bad, causing such an ultimate blister that I had to fold down the heel and walk on top of it, just keeping my toes covered.

The memory foam insole is so comfy! I put these on as soon as they arrived. They felt like DearFoam slippers after wearing my Rothy s all day! The toe isn t as pointy and the the vamp isn t cut as low as the Rothy s. For further comparison, I did not need to take a half size larger in these shoes as with the Rothy s - and both brands are machine washable. I have always machine washed all my fabric shoes gentle hand wash cycle, mesh bag, air dry, no heat sneakers, espadrilles, other Skechers slip-ons - you name it.
Very comfortable and doesn t require breaking in or cause any pain. Doesn t have too much arch support though.
Love these shoes. Super comfortable for all day wear. Like all flats not the most supportive but comfortable breathable.

I bought these because I just wanted a nice and simple but cute and comfortable pair of shoes for work. These shoes are all of the above! I ve been wearing them almost every day for about 2 months. They don t have arch support but they re comfortable to walk around in and they re very stretchy. They do become too stretched out after wearing them for a while, but I threw them in the washer dryer last week and they came out good as new!
Cute and comfy as long as I'm not wearing them for lots of walking. Not much arch support and I had to put a bandaid on my left heel to prevent a blister.
I have foot issues and this shoe fits comfortably. I love that you don't need to wear socks with it either! The cushion helps for great support

I didn t want to spend the money to purchase Rothy s, so when I found these, I was super excited. These fit great and pretty comfortable. However, by the end of the workday, my feet would hurt, so I recommend inserting some arch support if that is a concern for you.
Great for! The upper is so comfortable and flexible. The memory foam makes it easy for walking too. Would definitely buy again.

These shoes are just what I was looking for. Comfortable, a little bit dressy, reasonably priced. If you re looking for super arch support these aren t for you. Would I wear them to be on my feet all day at work? No. Still, they are more comfortable than most dressy flats.
Loveeee this shoe! In the Medical field so on my feet all day. Very comfortable shoe can be worn all day. I love that it s also made for wider feet like mine. Must have!
SO COMFORTABLE! Slip on easily and stay on your heels. My feet don't sweat in these and memory foam makes them comfortable for all-day use.

Could not be more pleased with these shoes! I bought them for a 14-day trip to 6 states in US with lots of walking. Weather was cool, with some rain but no snow. They are extremely comfortable, look great, and I am a happy buyer.
This is my favorite flat ever. I have looked for a comfortable flat for work have finally found one that doesn t hurt my feet toes. They also cover that annoying toe cleavage!

I usually find Sketchers 6.5 to be a touch too small and 7 to be too large. I needed a 7.5 in this one. It is very comfortable in the right size, except the heel rubs a little. I added a heel protector and now it's perfect! Not a ton of arch support, but as expected.
I bought these shoes for work and they are so comfortable! My feet were in pain at the end of the day before these shoes and now they feel great at the end of the day!

Ran small,I bought a black pair at Kohl s that were perfect fit so I bought the exact same size in the blue from Amazon.

Shoe is beautiful but I am returning them. The toe box is narrow and tight. Size is correct in length.
I bought both size 8 and 8 1 2. Neither fit well. Toe box too tight, support was lacking and too large in the heel

I am a true 9.5 - 10 size shoe, mostly size 10 though. I ordered a size 10 in this shoe and it wasn't even close to fitting. Had to return.

I literally never post reviews. I actually think this is my very first one and I am an avid review reader and Prime user, but alas I felt compelled to share the truth about these shoes. I was hopeful that they would be a less expensive alternative to my Rothy's as other reviews suggested, but I was disappointed and as a result returned them. They checked all the boxes for comfort, style and I believe they could be washed even though other reviews said they are not washable, but they slipped off my heel when I walked. They were my correct size in the toes and the width, but too big baggy in the heel so I had to return them. Glad they worked for others. I am still on the hunt for a comparable alternative to my Rothy's in red though.

I am a bit disappointed in these shoes. I have several pairs of Skechers that I wear all the time with and without socks. These shoes are so tight I will not be able to wear socks with them, even though they stretch. The problem is they are so narrow. I'm glad I can get away with a narrower than medium shoe.

Love these flats! True size, width is normal and they re a stylish yet comfortable pointed toe shoe. Definitely recommend!

Im gonna be honest with you I love these shoes BUT, the toe box is wayyy to small...I ordered a size up and probably should've ordered 2 sizes up. Other then not having room for my toes the shoes are extremely comfortable and cute!

I work in a corporate setting and a lot of days don't feel like wearing heels. These are just the ticket. So, yea, I own a pair of sketchers 2 pairs soon, mon dieu . There's no logo though. Just basic comfy flats with a moderate amount of scalloping for that classy vibe. To me, they sort of remind me of those Herve Leger bandaid dresses, but for your feet, nice stretch. Love em. Price point is right.
The material is stretchier than expected I thought the heel would rub all day but it didn't. However, if you have wide feet I wouldn't recommend going with your size as these were very snug.
Great fit. Specially when you have wide feet. Only thing i wish was that the sole was a little thicker as it looks on the photo.
I have foot issues and this shoe fits comfortably. I love that you don't need to wear socks with it either! The cushion helps for great support
I thought these size 10W fit my 10W foot perfectly. These shoes are comfortable and cute. I may buy a second pair.

I almost always fit into a size 7 shoe and that's what I ordered here but it was a bit tight in the toes and a few toes felt like they were slipping off of the sole. I'd like to try a 7 wide or 7.5 to see if they are better cause these shoes are really comfy everywhere else. Lots of stretch but they still stay on my feet with no slipping.
Nice shoes just about half size to big but I put a sole in it so it works. Takes a long time to get here but they are nice and soft.
I have a bunion on my right foot, and have a very hard time finding shoes that fit, and are comfortable. I love these!
Cute comfortable shoe for professional work attire Haven't had them long enough to see how they will wear

This shoe was surprisingly very comfortable and a great fit. The material is soft and stretchy and form fitting on the foot. The toe box is comfortable and covers the toes and bunion comfortably. They look stylish and are also comfy to walk in. I loved the fit and feel so much that I already bought another pair in a neutral color. It s a great flat to pair up or down with any outfit.
The back of the right shoe rubbed a place on my heel. It's not too tight. It just doesn't lay flat and the seam rubs.
Adorable shoes! Just what I wanted! The toe was perfect, but the heel was too loose! My heel slipped out with each step! If your heels are bigger than mine, you might live these!

Had these for a month and they are a hot mess ready for the trash. These just don t hold up to daily wear. The material is elastic so the shoes are turning brown red as the strands break. Not the usual quality from this brand.

Changing my review! After wearing shoe one month they are falling apart! How! ???? I'm so upset! I have wide feet and they fit perfectly. I work on and off my feet and at the end of the busiest days my feet are not hurting. The shoe has stretch and washes well in the washing machine.
Arrived in a timely fashion, but product was USED. Moderate wear, gum on the soles...very disappointed and upset. I didn t pay 50 for my wife to get shoes she wanted for them to be well-worn

Well it has just kept getting worse I can probably wear the shoes a couple of more times before I toss them. Will not be buying again. I do love the style and the fit.

I really wanted to love these shoes. Summer is coming and I need comfortable shoes that won't overheat my feet. These seemed perfect until I walked 5 blocks to the train and discovered they cut through my feet. I'm very disappointed.

I didn't start wearing these shoes until early May, and I only walk a short distance in them, from my car to my office. The soles are already peeling and worn as if I walked miles on concrete city blocks. The window for returns is closed because they were purchased in March, otherwise they would be sent back. Total waste of money. So aggreand upset!

Also I would have liked to have this in size 11.5 so it wouldn't look so sock-like or water shoes-like on my feet.

First of all my product was supposed to be delivered Sunday I had ordered it specifically for an event on Monday. One day after I ordered the delivery date was changed from Sunday to Monday -- too late for when I wanted it. Secondly, I ordered a size 8.
