Just opened these new shoes. They are obvious returns. Soles are dirty and toes are slightly scuffed. Not original packaging. Cute shoes and comfortable fit. Just not happy they sent me used shoes when I paid for new.

I have super high arches and bunions - comfort and flexible shoes are important. I couldn't pull the trigger on Rothy's due to price - but was looking for that type of shoe. Found these at DSW, fell in love and then found them cheaper on Amazon. They are comfortable, flexible mesh-like material. Sturdy and thick - I actually wore no shoe socks with them with no visibility. Highly recommend.

These are really cute and I've had good look with Skechers sneakers so thought I would try them. I like the fabric and scalloped detail and that they are navy blue but there's not much support and they probably won't last long for me because I'm rough on shoes. They are slightly wider and bigger than the usual 8 I wear. I will wear them until they fall apart though.
Cute comfortable shoe for professional work attire Haven't had them long enough to see how they will wear
These are super comfortable! I love them. No breaking-in process required for me. The material is breathable and soft. I have very sensitive feet and these have been great!
I have purchased several for work as I had foot surgery and can't wear heels. Easy to dress up or down. I do wish they had a better support and more durable sole. They wear out quickly.

One smidge from perfect. The insole is thin but comfortable, the stretchy sides are amazing. The knit pattern gives them visual interest, the scalloped edge elevates them from boring cheap flats. The toe box is a little tight, but they are still pointed shoes. The inside back of the shoes has this firm ribbon that helps hold shape on the back of the shoe and looks like it covers a seam - this rubs uncomfortably and scratches at the back of my heel. These shoes would be wear-and-go if not for that blister-maker. A bandaid fixes it but isn't sustainable or pretty, so I will have to glue a piece of fabric over that strip. I'd rather wear them straight out of the box. With the bandaids on they are comfortable to wear all day.

LONG-LASTING. Bought these over a year ago, and they are still in excellent condition, despite reasonably frequent, heavy wear. COMFORTABLE. These are form fitting, like a stretchy bodycon dress. Makes for a very comfy yet supportive shoe that requires zero break in time. They feature a memory foam insole that is quite durable. Still feels cushy after all this time. Good for wide-ish feet too I have a wide foot knuckle area that gets painfully squeezed by some standard width shoes. BREATHABLE. Stretchy material also keeps your feet from getting sweaty. I've walked 10-15k steps outside in humid Midwest summer heat in these, and they don't get icky. Learned today from other reviews that they are apparently washable? I've never felt the need to wash mine. That memory foam insole somehow doesn't get gross either it's cushy yet doesn't seem to absorb sweat. NOT UNATTRACTIVE. Honestly, they're not THE prettiest flats I own - those are some pointy suede Frye flats. However, I wear these way more often, because they are comfy, breathable, and still reasonably cute. They are not at all awkward or unfashionable, just not particularly exciting. I would be stoked if they came in more colors.
I just got these shoes and I really like them! They are super comfy. I am glad I read the reviews first and went up a half size bigger. Definitely size up!

For a shoe that s not a sneaker and can easily be worn as a casual dress shoe, you can t beat these. It has a non-skid sole and the material of the upper has a slight elasticity. I am very pleased with them.

I needed a new pair of flats for work, but I couldn t convince myself to shell out 150 for Rothy s. These shoes were mentioned as a decent dupe, so I decided to give them a shot. So glad I did!! They re comfortable to wear all day long and look just right. The scalloping is cute, too.

I couldn't believe it when I tried on this shoe with clean knee high hose and I actually said to my husband, "I can't believe it, I can actually wear these shoes and they don't hurt my feet. Wos. I like them." SO COMFORTABLE

Purchased 3 different colors and would have purchased more in a different color, but unfortunately not available!
So comfortable!! They are cute with jeans but also can be worn with a skirt or leggings. I have now purchased 2 pairs of these- Grey Black.
Cute and stylish. But definitely runs small. I went up a half size and it s still about a half size too small.
These are the holy grail! Flats that are comfy right out of the box, and stylish. They go with everything. I have them in several colors. They wash up nice as well.

I bought these Skechers Cleo in black because I bought them in navy blue from TJ Maxx and they were extremely comfortable. I had been wearing very flat, no support, ballet flats and those would make my sciatica flare up horribly. After wearing these for about a week, I realized my sciatic nerve wasn t hurting hardly at all! So they re a win for me!

The heel area of the left flat seemed a bit compressed during shipping, so perhaps my issue will improve with time. I'll update this review after wearing them for a few days weeks. On the Sketchers website one of their CS reps mentioned this make model could be machine washed on the delicate cycle similar to Rothy's , so I'm looking forward to testing this feature.
These are perfect for when you want to be a little dressy or feminine, but still want comfort. I'm so happy to have found them. Thank you Sketchers!
I have these shoes in several different colors they are perfect for everyday office wear. Feels like wearing bedroom shoes but they look great with slacks .

This was for my wife - these are her comments Wow, this doesn t even feel as though I have shoes on! They fit everywhere. They are so light weight, too. I need more in other colors! I think that qualifies as being exactly what she wanted.

I bought this pair to replace a pair my cat threw up in. These are my favorite shoes. I have them in all colors. Super comfortable. Can dress them up or down. Sleek enough to wear with dresses, comfy flats that go with jeans too.
Skechers make some comfortable shoes. Glad to see the comfort also in flat casual shoes. would love to buy in another color.

As a commuter and avid walker in San Francisco, Ive been looking for stylist yet comfortable flats. Who knew Sketchers makes them! I got them half the price of pay for my other shoes. Only downside the shoes are not eco friendly.
Very comfortable, no break in needed. I bought black and natural and they were both great. Highly recommend.
These are like wearing slippers. They can be casual or dressy. Love them, I have two pairs in navy and black. Love them.

I can tell these shoes are fine for some but I had a couple of issues 1. my toes already hit the edge of the shoe when I tried them on 2. when doing some cross-training plyometrics the top of the shoe rubbed against my toes giving me a blister 3. when walking in them the heels rubbed slightly 4. at a certain point during the walk my arches started to hurt - but then subsided. I bought these shoes for myself because I have low arches and get plantar's fascitis from it. Maybe because I have multiple foot issues the specificity of these just didn't work for me.

It has no padding is VERY uncomfortable. I wore them for about 3 hours couldn t take it anymore! I have flat feet even with my orthotics usually comfortable insoles, my feet were still sore the next day! Returned them!
Support felt great but these shoes run small in width. Seems narrow and Even the wide felt like a normal witdth and pinched my pinky toe. Sending back.
Not good for my feet , which are wide in box but narrow in heel, not good for my developing bunions What happened to good old Assics Gel 1120??

While this has been one of my favorite looking running shoes, I have to report after a couple of hundred miles that it is not the shoe for those who need both stability and cushioning. After running 7 milers in the shoes a number of times I found that the ball of my foot was in pain after every long run. This condition has never happened to me before with ASICs so it is definitely this particular shoe model as I have run in their shoes for years. Even when, as usual, I replaced the insole with an orthotic - the condition did not reverse. I ended up having to switch shoes far sooner than I normally would. Be careful if you need cushioning as there is virtually none in the shoe.
The soles are different from GT-2000 7 model, the current model gives nothing but the pain my feet now. Have to return.

representative_reviews.text: Very poor padding on the slide straps--both cut my feet after wearing them only a couple of times. Wish I could return them now--the design is terrible.
It's nothing the manufacturer did, but the top velcro attachment rubs on the top of my foot and gave me a blister. Don't like them at all.
Got contact dermatitis on both feet from wearing these without socks. My Dermatologist stated it was a reaction caused by something used in the manufacturing process.

This sandal is about one inch taller in the heel than the toe. This causes the wearer to be unbalanced and pushed forward. This feeling is so strange that it changes the wearer's gait. If Adidas fixes this issue, the sandal would move from one star to five stars. However, this issue is significant and is a tripping hazard. I was also concerned about long-term impacts for the change in gait. It was so unnatural that it took several minutes after removing the sandal to get back to "regular" walking.

I had worn adjustable open toed slide sandals from Adidas before with some success, but I have a sore heel and I wanted something with even more cushiony support. The shoes have that. Five stars for that. They have more cushiony soft support In the heel which is what I wanted. But this caused the heel to be raised up so they felt like I was kind of walking on high heels. Also found the inside soul of the shoe to be kind of slippery. The combination of the two caused me to feel not very secure walking around in them and one time I rushed for the phone and my heel slid off the sandal and I basically strained my injury prone knee. It's been probably at least a few weeks and my knee still has not healed. I would recommend The shoe for 20 something-year-olds that can take some punishment and not for 50 -year-olds that may have a sore knee.
Too small hurt my feet. I'm disabled and need a comfortable sandal. These run tight and only had a chance to use them today. July 14. Seems the return window is closed

I really wanted to like these. After wearing them for a few days straight on vacation, the strap had cut so deep into my feet that they became unwearable. I will try to wrap something around the sharp edge or attempt to make socks with sandals fashionable.

I bought these shoes for my husband because of all the great reviews it had saying they were really comfortable. He says they are hard with very little cushion and they rub the top of his feet. I am disappointed in this purchase!

Bought these and have only worn them a handful of times. I ve tried adjusting the straps in many positions but no matter what, upon walking, my feet always shift photos and the straps dig into the top of my feet causing blisters. I would really appreciate a refund!

Because of the poor design, my husband s feet kept sliding off-center so it was difficult for him to walk.
very comfortable sandals to wear. Except one week into it, the left one around the heel location started making small popping sound every step I took during walking Not too happy about that.
No matter if I tighten or loosen the material is the most uncomfortable I have ever felt and it s the lining where my thumb is hurts so bad walking. Very poorly designed do not recommend.

The hump was still there but not as bad. After wearing them for a few days, the hump became more noticeable. I wish I could return them but I have already worn them outside. If you purchase them I suggest you wear them inside for a couple of days before finalizing the transaction.

Alphabounce? How about Alpha-sprain my ankle! Just wear them and you ll see what I mean. Very unstable. Feet roll off to the sides. I ve tripped so many times. I ve owned lots of slides. These are a no go for me. They are now my dogs chew toys.
Very comfortable with much support. Great for someone with no arch support or flat feet. This is my second pair.

The sandals have a simple black-on-black design that doesn't scream a brand at you. But best of they feel great. Very good support and good grip beneath your feet so you don't feel like you're sliding around inside the sandal. The soles have good gripping tread even on wet surfaces. The strap is wide, comfortable, and the edges do not dig into your feet. All in all, really good buy.

About two tears ago I got suddenly stricken with a bad case of plantar fasciitis and had to find an alternative to my beloved Adidas Adilette sandals. I ve tried four different style of sandals and these are by far the best at relieving my issues. As soon as I put these on it was instant relief. There is a ton of cushion in these, but also some firm support and stability in the areas I need. I tried the cloudfoam Adidas, and while they have a ton of cushion, I did not feel much support on the bottom. These Alphabounces have the perfect blend of cushion and support.

Simply the most comfortable slide I have ever tried. I ve owned Under Armour memory foam slides, Jordan hydro retro slides and many more. These are the most comfortable slides. The cushion material takes pressure off my feet and knees. They are great for walking around in, and I bought an extra pair just for walking around the house. They are not intended for shower use, the product tag explicitly states it. Great quality, comfortable, and stylish. I m 10.5 and bought an 11. They fit ok, but a little long so I bought a 10 the second time around, and they are a perfect fit. Get them while you can.
I found the slippers is very comfortable. I don't have any foot pains when I use it to walk compared to others I used.

I have plantar fasciitis and a high arch. I was first skeptical about this sandal but I'm glad I purchased them. Wore them on vacation for 2 weeks and had zero foot pain! It's like a firm cushion in every step. Just what I needed!

I wish there were more color ways but the Alpha Bounce is the best adjustable slide on the market for athletes or those over 200 lbs. The foam is firm but the grooves and overall foot pattern make this the most durable and comfortable slide on the market for those with neutral feet who don't need arch support and I have tried many brands from other Adidas slides, Nike, Puma, Ofos, and Hoka. This allows me to have one pair of sandals at half the cost of other brands with better recovery no more foot or knee pain! and all day comfort. This is my 4th pair and they last significantly longer then any other sandals out there for those in warm climates who wear sandals all day.

I REALLY loved these slides! But....ill start with i wore the original Adidas slides with the nubs for the last ten years, had many pairs of them, however as my 49 yo feet became callus from the nubs in the summer months to the point i could not wear them anymore. So i researched comfortable slides and i ordered these baby's. When i tried them on and walked around my house i thought they were the most comfortable things on earth for real!! Loved them. So i wore them just around the house for the first few days and i called them my Cadillacs lol sooo comfortable! Then i wore them out and walked around all day in them and all was well till about hour 10 i started to feel stinging and pinching on both th tops of my feet, and found that the top strap was digging into my feet i guess from wearing them all day. I was devistated i really liked them but cant wear them any more, top straps cut into your feet, despite the heavenly base, fml..

These are perfect, they are soft and the cushion do not get that nasty sweaty foot smell. I bought 2 pairs of these and wear them daily. They are perfect for someone who would like a nice pair of comfy sandals to wear around the house, or out in public.

Bought these for my husband who has plantar fasciitis and sciatica pain that sits in his lower back. With these challenges finding the right shoe is hard. The moment he slid his feet in, it was comfort at first feel. He loves them and couldn't be happier with them. He said it's like walking on clouds but with support. He also likes being able to adjust them to the thickness of feet many slides now days don't have this option.

Purchased these for my partner, he loves them. They offer arch support as well as comfort. These are thick soled so you never feel anything you are stepping on rocks ect. I wear a 10.5 or 11 in virtually every shoe type. Went with a 10 here because all the reviews said they run pretty true to size.... Boy were they wrong! Putting these size 10 sandals next to my 10.5 Nike sneakers show that these sandals are well over an inch, closer to 2 inches longer than the larger sized shoes. Regardless of the tightness of the strap, there is 1.5 inches of extra space behind each foot. I would have just exchanged them for a smaller size, but honestly, size wasn't the only issue. However they've designed these, human feet are not meant to stay straight in them. I find myself constantly readjusting to keep them from curving from left to right on my feet as I walk. I also assumed that the massive thickness of these meant there was plenty of padding.... wrong. They are literally just an inch thick with no different material or padding. They look aesthetically pleasing, so I guess that's something. I immediately went and bought the Under Armour mens Ignite V Slide Sandal, Black in the same size for the exact same price, and they fit exceptionally well, AND offer far superior padding while not being super thick. If you're in the market for cheap ish slide sandals, just buy the Under Armour ones and you will be happy.

Also found the inside soul of the shoe to be kind of slippery. The combination of the two caused me to feel not very secure walking around in them and one time I rushed for the phone and my heel slid off the sandal and I basically strained my injury prone knee. It's been probably at least a few weeks and my knee still has not healed. I would recommend The shoe for 20 something-year-olds that can take some punishment and not for 50 -year-olds that may have a sore knee.

representative_reviews.text: I saw someone on the street wearing a pair of these Adilette clogs this summer and I knew I had to have a pair for myself. The shell-toe design is a cool callback to the classic design and reminds me of the pair I had in my youth. I'm 100 happy with my purchase, but I also recognize that these aren't the thickest, the softest, or the most comfortable clogs I've worn. I love that the sole mimics the classic Superstar tread pattern, but I also suspect it will wear smooth quickly. I also felt that the curve of the insole didn't quite match the shape of my foot. Perhaps I'll get used to it or perhaps it will always bug me. In spite of the shortcomings of the design, I still plan to wear these as my fun summer shoes until the soles wear thin.

I have severe arthritis reoccurring plantar fasciitis, and have been unable to walk without severe pain for the last three months. As a teacher, I am on my feet all day, and the pain is so distracting and limiting. After a ridiculous amount of time trying returning the more expensive recommended shoes that my podiatrist suggested, I ordered two different brands of Clarks. I've never worn Clarks before, and am SO glad I tried them! My arthritic big toes don't bend without pain, and so I can't wear heels - but my plantar fasciitis feels better WITH heels. So...a conundrum. I got these shoes because they just have a tiny angle of a heel, and they have a great inner cushion in the heel. The softer rubber seems more forgiving then the harder rubber soles on the more expensive brand. Also, these are cute - I don't feel like an old lady wearing them, which is more than I can say about most shoes designed to reduce foot pain! The elastic goring allows me to easily slide my foot in without hurting my arthritic thumbs or toes. They do not have a wide toe box, which was a concern for me. However, I put shoe-stretchers in them for one day, and since they are leather they stretched to the perfect width. I found them true to size with my thinner socks, but if you wear thick socks you may want to order up one half size. These are literally half the price and twice the pain relief as the cork-bottomed, highly-touted brands and way cuter . I will definitely buy Clarks in the future! Note These do not have removable insoles, which may be a problem if you wear custom orthotics.
This is very comfortable and very light shoes with very good arch support. I love them and ordered one more pair...

We did 17,000 steps for 2 days in a row and another day with over 12,000, and my feet were just fine. The decision was truly based on the two reasons I bought this shoe. Easy to put on, and take off without sitting down - as I was staying at a person's house and didn't want to deal with tying laces and untieing laces, and also comfort. double check. I'm very, very happy with these shoes.

I have severe arthritis reoccurring plantar fasciitis, and have been unable to walk without severe pain for the last three months. As a teacher, I am on my feet all day, and the pain is so distracting and limiting. After a ridiculous amount of time trying returning the more expensive recommended shoes that my podiatrist suggested, I ordered two different brands of Clarks. I've never worn Clarks before, and am SO glad I tried them! My arthritic big toes don't bend without pain, and so I can't wear heels - but my plantar fasciitis feels better WITH heels. So...a conundrum. I got these shoes because they just have a tiny angle of a heel, and they have a great inner cushion in the heel. The softer rubber seems more forgiving then the harder rubber soles on the more expensive brand. Also, these are cute - I don't feel like an old lady wearing them, which is more than I can say about most shoes designed to reduce foot pain! The elastic goring allows me to easily slide my foot in without hurting my arthritic thumbs or toes. They do not have a wide toe box, which was a concern for me. However, I put shoe-stretchers in them for one day, and since they are leather they stretched to the perfect width. I found them true to size with my thinner socks, but if you wear thick socks you may want to order up one half size. These are literally half the price and twice the pain relief as the cork-bottomed, highly-touted brands and way cuter . I will definitely buy Clarks in the future! Note These do not have removable insoles, which may be a problem if you wear custom orthotics.

representative_reviews.text: I have purchased the 4 pairs of the Terrex Swift R boots for years when I was a mail carrier and they lasted better than any other boot walking 9 miles a day...comfortable out of the box with not much "break in" required. I wanted to order some more for the winter and what is left out there is scraps, They stopped making them. I looked for a upgraded or new version of the Terrex Swift R GTX and seen these. Pretty close, I thought. I purchased the boots and the shoe version. Right out of the box I knew I was returning them. Concrete stiff, the soles are super narrow, The "continental" sole is a joke...Its not even from side to side...forcing your foot to sit crooked. Uneven and hard as a brick. NARROW!!! Like a wood clamp gripping the sides of my feet. Tried to walk, heel slips in the collar...You know thats going to be a hot spot. Decent room in the toe, not much complaint, length fit as normal, no rubbing Collar in the back way too big, makes the heel slip. Sole - I dont know even know what the heck is going on with that thing, hard, narrow, crooked?! Super narrow Imagine this...normal toe box, heel to big causing slipping, arch area comically narrow. Thats this shoe and the matching boot. Coming from buying 4 pair of the Swifts that were nearly perfect, these boots are a joke.
Stiff as a board, not comfortable at all. I have no idea how these wouldnt give you blisters from it rubbing areas on your foot when you walk from being too stiff....and i dont even get blisters.

Well built and good looking but wow, the sole on this shoe is ROCK HARD. Using both hands I could barely flex it. Because the sole doesn't flex, the heel slips. So I suspect you would get some pretty good blisters if hiking rugged, steep terrain. Another common issue I've had with Adidas brand shoes is that they're a bit too roomy above the toes. This is maybe fine if wearing a really thick, cushy hiking sock but otherwise it creates a big open pocket. These also have "speed lacing" which I'm not generally a fan of. If the sole was more flexible maybe the speed lacing would be fine, but it it's difficult to get the lacing tight enough to compensate for the super stiff sole. With a few improvements from Adida this could be a great shoe.

Great for Pinocchio perhaps, not for an active human feet. Anyways bought some Dr. Shultz inserts on Amazon, which helps, but over all, shoes in this price range should provide more comfort. After 50 years I finally found a hiking shoe that fit me. So of course, it may not fit you, but there are no lighter, better made hiking shoes on the market, which I first heard from an REI shoe salesman in Berkeley, though of course not surprising to me, except for him saying that.... I won't wear anything else now, and haven't had plantar fascitis and other foot maladies for 15 years.

I ve worn Solomons for the past few years and really like them. These are a cheaper alternative to them. I would say the arch support isn t as good, but definitely supports your foot. They have the same cable lacing system as the Solomons which is a must for me. I will definitely be buying another pair of these

I started working for Amazon as a Delivery driver about 90 days ago. I quickly discovered that running shoes are NOT what is needed for this type of job, too many different types of terrains, some wet, some dry and traction is important. Moreover, I did not want to wear some bulky construction site workboot. The answer Terrex Swift R2 GTX! This is THE shoe for those that cover a lot of ground and want to keep their feet protected. The lace-lock is great as well as this super-strong thin lace. The Black Black Black has a very aggressive look and the tread is tough and has a really great grip.

representative_reviews.text: Love the shoes, but they are TIGHT in the toes. Some long ride, my toes go numb - and I don t require wide shoes.

I normally where size 12, so that is what I ordered. Out of the box they were very uncomfortable and tight. I thought maybe just need to break them in. I have worn them 2 or 3 times a week to work for over a month since I purchased in January 2023. Walking from car to office desk, my feet are screaming get these off!. As soon as I get to desk I do take them off, and continued to do that throughout the day. Finally after missing window to return to Amazon, they sit in closet never to be worn again. Across toe and top of foot is where they hurt my feet. Not sure if is the design of the shoe or to small. Wish I could try different size to see, but not willing to spend money to try.

Defective product had the shoes 6 weeks only used for recreation, the side of toe box is ripping wearing. Expected better quality for 140.00. Very disappointed with product quality or lack of and with Amazon's customer service.

I have purchased the 4 pairs of the Terrex Swift R boots for years when I was a mail carrier and they lasted better than any other boot walking 9 miles a day...comfortable out of the box with not much "break in" required. I wanted to order some more for the winter and what is left out there is scraps, They stopped making them. I looked for a upgraded or new version of the Terrex Swift R GTX and seen these. Pretty close, I thought. I purchased the boots and the shoe version. Right out of the box I knew I was returning them. Concrete stiff, the soles are super narrow, The "continental" sole is a joke...Its not even from side to side...forcing your foot to sit crooked. Uneven and hard as a brick. NARROW!!! Like a wood clamp gripping the sides of my feet. Tried to walk, heel slips in the collar...You know thats going to be a hot spot. Decent room in the toe, not much complaint, length fit as normal, no rubbing Collar in the back way too big, makes the heel slip. Sole - I dont know even know what the heck is going on with that thing, hard, narrow, crooked?! Super narrow Imagine this...normal toe box, heel to big causing slipping, arch area comically narrow. Thats this shoe and the matching boot. Coming from buying 4 pair of the Swifts that were nearly perfect, these boots are a joke.

This is my third pair of Addidas Terrex shoes. The first pair was amazing.... Best shoes for hiking or trail running I've ever had. Super supportive and comfortable. The second pair fit tight and I believe we're mislabeled. These fit ok at first but I discovered on a 4 mi hike today that the fit is pretty bad and they are overall uncomfortable. My toes on my left foot were squished and they were just overall uncomfortable on the hike. Unfortunately I missed the return window by a couple weeks so I have another pair of these which are pretty much unusable.
If I wanted narrow and uncomfortable, I would have bought Nike. Also, if returned within 7 days you will only get 50 of cost back. Adidas has lost a customer.

I normally wear a 10 1 2 but ordered 11 and they were really tight and the toe box smashed my toes together. It was like I was participating in some kind of tribal custom were they try to mangle your toes by crushing them together. Shoes felt like they had solid construction, but had to return them because of the narrow toe box.

This is a very heavy shoe with a very hard, stiff sole. They seem to run very narrow even for an Adidas product. They became more comfortable after being worn for a few weeks. The do provide acceptable protection from rain.

I usually wear Salomon shoes but wanted give this one a try. I am sending this back and will never look at it again. It is so narrow and stiff. Going back to Salomon. Adidas, keep make running shoes and stay away from hiking shoes please

Bought these for Disc golf but they were way too narrow. I liked the look and the quality but the toe box was tight and around the arch caused my foot to cramp. I would only recommend these if you can find a wide.

These shoes are pretty narrow. My husband said the left shoe could be adjusted to be wide enough by expanding the bungee laces, but the laces are shorter on the right shoe for some reason, so that shoe is too narrow. We'll try to exchange them. If a new pair comes that fits better, I'll be happy to adjust my review.

I've had these for a few months. I wanted to like them but they aren't great. The lacing system is not as secure or even feeling as traditional laces. The heal cup feels very shallow and my heel raises a bit if not cinched down tight. The toe box is good in width but a bit tight on the top of the toes. They do seem well built and are definitely on the warmer side. Traction is great as well. These are stiff like hikers so be aware of that.

Great looking shoes, so I ended up keeping them, but now that I wore them couple times I regret. They are very stiff, uncomfortable, very inflexible. Great for Pinocchio perhaps, not for an active human feet. Anyways bought some Dr. Shultz inserts on Amazon, which helps, but over all, shoes in this price range should provide more comfort. Also, if you decide to get these, order them in half size bigger than you normally wear.

I was very disappointed in these shoes. I had previously owned another pair of Terreks but wore them out and wanted to get some just like them because I liked them so much. Within 6 months the rubber on the inside and the outside by the toe knuckles started to come off. Not a bit deal, I just secured it with some super glue. But now the entire sole is starting to come off of the bottom of the shoe, side and heel.

I don't know what I expected, and maybe all hiking shoes are like this. But, these are the most uncomfortable shoes I've ever put on my feet. I've owned a lot of Adidas, and they've always been very comfortable. These shoes hate feet.
Very tight in the toes and width. I should have tried a wider shoe. I truly love the fact that it's actually waterproof.

I really liked the Salomon speedcross 4 GTX when they came out, but when I tried them on they were just too narrow and hurt my feet. I tried them a few times, but just could not make them work. When I saw these, an obvious knockoff, I thought what the hell and ordered a pair. I am VERY impressed! Fit true to size for me , perfect width for me , and the sole, while still being harder than a normal sneaker, is softer and much more comfortable than the Salomons I tried. They fit and feel like a real sneaker while being waterproof, harder soled, breathable, and having great tread for traction. I use them for shooting sports and they are going to be perfect. Already thinking of ordering another pair for back up before they discontinue them or something!
It was laced up and ready to go. I can see how those with wide feet would need to go up a half size because they fit perfectly foy skinny feet
Comfort, traction, lacing system are all great. If you suffer from extreme foot pain, thIs is the shoe.

I purchased these for the look, as well as based on prior reviews. I was not disappointed with these. At first glance they looked narrow in the toe box, but once I put them on, I knew it wasn't so. I normally wear boots, and so I was just used to the appearance of a wider toe box. As others have mentioned, I wear a 11 in other sneakers, but opted for the half size smaller even with this choice these approximately would have a quarter inch play overall. Which makes sense if you are to wear thicker hiking socks etc. Construction is rock solid, grip is great, arch support is good. I really enjoy the quick cinch, or the lacing system provided. Time will tell though overall how these hold up but I can say I am pleased with these, and would recommend them.

Got a size a bit bigger as others suggested and the fit is perfect. These are the best utility shoes I've ever owned and they look pretty decent too. Very grippy. Easy lace system means I never have to stop to tie my shoes now just need to convince my buddies to get some so I don't have to stop and wait for them to tie their shoes 6 times

I m 6ft tall 250lbs and use size 13 shoes. My feet are wide and with this shoes. It s a little too snug for my feet. However, I just used a much thinner socks than I usually use to make up for uncomfortable it feels, I probably just have to break it in a little bit more. Overall, it just feels right.
I use them for everything! and I didn't have to ask for the extra size, my regular size fitted perfectly. you really feel your feet are protected with this shoe.

I typically don t buy shoes on line - gave these a shot didn t expect them to fit. However, they fit quite well. Love these shoes! I bought them for disk golfing and now I wear them all the time. They are both dry and warm.

Have had other Terrex shoes in the past. Ordered these in the same size, seemed a little bigger than expected. I then other the next size down and they fit great. These seem a little warmer, perhaps because these have Gortex. I like the show so far. Good cross between a sport shoe and a hiking shoe.

Very good shoes for work. Slip and water resistant. The size is a little smaller than my normal size. For the first two-three weeks there was pressure on my pinkie toe. Now it's better, but I should have bought half or one size bigger.
Fits well. Feels stiff but loosens up after a few wears. I wear 91 2 -10 and ordered 10 fits just right
What I didn't like about this pair of shoes is they were stolen but I know how they fit because I've been wearing this pair a few years now
Thought these had a hard toe? I bought a pair from the adidas store in Orlando same label and product name but they have a hard tipped toe and these ones don t?

Shoes are really comfy on the trail and very grippy on slick surfaces. Thanks to the Gor-Tex my feet stayed very dry. Toe box is fairly wide so is good for people with wider feet, not really wide feet, but kind of wide. Heel support is really good!

representative_reviews.text: Shoe was instantly sensationally comfortable, right out of the box. Been holding strong so far these last few months. However, with typical use there have now been two issues to the exterior of the show. First, a twig punctured the top of the left shoe while on a hike somehow. Second, just as suddenly, a couple of weeks later one of the sections holding the tie string bands came detached so now the tightening function is compromising the other sections as well. The couple of months I had with the shoe were great and I was extremely happy with my purchase but now, already, they feel like they need to be retired which is fairly pathetic.

The clip that holds the laces tight broke within the first month and a half of owning these shoes. I use them 2-3 times a week and only for a couple hours at a time. Otherwise great shoe.

Defective product had the shoes 6 weeks only used for recreation, the side of toe box is ripping wearing. Expected better quality for 140.00. Very disappointed with product quality or lack of and with Amazon's customer service.

This was my second pair of Adidas Men's Terrex Swift shoes. The first pair after about two years had a separation of the sole from the shoe in the toe area. I do like the shoe's fit nd Gore Tex for waterproofness. So I bought another pair thinking that the issue was likely a fluke. However, again the same separation in less than two years with only moderate use around the yard. That is quite disappointing. Also the fabric came apart on the left outside of the shoe near thel ace rivet.

Soles of the shoe looks like new, only issue it is separated from the shoe in under a year. Tried to repair with a glue gun multiple times, contacted Adidas and not a word back. If you want a disposable shoe that lasts less than a year, this is the shoe for you

Do not recommend these. I wish we could return them but the return period is over. My husband wears them once a week on his day off and they are already falling apart. They are also too small. Do not purchase.

First day , I tightened the shoe lace and the eye popped off making the shoe useless. The material holding the eye to the shoe base is super weak. Big quality control issye. The shoe otherwise is great too bad.

I wanted to order some more for the winter and what is left out there is scraps, They stopped making them. I looked for a upgraded or new version of the Terrex Swift R GTX and seen these. Lasted about a year or normal use, after 6-7 months the laces wore through the outer layer of the top of the shoe, they broke soon after. The sole wore very quickly and is way too soft. They breathe poorly in hot weather and overall don t compare to the Solomon gtx line.
The shoes look like they have been through a fire. Defiantly used and very disgusted that we paid for these and this is what came in the box!
Firm at first then comfortable once broken in. Did NOT stay waterproof for very long. After 3 months feet get wet even walking in dewy tall grass. Would NOT recommended for waterproof shoe

Purchased January 27, 2018 Bottom line up front Bad The laces cut through the gortex outer layer after only 10 months. Moderate Shoe is wide Good Waterproof and looks feels good Great Awesome Continental sole I live in Savannah, GA and was looking for an every day shoe to replace my Merrels I had for 5 years. As it rains a lot, I wanted waterproof. After a lot of research, I found these. Tread is outstanding, kept my feet dry, and I bought Superfeet Black insoles to go in it. I was severely upset that after only 10 months, the gortex has worn through by the wire thin shoe laces, making them less waterproof. I just replaced the string with Kiwi no tie shoe laces, which are thicker and more flexible. They also feel much better now. I will say it took 40 minutes trying to feed it through the lace holes as they are tiny. After almost a year of wear, I am not sure I would buy these again. For this price, I expect more. I have not contacted the company yet, but will update this post to notify anything from customer service.
Awesome durable shoes I feel they are versatile enough to be used daily, well made with industry best materials, will see how they hold up.
Only thing I can grumble about is it is a little stiff. But can't beat the price for a GoreTex trail running shoe. I use it more for working outside all kinds of weather.
The Continental sole has worn down quite a bit faster than my previous Terrex shoes that had the Adidas sole.

After going through several pair of another, more expensive, brand I wanted something more durable. I literally have shoes I've worn for years, and years. I generally do not wear them out The brand I had been using were wearing through the soles in 6 mos or the sides splitting out. These seem as though they'll wear better and are gortex as well.

If you think you are getting "Vibram" or "Goodyear" type longevity out of the tread..guess again. This shoe is perfect in so many ways except for the tread life. This shoe has the worst tread life I have experienced in a trail shoe. Continental rubber corp has seriously dropped the ball on this one. for 140 I should not be worrying about tread life in February when I bought them in December.

This shoe is high quality. It looks great and feels great after the break-in period which was about a week for me. I only have one concern that was easy to change The thin cheap bungee strings. The strings are so thin that they started to cut into the material in a weeks time. I changed them with the Kiwi brand that are 3X thicker. I would have given the shoe 5 stars but the strings that come with them had to be replaced.

I purchased these for next disc golf season. However I am wearing them to get them broken in. So far 2 weeks in they fit well the toe box is still a little tight but by spring hopefully we are set. and the draw closure is nice.
Great quality. Best shoe I've ever owned. The soles do not ware out. Water proof. Very durable. The perfect shoe of your active outdoors person

I started working for Amazon as a Delivery driver about 90 days ago. I quickly discovered that running shoes are NOT what is needed for this type of job, too many different types of terrains, some wet, some dry and traction is important. Moreover, I did not want to wear some bulky construction site workboot. The answer Terrex Swift R2 GTX! This is THE shoe for those that cover a lot of ground and want to keep their feet protected. The lace-lock is great as well as this super-strong thin lace. The Black Black Black has a very aggressive look and the tread is tough and has a really great grip.

The Adidas Terrex shoe is great! They are comfortable with good support for walking or hiking. The Gore-Tex is a bonus for snow rain, whether walking or hiking! The speed lacing system works well for getting in out of. Goodyear soles provide decent traction and should hold up well.
It was laced up and ready to go. I can see how those with wide feet would need to go up a half size because they fit perfectly foy skinny feet

This series of shoes are awesome this is my fourth pair over ten years, and I ve beaten the crap out of them! They ve held up well to my abuse I still have a beater pair for really messy activities mud, rock, dirty chores , and bought another pair for regular wear. The zip tie laces are great and quick the goretex fabric prevents water seeping in on hikes, and the overall construction is sturdy.
So far so good. I ve worn them for about 1 wk. they break in quick as they are initially very stiff. Very happy with them.

I ve used these shoes for almost 2.5 years now and they have been great. I ve tried Solomon, Under Armor, Original SWAT, etc. and the Terrex have been the only ones to last longer than 7-8 months. A friend recommended these and I will never buy another work shoe as long as these are made. The shoe stayed waterproof until the laces eventually cut through the top of the shoe and the toes started to separate at about the 2 year mark. Even with the damage, they are still water resistant and my feet are never squishy in a storm unless I walk through water over ankle deep. The soles on my old ones are completely slick from all the concrete pavement running but still manage to have some traction. Also the break in time is only a couple of shifts and I never got a hot spot during that time. I ll still get use out of the old pair as grass cutting shoes, so still getting my money s worth. Size is spot on for my foot, I wear a 10.5 in almost everything. They also look nice with a uniform which is a plus.

representative_reviews.text: These are way over priced for the quality of shoe. Previous pair of the same name were excellent. This new pair has a less flexible sole and the top material feels less durable. This should be a 60 shoe at most.
My only complaint is the price. Great shoes, try and wait until you can find them under 80 but you wont be disappointed either way.

Had my eye on these for over a year. The regular 100 price is just plain silly but kept in saved for later items so any time a price drop would let me know got them on sale and worth the wait. VERY comfortable and quick lace is a interesting design that works.

This shoe is great all around, good look, doesn't fall apart, weather proof, easy on and off with bungee, great traction, fits well, feels well. I wish they made soles on shoes replaceable though rather than replacing an entire shoe once the sole is worn.

Excellent shoes. Stable and supportive. Provide good protection but well cushioned. The goretex is perfect for damp fall outdoor activities. Great fit with almost zero break-in required. Continental rubber soles are a nice touch.
Great shoe. A bit stiff initially. Good lateral support and grippy sole. Wore them on brief hike on steep trails and it was flawless. Good reviews from outdoor websites.

This is a really great shoe gortex, washable, not a show of colors, great lacing system. The only fault I see is that the sole wears away all too fast. I do wish there was something I could about that post purchase, or hopefull the manufacturer will do something about it. Pricing seems to have a wide range, I don't know why. I only purchase the all black option and for what ever reason, it is always at the highest price. To me there is no logic for the color choices to have such a drastic effect on the selling price.
These shoes are great! I get over a year out of them. The current pair I own is going on 1 1 2 years and looking like they might make 2 years. Great Shoe
This is just a great all around adidas shoe... for trail or hiking..or just looking sporty ...water proof and durability..this will last for years..
The shoes are great. Water proof. Awesome grip in all conditions and surfaces. You can feel the sole grabbing the surface like a pair if performance tires. My only complaint is better color options.
Awesome durable shoes I feel they are versatile enough to be used daily, well made with industry best materials, will see how they hold up.

The ankle is too low on the foot to give an adequate fit for anything longer. You'll get blisters. But they have very good support and are comfortable for short distances.
I was excited to get these shows for support. They were recommended. They hurt my heal. A little too narrow for me and the support isn't what I need.

My heel slips out even walking so I can't use them to run. They angle my feet causing it to hurt after 5 minutes of walking because the same powerstep inserts perfect for Brooks Ghosts cause me to walk on the outside bones of my feet in these. The toe portion was not comfortable and overall gave a discomfort for me. Too tight Well I bet best option if you wanna buy is try before you buy. Returned and refunded.
Shoes are no better than my cheap shoes from Walmart. Good arch support but not enough cushion for my heels or toes.

I have never had a pair of Nikes before that were uncomfortable, but each time I have worn these I have had ankle and knee pain at the end of the day. I ve been in disbelief that the shoes were causing it, but each time I give them a try again I end up hurting. Don t buy this style

I have purchased previous versions of these running shoes, but these did not feel the same. The cut is very low below the ankle and the bulky heel was odd. I decided to return them and give up on this model.
I ve only had the shoes a month I wear them less than three days a week and tread is peeling off on both shoes
The shoes flattens my feet and sometimes causes my feet to cramp which is very annoying and utterly painful.

Very cool and fast looking but...the logos in the footbed make it uncomfortable without socks, my normal style. Makes the bottom of the foot stick to the shoe. Also, they re a bit narrow and the upper shoe has to spread out

Difficult to get your foot in. There is a piece of fabric connecting the tongue of the shoe to the body of the shoe and not just at the bottom of the tongue like on most athletic shoes, but almost all the way up the side to the top of the tongue . This makes it very difficult to get your foot into the shoe. But what's worse, if you have thick socks on or if your feet are a little swollen as they sometimes are during that time of the month when you're retaining water , loosening the shoelaces to give your foot more room, does no good because the tongue of the shoe is still constraining your foot. I also don't like the way these shoes lace-up. It's easy to make sure the laces are tight enough but it's impossible to loosen them to any extent see comment above making the shoe feel too tight across the instep. Lastly, the sides of the shoe are cut too low to the point where it feels like your foot is only halfway in the shoe. I'm really disappointed in this model of Nike.

I love running, and I love long distances favorite racing distances are 10K, 12K, 15K, and half marathons . Back in my high school track-and-field days, I was fitted and told I need to use a specific line of Brooks for support. Eventually I evolved to like Saucony mainly because they were cheaper but also because the fit...worked? After I started triathlons and Ironmans a few years ago, my miles grew exponentially so I decided to get refitted for a better sneaker once more. I found the Brooks Ghost at that point and was very pleased for nearly 9-ish months. They were a comfortable shoe that fit me well, however I found over time, the lack of ankle support really started to take it's toll. FYI, I change out my shoes roughly every 3-4 months depending on the amount of miles ran. By about last December, I started to get right foot pain after each run. Instead of looking elsewhere, I bought the next generation of Brooks Ghost. This seemed to only worsen the lack of ankle support and regular foot pain after longer distances. Finally, in search of another shoe, I found myself drawn to Nike even though I've never owned a pair of Nikes in my life. RunnersWorld and Triathlon articles have many suggested brands, and I never thought I'd see the day Nike was in their top 10. I must've missed how much Nike has changed their line of runners over the past decade suggesting that their shoes are now more comfortable and faster. I decided to take a chance with the Air Zoom Pegasus 36. The moment I put these on, they felt AMAZING! Typically any pair of new running shoes needs some time doing low miles to really break them in, however these adorable lime green Pegasus felt like they were made for my feet from day one! I should advise, I do have normal to narrower feet and these fit like a glove. The Pegasus is like a cloud supporting all the right places, springing comfortably with each stride, and VERY lightweight! I was so surprised at the light feel that I put these on an ounce gram scale to compare with my Ghosts. The Pegasus 36 pair weighed in at 478 grams and the Ghost 12 pair weighed in at 568... a 90g difference! That may not sound like much but when you add miles or do the distance after 90K of biking, shaving off a few grams can make all the difference. On my first run with these I took them to the track and did 8.5 miles, 6.25 of which at race pace. I got some of my fastest times recorded in a long time on the track that day. And bonus, no ankle or foot pain! I also did not need to stretch regularly between splits, because my legs felt amazing! Time will really tell how the Pegasus will hold up against the elements, but to be honest, even if these don't make it as my new, forever running brand, I would be happy to keep these as an everyday walking shoe. They are OH SO COMFORTABLE! Today after my run I actually put them back on to wear at work for a 12-hour shift. I can honestly say I never did that with my Ghosts 11s or 12s. - I'll report back in a few months to advise how these are holding up. ...maybe by then I'll actually get to run a race in these?!?!?! hopes That is, if Covid-19 ever calms the fudge down!!!! Hope y'all stay safe and healthy out there! Cheers! 5 month update I still love the Nike Pegasus 36. Since July I purchased a 2nd pair in pink black in order to alternate wear. The shoes still feel as comfortable as ever. I have even been able to run two Covid-approved races since October a 10K and Half Marathon where I placed 1st place overall female in both! However, I discovered that while I love the light-weight and energy transfer from the Pegasus, I am a greater fan of them with in shorter distances. When reaching the 13 mile mark, my joints feel as those they could use more stability. In a 10K, the Pegasus worked fantastic! I compared a half marathon solo run with the Pegasus then did the same with my old Brooks Ghost. While the Brooks still caused a few blisters and foot pain, my knees and poster kept better than with the Pegasus. I've learned that sometimes too much cushion with less structure can cause more work for the body to maneuver between stride for me at least . I am still a complete fan of the Pegasus and will continue to use them in training and DEFINITELY for any races shorter than 13.1 miles. However, I am now on the hunt for another shoe that'll go the distance with the same lightness and bounce as the Pegasus but with stability to keep my form in check when I reach those "greater fatigue miles". Thanks for listening! Happy running! -D

Love these shoes! They fit very light and comfortable and the pink is more neon than the picture shows, which I love!
Great fit as expected. Great color and design. Super comfortable... use for all activities and workouts!

the sneaker are VERY comfortable, they are light and super stylish in the light blue color. My favorite sneaker today.

Never understood why Nike always take away their winners and come up with new models that may be fresh in looks but never as good or comfortable as the older models that are practical and useful. So bought Nike older models online and this one good and fitting.

The fit is a bit off, though I like the pillowy cushion of the soles. Almost seems as tho the foot box is too shallow and the tongue a bit too short to give proper fit up around the ankle. But, the black and pink lace-like look is novel. Overall, above average.
This my second time to purchase these Nikes. I wore the other ones out unfortunately! They look really good on as well as are highly, highly functional.
Arrived quickly. I knew the shoe fit because I have purchased the same style in the past. Great price. Quality as expected. Very pleased.

The real test was this morning at the gym. I started out totally fine. Then 6 minutes.. only 6 minutes.. into my workout, my feet got DESTROYED. Massive PF flare-up, the worst one I've had since starting to work out, and I'm still experiencing it now, 4 hours later. Literally got to my car and took off the shoes entirely and drove home. Immediately triggered a return on these.
Upon opening the box I quickly realized that these shoes were used. Holes in the toes and the heel. Worn sole and small stones still embedded. Terrible and returned this product.

I can feel the interior skeleton of the shoe poking at my feet through the foam. I couldn't even go a mile in these. I normally do 3 miles a day and I had to take them off before I got home. I feel like I've had high heels on for a few hours. I don't understand how a tennis shoe can be this painful. Even cheap Walmart shoes are better than this. So disappointing because the colors are so bright and pretty and they definitely weren't cheap.

I thought these shoes were cute but they were so tight they made my feet hurt so I had to return them. I have never had this problem with any pair of shoes I have purchased. I wear an 8 but they were too tight all around.

Loved these shoes, but after wearing a while I noticed blisters on the back of my foot. After looking at the shoes closer, I noticed a plastic piece was stabbing into the back of my foot. Just check the inside back of the shoe BEFORE you pass the return time.

I've had them for about 2 months and the plastic piece in the heel has actually torn through the material on the inside of my shoes.

I have been running everyday for 5 years, anywhere from 1 to 26.2 miles . Never had knee pain until I wore these.

I do NOT recommend these shoes unless you have narrow feet and don't need arch support. I decided to try the Gel-Excite 7, because I need a second pair of athletic shoes in addition to the Asics Gel-Pulse 11 I've been wearing for a couple of years. The Pulse 11 fit perfectly and have great arch support, but I bought this Excite 7 as I like the color. I ordered my usual size 9.5 that I wear in athletic shoes I'm a 9 in regular shoes . When they arrived, I noticed the toe bed is much more narrow, the entire shoe is shorter in length, and there is zero arch support compared to my current Pulse 11 shoes. I can somewhat understand that the toe bed might be smaller, but when I measured the length against two pair I have of the Pulse 11, I found these are at least 3 4 of an inch shorter. They are so tight that after having them on for 15 minutes while sitting, my feet and legs ached. And running shoes should have arch support, but these have none at all. Sadly, I returned them and will be ordering another pair of the Pulse 11.

These shoes butchered my feet after only a mile of walking. Even though they seemed to fit perfectly, and even though I wore expensive no-blister athletic socks that covered my ankles, these shoes ripped the backs of my ankles until they were bloody. I ve had dress shoes do that, but never an athletic shoe! They also tore up part of my left big toe. Also, although they felt comfortable and supportive when I tried them on, after several minutes of walking it felt like there was nothing between the balls of my feet and the concrete I was walking on. I didn t even try running in them, but I think it would be brutal. If I hadn t already recycled the box, I would be trying return these shoes.

Great shoes, but the inserts are wack! Had to get different inserts because the originals are very narrow and uncomfortable at the sides and heal. It is difficult to push foot all the way in with the original inserts. Now that I figured out the insert situation, they feel great!

The sneakers look very nice and provide good support but after wearing them for a few days the back was rubbing against my heel and started causing irritation. I've never had this problem with sneakers before. I've worn them a few more times hoping that they just needed to be broken in but it's not helping. Don't think I'll be able to wear them anymore which is a disappointing waste

I have had every issue under the sun with my feet bunions, stress fractures, etc. Asics have always been the only brand of running shoe that allow me to run comfortably and for long distances without discomfort. This is their neutral shoe and even though I have high arches I prefer this shoe combined with my superfeet inserts to their high support shoe. Highly recommend for serious runner women with foot issues.
These were so comfortable the first time I put them in. I walk every day, and they offer good support.

Great arch support and lightweight. Good running shoe. However, these shoes rubbed the back of my heels RAW. I had to do some digging and rip out the plastic bit on the back of the heels. I probably won't get as many miles out of these shoes as I do from Brooks shoes, but at least I can walk a mile without limping now.
Worn these for running, long walks, and even a few hikes for about a month now. Very comfortable, no blisters, and great support. Would recommend
This shoe provided the needed cushion for my daily walks. I was really starting to feel foot pain with another brand of gym shoes. I m glad I decided to give these a try.

It is very comfortable but does not fit as perfect as my gel excite 3. Not as much arch support as I expected. May go back to the excite 3. Also be careful when wearing these shoes. Make sure you wear proper socks that go above the back of the shoe or it will rub the back of your heels esp if you go for long walks or runs.
Very comfortable for stability. Great support for people who are prone to get plantar fasciitis. I have 2 pair of these shoes. I stand all day and my feet never hurt.

I needed a soft comfy shoes that will help me keep going on my feet for 10-12hrs shift. I found this and I liked it! I tried several brands and several ASICS styles and ended up getting this. I am a hospital phlebotomist and I am on my feet and walking on a hospital hard floor all day, the only time I can seat is at lunch break if I m lucky . With this shoes, I can barely feel the floor, it bounce back when I am walking. I like wearing this specially on a morning run draw. With the clogs no matter how soft they are, it still hurts my foot toward the end of my shift. This shoe is kinda narrow and long so I ordered size 8.5W, it fit the width perfectly even though it s long but I still like it and still recommend this shoes.
I am on my feet for 10 hours a day and this shoe is so comfortable. I use to get foot or hip pain by the end of the day and now I don't!
Amazing. And feels great for supporting my plantar fasciitis. Amazing color will go perfect with my disneyland outfits
Feels great as soon as you take your first walk in it ! Asic s shoe never has let me down. Affordable and comfortable!
Wonderful, comfortable and basic for everyday life. If you have a little wide foot, I suggest buying the size wide to be more comfortable with the use of socks ...

My favorite brand for walking and running. I needed a new pair of walking shoes because I have been increasing my miles recently. Needed more cushioning than my last two pair of ASICS provided. I usually wear a 7.5 to 8 and purchased the 8, which is perfect I'd probably need a 8.5 if these were for running . There isn't as much arch support in this style, but it should be fine since I will be using them for walking only. Love these so much I've purchased two more pairs.

I bought this pair of shoes because I realized my Adidas Cloud Foams had basically been pounded flat and we're offering no cushioning, and my Nikes were beat up beyond salvation. I walk and run on an incline on my treadmill everyday, and I also do a lot of resistance training along with that. I needed a shoe that would aid in balance while doing my resistance training, and offer support and shock absorption while running. So far I've walked run about 4 miles in these and I like them a lot. The fit is perfect, and the shoes don't slip on my heel at all while I'm running which was my biggest pet peeve with the Adidas Cloud Foams. I have had zero joint or foot pain from the 2 runs I've used these shoes for which is a fantastic improvement. My feet, hips, and knees would become stiff and painful after every run with my old shoes. I did order a half size up which ended up being perfect, my usual size 8 would not have fit.

I'm trying to use the treadmill every day but I was getting sore feet from cheap sneakers. These did well in my searches, weren't crazy expensive, and aren't ugly. Out of the box they appear very well made. Lightweight, firmly structured but still flexible and breathable, thick soft footbed, and what looks like a cotton lining inside the upper. Frankly, as a lifelong wearer of inexpensive sneakers, I was amazed at how supportive and comfortable these were. I find it a bit annoying that I have to open the laces wide to get them on, but I figured that was part of getting this nice, supportive fit. The actual reason I dropped a star is because the back of the heel is too high. It rubs and creates sore spots. I added inserts to raise my feet up in the shoes - it's a shame because I really liked the feel of the footbed. Even with the inserts the back of the heels land a little high, but I haven't developed actual blisters. Just another data point to consider if you're looking at these sneakers.

I think I will opt for higher price point next time with more tapered toe box and softer insole and cushier feel to the step.

3 month update Well after the first 45 days of use these shoes have stretched and now day 91 the mesh is ripping at the outter side of the toe box. The support in this area is gone due to the mesh-like material. There's nothing inside to reinforce toes from rubbing hole through the thin perforated material. The last month and a half due to lack of support in this area my foot injury has stalled as far as healing... no longer supporting the toe area. Thankfully I waited to buy another pair because this was a waste of money. My last pair of Pumas and Nikes used the same cheap material but these ASICS began separating much sooner. Really bummed as they were nice looking but there's just nothing inside to reinforce the toe box. I'd recommend avoiding. I don't run. These were only used for light daily walking. I recently had a bilateral injury to my feet. I hyperextended the toes and because my primary sneakers really had minimal support the injury got worse and worse over the summer. I finally landed in the podiatrist's office and when he saw those shoes he told me that they were "done" and "buy some quality shoes w support." I was sent home with a pair of really sexy orthopedic velcro shoes to prevent my toes from bending over the next 6 weeks. I've been pretty disappointed in the last few running shoe purchases. I don't run btw. These are just everyday sneakers to me... I'm not doing anything more than my 8 mile day dog walking. Looks these have a clean and minimal color design. There were other shoes I looked at that were good brands and cheaper, but they were too wild in their color palette. The lilac is minimal - only one tiny bit on the outside edge of the sole. Just right. Quality to be fair I really won't know for a few months. The sole is thick and should hold up. The fabric around the foot is stiff. It's only on the upper part where the toes are that it's more flexible and the test for me will be if my big toe creates a hole thru that by year end. I really wish they'd reinforce that area on all sneakers. They did in the 70s. Support the sole is stiff and well padded. Again, I'm not running in these so if that is your primary use then refer to a runner's review. For everyday use these feel really supportive. The back heel is low enough so it won't rub causing any blisters. The sole is thick and overall the shoe is very comfortable. And I say that even with my current injury. I've been able to ditch the sexy ortho shoes and heal in these. Overall, I plan to buy a few more pairs in the coming months if this review holds up.

Are usually love the shoes but I think this one was defective because on the heel cup the support does not go all and it jabs into the back of my heel all day long, my last pair did not do this so I am very disappointed. Otherwise, these shoes are awesome but I wish that they weren t defective, my window has closed and I m not able to return them.

I have had every issue under the sun with my feet bunions, stress fractures, etc. Asics have always been the only brand of running shoe that allow me to run comfortably and for long distances without discomfort. This is their neutral shoe and even though I have high arches I prefer this shoe combined with my superfeet inserts to their high support shoe. Highly recommend for serious runner women with foot issues.

I got these shoes 3 months ago and they do not hold up at all. The fabric completely ripped in the back of the inside so now there is a hard plastic that dig into your heel and gives blisters. I have worn these to walk and do at home workouts so nothing to insane and they have not held up at all.
Good arch heel support for workouts. Also, cute and a good price on top of it. Will definitely buy again!

Super cute shoes. Really comfy sole but not so squishy that it still offers support when needed. All of my other shoes I own are size 9 - I read the reviews on this and ordered a 1 2 size up - really glad I did. Toes hit exactly where they should - so glad I checked here first. Maybe its because I don't like to pull my laces super tight but I feel like the laces are short - I mean I can tie them and they stay but there isn't much to spare - and I have rather narrow feet. The size being off slightly and the laces are really the only reason I didn't give a full 5 stars - otherwise they are great.
So happy with this purchase. Colors are great and could instantly feel all the support. Needed new shoes for bunions
I work in a warehouse on concrete floors I ve wore every brand tried so many different shoes this is my 1st pair of ASICS I m inlove with them! The support and comfort has help me in so many ways!

I ordered my first pair 2 years ago and they were so perfect that I ordered another pair right away . I saw last week that they were still available so I ordered another pair. I am glad I could still get them. Great shoes.
I deliver the mail Ian these shoes, makes my feet a whole lot happier than those postal issue Frankenstein shoes.
Very comfortable for stability. Great support for people who are prone to get plantar fasciitis. I have 2 pair of these shoes. I stand all day and my feet never hurt.

I thought it was just me whose sneakers had a hole in the fabric that formed after just two months but now I am seeing others with the same complaint. I have worked out for years and this has never happened to another pair of sneakers. Love the fit and comfort but will not be purchasing ASICS again
Worn these for running, long walks, and even a few hikes for about a month now. Very comfortable, no blisters, and great support. Would recommend

UPDATE After having and wearing these shoes for a little bit I m in love with them they are comfy like my other ASICS and are eye catching for sure. I originally felt like they were a bit cramped but I think it was the gel insole. Once I started walking around more it was not as crammed. Changed to a 5-star rating because on comfort and overall look. I just received mine today. Lemme say that I love ASICS and have always doted on how comfortable they are. I d wear my last pair all the time and they were awesome. I haven t really broken mine in since they were received today. But right off the bay after opening the box they seemed off. They don t look authentic to me in quality unless ASICS has went down hill. I ordered a full size up normally a size 6 and ordered a 7 and they fit insanely snug to my feet. I m not sure a sock will fit in there. I do have high arches though so maybe that s the problem? They are super cute and that s why I bought them. But I m questioning if I should ve bought them straight from ASICS. One thing that stood out most to me is that the pattern on the inside looks choppy on the edges. Not professional. I posted pics. I will come back and update my review in a couple weeks. And I will likely go buy this model directly from ASICS so I can compare.

I'm embarrassed to say this is the first new pair of sneakers I've bought in at least three years. Over the past 6 months or so, I developed plantar fasciitis. I've tried stretching, special socks, CBD oil, to no avail...but ever since I've started wearing these shoes, my feet have felt better than they have in a long time! I wouldn't say these are the most attractive or sleek shoes, but they feel like I'm walking on clouds. Great price, great product.
I have gotten five pairs of these shoes, this is the first time in the gray color. Very comfortable and sturdy. I work out in them all the time.

I'm trying to use the treadmill every day but I was getting sore feet from cheap sneakers. These did well in my searches, weren't crazy expensive, and aren't ugly. Out of the box they appear very well made. Lightweight, firmly structured but still flexible and breathable, thick soft footbed, and what looks like a cotton lining inside the upper. Frankly, as a lifelong wearer of inexpensive sneakers, I was amazed at how supportive and comfortable these were. I find it a bit annoying that I have to open the laces wide to get them on, but I figured that was part of getting this nice, supportive fit. The actual reason I dropped a star is because the back of the heel is too high. It rubs and creates sore spots. I added inserts to raise my feet up in the shoes - it's a shame because I really liked the feel of the footbed. Even with the inserts the back of the heels land a little high, but I haven't developed actual blisters. Just another data point to consider if you're looking at these sneakers.
