representative_reviews.text: Difficult to get on. Sole on a dry tile floor is a slick as ice. Pattern in footbed left blisters on the bottom of my foot. Worst shoe I have ever worn.
There is a seam in the center of the heel strap. One is fine but the other is very coarse and it hurts.

I have been buying only Keen Targhee boots and Newport Sandals for 12 years, and have owned several pairs of each - even though expensive, they are great quality and the most comfortable footwear I have found to date, especially if you have wide feet. I just got a new pair of these last fall, and they do not feel like the former pairs that I have owned - they do not seem to have the same arch support, and they make my feet hurt, given that I am on my feet much of the day. I am really disappointed, and am going to be trying the very similar Teva sandals now, which are not only less expensive, but are the best rated, so I hope they have been support.

I have three issues with this sandal. First, you need to use both grip loops to slip the sandal onto your feet which is good. The issue here is that the rear strap on one of the sandals broke on my second time putting them on. The second issue is that, unless I wear socks, the stitching rubs my Achilles tendon and causes severe pain and irritation after just a short period of time. Lastly, there is a pressure on the outside of my foot near the midfoot.
left shoe is defective hurts toes to wear pl ease app0rove and issue return instructions never had issue with this shoe in past. not first time buyer. first time on line.
very uncomfortable sandals, have tried to break them in but that isnt happening. Best reason I've experienced to try on shoes before purchasing.

These are meant to be adventure shoes sandals. Worked great on dry surfaces but when hiking through streams, rivers and wet rocks they have no grip. We slipped and fell several times unlike other adventure shoes sandals I ve owned that cost much less.

I don t like what I would call, bait and switch The primary pic posted for the ad was the pic that shows a whiteish stipe at the top of the sole, but the completely blackened sole pic was also posted as alternate pics I did think that the whiteish stripe added a nice contrast between the uppers and the sole, I ll have to think on whether to return these or not, and of course they re out of these in my size

I wear size 11 and have gone thru 2 pairs of Keens and loved them. When the heel begins to show wear I order another pair, they last about two, two and a half years, when I received them I put them on immediately upon arrival and to my disappointment they were about a half size too small. They went back today. I don't know why they shrunk the shoe but they did. Hey keen can you tell me what you've done to deliver a shoe that is different? I will attempt to reorder in the hopes that this was just a fluke. If in the event they deliver the shoe that is fitting the same way as the pair I just returned, I'm done with Keens forever unless they prove they can maintain quality control on their product.

This product is okay except for the fact that it catches my little toe and causes considerable damage to it. Unfortunetly by the time I relized the problem my return of the product had expired so I am stuck with a pair of shoes I cannot wear.

Although these are pretty comfortable, they are poorly made. I bought these to replace an older pair which I had to reglue numerous times and found them already letting go near the toe box. I think I will try another manufacturer of this type of shoe. I do own a pair of Keen hike shoes and they are fine. They fail at the assembly of this type of shoe. I'm sending these back.

I have been wearing Keen sandals for 15 years. I've never had a problem until now. I a wear size 13 men's shoe. I ordered a size 14 M in this sandal. They run small. The new sandals are too narrow. They rub against the sides of my feet. With regret, I am returning them.

It s a hard sandle to wear and I can t imagine wearing them without socks, they are not very comfortable at all and I ve worn them nonstop for a month. I ve got 15 sandles that feel better than these. The looks are spot on and are great, the bottom of the sole is great. They just hurt my feet at times and there s no real cushion in them so think on that before a purchase. I hate complaining but it s the experience I ve gotten with these.

We ordered the size he usually gets in shoes. This would have been his 2nd pair. He wears them pretty hard. When one of the back straps pulled away from the back heal of his old pair, he asked me to order another pair just like it. Got on line like a dutiful wife and found them on Amazon. They came within a couple of days. We are in the middle of summer and these were his go to shoes. He had already thrown his old in the garbage because his new were coming. When he tried them on, he literally couldn t get his foot into them. He has a high arch but his old shoes were fine. Supposedly the same shoes, same size. Even accounting for stretching out a little, these shoes would not have stretched that much! We returned them. Luckily the garbage men hadn t come. I superglued the strap back in on his old pair. I actually called Keen. They seem not to make them any bigger wider .
Sorry... if you have wide feet don't buy these. Keen used to be wide as a standard, don't know why they changed, but I won't buy another pair.
I am a lifetime KEEN customer!! I have three sets of KEEN Hiking Boots and two pair of KEEN sandals. All VERY COMFORTABLE TO WEAR with great arch support. I think they are the BEST!!

I have had these sandals for about 15 years. I wear the soles out-- it takes 4-5 years. The soles wear smooth the leather uppers show a nice warn look after 5 years . I am in Florida and wear them 90 of the time. Lots of sun and water. No issues. I prefer the leather version not the 'H2' with the nylon uppers. The leather fits better after break-in. They get wet almost every day and I bake them dry in the hot sun. I don't know how they treat the leather to withstand this abuse but it's done right. The liner material inside the leather does not seem to wear much. With extensive walking the heel bed does get somewhat compressed -- another reason for me 4-5 years is about it. I weigh about 200 pounds. I also wear them on the bike over 5000 miles year with good results. The soles dig into the pedals for good grip. However if you wear them for years and soles wear down they also age and get harder so the grip diminishes over time. I wear a size 10.5 and always buy size 11 for these sandals. They are worth the extra cost. I wear them with socks which works for me. Some of my bike friends wear them without socks and say they are fine. I kayak with them and like the underwater grip on slippery surfaces-- rocks, logs, mossy submerged stuff. And your toes are safe in these tuff environments.
Great sandal - waterproof- comfy! Well made, decent arch support. Will be perfect for hanging around the lake this summer.
these are very comfortable and support my feet and toes. I am type 1 diabetic so I have to take care of my feet these are great

As a hiker not a trail walker , I was hoping these would provide the support and comfort needed. Support was fine but my feet hurt after just a mile. They are well made and attractive but won't work for serious hiking.

Hands down the best sandles I've ever had. I can walk in them all day. The soles are tough, you can hardly feel rocks through them. The toe cap keeps your toes well protected. The arch support and stability are my favorite features no foot, knee, nor back pain. I highly recommend this product.

I deal with plantar fasciitis and finding comfortable casual shoes is a chore, especially online. I took a shot with the Keen brand and could not be more satisfied. No pain or discomfort even after wearing them for hours while spending most of that time on my feet. These are worth the price and look good too. Quite pleased.

These comfortable and long lasting shoes are part sandal part hiking boot part water shoe there s just nothing like them! They have a very comfortable fit and you could walk for hours once you break them in.

My husband absolutely loves these and says they are extremely comfortable and supportive. He wore them for hours walking on the beach, rocks, and a many other terrains. They seem to be well built and look like they will hold up well.
I was looking for sandals with arch support and these really seem to fit the bill. They are comfortable and seem like they will last for a while. I'm very pleased.
A little warmer on the feet but offers some protection. If you want cool summertime sandals, pick Keen other options.
Great indoor outdoor sandals hiking shoes. Comfortable enough to wear all day, rugged enough to take on hiking trails

Very comfortable from the first time wearing the shoes. A little difficult to slip on at first but use the finger loop on the tongue of shoe and on the back of the shoe which will assist the effort. Great price from Amazon.

Lost my keens on a trip this spring... Bought this pair before a trip to Europe with miles of walking 100 miles , after the third day, they replaced my walking shoes in most situations. Great fit, great arch support, and protected my feet.

I love my KEEN Men's Newport Closed Toe Leather Sandals - this is probably my fourth pair. If you wear them ALL the time, I recommend replacing them yearly. The cushion seems to go out between 1 1.5 years with heavy use. They still work fine for YEARS, but with a less supportive cushion, they're not as good for all-day use. And this depends on use. I've used them at the four Disney Parks in Orlando and their two water parks - all day, all concrete walking, and the cushion is very important. I've walked on dirt rock in the Colorado Rocky Mountains and you can get away with older Keens and more worn cushion support. The great thing there is the closed toe around all the rocks. That being said, I'm still using Keens from Dec 2018 blue leather and March 2017 brown leather , and just got another pair of brown Keens sandals this Christmas Dec 2022

They seem to be very good sandals but beware of the sizing.

The only brand of sandal shoes my husband wears has never had an issue with fitting size. Had to return because they didn't fit like all the other Keen's of the same size. Unable to order next size up due to availability.

I bought my usual size 9 in Keen but these keen sandals are a different size 9 not much room for my toes. There is elastic where the shoes are laced and putting them on is a struggle, bottom line is these are tight fitting keen sandals.
the sizes run small. my foot is 12. all boots and shoes are 12. i ordered 13 for comfort and easily removed. however much to my dislike they are tight. so iguess ishould of ordered 2 sizes higher
These sandles run small. After ordering twice had to return both. Now I'm waiting over 10 days for refund. I don't recommend this product
This is very likely the last pair I would buy. Not the same quality shoes they started with, comes apart too soon.

I ordered these based on my last order, and they are not the same shoe, much narrower, and don't fit my feet. Very disappointed. I wear a wide, and my last order was wide, but it shows up in my past order list as this shoe. I realize now that 9 M doesn't mean 9 mens, but 9 medium. I should have caught this, but expected the Amazon past order descriptions to be accurate. Sadly, I didn't check these out before the return window closed, my fault, but very disappointed that I can no longer get the shoes I loved!
There is a seam in the center of the heel strap. One is fine but the other is very coarse and it hurts.

I was disappointed. I wore this brand and model for more than 10 years and was very pleased. Sadly, the sandals available through Amazon are very narrow. I have fairly wide feet and the sandals were extremely tight. I think even a person with medium width feet would find them tight. It was also difficult to size the length. I am an 11 1 2 and even 12 was too short.

The information stated to order your true size. I did and I could not even get the shoe on. I have had two pair in the past and these fit perfectly. Love the shoe. Wonder if these are being made somewhere else? Addendum Received the size 12, two sizes larger than normal and they fit well. I have worn them several days and am very pleased. Thanks.

I have several pairs of these sandals. I first tried on a pair in a store in my regular shoe size - 11. They were way too small very difficult to put on when I did manage to get them on, my big toe was wedged right up against the front. The next size up - 11.5 fit perfectly. What really surprised me was the width. I need a 4E shoe, which is extra wide. These sandals don't come in wide, but they are already wide the width was perfect. That almost never happens. I also like the fact that unlike open-toe sandals , these protect my toes very important for diabetes. And they don't have that "Gladiator" look they look like shoes, while providing more ventilation for feet that regular shoes do. There is a trick to putting these sandals on because of the design You have to pull them on in two places at the same time - the loop on the tongue and the other loop on the heel. And if you're wearing socks, a shoe horn on the heel helps.

Quality of construction is solid and good Keep in mind if you are a certain size, maybe best to order the next size up so you get enough toe room, as the closed toe tends to restrict toe room a little bit

Great Keen shoes. Fit perfectly. I purchased them one half size larger. The build quality is very good. Came in the original box. Brand new. I hike with them through the Rocky mountains. The last pair lasted three years.

Right out of the box, these babies fit perfectly. I have pretty wide feet, and these fit like a glove. Great quality, great price. I got these for under 50 because of the color, that they call 34 fairway 34 but is better described as Army Olive Drab. I don't mind the color, but it certainly isn't fashionable.

Great Sandals for guys with Big Feet. I wear size 13 Wide shoes, so I ordered the Size 14 and they are a great fit. They look great too!

Ordered the same size of this same model new one too small, had to return and go 1 full size larger to fit my foot. They appear to have changed sandal-makers and are reducing standard sizes slightly to save material cost my speculation only .
These shoes are almost perfect for my big foot. The description about this brand, is they are 1 2 size too small for most buyers. I agree they barely fit, any shorter I would return them.

this my 3rd pair of these shoes. When I'm working on the farm the solid toe helps keeps gravel and grass burrs from entering. They are my most comfortable wearing shoes. Wife won't let me wear them to church.
Very very happy with this product. Excellent quality. Excellent fit. I recommend these sandals to everyone!

I read the reviews and didn t listen yeah......mea culpe! . These really do run small and other reviewers really are correct. Thank goodness for Amazon s return policy.....I float somewhere b w 8 and 8.5.....I thought let me go for an 8.5.....way, way too small......I moved up to a 9 and did a couple of mid-distance walks and because my foot was not aligned properly at the heel I developed horrendous blisters....took a few days to clear up. Gave it one last go and tried a 9.5.....finally a decent fit!!! Took about 3 weeks of use to break them in as they are a very well-built shoe alternatively it could be that these shoes broke my feet in!!! . So a good shoe that fits well when you get the correct size but listen to the reviews..... definitely size up....will take a bit to break in but once you do a solid shoe that will pay a while.

I have a 10EE size foot and have problems finding sandals like these anywhere until I ran across this. Great fit, good support and the ribbed bottom gives a nice, relaxing message to the feet while wearing them. Highly recommend these sandals!

When I stand in a shoe measuring device my foot measures 11.5 , but I ve always bought size 12 . Knowing that most reviews were saying that the Keen Newport ran 1 2 to a full size smaller, I concur that the sandal ran a full size to small and I ended up buying a full size larger size 13 mens Keen Newport sandal. Noting all shoe dimensions fit perfectly with the exception to the lenght. In my opinion.

very uncomfortable sandals, have tried to break them in but that isnt happening. Best reason I've experienced to try on shoes before purchasing.

I really wanted to be one of the many who enjoy this shoe it is leather, has a cushioned foot bed and designed just the way I like a man's sandal. Unfortunately, there is stitching on the inside of the sandal that can dig deeply into the side of the foot. I am thankful that I used the "try before you buy" I returned them for a larger size to see if the difference would eliminate the problem, but it did not. I had read other reviews that expressed the same experience I just hoped that I would not be one of them, but I was. I wish that the company will consider re-working the interior stitching so that others like myself can enjoy this shoe.

In my experience Keen has continued to make worse products. I had a pair of Newports around 10 years ago and they were great. Now I have tried different sandals and styles but every single time either the glue starts giving out within 6 months or the sizes and shape of each sandal is so different that it's uncomfortable. I would appreciate it if Keen would start paying more for production costs to make a quality product again.

Been buying the brown leather bison for over 30 years. Used to be, including my last pair which I bought about 3 years ago far superior to anything else in its class of sandal which is why I didn't mind paying upwards to 100 for them. This pair which is the exact same size I've been ordering for all these years we're running small and narrower and I could tell the workmanship was not as good even though at retail they're about 140 which is not what I paid for these because these were quote unquote seconds returns but like brand new. Much narrower and smaller than my last four pairs. I usually get up to 3 years with these and use my old ones as my kayak or beach sandals. Have only had for about a month and can already see the stitching is wearing more than my previous pairs by a lot. I realize everything is going up price wise but at 140 retail these are not up to Snuff. It is too bad because previously I have told everyone I know that these sandals even though very expensive were worth the price I no longer feel that way I will be looking at other alternatives on my next purchase. I can see Corners being cut for a sandal that sells for less than half the price but once again at the retail price these sell for you should be able to get the same quality sandal that they were putting out just 6 years ago. Can no longer recommend and will be looking at competitors but I don't know what else is out there that will be better quality for about the same money or less. Also have a pair of Keen boots that I really enjoyed so not quite sure if my next pair will be Keen or another brand.

I have three issues with this sandal. First, you need to use both grip loops to slip the sandal onto your feet which is good. The issue here is that the rear strap on one of the sandals broke on my second time putting them on. The second issue is that, unless I wear socks, the stitching rubs my Achilles tendon and causes severe pain and irritation after just a short period of time. Lastly, there is a pressure on the outside of my foot near the midfoot.

I've had a lot of Keens, between my two boys and wife we have at least 8 pairs here in the house currently. Over the years I have loved these sandals and wear them all over and they hold up pretty well. My comment on this last order is that they are too small, I had to order a full size too big to even get them to fit properly, and for some reason, they are coming in way narrower than they used to be. So they are tight side to side even when I get a size too big. Amazon's easy exchange and return process made it fairly painless to get them replaced.

This product is okay except for the fact that it catches my little toe and causes considerable damage to it. Unfortunetly by the time I relized the problem my return of the product had expired so I am stuck with a pair of shoes I cannot wear.

My husband has been using Keen H2 sandals for over 10 years. He has been eyeing the leather version for several years and finally decided to try them. They are a sad disappointment and don't fit the same as other H2s. The stitching on the inside of one of the sandals was inconsistent and didn't feel right. These will be returned and he'll pick up another non-leather H2 Keen to replace it.

Although these are pretty comfortable, they are poorly made. I bought these to replace an older pair which I had to reglue numerous times and found them already letting go near the toe box. I think I will try another manufacturer of this type of shoe. I do own a pair of Keen hike shoes and they are fine. They fail at the assembly of this type of shoe. I'm sending these back.

I have had these sandals for about 15 years. I wear the soles out-- it takes 4-5 years. The soles wear smooth the leather uppers show a nice warn look after 5 years . I am in Florida and wear them 90 of the time. Lots of sun and water. No issues. I prefer the leather version not the 'H2' with the nylon uppers. The leather fits better after break-in. They get wet almost every day and I bake them dry in the hot sun. I don't know how they treat the leather to withstand this abuse but it's done right. The liner material inside the leather does not seem to wear much. With extensive walking the heel bed does get somewhat compressed -- another reason for me 4-5 years is about it. I weigh about 200 pounds. I also wear them on the bike over 5000 miles year with good results. The soles dig into the pedals for good grip. However if you wear them for years and soles wear down they also age and get harder so the grip diminishes over time. I wear a size 10.5 and always buy size 11 for these sandals. They are worth the extra cost. I wear them with socks which works for me. Some of my bike friends wear them without socks and say they are fine. I kayak with them and like the underwater grip on slippery surfaces-- rocks, logs, mossy submerged stuff. And your toes are safe in these tuff environments.
Love the last pair but it was falling apart for a few years on stitching. This one fits well and stitching looks like it will be more durable than the last pair.
I keep wanting to go to the nylon version of this, but the stiching always fails. This model just keeps going. Comfortable and keeps those toes protected.

Quality of construction is solid and good Keep in mind if you are a certain size, maybe best to order the next size up so you get enough toe room, as the closed toe tends to restrict toe room a little bit
Used for hiking and trail blazing. Keeps are outstanding and really last. They are well worth the money.

Great shoes. Just what I needed for the north coast outdoors. From rocks to rivers yo forests and back, these shoes really hold up very well. There is a short break in period that s not so bad. I will be purchasing another pair.

I've been hooked on Keen sandals for about 7 years now which is how long my last pair was functional . I was most impressed at their rugged construction while maintaining that professional beach bum look. Styles change and, though I wanted exact duplicates of my last pair, I had to "settle" for these. Very satisfied.
Great shoe and better than the H2, which has a stitched connection near the heel and the stitching comes undone , this one is all one piece of leather
great quality sandal, my first pair lasted over 3 years before I replaced them. they are still in okay enough shape too that I plan to donate them. Solid footwear.

This was my 3rd pair of this same model over the last dozen or so years. My first pair are still usable but the sole has been worn smooth. My last pair are still doing ok, but one of the leather straps is separating from the sole. For 8 years of good service, that's just fine. The uppers on the new pair seem just a little snug, but the sole is just right for my size. I actually like having the elastic uppers being snug since I know they will and already have loosen up. These are my favorite footwear from May to October for outside use, and well beyond for inside use. They last a long time, are comfortable, look great and are a great value for the cost. I'm a loyal and happy customer. Recommended buy for sure.

I've been a Keen user for around 12 years. This time I stepped up and purchased this shoe due to it's 'leather' strapping features, rather than nylon. I wondered if it would hold up around water and it does very well. Initially as with my other Keens, they tend to fit tight when new, but, after wearing them to 'break in' they have become more comfortable. For me it took around 10 15 hours of intermittent use before they felt good. Unfortunately, they are not made in U.S.A.

These are one of the most comfortable pair of shoes I've ever purchased. They are well constructed, protect the toes yet let in plenty of air, so they are cool. I will buy a few more pairs of these. I switched from TEVA, which I have found that the quality has dropped quite a bit over the years. I went through 3 pairs of TEVA sandals last year when the glue just came apart and the straps pulled out. Not like the old TEVA's. But these Keen sandals are built like a truck. We'll see if the glue fails as it is extremely humid where I live. But sandals should not fall apart in a year.
I love keen products. I already had the fabric version and wanted to have the leather ones. Now it is like a don t need any other shoe but my keens and my running shoes, that s it!

Love these shoes - buy a pair every year and the new ones become 34 dress 34 shoes, last year's become 34 everyday 34 shoes and the next pair down becomes garden work shoes. Great support and great comfort.

We traveled to France and Spain during the first two weeks of September, 2019. I was determined to pack light and only wanted to take one pair of shoes. I picked these. I ordered them about three weeks before our departure date so I'd have time to break them in, and, if necessary, find a different pair of shoes. No need for that nonsense the Keen's were all I could have hoped for. Temperatures while we were there ranged from the mid 80s F to the mid 40s F . On warm days, these were plenty cool enough, and on cool days they comfortably accommodated socks. The closed toe and the leather looked respectable enough to fit in even in nicer restaurants and attractions, but they nevertheless dried quickly when we encountered rain or other water hazards. The grippy sole kept me sure-footed on an 8 mile excursion down a gravel hillside though there were a couple of stops to dump small rocks , and there was plenty of cushioning for many, many miles of walking through cities and towns. Perhaps the best travel purchase I made. I continued wearing them back home until the snow started sticking. Great pair of shoes.

representative_reviews.text: I bought these because of the wonderful reviews. I have plantar fasciitis. They hurt my feet so bad. I m returning them. The leather was hard and it looked cheap. Very disappointing.

These shoes eat my socks. Unfortunately I couldn't have known this before wearing them, now I cannot return them. I don't know what causes this but it's definitely annoying. Doesn't matter the type of socks I wear, they slouch down quickly and bunch up into the toe of the shoe. Also, I'm not getting the arch support I would expect. I was really hoping for a quality shoe with the favorable ratings but alas I'm disappointed.
I have always been a fan of Clarks shoes but not this time. There is no arch support or cushion on the inside. Very uncomfortable would not recommend them.
These shoes are not a wide, which I ordered. They are extremely tight and kill my feet. I would return them, but the box was damaged.

They are pretty nice. Run real narrow and low instep. they aren't TSA Pre approved, meaning they have a metal shaft and require you to remove them even if you have PRE. they seem to be pretty slide proof in the restaurants i work in. I had to have them stretched for 25 dollars and I still can't wear them for long periods of time... i'm trying to work them in slowly, very narrow. I had trouble getting them at first, not sure if delivery service was the issue or their shipping department but when i called them to follow up on it they had a pair out to me immediately. Certainly responsive to my call. Because i haven't had a chance to wear them all the time i'm uncertain how they will hold up, however, for 8 hours on my feet they seem stand walk comfortable, good cushion but as i mentioned the narrowness is an issue and begins to hurt.

I purchased twice, and had to return both pairs due to a sharp spike that presses against the heel of the foot from the insole. You can clearly see it raising through the insole cushion. A significant defect that was in all 4 shoes, same location. It's really a shame since they are such cute shoes, and fit wide width. Unless you like walking on nails, pass on these.

These boots were supposed to be very comfortable for all-day wear. However, I wore them to work for the first day and after about 2 - 3 hours on my feet, my feet were hurting and very uncomfortable. I couldn't wear them to work the next day, as I'm on my feet all day and can't be in pain from my feet. Maybe they might be more comfortable with more cushioned insoles and arch support. I wasn't happy with this purchase.

I bought a pair back in 2019, they were great. Fit great, never gave me a blister, were great on my back neck feet, but now must have a different make since. My 2019 pair were just wonderful for my job. I worked as a cocktail server and was always running around. The 2019 pair lasted until April of 2021, so I bought another pair. I am now bartending and serving at a nicer restaurant starting back in February of 2021, and don't feel like I am running around as much, and much to my surprise the new pair have already broken down. I had spoken to the company about my dilemma and they reimburse me and I did buy another pair because they are great all around. However, this new pair is falling apart and it is the very end of November. I'm looking into other shoes, but I will buy another pair in the meantime. I don't know why they have changed the product because the quality initially was great, but now the shoes are completely different. Good luck to the people in the food and beverage industry, the struggle is real on finding quality nice looking shoes.

I have had several pair of Clarks work shoes in the past. They are basically my go-to shoe for work because of comfort and quality. I bought this pair in August and started wearing them about October November when it started getting too cold for flats. I love the look, fit, and comfort. Unfortunately, though, the quality of the shoe is very poor. The toes dent in all the time with any sort of touching to them. The black also scuffed up really badly both on the toes and heels. I work in a school and move around a lot on the floor, which is what scuffed them. I have never had this problem with any other of my Clarks, so I am unsure and disappointed why this happened with these. I've only actually been wearing them for about a month.
I read all the reviews and everything, I ordered and was excited! These hurt my feet so bad that I was in tears at the end of my shift !!!

Absolutely loved the shoes the first time I wore them. I just wore for the second time today and every step I take, each shoe makes a loud squeaking noise. They are just as loud on carpet as on tile which means to me it is something inside the shoe making the noise.

These are not non slip the wide it to tight and even left unzipped my feet are killing me. I work in a restaurant and almost fall multiple times a day in these. They are cute and may be fine for an office or mild wear but do not recommend if you have to be on your feet for more than a hour or two

I love these shoes and they are very comfortable but the right shoe does not fit right. The left shoe fits perfect but the right shoe is too big! I added a pad and thicker sock but my foot still slips when I walk so I have to return them. I debated this a couple of weeks only wearing them once and decided on principle to return them because shoes can be made correct and the fact that right feet are bigger than left makes this is bizarre.
The box was broke, they were the wrong shoes all together!!! They look like they have been worn!!!!! I would give no stars if that was an option!!
I actually returned these, but they looked and felt great. They didn t work for me because the foot bed was too hard under the cushion and I am on my feet for over eight hours a day.

I work in a hospital and was tired of wearing sneakers or clogs. I had a pair of Clarke flip flops that I just loved so thought I'd give these a shot. They are almost as comfy as sneakers! I wore them all day and my feet still felt great at the end of the day. I highly recommend these shoes!
Not alot of arch support but wide enough in the toe area for my flat wide feet. Fits as expected. Very cute shoes.

I needed a decently fashionable shoe for work that was supportive due to plantar fasciitis. This fit the bill! I had to get a wide shoe which is unusual for me, but otherwise fit as expected. Cushiony enough to wear comfortably all day
This shoe is seriously amazing. I'm on my feet most of the day and have had zero discomfort or soreness. These are more comfortable than some flats I've worn.
Super comfortable! Can wear all day, with a lot of walking and standing and feet don't hurt or get tired.

I got these for work in an office that could match most of my outfits. I don t feel like I needed to break them in at all. No adjustment period and no pain. Good arch support. I walked 0.9 of a mile home in them today and it was fine!

I m in the food and beverage industry so I m constantly on my feet. I, also have Achilles tendinitis and these are the only pair of shoes that get me through the day. They are very comfortable. Just need more arch support.

They are so versatile they look great with casual dress as expected, but they really dress up a pair of jeans and just about everything! When I ordered mine I read all the reviews and took their advice to order a 1 2 to 1 size up from my usual- since I usually take a 9 or 9.5 I ordered these in a 10 and they fit perfect. Especially if you're like me and wear flats most of the time the narrow toe combined with the mid-heel can make it feel like your toes are cramped in- but with the extra room half a size larger provides, I never had this problem. In fact, over the winter I found they fit fine even with a pair of socks med. thick, not 34 trouser socks 34 . When these give out, not that they show any signs of it, I am definitely ordering more- service was excellent, arrived 2days after ordering.

I think it is safe to say that this shoe is the most comfortable shoe I have ever owned. As soon as I tried them on I knew they were keepers. I have high arches and this shoe provides just the perfect amount of support. The sole is well padded and comfortable to walk on all surfaces. The shoe looks exactly like the photos. I m happy I bought them.

Need to start wearing a lower heeled shoe but did not want a complete flat. These look like an ankle boot, zipper open close for easy on and off, feels like I am walking on a pillow, very squishy and oh so comfortable Best buy ever.

I love these shoes! I have a very high arch and I need shoes that have extra support. I also want something stylish because most comfortable shoes are ugly! These are both comfortable and attractive, I couldn t ask for more!!!
I m a fan of this brand and I m on my feet a lot and walk my property a lot so comfort is a must. This brand always lasts and is a great value on how long they last

I usually like the Clarks brand. The shoes are pretty, but after wearing them for a couple of hours, they just aren't as comfortable as previous pairs.I am not sure why, but they don't feel as padded or something? They aren't uncomfortable like you want to take them off, but they won't be my go to pair for all day walking either. I was hoping for super comfortable, but these are average.

The heal is not too high very stable, Clarks is always such a great fit but this does run a bit large which only means I can wear a thin knee sock w the narrow width instead of a nylon knee-high . Plenty of room.

The day after I got these shoes I wore them to work. I stand more than I sit for my job and work an average of a 8.5 9.0 hour day. These shoes have been comfortable from the beginning and there wasn't a break in period. I have higher arches so I put my arch supports in them and they have been perfect so far. I hope they last longer than a season unlike previous shoes I have bought.

This pair of Clark's is at least a half inch shorter than another pair of this brand that I already own. Also runs more narrow M Width . The leather is extremely stiff the shoe was not at all comfortable. Cute style, but quality has gone way down.

Very durable! My last pair lasted 4 years of wearing 5 days a week. Easy on and off with zipper on the side. A very quiet heel. Well made shoe. It does not disappoint.

When I first tried these on, the toe box felt a tad tight, but being leather that didn't last long. These are so comfortable! I'm usually wearing sneakers, so am very happy with these shoes

My last two add a little cushion on the inside of the shoe where your heel sits.

I get frustrated with looking for shoes and usually don't find much selection and don't have luck in what I find. I will need to think of what sock or sheer to wear with them as they come in right along close to the upper part of the foot, and I think a sock would be bulky there. Heel looks nice showing from jeans or slacks. I am eager to wear these, for the good fit and what I perceive as good quality.

I needed a decently fashionable shoe for work that was supportive due to plantar fasciitis. This fit the bill! I had to get a wide shoe which is unusual for me, but otherwise fit as expected. Cushiony enough to wear comfortably all day

I purchased twice, and had to return both pairs due to a sharp spike that presses against the heel of the foot from the insole. You can clearly see it raising through the insole cushion. A significant defect that was in all 4 shoes, same location. It's really a shame since they are such cute shoes, and fit wide width. Unless you like walking on nails, pass on these.

I'm totally unhappy with these shoes went in to return them UNWORN, only to discover that there was a "return by date" that that I could not find anywhere on the order page, nor had I seen it before ordering the shoes. I had had the shoes about 6 wks, during which time I'd been away on vacation part of the time. I had ordered a second pair at the same time from apparently another supplier, they are accepting that pair UNWORN back. I'm stuck with a pair of shoes I may never be able to wear. I'm most unhappy and will never order from this supplier again!! GRRRRR!!!

I love Clark's shoes boots. With the exception of one pair of mud boots, all the shoes boots I own are Clark's . What has changed... I think it is having added an awesome comfy insole but NOT having bothered to re-engineer the shoe to raise it the 1 8-1 4 inch to make up the needed additional room the insole takes up... The result, my heel slides up and down way to easily in the back of the shoe while my toes are scrunched in the front Please fix this Clark

Unfortunately I have to rate this experience as horrible The shoes arrived late last week and I decided to wear them to work today and when I got to work this morning and put my glasses on I noticed substantial scratching and imperfections in the leather on the right side of the right shoe. I should have inspected the shoes upon receiving them but because of Clark's excellent reputation - I own several pair - I didn't and I'll be returning them today.

There can be no way these are true Clarks shoes. I've been purchasing Clarks shoes for years. My line of work has me on my feet all 10 hours of my shift each day. As I stated there is NO WAY these are leather and they are extremely uncomfortable. I would send them back but my partner accidently threw the box away, so I guess I'm stuck with these. What a waist! Perhaps I will take them to the Clarks store and have them check it out. If I find that these are fake, I will be contacting everyone in my power to not have this happen to anyone else again!
I actually returned these, but they looked and felt great. They didn t work for me because the foot bed was too hard under the cushion and I am on my feet for over eight hours a day.

I work in a hospital and was tired of wearing sneakers or clogs. I had a pair of Clarke flip flops that I just loved so thought I'd give these a shot. They are almost as comfy as sneakers! I wore them all day and my feet still felt great at the end of the day. I highly recommend these shoes!
Got it for my daughter her first pair lasted over 3 years !! she s on her feet, her whole shift at work !! She likes the look, and the comfort !! And it s good quality !! Aloha

These are currently my favorite non doc martin shoes- I am 5'9 34 but love the extra boost the heel on these gives me. They are so versatile they look great with casual dress as expected, but they really dress up a pair of jeans and just about everything! When I ordered mine I read all the reviews and took their advice to order a 1 2 to 1 size up from my usual- since I usually take a 9 or 9.5 I ordered these in a 10 and they fit perfect. Especially if you're like me and wear flats most of the time the narrow toe combined with the mid-heel can make it feel like your toes are cramped in- but with the extra room half a size larger provides, I never had this problem. In fact, over the winter I found they fit fine even with a pair of socks med. thick, not 34 trouser socks 34 . When these give out, not that they show any signs of it, I am definitely ordering more- service was excellent, arrived 2days after ordering.

Everything is great with these boots. However, after wearing them for a few months now the right shoe sole is squeaking loudly with each step. Maybe needs higher quality materials. Other than this, the boots fit and looks great.

Clark's shoes for me have been on target every time. Every shoe that I purchased have never had to be broken in, they just fit perfectly. Clark's have now become my "GO TO" choice and I hope it continues.

This shoe is beautiful but they hurt my feet as though I had been standing in 4" heels all day I used to do that It took a day and then some for the pain to dissipate. Now I am not able to return a worn shoe, so it is going to Goodwill.

Great quality. Very comfortable. I wanted heels that I could wear with socks and these are perfect. If you're wanting to wear hose with them they may be a bit loose. I ordered a 9.5 wide and they fit perfectly.
Everything about this ankle boot is perfect. I've been wearing Clark shoes for 40 years. They're AMAZING
Great work shoes, especially if you stand all day. Loose fit, but doesn't feel like they will fall off

I was concerned when I took these out of the box because the leather is stiff and the edges around the top are thin. I thought they would cit my feet around the ankle as others have. But I gave them a try and they've been very comfortable, even after 9 hours. After a half dozen wears now, leather does not look scratched or worn. These are great.

I currently own these shoes and they are one of few I can comfortably wear as an elementary teacher and still wear "classically" professional clothes. My current ones are old and worn out but I couldn't find them in stores or on the Clarks website so excite to find here. They will need a kittle breaking in before they are the best shoe again.

I think it is safe to say that this shoe is the most comfortable shoe I have ever owned. As soon as I tried them on I knew they were keepers. I have high arches and this shoe provides just the perfect amount of support. The sole is well padded and comfortable to walk on all surfaces. The shoe looks exactly like the photos. I m happy I bought them.
I m a fan of this brand and I m on my feet a lot and walk my property a lot so comfort is a must. This brand always lasts and is a great value on how long they last

I purchased the brown and black pair after having the blue pair for months. These shoes are perfect for me to wear to work or going out with friends. They work with my pants and jeans. I have a high instep and these shoes give me the room I need to comfortably wear them.
I kept them but haven't worn them for any length of time yet. They are nicely made and feel comfortable when I tried them on.

design.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발의 디자인이 매력적이고 스타일리시하다고 반복적으로 언급하며, 편안함과 함께 시각적인 만족감을 제공합니다.

representative_reviews.text: I love these shoes! I have a very high arch and I need shoes that have extra support. I also want something stylish because most comfortable shoes are ugly! These are both comfortable and attractive, I couldn t ask for more!!!

Love these shoes! The double button detail on the side is super cute. So I usually get a size 8 for wearing thicker socks, but I wanted to wear these shoes with a thinner trouser sock or tights, so I bought a 7.5 and they fit perfectly. I have a high arch, and the inner sole is very comfortable with good support, while still being soft and forgiving. I could walk around in these all day even with the high heel. The leather is very nice, not too shiny and definitely not cheap looking as another reviewer said above. These will be very sharp with jeans and a blazer to dress up a casual look, and they would look very nice with a pencil skirt and tights or no-show socks. Was happy to catch Clarks for under 50- a good bargain for a nice name brand.

product_name: KEEN Women's Targhee 2 Mid Height Waterproof
