representative_reviews.text: I am an Army veteran with two bad feet with bones broken many times. My feet HURT. It is essential that I wear comfortable shoes. These are a joke on many levels. I thought long and hard about ordering these. Months. I didn't want to spring for another pair Lowa boots because of the price. BIG MISTAKE. I read review after review. I always read reviews with 1-3 stars because then I can discount those that are just picky or may have received something damaged etc. I finally settled on these thinking they looked good on the outside, waterproof, had all the things I was looking for. Again BIG MISTAKE. I was excited when they arrived yesterday. They are now back in the box ready for return. There is absolutely no comfort, cushioning, arch support or ankle support. Sure, they look great on, and if you plan on only wearing them while sitting, these are boots for you. I live on a horse ranch in Las Vegas. These weren't just for show, I needed them to hold up. If I had gone hiking in these I wouldn't have made it from the car to the trail! ZERO cushioning. You might as well be walking on the rubber sole. Even the insert looks nice and actually looks as if when you put the boot on your feet will go "aaahhhh." Negative. The minute I stood up and went from carpeting to hard flooring, to outside my feet were screaming. The insole says " Every step makes an impact, Consciously Created for a Better Environment." I don't give a fart about that. Why can't Keen or any company charging this price just make a darn shoe that is comfortable and cushioned with actual arch support. Just because the insole says arch support doesn't make it so. I am so sick of these companies with their "green" this and "conscious" that -- make a product that works and shut down your "wokeness" whatever THAT is! I will never buy Keen again. I should have bought the Lowa boots and just sucked up the price. They are the only boots that literally feel like they hug my heel, support my ankles, and have so much support and cushioning that I feel ashamed for going astray. I'm sorry Lowa. Keen, take your consciously created step monsters somewhere else, you're not getting another dime out of me.
Hurt my feet and I have a narrow foot. I know Keen is the best but boot was hard and no arch support. Rubbed my toes.

Ordered my standard size, 7.5, and they felt much too tight. By that I mean that the top of my big toe felt like it was hitting the top of the boot when I walked. Not wanting to get a blister under my toe nail, I returned the boot and replaced it with a size 8. In hindsight this wasn't a good decision as the boot stretched out quite a bit, such that my foot slipped around so much I got a blister. Bottom line is the length of the shoe was probably fine but the width was too loose in the bigger size when the shoe loosened up.

I had a wonderful pair of boots that died on my last hike, so I bought these based off reviews. I wear a size 9 in boots but my foot seems to float in these which causes rubbing when I hiked. The toe area is very large which might be part of the problem.

I LOVED the arch support but as I began to walk, 3 things became obvious 1. The heel structure caused me to land on the inside of my heel, rocking inward 2. The stitching and grommets along the top pressed painfully into the top of my feet and 3. Soles are too hard and cause pain in the ball of my foot. I had ample width room for my toes but too tight on the top. All it took was 20 minutes of wearing to discover this. I am returning, I am disappointed, and they hurt my feet terribly.

Don t buy if you do a lot of walking. I m a meter reader. I ve only had these for one month and the sole is separating already. I always buy keen brand, but these are uncomfortable and not a good quality. My feet start hurting after a couple of weeks and now the sole is coming off. Waste of money. The last pair I brought from Keen lasted 8 months. These are the worst ones I ve had.

I've worn these boots several times hiking long distances and always end up with very sore achy feet. I've added different insoles and worn thicker socks...still the same outcome. While going downhill, sometimes my toe will hit the front of the boot...which has plenty of room. If I tighten the laces to restrict movement of the foot forward in the boot, I end up feeling like the boot is too tight around the ankle and foot. I have other hiking boots that are much more comfortable. I just feel they don't provide the support my feet need. The grip is amazing on them though and I love the color. Maybe this particular style just doesn't work for me. I never have a problem with achey feet when I wear my Oboz or Merrells.

update 2020 tried another pair giving them the benefit of the doubt-maybe my first pair was a hiccup in factory production? NOPE! Same problem and even faster this time!! Not I can catch the lace of the opposite shoe while walking as the tread is falling off.. so near tripping periodically. Throwing these out! DO NOT BUY THEM THEY ARE NOT WORTH THE !!! Tread pealed off after less than 8 months of periodic use, and proper upkeep. Nothing extreme like mountain climbing. Mostly short walks in grassy fields or on dirt paths. Extremely disappointment with this product, for the price I'd expect it to last much longer.. everything is such junk now its ridiculous!

This is what an experienced hiker told me when she saw me slip during a very dangerous hike. I wondered why the entire hike up a mountain I could not keep from slipping. On the way down I could not trust my feet. I was wondering why I was being so clumsy, I am athletic and have done many difficult hikes, then I heard "YOu're wearing Keen's - they're so slippery!" I felt vindicated and then understood why I was having such a difficult time - at the same time, I felt worried for the 4 hour hike down. I had no idea that these good-looking boots were known for not having traction. They caused me so much anguish that I left them at the resort where I had been staying with a not for them to be donated to a shelter. I was not going to waste my time cleaning them and packing them. Waste of 114.00. Never again. I'll do better research next time.

I've worn Keen Targhee boots for many years, but had to return these because the sizing is different and they were painful in my forefoot even though they were long enough. Apparently they're narrower across the metatarsal arch than other Targhee styles. I formerly wore size 9.5, so I tried a 10 and still had the metatarsal arch pain. I returned them and got a different Targhee, the EXP mid, which has a different type of sole. The fit is good with the EXP.

I love Keen shoes. I ordered these to replace my old Keen hikers but was disappointed that Keen changed the material around the ankel to a rubber piece. They were very stiff and uncomfortable. I didn't want to risk hiking in them and being in pain so I returned them.

This is a nice-booking boot and looks very well-constructed. However, when I put my foot in, there was a significant rise in the footbed on the left outside portion of the left boot. There is a small rise in the right boot, but I could have lived with it. Unfortunately, the left boot was so uncomfortable I had to return the boots immediately. Very disappointed in this product.
My heel is too narrow for this particular boot. Ken is the best though and I have had 7 pairs that were each a perfect fit.

I bought these to replace a pair from around five years ago which had started to come apart on the sole. They are not comparable to the old pair. They look the same, but the comfort level is completely different. The old pair fit comfortably from the first wearing, and had a cushy insole and wide toe box. I ve had many Keen shoes, boots, steel toes and sandals, and they have always been comfortable. This pair has no arch support, a seam by the toe, hard, narrow toe box, and hard rubber-like insole. My feet hurt after wearing these, and I ve been wearing them off and on for over a month. I m so disappointed because my last pair of identical Keen hiking boots were my favorite hikers, and these suck. I feel like I wasted a lot of money. If this is what Keens are like now, maybe to save costs or whatever, I won t be buying again.
In less than a year the stitching in the toe box area started coming apart. Then a section of the tread on the outer sole area came unglued. Very disappointing.

Comfortable right out of box. Good arch support. Excellent ankle support. I ve owned Keen hiking boots previously, but got a size too small and couldn t return. I endured them for 3 years and now I upped to 1 2 size larger and they are perfects. I can see keeping these a long time.

Just returned from a 9 day hiking trip out west. I got these the day before we left so no 34 breaking them in 34 . I have plantar fasciitis in one foot and some lower back issues. These were THE MOST COMFORTABLE SHOES that I have. As good as my Asic tennis shoes. My feet did not hurt the whole trip. These are sturdy for climbing, jumping and walking. I could not be more pleased. They gripped well on slick rock as well as in sand.

Best hiking shoes I've ever owned. Now I chose them because they were said to be the best for bunions bone deformity and they definitely give me the room I need for that and quite a bit of cushion under the ball of the foot. But don't expect to just magically not be in pain after a hike. Maybe if there was even more cushion. I'll probably just pick up a little ball of foot hell cushion to throw in there. AWESOME AWESOME SHOE THOUGH. Especially if you have wide feet or want extra room around the the toe box area.

These are great boots. I broke them in on a 5 mile hike in Shenandoah National Park one mile of which was pretty serious rock scrambling. The boots had great traction on the rocks. We got caught in a downpour and had to walk two miles back to the car on a steep incline up wet rocks and I didn t slip at all. I wear a 7.5 or 8 and went with the 8 in these and they fit as expected.

I hiked the blue mountains in Jamaica with these boots. They provided great comfort, ankle support, and toe box space for swelling of feet. I usually have arch pain after walking an hour but these provided arch support for 4hrs. Hike took a total of 9.5hrs and was a total of 16miles long with altitude 7,600 to give you an idea of intensity. I wasn t able to break the shoes in before the trip but there was no need to do so! This Keen model was my favorite I ve tried others which were too stiff . I also recommend getting a half size bigger and getting good hiking socks.

If you suffer from painful metatarsal issues, these mids may be the answer you are seeking. I suffer from plantar fasciitis, degenerative changes in the metatarsal area as well as several other foot problems. Had no idea how I was going to get through the winter here in New England as I live in Birkenstock and Chaco sandals whenever the temps are above freezing and there isn't snow on the ground. Am grateful to have found the Keen Targhee line of boots as they do not cause painful pressure on the metatarsal region and also offer decent arch support. All other brands that I have tried cause immediate pain under the met heads. These boots are not highly cushioned and for me this is a very good thing. Only four stars due to the fact that the lace hooks at the top of the lacing system are plastic and not metal.
I walk daily on the sidewalks in my neighborhood and I wanted a firm shoe with good support for the hour walk during the winter months ahead. The shoe is what I need.

Great support, I hike a lot and like the protection I get from these. Excellent traction. All day comfort, I never feel like I can't wait to get out of my boots. The only downside I've experienced is that the outer layer of the sole starts coming off at about 2-2 1 2 years of use. Otherwise I'd still be on my first pair.
The cushioning in these shoes is excellent. I actually want to wear them just walking around our yard. Great shoes. Would buy again.

I have fasciitis plantar and walking anywhere felt insufferable. These boots have the support and cushioning that relieved me of my pain instantly by about 85 ! I am so happy w these boots I wear them when I m out and about and I ll be wearing them when I go camping!
These shoes are extremely comfortable. I'm on my feet 7 hours day, 3 days a week. I tried another brand for awhile but have come to these. Would recommend.

I am older and like to hike. This boot provides the comfort and ankle stabilization that I need. I have experienced immediate comfort with this boot. It is not too stiff or too soft. The break in period was minimal if anything. Happy New Year! Going out for a hike!

The Keen targhee2 was one of several shoes recommended by my podiatrist for osteoarthritis pain on top of foot and side of ankle. Note that the targhee2 provides better ankle support than the targhee3. So far it's helped a lot with stairs, driving, chores, etc

My first pair of Keen boots were ventilated and therefore softer, these are much stiffer but still comfortable. I need the ankle support on rocky hikes and Keen never fails. Great right out of the box and true to size. Shipping sucked but that s on Amazon not Keen
The outside arch is a little high for me but otherwise the boots are very comfortable and supportive. I like the way they look. I have bunions and they don t bother me in these boots.

size.issue_summary: 많은 구매자들이 사이즈가 너무 넓거나 좁아서 불편함을 겪고 있으며, 일반적인 사이즈보다 작게 나오는 경우가 많습니다.
size.strength_summary: 많은 구매자들이 넉넉한 발가락 공간과 완벽한 사이즈로 인해 편안함을 느끼고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: I was disappointed these were so wide and the toe was not the usual keen shape... seems to have lost the old keen fit. Possibly if I could order a narrow size these would still work, but I had to return them. Wish I'd taken a photo to share with you of this keen boot next to my old keen boot for you to see what I mean.
Hurt my feet and I have a narrow foot. I know Keen is the best but boot was hard and no arch support. Rubbed my toes.
My heel is too narrow for this particular boot. Ken is the best though and I have had 7 pairs that were each a perfect fit.

I've worn Keen Targhee boots for many years, but had to return these because the sizing is different and they were painful in my forefoot even though they were long enough. Apparently they're narrower across the metatarsal arch than other Targhee styles. I formerly wore size 9.5, so I tried a 10 and still had the metatarsal arch pain. I returned them and got a different Targhee, the EXP mid, which has a different type of sole. The fit is good with the EXP.

When ordered these hiking shoes, I was hoping they would fit my narrow feet, however, that was not the case. I am returning them in hopes of finding the perfect fit. It's been difficult because hiking shoes appear to run wide.

The nice boxy toe is deceptive because it's actually narrow. Keen shoes run small. I wear a size 8 but in this brand need an 8.5. I needed a 9 for this boot. I returned it because it was too narrow. For those with normal width or narrow feet these hiking boots should be fine. Some Keen shoes are wide enough. The variability across models is odd.

Ordered my standard size, 7.5, and they felt much too tight. By that I mean that the top of my big toe felt like it was hitting the top of the boot when I walked. Not wanting to get a blister under my toe nail, I returned the boot and replaced it with a size 8. In hindsight this wasn't a good decision as the boot stretched out quite a bit, such that my foot slipped around so much I got a blister. Bottom line is the length of the shoe was probably fine but the width was too loose in the bigger size when the shoe loosened up.

I was looking for something very similar to some Merrils that I had where they were very sturdy yet cushioned. My own fault for buying on line so close to the event when I needed these but I has to buy insoles to make these shoes tolerable. Also, they mention in many reviews that they run large so I got a half size larger but they were a little too big. The added insole usually take out the one it came with but did not helped some. I am disappointed that I have to keep them because I needed and wore them that day. If they were the proper size and had a better insole I would have loved them.

I loved that I didn't need to break these in, they were wide enough and super comfortable from the box. They fall apart very easily. The soles were shredded after one 4k in NHs whites. Not what I expected from a 130.00 boots.

All of the shoe sites touted this as some sort of marvel for people with bunions. Mine isn't even that bad, and I found these shoes to be too narrow. Also, there's a really uncomfortable bump in the insert in a spot that's too far forward to be for arch support. I'm sticking with my Merrells.

I purchased a 1 2 larger than my size they are too small. My feet are not wide, pretty normal. I've always bought my boots 1 2 size larger so I can fit an extra sock or a thicker one. I put them on, it lasts for about an hour, my toes rub against the boot and it kills.. The boot has not stretched a bit. I never complain, but for the price I have to be honest. I have also tried to adjust the laces and strap, nothing gives.
Have worn keens for years as I have a lot of foot issues,that being said,these are narrow ,more so than non so? not sure a half size bigger would help.
Didnt fit well...very uncomfortable. But they may fit your feet perfectly...never know! Went with the Merrells.

Keen has some crazy sizing. I wear a 9.5 in sneakers, 10 in a boot with a heel or wedge. When I'm unable to try shoes on, I go with the UK or Europe Size which was a 41. This usually works, so I ordered a 10.5. Too big. But that's not the problem. The big unforgiving toe cap is. I can't see this becoming comfortable. I'm sure this is a great shoe if that's what you're used to but I'm just not. If a shoe isn't immediately comfortable when I put it on, it goes back. I don't break in shoes. So while I can't comment on the waterproofness or other features of this shoe, I can say that I'm used to shoes that bend in the toe box with each step. These are going back, perhaps for something more sneaker-like.
In less than a year the stitching in the toe box area started coming apart. Then a section of the tread on the outer sole area came unglued. Very disappointing.
This is just the right fit. I have wide feet and sometimes have a hard time with sizing. These were so comfortable, I forgot I was wearing th in the house.

These are great boots. I broke them in on a 5 mile hike in Shenandoah National Park one mile of which was pretty serious rock scrambling. The boots had great traction on the rocks. We got caught in a downpour and had to walk two miles back to the car on a steep incline up wet rocks and I didn t slip at all. I wear a 7.5 or 8 and went with the 8 in these and they fit as expected.

Comfortable snug fit. Roomy toe box. I ordered 8.5 boot. In tennis shoes I wear 8.5 and in sandals and dress shoe I wear an 8. I m wearing hiking socks that are thin with padded heel and toe. I hope this helps in determining what size to buy. I plan to wear hiking and later in the snow. I m riding on the good reputation of Keen. If the performance is less than expected I will update.

Fit-as expected, same as old pair, good arch support and stability, roomy toe box for bunions toes warm socks. Good gripping sole. Like for casual winter walking, hiking on off trail. Live in Upper snowy, cold Midwest
Love the room in the toe box. These are not the best looking boots around but are certainly comfortable
The size was too large but the shoe was well made and probably wears well. Just too large for me. Shoes arrived timely.
I was searching for a hiker with a large toe box but not a wide fit every where else and this one fit the bill perfectly very comfy. Mostly Wear a size 9.5 regular ordered a 10. Just right!!!
This boot is a great boot for wide toe room. I did order half size larger to wear thicker socks. No break-in, light, comfortable. Love them.

My doctor gave me a list of shoes that would help, these are the best for my lifestyle. These shoes have a rigid sole which is great for preventing painful feet if you have an injury or arthritis. And the track pattern on the bottom gives good all-terrain footing. The toe box is wide enough for all of your toes which is unheard of in women's shoes. They are also well built enough to give years of wear.

I usually wear a 7 in heels and 6 in flip flops but I ordered an 8 so my feet would have room to swell, and spread as I'm on my feet all day. This shoe is also wider and doesn't squeeze my feet. The larger size also gives my toes room and doesn't bump the edge of the inside when I walk.

I'm very particular about shoes and didn't think I could ever buy online. I took a chance a few years ago and bought a pair of KEENs from Amazon. They are amazing! Perfect fit, perfect toe-box. I have two regular sneaker-style KEENs and recently bought this hiking boot style. Love it!!!

A friend recommended these. I figured I could return them if they didn t feel or fit well. I was very pleasantly surprised. I do recommend going 1 2 size larger. The toe box is comfortable, which was one of my concerns. I have used them in the snow and look forward to this summer walks in the woods. I recommend them. The Targhee II mid waterproof boot.
These fit great and are the most supportive and comfortable shoe I've had in ages. No complaints. Definitely would recommend.

Just returned from a 9 day hiking trip out west. I got these the day before we left so no 34 breaking them in 34 . I have plantar fasciitis in one foot and some lower back issues. These were THE MOST COMFORTABLE SHOES that I have. As good as my Asic tennis shoes. My feet did not hurt the whole trip. These are sturdy for climbing, jumping and walking. I could not be more pleased. They gripped well on slick rock as well as in sand.
Love these shoes, but toe guard Is off on one side, looks odd. But they fit so well, I can live with it.

durability.issue_summary: 구매자들은 내구성 문제로 인해 신발이 빠르게 망가지는 경향이 있다고 불만을 토로하고 있습니다.
durability.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 내구성이 뛰어나고 일상적인 사용에도 잘 견딘다고 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: I bought my 5th pair of these this past June. They typically last me 3 years and this pair fell apart within 3 months. Very disappointed!!!

I am disappointed in this product. I have had other Keen shoes and have been great. This one started off great but after wearing the shoe three times the strap that holds the lace in broke and now it does not lace us as well as it should. I stopped wearing them in favor of other brand that has not broken on me.
In less than a year the stitching in the toe box area started coming apart. Then a section of the tread on the outer sole area came unglued. Very disappointing.

This was my third pair of these boots. I have loved them in the past. This pair was made in Thailand and had very poor workmanship. On the inside of the top of the boot there was a bunch of material in each boot. The insert for the boot had a bad wrinkle in each one. Needless to say I returned them.
These are super comfortable, no breaking in required, but the seam is pulling apart after 10 months of wear. I wouldn t buy them again

I have bought 2 pairs of Keen Targhees and have put well over 400 miles on each pair. I ordered this 3rd pair in preparation for a 300 mile trek and found these cracks after my initial 10 mi breaking in hike. These signs of breaking down should not be occurring already. I believe the shoe is defective and therefore I am returning them.

update 2020 tried another pair giving them the benefit of the doubt-maybe my first pair was a hiccup in factory production? NOPE! Same problem and even faster this time!! Not I can catch the lace of the opposite shoe while walking as the tread is falling off.. so near tripping periodically. Throwing these out! DO NOT BUY THEM THEY ARE NOT WORTH THE !!! Tread pealed off after less than 8 months of periodic use, and proper upkeep. Nothing extreme like mountain climbing. Mostly short walks in grassy fields or on dirt paths. Extremely disappointment with this product, for the price I'd expect it to last much longer.. everything is such junk now its ridiculous!

Bought in 2019. By 2021 the soles were coming off, reglued soles. By 2023 the soles were coming off again. This also happened to two pairs of Keen sandals. One pair were 3 years old, the second pair were stored for a year and the soles fell off while removing from the box. Replaced with another brand. Recommend using Shoe Goo adhesive. I have Cabelas brand of boots 15 years old and over 1000 miles still going strong.

I have a pair of Keens I bough about 12 years ago and love them. They are wearing out so I thought I would get another pair. These new Keens are not made at all like the old ones. As you can see by the pictures the heal is coming apart. They arrived that way. I am sending them back. To pay over a 100.00 for a pair of hiking boots they should be in perfect shape upon arrival.

I loved that I didn't need to break these in, they were wide enough and super comfortable from the box. They fall apart very easily. The soles were shredded after one 4k in NHs whites. Not what I expected from a 130.00 boots.

I m so disappointed. I bought these a few days in advance for a camping trip. Give them time to break in .was the plan. They were damaged when I got them but I was willing to overlook it because we leave tomorrow morning but then when I went to put them on this morning the loop for the lace broke. I have had a pair of KEEN in the past and loved them. Lasted me a good decade. This is pathetic. Did you chance manufacturers or something?

After reading all of the reviews...some were not very happy....I considered myself really lucky...until now.... My Keen Targhee II mid fits really well is very comfortable to wear. However,..... the brown leather on both shoes are really scuffed up....never seen the likes of the condition that I got them in.....I know that they are not used by the condition of the bottom of the shoe the inside of the shoe show no wear AT ALL....SO....my very 1st time....will it be my last time?

I had purchased women's keen utility hiking boots about 10 years ago and just loved them. After 10 years, it was time to buy a new pair thinking the same quality would be there. I purchased the above product in January of 2022. Unfortunately, within a year, several areas of the soul where the soul has been glued on to the boot, the glue has failed. Very disappointed, especially given the price of these boots.
Boots arrived in a plain box, shoelaces undone like someone tried them on. There was no stuffing inside the boots. Did I receive someone s returned boots?

I have used Keens for years hiking all over. I noticed there are three countries making these now. This pair fell apart within weeks. First the top plastic eyelit snapped off so I can't tighten my lace. Then 2months ago the base separated from the boot! I purchased these Oct,2022 So 9 months ago!!!!! I would love a refund.

Just returned from a 9 day hiking trip out west. I got these the day before we left so no 34 breaking them in 34 . I have plantar fasciitis in one foot and some lower back issues. These were THE MOST COMFORTABLE SHOES that I have. As good as my Asic tennis shoes. My feet did not hurt the whole trip. These are sturdy for climbing, jumping and walking. I could not be more pleased. They gripped well on slick rock as well as in sand.
Still going strong even after a year of daily use! This is my second pair of Keens and aside from Ariat for leather, I will never buy another brand!

Received these boots in the beginning of summer, took a. Couple weeks to break them in and they quickly became my favorite!! Used them hiking, working, camping, everything where I wasn t wearing my Sanford I had these on! But by the end of the summer, they are almost done. The sole is starting to fall off. I will try glue and see if they will get me through fall winter but I m a little disappointed they didn t last longer. I really loved them!
Well made and comfortable from the first use. Highly recommend. Roomy in the toe box and fits maybe half a size larger or less which makes room for thicker socks so I'm ok with it
I have worn keen in the past so I knew I was getting a good boot. Gives me support and I can wear my custom insoles with them.

Previously discouraged with Keens durability, I tried another brand for about 8 months, big mistake! Came back to the Keen Targhee boot my feet are doing so much better. These are my everyday. Previously I have had issues with construction after a year or so, but the comfort outways this issue for me.
While these were great to begin with great fit, actually water resistant, comfortable, good traction , the stitching is already pulling out.

This shoe looks really good as advertised. The sole makes it even more appealing because it looks like it has good grip but after sometime the sole started to detach. See video. Good shoe for short term light travel. Doesn t hold up backpacking.
Great boots bought cheaper ones this time and I'll go back to keen. I use them for work and they hold up great.
I walk daily on the sidewalks in my neighborhood and I wanted a firm shoe with good support for the hour walk during the winter months ahead. The shoe is what I need.

Great support, I hike a lot and like the protection I get from these. Excellent traction. All day comfort, I never feel like I can't wait to get out of my boots. The only downside I've experienced is that the outer layer of the sole starts coming off at about 2-2 1 2 years of use. Otherwise I'd still be on my first pair.
I'm a zookeeper and these hold up to the daily wear and tear that I put them through! Highly recommended!
My wife has been buying these shoes for years she probably has had six pairs.She loves the way they fit she has a very wide foot.

Wore them right out of the box for a 3 mile hike through the snow and slush through the woods and along the shore of Lake Michigan. My feet stayed warm, dry and completely comfortable!!! Next time out I strapped my snowshoes on and trekked through the woods...perfect!! They also work great with my Outdoor Research gaiters!!

I order a pair of these about every 4 to 5 years! I work outside and this time there was no break in time. The last pair was so stiff but not this pair. It was like I d had already been wearing them for a few months. My old pair was worn down in the bottom so with the new tread I felt taller and tripped a lot at first lol. Hopefully This will be my last pair for work because in about 2 1 2 years I m going to retire! Yeah! If it s the lords will. This show has a larger toe box and good tread and are waterproof. My last pair had stopped being waterproof I bought spray for them but that didn t help so now they will be yard working shoes. And the new ones will be my work shoes! They went up 20.00 from a little over 4 years ago but I got them anyway because for my job they work!

design.issue_summary: 구매자들은 디자인에 대한 실망을 표현하며, 색상이 벗겨져 외관이 나빠지는 문제를 겪고 있습니다.
design.strength_summary: 구매자들은 부츠의 색상과 디자인에 대해 긍정적인 반응을 보였으며, 실제로 착용했을 때 더 매력적으로 보인다고 언급했습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Super disappointed in Keen! I have ordered many pairs of Keens in the past and have never experienced this. I received these boots for Christmas and have only worn them a handful of times and now the color is flaking off of the leather eventually they will look really bad. I expect so much more from their company, very sad.
The only problem I had was finding my foot size boot in the color I wanted. This was my second choice color scheme.
Look good but very lightweight...didn't keep them. I went to the Keen website and ordered all-leather boots since Amazon didn't seem to have any.

Got these for the Mrs to replace a 3 year old pair that were worn daily and finally gave out. She says it's like her old pair was rejuvenated into new. Fit and comfort picked up where the old pair left off.
I bought one for my daughter and need one for myself too! I love Keene s and these meet my expectations for good fit, comfort, and quality.
Very comfortable and has great support in arches and around ankles. Color is WRONG! supposed to be Black. I think I should have ordered a half-size smaller though but now I know for the next pair.

Arrived a day early, fit perfect and I love the color. I have been shopping retail stores for these boots but all out of my size I found them on black Friday for a great price here on Amazon. I had my last pair I bet 8 years and hiked hard in them. I won t buy any other brand.

I love this hiking boot. In the winter time, I wear it several times a week. It's comfortable. Sturdy , warm and I think stylish. Keen tend to be on the pricy side but you will get several years wear.

I usually wear a 7, so ordered a 7.5 to accommodate thick socks and the fit is perfect. The color is a little darker than I expected, but the boots still look great to me and they are COMFORTABLE. So glad I chose to go with Keen...this is the first time I've tried this brand and I will be back for more. -
Very comfortable and true to size. Lightweight. Price was significantly lower than retail store for some reason. Paid 75 and usually retails for more.
Wow! Right out of the box and these things feel great. Ordered 1 2 size larger like my running shoes . Headed to Patagonia in a month and these will be my hiking shoes. Can t wait!
Comfortable right out of the box!!! My last pair I finally had to replace after 7 years! Can t go wrong with Keen!!
I bought this boot as a gift. It is light, and a lovely color combination. The boots fit perfectly as sized 1 2 size up allowing for room for thicker hiking socks. She loves them!
Haven t had the opportunity to wear yet but I was pleased with the appearance of the boots and felt comfortable during the try on

A friend turned me onto Keen and since I'm off to Scotland in May, I thought these shoes would be perfect for all the hikes and sightseeing. They look even better in person and the fit is dreamy - I have a wide upper foot and most shoes and boots kill my pinky toes - not an issues with these! The toe portion is oversized probably for better balance and my feet feel great in them. The insole is great too, but I'll still be bringing supports just in case. I'll update after the trip to let you know how well they performed! Cheers!

Purchased Keen hiking boots because I heard such great things about them. Namely, from my spouse, who has the exact same style, only about 6 months older than mine. His are fine, but unfortunately, one of mine fell apart. I was disappointed, but because they are Keen, I went to the manufacture's site, contacted them, had to fill out some paperwork and send some pictures and receipts, but I'm happy to say they stood behind their shoes and I'm getting a new pair. Customer service makes all the difference.

price.issue_summary: 구매자들은 가격에 비해 품질이 저조하다고 반복적으로 언급하고 있으며, 이로 인해 실망감이 커지고 있습니다.
price.strength_summary: 가격이 저렴하다는 긍정적인 리뷰가 많아 소비자들이 가성비에 만족하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Overpriced trash. Touted as durable work boots but didn t even last 10 months. Sole separated on one shoe, the water resistance didn t hold up at all. I don t work in a river, but I do clean enclosures and there is no reason my feet should be soaked all day. This is my second pair in the last 2 years and I won t be giving them a 3rd chance. Better off buying cheap Walmart boots with how often quickly these go bad.

I have always bought these hiking boots and love them but the quality of these is horrible. I have used them lightly since July of this year and the stitching is coming undone and the area where the leather and the cloth meet has torn. I am so disappointed in Keens.

I m so disappointed. I bought these a few days in advance for a camping trip. Give them time to break in .was the plan. They were damaged when I got them but I was willing to overlook it because we leave tomorrow morning but then when I went to put them on this morning the loop for the lace broke. I have had a pair of KEEN in the past and loved them. Lasted me a good decade. This is pathetic. Did you chance manufacturers or something?

I had purchased women's keen utility hiking boots about 10 years ago and just loved them. After 10 years, it was time to buy a new pair thinking the same quality would be there. I purchased the above product in January of 2022. Unfortunately, within a year, several areas of the soul where the soul has been glued on to the boot, the glue has failed. Very disappointed, especially given the price of these boots.
Very comfortable and true to size. Lightweight. Price was significantly lower than retail store for some reason. Paid 75 and usually retails for more.
My wife bought these after someone gave her a pair a few years ago. She works at a garden center. We couldn't beat this price.
Didn't bought is for myself, looks good...real review could be done after use....so that is why now only moderate reply...
Great boots bought cheaper ones this time and I'll go back to keen. I use them for work and they hold up great.
I bought one for my daughter and need one for myself too! I love Keene s and these meet my expectations for good fit, comfort, and quality.
Comfortable right out of the box!!! My last pair I finally had to replace after 7 years! Can t go wrong with Keen!!

This shoe looks really good as advertised. The sole makes it even more appealing because it looks like it has good grip but after sometime the sole started to detach. See video. Good shoe for short term light travel. Doesn t hold up backpacking.

product_name: adidas Unisex-Adult Adilette Slide Sandal

urgent_issues.summary: 사이즈 관련 문제가 반복적으로 발생하고 있으며, 구매자들은 잘 맞지 않는 사이즈로 인해 불만을 토로하고 있습니다.

comfort.issue_summary: 구매자들은 착용 시 통증과 물집이 생기며, 패딩이 부족하거나 단단한 소재로 인해 불편함을 호소하고 있습니다.
comfort.strength_summary: 구매자들은 착용감이 우수하다고 반복적으로 언급하며, 발에 편안함과 지지를 제공한다고 평가했습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Got blisters below my toe line on right foot. Too ridged and stiff. If it wasn't for the fact that I only paid 8.28 I would have packaged up and returned .

I generally fit a US Men's 10.5-11. These sandals were not a standard 11, not even close, more like an 11 length with the width of an 8 or 9. If your feet aren't shaped like a pair of skis you're probably going to find these a disappointing fit. If you are the very rare person who can row these longboats, you may still be disappointed. I usually buy these in person at Big5 but this year the price on Adidas Adilette Cloudfoam was nearly double and the normally padded pseudo-suede strap was now an uncomfortable piece of thin rubber. The slides I received in this order seem to be of an even lower quality. The real Adilette Cloudfoam are obviously not shower shoes but these were so cheaply made they had to attach a sign to them saying, "These are not shower shoes". The strap looks suede in the pics, nope, that's just a textured rubbery strap designed to imitate the look of the original Adidas series.
These slides are awful. They were not made well at all. In the heel bed there s material missing inside and it feels like something sharp is poking your foot.
I should have read the reviews. I bought these end of may . The smell from wearing bare feet is horrendous. The are comfortable but I can smell them across the room.

This product should be removed off the market. I finally got to wear them out on a trip and they made my trip miserable. I have blisters and can t walk 20ft without feeling the pain. wore them a couple of times before at home Also they are terrible to wear by the water and take more than 24hrs to get dry I wish I could return then and get my money back.

This products looked thick sole in the picture. As it was, it is a little thin on the sole. It doesn't seem the same products. I wanted to return this slipper, but the supplier wanted me to pay the return postage. It was about 2 3 of the price that I paid for this slipper.

No padding on interior of the strap. Cuts into the top of both feet right behind the back edge of the strap. Extremely uncomfortable to walk in for extended periods. My old slides were so awesome and padded . Adidas sure knows how to screw up a good thing. Removed all padding and tightened up the strap equals cuts, bleeding and pain.
Put them on. ...walked to the mailbox, came back and returned them. they fit me terrible, could not keep them on my feet
Dislike my foot wants to extend past the front because it is set too wide even for my D width foot with bunion! Top is cushioned but sharp at the front and rear. Like foot pad is cushy.

I bought a pair of these a few years back and they ve skimped on materials since. In my photo you ll see my current pair obviously worn from daily use has a cushion under the band. These new pair I bought have a thin piece of a rubbery material with no cushion. While the material feels durable, it s very snug and not as comfortable for my foot. As far as the soles, both are about the same level of comfort. The band on top bothers me too much though. I didn t want to go a size up because I didn t want the footbed to be any longer. I hate to be that guy, but they just don t make these like they used to. I m returning these and buying these slides but with adjustable band in hopes they ll be more comfortable.
These are hard as a rock. They're not like the black ones or the other ones that are soft and plush. If you love the team great but if you cherish your feet abort
The strap that goes over your foot to hold the sandal on your foot is too small. The length is fine.

These were HUGE on my husband's feet. I ordered a 10 which is the size he wears, they were too wide and too long. WARNING, IF THESE DON'T FIT THE SELLER WILL MAKE YOU PAY TO RETURN THEN, IT COST ME OVER 13.00 TO SEND THEM BACK!

I chose wrong this sandals are not really waterproof or water resistant, so I ve been using them as slippers or summer sandals but they re getting deteriorated fast man! I ve been wearing them for less than a month and they re already chopped from the tip, not worth it , scammy product from adidas I think
I have the original white stripes and bought these as a second pair. First wear had me slipping every where. My foot would not stay put inside. Unfortunately I wore them outside, so I cannot return.

Hubby loved it. My husband is size 10.5 and i ordered 10, still a little big, as you can see in the picture. Other than that it is super soft and the arch support,support very well. He said he can wear it all day.

I've been getting these slides for a few years now. They are so comfortable! I have Plantar Fasciitis in my right foot and when I put these on after work they hug my heel and have just the right amount of arch support in them to make my feet feel better.
Comfortable but I was hoping for a softer foam. I have a pair of Adidas already and the foam is perfect. These have more rigidity and don t cushion the same way.

Best comfy sandals So much foam for feel Feels like walking on clouds Great for giving as a gift Even better to by them for yourself your feet will thank you Super cute colors And the price was perfect
Fits well, not too spongy this is a word right? . Arch not too high, and not too expensive. I would buy again, and I have.

I love this shoe. It is super comfortable and stays in your feet well. I use them to do my errands and just putz around outside in. I actually ordered this thinking it was the other slide Adidas makes and I think I like this more. It is cushioned but hold its shape.
This is just perfect when you are walking and standing the whole day, just simply comfortable and stress free experience on your feet.
These are comfortable have good support. I sized down to accommodate I needed woman s sizing. Love the camouflage.
It is not very comfortable as the bottom is pretty hard and it has a huge bump that seems to be for your feet arches but it didn't fit my feet arches so it made the whole experience bad.

I am debating getting a size up, but with the amount of discomfort I've been feeling with these the few hours I've worn them that makes me not want to. I usually wear a size 9.5 in running shoes, have another different pair of Adidas Sandals size 8 which is why I go around these sizes, the Adidas size 8 fits well. I start to feel soreness and almost tingling around my feet and toes after around an hour of standing in these, I do not weigh a lot, I am very physically active and don't think that has anything to do negatively with the amount of discomfort I feel in these. I have a pair of quick drying water shoes that are pretty flat but are more comfortable than these. The rubber feels firm and I feel it push back up quickly when I press down on it with my fingers.
I like how it has cushion and yet it is sturdy enough to support the weight. Overall very pleased with the product.

I often have trouble finding comfortable footwear due to having Plantar Fasciitis, but these have a lot of cushion and are good for walking. The strap is another issue, sometimes, the footstrap is so rigid that it digs into the top of your foot. This one is a little like that, but hopefully the strap will wear in and loosen up a little over time.

I have wide flat feet and walking around on this floor was killing my feet. Major pain, but once these sandals came, they brought relieve to my aching feet. Comfy sandals indeed! NOTE The sandals brand new need some stretching out if you have wider feet. I broke mine in about 2 days.

First the good the soles are cushy and supportive. So they re both comfortable in the foot base and have arch support. However the strap is snug, too snug. They didn t seem true to size. Also the top of the strap near the toes begins to rub unpleasantly and cause some abrasion on the toes after a little while. They re ok to run outside or for something brief but not a long time.

love these to death. super bouncy and comfortable footbed. wear them both with and without socks in the house but can't speak for long distances outside. don't pay more than 30 for these - you can often get them even cheaper. can't go wrong with Adilettes

These were HUGE on my husband's feet. I ordered a 10 which is the size he wears, they were too wide and too long. WARNING, IF THESE DON'T FIT THE SELLER WILL MAKE YOU PAY TO RETURN THEN, IT COST ME OVER 13.00 TO SEND THEM BACK!

These shoes are not for people with wide feet. My feet are 9 1 2 EE wide , so I bought the size 10s, which I often do. This time it didn't work out - the shoes were both way too long and simultaneously too tight across the top. So they hurt, AND posed a tripping risk. I returned them immediately.

The sizing is completely wrong. It says women s 9 men s 9. I knew that was wrong so because I wear a women s 9 I ordered a men s 7 because that s how shoe sizes work! Well not with these. They re too small because the box says men s 7 women s 8!

Love the look of these however the pair I have ended up cutting my big toe on both feet the first few times I wore these for an hour or more. I ended up shaving that part of the slide down with a razor as there was a ridge there in the molding process. Wore the slides more, caused redness but no cuts and in time my feet toughened up and now no issues. Now that my feet are broken in, they are very comfortable and once again look great.
These slides are awful. They were not made well at all. In the heel bed there s material missing inside and it feels like something sharp is poking your foot.

My daughter wore her old Adidas slides for years and loved them. It finally came time to replace them and when we did we discovered they had changed. The strap that covers the forefoot has sharp edges and cuts into the foot when walking. They are completely unusable in their new form. Do not buy unless you plan to wear socks with them 100 of the time.

Sent back twice, description say womens, box says men's, sent back, still too big, compared them to the previous ones so I would know what size to get for the next ones, barely a difference. Just not going to bother getting another pair

Slides look nice but you can t wear socks with them because the footbed is super slippery. Returning because of that reason. Bottom also different than original more of an outdoor sole doesn t seem as comfy.
Put them on. ...walked to the mailbox, came back and returned them. they fit me terrible, could not keep them on my feet

Hubby loved it. My husband is size 10.5 and i ordered 10, still a little big, as you can see in the picture. Other than that it is super soft and the arch support,support very well. He said he can wear it all day.
Fit was very good and foot bed very comfortable. unfortunately the front of the slide "strap" pressed into top of my toes when I walked
True to size. Very comfortable, with padded sole. Nice color. My boyfriend wore them around the house all day. Not quite warm enough to wear outside yet ...

The style of this shoe is very nice! I am not a fan of the slide style sandals, but wanted a pair to wear to the airport that coordinates with my grey Adidas tracksuit. I choose this pair because it was hard to find my size 10 women in other colors and styles. The shoe arrived in a timely manner, packaged well, brand new. I tried them on and they were too large, too wide. Although comfortable to walk in, and the style was very nice, but I couldn't make it work not even wearing thick socks, so I had to return them. I tried to order a smaller size, but at the time none were available, not even in the stores. I strongly suggest ordering a size smaller than your actual size, and if you find a pair - GET IT!
This was for a grandson. He said they fit great and he loves that they have some cushion in the insoles.

I read a lot of reviews before ordering these Shoes, I really wanted them because of the different colors on the Adidas on front you can match them up with many things, Now you are able to get your true size if you just follow thee men size, for women what ever size you were in men get that size the women size is incorrect on their so for me I usually were a women s 9 so I purchased men s 7 and they fit perfectly I gave them a 5 star cause I actually got the right size and they look amazing
Size fit perfectly, they feel like gel very comfortable I love I was not expecting to be so good I fully recommend it

Got these to replace my old pair. Just as comfy but a snug fit since I got the "correct" size and not one that was the only thing available. If you have wide feet go 1 size up, unless you don't mind the stretch out period.

They are absolutely perfect and great price!!! Will definitely be buying more of these.... The comfort level is amazing. I normally wear a regular 9 but my feet are wide normally and happen to be swollen these past two days but normally I order a size up when it comes to wearing these types of shoes.
Good size that matches the size and comfy. Get your cheap adidas slippers that are suitable for casual wearing

I bought these comft slides for entire family for inside shoes and they are great! I have tried so many things since we all have various foot issues pea plants, plantar fasciitis, high arches, etc.. they work great and are better and less expensive than expensive foot recovery options..
My 11 yr old loves these sandals. Runs true to size. He is a size 7 1 2 and ordered a size 8. Perfect with room to grow into them.
These shoes were identical in fit and comfort to the ones my son literally wore out so thankful they continue to make the same consistent style and fit
I brought these slides for my son and was very impressed that they came in his size and fit perfectly. It's very hard to find slides or any other shoe in size 18
I bought these for my partner. I was worried about what size to get as other reviews mention sizing up. They are true to size! He loves the soft gel sole.

representative_reviews.text: I chose wrong this sandals are not really waterproof or water resistant, so I ve been using them as slippers or summer sandals but they re getting deteriorated fast man! This product should be removed off the market. I finally got to wear them out on a trip and they made my trip miserable. I have blisters and can t walk 20ft without feeling the pain. wore them a couple of times before at home Also they are terrible to wear by the water and take more than 24hrs to get dry I wish I could return then and get my money back.

My daughter wore her old Adidas slides for years and loved them. It finally came time to replace them and when we did we discovered they had changed. The strap that covers the forefoot has sharp edges and cuts into the foot when walking. They are completely unusable in their new form. Do not buy unless you plan to wear socks with them 100 of the time.

I don't know how you manage to screw up a slide but you could start by putting the strap too far back and too high and have it pinch the top of your toes which won't reach the end of the shoe because the strap is an actual choke point. Good looking slide but if you can't design a strap on it to fit a normal human foot then you need to go straight to shoe jail. Waste of money.

Just as others have commented, the top edge of the strap upper slices into the toes, especially the big toes in my case. I could only tolerate a few minutes of wearing this thing. Horrible design. Surprised that more people haven't complained about this.

Love the look of these however the pair I have ended up cutting my big toe on both feet the first few times I wore these for an hour or more. I ended up shaving that part of the slide down with a razor as there was a ridge there in the molding process. Wore the slides more, caused redness but no cuts and in time my feet toughened up and now no issues. Now that my feet are broken in, they are very comfortable and once again look great.

I owned the original Cloudfoam plus or whatever it was called for many years, very soft and comfortable. Sadly this new version changed the strap which make it unwearable. As you can see in the picture, the padding on the black new one is much thinner! The strap cuts into my toes every step now guarantee blisters. Hope adidas change the padding back to what it was, please don t ruined your own product. Too bad, i m getting my slide from your competitors now adidas.
These slides are awful. They were not made well at all. In the heel bed there s material missing inside and it feels like something sharp is poking your foot.
I have the original white stripes and bought these as a second pair. First wear had me slipping every where. My foot would not stay put inside. Unfortunately I wore them outside, so I cannot return.

Slides look nice but you can t wear socks with them because the footbed is super slippery. Returning because of that reason. Bottom also different than original more of an outdoor sole doesn t seem as comfy.

I bought a pair of these a few years back and they ve skimped on materials since. In my photo you ll see my current pair obviously worn from daily use has a cushion under the band. These new pair I bought have a thin piece of a rubbery material with no cushion. While the material feels durable, it s very snug and not as comfortable for my foot. As far as the soles, both are about the same level of comfort. The band on top bothers me too much though. I didn t want to go a size up because I didn t want the footbed to be any longer. I hate to be that guy, but they just don t make these like they used to. I m returning these and buying these slides but with adjustable band in hopes they ll be more comfortable.

I ve had my last pair of these sliders going on 8 years now and they re still holding up and I wear them constantly . This new green and red pair looks awesome and is very comfortable, especially after they re broken in a bit.

These are made well with quality material - just like you'd expect from adidas. I umpire for Legion baseball and most times we're changing in the parking lot or on grass. These keep your feet off the ground and what's on the ground off your socks. Excellent price for this quality.

It takes a good day or two to break them in. I suggest wearing socks to avoid losing the top layer of skin on the top of toes. Once they are broken in though they are really comfortable. I'm replacing an old pair of Nike solarsofts that they apparently don't make anymore and the soles on these are very similar.
Still comfy. A little narrow. Not nearly as nice as the other version CF that they don t make any more with the suede. Why would they do such a thang

I have plantar fasciitis and these offer excellent support. I will note that they rub on the top of my foot after a lot of walking without socks on, but I usually wear socks with them so it's not too much of an issue. Would buy again

Best comfy sandals So much foam for feel Feels like walking on clouds Great for giving as a gift Even better to by them for yourself your feet will thank you Super cute colors And the price was perfect
Me and my boyfriend bought matching pairs and as soon as we put them on they were so comfy 1000 1000

My hubby loves it and thinks we should buy two more for our sons. Its fits perfect, comfortable for long wear and its neat on his feet. We can't speak to the durability of it just yet as we recently bought it.
Good support for a slide sandal, holds-up well and cleans-up like new with a little magic eraser action.

First time ever owning a pair of Addidas anything. My girlfriend purchase these for me to replace my Nike Under Armor pair. My feet run hot and I tend to sweat a lot in them causing them to smell even after washing feet smell would come back after one wear. But these paid fit, feel and support great! Definitely a fan now. No complaints just yet and I absolutely love the all black!
This was for a grandson. He said they fit great and he loves that they have some cushion in the insoles.

These are quite comfy, not perfect, but for me to wear around the house with some socks they are perfect. I'm just wondering... why is there nothing in the description and reviews that i saw about the face that there is a plainly obvious Juventus logo on here? lol It's not an issue but I just found is very odd that it's not mentioned at all.

Bought these for my boyfriend and wanted to steal them from him. They feel like you are walking on clouds! He absolutely loves them also. He has had them for months now and they hold up well with wear and tear.
Shoes were exactly as expected.. EXCEPT i didnt realize the sole of the shoe would be so hard and stiff. Makes the shoe not very comfortable because of it.
Great for running around doing errands and or for the house when you do not want to wear socks and shoes

The style of this shoe is very nice! I am not a fan of the slide style sandals, but wanted a pair to wear to the airport that coordinates with my grey Adidas tracksuit. I choose this pair because it was hard to find my size 10 women in other colors and styles. The shoe arrived in a timely manner, packaged well, brand new. I tried them on and they were too large, too wide. Although comfortable to walk in, and the style was very nice, but I couldn't make it work not even wearing thick socks, so I had to return them. I tried to order a smaller size, but at the time none were available, not even in the stores. I strongly suggest ordering a size smaller than your actual size, and if you find a pair - GET IT!
The look and feel is better than in the pictures. They re probably not as durable as my old ones, but that s ok. I can use these as my dress slides and my old ones become the casual wear slides
I've had these for a while as guest slippers. They feel great and my friends love them. Really ads a unique variety to the set and the colors are neutral enough to match with the modern aesthetics.

When we think adilette we think Adidas. They never disappoint with this line because it s part of their legacy. They size right, come in a nice navy blue box and are low maintenance. I wear them all day at times and my feet never hurt. I even know washed them!
EDIT bumped to 5 stars because my partner who they were bought for said they are incredibly comfy and he likes the upside down logo
Awesome sandals I bought them because I Love the color but sorprise it says Messi right on them nice

representative_reviews.text: It s not anti-slip! Daughter fell in the boat, hurt her tailbone, hasn t recovered from 2wks till today. The sole is thin, walking long distance will hurt too.

Usually don t write reviews but felt like I needed to for these. Was super excited about these and happy to find they fit our kid great when they first arrived 2 days ago... the wear on these after ONE DAY of wearing them indoors all day at daycare is awful! The toebox blue had rubbed off substantially, the blue on the treds is almost fully worn off and now purple and on the sides of the shoes the blue has worn off and PINK is showing through in multiple spots! Again, this was after my kid wearing these, all indoors for 8 hours at daycare today. Not sure if this is typical with Keen quality or if these are knockoffs?! but it certainly is unacceptable in my book and they re being sent back tomorrow! Beware!

I had high expectations for these, however, they were way too wide for my daughters narrow feet heels. If looking for a Keen water sandal for narrow feet I recommend trying the Moxie vs the Seacamp. Otherwise, cute sandal!

I thought maybe we were having a sizing issue at first because my son wouldn t wear these for more than ten seconds. I sent the right size for him back and ordered this size. He put them on and they seemed to fit and he was happy. We went the the store, since I had confidence in this product and thought I had found him a good sandal. 15 minutes into shopping he started crying about how badly his feet hurt. Unfortunately this meant I rushed through the rest of our much needed shopping and got us home. The sandals seemed to fit though I realized he didn t have much room to grow. But he took them off and his feet were a little red. He is allergic to soy, kiwi, and therefore latex. His feet were better the next day, with no blisters or signs that the shoe was an ill fit. However when I took him shopping for another pair of sandals, we found that he wanted the same style of shoe and was totally comfortable, with no complaints as he ran around the store where we bought the other shoe the red and black sandals . I suspect that he was having an allergic reaction and there are some sizing issues with these shoes. I posted a picture of the keen sandal next to the sandal we bought to show that the keen sizes run a bit big. My son cannot fit a size three in any other shoe, and the red and black sandal is a size four. The size four keen was slipping off his foot, and the size three was just big enough. In conclusion, the keen sandals run big and it is possible that some children will have an allergic reaction, like my son did.

Sadly we received these already broken upon arrival! The elastic holding the foot in was detached. These would be great because the soles are nice and flexible, seem to be comfy. But can t use a broken shoe.

Shoes were delivered this morning and see pictures of what they looked like straight of the the box.....covered with large black marks!! I am sure they were great shoes for the 1st owner ......sadly it was not me!! Very disappointed that this seller would send these out and can not see how awful condition they could begin to attempt to say they did not notice .....YUCK!!

I loved, how comfortable it was for my daughter, but ohh boy it stinks so bad, it literally made my daughters feet stink so much, doesn t matter how many times I wash it. Very disappointed. Would ve bought it if I knew about this problem.
The soles were paper thin very poor quality I returned them and won t be buying any more One star is to many

I've bought Keen sandals each summer for my kids. This pair has been a huge disappointment. After barely 3 wears the shoes took on the worst stink. Kids at school bullied my kid over the smell. I've washed them in the washer. I've tried scrubbing the inside with a toothbrush and baking soda. I've put deodorant on my kids feet before putting on freshly washed shoes. Nothing works thru 1 day of wear. I don't have time to wash the shoes daily. The functional design and color is great but because of the stink these shoes are getting donated and I'm buying Chacos instead. Don't waste your money on these.

Baby wears size 8 in most sneakers, so I thought sandals with no socks would be fine in an 8 too. These are really hard to put on, and baby s foot is creased from the strap seams and so sweaty when we take them off. They fit too tight for socks. They just don t seem very comfortable and may be for narrow low arch feet.

My daughter started using these shoes in early July and it s late August and the strap is falling apart. She didn t wear them everyday. I would estimate there were 25-30 wearings. She isn t rough on her clothes shoes, and we have had this model twice before and she outgrew the shoes before they wore out. These are either defective or counterfeits. Really annoyed - these shoes are too expensive to fall apart after so little use.

Bought this for my daughter to join me on easy hikes. But the shoes were too slippery even after a small rain. She had no traction at all. I think these would be nice for casual walking on paved roads, but not on nature trails of Hawaii.
These are nice shoes but appear to run 2 sizes too small. Make sure you are able to return these if you need to otherwise I would try them on in person.
Fits fine but OMG it made my kids feet stink! Returning it ASAP! The material used on these sandals is resulting in HORRIBLE ODOR! Causes the feet to smell extremely Stinky!

My daughter had a pair of these a year ago. She really liked them so I got her another pair in a bigger size. She had worn them several times over about 3 months. She is pretty gentle on her footwear and she typically rotates 4-5 different pairs of shoes in a given timeframe. The cord on both shoes broke within one week of each other for no good reason. Her original pair is still in very good condition and we never had any issues. My daughter and I are disappointed these broke so easily and we cannot repair them.

Son was constantly complaining about pain in his legs, we eventually figured out he meant his ankles were hurting. Knowing he was flat footed, we began the pursuit of sandals with arch support and ran into servers good reviews about these ones. What a incredible change, they do provide great support and he no longer complains about ankle pain when wearing them. I just wished I'd have found them sooner.

We absolutely love this hiking sandal! everything is as mention, very durable very comfortable, waterproof. not cheaply made! highly recommend another purchase. Only thing I would mention is that the colors are slightly lighter than what is shown on Amazon picture. Overall wonderful pair of sandals.
LOVE this shoe. It's darling, and my daughter says they're so comfortable. She wore these a lot on our trip to Costa Rica. A bit expensive for something she'll grow out of quickly, but worth it.

Keen's are the best. Very durable and COMFORTABLE! Kids can go in and out of water and it drains so no "swamp feet". Protects their toes. No blisters. This is her 3rd pair. LOVE THEM. I think they run a little big. I bought a pair for myself adult size and hiked 6 miles brand new....no issues. very comfortable.
I wear an women s 6 so these fit just right. They don t have much arch support, but, again, they re kids shoes. Can t expect kids to have flat feet! This is my second pair. Really worth the money.

Great for my special needs 2 yo daughter. Goes over her SMOs well. Makes our local splash pad a blast. Any parent looking for a water shoe so go over their kids braces. She has spina bifida and uses a walker, these have worked very well.

My nieces and nephews have always worn keen and their parents have loved them! I bought for my son 15 mos , not a walker yet, but they are the only shoes he lets me put on and keeps on. They provide him good support as he is learning to walk.

I love these! I just bought my son keens and have been dying to get myself some. I also love that the foot bed is not too cushiony we try minimalist shoes but I still get a bit of support. When running I also don t feel as I have heavy shoes on. Love these!

I am in Vanautu on an LDS Charities mission assigned to do humanitarian work. We were advised before we left to get KEEN sandals. It was the best advice. They go through water, hiking, muddy trails into villages, through town and into business meetings and keep looking great. Excellent value for the money. I am a lady but with a wide foot and I purchased a child's shoe for a perfect fit. Take a look at this picture, I have my KEENs on. Wear them walking to church.

These are simply the best footwear for summer camp. The openings let air circulate and the material over the toes was very protective. These are pretty and sturdy and we intend to buy them again next summer.

Bought these last year for my 2 y o, bought them again this year. They are just the best hybrid shoes. They support like a sneaker, but breath like a sandal. They are no skid and are super comfy. They dry pretty quickly and look pretty much new even at the end of the season. My daughter has a wider food where her toes are and these are comfortable for her. Will most definitely be buying another pair again for next summer. Great water hiking summer shoe!
Fits well for wide feet. Great Toe protection with cool design. Sturdy ankle strap and nice arch support. Definately exceeds my expectations. It was pricey but totally worth it!
sand or water! traction! moves with his foot!! love this shoe!! we went through 15 other pairs before settling with Keens! Worth the extra 25!
Great for being outside in the summer! I got my nephew, daughter and myself a pair! They are extremely lightweight and very comfortable.

I'm so glad these exist. My toddler is amphibious so I needed a shoe that is too! Sturdy, treks through all terrains dirt? Mud? Sand? Ocean? Forest? Lake? My son will go in it , dries quickly, strong velcro. A

Previously we were getting them the Keen Newport sandals, but the Seacamp ones were on sale, so we went with those this time. I like them a lot better. We've had them about a month and a half, and they are holding up very well. They don't look beaten up at all. I like that the width accommodates a wider foot, however we did size up in these. I ordered an 11 her regular size and a 12. The 11s were too short, so we sized up to the 12. I will be looking into whether or not Keen makes a non sandal type shoe. We live in a place with cold winters, so the cut outs won't work for cooler weather.
