Also in crocs I wear ladies 9 mens 7. In sperry I wear a 6 in Big Kid. So I measured my feet according to the Keen website chart, 24 cm, and ordered a 6 big kid that would fit a 24 cm foot. 24.1 cm is the 8. They sort of fit when I tried them on but I should have returned them. I ended up ordering a Size 7 big kid and that one fits much better. They are ever so slightly wider and longer than a big kid 6, which is what I needed. The womens keen 8 in the Newport were too heavy, too narrow, too tight on top, and not quite big enough in the toe box.
Shoes came on time as promised. Fit well. Our little loves them. Great outside on the lawn or on the beach. Easy on and off.
fits great, nice shoes. The recipient received another pair so these were returned with no problems at all.

Love these keens! I have the same ones from a couple years ago. The shoes themselves have held up very well but my dog got to them so I needed another pair. As with all keens they are a wider fit and somewhat loose. I have narrow heel and wider ball of foot. Love how comfortable these keens are.
I wear an women s 6 so these fit just right. They don t have much arch support, but, again, they re kids shoes. Can t expect kids to have flat feet! This is my second pair. Really worth the money.
Perfect shoe for active kids. I love the lace design that adjusts the width of the shoes and makes them perfect fit for various shapes of feet!

I was lucky to find in my size. A good value plus, I love the color blue. Keens doesn't offer this in women's shoes. I have a wide foot and narrow heal. This sandal is tough, offers good support, protects my toes while bike riding, keeps small rocks and debris out for the most part when walking hiking on trails. Easy to wash and air drys fast. Soft too. I didn't get any blisters all summer long and these sandals were used regularly all summer.

I have bought my daughter a few pairs of sandals but after sometime they start marking my daughter's foot. She has wide feet and it has been a struggle to find her comfortable shoes. I feel this pair has protected her toes and she's comfortable in them. I truly recommend these shoes.
Great shoe, well made like most Keen products. Definitely for a more narrow foot, though not as narrow as the Moxie.
We bought these for a water day at school. They fit perfectly, were comfortable, and worked wonderfully for water. They were also easy to put on and take off.

durability.issue_summary: 구매자들은 내구성이 매우 낮아 신발이 빠르게 마모되거나 찢어지는 문제를 반복적으로 경험하고 있습니다.
durability.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 내구성이 뛰어나고 오랜 사용에도 잘 견디며, 아이들의 발을 보호해준다고 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Usually don t write reviews but felt like I needed to for these. Was super excited about these and happy to find they fit our kid great when they first arrived 2 days ago... the wear on these after ONE DAY of wearing them indoors all day at daycare is awful! The toebox blue had rubbed off substantially, the blue on the treds is almost fully worn off and now purple and on the sides of the shoes the blue has worn off and PINK is showing through in multiple spots! Again, this was after my kid wearing these, all indoors for 8 hours at daycare today. Not sure if this is typical with Keen quality or if these are knockoffs?! but it certainly is unacceptable in my book and they re being sent back tomorrow! Beware!
It s not anti-slip! Daughter fell in the boat, hurt her tailbone, hasn t recovered from 2wks till today. The sole is thin, walking long distance will hurt too.

Its already worn out and my daughter is not someone who jumps crazy at all. Velcro doesn t stay intact. I thought it would last at least for 6 months. Disappointed with the money charged. I would not pay more than 12 for this item.
Within 40 days, elastic strap broke. Kiddo wore maybe a dozen times. Now worthless. Past the Amazon return window as well. 70 for shoes that break in 40 days. Not right.
I usually love Keens and buy them all the time. Just noticed today that strap to secure the shoe on is coming apart. Unfortunately this listing doesn't tell me how to contact the seller.
The soles were paper thin very poor quality I returned them and won t be buying any more One star is to many

Sadly we received these already broken upon arrival! The elastic holding the foot in was detached. These would be great because the soles are nice and flexible, seem to be comfy. But can t use a broken shoe.

Silly me for expecting that spending 55 for a pair of sandals for my 4yr old might guarantee that they weren t defective and falling apart upon delivery. Disappointing quality for a pair of Keens. Certainly do not order this product if you cannot return it for free
Wore them for 3 hours and they felt great! Went to put them back on the next day and the back pull strap broke, there are not made like they used to be. Im extremely disappointed!

It was worn by a 5 year old twice and has already fallen apart. Didn t realize the return window was closed so quickly, cheaply made, probably knock offs?? We ve had keens before and they were very durable. These were not at all

Strong toxic chemical smell, these are not appropriate for children, not sure if the smell is coming from the adhesive or the paint on the rubber insoles and or soles but it is very strong and smells toxic

I NEVER leave reviews, but felt like I wanted to save someone else the hassle of dealing with this. We love Keens and wanted to love these sandals for our 1.5 year old. But, were very disappointed. The first pair we received came apart in an hour, the second pair lasted only a couple weeks, and the THIRD pair lasted about 10 minutes. They all broke in the exact same spot! And, I can t even make a good pair out of the 3 because it s the same shoe every time. Also, the sandals pictured are not the ones you will receive! There is not a clasp to tighten the laces, the laces are just barely stitched on. Oh, and I also contacted Keen directly about the issue, but their warranty does not cover laces! There s far cheaper sandals for toddlers, that are better made!
These were bought as a gift, however they only lasted one month of infrequent wear?! Disappointed! Will be looking for a replacement.

My daughter started using these shoes in early July and it s late August and the strap is falling apart. She didn t wear them everyday. I would estimate there were 25-30 wearings. She isn t rough on her clothes shoes, and we have had this model twice before and she outgrew the shoes before they wore out. These are either defective or counterfeits. Really annoyed - these shoes are too expensive to fall apart after so little use.
We usually love Keens and buy a pair for the kids every spring. The strap is ripping right where it bends after only 2 months of use.
Good shoe, super durable. They are difficult for kids to put on themselves and they make kids feet stink. But I love keens. So we ll made. Will last forever.
Washable, high-quality materials, and a cover over the toe incase of trips falls . What more do you need?
Wow, these are definitely a worthwhile purchase. Great amazing quality. Holding up perfectly. Would recommend.
Not a huge fan of the look but Keen just holds up better than all the other brands I try. They also are very supportive for a sandal. My daughter runs these ragged at the playground with no issues.

I have purchased these sandals every summer for the last 4 years. They hold up great all summer long. This year, since my son is 5, I decided to let him choose between these or the Newports. He chose Seacamp, said they were lighter and more flexible. We love these and will continue to buy them every summer for years to come!

I love keens as an adult. I have multiple pairs as well as my husband. We got these for our two boys and they have worn them around a dozen times. The Velcro on the top strap has already stopped holding together.

These are simply the best footwear for summer camp. The openings let air circulate and the material over the toes was very protective. These are pretty and sturdy and we intend to buy them again next summer.

My son is 7 years old and wanted a pair of sneakers "with holes in the sides" like his friend has. I wanted to not be washing socks so much in the summer. He has worn these sandals everyday for about two months and they are holding up well. Great for playgrounds, tree climbing, hiking trails, and the day to day stuff of childhood.

I am in Vanautu on an LDS Charities mission assigned to do humanitarian work. We were advised before we left to get KEEN sandals. It was the best advice. They go through water, hiking, muddy trails into villages, through town and into business meetings and keep looking great. Excellent value for the money. I am a lady but with a wide foot and I purchased a child's shoe for a perfect fit. Take a look at this picture, I have my KEENs on. Wear them walking to church.
Very happy each year I purchase for my son! They are comfortable, softer fabric than similar brands and are durable.
Image is misleading. Color is totally off. Insole is pink not as expected. Otherwise it looks like a well built shoe,
Love Keen sandals. This is at least our 4th pair over the years, and they are great quality and are very sturdy shoes. I love the sandal with toe protection, keeps her feet cool but also protected.
My daughter loves these! We purchase a new pair every summer just because she out grows them , and they always hold up!

Worked even better than the highly recommended H2 model as the sole is a bit more forgiving for tiny feet 18 months . She doesn't want to take them off!! And bonus, I learned they're machine washable!!
These are super good quality. This is my son s second pair. He wears them all summer long for everything. He grew out of the last pair before they wore out. Great because they protect his toes.

design.issue_summary: 구매자들은 디자인에 대한 불만을 제기하며, 제품이 사진과 다르거나 불량한 외관을 가지고 있다고 보고했습니다.
design.strength_summary: 구매자들은 신발의 색상과 디자인에 대해 긍정적인 반응을 보이며, 실제로 더 생생하고 매력적이라는 점을 강조하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Shoes were delivered this morning and see pictures of what they looked like straight of the the box.....covered with large black marks!! I am sure they were great shoes for the 1st owner ......sadly it was not me!! Very disappointed that this seller would send these out and can not see how awful condition they could begin to attempt to say they did not notice .....YUCK!!

Ordered the exact same pair in color and size from Keen online and compared them. Not the same brand at all. Very poor construction, visible glue, totally different toe shape and color. Save your time and money and buy direct from Keen.
We love Keen shoes because they're so durable and supportive. These are no different and the bright color is vibrant and fits my daughter's style perfectly!

Seacamp is the more beachy of the closed toe Keens more open than the Newport h20. Returning as main use will be on dry land woods, and also, the ocean wave flint is aqua and pink on my screen it looked more like teal and peach, but in person it s definitely pink not all boys would like to wear it. How about a more descriptive color name? I think flint refers to the grayish suede-like material, but footbed and accents are ocean wave and LIGHT PINK.
Image is misleading. Color is totally off. Insole is pink not as expected. Otherwise it looks like a well built shoe,
Daughter loves them. Pink way more vibrant in person- a good thing for a spunky 6 year old. Going to order more for my other kids.

We absolutely love this hiking sandal! everything is as mention, very durable very comfortable, waterproof. not cheaply made! highly recommend another purchase. Only thing I would mention is that the colors are slightly lighter than what is shown on Amazon picture. Overall wonderful pair of sandals.
My Granddaughter liked the color and these are her Favorite summer sandal. This is her third pair she owned.

I ordered multiple shoes for daughter to try on for our Disney trip. I wanted to invest in a good walking shoe. I want her to be comfortable all day. Out of the 5 pairs of shoes I ordered, these came in 1st. Initially the color bothered me but honestly, she was able to wear them with everything.

This is my 2nd pair of Keen sandals. I am a full-grown woman that fits the Keen's Big Kid size 6 I wear 7.5 Women's . My first pair Newport H2 has been tried-and-true, traveling to several countries for miles of hikes and walks through all sorts of terrain and weather. I wanted a 2nd pair to wear while my 1st pair was drying from rain rafting beach. These are comparable to the Newport H2's in that both are comfortable, air-dry pretty fast and are the ugliest shoes I own. The main difference is that these are much lighter and nowhere near as clunky and clowny-looking. You won't win any fashion contests with these but they are practical and excellent hiking sandals.
Not a huge fan of the look but Keen just holds up better than all the other brands I try. They also are very supportive for a sandal. My daughter runs these ragged at the playground with no issues.
My daughter LOVES these cute shoes! The colors are vibrant and beautiful. They seem like very sturdy and durable shoes.
Loved the color combo and material quality. We ordered a size up from his sneakers to make sure they fit, but they are still way too narrow for his feet.

I like this sandals. I ordered for our daughter first, snd then I bought the same model but in different color for our son. Very much happy with the purchase. Our children are very active and have narrow legs, so these sandals with wide adjusted strip and closed front zone are covered all our requirements to the summer shoes.

My kids have been wearing Keens since they could walk, and the Seacamp is the most versatile. It's as easy to put on as a sneaker, with a more flexible sole than the newport. The colors stay bright despite lots of play and washing, and we hand down every pair to younger children. My daughter loves the coral orange color so much that we just bought the same pair again in her next size.

Worth the extra 20 or so over the cheaper look alikes. Durable enough for Summer camp and outdoor activities. My daughter who usually refuses putting on her own shoes can actually put these on with ease. Enjoying them and recommend to other parents

First I will say we love the style and fit of these shoes. We love Keens for my adventurous daughter. They are comfortable and it s the only pair of shoes she wants to wear. However, this pair bled a dark pink every time they got wet. Her feet would be completely pink it she was to step in water. I let them soak over night thinking I could get all of the dye out but her feet still get a little pink if she gets them wet.

price.issue_summary: 구매자들은 가격에 비해 품질이 실망스럽고, 제품이 결함이 있는 경우가 많다고 보고하고 있습니다. 이는 소비자에게 큰 불만을 초래하고 있습니다.
price.strength_summary: 구매자들은 가격이 다소 높더라도 품질과 내구성이 뛰어나기 때문에 충분히 가치가 있다고 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Silly me for expecting that spending 55 for a pair of sandals for my 4yr old might guarantee that they weren t defective and falling apart upon delivery. Disappointing quality for a pair of Keens. Certainly do not order this product if you cannot return it for free

Not worth the money at all. My daughter has had these for a month and already the tab on the strap has come off and the laces have snapped, so I don t think she can wear them anymore. Neither defect would be covered by their warranty which after reading it, I m honestly not sure what would be . She s 4 almost 5 but somewhat hard on shoes but we typically get at least 6 months out of tennis shoes and we ve made it full summers with Keens previously. We used to swear by Keens, but I don t think the quality is what it used to be. I m not likely to buy them again.
Ordered a new keen shoes for kids at full price but Received used, broken and dirty shoes. Total scam!
Wow, these are definitely a worthwhile purchase. Great amazing quality. Holding up perfectly. Would recommend.
Always love our Keens. Great value. Good in the water, in rock rivers and on sharp shells. Good traction.
Best sandals my daughter has had. Worth the premium vs less costly brands like Target, Walmart, or even Gymboree or children's place.
Prime made it possible to try before buying! We were extremely happy with them and had a blast at Disneyland in them!
Keen products have always been great quality and adorable. Daughter puts then through the ringer, wears them everyday and has even been rock climbing with them. Killer product. Totally recommend. 110

Worth the extra 20 or so over the cheaper look alikes. Durable enough for Summer camp and outdoor activities. My daughter who usually refuses putting on her own shoes can actually put these on with ease. Enjoying them and recommend to other parents
Great quality sandal for all terrain. My kid loves them, no run spots anywhere. Easy and on and off.
Great product..second pair, son grew out of first ones pretty fast! Of course came promptly with Amazon as usual..
Good shoe, super durable. They are difficult for kids to put on themselves and they make kids feet stink. But I love keens. So we ll made. Will last forever.
We have used Keens since my kids were little. They never disappoint. Comfortable, durable, and the variety of colors are gorgeous. Bought for each of my kids and they used at the pool and beach.
My son LOVES these shoes, can run and do just about anything in them. Great price too. Definitely worth the money

Nice shoes, just overpriced in my opinion, especially compared to the knockoffs on Amazon. Also, I haven't used fully since 1. It's not hot enough, but maybe as summer comes I'll use them more, and 2. I don't think I like this style of shoe because of the obvious pebble, etc that will enter and hurt his feet. But that's my fault for buying.

I know the price is a little high for toddler shoes, but for each age group, we buy our son one pair of keens and one pair of vans. Between those two, he doesn't need any other shoes for the year. These hold up well for learning to walk, hiking, playing in the mud washable people! , swimming lakes etc, YOU NAME IT! My son is HARD on shoes and before we started the two brand plan, we were buying a new pair of shoes at Target or Walmart every month. These are worth buying.
Not a huge fan of the look but Keen just holds up better than all the other brands I try. They also are very supportive for a sandal. My daughter runs these ragged at the playground with no issues.
I love these shoes! This is the second pair I've purchased for my daughter and the quality is great! Worth the money. I buy them a little on the big side so they last 2 years.

product_name: Nike Women's Sneaker Running Shoes

urgent_issues.summary: 구매자들은 내구성과 관련하여 손상된 끈, 이상한 접착제, 찢어진 상자 및 사용된 듯한 외관에 대해 불만을 제기하고 있습니다.

comfort.issue_summary: 구매자들은 착용감이 좋지 않다고 반복적으로 언급하며, 발의 통증과 불편함을 경험하고 있습니다.
comfort.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 매우 편안하고 발을 잘 지지해준다고 반복적으로 언급했습니다. 특히 장시간 착용에도 발에 통증이 없다는 점이 긍정적으로 평가되었습니다.

representative_reviews.text: I purchased these shoes for cross training. I do a lot of jumping, like burpees and jump squats. I have flat feet and these shoes have no arch support, so my feet ached after less than a week of wearing them. I now use them solely for walking around.

The product is advertised incorrectly. I was specifically looking for the 2017 shoe. I have seen newer years models in store. I didn't like that the material of the tread of the shoe had been changed. The 2017 model is more foam and the newer more plasticky feeling. I wasn't happy with the change so I specifically searched for the old ones and spent more than I would have otherwise. The screen says 2017, my receipt says 2018, and my shoe tag says 2019. I gave 2 stars because it is mislabeled and not what I was hoping to receive. The newer model is ok but not as comfortable and has less cushion than the older ones I have.

This running shoe does not give you good support for running. It's bottom is flat so if you have any sensitive spot on the bottom of your feet you will feel it. I'm returning it and getting my old Lunasolo back.
Not a comfortable sneakers. If I wear them all day my feet and legs hurt. The cushion is really flat and you feel the concrete under your feet. Too much money to spend for not such a great sneaker

I work in sales , so is important be comfortable. This shoes , aren t durable , the soles have so many cuts , after couple of weeks walking ll b completely damaged , the way the shoe have been made reduce durability to a 50
I am returning this product due to the damaged shoelaces and the weird white glue on top of one of the shoes.

Be careful. There is a bait and switch going on. If you order the Nike 2017, which is a great shoe, they are swapping it for the 2018 version that is constructed completely differently and has that annoying sewn in tongue that you can barely get your foot into with leg cramps. What is happening Amazon? Don't put the product out there if the product is not the one you have to fulfill.
Oddly did not fit at all. Thought I was buying similar or same to shoes I love that I bought at Nordstrom.. these however are not nearly wide enough in the toebox..
Flip flops would make better running shoes than these. Maybe cute for people who don't want to run and don't mind joints aching?

Spending this amount on shoes I was expecting them to be new. When they came in the box was all torn up and the shoes look slightly used! There are dirt stains on the sides and the bottoms definitely look like they have been worn before. Paying this much for new shoes and getting this was upsetting. Nowhere in the description did it say shoes may be worn definitely returning.

I purposely ordered the "Nike Womens Free Rn 2018 Running Shoes 942837" because they're so comfortable, and I walk a lot at my job and having a toddler. Well I ordered a grey pair because my white pair get so dirty so quickly, the pair that I received from this listing isn't even the same style, design or color. The laces don't match, its a completely different style of shoe. Super frustrating because this was supposed to be a christmas present and then on top of it, theyre not even the right shoe. they're so stiff, I wouldn't order these if I were you. Who knows what pair you'll actually end up with. Mine also didn't have any stuffing inside the shoe, like they'd been tried on who knows how many times.

I LOVE these shoes! I rarely ever buy shoes without trying them on first, and this was the best purchase I could have ever made. They are super super comfortable and I have not had any issues with them while working out. I also sometimes wear them while at work and they make the perfect "athleisure" shoe. I love how the tops of the shoes are more square so it gives my feet plenty of room and they don't feel squished by the end of the day. My feet are never sore at the end of the day. Highly recommend!!

Nike free run are my favorite shoes to run in. I've been wearing them for 5 years now. Every time a new model comes out I try it out since they're always so flexible AND supportive. Thing is this model let me down. I run half marathons and after mile 7 8 these make the bottoms of my feet really sore. I don't know if it's less cushioning than the other models or what but I'm thinking I'll buy and older model for my next half. If you're running less than 7 8 miles you'll be fine.

I like the comfort of the soft soles but the sole material is so soft it allows pebbles to get into the holes and they stick in there until you pick them out. Some are difficult to remove. You can hear the pebbles on the concrete when walking. Also not a good idea to wear these shoes with pebbles in the soles on hardwood floors as this can scratch the floors.
These are super comfy and have a nice toe bed and the arch feels great!! I ordered up a 1 2 size and they fit perfect!
These shoes are very comfortable. They support my feet throughout the whole day and also look very stylish.

I work 12 hour days on my feet with high arches and run on my days off. These are the only shoe I ve found that can manage both activities without foot pain. I had the 2017 version last me a year before I got these and they still hold up.

I bought a pair of these shoes from a local store back in 2018 and loved how they fit my foot like a glove and felt so light on my feet for any kind of activity. I went back to the same store a couple of years later to buy them again but they did not carry the same model. I was very happy to find them on Amazon in many more beautiful colors than the two colors my initial pair were available in. I had bought my first pair for 60 and feel that spending 100 is rather expensive but it is also difficult to find running shoes that feel so good and I loved the bright color so I bought 3 more pairs to hopefully keep me in running shoes for the next several years. My first pair has held up very well for me and have been washed several times so I feel good about the overall quality of the shoes. I have low arches and have had double bunion surgery many years ago so I usually exchange the insoles that come in shoes for insoles with an arch. I did not need to do this for about three years with my first pair but lately began having some toe pain so I simply added added a gel arch under the regular insole and that easily solved the problem. I generally wear a 5 or 5.5 but a 6 fits me perfectly. I also have narrow heels and these shoes gently hug my feel all around, giving a solid feeling of stability and lightness.
Absolutely the best fitting sneaker I've ever owned. I'm not a runner but rather an avid walker. These are supportive with just enough cushion. My feet feel completely comfortable. Highly recommend.

These were perfect for my narrow heels - no slipping, and SO comfortable! I wanted to order another pair in a different color but learned that this is the 2018 version and availability is very limited. I then ordered the latest version Free Run 5.0 , which I don't like nearly as well as the 2018 version, although it is still very comfortable.

My husband bought these for me for Christmas a few years ago. They got worn out because I would wear them at work. I looked for them everywhere to get a new pair but it was so hard to find them again. I m a nurse and work on my feet for 13-14 hours let me tell you... my feet never hurt!!!! 10 10 recommend.

Great product. But way over priced. I paid 50 for them before. But now they are not available anywhere the seller decided to put the price up so high 150. But because they are so comfortable I paid it.

For those looking for a flexible running shoe, this feels amazing on your ankles and toes. Only complaint is that they're tight around the upper middle, but nothing a lace adjustment can't fix. Tongue doesn't interfere with stride, neither. Light and breathable material makes these perfect for hot climates. I love the reflective features on the front and rear as well for running in early morning and evening. Would recommend wearing thin socks if buying at normal size, if wearing thicker size, buy half size up.
These are super comfortable and can be pulled on and off without untying the laces, because they have stretch in the fabric. Not much arch support but very cushioned insole.
Most comfortable shoe I have ever had. I have had 3 pair. Power walking outside treadmill on bad weather days.
Fits like a glove, sure footed, no heel pain, no instep pain. As an RN, hands down, favorite shoe of all time

size.issue_summary: 많은 구매자들이 사이즈가 작고 좁아서 불편함을 겪고 있으며, 사이즈가 잘못 배송되는 경우도 빈번합니다.
size.strength_summary: 많은 구매자들이 사이즈가 정확하고 발가락에 여유가 있어 편안하다고 언급했습니다. 이로 인해 장시간 착용에도 불편함이 없다는 긍정적인 반응이 많습니다.

representative_reviews.text: I ordered size 6.5 because that is what I wear in Nike. The shoe was too small and narrow for my foot.
Flip flops would make better running shoes than these. Maybe cute for people who don't want to run and don't mind joints aching?

Like other reviews, runs very small. I sized up two sizes and it still was too small. With this style, there is elastic holding the shoe on, the laces are pretty much just for looks so not much wiggle room to get shoe on.
Didn t fit Was way to narrow I don t wear a wide shoe so ordered my normal size and couldn t get my foot in

I have always worn a 7.5 medium width- but these shoes are very tight and a bit too narrow for me. My toes go to the very front of shoe and I have to wear very thin socks..... even with the thin socks, these are somewhat tight fitting. They are lightweight and seem to have a decent cushion, - unfortunately I cant wear them very often. The bottom sole has nice traction to the pavement but that same traction material makes a noise when walking. Won t buy again.

Received a pair of navy flip flops instead of a sleek looking pair of running shoes. Look, I know accidents happen.. but after 6 years of Prime, this is the first experience I ve had where the item is just dead wrong. Super bummed because they were for a 5k benefit for work...happening tomorrow. If I may, a request for the seller distributor Please pay attention to what s going in the box spend a few more seconds double checking so this happens less in the future - it d make for an improved customer experience!

This running shoe does not give you good support for running. It's bottom is flat so if you have any sensitive spot on the bottom of your feet you will feel it. I'm returning it and getting my old Lunasolo back.
I am a true size 9. I don t buy narrow width shoes but I do have a tiny foot in that aspect. The size 9 is tight over the top of my foot and my toes go to the edge. You should order a half size up.

I purposely ordered the "Nike Womens Free Rn 2018 Running Shoes 942837" because they're so comfortable, and I walk a lot at my job and having a toddler. Well I ordered a grey pair because my white pair get so dirty so quickly, the pair that I received from this listing isn't even the same style, design or color. Super frustrating because this was supposed to be a christmas present and then on top of it, theyre not even the right shoe. they're so stiff, I wouldn't order these if I were you. Who knows what pair you'll actually end up with. Mine also didn't have any stuffing inside the shoe, like they'd been tried on who knows how many times.

I purchased these shoes for cross training. I do a lot of jumping, like burpees and jump squats. I have flat feet and these shoes have no arch support, so my feet ached after less than a week of wearing them. I now use them solely for walking around.

I bought these as a replacement pair for a really worn out pair that I absolutely loved. Unfortunately, the listing is inaccurate. I ordered what I thought were US women s size 7 shoes in the Elemental Rose Particle Rose Gunsmoke color. I received US women s size 9.5 shoes, which turns out to be UK women s size 7. Disappointed. Returning and won t try to purchase again to receive the correct size.
I have these same exact shoes and I ordered the same size as my tag shows and the shoes that came are HUGE. Tag shows the size I ordered but definitely not accurate. Extremely disappointed.
Ordered size 7, received size 9.5. Returned shoe, asking for an exchange to size 7. Received 9.5 again. I GIVE UP.

Almost 100 shoe that overall feels as though it was manufactured for 5.00. Granted it's a running shoe, so it's a light shoe, but I used to buy Nike running shoes that were a heck of a lot different. I gave it 2 stars because they're nice to look at, but that's about it. Not made for wide feet, either. Pretty narrow shoe. If you have a wide foot, I'd recommend ordering a half size up if you must have this shoe D
Normally wears a 7.5. Way too small. Have to pay over 5 to return.. Like the shoe, but runs really small Ordered and waiting on the 8.5.
Great fit! Fit to size. Very flexible and full of cushion from toe to heel. I am on my feet a lot and on types of floor surfaces so this shoe is very diverse for my needs.

I work out in the gym 6 days a week and need a decent shoe that's cushioned and stable. This is a great shoe for my workouts and has enough stability when I"m doing lunges or squats. I don't run in these, I never could run in Nike's but for everything else I do spin, cross trainer, step mill, treadmill hills walking, weightlifting these are perfect.
I have bought a lot of different air max shoes in the past. These just haven t given me the perfect feel that most of the others have.
Very comfortable shoes especially for people in the nursing field who work 12 hour shifts. I love them

This is my third pair of these shoes over the last 5 years. I wear them for tennis, biking, running. They last a long time and I only replace them because the rubber bottom becomes smooth after so much use. I highly recommend them
The shoe was hard inside, no support. I need to by a different enter sole. Nike always had great support now they are more like Sketchers.

I love these sneakers! This is the third pair that I've purchased, and I hope Nike never quits making them! I walk every day and these shoes see some miles. I have bunions on both feet, have injured both feet so foot pain from the wrong shoes is a real issue , and need a wider toe box but "normal" in the heel. These sneaks fit perfectly without buying a wide width I do go up a half size though . I'm able to get my walks in without even a twinge of protest from my tootsies. They are so comfortable my toes can wiggle, no heel slippage, and great support. I wish the arch were a tiny bit higher, but this isn't enough of an issue for me to knock off a star. Best shoes, hands or feet down.

I never justify spending this much on sneakers but I had been being very frugal and had owned the same pair in 2 different colors. I ordered them for work but ultimately decided they were too beautiful to risk damage to. I am a bartender at a very busy restaurant bar. They are also not black, they are NAVY W black soles which goes better with the other colors. Gave 4 stars for comfort cuz I did wear them to work just once and they started to hurt my feet but having had these same sneakers in other colors, I know that they break in well. I got cheap Dr. Scholl inserts for my last pair and they were so comfortable I wore them until they HAD to go, so the comfort does come after wearing them in and with the help of some maybe 15 inserts, I m also in my feet ALL day, wearing them around for the day and what not I had NO DISCOMFORT. The colors are absolutely gorgeous which is why I can t risk these beauties getting something spilled on them.
Love these shoes they are so comfortable and durable cus I m hard on shoes! But these are hanging in there nicely!!

It's was a gift for my wife , she's has trouble with her feet hurting when she stands at work for to long. Also she lost to take walks to try and keep fit these shoes help with comfort, they well made as for as craftsmanship the last pair lasted 3yrs so overall it's a great buy !
I love these sneakers are very very comfortable and give me some of the support I need I wish you had more art support but it's still good I get several compliments

representative_reviews.text: I am so disappointed in these shoes. I have been buying Nike s for 32 years . I think I accidentally bought a counterfeit pair at a discount shoe store at a mall once. Ran for 23 years and would buy several pairs a year. I tried these on right away and they remind me of the pair I thought was counterfeit. Can t say for sure but I am not happy. Box was chewed up. No receipt or packing slip. The shoe tag says 2019 . The inside tongue is not even sewn flat so it did not fell good on my toe the minute I put on. Now without even a packing slip, I don t know if I will be able to return? I paid 189.00 for these and when I started looking for info they are selling for 85.00 in this years model. Not happy with this transaction.

The Nike box wasn't sealed practically busted apart and it looks like someone already returned them due to defects with the shoes. One shoe tied and the other untied . I also paid around 130 for these shoes however, someone left the pricetag on the box for 85. Kinda angry and very disappointed...
I loved the way they looked online but when I got them they looked very cheaply made and looked used
100 worth the money. Very comfy and light. May take a day to adjust to the tongue of the shoe if you have high arches

I love NIKE except the the OVER PRICED COST. I get the comfort I need, most of the time. I have always loved the ' air max series' and the squared off fronts so my toes do NOT RUB . Now that I work a ' physical job ' and have put on weight and ' real aged ' these have been great for standing long hours and short walks over those hours. I really bought them for my ' exercise walking ' on uneven sidewalks and over unpaved grounds , these are the sturdier than most. NIKE IS SO HIGH PRICED THOUGH I HAVE CHANGED TO A GREAT SHOE COMPANY NAMED RYKA so much better for work and exercise and especially here on Amazon the selection is fantastic and prices are much lower.

I love these sneakers. They look awesome and are very light weight. The arch support is just right for me. I bought these to replace a worn out pair of Asiacs that I really liked and didn't think I'd find anything as good- I'm on my feet a lot and Nike doesn't disappoint. At first I thought they were over priced at 90 but no regrets- you get what you pay for, as they say.

Way too expensive, but I honestly have not had shoes this comfortable, ever. Especially right out of the box! I like the anti-slip bottom, the comfortable air pockets inside, and the style of the shoe. The only things I don't like, other than the outrageous price, is that the laces are too short and rigid, the lace holes are too small, and the shoe is too narrow. But once I change the laces, I can honestly live with the other stuff and be very pleased with these shoes. I would love order them again if I find them at a better price.
Excellent sneakers, bought them for a trip with lots of walking and they were great. I have plantar fasciitis and these sneakers were a dream. Loved them so much bought my mom a pair.
Love this SHOE! Everything about it is great, from how it looks to how it feels. Comfortable, durable and LOOK BOMB. Would buy again
Very nice color and comfortable. I can wear thus for 8-hour work that requires lots of standing hours.

I love these sneakers. They are light weight and so comfortable. I use them to walk daily 1 to 2 miles. Best purchase! Even better, they arrived early! I would recommend these sneakers to anyone who enjoys walking, going to the gym, or even casual wearing.

representative_reviews.text: I have owned several pairs of the Asics GT-2000 5 shoes and they were excellent. Since that generation is no longer available, I ordered the GT-2000 8, expecting they would be even better. They are unwearable. The heal has been shortened and has very little structure compared to the old design. While the old design felt like it molded to my foot, the new design slips around uncontrollably! I'm going to need to find a different shoe to wear.
The inside heal cup has a ridge which I assume is to keep the insert from riding up. This has caused severe blistering on my right foot. Be aware that this could happen to you as well.
This is my eighth pair of the GT-2000. Excruciating pain in my right foot after running a mile. Make sure and return within the allotted time.

The left foot fits perfectly the right foot the heel sits back on the embedded membrane for memory foam so it's somewhat uncomfortable I considered returning them but I thought maybe by redoing the laces I might be able to tie it differently.. but I'll keep them, right now I'm walking with them I bought them so I could eventually get to running but they will not work for running but for walking they do. So I guess it's just a minor factory defect on the right shoe.
I bought the shoe to help with my back and over pronate problem. Shoe does not provide the relief I needed and added insert do not fit.

Shoes look nice, but feels like you are running on a piece of wood, not a lot of give at all. Wanted to see if they broke in after a few runs but it is still quite uncomfortable. Someone might be looking for something like that, but definitely not what we thought it would be.

I have used Asics before and was happy. I am on an old Brooks. Bought this Asics and walked at home so kept them past return date. I recently started to wear them outdoor for a walk and so disappointed. Both feet soles hurt and the right foot fell asleep. This happened on 5 different occasions when walking on them cannot imagine running on them. After 6th time walking on them, my feet do not hurt nor did it fall asleep but they are not comfortable. Using my Brooks until I cannot.

Since I started running a lot, more than a decade ago, I have always used and had success with the Nike Structure Zoom. Late, last year I decided to try a different brand, just to see if I could find some even better. After reading articles on support shoes I settled on the GT-2000. When I looked on Amazon I found I love the design of these shoes. I think they look very sharp. When I first started running in them I got several blisters but the support was great. They never did fit quite as well as my Nike's but blisters did eventually stop. All in all they are great stability shoes. I have switched back to Nike, however. The ASICS only seem to give me 100 to 200 miles of running before they start to wear down and I experience aches and pains in my legs. The Nike Structure usually gives me around 400 miles before I feel any aches. I'm a big guy, 5'11, 200 pounds and I run consistently in the 8 to 9 minute pace range. So, someone lighter or who doesn't run as hard might get more mileage out of the ASICS. For me, they are good shoes, but the Nike's are still the best fit and comfort for me as well as being a better value, lasting so much longer.

After a 3 mile run I realized that small stick made a hole and almost went thru all the way ,where it could have been harmful . I returned it with explanation and they refunded 50 because the shoe was used . I would expect more from company like Asics but I guess it is what it is.

DISLIKE BUYING THESE FROM AMAZON. I don t wear them running. They re worn indoors for work due to my back. As you can see, after 2 month they re in EXCELLENT condition HOWEVER see that nodules knobs on outside rear on the bottom have both cone off. I can t return to ASICS because I bought them on Amazon. So here I am now with 100 dollar pair of tennis shoes in excellent condition except for the rubber Nigel s coming off in the same spot on both shoes.

Another disappointing Asics shoe. Used to know exactly what to expect when getting an Asics shoe...but not anymore... it's a crapshoot now. This one is made very narrow and has poor cushioning and no arch support.

After a couple weeks of use, on of the nubs on the bottom side edge peeled back. Can t find a glue that will stick to hold it back down. Dont want to cut it off a new pair of shoes. I like Asics, but this pair is defective.

Been buying these shoes since 2014. Every new version they lose ankle support little by little. The materials get cheaper and the quality suffers. The first pair I bought costed 130 on sale and for good reason. They were top of the line trail running shoes. These new ones are cheaply made and your ankles knees lower back and hips will tell you so if you buy these and intend on running with any consistency. Already after a months use the toe of mine has collapsed in the middle somehow, my ankles are swollen and my shins hurt. There is absolutely no ankle support either. I guess the new trend is to go low profile but I guess that means I will also have to go with another company.

What caught my eyes first is the beautiful shark blue color. It breaths new aesthetics into the line and gives the shoe more dynamic look.The new design of the shoe is 10 10 however it falls short of the comforty, such as not enough room for the toe boxes. This shoes provide excellent stability while running but make sure you put on some long socks before wearing them. The edges of both of the shoes are made of cheap material which had already been causing some blisters and cuts on the back of both of my ankles.
After 3 uses the sole in one has moved so my foot isn t fully on it. Support is minimal and size is a little small. Have had ASICS for years. Not good

As a moderate runner who logs 12 miles around town each week, I've usually been happy over the years with Asics GT-2000 line. The latest addition to that line--the GT-2000 8 Running Shoe--feels lighter and more flexible than its immediate predecessors, but it still offers good lateral support and a nicely cushioned step. It's also an extremely handsome shoe. I bought mine in Grand Shark Black and have gotten several compliments on how cool they look. Good purchase.
Great support and wide 10 1 2 4E enough space for wide flat feet. Lots of arch support with just the right amount of cushioning.

Has very hard polymers in the arch and good quality foam in the heal. Light weight , breathable mesh. I have a lawn care business Wear 5 days a week 8 hours a day. My last pair lasted 9 months. Hip pain is also gone after wearing these. Don t be cheap.

Got these for my husband as a gift, he has a long history of back issues and had surgery a few months ago. These have been great in getting him back to standing and walking all day at his job. He says they are the most comfortable shoes he's had in a long time, good support and nice and light to wear. Only downside is the insoles I got to go with them did not fit because they were too wide for this shoe, and protruded into the mesh at the inner arch area. But he wears them fine with no extra insoles.

I'm in the over 55 crowd and this is a very comfortable walking shoe. I'm not a runner so I cannot comment on that. It has good lift and cushion especially in the sole of the foot. It does not have as much arch support as others but it is sufficient even for me and I do require a little more than the average person. I have a narrow foot and this shoe fits snug. If you're foot is slightly wider you will definitely need to get a wider size. Great price too.
I only buy Asics with front and rear gel cushioning. I use them for everyday walking, sometimes for 1 mile hikes, very comfy. I also have 2 pairs of the Asics Zeruss model.

I overpronate pretty bad on my right foot. So much so, if I am not wearing the correct shoes when I walk for exercise, it gets painful. I have tried different stability shoes from Hoka, Nike, and Brooks. They all have good points but I have had to do something to make them work insole change or add, lacing pattern, wrap . These ASICS are the only shoes I could take out of the box and walk miles without pain. They don't have the cushioning of a Hoka or the secure fit of the Nike but the stability design works for me without question.

These are some of the best gym shoes I have found and they feel like im running on a cloud I was going to purchase some brooks however I am extremely happy with this product I workout in the gym 3to 4 hrs everyday except for sundays and my work outs are extreme and only time I rest is when im moving from one set to another and these shoes are continues and they keep up no matter if im running ,walking ,are strength training these shoes as far as I can say are bad to the bone and were worth every single penny .
I love the way this shoe fits, and how it feels. I love its cushioning and support. It is a key element for my power walks. Glad I made this purchase.

Used for walking, leisure, and cross-training. Repeat order because my first pair were so good. Typically walk 15-20 miles per week, 3 - 4 weight training sessions, and wear nearly daily. Great support, although some leisure shoes may be more comfortable.
I'm a heavy guy and flat footed. It's been a year and figured it was time to buy a new pair. I'm buying another pair as we speak.
Extremely comfortable running shoe. I have a arch that needs support and my feet feel great in these shoes.

I have flat feet and generally on longer walks or otherwise being on my feet for a long time, I get fatigue in my legs, particularly my shins. These shoes offer exceptional cushioning, and felt almost like mini-air mattresses under my feet in comparison to an older pair of running walking shoes I'd been wearing. This model also seems to have great lateral stability and helps with another existing issue where I pronate on my left foot due to an old knee injury on the right side. You will feel less impact in your feet and legs with these shoes compared to many most others. My only nit to pick is that they were a bit on the narrow side for my feet.... though as I've warn them more probably a dozen uses walking 2-4 miles they've broken in a bit and are more comfortable. The fit in length seems to form.
I am a big guy so a good shoe so plenty of cushion and support is very important to me when I run. After a few runs, I have to say this may be my favorite shoe I've ever purchased.

These were comfortable when sitting. But they fit very narrow near the heel so I felt as tho I would roll an ankle. I would try a wider model next time and had intended to trade for that. However the return would only allow a full return as it came from ASICS.

I have wide feet so I did one size up on this pair and fit perfect. very comfortable shoes. good for walking and running.
These are the best shoes out there. The fit is perfect and finding a shoe with extra wide fit is hard. I am in these shoes for 12 hr shifts and my feet never ache like with other shoes
Shoes fit perfect from the moment I put them on. How often does that happen? Very happy with my purchase, shoes are great!

True fit. Great feel. Took them out for a 2 mile run. Cushioning felt great. No pain afterward. Felt responsive and light. This is my new go-to running shoe. Was using cumulus gel 21 before, but I am much more pleased with this.
I love the way this shoe fits, and how it feels. I love its cushioning and support. It is a key element for my power walks. Glad I made this purchase.

So I wanted these series of asics because I'm obese and my feet and legs have been hurting more recently. even though I don't stand a lot currently. I have a pair of gel conture? 6 shoes. But I wanted something better or least evaluated as better. These were rated as such. I am 11.5 extra wide. My asics before were. But either because it's running shoes or the series. The product came early when selecting the third party store that had these shoes in stock. They fit just as expected and proved so much support
Shoe offers great support and comfort. I did find the shoe to run small and narrow. I usually wear 12M. Needed a 12.5 W in this shoe. Great value in my opinion.

Shin splints no more. Great shoe to prevent overpronation due to flat feet. Provides great stability.10 wide fits as expected. The only complaint is that they lack bounce. A bit too hard on the landings for my taste. Otherwise a great running show.

I use these for competitive 6's indoor volleyball. The drop isn't ideal but the comfort, laces, and breathability vs the volleyball shoe alternatives is ideal for my narrow , no heel feet. These don't rub my pinky toe raw the way leather sided shoes do.

These new ones are cheaply made and your ankles knees lower back and hips will tell you so if you buy these and intend on running with any consistency. Already after a months use the toe of mine has collapsed in the middle somehow, my ankles are swollen and my shins hurt. There is absolutely no ankle support either. I guess the new trend is to go low profile but I guess that means I will also have to go with another company.
The inside heal cup has a ridge which I assume is to keep the insert from riding up. This has caused severe blistering on my right foot. Be aware that this could happen to you as well.

The left foot fits perfectly the right foot the heel sits back on the embedded membrane for memory foam so it's somewhat uncomfortable I considered returning them but I thought maybe by redoing the laces I might be able to tie it differently.. but I'll keep them, right now I'm walking with them I bought them so I could eventually get to running but they will not work for running but for walking they do. So I guess it's just a minor factory defect on the right shoe.
Shoe had a great feeling and the tread held up but the material was not to good for the long run hole in shoe by the 8 month mark of 60miles a week at work

As a moderate runner who logs 12 miles around town each week, I've usually been happy over the years with Asics GT-2000 line. The latest addition to that line--the GT-2000 8 Running Shoe--feels lighter and more flexible than its immediate predecessors, but it still offers good lateral support and a nicely cushioned step. It's also an extremely handsome shoe. I bought mine in Grand Shark Black and have gotten several compliments on how cool they look. Good purchase.
Inside sole is very bouncy? Very hard to stand still , this shoe are made for moving in which case there great.

These are some of the best gym shoes I have found and they feel like im running on a cloud I was going to purchase some brooks however I am extremely happy with this product I workout in the gym 3to 4 hrs everyday except for sundays and my work outs are extreme and only time I rest is when im moving from one set to another and these shoes are continues and they keep up no matter if im running ,walking ,are strength training these shoes as far as I can say are bad to the bone and were worth every single penny .

I really like this brand of shoes for ultimate comfort and support. They last awhile. My feet sweat a lot so it's nice the soles can be easily removed to air em out. A little expensive but a solid shoe that will last awhile maybe buying new insoles in the future to restore comfort if you're on your feet all day like me

Before you say I don't know what I'm talking about, I've been wearing Asics for the last 10 years exclusively. I have some foot issues, so I buy the same model, same size, and sometimes even the same color to ensure I get consistent fit and support. When they wear out, I buy a new pair and rotate the older ones to my lawn mowing shoes. The last couple pairs of this exact same shoe have been disappointing from a durability stand point. I run in them about once a week, and walk a few miles a day in them, and they just don't last a long time like they used to. The sole wears down within a couple weeks and this most recent pair had the back of the shoe heel area break and crack. Fit and support are usually very consistent. Just finding I have to buy a new pair within about 2 months of buying the last pair, whereas it used to be 5 months. As a result I'll begin looking at other brands.
Appreciate how Amazon got me a shoe that's been out of production for two years. Just awesome and brand new. Thanks

I've been wearing this style for over a decade. I like the fit, and they've always worked very well for me. Quite durable and I'm able to put several hundred miles on each pair. Will definitely be buying again.

Shin splints no more. Great shoe to prevent overpronation due to flat feet. Provides great stability.10 wide fits as expected. The only complaint is that they lack bounce. A bit too hard on the landings for my taste. Otherwise a great running show.
Comfortable but wear out quickly. Have used them for working inside of a grocery store and they have holes in them all ready in less than 3 months. The 1000s used to give me 8-9 months.

Has very hard polymers in the arch and good quality foam in the heal. Light weight , breathable mesh. I have a lawn care business Wear 5 days a week 8 hours a day. My last pair lasted 9 months. Hip pain is also gone after wearing these. Don t be cheap.
Bought them for work hospital after two months no support and my feet screamed every night after work until buying something different

I normally need aftermarket insoles to get the support I need for me fit to not hurt - These work perfectly right out of the box ! This is a big win - I dont have to buy 100 inserts to be able t wear them all day -
Well, after 400 km I can say that these are good running shoes and even solved a knee pain problem ... I am very satisfied and they also look good
Shoes fit perfect from the moment I put them on. How often does that happen? Very happy with my purchase, shoes are great!

It looks like this is the last style that I will be buying of the GT-1000 series. Newer styles are not only ugly, but aren't as comfortable.

Been wearing these for a few months now and they still look like new. Very comfortable. Nice design. I clean them with a damp cotton cloth twice a month what makes them last forever.
Compared to my other pair if asics, the kayano 26, this is slightly less premium. To me not really a good looking shoe. But it fits and is comfortable.

I've been wearing this style for over a decade. I like the fit, and they've always worked very well for me. Quite durable and I'm able to put several hundred miles on each pair. Will definitely be buying again.
has a classy look and design,it could be a lot more comfortable if it fitted just right.little small.

I was pleasantly surprised These shoes seem to look even better when you put 'em on they're just like the photos show blue, black, with slight orange highlights You can't go wrong with these .. I'm a 12 XW and these fit really well
Enjoying this shoe so much I bought two more pairs in different colors. Looks great and is very comfortable.

I have bought the Asics GT2000 for almost a decade. This version is one of the best, I do insert a improved foot insert for the another, creating a almost perfect fit. I wish the cost wasn't as high , and the most popular colors are never available when they are reducing prices. If you don't buy early you don't get all the color choices. I wish all the colors came in the 4E extra wide version as well. More toe room reduces the cramped toe feeling.
These are comfortable everyday sneakers and seem to be sized correctly. I own three different pairs with different color schemes.
What I really like is the consistent fit year to year even as the model changes. I have been wearing this shoe for years as a runner and it always works. Only running shoe I will buy.
I love the comfortable feel if the ASICS brand! I also like the round heavy duty shoe strings they use in their shoes

I have run in this shoe for years. My only worry was would they be new and perfect? Or, was I getting another persons returns. They are perfect in every way. New out of the box. I was so satisfied I ordered another pair of a different color.

I hope the brand stands by the quality defect and get me a replacement, and if that happens even it means I can trust the brand and will keep buying their products.

We ve been a huge fan of Keen for years. Bought these for my niece when we took her to Disney. Day 3 she said she had a blister. It was then I noticed a huge hole in her heel. Definitely shocked. I ve bought Keens for all my family whenever we take them. I love Keens that much. But this is shocking. Hopefully it s a fluke and not quality slipping away.
The shoes are very hard to get on a wet foot. The opening for the ankle is tight compared to the last pair of Keen shoes we had.

Was excited about these sandals for an active 5yo boy. Like the tread and bump toe. Unfortunately I noticed the rubberized sole coming loose from the sandal upper in less than 3 wearings of the shoe on n light conditions. Ex church and grocery store not hiking bike riding or wet conditions. Very disappointed I missed the return window. Costly mistake on my part.

The shoes are nice but it looked like I wasn't the first person to buy the shoes as the box was smashed, the tissue paper had a hole in it and there was no sticker on the bottom like when I purchased my pair.
Hard to get on. Uncomfortable material. Poorly designed strap. 3.5 yr old consistently prefers full shoe in hot weather to these despite living in a different brand last summer.

Wore them for the first time today and almost fell on my face at the restaurant. They are SO SLIPPERY I can t even imagine how they d perform on wet rocks on a hike! My SO wore Sanuk flip flops and didn t notice anything wrong about the floor. Disappointed!

Ugh, I thought Keens were supposed to be wonderful. I bought these for wet-dry shoes for my sons to walk around Disney and also for the beach. Well, once they get wet...they stay that way. This means irritated, grumpy sons with wet shoes all day that caused blisters while walking around Disney. Never again.

Good quality, comfortable fit, but they are not, by any means, odor free. They make my 19 mo boy's feet smell terribly, even indoors, with the air conditioning set at 72. I wouldn't recommend them, for sure. I'm not buying them again.
Once you get them on, they stay on. But hard to get on, especially for little ones with wiggley feet. Also there is no give to stretch them on.
Shoes arrived and were very obviously used. Grass blades stuck in them, dirty, squished gum on the bottom, the soles scraped up and frayed seems.

I'm able to wear a children's 4 so I tried these. They rubbed on the bottom of my ankle bone "knob." The sides of these come up high so they can rub and create irritation. Maybe they'll work fine for your kiddo's foot, but check it, esp if they can't verbalize the details of the fit. It would be really painful if that rubbed on a long hike.

These are so heavy! We have also heard amazing things about Crocs for active, outdoor kids. But these were a huge disappointment. They're extremely heavy and have no flexibility in the sole. We ended up getting the Pediped Sahar sandals and they are amazing! Way lighter, while still being perfect for hikes, wading through creeks, play grounds and even 2 weeks backpacking through the U.K. With my 3 year old. Skip the Keens!

I found the width of the holes to be too wide and my grandson's little toe stuck out of the shoe. This, to me, was dangerous as I bought the shoes for bike riding and other outside summer play. Needless to say, I returned this purchase. I would not recommend this shoe.

I ordered the Seacamp and Newport to see the difference. Both are very similar except for two things...the rubber covers the toe area more on the Newport compared to the Seacamp and the Newport has an overlapping strap, which might keep the shoe on better, but not sure. Ultimately I went with the Newport. I d keep both though if I could! Seacamp would be an excellent shoe to get on and off quickly and both seem comfortable, soft and flexible. Once we use them this summer, I ll give an update.

We need substantial arch support for our kid. This is just about perfect. This is the second pair of Keens we have purchased. The first pair is still great our kid simply outgrew them. I wish they had more sizes. Otherwise, really good. Our family recommends them.

I bought these for my daughter to wear when we go hiking in Hawaii. The hikes we go on are extremely muddy, hiking with these made the hike more enjoyable. They were sturdy, supportive and had great traction from mud to stream to dry trail.

These are the most comfortable shoes I have found. I have issues with my feet swelling do to arthritis these I can adjust for the swelling. Love them. Have 3 different colors Very well made and great support.
Literally the best shoes we have found for our little outdoorsman. Great arch support and toe coverage!

The footbed is built like an adult shoe, contoured with plenty of padding. I am impressed with the quality and would buy these again even given the pricetag. I noticed a few reviewers noted that it left sores on their kid's foot. The edges are rounded and we have not had any issues with this despite the fact that we broke them in walking around an amusement park for 7 days .

I chose these for my son because I used to wear Keens about 15 years ago when I was hiking in the White Mountains. My son was going to be doing rappelling and then working in the water. These are a good sturdy sandal which has a good sole that does not slip. These sandals did not disappoint. When it came time to perform he had all of the footing he needed. I ended up switching from a different type of shoe and bought myself the same product. Keen has amazing quality and the size is true to fit. I love Keen and recommend them to anyone. This sandal is great for any and all activities no matter how intense.
I love the comfort and protection these sandals offer but don't like the velcro straps because they detach on occasion especially when playing or running.

I bought these for myself for kayaking. They are extremely comfortable and keep my feet from being torn up on rocks. The ONLY thing I don't care for is the velcro strap on the top. It's unnecessary, curls up and gets in the way.

I have been wearing keens now to work for over 5 years and as a registered nurse I never have to think how tired or sore my feet are because they never get tired or sore wearing this KEENS. I love these keens and praise them to everyone and anyone who will listen. They are so much better than the danskos and crocs plus you can wear them on hikes, and anywhere outdoors. This style just happen to be my favorite and all I wear to work now. I even got my nephew to buy some and those kids love these shoes. They are great for anyone and everyone. I highly recommend these shoes for men, women, and all children.!!
Same Keen quality I ve come to trust. Purchased for myself because true red isn t available in a women s model. Comfortable- great traction-dries quickly. stands up to long wear!

These are perfect! Excellent arch support. Well made materials and crafting. Colors are bright and looks just like picture. Price was wonderful. I expect these to last. One a side note about others that try to copy these shoes Tried quite a few others brands in order to save money, but that didn't help, other knock off brands were breaking within a few hours use, and other knock off brands had no support hurting my kids feet. I ended up returning other copy brands and bought these!

They were comfy right out of the box. I wear them every day. I plan on wearing them for as long as I can. I am going to wear wool socks with them they are so comfy. I am an adult with small feet. These shoes don't look like children's shoes. I can wear them and pass them off as adult shoes. I get lots of complements on them. They seem to be well made and will stand up to years of wear.
What I like is it keeps my baby feet safe while walking and running. It protect his feet from hitting somewhere while walking.

After buying several pairs of shoes and sandals for my 18 month old, I ordered these. His feet aren t overly fat, but he clenches his toes and it s hard getting anything on. These are perfect, wife at the front, but the Velcro allows you to yihten them to stay on. The inside is nice and soft with a little arch support.

Someone mentioned in a review that they found the sandals more flexible than other Keen soles. I disagree. My son found them uncomfortable, I think because they are stiffer than anything else he's ever worn. As others have mentioned, it would be nice if Keen could figure out sizing. The 8s I initially ordered are about the size of the Crocs size 6 he wore last year. His winter Keen boots were a size 10, so in hindsight I don't know why I paid attention to people who checked "true to size" and ordered an 8 probably b c this all started with the 8.5W Stride Rite's I ordered that were enormous - probably legit true to size . These are the ones we landed on that are wide enough for him and he found comfortable. Less stiff sole and fabric than the Keens. Not as wide as the Keens but fit him with a thin sock and look just wide enough

I really like the fit of these sandals, every other shoe I have bought slips off his heel easily. He is 10 months and wearing a size 4, and there is a little room to grow.

My 4th pair of Keens and the best looking one! I wear a 6.5 to 7 in USA women's shoes, but the big kids size 6 fits great and that is what I always buy and they cost much less than an adult size. Keens are the perfect shoes year round to me. Cool in summer and not too hot in winter when I wear them with wool socks. Exactly what I wanted. Big Kid size 5 fits my mature womans size 7 - 7.5 wide foot perfectly. Saved 35 !

I bought this new pair in a US size 6 Youth. The toe section is really wide .but that s okay since I m going to wear them with thick water socks. I discovered that I could wear these when I go windsurfing. Note New Keens on the inside in the picture.
Love these for our little guy! They fit great and are easy to get on, plus, bonus, they are perfect for developing feet, with sturdy soles and a thick, rubber toe guard.
Excellent sandals, they do run large, but they are good quality and worth the purchase. Soles are well-made and have good tread. Whole fam wears Keens, I trust this brand!

I've been ordering this style sandal for both of my kids for years. I struggle to get the right fit with their sizing. This year was no exception. My son is 10 years old and wears a size 6 shoe. We ordered size 6 in the Blue Depths color. His toes didn't come close to reaching the end and there was quite a bit of space around the outside of his foot, even for his slightly wider than normal foot. In order to cinch the shoe down tight enough, he had to pull the cinch string very far out, which left too much string out visibly. The velcro didn't come close to being tight enough around the top of his foot. The fit on these is way off. My son never has trouble with shoes being too wide and these definitely were both too wide and too long. We didn't even attempt to send them back for an exchange. I wouldn't have known what size to order that would have made these fit properly.

Fits true to size. My son wears a toddler 5. At first I went by the reviews on here and ordered a size up a 6 it was GIANT unwearable for him. So we found the other reviews to not be accurate for us. changed I to a 5 and it fits perfect. Easy to put on chubby toddler feet and great outside. They don t seem to bother him in anyway and he is learning to walk on the uneven surfaces outside in them great.

its as if crocs and chacos had a baby and created keen. very comfortable and the fit was exact. im a womens 4.5 5, youth nike running shoes 4, other youth shoes 3 and i bought a 3 and they fit perfect. just wanted to give size ideas

Nice solid shoe, just extremely hard to get on my sons foot. He doesn t have wide feet, and once they are on they are comfortable and he loves them. Haven t figured out a way yet to make putting them on easier.

These are fantastic. The fit is easily adjustable for a wide variety of feet. My son has average width feet and I have wide width feet and they are comfortable on both of us. Socks are optional when the weather gets cooler because neither of us like any other shoes as much as we love these. They are awesome when they get wet because they dry well. We wash ours in the washing machine regularly. They rarely get stinky even with daily wear and we only wear these shoes in the spring and summer but they do get dirty. We prefer bright colors so the washing machine restores them to that "new" look. They are always outgrown before the tread is worn out. They are awesome for traversing rocky rivers, hiking trails, and the playground. These also work well for school. I'm not sure if the soles are marketed as non marking but neither of my sons have ever had a problem wearing these for gym class and they've been worn for several years between the two of them. They are also safe for bikes and scooters with the study rubber toe covers. My sons used these to stop their bikes and scooters as they wereb learning and they never managed to do more than scuff them. They are also easy to get on and off. These are the first shoes either of my sons were able to get on and off by themselves in a reasonable amount of time. This is important because my younger son always removes his shoes upon entering a vehicle. These are his favorite shoes but, for him, barefoot is always best. At the time of this review my older son has had 2 pairs of this style, my younger son is on pair 5 currently, and this is my first pair in this style but second year wearing them. I fit in kids sizes and adult sizes. I don't notice a difference in quality. We are an outdoorsy family so they see a lot of use.
