For a 50 pair of shoes this is really awful quality. I'm extremely disappointed with this because my kid loves the shoes and now I have to quickly find a way to replace these. I hope the brand stands by the quality defect and get me a replacement, and if that happens even it means I can trust the brand and will keep buying their products.

Was excited about these sandals for an active 5yo boy. Like the tread and bump toe. Unfortunately I noticed the rubberized sole coming loose from the sandal upper in less than 3 wearings of the shoe on n light conditions. Ex church and grocery store not hiking bike riding or wet conditions. Very disappointed I missed the return window. Costly mistake on my part.

Purchased these less than 2 months ago. My son has worn these maybe 15 times in total. On the first day of getting wet , both shoes developed tears at the seams. have never had shoes fall apart before . Quality of the material and craftsmanship is clearly lacking, particularly outrageous at this prices point. My return window expired 2 weeks ago so sadly can't return. I will never buys Keens again.
Hard to get on. Uncomfortable material. Poorly designed strap. 3.5 yr old consistently prefers full shoe in hot weather to these despite living in a different brand last summer.

My son has been wearing these for only 1 month and the strap on the left sandal will NOT thread through the plastic loop so I can secure the velcro after putting them on! The velcro has frayed a bit normal and the rubber piece on the end of the strap is too thick to thread the strap into the plastic loop. I am frustrated because Keens have always been our summer got to shoe. I am also frustrated since I am not able to return or exchange them any longer. They arrived 6 1 19 and only a little over a month later we can't use them.

We ve been a huge fan of Keen for years. Bought these for my niece when we took her to Disney. Day 3 she said she had a blister. It was then I noticed a huge hole in her heel. Definitely shocked. I ve bought Keens for all my family whenever we take them. I love Keens that much. But this is shocking. Hopefully it s a fluke and not quality slipping away.

I was excited to buy my toddler his first pair of Keens, but have been disappointed to find that these just aren't made as nicely as the ones for adults and I have concerns about how long they'll actually last. There's visible glue at the seams, and after only one wear into a restaurant -- on wooden floors, not on some rough, uneven pavement -- the soles were showing wear and tear and scraped on the sides. Can't say I'm eager to buy any other Keens for kids.

The quality is good but your child won t be able to put on or take off these shoes on their own!! The little extra flap at the adhesive will get stuck on the loop and you can t easily loosen up the strap to slide the foot in without carefully threading it through the loop every time. It s annoying and I had to cut the little flap but that also means cutting some of the stitches. The strap should ve been one continuous piece. Anyhow, we wasted money and don t use these shoes at all.

I was so disappointed that my sandals began to rip after just one week of light wear. Keen's quality seems to have taken a hit since I started wearing their shoes over a decade ago. I just bought a similar pair of Merrell sandals to replace these, and the quality is far superior.
Shoes arrived and were very obviously used. Grass blades stuck in them, dirty, squished gum on the bottom, the soles scraped up and frayed seems.

We live in the Pacific Northwest, and the sandals do not dry quickly. Maybe they dry quickly in hot, dry climates or something. The fabric webbing is quite thick and sturdy, but if it gets wet, it s not dry and ready to wear again for several hours or overnight.
For my granddaughter I ordered Keen sandals and shoes. The tread has lasted well but the uppers started deteriorating quickly and then the straps broke on both pairs within a week of each other

I ordered this shoe on May 1. By July 1 the velcro had completely worn off and they would not stay closed. Spending over 40 on a pair of shoes I would at least expect them to last through a season. I would also add that they are tricky for my 3 year old to get on and off and they do have the tendency to rub.

I bought these shoes in July for my son. I was excited because they fit right and he liked them. One month later the rubber at the toes started cracking. The amount of dirt that gets trapped in the toe area is ridiculous and you can t even clean it properly I was using a bottle brush . I washed them by hand, I put them in the washer but after 2 months I am throwing them out because they stink and I can not clean them and they are broken anyways. Not worth the money.
I ordered these shoes for my daughter but she couldn't wear them due to the defect. The velcro strap around the ankle was made too large. I think they were made defective.

Love the style and quality and seem to be very comfy. They don't fall off like other shoes my son has had. I prefer to put socks on him first because his feet still get sweaty otherwise and smelly so they don't breath as well as I expected but I definitely will buy another pair for him next summer!
A very sturdy shoe. I like it better than the older Newports that we have been using. Hope they keep making these.

I am in Vanautu on an LDS Charities mission assigned to do humanitarian work. We were advised before we left to get KEEN sandals. It was the best advice. They go through water, hiking, muddy trails into villages, through town and into business meetings and keep looking great. Excellent value for the money. They hold up well. I am a lady but with a wide foot and I purchased a child's shoe for a perfect fit. Take a look at this picture, I have my KEENs on. Wear them walking to church.
Shipping was faster than anticipated. Keens are durable, and will last through the season. My kids wear these every day once the weather turns nice. They do not fade. Worth the price.
On 3rd set, have kept buying as our kid grows to the next size. Perfect for an active outdoor kid. Footwear holds up well, hopefully they hold onto that quailty.

This pair of Keen sandals is the third pair I have purchased. The first pair fit like a dream and there was no break in time at all. The footbed of this new pair isn't quite as comfortable, and the material doesn't seem like it's the same quality. They are still better quality than the other brands at the same price point, but it is definitely noticeable that they have made some compromises in order to maintain their price. I paid the same amount 3 years ago. Overall good sandals but I would rather pay a little more for the original quality.
Bought them for my son for sailing camp. It was great on the boat and kept his feet cool and protected.

My son has always worn durable sandals and keens is one of the best he s worn. Everytime he grows out of them I continue trying to search same brand bigger size because these sandals are so durable and protective of our young ones little toes, not to mention they re comfy too!
Durable and comfortable, have good grip and toe protection. Can get them wet and dry quickly with no issues. Well worth it.

These are super sturdy and my four-year-old son can beat these up quite hard and they can take it. The one downfall, and it is a big one for me, is they are difficult to put on. My son is pretty good at getting his own shoes on, and he cannot with these. I probably wouldn t have bought them if I knew they were so hard to get on. But once they re on, they are great.
Same Keen quality I ve come to trust. Purchased for myself because true red isn t available in a women s model. Comfortable- great traction-dries quickly. stands up to long wear!
I paid for keen because I love the quality but the back strap was too tight for my kid so I had to cut it. Kids feet grow so fast anyway but the back strap should be more flexible material
I love the comfort and protection these sandals offer but don't like the velcro straps because they detach on occasion especially when playing or running.
He wears these until they are destroyed or until his feet grow again. Durable and versatile and apparently comfortable to an elementary school boy.
Awesome all around shoe for our grandson, water, sand, dirt and grass along with s comfortable fit with toe protection.

My son loves these shoes, great buy and they are durable and built so good! They sent me the wrong color then I ordered but idc, my son likes them regardless.

representative_reviews.text: The soles was great for my foot problems but they were to tight around the pinky area and really skinned me. Also the back of the shoe hurt me but socks fixed that. Shameful cause they re cute.

Clarks has changed, and it appears this style is no longer Bendable . I have had Ashland s for years, but the heel wore out I had a slightly different style from this Ashland Spin Q. I ordered replacements in the closest Ashland shoe that I could find, in both black and blue Ashland Spin Q . When I tried them on, the 2 colors felt very different. I couldn t figure out why the blue was so much more comfortable. I remembered the blue ones came in an old-style box with the green lid, and the black ones came in a new style box with an attached brown cardboard lid. Also, I started feeling the inside, the blue shoes were more cushiony. The black shoes have a thinner cushion and it doesn t feel like they have any cushioning or any give underneath the cushion. Then I realized that the inside of the blue shoe looks just like my old shoe, but the black has changed and it no longer says bendable . The difference is subtle until you walk on them, but then I could tell a big difference. I have severe foot problems and bendables are the only dress shoes I have been able to wear for a long time. Maybe someone with normal feet wouldn t notice the difference as much. But I thought people needed to know that Clarks has changed. Also, I believe the good blue shoes that I received must be much older. They might even be seconds because the strap with the velcro goes under the other strap instead of over it. But I don t care because they are comfortable. There is one slight improvement in the Ashlands. They now come in 12 Narrow so I won t have to stretch the toe and the heel won t fall off all the time. The navy blue is very dark almost black , but that s an advantage for me because it will pass for black as I m returning the black shoes the Unbendable ones!
Painful uncomfortable. Size is right and my feet are on the narrow skinny side but the stitching, cutouts and Velcro closure are all very scratchy, pinchy, picky and uncomfortable.

I worn them for a long period of time and my feet were pretty tight in them, had a few blisters and I am hoping it is because they were new! I hope I can stretch them out!! I wear a 8 1 2 and I know the 9's will be too big! I hope this helps the next customer. I suppose I expect a lot from Clarks!

I will have to return these. I was congested when I got them, so didn't notice the odor when I first tried them on. They are really cute and comfy. I noticed a weird odor in my closet the last two days. Today, I tried to wear them and kept smelling this strong chemical yucky odor and realized it was the shoes. Took them off and left them in my room...could still smell them. Sat them in my hallway...could still smell them. I don't know what the deal is but it is a gross chemical smell like a mixture of super strong glue and spray paint. The box is just as bad! OH....my feet had the odor after I took them off...had to literally scrub the scent away... really! Disappointed...cuz they really are cute.

I really loved these shoes. Clark's is quality. Not cheap shoes. I received December 10. Worn four times and I don't remember stubbing my toe but even so it's unreasonable for the leather surface to peel like this. Return window was January 31.

Shoe looks attractive and well made but for me a bit too tight around arch. Bought the shoes for spring and just put them on to wear out and not too happy with the fit. I'm returning this product. Thank you. Please send me the return papers.
The buckle on these hurt my feet on the top!! I could not wear them. Had to trash them! Tried wearing sock or cushionn with a bandaid. Terrible!
I have a bunion on one foot and even though they were cute, the Wide width was too tight and the WW width was too loose in the heel. I was disappointed I couldn't make them work.
Color wasn t what I expected. And must of ordered the wrong size cuz a got a blister on the first day it was worn. Not their fault. Otherwise it seemed like a very good quality shoe.
nice shoe, but had to return it due to being too tight in the top of the toe area that cant be adjusted.

I bought a pair of these shoes for work a couple years ago and they were thee most comfortable shoes with rubber bottoms, but this pair I recently bought are cheap knock offs with looser fit and the bottom sole made out of plastic. Just put them on for a job interview today and was disappointed when I noticed it. Hopefully its not too last to return them. I ve been noticing this happening with a few American brand shoes I have bought here on Amazon in the past like Clarks, Life Stride, Tahara and Naturalizer. All being returned.

The right shoe feels like from the ball of my foot to the toe area isnt lined up properly . Both shes has NO custion at all, It feels like im walking on cardboard. Iam very disapointed in Clark shoes.
I loved the look of these but the toe box was uncomfortable to me because it is turned upwards and my toenails were hitting and it hurt.

I really wanted to love these and needed them for a trip. They are great looking! But they are not comfortable. I debated keeping them for short use, but that seems silly since there are so many shoes on the market...I will consider a wider shoe by Clarks...after I return. Two issues The wide is pretty average at 3 3 4" at the widest part I need 4". I realize they might stretch, but I'd rather start off with something that fits in case feet swell during wear. And...I need more support for the metatarsal ball of foot...there is none. As soon as I put the shoe on, it was uncomfortable and hard. So, definitely not a shoe I want to stand or walk in for any length of time. Combined with the tightness...there is no room to add padding. I recommend ordering wider than you think you need. I have been told I am size 6 9" foot , but I've never worn a size 6, because I hate cramped toes...I wear a 37 in Birkenstocks and normally buy 7-8 shoes size in wide.

As a big girl, I wear a size 28 with a wide foot I these shoes!!! I ve often hear Clarkes were comfortable but I hesitated buying them online because I like to try on things in the store however no one around me carried wides so I finally broke down and bought them. And I am just sorry I waited so long! I wore them this past Saturday to my daughter s JROTC Drill Meet. It s an all day thing, lots of walking all over the school and going up down stairs. These shoes were super comfy!! My feet never hurt like they do with other dressy shoes. I can t say enough good things about them. Oh the lining is awesome. I usually have to wear knee highs or something with dress shoes but it s super soft and I just slip them on my bare feet go. Stop hesitating and buy these shoes. You will be glad you did.
Well made show with excellent support for high arches. Very comfortable. Love this show cobbler company!
I have a hard time finding good arch support shoes that don't put pressure on the balls of my feet. These shoes are the most comfortable that I have found.

This shoe is much cuter than I expected! I needed a comfy work shoe. The sole of the shoe is great. As with all leather pleather shoes, the material is a little snug at first and just needed time to adapt to my wider foot. I ve had no problems though. I m pleased with the style!

They are great shoes, the only problem is that the straps were really really tight....it made my feet swell through the openings within seconds . I originally ordered a 6.5M, so I figured I could order 6.5W and they would be perfect. Well, when I got them, they were wider.....but they were also an inch longer...so I kept sliding around in the shoes, even with the straps pulled tight. I am going to return those. I ended up putting a bag of water in each shoe 6.5M and freezing them overnight to stretch them out. It worked! So now I love these shoes
After I received these shoes I did a lot of walking while on a vacation. Very comfortable, I m happily satisfied
I've found Clark's runs "long" so 1 size down. Very pleased so far, toe box ample, arch support terrific. Stylish and sure footed

These Clarks shoes feel good, but surprisingly does not have the normal arch support Clarks is known for. I usually wear an 8 so that is what I bought. The heal is loose. I should have gone up a half size. I added a heal cup and that helped a little. Overall I would say this mid-priced Clarks would be fine if you try them on before buying them. If arch support is no big deal, then these would be perfect for the office. I just wouldn't stand in them all day.

Cute shoe with comfortable sole, and was available in Narrow, which is impossible to find where I live. I did add an insert for extra arch and heel support, because I have Plantar Faciitis, but most people would not need that. I highly recommend this shoe and others by Clark.
I hoping for a comfortable shoe that helps keep my back aligned. The shoe is stiff and doesn t give where needed

I got this shoe to coddle a bunion on one foot. The toe box, while ample, isn't clunky or ugly. No arch support to speak of, though there's a little pad. The soles aren't padded or thick rubber as in a real "walking shoe.". The shoe is more like a slipper, though quite a cute one even in a size 12! , with the overlapping straps. Though it's only a AA width, the heels are quite narrow, good for my really AAA foot. One velcro strap adjusts the width a bit, too. Comes in a lot of colors!
I liked the width which is narrow and it has an arch support which is really needed when you have high arches.

These are now my favorite shoes-- and I wore them daily walking on a trip and they offered good support for walking all day. However, I had to do some of work to 'customize' them As other reviews mention, one of the unadjustable straps on top was too tight and painfully cut into the top of my foot. I put hand sanitizer on the underside of the strap until it was damp, and then wore them to around-- which permanently loosened them up after several times. I also added heal pads to the so they'd stop cutting into my heels. Like I said, I now love them!

I bought this shoe to wear between summer and fall. I like the color, the airiness of the design and I LOVE Clark shoes, so this was a good fit. Most importantly, the shoe crossed at the medial arch on top of the foot and that s important because I have a bunion. Nothing presses on that sensitive area and that s the main reason I was drawn to this shoes. It s very comfortable.

I liked the price, arch support, wide width, and overall appearance of these shoes. I wore them for the first time today, and truly they felt to comfortable to be new shoes. I know I will enjoy wearing these for a long time! To update this review, I have ordered a pair just like these in black. Need I say more!

This may be a cheaper line than my previous Clarks, which have a removable footbed and more comfortable feel to them. Sending back.

Returned. I marked 34 too small 34 because I normally wear a 9M and I ordered a 9.5 wide because reviews said this ran small. It barely fit and the inside was somewhat rough, too much so to wear without socks or stockings. Nice-looking shoe but order larger than your usual size.
I ordered these in a extra wide width for my large feet. I can wear them, however they are still very snug.
They were beautiful shoes, just way too tight and short. Usually Clark's fit me perfect. This style was just not true to usual size. I loved the loafer and was disappointed in the it.

Strange fitting shoes. Do not recommend. Updated I order the wide size to see if that was better. They were too wide and had to be returned.

Color wasn t what I expected. And must of ordered the wrong size cuz a got a blister on the first day it was worn. Not their fault. Otherwise it seemed like a very good quality shoe.

Fortunately, Amazon made the return process very easy and credited my account the full amount of purchase.

As you can see, I have problems with my right foot and ankle. Finding shoes that fit is difficult. These are comfortable and I was able to tighten and loosen the buckles on the sides to adjust the discrepancy between my feet. It has decent arch support, but if you need hard core support, you will need to add an insert to accommodate that. The toe box has more room than I expected. In the pictures of the shoes, they look like they do not have a lot of depth in the toe box. I was afraid they would not be deep enough for my swelling and toes that are curled under on the right. I put these on after being on my feet most of the day and traveling in the car for about 6 hours. They fit snug but not tight. That's perfect. I won't have to worry about my feet sliding around on the left or having a too-tight shoe on the right. They look great with my jeans and will also work well with slacks for church. I wear a 10 medium in earth origins and 11-1 2 medium in Brooks walking shoes. Those both run wide. The reviews for these shoes state they run large and true to size in width. So I tried a 10 wide and they are just right. I haven't spent a day in them yet, but considering how well they fit, I am hopeful they will be perfect. Love the neutral pewter color as well. It goes with everything in my closet. I hope this review will be helpful.

This shoe is much cuter than I expected! I needed a comfy work shoe. The sole of the shoe is great. As with all leather pleather shoes, the material is a little snug at first and just needed time to adapt to my wider foot. I ve had no problems though. I m pleased with the style!
Fits well except heel is a bit long and loose. Still pretty comfortable. Trying to decide whether to keep.

Would have loved these shoes but only one cross strap is adjustable and the other is too tight. A simple elastic on the bottom cross strap would fix it. Toe box and size are true to size, but I have a high arch so they go back.

These Clarks shoes fit perfectly right out of the box. I normally wear a 7 or 71 2 in regular shoes and an 8 in athletic shoes. I ordered a 7 and they fit just right.....plenty of toe room for walking and snug in the heel with no slippage. I wore them the first time for about 6 hours with no problems. They will probably get more comfortable as they stretch out.
toe bed fits hammer toes. width accommodates bunions. VERY comfortable when you're "of an age" and refuse to admit it.

I usually wear an 8W but that size was too big. So I ordered a 7.5 W and they fit perfect. They are plenty wide in the toe box. If you are borderline with a wide width you could probably get away with a medium width. The shoe is very comfortable.
I have a problem with a longer second toe than big toe. Usually that toe gets cramped. In this shoe at wide sizing, I could wiggle it. Thanks for the extra room in the roe box.
The shoes were my size but did not fit. The seller was very concerned about my complaint and kindly credited my account. This was very much appreciated. Thank you!
Like the shoes, with a light sock they fit well but having narrow heels, I find them a little loose in the heel.

In my older age I need Sox for comfort. I don t know where my head was when I placed this order. They are cute. I cannot wear cuter shoes and definitely not heels anymore. It was fun to dream for a minute. I will keep looking. Thank you Judy

I ordered wide because I have bunions and I need room in the toe box. I ordered 8.5 because I was worried the heel area would rub because I normally wear clog type shoes. I like the shoes in spite of what I have to do to them

Truthfully I wish I didn't waste 50 on these. They barely lasted 1.5 months and are already falling apart at the stitching. Also, they aren't truly wide-width. I had to get some stretchers in them and they still cut into my feet. Just disappointed and will never buy this brand again.

I ordered these shoes based on recommendations from others comments. I was excited, but putting them on for the first time showed that the strap stitching hooking the top to the side is not sewn to the end on one of the shoes. They look like they would be perfect for what I need, but I'm very hesitant to order another Clark product because of the bad craftsmanship of this pair. I would hope that this is a "bad lemon" pair, but just not sure.

Shoe looks attractive and well made but for me a bit too tight around arch. Bought the shoes for spring and just put them on to wear out and not too happy with the fit. I'm returning this product. Thank you. Please send me the return papers.

Clarks has changed, and it appears this style is no longer Bendable . I have had Ashland s for years, but the heel wore out I had a slightly different style from this Ashland Spin Q. I ordered replacements in the closest Ashland shoe that I could find, in both black and blue Ashland Spin Q . When I tried them on, the 2 colors felt very different. I couldn t figure out why the blue was so much more comfortable. I remembered the blue ones came in an old-style box with the green lid, and the black ones came in a new style box with an attached brown cardboard lid. Also, I started feeling the inside, the blue shoes were more cushiony. The black shoes have a thinner cushion and it doesn t feel like they have any cushioning or any give underneath the cushion. Then I realized that the inside of the blue shoe looks just like my old shoe, but the black has changed and it no longer says bendable . The difference is subtle until you walk on them, but then I could tell a big difference. I have severe foot problems and bendables are the only dress shoes I have been able to wear for a long time. Maybe someone with normal feet wouldn t notice the difference as much. But I thought people needed to know that Clarks has changed. Also, I believe the good blue shoes that I received must be much older. They might even be seconds because the strap with the velcro goes under the other strap instead of over it. But I don t care because they are comfortable. There is one slight improvement in the Ashlands. They now come in 12 Narrow so I won t have to stretch the toe and the heel won t fall off all the time. The navy blue is very dark almost black , but that s an advantage for me because it will pass for black as I m returning the black shoes the Unbendable ones!

I will have to return these. I was congested when I got them, so didn't notice the odor when I first tried them on. They are really cute and comfy. I noticed a weird odor in my closet the last two days. Today, I tried to wear them and kept smelling this strong chemical yucky odor and realized it was the shoes. Took them off and left them in my room...could still smell them. Sat them in my hallway...could still smell them. I don't know what the deal is but it is a gross chemical smell like a mixture of super strong glue and spray paint. The box is just as bad! OH....my feet had the odor after I took them off...had to literally scrub the scent away... really! Disappointed...cuz they really are cute.

I bought a pair of these shoes for work a couple years ago and they were thee most comfortable shoes with rubber bottoms, but this pair I recently bought are cheap knock offs with looser fit and the bottom sole made out of plastic. Just put them on for a job interview today and was disappointed when I noticed it. Hopefully its not too last to return them. I ve been noticing this happening with a few American brand shoes I have bought here on Amazon in the past like Clarks, Life Stride, Tahara and Naturalizer. All being returned.

I am out 5.00 dollars for going into staples to print off the lables to send this back as the shoes are to small.I already paid the shipping, and handling in order to get them sent her.So the shoes are on the way back from ups as of today.

The shoe box was badly damaged It wasn t inside another Box The first I purchased the pair of shoes. The shoes packaging wasn t new but had used tissue on top of the shoes. The Right shoe did not fit properly appears to be Defect in the making of the shoe. I returned the shoes I Love the first pair of shoes I purchased
These were my every day shoes for 6 months, until the sole separated from the upper shoe. I did not get them wet, it just randomly happened. What a cheap shoe, nothing like I expected from Clark's.
Unfortunately had to return. Fit was very tight. Ended up actually purchasing a similar better fitting pair.
Painful uncomfortable. Size is right and my feet are on the narrow skinny side but the stitching, cutouts and Velcro closure are all very scratchy, pinchy, picky and uncomfortable.

Too tight in the instep, and very stiff. Cute shoe but will be returning as I did not find the shoes to be comfortable at all. I do not have a high instep or wide feet and these just squeezed my feet horribly. I wore them for an hour just sitting around, walked a small amount and when I took them off there were indentations in my feet across the instep and underneath the strap. It's too bad because the style is nice. I am so disappointed.

I worn them for a long period of time and my feet were pretty tight in them, had a few blisters and I am hoping it is because they were new! I hope I can stretch them out!! I wear a 8 1 2 and I know the 9's will be too big! I hope this helps the next customer. I suppose I expect a lot from Clarks!

This shoe is much cuter than I expected! I needed a comfy work shoe. The sole of the shoe is great. As with all leather pleather shoes, the material is a little snug at first and just needed time to adapt to my wider foot. I ve had no problems though. I m pleased with the style!
I bought Clarks for the last twenty year never had a problem until now fell apart between the shoe and the sole looks like it was stitched but it was glued. MY return date expired Yesterday 6 29 22

They are great shoes, the only problem is that the straps were really really tight....it made my feet swell through the openings within seconds . I originally ordered a 6.5M, so I figured I could order 6.5W and they would be perfect. Well, when I got them, they were wider.....but they were also an inch longer...so I kept sliding around in the shoes, even with the straps pulled tight. I am going to return those. I ended up putting a bag of water in each shoe 6.5M and freezing them overnight to stretch them out. It worked! So now I love these shoes
Well made show with excellent support for high arches. Very comfortable. Love this show cobbler company!

As a big girl, I wear a size 28 with a wide foot I these shoes!!! I ve often hear Clarkes were comfortable but I hesitated buying them online because I like to try on things in the store however no one around me carried wides so I finally broke down and bought them. And I am just sorry I waited so long! I wore them this past Saturday to my daughter s JROTC Drill Meet. It s an all day thing, lots of walking all over the school and going up down stairs. These shoes were super comfy!! My feet never hurt like they do with other dressy shoes. I can t say enough good things about them. Oh the lining is awesome. I usually have to wear knee highs or something with dress shoes but it s super soft and I just slip them on my bare feet go. Stop hesitating and buy these shoes. You will be glad you did.
These arrived as expected, great quality, amazing comfort, no breaking in required. It was a great purchase, and I am very pleased.
I have bought this shoe for the past three years - this style from Clark s - love them - keep my feet cool In the Florida heat and very comfy
Well made shoes, but a little stiff. Right out of the box, they re ridged due to the type of leather , but soften over a couple of wears. Quality is good and recommended for work.

Seems like a sturdy, well made shoe that will last a while. I'm on my feet all day as a teller and need shoes with good support. These offer decent support, perhaps if i had gotten a wide they'd be better? All together a nice shoe that I'll be able to wear for a while
I hoping for a comfortable shoe that helps keep my back aligned. The shoe is stiff and doesn t give where needed

In my older age I need Sox for comfort. I don t know where my head was when I placed this order. They are cute. I cannot wear cuter shoes and definitely not heels anymore. It was fun to dream for a minute. I will keep looking. Thank you Judy

These are really cute shoes. I ve looked at them quite a few times and finally bought them. Honestly I would have kept them but they were so slippery on the bottom that I almost fell! I did return them but only because of that. I thought about scuffing the bottoms up but if that didn t work I couldn t return them!
I'm headed on a trip and will be doing a great deal of walking so I wanted very comfortable shoes. From the minute I put them on, they were great. No breaking in at all.

I got it on sale as "Used, Very Good" - I'm assuming someone bought it and then returned it. Looks new to me, fits okay although I needed to use a Dr. Scholls' type insert to make it totally comfortable. I sometimes wear a 7 1 2, sometimes an 8, and this shoe is an 8. This shoe would be fine with jeans, slacks, even a skirt or dress if it's not too fancy. I haven't work it much but it looks like it will hold up well. All in all, I'm very happy that I took a chance on it!
I just started wearing a 12 W with orthotics. I have to remove the inside footbed and put in my orthotics and voila, perfect fit! Love it!

product_name: adidas Men's Ultraboost X Running Shoe

urgent_issues.summary: 구매자들은 내구성 문제로 인해 신발이 쉽게 망가진다고 불만을 토로하고 있습니다. 이는 소비자에게 실망을 주고 있습니다.

comfort.issue_summary: 많은 구매자들이 착용감이 매우 불편하고, 발이 좁거나 너무 꽉 끼는 문제를 경험했습니다. 이로 인해 신발을 착용하기 어려운 상황이 발생하고 있습니다.
comfort.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 뛰어난 아치 지지력과 우수한 쿠셔닝을 제공하며, 착용 시 편안함을 느낀다고 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: After a month of wearing this shoe I honestly believe we are being sold counterfeits. I've owned ultra boost shoes in the past and comfort wise this shoe is awful in comparison. I've gone through 2 pairs returning one because after only a day of light use the inner mid-sole foam started turning blue. I thought this was a one time mistake but the new pair had the exact same issue and i just put up with it. I thought maybe i just wasn't used to the new changes made by Adidas but 2 months later these are still just terrible to even walk in. My refund period has expired and i'm extremely dissatisfied. Side note- I've tried to clean the blue stain off several times, as seen in the photos it helped one shoe but still not completely. The other one remained terrible.
can't stand these shoes extremely narrow and getting in and out is a hassle, poor design also stay clear of this shoe

I decided to buy because I've seen some positive reviews about the comfort and why not... they look good. I used these for running not for fashion though. I wanted some cushion for my longer runs and yes, they give good cushion. The problem for me is that my toes feel a little cramped, despite the upper being stretchy, the toe box could be roomier. After some runs I realized that about 5 miles I started to feel that the plastic support of the sides was rubbing one of my arches, at one time I even developed a blister, they feel hot as well. Now I only use them occasionally.

The toung is so tight I had to go out and buy a shoe horn just to put on. Once on fit well except way too tight on top toung. Rather than return I will cut the onge this this may solve problem. If you have any kind of a high arch I would keep away from these shoes.
Shoes badly damaged. Appears shoes may have been chewed up by a dog? Hard to believe this product was sent at all! Wouldn t have given a star at all, but had to give one in order to write a review.
These sneakers are uncomfortable and i have rolled my ankle once and fallen once in these. These are performance sneakers?

I can not tell you a thing about the shoes. They send the wrong size in one of the shoes, one 8 1 2 and the next 8. One too small. That would have not been the issue it took a very long sequence of mails, phone calls, conversations and yet I have not been able to return the incompatible pair. I would have expected a better easier costumer service. as a result I will loose the money and I can't even give the shoes to someone else. At least not to the same person. I know its probably a machine error, nevertheless, not my error and it will need a human correction.

I don't see the big deal with these. First pair was too large long , half size smaller a little too tight. Can't really wear with socks. Yes, you can take out the insole but I would not recommend any activity that way, maybe just a casual stroll. If they are meant to be worn barefoot I guess they are pretty comfortable but I don't like to work out that way. For the Amazon price they are fine but if I paid 180 in a store I would be disappointed. After I break them in some more I may revisit this review.
Shoes are so comfortable. I can walk in the them all day. but they look a little rough. Out of the box there was some Grey white glue at the seam showing that I was able to remove myself.

The quality of the shoe is high and the cushioning is really very nice at the heel, but these shoes seem to run about 1 2 to 1 full size too small. I wear 13D on every shoe I buy including other Adidas models such as the AlphaBounce, but the UltraBoost seems to run consistently small. I had to send back a brand new pair of 13's in exchange for some 14's and they JUST barely fit. Others have stated similar and have even resorted to taking out the insole. Also, if you're a big guy or need extra lateral stability, I'd recommend looking for another shoe. Not much lateral support in these - if you're the kind of person runner that needs that additional lateral stability due to age or previous injury - look elsewhere.

I've had these on for about an hour now, so I am sure they are not returnable. That's too bad, because an hour has shown me that they are very uncomfortable. I cannot imagine who would find them wearable. Maybe someone with abnormally narrow feet. The VERY stretchy material they are made from makes them hard to get on. You MUST use a shoehorn, and even then, it is not easy. They also - unpleasantly - squeeze the foot. After an hour, my toes are getting cold from low circulation! Seriously! Plus, the material does not breathe well, despite it's "perforated" appearance. So my feet are hot and wet. The laces are just decoration. It's the tight material that holds them on. Plus, the artsy-craftsy arch inset in the instep is an invitation to soiling underneath it, without giving much arch support. Could these be knock-offs? I assumed the attractive price was because they are a discontinued color. Maybe they are just fakes!. PS THESE ARE NOT FOR DIABETICS. There is too much restriction of circulation. I was advised to get "caged" Ultraboosts...the ones that lace normally. The "cage" is the plastic framework for the laces. But I liked the color of these. Big mistake.

I have had these shoes 4 months and they have a hole in the top of the shoe already. I am not a runner - I wear these to do errands around town so they haven't had much abuse, I am extremely disappointed to have paid this much money for a pair of shoes that can't hold up to light use. I would give them 5 stars for comfort and appearance -- but they are getting 1 due to their shoddy craftsmanship.

I have a size 9 wide flat foot and I really want you love these sneakers what the size 9 is too small. My toe goes all the way to the end and they are not wide enough. I suffer from plantar fasciitis and have been living in hokas so it's very hard to find something else comprable without being too picky. They stop making my beloved Vanquish to model so I've been looking for alternates. You definitely cannot wear the shoe with socks. The socks get to bunchy and take up too much space, unless you had came above your ankle no. The shoe does have arch support but it's the kind that compresses almost flat when you stand. The body of the shoe is knitted and attached to the soul. It's almost like a sock. It's very thick and comfortable but over the long term I don't know how long these would last. I'm definitely going up one size to make my final decision. It is a little annoying when you pull your foot out and the insole comes out. It's just a flimsy insole that's not attached to the shoe.I'm honestly hoping to find a meatier more sturdier version of the shoe if it's even possible. If your foot is at all wide I would definitely go at least a half size up. The way the shoe is made you can tighten it or loosen it as much as you need around the top of your foot. I also was able to slip in my orthotic but it was a little too tight.

I was so excited to get these shoes in but when I opened the box they were clearly worn before. One of the shoes had some sort of hair all inside and smelled horrible. The other shoe still had the insert that comes in new shoes and didn t smell at all.

I really like the look of the shoe. The insert slides back every time I use them. I would expect them to be more stationary in a shoe like this. The smell of the shoe is awful as well. I'm a fan of Adidas but this one is making me a little leary.

Very comfortable, very good arch support, very good heel support. The thing I don't like about it is they probably are a little bit tight around my toes I wear a size 9 and 1 2 10 I purchase size 10, and they are still a little snug. Otherwise amazing. Also, the white ones get dirty really quick. These help the ache from 12 hour nursing shifts.

This was my third pair of Ultraboost 19s, since then I have added one more pair to my collection and am waiting on the 20s...I rarely ever buy dupes of a product, so that s saying a lot. I have arthritis in my feet and recently broke my shinbone and have had residual pain that has made it difficult to consistently exercise or let alone wear one pair of shoes from more than 4 hours without severe pain. After meticulously researching the technology in this shoe boost and prime knit I decided to see what the hype was all about...now my only regret is not purchasing sooner! The prime knit is amazing and stretchy for accommodating inflammation and lets me wear the sneaker casually without having to tie it. They are so easy to slip on and off! The boost is awesome too. They feel so light and bouncy during jogs or walks. Tip I am a female who ordered men s because they are one width wider than women s.
Extremely lightweight and supported of high arch. Went on vacation and walked 5 miles every day for 3 days in a row. No blisters and excellent support and cushioning.

Had a previous pair of all terrain so because of the comfort purchased them again. The sole feel like ur walking on the cloud... Dont recommend for all day use they can b a bit snug. Mayb for running or working out or just casual wear.

I am a senior distance runner. I run about seven miles in an hour. Most of my run is on pavement. The cushion and flex are superior. Support is exceptional. The tread isn't thick but it looks almost new after 80 miles. I will buy them again if they are available.
Nice looking and very comfortable , I had a Sciatica episode last Nov and this shoe helped me walk thru the pain

Great shoes - the softest insole I've ever had, but gives great support too. Because of an old Achilles tear and some tendon problems, I have troubles wearing anything but Merrell hiking shoes normally, but I tried these on in a store price was crazy and ordered them on Amazon for far less. I figured if they caused pain like other shoes, I'd give them to my son. But they're amazing - incredibly soft, but after wearing them for a week and doing 15-20,000 steps per day, I had no pain.
Lightweight, breathable comfort as a daily or as a genuine running shoe. My two miles per day at an eight minute pace are a breeze thanks to the Boost foam.

Despite what reviewers might say about it being wider now or whatever, it's a very narrow fitting shoe, putting this on was like trying to get a boot on, and I went a size up. Of course I'm 250 and have big feet so for anyone else I'm sure it'll be fine, but for me, I'll stick with New Balance fresh foam. I am going to rate it a 5 star though, because the shoe is very well built, and I'm sure to anyone with a normal weight foot this will be a godsend, just not for me specifically.
These shoes are very comfortable, have a lot of style and they give orthopedic quality support. Only thing missing is good arch support but so far my feet feel good.

The ultraboost 19 doesn't feel as comfortable as the old ultraboost versions. I think ultraboost 3.0 was the most comfortable. It feels a lot stiffer and there is a weird arch in the toe area. I wish that addias would bring back those old versions of the ultraboost

Provides instep support with the lacing system which is great for us super high arch people. They fit snug perfect for running!!!! I have got a handful of compliments and will be buying another pair in a different color.
Wonderful support- fits like a sock- perfect fit- with lots of heal cushion- like walking on air. I would recommend.

Comfortable shoe that because of construction is difficult to put on without a shoe horn. Very good cushion in a road shoe. Had the ultra boost before and liked it. Previous shoes construction was better. Colors pretty much suck but given how the shoe works would buy it again.
So comfy!! It s like walking on clouds! The only negative of the shoe is it has a mesh upper part of the shoe so if you have weak ankles stay away!

Fit was true to size and a very comfortable shoe. I have a very high arch and these shoes do support my feet. Only thing is a little more money than what I like to spend, but I do like them. I'm hoping they are durable.

Handsome sneaker design. The fabric upper is a cool white but the midsole is ivory. My issue is fit. I own two Adidas Questar Rise in 11 but based on reviews I purchased these in 12. The toe box is fine but they are tight from heel to the middle of my foot. Even though I usually wear 11's there is enough room lengthwise in these 12's to assume I should have ordered size 13.

This pair of shoes came in a generic box, without any labels or tags on the shoes. It makes me think that these are not the real deal. I feel the quality is different from the same exact pair of shoes that I purchased from Dick's Sporting Goods. If you're buying a particular brand, and it is brand new, it should come in the original box and packaging.

One of the most comfortable shoes I've ever owned. My feet are wide and most shoes feel too narrow, but these stretch to comfort even on the first day out. They are so soft and bouncy it is unreal. Unlike any other shoe I have ever worn. I liked the white-out pair so much, I bought the black with blue accent pair as well. Only negative is that my feet stink if the shoes get soaked in the rain. I had to wash the white pair already to get them smelling good again after getting caught in a rain storm. I never have stinky socks or shoes, so I'm blaming the fact I didn't take out the inserts to let them dry. They washed up great in lingerie bags in a load of white dog towels.

Perfect fit and excellent quality however it s strange that the thumbnail picture of the shoes in the cart is of a different brand line than the one bought in the description which is ultraboost 19
These shoes are great, I typically wear extra wide 4e shoes, however these shoes fit well I purchased half a a size up .
These are the best shoes I have ever purchased. They fit perfect for me and so comfortable. Not cheap but I do believe you get what you pay for.
Everything about this shoe is perfect. Was initially drawn by the color way, but the fit is absolutely amazing.
Actually one of the most comfortable shoes I ve ever worn in my entire life. Wore these on a 12 hour shift and my feet never hurt at all. It fits just like a glove.
Fits true to size for my husband s size 11 foot. Best running shoes with style. I was surprised these were on sale on Amazon. Ultra Boost are traditionally expensive.

Fit and comfort are fantastic. Foot entry into shoe is different but I'm used to it now. I have plantar problems and added arch supporting 3 4 length heel-to-ball insoles with the heels cut out. I wear 12 s in everything but lacrosse ankle-tight rubber boots 10.5 . I like a solid inch of space between the end of my big toe and the front of my shoe. These shoes are consistent in fit with all other athletic 12 s that I own. The stretchy mesh will reveal my toes definition if I lift them up, which is typical of my other shoes with this design. I have only test-worn them in the house, but my initial assessment does not satisfy the expectations I had based on the reviews and the model description. These don t feel particularly light or significantly cushioned to me. I can feel the stiffness of the soles transfer up to my sensitive knees. The pros bought them for 85 I like the design I find them aesthetically pleasing, adequately supportive, snug in fit, and no discernible rubbing points e.g., my Achilles, ankles, etc. . I like the plastic material on the outer mid-foot, as I can tuck my laces between it and the outside of the shoe versus my usual tucking of the laces inside the shoe next to my foot which often leads to frequent adjustment as the laces will eventually walk under my foot . I also like that the soles have a nice grip albeit only tested on my tiled floor . Just from a casual walk across the house, these shoes seem a good fit for my gait some shoes make my ankles feel unstable and with some shoes, my heel will strike first and trip me up if I m walking casually . As for durability and performance on the treadmill pavement...I ll have to update once I ve tested them out. At first glance, they don t appear suited for running in inclement weather conditions or dirty environments, but time will tell. I m satisfied with my purchase, but I was perhaps overly-hyped by the raving reviews. All that said, I am by no means an experienced runner yet no stranger to running . Take that how you want.
Wonderful support- fits like a sock- perfect fit- with lots of heal cushion- like walking on air. I would recommend.
My son wears these every day and he likes them. They have not torn and are good quality. Worn every day for 3 months.....

This was my third pair of Ultraboost 19s, since then I have added one more pair to my collection and am waiting on the 20s...I rarely ever buy dupes of a product, so that s saying a lot. After meticulously researching the technology in this shoe boost and prime knit I decided to see what the hype was all about...now my only regret is not purchasing sooner! The prime knit is amazing and stretchy for accommodating inflammation and lets me wear the sneaker casually without having to tie it. They are so easy to slip on and off! The boost is awesome too. They feel so light and bouncy during jogs or walks. Tip I am a female who ordered men s because they are one width wider than women s.

As I'm doing at least 10-15 mls every single day with exceeding 30 mls every this and then I need running shoes that offer more than fancy looking. These shoes are not only great on running, but they last pretty long with an average max mileage of below 300 for other brands, some are done already after 100 mls, these take me up to 450 still offering comfort and stability. Was scared at first as this product is made in China and there are confusions about sizing, but they do a good job. Sure, would prefer to buy anything else but made in China, I tried all our US stuff, but not only most of it is from China as well but, yes, most of it was trash from the very first run. And yes, for that money I'd expect something made in the US, or Europe, Japan, at least Mex.

A friend of his let him try these and his pain almost instantly went away when he stood up in them, so he shelled out the money for his own pair. It s been several weeks and his feet are slowly healing. His pain is still there but he can get through the day much more easily.

Insole is removable And I love that they come up high enough that you can wear low-cut socks and it not be an issue Lightweight enough for the summer months Cons -The shoes arnt uncomfortable by any means, but I wouldn't exactly say there's a whole lot of support or cushion. -Zero arch support- but again the insoles are removable -Perfect for running around but my feet would hurt after a long day of walking. I would need something a little softer more supportive -I don't see these as being sustainable. Take care of them if you want them to last a full 6 months just a projection Overall It boils down to expectations vs price. For this price range I feel they're pretty good shoes. I wouldn't expect them to be more sustainable or made with more eco-friendly materials at this point. I've spent three times that this past year and have gotten shoes that felt like they were made out of concrete. And last, they're cute af Bottom line- I definitely recommend balanced expectations

representative_reviews.text: I bought these after reviewing a number of water shoe comparisons and customer reviews. I was looking for a shoe for canoeing and hiking on trails where I crossed a number of streams and where I would be walking around water falls. I've had the shoes for about a month now. The shoes fit well and are very comfortable - both with socks and without socks. I wear them going through airport checkin here in the states where we have to take our shoes off. In these cases, I wear socks with them. When hiking and canoeing with them, I wear them without socks. I have used them on up to four days of consecutive hiking, covering anywhere from five to eight miles per day over a mix of paved, gravel, and dirt trails. I did not experience any rubbing or other problems with the shoes. The trails included both up and down as well as flat trail surfaces and the shoes provided good solid protection to my feet from stones and sticks in the path. However, when crossing creeks streams with large river rock type stepping stones i.e rounded, not flat. and wet, not dry and when walking over wet granite type rock, the shoes lost all traction and became more a hazard then a help. I also found when hiking over wet metal grates that have been put up around that have been used around some of the water falls that I have been hiking around, they also loose traction. I checked with other hikers in my group that were walking on granite and on the metal grating with traditional low top hiking shoes not boots and they didn't have the same problems I did. The shoes did fine in small river rock stream beds, in dirt mud stream crossings, and in lake shore mud flats sand canoeing they didn't do so well in clay mud but I have yet to find a shoe that does so I don't hold that against them . They were easy to clean off but did take a long time to dry if not left out in the sun. The few times when I left the out to dry overnight, they were still damp in the morning. I found that it was easy to clean any mud off of them by spraying them with a hose or by rinsing them off in lake or stream water after taking them off. I haven't had any problems with pebbles sticks getting in the shoes when walking on dry or mud that isn't deep. The shoes have gotten mud in them when walking through streams and lake shore mud flats but I just rinsed them off when I got out of the stream mudflat and continued hiking in them wet. Again, I haven't had any problems with them chaffing while either dry or wet. I have worn them on a sand beach. I would not wear them in dry sand but they did fine in damp sand. in the dry sand, they just kept getting sand in them that I would have to stop and shake out every two or three steps. Overall,I like the shoes a lot but they aren't very good when it comes to wet rock hiking. If this is what you want shoes for, then I would say to keep looking. However, if you are looking for a show to use when canoeing, hiking over dry ground, damp sand, and mud, or gravel river beds, then I would say that these should would be a strong option.

I've got slightly narrow feet and while the shoe looks like it'd be great it just tightens such that it's too tight in some areas and not tight enough in others. I recommend avoiding these shoes. I give them one star above the minimum because I think they do look quite good, but they fail at everything that I want a shoe to do.

Merrell Men's J65243 Water Shoes, Once upon a time Merrell made a water shoe that I think was called a Millenial. That was a great shoe that Merrell stopped making, thereby handing the entire closed toe sandal market over to Teva. For years I ve had to put up with the declining quality of Teva shoes waiting for Merrell to come back. Well, if this shoe is the answer, YOU VE FAILED!,! - Loose stitching right out of the box. - Fully elastic backstrap. How is my foot supposed to stay in the shoe with an elastic backstrap, like up a hill? Stupid Design. - Whole shoe is built with Thin materials fabric, leather , with Lots of zigzag stitching the weakest kind of stitch . Pretty Vibram sole with almost no lug,. My worn out Tevas have more lug. All in all this is one of the poorest products from a company known for good shoes. The Race to the Bottom continues.

I bought these to wear with socks as an upgrade from sandals. They are not intended to be used in sandy areas as the sand will collect in all the shoes crevasses. Long walks will result in blisters if not paired with socks. Unfortunately I returned these after walking many miles in them because the sole had a painful lump in the right shoe. Maybe these could be 5 stars but again...socks are needed for long walks and without socks they feel very clammy. I might purchase these again but in a Merrill store so I can feel the product for defects.

I finally used these shoes during a cruise and can give my two cents. The shoes are comfortable. They provide decent arch support which I have issues with. Never felt pain, but the only issue I had was the sand. As soon as I got in the water, the rocks and sand got in the shoe right away. It was very uncomfortable and was hard to get the rocks out. If these were advertised as water swimming pool only shoes, then I can give it 5 stars.

Had a pair of Keen Newport H2's that lasted years. Eventually the soles wore out. Wanted to try something new and these looked great and the price was a bit more affordable. Have only had for a short while and so far so good though 1 they do not feel as secure as the keen. When hiking in wet areas I fear that my foot will slip inside the shoe more so then the keen's did... though admittedly I've not yet used them in this environment. 2 they have zero arch support. I have flat feet and suspect that this might be problematic for a long hike. Otherwise I like the style and comfort very much.

Comfortable for the most part. I wish they had a little more support. There was a bit of a break in period when I first got them. Have done mild hiking in them in addition to just wearing on the go. It seems like they cause my hips and knees to be a little achy if I wear more than a couple days in a row.
There was more arch support than expected and I got blisters initially. Everyone will be different. No issues with fit and plenty of grip on rocks.

Great all around kicks! Nice lite hiker for short jaunts. Comfortable and convenient, easy to slip on off. Excellent materials, great cushion, wide protective toe box grippy Vibram outsole. Would definitely buy again!

This product is used in place of slippers around the house. My son's slippers and slides give no shape and support to his foot. I noticed his foot turning as he walked around the house. I purchased this for him to wear in casual situations but also around the house but most importantly to supply and arch and support to a fifteen years old's foot.

This is my second pair, which I bought to rotate with my others which I wear almost every day and have for many months . Great for walking in warm climates and anywhere near the water, easy to carry and to clean for travel. Has the advantages of both a slip-on sandal and a shoe with laces for adjusting fit. The arch support improves with use as the footbed starts to conform.
Excellent and extremely comfortable. I walked and hiked all around Greece in these as my only shoes, and couldn't be happier.
I typically wear custom orthotics. Hesitant that would not support enough, no worries. Wore for 8 hours on wave runner and walking the board walk. No issues, very comfortable
Support of a walking shoe with great draining for wearing in the water. Waterfront at our cabin has a rough bottom. These are great for working or playing by the water

Tried Keen and Treva and I can tell this is much better. Not over engineered or stiff like the others. It fits perfectly, offer necessary protection and can put it on or take it off is a second. Feels very comfortable too. I had returned a Treva sandal after it hurt my ankle.

After casual and in water wearing this shoe, I am revising my review from 4 to 5 stars. I was concerned with 'arch support' but must state that is 'not an issue'. These are comfortable, light weight shoes, with a flat sole that grips on wet surface quality and finish is 'very good'. I highly recommend this shoe.
Soft sole. Nice and snug. Good protection all around from rocks and other street debris. Cannot wait to use these on the cruise ship on the beaches of the Caribbean.
Love the quality and performance of this shoe. Very comfortable. I think I've hiked in these more than my trail hiking shoes since I bought them. Shed water quickly. Love them.

My husband wore these for two weeks straight on an island vacation. I got the women's version. They were AMAZING. We could hike on the super muddy trails and sink right in and then blast off all the mud with water before getting in the car again. Also wore them in the ocean on particularly rocky beaches. They weren't super comfortable while walking around with them wet but they dry pretty quick and they were so much more versatile than regular hiking shoes. The arch support was good and we never had tired feet.

These water shoes were EXACTLY what I wanted. They have a more rugged sole than some other beach-only water shoes so I could walk comfortably along the rockier shore of lakes and rivers. The contoured foot bed gave me more arch support than flat sandals do and the soft uppers did not cause any friction or chafing even after all day use. Left to drip-dry overnight, they were only just a little damp next morning.

size.issue_summary: 많은 고객들이 사이즈 문제로 불만을 토로하고 있으며, 신발이 너무 작거나 너무 큰 경우가 많아 착용에 어려움을 겪고 있습니다.
size.strength_summary: 구매자들은 신발의 사이즈가 정확하고 편안하다고 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다. 이는 소비자들에게 신뢰감을 주고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Took me 3 orders to finally get a pair of these shoes, and then the stitching started coming undone on my first time out with them. Less than a mile walked. First pair was a size 11, which I normally wear. Length felt correct but the toe-box was very roomy, like it was too tall. So I exchanged them for a size 10.5 which felt too short by had an appropriate sized toe-box. Returned the 10.5 in favor of 11's again and the threads started unraveling on my first walk around the house and in the garden not even on a hike or anything like that .

My worn out Tevas have more lug. All in all this is one of the poorest products from a company known for good shoes. The Race to the Bottom continues.

Like the design, but having a wide foot they didn't work well for me. They were too tight narrow in the mid-portion of the shoe at the front of my arch and rubbed my foot raw after few short hours. Wish they made them in a wide version. Merrell's make nice products, but not enough choices in a wide foot. Too bad for me I guess...
I replaced a pair which fit perfectly with an identical pair. Last time they fit perfectly. This time, they are too small.

I ve been a KEEN sandal guy for around 15 years. It seemed like the newer versions of the KEENs didn t fit my foot well anymore for some reason. I decided to try these. They fit great and are very comfortable. I think they are lighter than a comparable KEEN as well. I recommend these sandals. Edit After 6 weeks of easy use one of the straps eyelets broke. The strap material doesn't seem up to the task

I usually wear Keen Newport and have for years in all conditions, I wear Merrell sneakers the rest of the time. I even own Merrell dress shoes. Merrell sneakers are the most comfortable sneakers I have ever worn. I turned my wife onto Merrell sneakers and she calls them 34 billy goat shoes 34 because of the grip they have on the granite here in Tucson. I thought I should give these All Out Blaze Sieve Trail Runners a try. And to my disappointment these 34 trail runners 34 are not suitable for running on the sidewalk or the trail. The sole is thin and there is little support. My Keen Newport can handle everything from the trail to street hockey with the guys. Plus buyer beware the return policy states 34 You can return this item for any reason and get a full refund no shipping charges. The item must be returned in new and unused condition. 34 You cannot return this item for any reason and get a full refund. These Merrells feel fine for a little walking around the house. But a walk out side reveals the bothersome sole and uncomfortable upper design. So I can indeed return these Merrells for any reason as long as the reason is that I wore them and found out how uncomfortable they are. Please do yourself a favor and try the Keen Newport.

I had a slightly different pair of these that I wore for years. The biggest difference for me is not having an adjustable back strap. The back strap is loose but the rest of the shoe fits fine. I can try to use the elastic to get it tight all over, but that to try to shore up the back just makes the extra elastic band ridiculously long and event tucking it under the cross straps still leaves several inches past the toe. For the price I expected better. I loved my old ones, but will likely look to a different brand in the future.
I want to love these but there s a flaw on the sole of the right foot. I can t figure out what is causing the pain but it s at the front of my arch by the ball of my right foot.
These shoes have several weak links. the loops that hold the laces split open as well as the major straps that secure your foot.

I'm a big fan of Merrell, shoes I bought these to replace a five-year-old pair of Moab water shoes that I love and have worn constantly as a lightweight everyday street shoe, but sadly were discontinued some time ago. Although these seem OK, ultimately, I returned them and went with the Aero version of the ALL Out Blaze I didn't really care for the feel and fit of these with the lack of a tongue, nor the open back of the heeI the Areo's are more enclosed and constructed a more like a standard running shoe. After three weeks, I'm liking them a lot. But I suppose if you are planning to be in the water, these would be more appropriate. If you are looking at these, you might want to also check out the Merrell Tetrex Crest Wrap Sport Sandal as well - if I had found them before I bought these, they are what I would have ordered, as they look to be closer to the Moabs I love so much.
The heel straps fall off and must be pulled up every 20 feet!! HORRIBLE if want to wear socks, but even bare foot the heel straps drop down off foot!!! But they know this defect!!!

I bought these for a week-long rafting trip. I wanted something that was good for side-hikes, and on the wet raft. I got these because usually Merrel has well-molded shoes with good arch support. I work as a surgeon and wear Merrels in the OR for that reason. Well, this is not the case with these whatsoever. No molded sole at all. Plantar fasciitis raging all week. Comparing these to the 10 pair I bought at Walmart and threw some cheap inserts into, these are actually less comfortable, collect a ton of silt, and take forever to dry. The way the holes are you pretty much always end up with a few pebbles around your toes which are impossible to shake loose. Also, the rubber material the sole is made from is squeaky and uncomfortable against the bottom of your foot. They look very snazzy, but for the function I would not pay 15 for them. Save your money and look elsewhere.

I wish I could return the shoes. I didn't even hike or anything. Regular everyday use going to work, shopping etc. The stitching is coming off in several places. Didn't expect this after 2 months from shoes that cost 90 dollars. Fit A little bit wide towards the front, otherwise the fit is great.

There is very little flexible cushion on the sole which makes them not good for general walking around. The pair I have has a left foot that feels like there is a small rock in the tread. It's caused a bone in my foot to get out of wack and now my foot still hurts a week after not wearing them. I've never had an issue with Merrell's comfort nor quality control until now.

I bought these as a replacement to my Keen Newports, as I had worn them out over the past 10 years and saw these had good reviews. The shoes look good but that's about where the positives end. First and foremost, the shoe was an entire size too large they're a bit over an inch larger than my Keens of the same size . The bungee tightening strap is either defective or cheaply made it forcefully rubs against the bungee cord when tightening or loosening the strap. I bet the cord couldn't last more than 4 months of daily use. The rubber bottom feels fragile and provides very little support. Finally, these are just uncomfortable. I've got slightly narrow feet and while the shoe looks like it'd be great it just tightens such that it's too tight in some areas and not tight enough in others. I recommend avoiding these shoes. I give them one star above the minimum because I think they do look quite good, but they fail at everything that I want a shoe to do.
I like that the shoe felt good right away and that they fit my exact size. The shoes are very comfortable and durable.

I have bought many pairs of merrell shoes over the years, but have required a wide for comfort. Unfortunately, this leaves me with limited options. I took a chance with these sandals, hoping they would be looser in the toe area than a regular shoe. Very pleased to find out this was the case.

Finally found a water shoe that fits and doesn't eat my feet up. I used them yesterday at Kanarra Creek in Utah. The holes in the sides are big enough to breath but not allow rocks to get in. Great fit for my big feet.

All is well but the 34 Heel 34 it slides down while step forward, to avoid that, need to over thighten the cord so that the heel stay while walking. Made of slippery material that it does not stay in contact with skeen at the heel. Not a confortable shoe for me

Amazon delivered these sandals a day early, which I appreciate. I wear size 11 sandals, ordered size 11 , received size 11, and they fit perfectly. The toe box is wide enough so that your feet aren't cramped. Well built. Ordered these to replace a pair of Keen Newport H2 water sandals which came apart after 3 months. Merrells are known for durability. These look like they will last longer. Highly recommended.
It s half size bigger I think. I normally wear 8 with sock but the size 7.5 was not available for me. I have to give them to my dad. Shoe is good I like it.

This is my second pair. Great sure footed sandal moc I size down 1 2 size for a really secure fit. I will most likely buy a third pair. Light rock scrambling camp shoe, I will take a pair to Greece as an everything shoe.

Fit perfectly and didn t need a break in time period before wearing all day. Cool comfy with no socks. This is my 3rd pair. I wear them daily and they last about a 12-18 months. Wish they were not so hard to find these days, so I bought 3 pair.
I HAVE VERY WIDE FEET THIS IS THE FIRST SHOE IN YEARS THAT I PUT ON THAT FIT AND THEY LOOK AWESOME. PROBABLY BY MORE TO STOCK PILL

Wanted a shoe that was washable with a tough sole for doing chores on our small farm. The soles hard enough to work a shovel and the closed toes protect my feet. When they get dirty, just hose them down and back to work.

Looked like a great product decided to actually go with a more shoe like pair of river shoes in the end. These are more like sandals and open. I usually always wear a a size 9 in men's and had to order an 8 eventually that fit well. No real test other than fitment but geeze was that hard to find online. Didnt even get that info here so thought I would let others know my personal experience.

I love these shoes! I was concerned about the fit due to some of the comments. I have narrow feet which also often can be a problem but these were true to size on length and adjust for narrow or standard width. I took a 3 1 2 mile walk straight out of the box and I was amazed at how comfortable they were. I highly recommend these shoes.
Very comfortable right out of the box. I never wear shoes like this and didn't know if I would like them but am really liking them and have already recommended them to others
Really liked the overall fit. Goes on and off easy, covers toes and the lace system is easy to operate. Fit is spot on! Quality is up to the Merrell high level. Would buy again!

I HAVE HAD A VERY HARD TIME FINDING SHOES WIDE ENOUGH AND COMFORTABLE TO WEAR ALL DAY. THEN I FOUND MERRILL SHOES. I ALWAYS ORDER MENS.THESE FIT GREAT . I'M A PRESCHOOL TEACHER AND ON MY FEET ALOT.I AM OLDER NOW AND NO LONGER CAN GO HIKING. BUT STILL WEAR THESE EVERYDAY .I ALSO HAVE DIABETES AND FOOT PROBLEMS, AND THESE HELP PROTECT MY FEET.

durability.issue_summary: 구매자들은 내구성 문제로 인해 여러 번 수선이 필요하거나 사용 중에 제품이 손상되는 경험을 하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: I ve owned a pair of these for years and they have been great. They finally started showing wear so I ordered a new pair for me and one for my son. On both new pairs, and the replacements, the stitching came apart in multiple places, especially the heal immediately. Hopefully Merrill can up the quality control as I d still like a new pair without the defects!

I bought these as a gift to be used for vacation. While on vacation the inside lining of shoe came off. We just returned this weekend only to find out that the return window has closed July 31. These are not inexpensive shoes and should hold up longer than one week. VERY disappointed in return policy.

I really wanted to like these sandals! I ordered these twice and both times the rear strap started to break! I personally did not get blisters. I gently broke both the pairs in by going on a walk around town 2-3 miles each time . By the second and third use the rear left strap started breaking.

I got these for backwoods fishing trips. My trips are generally 3 to 5 days and involve some pretty rough hiking and often 8 to 10 hours of wet wading per day. I've made 8 trips since I bought these shoes. At first they were really nice but unfortunately they are already falling apart. The soles are still perfect but the stitching can't stand up to being wet for extended periods of time. The material in the uppers takes a long time to dry so when I'm using them mine never really get a chance to completely dry. The thread holding everything together has disintegrated in many places so the shoes are coming apart. They are still wearable but they don't fit as well and I don't trust them for hiking or wading in the backwoods. In fairness I asked a lot of these shoes and I'm not completely disappointed with them but I'm probably going to try something else before buying another pair.
