The soles have lasted so far with no sign of separation, but the lace loops need improvement. They still hold onto my feet enough, but I feel they ll only last another few months. Not the long term durability that I ve known from Merrell. If those loops were reinforced these would be absolutely perfect.

I wish I could return the shoes. I didn't even hike or anything. Regular everyday use going to work, shopping etc. The stitching is coming off in several places. Didn't expect this after 2 months from shoes that cost 90 dollars. Fit A little bit wide towards the front, otherwise the fit is great.
I replaced a pair which fit perfectly with an identical pair. Last time they fit perfectly. This time, they are too small.

The soles are made from a very hard compound. My previous pair Chameleons from Merrell had much better traction on both dry and wet surfaces. If I could get new back straps for them, they would have a lot of life left. The Blaze Sieve are slippery even when transitioning from a wet to a dry surface. And traction on some dry surfaces is dicey. On wet surfaces, be careful of leaves or dirt. The fit is good with or without socks. The "tongue" bit could be wider and longer it folds under when putting on the shoes and is so small the getting a grip on it is not so easy. If the traction issues were better, these would be nice. As they are, they are just adequate with precautions kept in mind.
These shoes have several weak links. the loops that hold the laces split open as well as the major straps that secure your foot.
I paid about 90 for these water shoes to participate in Aqua classes and the fabric tore in less than 6 months. I would NOT recommend this product

I bought them because my feet sweat a lot during summer and thought of giving this sandals a chance. Turns out they're not the right product for me. After about an hour of use, the sweat of my feet combined with the friction somehow accelerates the wearing of the interior and starts to peel it off giving a grainy and slippery sensation that's obviously unpleasant.

I purchased these for a trip to Las Vegas where we would be hiking in the desert and kayaking on the Colorado River all in the same day. The first time I wore them for any length of time was on a four mile hike to some natural hot springs and then onto an 8 mile kayak trip. The shoes were incredible. I did pick up sand and small rocks but that's expected. Even people with expensive hiking boots had to stop occasionally and empty their shoes. They gripped great in the water. I wear an 112EE but they fit perfectly. They are very comfortable right out of the box. I did have some threading come loose on both shoes so I had to return them for replacement. However, I'm confident it was an anomaly. I look forward to receiving my replacements in a couple of days. UPDATE Received my replacements May 3, 2018. There was threading loose on these too but I repaired it myself. On June 8, 2018 I noticed the toe on the left shoe was separating. Yes, 8 days after the Amazon 30 day return guarantee expired. I'll be contacting Merrell to return them once again. They feel fantastic on my feet but I'm not sure of the quality at this point. Maybe the third time will be the charm! So five stars for how they feel but one star for workmanship. Disappointing!

I have been wearing these for a few years and they have held up well and still look pretty good. Some wear, a few threads here and there but still good. They filled the bill, easy to wear, protect my feet and are cool. I Like them!

Wanted a shoe that was washable with a tough sole for doing chores on our small farm. The soles hard enough to work a shovel and the closed toes protect my feet. When they get dirty, just hose them down and back to work.
This shoe held up very well during two weeks of hiking in Hawaii, often over very rough lava fields.

This is the third pair I have owned and usually get 3-4 years out of them. They are worn daily from March through November snow and slop and the reason for getting a new pair is that the soles are worn flat.

Last couple pairs of Keen s that I have had, the stitching would loosen. So I found these Marrell s, and they are a great replacement and a great fit I haven t worn them to the beach yet but I love them and they feel great walking through the woods., Easy to slip them very comfy too.
I typically wear custom orthotics. Hesitant that would not support enough, no worries. Wore for 8 hours on wave runner and walking the board walk. No issues, very comfortable
These are great shoes. Unfortunately, this particular pair was mis-sewn and had to be repaired almost right away. We just did that.

Funny I purchased these in May of 2017 and they still have no flaws despite numerous camping, kayaking and fishing adventures I've worn them on. I think they are worth more than 200 because I can wear them for years with only mild fading and the sole does need to be kept clean with a deodorizer. For the money for an outdoor enthusiast I will purchase another pair when these give out but they are over 3 years old and barely any wear on the sole, I probably have over 100 miles on these walking. Being a former paratrooper I put a lot of stock on reliability and function, these are by far the best pair of shoes I've owned including regular hiking boots. You can go for hiking adventures with these and walk through streams and if you tip your kayak or canoe these stay on.

There is nothing my husband likes more than finding something he loves and then buying it over and over and over! again. He finds these sandals very comfortable and wears them year-round. To him, they offer the support of a tennis shoe while allowing for great venting in the heat of Southern California. God willing, I'll keep buying them as long as Merrell offers them. The previous pair is about 2 years old with constant wear. I'd say that's a pretty well-made product. RECOMMEND.
Use these for my fishing shoes. Dad wears his every day in summer. Dry quick, solid support, not slick on wet boat ramp.

I think these are quite well made, as they should be for the price paid. My US size 10's fit as expected. With the elastic lacing system there is ample range of adjustment for size and width variations in your foot. There is an elastic heel strap which allows you to set the tension on the laces once, then slip the shoes on and off without further adjustments to the laces. These shoes fit comfortably, have a cushioned rubber insole, and there is ample room around my toes so that they do not rub. I had tried another, much less expensive brand, but had a problem with those rubbing the top of my little toe. No such problem here. Being fairly new I can't say just how durable these will be long term, but the construction appears to be solid.

Bought these for my husband to use during a fishing tournament. He was able to use immediately, no break in needed. Wore them several hours each day. Mostly standing. Dried quickly. He said they felt better than a tennis shoe. No low back pain at the end of the day.

So far so good. These are well built shoes with good attention to detail. The lace tie works well and holds even under heavy use. Comfort level is very high and they seem like they will last awhile. We'll see.......I can see why Merrell is considered a top brand.

Right out of the box an amazing Merrell product at an equally amazing price with almost instant delivery from Amazon UPDATE 13 months later.....these are the very best sandals I've ever owned hands down....they are so comfortable I have worn them frequently with sox in the Winter in VT! Being retired I spend the bulk of my free time fishing, all Summer throughout VT, NH, ME and Canada...these sandals provide perfect traction in the boat, on slippery rocks, even walking brookside in 3' tall weeds, great ventilation, great when wet, great on any terrain.....the Vibram soles are tough and even after extensive wear, only the outside heal nubs show any wear at all......next Spring I'll buy another pair without even shopping! UPDATE July 2020 While these remain very capable and comfortable, I am faced with a failure that I should mention. My sandals remain in very good general condition however ONE loop guiding the lace on the left foot, right hand side, has broken for no apparent reason leaving the sandal loose and it cannot be easily repaired! This is a manufacturing issue on an amazing pair of high quality sandals...NOW, do I bite the bullet and buy another pair anyway, or look at alternatives? MERRELL?
Durable and nice looking. Comfortable enough for all day walking and hiking. Easy clean and get a few years out of each pair.

representative_reviews.text: I am a footwear enthusiast and have no problem spending the extra money on quality footwear and unfortunately this shoe is not terrible overall yet it's only the value of about a 40 dollar sandel of equal style. Very cheaply made. So if you plan on wearing these often keep looking.

Only the footbed comfort combined with cuteness factor made me keep these after stumbling and falling on top of someone in Costco, totally obliterating social distancing measures. The other issue I had was that the straps did rub on the usual places sandals like these always cause me blisters, so my hope that the rubbery material might somehow be better failed. I took other reviewers' advice and sized up 1 2 size, and I'm glad I did. At first, I was a little worried they were still too small, but they fit like a glove and hug your foot as you move around. The end result - they keep your foot extremely stable, so no blisters and no injuries from your foot shifting around. I did notice the very top tongue area of the shoe would cinch up and felt too tight against my instep, like they were cutting off blood flow. I simply unlaced the eyelets second from the top and loosened the overall lacing, and this did the trick. These shoes are well-cushioned and durable. I have a prior metatarsal fracture and a bunion on one big toe thank you narrow pointy heels , and I can walk comfortably in these for miles. The mesh on top is reinforced, so your toes won't break holes through the top, and the soles are wearing well. Highly recommend this shoe!

representative_reviews.text: I've had these shoes for a little under 2 months now and loved them till just a few days ago. I started to notice some discomfort in my left shoe right in the middle and to my dismay when I looked there was a decent hole that developed right in the middle of the padding. Normally I just try to do something like put duct tape over it or whatever but for these to be walking shoes and have it already start to fall apart nothing yet with my right shoe yet it's kinda hard to be happy with these. I work from home so normally only wear them when I walk my dog or go to the store so I'd say maybe 2-3 miles per day I walk in them and now they're uncomfortable as can be so ill likely go back to either my ASICS or Sauconys again.

These fit my small feet well, though they do have little arch support. They feel light and super comfortable, easy on and off. However, the bottom of the sole is a weird design with large deep enough gaps that they pick up and hold on to every piece of gravel they can. I spent half my walk today pulling gravel out of my shoes! So these are great for indoors, but I won't be using them as my outdoor walking shoes unfortunately.
Poor quality, very poor quality. Thin with almost zero support. Feel like wearing a cheap pair of slippers

I wore these to work where I stand for 7 to 9 hours. The stretch top is great, but by the end of the day my feet hurt like heck. The bottoms drive me crazy. I have a gravel driveway and the pebbles get into the soles of the shoe and I have to constantly clean them before going in the house. I was too late to return them, so I will rehome them.
Nice shoes but very uncomfortable! The heel is too low. My feet hurt every time I wore them. I should have sent them back but waited too long.

I have mobility issues and I really need a slip-on shoe that I can just slip on. This is not it. The heal folds under and the opening is very narrow. This product did not work for me. Couldn't even get it on to see if it fit!

After adding some Physix Gear Sport insoles for better arch support, my plantar fasciitis is not longer bothering me. Aside from a pair of sandals, the ventilation is impeccable making them perfect for hot weather. The soles do pick up all sorts of small debris from landscaping bark to pea gravel but my feet have never been more comfortable. The bad news is that I've only gotten about 4 months of use out of them. Being lightweight and breathable, they aren't up to daily rough-and-tumble abuse like working in the garage or bumping into things which can snag the fabric. There isn't any reinforcing material on top of the toe area so my big toes have worn holes nearly through from the inside-out. Until I find a more durable shoe though, I'm kind of stuck with these. Having sore feet from PF is miserable because the only thing that doesn't hurt is sitting

I expected Skechers given the number of commercials would deliver the better or at least equal to comfort in my ASICS runners but was horribly disappointed with the marginal level of support and cushioning needed for arthritis pain. These shoes are only slightly better support than my slippers which have NONE. Conclusion Maybe trust but verify should be your watchwords. Skechers are definitely Meh .

I have an sprained right wrist and injured feet, and have bought these shoes for physical therapy. The shoes support my feet very well actually, which is good, but they freaking require a lot of force to actually put on my feet because the ankle opening of the shoe is so tight. This is difficult to do in my condition, because I either need to put a lot of force through my feet, which I cannot do without reinjuring myself, or i put force through my right hand which is my major hand and hurt my wrist. Given the wrist is the lesser injury at least for now, I choose to sacrifice risking hurting the wrist, and I've already hurt my wrist a little putting these on for one of my PT sessions. I wish they would have said that at least in the description, but hopefully people who are buying this while injured will see this review. I don't blame Skechers or whoever if anyone is to blame, it's Amazon's "true to fit" moniker which doesn't take putting the shoes on into account, just the fit once it's on , it's just most of these reviews are for abled, non-injured people, not someone like me.

I purchased these shoes in April. I have only worn them twice. Both times, I have developed blisters on my feet because of the slippage. I would like to get the same shoe in an 11.5 NORMAL width. I know I am outside the return period, bur am asking for an exception. I do a lot of purchasing from Amazon, and I am very unhappy. Thank you for your consideration in this matter.

I've always bought Go Walks, but this is way too much on the bottom. I feel like I'm driving with snow shoes on. The soul even canght the brake as I moved my foot from the gas pedal to the brake. It doesn't feel safe driving. I want to return them.

These shoes are terrible. They are squishy and provide zero foot support. They should be called Go Sit , because they certainly are useless for walking. They are akin to walking around on marshmallows. A great way to destroy your feet!

I bought these for my husband in hopes that these would work for him to wear at work in a busy medical setting where he is always on his feet. He told me they were only comfortable for the first couple of days after that the memory foam was flat he felt like he was walking on concrete with no ankle support. He had to discontinue wearing them after about 3-4 weeks as he was experiencing back pain leg pain from the shoes. I guess you get what you pay for?

This is a good shoe for every day activity. My only complaint is that it is not good for athletic activity or extended walking. For walking around your house or office, you'll be fine, but if you plan on walking for 10 or more minutes, I would suggest a more expensive, well padded shoe and you may be able to fix this with Dr. Scholls . The reason it doesn't work for athletics is because it isn't right on your foot due to it being a slip on shoe, so your foot can slip off the side. I almost twisted my ankle trying to play tennis in these. Otherwise, good all around shoe for the money. Update Decreased from 4 stars to 2 stars. These shoes didn't hold up well. The main complaint is the grip on the bottom smoothed over very quickly and made it borderline dangerous to wear these if it was wet or slick where you were walking.

first off, I love this shoe. It is very comfortable to walk in, but I will be replacing them well before they are worn out. The deep tread on these walking shoes captures so many rocks that you will end up. Scratching your floors as you walk across your home. It also makes the shoes uncomfortable to walk in when there are rocks in bedded in the treads. I find myself constantly stopping to pick rocks out of the treads. This company needs to think hard about developing a different tread pattern.

Being in the Military most of my life and wearing Government issued combat boots that never fit properly, my feet now are a total wreck. These Skechers shoes are absolutely the best fitting and most comfortable shoes I've worn. They are easy to slip on and you don't need a shoe horn to do it. I wear a size 12 4E depending on who makes the shoe. When Skechers say "wide shoe," the mean it. These shoes are wide and true to size. I noted that some of the reviews were low because folks had issues with the elastic tearing at the arch. I would say the reason for this is they are using the shoes for high-activity sports that put a lot of stress on the arch. They would be better off wearing lace-up tennis shoes that can take the abuse. These Go Walk Sneakers are intended for walking, not high-activity sports. Wear them for their intended purpose and you wont have issues. I love them and especially recommend them for people who have serious back problems. They can be easily slipped on without having to bend over and tie the shoe. They look good enough to wear just about anywhere and the price is right for what you get.
This was a comfortable fit right out of the box. Easy to slip on and like walking on a pillow. I recommend highly!
I wear these to work and they are so comfortable. It's like there's an extra cushion under my feet. I love them!
This is the most comfortable shoe I have ever bought. I have a bad back and this shoe makes it easier to walk. Great Shoe

Very nicely made and bottoms grip well. I had a model like this one before that had memory foam and was a big disappointment. The foam fell apart while the bottoms still looked to be in very good condition which then caused my feet to get blisters. This one had a mat on the bottom with some arch support. The grip is pretty good and I do not feel the rubber bottom they say its rubber is too soft like my other ones where you can feel large rocks like they were a sponge. These ones are nicely made and should be much better.

I was dubious but decided to try Sketchers. I am using it for daily life and find it comfortable and lightweight. I take a men's 12 and this fits just right. I'm not sure about the arch support. It seems a bit weak, but I haven't noticed any pain during or after wearing the shoes all day.

Bought as slippers to wear around the house and go outside with the dog. Very comfortable. I have VERY HIGH arches and have foot cast orthopedic arch-support inserts that I wear so to me, there was no arch support in these but I would have to have my inserts in any shoe I wear. They arrived in one day and I wore them to work the next day. They have soft tread so I wouldn't recommend walking on rocks or pavement but around the house they should hold up nicely.

I have degenerative Joint disease so standing for long periods is painful. I bought these before vacation hoping I wouldn't hurt as bad at the end of the day. They worked perfectly! They're light weight and super comfortable. The cushioning almost has a bounce when I walk. I love these shoes!
I bought these for house shoes. They are very comfortable and light. They are a good walking shoe although I'd like a little more arch support.
Perfect replacement for my original canvas shoe. Comfortable cushion at ball of my foot which was exactly what I needed.
Work on my feet all day and it s nice to have a wonderful pare shoes that are very well padded and quite comfortable.

So many shoe manufacturers boast theirs is the most comfortable, best ever and your new favorite. Don't listen. THIS IS. Well made, light weight, attractive and you can stand for hours. I am 70, arthritic and usually in pain. These help. Only wish I had them 30 years ago. Buy them. Today.

All Aspects? You bet. In 2 years my feet demanded that I go from a 12D to a 14WWW. I reluctantly bought these and am dreadfully sad for waiting so long. They are a fantastic fit just like using my own last. My cardiologist recommended them an did not even charge extra. The foot bed is made from a heavy weight material that absorbs every step. This is an all encompassing casual shoe made for wear and comfort. Its pricepoint is quite attractive for such comfort and versatility.

I love these shoes. The cushioning is perfect. I took a chance and took them to Europe when brand new. I am so glad I did. I walked 5-7 miles every day through the streets of Europe. My feet were never tired or sore. They slip on and off for TSA. They show no wear after 4 weeks of daily hard use. I'm thinking of buying another pair to have when these eventually wear out. For the price they can't be beat.

This is the first and last time I order shoes or any kind of clothing online!

I purchased these thinking they d be a logical step up from the Sketchers Go Walk Max Clinched model that I ve really enjoyed. However, a short two-mile walk revealed that the toe box is much narrower in comparison, leaving my toes feeling pinched. I have a narrow foot with plenty of natural arch and wear a size 11D. My biggest concerns are toe comfort and plenty of sole cushioning for shock absorption, thanks to arthritis issues. Unfortunately, the restricted toe box didn t allow much freedom of toe movement and also negatively affects isolation from road shock. Lesson learned. I just ordered my third pair of the Go Walk Max Clinched - If you find something that works, stay with it.

Photos included show 10.5 regular vs 10.5 wide. Reg on left wide on right These shoes didn t fit but I am keeping them anyway. The 10.5 wides run wider than all other extra wide shoes I have. There is an extra inch of space in the toe box making them feel more like 11 s. Sketchers must think that wide foot also means fat ankle because the ankle openings on these are massive. They don t give any ankle support. I also ordered size 10.5 regular and 10 wide to check the fit since there s always a little size difference between manufacturers. The 10 wides were too small and cramped my foot in the toe box. The 10.5 regular had no wiggle room in the toe box and was so tight it felt like I had a Boa Constructor on my foot. The 10.5 regular did have a better fit at the ankle openings. These shoes also have no arch support so if that s something you need you may be disappointed. Ok so why am I keeping the 10.5 wides if they don t fit right? Bottom line.. the insole and bottom sole are so nice to stand on. They feel that good under my feet! I am only using these as house slippers and they will never go outside. I also found that the extra room will allow me to wear extra thick socks with them during the winter. The bottom soles are also quiet and no-slip on wood and tile. If the manufacturer would have made these 1 2 inch smaller and used a normal size ankle openings they would been perfect.

As a slip on, the fabric is very breathable which helps keep my feet cool or at least not as hot and sweaty as a traditional sneaker. Very happy with my purchase.
Shoes fit perfectly and looking forward to much use out of them Appear to be just what the doctor ordered!

These shoes were comfortable from the time I first put them on and they were are great for long trips. They are easy to put on and fit just right. Wearing these shoes are like walking on air. I normally purchase EE shoes, but with these sketchers I did not need the wide shoe. The size was true to fit...so don't buy them bigger than normal...be exact when determining your size. We are thrilled to find an excellent well-fitting and nice looking shoe for him. We highly recommend these shoes! Thank you! They came quickly and in a nice shoe box too.

I usually have a hard time find sneakers that fit but these are the bees knees! Excellent, wide fit, super easy to slip on. They kind of fit like and look a little like Crocs, but made of fabric rather than plastic, and with a higher heel back that keeps your tootsies securely in the shoe. Fantastic!

These shoes are VERY comfortable to wear all day, even after a year of use. I've purchased a Size 15, and to my surprise, they were quite loose in the heel area, allowing 2 fingers. Toe box has ample room for normal width shoes. Washable without any problems Excellent, breathable shoe to wear for summer months, and for early fall late spring. Also, on certain tile surfaces and laminated surfaces, these shoes tend to "stick" when you step. Imagine a suction cup constantly being applied and removed from a glass surface. This is the only reason for -1 Star.

I'm retired and was looking for a pair of easy to slip-on sneakers for traveling thru airports, and those long walking days visiting sites on vacations. I have a 9.5 long, and solid 4E wide foot with a very high top arch and finding comfortable slip-ons inwhich I can get my foot into has proven difficult to find. These are a perfect fit. I have approximately a quarter inch of front toe space and the width is almost perfect. There is still a tiny bit of bulge on the side, as my foot width is actually a little greater than 4E but it hardly noticeably. So these are spot on for sizing according to a 9.5 - 4E foot measurement. These are the best fitting footwear I have ever owned. As for the slip-on factor, my foot easily slips in due to the elastic tongue, but I still need to reach down and gently pull up on the heal tab, but it is essentially effortless. For someone without a high top arch, they maybe able to just slip their foot in, it depends more on your overall foot structure. I can easily remove them without bending over by gently holding the heal with my other foot. As for comfort, I couldn't ask for anything more comfortable. My foot fits comfortably snug without a pressure points, or looseness, including heal section. They have somthing called GOGA MAT cushion, which provides a gel like cushion support with more of firm foam like even distribution. It doesn't have the jelly like squishy feel, but more of a firm supportive sponge. It's like walking on a firm cloud. My body also runs hot so my feet perspire and I live in sandels around the house. They state they are air cooled, and the couple times I have briefly used them, they appear to provide some relief in this area, as my feet didn't feel hot, but it is hard for me to say diffentively yet. But, these appear to be the best footware purchase I have ever made and I can't wait to try them out on our upcoming 2 week vacation with a lot of walking planned. Due to my foot shape, I am very rough on footware, so we will see how these hold up over time. I will only return to this review for update, if I find these do not live up to expectation in any way.
Great fitting shoe! My job requires me to be on my feet and the shoes are great for long walking and standing. I wear 11.5 size so with my big size feet they fit great.
I bought these for a 6'5" young man with size 16 feet and Autism. He couldn't find any shoes in Amarillo, Texas. He adores these. His mother says he sleeps with them.

I have flat feet, and always have to go up a size to get a woman's walking shoe that fits. When I was a kid, I would wear my brother's sneakers which was 2 sizes smaller using Men's measurements. I got this was in a wide and it fits perfectly! Lots of room for my "bear cub" feet without it being too long. It looks neat on the foot and love how it looks with pants.

I have US 10.5 size feet but I need narrow which is almost impossible to find. I ordered medium and they are medium which leaves them a bit loose on me as expected. I wear them everywhere for easy-on comfort in a good looking casual shoe. I can walk around the neighborhood for exercise comfortably with balance and support in them. They are very fairly priced.

representative_reviews.text: Poor quality, very poor quality. Thin with almost zero support. Feel like wearing a cheap pair of slippers
I wore these while driving and changed into work shoes when i got to work. The threads started coming apart within 2 weeks. Unfortunate because they were comfy.

Was so happy with this product when it first arrived. Fit perfectly and very comfortable for my daily two mile walk. I walk in a suburban neighborhood with sidewalks, no hills and very little no finished surface. I paid more for these shoes as they were marketed as walkers. After about sixty days the sole began to separate from the uppers. I loved the shoe so I applied a little super glue thinking that would hold and it di for about thirty days. During that time the other shoe toe separated, so I applied glue to that. Well after that thirty days the super glue gave up and the soles separated from the upper and I had a set of "flappers" with virtually no sole wear out. I tried contacting the manufacturer through their website, but was unsuccessful. Finally I wrote a letter and sent the shoes back, at my expense, but have not gotten a response. Don't waste money on these shoes
After using this Skechers Men's Go Walk Evolution Ultra occasionally it began to loosen now my right shoe feels like it going to fall off.

I have an sprained right wrist and injured feet, and have bought these shoes for physical therapy. The shoes support my feet very well actually, which is good, but they freaking require a lot of force to actually put on my feet because the ankle opening of the shoe is so tight. This is difficult to do in my condition, because I either need to put a lot of force through my feet, which I cannot do without reinjuring myself, or i put force through my right hand which is my major hand and hurt my wrist. Given the wrist is the lesser injury at least for now, I choose to sacrifice risking hurting the wrist, and I've already hurt my wrist a little putting these on for one of my PT sessions. I wish they would have said that at least in the description, but hopefully people who are buying this while injured will see this review. I don't blame Skechers or whoever if anyone is to blame, it's Amazon's "true to fit" moniker which doesn't take putting the shoes on into account, just the fit once it's on , it's just most of these reviews are for abled, non-injured people, not someone like me.

I've had these shoes for a little under 2 months now and loved them till just a few days ago. I started to notice some discomfort in my left shoe right in the middle and to my dismay when I looked there was a decent hole that developed right in the middle of the padding. Normally I just try to do something like put duct tape over it or whatever but for these to be walking shoes and have it already start to fall apart nothing yet with my right shoe yet it's kinda hard to be happy with these. I work from home so normally only wear them when I walk my dog or go to the store so I'd say maybe 2-3 miles per day I walk in them and now they're uncomfortable as can be so ill likely go back to either my ASICS or Sauconys again.

Ok quality. Skechers is always just fine. However, this particular style does not properly fit a slightly narrower than medium wide foot. In addition, the material will likely stretch a bit, which would only amplify the loose-ness. MOST importantly, BEWARE this seller - SOFTMOC. They say "returnable" on the item page, but DO NOT say customer has to pay for return, which is a bit unfair imho. They should CLEARLY make this known. Also, their return procedure makes you jump through too many hoops!! Once you finally get their "accepted" OK to return and their label, the print is so tiny..good-grief riduculous. Then, the sheer amount of instructions is off-putting! The kind of seller that sees customer's as "the enemy," it seems. Ok, maybe too harsh. The UPS man had to get a magnifying glass to read their label. I would NEVER EVER purchase from this seller again, SOFTMOC , I'd rather pay MORE, and know if the shoe did not fit, I could return it WITHOUT LOOSING money. SO, triple check this seller, as the discount price may not be such a good deal in the end. BEST

I have mobility issues and I really need a slip-on shoe that I can just slip on. This is not it. The heal folds under and the opening is very narrow. This product did not work for me. Couldn't even get it on to see if it fit!

I wore these to work where I stand for 7 to 9 hours. The stretch top is great, but by the end of the day my feet hurt like heck. The bottoms drive me crazy. I have a gravel driveway and the pebbles get into the soles of the shoe and I have to constantly clean them before going in the house. I was too late to return them, so I will rehome them.

Ok. I had to rewrite this review. At first the shoes were amazing, they were comfortable but after 3 months the soles were worn out. That's 80 miles of walk time on concrete and the soles completely wore out. Sad, because they were great shoes.

A brand should stick to consistent sizing. I have an old pair of Skechers that were so comfortable I've kept them until they're falling apart. They fit perfectly from the day I bought them until now. Recently I ordered 4 different Skechers models, including the exact one I've been wearing for years, and ALL of them are way too tight. As a result, I have to return all of them. This is the first and last time I order shoes or any kind of clothing online!

This is a good shoe for every day activity. My only complaint is that it is not good for athletic activity or extended walking. For walking around your house or office, you'll be fine, but if you plan on walking for 10 or more minutes, I would suggest a more expensive, well padded shoe and you may be able to fix this with Dr. Scholls . The reason it doesn't work for athletics is because it isn't right on your foot due to it being a slip on shoe, so your foot can slip off the side. I almost twisted my ankle trying to play tennis in these. Otherwise, good all around shoe for the money. Update Decreased from 4 stars to 2 stars. These shoes didn't hold up well. The main complaint is the grip on the bottom smoothed over very quickly and made it borderline dangerous to wear these if it was wet or slick where you were walking.
I like the new sole design. My last pair stood me up for 3 years, I hope I get that kind of mileage from these

For 40 bucks I didn't think these would be much, but my first take is that they seem well made and are super comfortable. Don't know how they will hold up, but they say they are machine washable, which is a huge plus if they come out of the wash in good shape. Very good packaging, great price and fast delivery. I'm not able to tie laces anymore and slip on shoes are a new must for me so if you're in the same boat, I'd say give them a try.

These shoes are comfortable. They seem to keep my feet cool. I was wearing black leather Skechers, since my other summer shoes fell apart, and my socks would be wet from sweat after wearing them throughout the day. The Air Cooled Goga Mat keeps my feet cooler, and is just as comfortable as the regular Skechers Memory foam. However, it is a bit more rigid, and I had a bit of stability issue, as it knocked me off balance some. 3-4 days in and that small issue has gone away. I have 12 inch very wide feet, and size 12 x-wide fits me well. They seem to have good support, but not sure about long term. Also, I have some concern about durability long term. These shoes are mesh instead of leather like my other shoes. I won't be wearing in winter months, as I will go back to my black leather Skechers. I would have given 5 stars , but only 4 stars because of concern for long term comfort and durability.
Perfect replacement for my original canvas shoe. Comfortable cushion at ball of my foot which was exactly what I needed.
Pebbles get stuck on some of shoe 2nd purchase. I added an insole for more stability. I would buy again
Best shoe I have ever owned. After 12 hours a day on my feet at work, I have never found a better shoe for comfort and support.

They were alright good for the first 6 months. There are two things I don't like about this shoe. They used a pink open cell foam under the insole that will get very petrydish like if when you replace the insole. I wish they used closed cell foam and used a built in antimicrobial like microban silver phosphate. The tread makes a squeeling sound when walking on ceramic tile marble it's somewhat embarrassing when your the only one with squeeking shoes at work. They are comfortable easy to put on I just wish they fixed those things generally designed it to last longer instead of being a throw away item.

Well made, breathable slip on. I liked the black color, I don't do white or any wild colors, hard to clean. The one thing I didn't like, it collects rocks, i hate walking around with rocks, pebbles stuck under my shoes. Please stop making sneakers with tractor tire bottoms.

I was worried about the snugness on my foot because there are no laces. To my delight, the fabric hugs your foot without being tight and the shoe stays in place so no blisters will occur on long walks. These have surpassed my expectations in every way. I just got them, so I don't know how long they will hold up, but they appear to be very well made. I reserve space to attest to the durability at a later time.

Saying these are super comfy would be an understatement. I've only been wearing them for a couple of weeks, so my only question at this stage is how long they will last versus more traditional sneakers. Definitely have happy feet right now

Of all the shoes I have owned these are the cats meow! So incredibly comfortable and lightweight. So far they are standing up very well. Great price. Can't say enough good! Hope and pray that Sketchers continue this line of shoe.......

These fit well, are wide, easy to get into and take off. The problem is he insole is full of manufactured holes which means the foam sole will break down quickly. Pretty obvious built-in obsolescence, as the insoles end up dying first anyway.
My husband is a bad person to get anything for but this was a win!!!!! loves them he has no arch and wide feet he loves them !!!!

I really like these shoes. The cushioned soles are exactly what my feet need. I have a pair of tan Sketchers Air Walks I like so much they're beginning to show some wear. So. I'm watching TV. There, a movie star is running with a new Sketchers style, and his shoes are bright blue. I thought this Fantastic, I'm going to see if Amazon has them. Nope. Amazon only had black, charcoal, brown, tan and a very dark navy blue on offer. No bright blue. No red ones. Nope. Only what sells to people who are dead inside. Why is this? O went to the Sketchers website, asked, and found some really cool-looking shoes that indeed are bright blue. My size is sold out. Why? Because those shoes are selling like hotcakes.

I was hoping this would be a silver bullet for my foot pain. It did take longer to start hurting, but apparently I need to see a doc because if these shoes did not fix it.. it's not the shoes. These things are amazing comfy. Think of using a bag of marshmallows on your feet and you have an idea. It is made like the clogs material but 3 times thicker. It likely won't last for long mileage wise because of this, but if you don't put a ton of miles on them they should be excellent. Also because of the material they are about as anti slip as you can get. Almost to a fault actually. I ordered extra wide and got extra WIDE.. which is great since I am technically a double wide. They are good looking too. Probably too good looking for a guy like me. I wish they came in something that looked like a Keen hiking sandal so they would breath more for summer.. but that isn't really a flaw. Maybe the loop at the back could be a smidgen larger to make slipping them on even easier. Splitting hairs here for the most comfy shoes I am sure have ever been invented.

Usually, the first thing I do when I come in from outside be it work no longer a factor , checking the mail, unloading the car, or just walking around , I get my shoes off ASAP usually due to sweaty feet, and the heaviness associated with the shoes . But, these shoes are unbelievably light and so fricking comfortable, I've worn them inside for nearly 12 hours before taking them off! They seem very well made daily wear will show this pretty darn quickly , and well worth the money, I'm seriously considering buying more to subsidies my regular dress shoes, and wear these to the more informal functions.

I purchased this shoe for my husband. He is very pleased with the look, fit and color. I found the price to be exceptionally wonderful!! My husband claims that the memory foam inserts make this the most comfortable shoe he has ever worn. Good value, super comfort and the shoes allow air flow that makes it cool to wear.
Just what I ordered. I have bought several pairs over the past four years in and wear a pair 98 percent of the time.

This shoe works very well for my husband, who overpronates enough to virtually walk out of his shoes at the heel in a very short time. He had a little bit of adjusting to the way it held his foot, but it was not enough to quit wearing them. They are comfortable as well! So now he has three colors. I must say it is quite hard to clean the light khaki shoes, which is why I gave this 4 stars. Would have been 4-1 2 if that was an option. I hope they do not change this shoe, or give loyal customers a heads up so we can have a surplus to fall back on.
I put almost 1,000 miles walking into these shoes last year and they re only showing slight wear, which I think should speak to the quality of these.
Bought them for my 13 year old son. They are super comfortable for all day wearing and running around. And they look good on as well
These are my third skechers pair of shoes, as always, nice and very comfortable! They are also very light. I could not expect anything better for that price. UPDATE My fourth! Still great.

Did a lot of homework before deciding on this shoe. This is a perfect show for my needs. I am a diabetic, while I don t have any foot problems as a result, but I d like to avoid them. I got these shoes for my job as a restaurant host. Of course this involves a lot of walking and standing. These shoes are like walking on air, with a roomy to box and a very good fit. Already thinking about another pair in a different color.

A stylish shoe and very light but durable. I love the breathable mesh upper. These are actually machine-washable in cold water, gentle cycle and can be tumble-dried on low delicate or, of course, air-dried. They can even handle my orthopedic arch-support shoe insert. They're perfect for walking and are SO COMFORTABLE! It almost feels like I'm not wearing shoes. - great for wearing around the house and yard, walking, driving, etc. This shoe is without a doubt the most comfortable shoe that I have ever owned. I don't think you will be disappointed.

After I purchased and wore my first pair Sketchers Men's Go Walk, after 3 days, I purchased 2 more pairs! They are the lightest most comfortable sneaker I have ever worn! Great color selection and they're available in my size 14 shoe size!
I like the wide sole edge, the wider fit and the solid sole! Very nice for walking as stated. Wish I could get one in black!

representative_reviews.text: Bought these for my husband and he loves them. He'd tried on a similar pair of Skechers in a retail store but didn't care for the price. I found these 2 months later, much better priced. They are absolutely the best shoes he's gone fishing in. Even when it's hot and humid, his feet are cool and dry the best shoes he's had in over 40 years of fishing. They're also great walking shoes!

Very nice house shoes for the price. They are wide, comfortable and the mesh construction is sturdy and breathable. I bought them half a size up and they are easy to slip in and out of. Everything you could hope for. I wouldn't go running in them but fine for walking around the house and short trips.

representative_reviews.text: I really wanted to keep these sandals. When I tried them on I liked how cushiony the soles were, and how they wrapped around my foot feeling very stable. BUT, All it took was to walk a few steps in them and I felt how the front edge of the strap that goes over my toes would cause blisters on the big toe. The edges of these straps are very sharp and it hurts when they rub against the skin while walking.

I have plantar fasciitis in my left foot and was looking for a shoe I could wear at work and not have pain by the end of the work day. I wore these a whole day at work and my foot pain was a 7 out of 10. I m disappointed they didn t work. They are a cute stylish shoe.

I gave these a 1 for a few reasons a I was charged for them even though I sent them back. They got 66 from me and I have no sandals b They were not as comfortable as I thought they would be. 1 - the material and 2- the support c Overall I thought they felt cheap I was dissappointed because I generally love their shoes and I loved the look of these. It also taught me to not use Prime Wardrobe again because of this snafu. Lesson learned.
Honestly feels great in place walked a mile in them now with two blisters on bottom Of my foot from rubbing the material which is a bit rough. Sad cause they felt so comfy at first
I sent these back. I love Keen shoes but these did not have the support I expected and the strap was too loose across my foot.

I really wanted to like these sandals. They are so cute. The heel was very cushy for my plantar fasciitis. But the band across my toes rubbed my toes and I was afraid I would get blisters. So had to return them.

I wore it 3 times not even for a long walk and the bottom of the shoes are both shaved, the top edge is damaged... just look at the pictures. I am a shoe collector and Take care of my shoes very carefully. I do not know what to do know. this is just terrible that you pay almost 110 for something like this.

The length of the shoe was spot on, but they were too narrow for my comfort. Well made, cute style, comfortable foot bed. But just too narrow. I do have feet on the wider side, but I don't usually wear a wide width in shoes. I'm either a 9.5 or 10, depending on the style. I could have worn these around town for a couple of hours at a time, but I needed them for a long walking vacation, so it was out of the question. If you don't have wide feet, they were awesome.

Took this shoe to Thailand in hopes of killing two birds with one stone and have a cute sandal that also lets me go on adventures. Don't get me wrong, this shoe is VERY comfortable and can wear for long hours. The support in the shoe is great. I have bunion pain with flat shoes but this shoe was great! no pain. My feet do get sweaty so, i had some blisters near the skin of the top strap of the shoe near the toes . But, i think if they change the design slightly to accommodate for the rough texture of the strap, it would be perfect. I wish this shoe was waterproof so badly. I took it to a waterfall hike and the show got so wet and smelly It also takes a while to dry so that was a little disappointing. If they ever make a new upgraded design of this shoe, I hope they reach out to me because I would love to try it.
I love keens, and was excited to try these sandals, unfortunately there is no half sizes, so the 8 was a tad small and the 9 was too big. Had to return both.

I bought these a little over a month ago and have only worn them maybe 10 times. Today the whole sole came off while I was at work. For 100 you would expect the adhesive to be better quality and last longer than a month. Ridiculous. My return window closed or I would return them. Keen used to be good quality. I won't buy from them again.

This shoe was comfortable and durable- I bought them to wear on our trip to Italy. After TWO days the smell was so horrible I literally threw them away- couldn t have them in my suitcase. Reminiscent of when my kids were little and their keens smelled just as bad- called it keen feet . Very disappointed that these have the same problems!

These shoes almost ticked all of the boxes. They are cute and comfortable with great arch support. Unfortunately, the toe strap is too far forward and puts pressure on the toes. They were painful after having them on for just a few minutes.
Very obvious that this pair I received has been used. There are wear marks at the bottom front and heel from being used! Definitely returning
These are very cut sandals but the elastic straps were too uncomfortable to keep them. They cut on the sides and sounded like flip-flops when I walked.

I have flexible flat feet and have been wanting a pair of sandals for a while. I came across these and they fit really well. I wear a 9.5 and they were true to size. There's a little bit of arch support and slightly raised in the heel to help give it some natural support. The sole is so cushiony too. I'm in love.
Great product with great support! Comfortable and cute! Easy to walk around for however long. I haven't hiked in them yet, but I bet they would hold up well there too!
Used this pair of sandals for a cruise. Arch support was perfect. We did a lot of walking. Very comfortable, my feet didn t hurt at all!
Out of the box comfortable. Love that the bottom of the shoe is ridged as all my other Keen hiking shoes

I was pleasantly surprised to feel how light weight these shoes are and how comfortable they are. The straps are sufficient to hold my foot in place in the shoe without feeling tight or restrictive and without hurting the tops of my feet. I've had those problems with other brands! I have purchased Keen before in heavier, closed shoes and find that the arch support is adequate and the fit is comfortable. These did not disappoint. Would recommend!!

Wow, I love these sandals. I was concerned when I first put them on as they re a little nerdy. But they are RIDICULOUSLY comfortable, even on long walks, and work well with just about any outfit. 5 stars. My new favorites.

I have plantar fasciitis and was looking for a better sandal to wear that wasn t Chacos. I wore these on my trips to Montana and Colorado this summer and at times only wore these on easy trails. I also wear these to school and by the end of the day, my feet don t hurt as bad as they do with other shoes. I ll definitely buy another pair.

Extremely Comfortable sandal. I have low arches and these are perfect. There s just the right amount of support. I usually wear a 5.5 but the 5 was only 16 so I tried my luck. The top strap is stretchy and nothing rubs uncomfortably. Really happy with this purchase.

There are less expensive options out these but these are worth the . There are comfortable, stay in the foot, have a bit of arch support this is important for me since I have flexible flare feet they are stylish and have good grip at bottom.

Soft, comfortable, supportive, cute enough for the office but tough enough to handle a hike. I wore them in Las Vegas tons of walking and my feet didn t hurt once. No pinch point, rubbing or sore feet. They do flop like a flip flop and I d recommend a half size bigger if you aren t certain on size. Would recommend them 110

These shoes are ready to wear right out of the box! They have a very soft footbed, and the straps stretch well as you walk. There is no noticeable arch support, but for me, that does not affect the comfort of these shoes. I am flat-footed and typically wear between a size 6 and 6.5, and the size 6 in these Keen sandals fits perfectly. I am very pleased with my purchase. Thank you.

I m far too young to have foot problems but I went a little too hard at my barre classes and I ended up with metrarsalgia so, my doc straight up said I could no longer wear cute flip flops. I needed something with cushion and arch support. I begrudgingly picked up these sandals and let me say, despite feeling like a 2nd century Greek philosopher every time I wear them- I love them. They are comfortable, they don t give me blisters and if they get wet, they dry quickly. I ve worn them to New York City, England, Ireland and Scotland -and I ve never had a single issue. I ve walked at least a few hundred miles in them and there is so much sole left that I think I ll get a few hundred more. Swallow your pride and take your mama s advice Buy shoes for how they feel and not look. Your feet will thank you.

This slide is very comfortable. My only complaint is it is a slide and does not stay snuggly on your foot while walking. While walking it slips around on your foot so you re constantly re-sliding your foot back in. Really cute though!
Comfortable shoe haven't walked far in them, just around the house. OK arch support but would like more...MUCH better than flip flops however!

I have 3 pairs of this style of Keen sandal. I work at a standing desk all day and am able to wear these eliminating back and foot pain. They're also sturdy for walking. Because they are a recycled plastic, they can cause a blister if you walk long distances when they're new and snug. The straps do loosen over time making them more comfortable for walking for longer periods of time.

representative_reviews.text: I have purchased quite a few pairs of Keens footwear. For the most part they tend to run true to size. These do not, the pair I received run small. Unfortunately I discovered this after the Amazon return window had closed. Won't buy shoes from Amazon again.
Very very tight fit. Straps not adjustable across top part of foot and it s a very very shallow foot strap. Very tight fit. Uncomfortable.

I have plantar fasciitis in my left foot and was looking for a shoe I could wear at work and not have pain by the end of the work day. I wore these a whole day at work and my foot pain was a 7 out of 10. I m disappointed they didn t work. They are a cute stylish shoe.
These are very cut sandals but the elastic straps were too uncomfortable to keep them. They cut on the sides and sounded like flip-flops when I walked.

These were a little snug and not very stretchy much less stretchy than they look . The heel part of the sole is squishy like a marshmallow. I don't like the feeling of my heel sinking lower than my toes when I walk. If you're looking for shoes that lack general stability, you might like these. I've been a fan of Keen for years because they are usually so comfortable, but I tried these on and then put them straight back in the box. They are definitely not for me.
Very obvious that this pair I received has been used. There are wear marks at the bottom front and heel from being used! Definitely returning

I tried on all 3 I choose and loved 2 out of the 3 pairs but at 60 a pop I could only choose one so I went with this pair. It is so comfortable! The foot bed is nice and cushy. They felt a little snug toward the end of the evening but I had a few beers and my feet were swollen a bit. I was still able to make it back to our car with little fuss. Overall an excellent pair of shoes and I look forward to purchasing other pairs of wide Clarks in the future!

They felt a little snug toward the end of the evening but I had a few beers and my feet were swollen a bit. I was still able to make it back to our car with little fuss. Overall an excellent pair of shoes and I look forward to purchasing other pairs of wide Clarks in the future!

Just received these today. I wear an 8 to an 8.5, and I'm glad I read the reviews and ordered 8.5. Fits perfectly. So comfortable! I know I can wear these all day with no issues. Love the foot coverage too.
I ordered a half size bigger than normal and they barely fit. My foot was right on the verge of hanging off.
Clark shoes never disappoint ! Nice snug fit, its true to size. If your medium shoe is a tad bit tight order a wide. The sole is soft to the touch and soothes the foot
I bought a size 10. Like these wedge sandals but run small, for sure size up if you have a wide foot.
These shoes are PERFECT!! So perfect I bought 2 . They are ridiculously comfortable and I am thrilled to find shoes that fit and feel good and have a heel! Woohoo !!

Super comfy right out of the box, make sure you order up a half size. I have a wide foot but didn't order the wide shoe. I have a narrow heel, high instep plus my foot is wide and no kidding these are SUPER COMFORTABLE! I have them in 2 colors of the nubuck and plan to order another. I returned a pair of the leather I ordered in wide.

I'm usually a size 7 or 7W in a sandal. After reading reviews I ordered a 7 1 2 Medium happy I did! They fit perfect!!! So they do run about a half size small, but the width was fine. I got the Coral color it's very pretty. A little darker brighter than the picture, but a true deep coral. The reason I left off a star is the bottom of the shoe. It's VERY slim. I'm used to a wider bottom in a platform for balance so it's the type of sandal that you have to be careful walking in. I just got them today I'm already used to them but if the bottom was any more narrow they would be tough to balance in. I have a lot of foot problems but find a platform shoe very comfortable. They are comfy the back adjusts with hidden velcro. Beautiful dress shoe. I will update soon as if I find a shoe that works I usually buy it in another color. When you have bad feet a good shoe is a blessing... Also I'm 61 years old the style is fine for my age group in my opinion. Hahaha. REMEMBER LADIES go up a 1 2 size

As mentioned, the shoe runs a bit short on me. I think about a half size short. I have a long thin foot, long toes, and bunions yay me and I usually take a 9 1 2 or 10. I purchased a 10 and with the way the front of the shoe is cut on an angle, it s probably better suited for women with toes that angle. I can fit in them, but one or two toes sort of want to fall off the edge. Other than that, I choose this type of shoe for events such as weddings when I need to wear a heel to be more dressy, but don t actually like wearing heels! They aren t super dressy, but may be dressy enough for most occasions. I got the silvery color. They are lightweight and seem like they would be comfy.

These shoes are super comfy, but the reviews are right - they run small, and they re narrow. I m normally a 10.5 and a W, but I ordered an 11. Unfortunately, they don t have 11W. While it fits well, it s so narrow that after a few hours, I really feel it in my feet. Which is unfortunate, because they otherwise are super comfy. If you have a W foot, this might not be the best for you.
I like these wedges but the heel height is lower than I prefer and they definitely run 1 2 size too small.

representative_reviews.text: I've bought Clark shoes for at least 10 years if not longer. I still have every one I bought until around July and I looked at them and the padding on the soul was flat. So I decided to get new ones. They lasted 10 years and didn't have any problems. But the 3 pair that I bought this summer are already falling apart! They're only 2-3 months old! The leather across the top and sides are pulling away from the soul and one of them has poor workmanship across the edge which is tattered and one is so crookedly made that my foot hangs over the right side in the back. I don't know what happened, but they are not the quality I expected. I'm very disappointed.

I had to return them because the top material on the shoe black part was coming off from the wedge. Decided to get a different shoe as I'm sure this would have happened again. Disappointed because they were very comfortable.

I bought a pair in July. Have not had them for a full month and they are coming apart at the front. Not sure if it s just a defective pair I got or what. It s very comfortable but I m not sure if I can trust ordering them from Amozon again. The pair I got at Macy s I have those for longer and are still in great shape.
I m very disappointed ... I ve purchased Clark s before and they lasted a while. I just got these in May and I need a new pair already barely lasted couple months. Disappointed....
I ve had them for a month and a half. They re already ripping. I ve worn them maybe 10 times. They re comfortable, but do run small.

I have several pairs of Clarks wedges that I have bought over the last couple of years and loved the quality. I have ordered 6 different styles in the last month, all advertised as leather or nubuck. They have all been synthetic material and I have had to return them. I am SO disappointed. Please update your description or get another vendor.

I waited for several months because these shoes in the color I wanted was always sold out. Finally I get a pair delivered today, at the whopping price of 139.00 and they are used! They have been worn by someone, they came in a box with no wrapping, no buckle protector s or even a balled up tissue insert for the toes. There is even a ink pen mark on the top of the shoe. Very disappointed with this purchase.

Perfect work or play shoe!!! Sooooo comfortable really pretty!!!! You won t be disappointed. I like them so much I ordered 5 different pairs of Clark s Wedge Sandals to wear to work. Hemmed all my pants to work with my Clark s! So thankful I found these on Amazon! I work in retail full time. On my feet all day. These are a God send!
Wore these for my daughters wedding and the comfort lasted all day. I struggle with any shoe lasting all day. They are so cute too!

I have wide feet and I have found it to be very difficult to find wide shoe sizes in brick and mortar stores. I wear a 9.5 W but find myself buying 10 M because of availability. I choose this pair as well as 2 others to try with Prime Wardrobe. This was my first experience with Prime Wardrobe and it won't be my last!! I tried on all 3 I choose and loved 2 out of the 3 pairs but at 60 a pop I could only choose one so I went with this pair. It is so comfortable! The foot bed is nice and cushy. The Velcro closure makes putting on this shoe so easy! No contorting yourself trying to get the strap through a tiny buckle closure. The first time I wore this pair was to a basketball game downtown. We parked several blocks from the arena and had a good bit of walking to do to get to our destination. These shoes held up amazingly and I barely felt them all night. They felt a little snug toward the end of the evening but I had a few beers and my feet were swollen a bit. I was still able to make it back to our car with little fuss. Overall an excellent pair of shoes and I look forward to purchasing other pairs of wide Clarks in the future!
Best shoes ever. I never knew wedges would feel like this. Absolutely will buy again if mine wear out. Beautiful, too.
I can't really think of what to say about these shoes without gushing! They are AMAZING! Comfortable right out of the box - no break-in period needed. Don't even think about it - just get them!

I have loved these shoes for the past four months that I have owned them. They are very comfortable. I just noticed today, though, that the cork overlay is wearing away from the toe area of one shoe see photo . So disappointing...I expect better from Clark's.
Fabric cuddles your feet. I'm in my early 50's work at a sound system standing on these for 5 hours straight the first night I got them. Then wore them to Costco the next day. Fabulous!
This is my second pair My job has me running errands all day .these shoes are like wearing running shoes ..and my feet never fatigue Love them

I love these shoes! I don't get to "dress up" very often so wearing anything other than tennis shoes can be rather uncomfortable for me. But these shoes are amazingly comfortable and look very nice! I couldn't believe how comfortable they were, even wearing them all day!! I have only worn them a couple times so far so I am not sure how well they will hold up, but I would definitely recommend!!

I have been a big Dansko fan due to my plantar fasciitis but found that the Clark wedge is a less expensive option for me. Gives me heels feet just the right amount of support cushion. Would recommend.

I m not one to write reviews typically but I know Clark s are good shoes and I got these for 35 on sale and these are the most comfortable wedges I ve ever put on, there s no breaking them in trial they just sit and wear nicely from the beginning!
Super comfy when u first try on. Though does take time to break them in. First day has some pains, but overall like baby clouds. Good neutral shoe for summer!
These shoes are the perfect height and support. I ordered the silver and then ordered every color after. I love them! Perfect for all day at the office and into the evening!

Pros Soft Insole Padding does not cause blisters even after long wear Nice enough and comfortable enough for a dress. My favorite cocktail party standing shoe. Great hight for short gal. Con It s a little narrower at the bottom of the sole, so I have rolled my ankle often. However, I haven t hurt myself the way I would expect at that hight. Because they are super comfortable, I can catch myself easily with the other foot.
I was looking for a comfy shoe to wear to work this summer. Im always moving for work up and down. These atr great and don't hurt my feet.

design.strength_summary: 고객들은 이 신발의 디자인이 매우 뛰어나고, 부피감이 없으며, 시각적으로 매력적이라고 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다. 이러한 특성 덕분에 신발을 착용하는 것이 더욱 즐거워집니다.

representative_reviews.text: The most amazing shoes!!! Light, not bulky and super easy to walk in without feeling as if you might fall or break an ankle . These are SO comfortable, it's even better than wearing flats. I would wear these every day, all day, if I could.

representative_reviews.text: I really wanted to like these, but can't as they are very uncomfortable. The whole shoe feels plastic. The label printed on the inside of the shoe states 34 Fabrique au Vietnam 34 , with no mention of leather. Every manufacturer states leather if they use it. But, there is a sticker on the bottom of the shoe that states the 34 uppers 34 are leather the rest is manmade. I can't tell if the outer layer on the straps is indeed leather, but the inner layer of the straps that hug the feet are certainly synthetic plastic and feel like it. The footpad is synthetic, too, so basically you are walking around in a plastic shoe. They made my feet sweat and I was just trying them out at home. So, something is amiss here, not a quality sandal at all and I cannot believe all the rave reviews. I have to believe that many of the 4 5 star reviews are bogus. Have you ever noticed that on furnishing reviews pillows, rugs, etc. many photos submitted by 34 customers 34 show perfect rooms with no papers or magazines around, in other words not looking lived in? Just immaculately decorated rooms with the product shown. I suspect they are submitted by the seller. Amazon should stay on top of this and kick these merchants off their site. Anyway, THIS is a genuine review and just my honest opinion. But, the knockoff quality shoes are going back.
Was very uncomfortable on my left foot. Position of strap dug into bone no matter how I adjusted it. Couldn t wait to get home and take my shoes off.

I have 4 pairs of these sandals. I absolutely loved them. The newest pair I just purchased has a more plastic sole, which makes the bed less flexible. The sole on all of my other sandals are more rubberized and comfortable. The bed used to feel more like suede now it feels like hard leather. The seam is cutting into my arch. They are extremely uncomfortable compared to my previous pairs. I am sending them back. I am sad that Clarks has changed the way that they manufacture these sandals because they are absolutely inferior.

the straps rub your feet making it uncomfortable to wear..tried wearing them just to church - they really rubbed my toes and my feet...might be able to wear them short term, but definitely NOT out shopping..

I love the shoes as I have 6 pair of this same style. Problem is on this particular pair, a plastic thread was sticking through the 3rd band on top of my left foot and actually made a hole in my skin. Have to have the shoes repaired locally. But they are awesome shoes that's why I'm willing to take them to be worked on. But disappointed I have to pay more money.

I thought the shoes would have the same color insole as pictured - dark tan, which helps hide the dirt. But, the insole is off-white shows dirt easily . The comfort is good, but EXTREMELY disappointed that they have changed the insole color. Who wants a sandal that shows dirty foot marks? I will stop buying Clarks if they don't revert to the previous dark tan or black colored insoles.

I've always had issues finding sandals and really, any shoe that will fit the very high instep I apparently have, I usually have to get things with elastic uppers for this reason. I had hoped that these would work since they had adjustable straps, and I'd heard good things about Clarks. The strap nearest the toes was more than fine. The middle strap barely reached across to the velcro, but eh, I thought it might stretch a bit. But the last strap wouldn't even reach the velcro. Don't get me wrong, the shoe looked great and well-made. But unfortunately, it will not work for me, and thus, I'm just giving a heads up to others who may have my fitting problem.
I was disappointed considering the price of shoe there is little support and the sole is thinner than I expected. I will keep them but the next shoe I buy I will be a lot more careful.

I have worn Clark s for well over 20 years and they always feel substantial with plenty of padding on the soles and on the straps. This shoe is thinly built. I can feel the squares under the material of the soles. The straps dig into the top of my foot. I think I paid 85 for them but I wore them for a day around the house and can t return. I turned to the official Clark s site for my next purchase.

I have 6 pairs of Clark Sandals and these are a knock off. The soles are PLASTIC instead of rubber, the insole is plastic instead of leather. I will return these and won't be ordering from Amazon anymore. It seems like you can't trust what you are getting from them.

I've worn Clarks for years and have for the most part been very happy. Clarks saved me when I worked retail, so I feel bad giving these 3 stars. But I have to be honest! When I first got these, I was happy with the style, design and quality. I had been on the hunt for a sandal that would combine the comfort of a Birkenstock but be a little dressier. The Velcro straps make these super adjustable and the padding is super comfortable. It wasn't until I wore them that I noticed the design flaw. The sole of these is narrower than the foot bed so it's super easy to turn your ankle. I thought it might just be a fluke the first time it happened. Unfortunately, I was wrong. For that reason, I must return these.

I had 2 of the same sandals, brought long time ago. This Clark's sandal is not soft like the older ones. The sole bottom is not soft, and its hard and not comfortable, its feels like a soft plastic bottom. I kept in only I threw away the box, and its such a hassle now to return. I will wear it working in the garden, def not for walking.

A bit disappointed. I had purchased Clark's sandals before and these sandals quality is definitely inferior. They are attractive, true to size that is the positive but to be honest I find the inside of the shoe very uncomfortable because the lining is fabric not leather, feels like synthetic that keeps your feet sweaty and hot and the inside padding not what it used to be. You have made a sandal that looks good but does not feel good on my feet. You have skimped on the leather. Even the outer sole looks cheap. Definitely not worthy of the Clarks name. New customers may not notice but for those who have bought Clarks shoes over the years this is disappointing.

These sandals are very attractive, and the price on Amazon was the best. BUT, these shoes run very narrow. I ordered Wide, which is my size. Same feet, same size for years and years. But these are a tight fit, width wise. I loosened the velcro straps as far out as they would still hold, in order to get a decent fit. But in doing that, you expose the sticky part of the velcro to catching all sorts of dust and stuff. Yuk. Now I have to constantly clean them in order to look neat and nice. I don't appreciate that hassle. The design is just wrong, if they justify the narrow size by saying you can just open up the straps. Hence my low star rating. I'm not really recommending these. Next time I will go to Zappos or somewhere like that, where they sell extra wide. It seems like any time I order shoes that come from China, they run shorter and more narrow than they used to be made. Buyer beware.
Very comfortable shoe, made well,size fits as expected but I ordered red sandals. They are advertised as red however, they are actually a reddish brown and not the color I needed. They were returned

These are great sandals. Not as much arch support as I had hoped for, but I have been spoiled by my leather Clarks flip-flops. The arch support is just fine, I just have ludicrously high arches, normal humans or even mildly high arched folks will be just fine with these. I also like the versatility of the velcro but I was worried of the aesthetics of it. Turns out from a foot and a half away you can't even see the velcro! I have the black sandals, may not be the case with other colors. So seeing as most folks are more than a foot and a half away from my feet I'm good!
Does not feel cushiony. The hard soles make the bottoms of my feet hurt after wearing them for a few hours. Very cute shoes though.

The foam-cushioned recessed heel cup is good for my flat pronating feet. The three adjustable straps are a good choice for wearing with a compression sleeve or bandage. The red leather looks like the photo it's a nice toned down color like a reddish cognac. I always order a half size smaller when I buy Clarks.

Very comfortable sandal with some arch support and cushioning. Love that all three straps are adjustable w velcro! Makes it easy to adjust fit All across front of foot! I have a low instep top of foot in front of ankle and sandals are always floppy in that area, so the adjustable strap is perfect. Also, as shoes stretch, you can readjust the fit! My second pair first pair in blue has lasted 2 yrs with almost daily wear in season and still look great!
the upper structure wasn't as soft supple as this brand usually is. Kept them anyway but won't wear them anywhere requiring lots of walking.
It is not the most orthopedic in terms of comfort, healing, but it looks good and is functional-more so than most others I have been wearing.

I have a fairly wide foot and get some swelling as the day goes on. This sandal makes my larger feet look nice and being able to adjust the straps is awesome. I feel like my arches are supported. I have only worn them around the house and to the store so far. Looking forward to really getting some walking in this spring and summer. Very happy with my purchase. I have had Clark's in the past and know that I may spend more up front, but these shoes will provide comfort and style for many years.

I purchased this shoe because I needed something comfortable for my feet. I was looking for something with soft memory foam like insole. While this shoe is nice, and I like the ability to adjust the straps pleasantly surprised these have Velcro the insole is just not the level of softness comfort I was looking for. These shows are good for someone who has feet that swell you can adjust the straps looser tighter but not that great for someone with heel problems or weight problems looking for relief on the bottom of the foot. Nice shoe, adjustable, just not the level of comfort I needed.
Clarke shoes are a favorite for me. They provide good arch support, are comfortable and look good too. These do not disappoint.

These are very comfortable-the foot pad is cushioned and smooth sweaty feet don't stick to the foot pad. The velcro adjustments are not obvious but allow adjustment of snugness of fit. Great for extended walking days and would be great for pregnant feet as well. Good arch support as well.
Clarks always has good arch support and comfortable foot bed linings. The color is a mid tone brown, not a deep chocolate color. They are comfortable but not especially light weight.
That s so comfortable for me but they might be for someone else I have neuropathy and they just didn t help me they made my made it worse

I have a wide foot so I had to get sandals that I can adjust. I found the Velcro support straps to allow enough room to get my foot in there easily. They are well-made, have good stitching, quality leather, and a good design overall. I found the arch to have a good support and they were comfortable Enough to wear when shopping.
These sandals gave me excellent support they were very comfortable and lightweight. I have fasciitis and these worked great as I m standing on my feet all day at work. .
I bought this shoe 2 years ago and liked it so much I just bought another pair. This shoe is great if you have any problems with your feet. It cushions your heels and supports your arches.

For that reason, I must return these.

I was a little hesitant to order sandals online, since I often struggle to find the right fit, but in store shopping isn t an option right now. My feet are often too narrow for a medium, but too wide for a narrow, which is why I usually have to try on half a dozen styles before I find something that s good enough, but often still not a perfect fit. These sandals clearly run a little on the narrow side, so the medium width is perfect for me. The sandals are also cute with a comfortable footbed, so they check all the boxes for me.
