The red leather looks like the photo it's a nice toned down color like a reddish cognac. I always order a half size smaller when I buy Clarks.

I like that the fit was immediately perfect for me! No break-in period! The shoes look very nice on my feet. That right there is unusual for me, I have wide, D width feet! Getting nice, name brand Clark s shoes without trying them on first, and having them fit perfectly and comfortably immediately, is rare for me. The height of the heel was a a little disappointing. I would have preferred the heel to be a bit taller. I ll adapt. If my dog does not chew on these, the shoes should be perfect for me to wear! Great fit! Great look! Very happy!

IMPORTANT Use a tape measure to measure your foot from your heel to your longest toe which may not be your big toe . Check on Clark's size chart to see what they recommend your shoe size is, and then SIZE DOWN 1. For example, if their size chart says you are a 9 1 2, get a 9. If their size chart says you are a 7, get a 6.5. Their shoes run long and narrow, I am a wide width in other brands, and Clark's standard wide width suits me fine, but barely - a hair narrower and I would have to order their extra wide width , but I sized down 1 size, and these shoes are PERFECT - the best fitting pair of shoes I have ever worn. They are perfectly sized - 1 2 inch between my longest toe for me that is my big toe and the edge of the sole bed in the front, and a little less than an index finger width in the back. These shoes make your feet, calves, all the way up to your knees feel really nice. I can't even explain how good these will make your lower legs and feet feel. Just trust me and buy a pair!
Very comfortable! I have slightly wide feet, but wide width shoes are TOO wide. These fit great right out of the box!

I have a bad foot that requires surgery although I cannot afford to be down for a year. Finally found a shoe that is comfortable on my feet. Shoe runs true to size. Although I ordered a narrow and you actually need a medium or wide if you have swollen feet or a bunion with deformed toes. The narrow work it just shows more velcro than I want but it will do. Next shoes I know to order a medium or wide. You can adjust the straps to fit. and the shoe has so much support and comfy.
I like the fact that this sandal has enclosed the small toes to keep them from getting stubbed. I have previously had booked toed with sandals that don t have this feature.
The perfect shoe as it is adjustable .. my feet swell up and sometimes swelling is down.. so I adjust as needed.. Love these and this brand lasts for years. Love these sandals.. Sooo comfortable

The shoes fit my Size 5 Medium feet perfectly. With their velcro adjustability they would fit a narrow foot, too. I bought them as an easy slide to wear around the house, and I'm so happy that they stay comfortably on my feet, so I forget I'm wearing a slide. They look great and of course, they can be worn anywhere you would wear a comfortable sandal. No break-in period required. They fit right out of the box, with good arch support and a contoured footbed. The multi-brown has attractive styling with contrast stitching, patterning, and straps just wide enough so they seem sleek to me rather than clunky, which is great for "petite" feet or for any size!

My new Clarks Leisa Cacti Slides are an instant hit! Adjusted the straps to my fat wide foot size 9 ww and lo, a shoe that feels comfortable, and more importantly, supports these old feet just so fine! Got the size 9 wide, and could have done with the 8.5 w, but work well despite the 3 4 inch heel area space overage. Like the molded foot base, and they are not too heavy, but easy to walk in.

I have a wide foot and have trouble finding a sandal that fits comfortably but this sandal is great. I ordered a size 9W but could have gone with an 8 1 2W but decided to keep them because the width was perfect.
I like the way these fit. They are true to size and they are comfortable. They look great with jeans.
I like these very much, unusual color that fits in with my life style. I opened the box, slipped the sandals on and away I went, fit is great for long, narrow feet.

I have a bunion and wide feet. The 7 wide fit perfectly. The shoe is so comfortable I can wear them all day. This shoe is so cute and adjusts to fit if the leather stretches. Well worth the money. I believe it will last a very long time. I've ordered Clarks in past and stand by their quality and craftsmanship.
I have a long narrow foot and have difficulty fitting in regular witdth shoes, these work perfectly! Bonus that they re a very nice looking shoe also!

durability.issue_summary: 구매자들은 내구성 문제로 인해 신발이 쉽게 망가진다고 불만을 토로하고 있습니다. 특히, 플라스틱 소재와 불량한 봉제 문제로 인해 불편함을 겪고 있습니다.
durability.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 샌들이 내구성이 뛰어나고 잘 만들어졌다고 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다. 이는 장기간 사용에도 품질이 유지된다는 것을 의미합니다.

representative_reviews.text: I really wanted to like these, but can't as they are very uncomfortable. The whole shoe feels plastic. The label printed on the inside of the shoe states 34 Fabrique au Vietnam 34 , with no mention of leather. Every manufacturer states leather if they use it. But, there is a sticker on the bottom of the shoe that states the 34 uppers 34 are leather the rest is manmade. I can't tell if the outer layer on the straps is indeed leather, but the inner layer of the straps that hug the feet are certainly synthetic plastic and feel like it. The footpad is synthetic, too, so basically you are walking around in a plastic shoe. They made my feet sweat and I was just trying them out at home. So, something is amiss here, not a quality sandal at all and I cannot believe all the rave reviews. I have to believe that many of the 4 5 star reviews are bogus. Have you ever noticed that on furnishing reviews pillows, rugs, etc. many photos submitted by 34 customers 34 show perfect rooms with no papers or magazines around, in other words not looking lived in? Just immaculately decorated rooms with the product shown. I suspect they are submitted by the seller. Amazon should stay on top of this and kick these merchants off their site. Anyway, THIS is a genuine review and just my honest opinion. But, the knockoff quality shoes are going back.

I have always worn Clark's shoes. Can't believe that these have fallen apart. I orded these on June 26. After 57 days of ownership not even wearing them everyday they are falling apart. Total waste of money. Amazon is going to refund, but wanted to charge restocking fee. For what????!!!! Finally agreed to return restocking fee when I said Iwould dispute the charge. Not what I expect from Amazon nor from a Clark's product. Don't Buy it.

I have 6 pairs of Clark Sandals and these are a knock off. The soles are PLASTIC instead of rubber, the insole is plastic instead of leather. I will return these and won't be ordering from Amazon anymore. It seems like you can't trust what you are getting from them.

I love the shoes as I have 6 pair of this same style. Problem is on this particular pair, a plastic thread was sticking through the 3rd band on top of my left foot and actually made a hole in my skin. Have to have the shoes repaired locally. But they are awesome shoes that's why I'm willing to take them to be worked on. But disappointed I have to pay more money.

I have 4 pairs of these sandals. I absolutely loved them. The newest pair I just purchased has a more plastic sole, which makes the bed less flexible. The sole on all of my other sandals are more rubberized and comfortable. The bed used to feel more like suede now it feels like hard leather. The seam is cutting into my arch. They are extremely uncomfortable compared to my previous pairs. I am sending them back. I am sad that Clarks has changed the way that they manufacture these sandals because they are absolutely inferior.

Disappointed in these, as they appear to be a cheap knockoff. The soles are made of light weight, slick plastic, not the sturdy rubber like the pair I already own. The upper straps are plastic and cheap looking. I do not believe these are actual Clark's sandals. I have many pairs and these are nothing like those. They fit about the same, but not as comfortable.
If these are made by Clark I m really disappointed. I have been buying their shoes for years. But these where not comfortable at all. You could feel the stitching through the leather. Sad.

I've always had issues finding sandals and really, any shoe that will fit the very high instep I apparently have, I usually have to get things with elastic uppers for this reason. I had hoped that these would work since they had adjustable straps, and I'd heard good things about Clarks. The strap nearest the toes was more than fine. The middle strap barely reached across to the velcro, but eh, I thought it might stretch a bit. But the last strap wouldn't even reach the velcro. Don't get me wrong, the shoe looked great and well-made. But unfortunately, it will not work for me, and thus, I'm just giving a heads up to others who may have my fitting problem.

These sandals are very attractive, and the price on Amazon was the best. BUT, these shoes run very narrow. I ordered Wide, which is my size. Same feet, same size for years and years. But these are a tight fit, width wise. I loosened the velcro straps as far out as they would still hold, in order to get a decent fit. But in doing that, you expose the sticky part of the velcro to catching all sorts of dust and stuff. Yuk. Now I have to constantly clean them in order to look neat and nice. I don't appreciate that hassle. The design is just wrong, if they justify the narrow size by saying you can just open up the straps. Hence my low star rating. I'm not really recommending these. Next time I will go to Zappos or somewhere like that, where they sell extra wide. It seems like any time I order shoes that come from China, they run shorter and more narrow than they used to be made. Buyer beware.
I was disappointed considering the price of shoe there is little support and the sole is thinner than I expected. I will keep them but the next shoe I buy I will be a lot more careful.

the straps rub your feet making it uncomfortable to wear..tried wearing them just to church - they really rubbed my toes and my feet...might be able to wear them short term, but definitely NOT out shopping..

I have worn Clark s for well over 20 years and they always feel substantial with plenty of padding on the soles and on the straps. This shoe is thinly built. I can feel the squares under the material of the soles. The straps dig into the top of my foot. I think I paid 85 for them but I wore them for a day around the house and can t return. I turned to the official Clark s site for my next purchase.

The three straps across the top have a velcro area where you can adjust the fit. The fit was fine, but the straps and the stitched in velcro rub on the top of my foot causing my skin to tear. Have to wear a bandage to protect my skin from tearing opening and bleeding. Very disappointing. Unfortunately, I missed the window of return as I did not wear frequently enough when first purchased.

I've worn Clarks for years and have for the most part been very happy. Clarks saved me when I worked retail, so I feel bad giving these 3 stars. But I have to be honest! When I first got these, I was happy with the style, design and quality. I had been on the hunt for a sandal that would combine the comfort of a Birkenstock but be a little dressier. The Velcro straps make these super adjustable and the padding is super comfortable. It wasn't until I wore them that I noticed the design flaw. The sole of these is narrower than the foot bed so it's super easy to turn your ankle. I thought it might just be a fluke the first time it happened. Unfortunately, I was wrong. For that reason, I must return these.

I ve been wearing this style sandal for 4 years. I have purchased 5 pairs and love the fit and comfort. This recent purchase is junk. The guilty and materials have gone into the dumpster. I ll have to fine another brand to buy. And I returned them immediately and still no refund.

I just received my sandals today. Will update this review in a few weeks. The good the white color is perfect. My size 8 fits well, the same as my previous ones. They look really nice. The not so good these do not seem to be the same excellent quality as my other Clark sandals of the same style and name. Not sure what material the soles are. My previous ones look like rubber. These look more like plastic or some type of combination material. They are slightly slippery when walking on my wood floors. The insoles are definitely not the soft leather of my other Clarks. Have no idea what they are. Looks like some type of brushed cloth fabric. My concern is they won t hold up well and I am sure they won t look as nice after several wearings. Definitely not leather because it says only the uppers are leather. Wish I could give 3 1 2 stars. But I am going to give them the benefit of doubt and give 4 stars.
Every 2 or 3 years I buy another pair of Clark s Leisa Slides. It s a great shoe, holds up to every day usage and looks good as well.
It is not the most orthopedic in terms of comfort, healing, but it looks good and is functional-more so than most others I have been wearing.

I have a wide foot so I had to get sandals that I can adjust. I found the Velcro support straps to allow enough room to get my foot in there easily. They are well-made, have good stitching, quality leather, and a good design overall. I found the arch to have a good support and they were comfortable Enough to wear when shopping.

Clark's are my favorite shoe brand. I have had a few foot surgeries, and Clark's shoes are quite comfortable for someone with bad feet. However, they have really gone up in price in recent years and are hard to find at under 100 per pair. So I was thrilled to find these at less than 30 on Amazon. The color is a true sage, which is hard to find in most stores, and the fit is good. The only problem I have encountered with some of my newer Clark's shoes is that the insole separates from the bottom over time. They are obviously being constructed differently than in the past, because I have had this happen to 5 pairs of Clark's shoes. But a little glue seems to work, and for the price, it is worth it even if the shoes only last a year or so.
Love theses so much I bought a second pair. Super comfortable and the pewter matches a lot of outfits.

Have had these before and they are tops in every way. And they last!! I still have the first pair I bought the year this style came out. They still look great and I wear them everywhere!! Clarks has always been a winner for me. I found out with the first pair I bought another style. I put them on, flew to a conference and took them off when I got to my room that night. No break in time. And so the story goes with every pair I ve bought since.

I bought a black pair years ago, and was so pleased with how comfortably they fit. Fast forward and the sole is getting a little worn, so I thought I'd try to find another pair. Amazon had them! I might go back for more colors.

I bought these shoes for my honeymoon to France and they were the most comfortable shoes I ve ever worn in my life! Seriously! I had bunion removal surgery about a year before and could barely get through a little bit of heel wear during my wedding so these were goddess sent. I wore these sandals all over France and the cobble stones. They were surprisingly easy to keep on. I even wore the sandals on a tour through the palace of Versailles with friends who wore tennis shoes. By the end of the tour everyone was complaining about their feet and no joke mine felt amazing!! I m definitely buying more!!
Just great Clark's sandals as always. Perfect from the first time you put them on your feet. No break in period and they hold up forever.
I have multiple pairs of this style sandal because they come in wide and have 3 adjustable straps. The leather upper and padded sole make them the most comfortable sandal I ve owned.

I purchased this style several years ago and it quickly became my "go to" summer footwear. The three straps with hidden Velcro tabs allow for easy adjustment when the heat and humidity soar. The sandals are very durable, and I ordered this pair in anticipation of next summer, because my original pair is becoming worn in the interior heel area. The rest of the sandal shows minimal signs of the almost daily wear. The denim blue is a few shades darker this time around, but it is still a perfect shade for summer.

They are comfortable and cute but no the quality I expect from Clark s. I ve had many pairs of Clark s and this is probably last on my list. Feels like the soles are plastic and honestly the only familiar Clark look or feel is the insole. Probably would not buy again.
the upper structure wasn't as soft supple as this brand usually is. Kept them anyway but won't wear them anywhere requiring lots of walking.

My Mom has had a pair of these Clark's for years. In fact, she's had them for so long, the fabric in the sandal had started to rip and fray...but the leather and the sole of the shoe was still in great condition. She tends to wear the sandal all year-round, so I bought her another pair in a different color. Fast forward to a week after I purchased a pair for my Mom and I noticed that my sister had on the exact same pair too! The next pair I purchase will be for me!

design.issue_summary: 구매자들은 색상 차이와 인솔 색상 변경으로 인해 실망하고 있으며, 이는 제품의 디자인에 대한 신뢰를 저하시킵니다.

representative_reviews.text: Watch the sizes...I ordered two different colors, in the same size, and there was 1 2 to one size difference between them.
The color I ordered was blue same as my first pair and the color I received is almost a grey color I love the Shoe, I have four pairs and wanted to replace worn out blue ones.

I thought the shoes would have the same color insole as pictured - dark tan, which helps hide the dirt. But, the insole is off-white shows dirt easily . The comfort is good, but EXTREMELY disappointed that they have changed the insole color. Who wants a sandal that shows dirty foot marks? I will stop buying Clarks if they don't revert to the previous dark tan or black colored insoles.
The shoe color was more bright silver than pewter. I don't like the color and am returning the shoes.

Love that these are a quick slide on and the color goes with jeans or black or navy pants or shorts. Wore all day running errands and forgot I even had shoes on. The older I get the more comfort I like and these are great.
I love the style and comfort these provide. This is the second pair of Clark's I've purchased and will definitely buy more!! I am very picky on what I wear and these meet all expectations.

I love these shoes. I wear the Coral ones every day. Have had my oldest pair about 2 years and they are still going strong but showing just a little wear. Although these are advertised as 34 Sage something 34 but they are a lovely taupe. Velcro adjustments on 3 side straps make these a perfect fit.

I just received my sandals today. Will update this review in a few weeks. The good the white color is perfect. My size 8 fits well, the same as my previous ones. They look really nice. The not so good these do not seem to be the same excellent quality as my other Clark sandals of the same style and name. Not sure what material the soles are. My previous ones look like rubber. These look more like plastic or some type of combination material. They are slightly slippery when walking on my wood floors. The insoles are definitely not the soft leather of my other Clarks. Have no idea what they are. Looks like some type of brushed cloth fabric. My concern is they won t hold up well and I am sure they won t look as nice after several wearings. Definitely not leather because it says only the uppers are leather. Wish I could give 3 1 2 stars. But I am going to give them the benefit of doubt and give 4 stars.
This is my second pair of this style. Love the fit, quality, but the denim blue color is more gray than blue.

I am going to purchase in several colors! I was worried that they would feel heavy clunky, , but they are light and so comfortable. Ho westly, these sandal feel as if they were custom made for me. My Podiatrist wanted me to wear a better sandal...found them!

Background Two months ago I had foot surgery to shave down a large heel spur on the back of my heel, not the bottom of my foot, that was also tearing up my Achilles tendon. I was released from the medical boot and discovered I could not wear any of the shoes in my closet and it would be awhile before I could handle anything touching my heel so began the search for open back shoes without heel or ankle straps but would remain secure on my feet. Luckily, we are heading into summer and I needed new sandles anyway so I bought 3 pair different brands . I bought black, off white, and wanted gray but that color option was a real challenge so blue was another color choice that comes in handy...thinking navy blue. Well, I finally stumbled onto the Clarke Leisa sandals and really liked the denim blue and they were on sale in my size...score! The shoes Fit was true to size and I love the fact the upper leather straps are customizable this adjustability is perfect as my left foot swells a lot as I am still slowly increasing my walking distance. When swollen and I have to loosen the straps, the velcro does show a bit, which is annoying but not glaringly obvious as the color of the velcro is near to the leather color. Comfort I have to say, out of all 3 pair, these Clarke's are the most comfortable out of the box. That is saying something as the other 2 pair are comfortable enough but the leather on this shoe just feel like slippers to me yet are far more secure on my foot than any slipper I have had. As for support, I cannot judge as my recent surgery prevents any long standing or walking any distance. Color The denim blue does indeed look like picture above....in some light. Then, in different lighting they are decidedly gray in color. I love them! So, I got what I wanted afterall...both blue or gray sandals that will always go with any Jean outfit. Just be warned that if you hate gray, this denim color may not be for you.
The fit is perfect, the color is perfect tends to take on a shade matching your clothing. Wore them yesterday afternoon - they're great!
I love this style and have a pair in every color. This is my third pair of black ones. Being in Florida means I am in sandals almost everyday of the year.
Was not disappointed with this style, comfort, and material. Fit like a glove when I put it on the first time my feet did not have to get used to the shoes the shoes fit my feet.
Nice color and fits very well. Not tight but snug so they do not feel like they may come off while walking. I like they had the half sizes. Clarks always good.

I bought a black pair years ago, and was so pleased with how comfortably they fit. Fast forward and the sole is getting a little worn, so I thought I'd try to find another pair. Amazon had them! I might go back for more colors.

This is my second pair of these Clarks sandals. Comfortable right from the start, has support where it is needed, adjustable straps, and look great too. I have them in brown and now black. My brown pair is 6 years old and still looks and wears great. I wear them often too.

I purchased this style several years ago and it quickly became my "go to" summer footwear. The three straps with hidden Velcro tabs allow for easy adjustment when the heat and humidity soar. The sandals are very durable, and I ordered this pair in anticipation of next summer, because my original pair is becoming worn in the interior heel area. The rest of the sandal shows minimal signs of the almost daily wear. The denim blue is a few shades darker this time around, but it is still a perfect shade for summer.

These are perfect for me. I finally got them in Navy! They are very comfortable they last a long time. I have even washed mine in the washing machine they still look great. I must have close to 10 pair right now. Of course the navy will get worn a lot. I may have to get another pair. I'm looking at the denim color next. I have back issues I can wear these all day.

product_name: ASICS Women's Gel-Excite 8 Running Shoes

urgent_issues.summary: 구매자들은 내구성 문제로 인해 신발이 빠르게 마모되거나 손상된다고 불만을 토로하고 있습니다.

comfort.issue_summary: 많은 구매자들이 착용 시 발이 아프고 불편하다고 보고하고 있습니다. 특히 좁은 디자인과 단단한 바닥이 문제로 지적되고 있습니다.
comfort.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 뛰어난 아치 지지력과 깊은 쿠셔닝을 제공하여 편안한 착용감을 준다고 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Everytime i wear these shoes it crushes my feet, worst pain ive ever had and Ive tried breaking into these shoes for months. the shoe is just too narrow

I have worn ASICS for running, walking and working out for 15 years. I needed a new pair and these seemed comparable to my prior ASICS purchases. I tried them on and they felt great. When I went for a walk a few days later, I began to feel the shoe rubbing at the back of my heel - but low on the heel, inside the shoe. I thought it would get better as they loosened up but it got much worse. I ended up running on the balls of my feet to get back home because my heels were on fire. These shoes rubbed two blisters on each heel. The problem appears to be that the inner sole comes part way up the inner heel of the shoe, creating a stiff ridge that rips into the skin on the lower heel see photo - the yellow lines mark where the sole meets the back of the shoe, but then the sole goes almost 1 2" up the back . Not sure if this is a defect on this pair or a design flaw, but it's a no-go for me! And they can't be returned because I wore them outside one time!

I have a long history with this brand typically loving their shoes. I really liked the color but these were the most uncomfortable Asics I have ever put on. No cushion and hard foot bed. I had to return them.
I m a nurse who is on my feet for 12 hours a day and by the end of a shift my feet we re killing me. I tried for a month and it never got any better.
I searched for shoes that were slip resistant for work. Almost fell on my ass walking into the kitchen. Need better descriptions please. Not happy with these at all.
This pair has made me rethink Sacouny. I returned these. They look cheap and hard plasticky. Soles are hard.
The material around the ankle is stiff as a board so when you're moving around on the court, it rubs you the wrong way!

I purchased these shoes about 2 months back and i wore them for about a month or more.As per the color and quality all looked fine, but then I started getting ankle pain, i changed to a different brand shoe and it s all fine I don t know wether it is their gel technology or wether the seller is not giving genuine product, but these goes were literally pain in the feet. It is sad that I cannot get a refund as the return date is over, a total waste of money .
This shoe does not fit or is defective. I find it very uncomfortable and feel like it has heel tilt issue
I run approximately 6 miles everyday, in less than a month after wearing this sneakers I got 2 injuries. One in my ankle and my groin, they are very slippery on wet road. Nearly fell twice with them

I have never been disappointed by a pair of Asics before, but I found these shoes to be so uncomfortable. The treads were wearing down on the soles of my Gel Flux 5 and I was unable to find those for sale anywhere, so I got these as a replacement. I wore them to work 10 hours shifts mostly on my feet for a couple of days to test out the comfort level and found the tops tongue of the shoe to be tight and uncomfortable. I wore them while running 3.5 miles yesterday and that part of the shoe irritated my feet even more and i had to stop multiple times to adjust the tongues. Today I noticed that my heels are very sensitive, so the shoes must not have as much padding inside as I'm used to in the Gel Flux 5. While running in the shoes again today to give them another chance, I decided I just can't put my feet through this much discomfort to potentially get used to the shoes. The quality seems good and the shoes look very nice, they just aren't comfortable or suitable for what I purchased them for. Unfortunately I am just outside the surprisingly short return window so I'll be storing them in my closet for now.

These shoes are extremely comfortable and lightweight-feels. They have a nice walking on clouds feel and good support for walking and jogging. Shoes are wide enough that toes do not feel scrunched on the sides or the tips -they fit to size. Unfortunately, one foot of mine is a size larger than the other which makes finding a pair of shoes that fit difficult. These fit pretty well-my larger foot doesn t touch the tip and the smaller foot doesn t move around too much. The laces are too small for the shoes as reported in other reviews but I have managed to use them and they stay they tied most of the time. Unfortunately a hole has formed on the top of the shoe where the rubber meets the fabric. To be clear, it s not from my toe hitting the edge. I have had the shoes since mid July of this year and the hole appeared at the end of October the same year . I only wore them a few times this summer- I wore sandals most of the time until late September. I use these for walking the dog and have jogged in them a few times. The rest of the shoes still look and feel pretty much brand new-but the hole is a big problem and once it formed it only is getting larger. Shoes don t last forever-but these did not last very long and are not cheap. I like them so much I am tempted to buy another pair but not going to risk wasting so much money.

I ordered these shoes since they were cute and available in wide . Now, I know I have a particularly wide foot, however I order Skechers wide shoes all the time and they fit great and are super squishy and comfortable. I can wear Skechers daily for work with no issue, even on my 16 hour work days. These ASICS wide shoes are NOT wide. I had to check the tag to make sure I didn t receive regular width shoes. Nope, the tag said wide. I ve worn them for 5 days now thinking they d stretch out a bit and no they sure didn t. They were so tight they d make marks into my skin on the tops of my feet and you could see my socks through the sides of the tongue cuz my foot was stretching the shoe lol. The moral of the story is this, If you truly have wide feet and NEED a true wide shoe, these are not for you!

I am mostly a five-star reviewer and have rarely came on here to give four stars or less. These shoes are horrible, hence the sale price. They are sitting in the box new with tags but I missed the return window so I cannot even exchange or get a store credit for them. Even Asics doesn't want them back. I am often on my feet for 12 hours and leave my shifts in pain. I need a shoe that fits accurately and gives me support. What happened to the excite? The 8 is so bad without even taking into consideration the over an inch too long in length. They look and feel like clown shoes, they feel cheaper and do not even come close to hugging my foot. Looks can be deceiving - the pictures look great - I'm Extremely disappointed that I mistakenly purchased 2 of this blunder before trying them on The price was great and I thought I was getting a deal and I wanted to set myself up for the next year. Really really disappointed that I will not get even one use out of these.
Wore these just 3 times and now the soles are bunched and gives blisters. Totally unacceptable. Always loved Asics but not now.

I am probably not the typical purchaser of this footwear I am an overweight senior with arthritis and foot issues. I keep active by walking an energetic dog several miles a day. I have been searching for walking shoes with arch support and deep cushioning in the sole. These shoes are the best I ve found to date! My pain is still present, but markedly reduced, so much so that I hardly think about my painful feet any longer, a change for the better!

There are pros and cons to the Excite 8's. I have three pairs of Excite 7's which I loved, and decided to try out the 8's. The biggest pro is the removable insole, which the 7's did not have, it makes it so much easier to use your own inserts. The fit is definitely different between the two styles. The 7's were immediately comfortable out of the box, the 8's will need some getting used to. The 8's feel more roomy than the 7's, in both width and length and I'm a little concerned my feet might slip around if it gets wet. They also seem a little more stiff and have a higher arch support than the 7's. I don't know if these changes are good or bad yet because I have only had them a short time and don't know how these changes will effect long term wear. Edit After walking around my house awhile, I don't think they'll work for my feet. I'll stick with the Excite 7s.

Color is just as pictured bright and pretty-- I always buy this brand so know I have to size up I usually buy 8 1 2 running shoes but for these, I always need a size 9-- these have a very high back so you need an ankle running sock otherwise the back of your heel will be sore--I like them but have a concern about how thin the top material on the sneakers is-- You can see here when I lift my toe it is very thin- I am worried they won't last long as I tend to pronate my toes but even if I didn't it would still be a concern about the life expectancy of these sneakers It is for this reason I rated them only 3 stars the quality could be an issue
Very comfortable! I ll be purchasing a back up pair! As a cosmetologist that stands on her feel for so least 10 hours per day, they are a great neutral fit!
Supportive shoe and comfy from day one. Great for walking and working on your feet all day. I will definitely be ordering another pair when I need a new.

these shoes saved my legs from extreme pain. i work 12 hour shifts as a night shift nurse and these are so incredibly comfortable! i also wear them to jog the trail near my place. amazing and affordable too.
Excellent padding all the way from heel to toe. Bought the wide as I have slightly wide feet and found lots of room in toe box. Excellent arch support. Very stable.

I liked the pair I bought in the local store, but they didn t have any left but ever faithful Amazon AND HERE WE ARE!! Excellent support for my high arches, more than proficient cushion to get me through a 9 hour busy Dr Office schedule, and cute to the max!!!

I'm very particular with my athletic shoes and these have decent enough cushion that I didn't need to immediately replace the arch supports. I wear these to the gym and for long walks and they're one of my favorite pairs! Gotta love asics!

I work at a hotel as a housekeeper so i am on my feet anywhere from 4 to 8 hours a day plus I have a bunion on my right foot so it is extremely hard to find something that is comfortable. This was my first time buying Ascics but I can guarantee it won't be my last. The fit was perfect, they are lightweight, plus they go well with what I wear to work and are super cute...it is amazing being able to come home and not have aching feet everyday
Great product for indoor training, not much for running since don't feel very confortable, kind of hard.

Love this shoe....the cushioning, the arch support, the colors. I'm on the eve of 70 yrs old love, love, love to walk and have a degenerative spinal disease. Thanks to these shoes original pair I bought 5 months ago I am now able to walk an hour day! I just purchased 5 more pair!!!! Thank you, Asics

I love these shoes so much! They look very good on my feet I was specifically looking for white shoes as I feel more athletic in those mind tricks, I know ... I like lifting, but I need some cardio in my training, and bits like this help me getting those in. It has more arch support than I expected I had the Excite 7 before, but this was cheaper right now in my size , but it doesn't have a lot of cushion hence the 4 stars. It has more drop and more cushion that I would tolerate for lifting, though, so I still keep this for my cardio workouts! Wouldn't recommend them for lower body heavy -er lifting! I have wide feet and it has a comfortable toe box to accommodate for that need! I usually wear 10-10.5 for running, but I use these in the gym exclusively keeping them clean-er , and for any other activities, most styles fit me in 9-9.5. I ordered 9.5 and they are perfect! All in all, I'd recommend these shoes, just be aware that you won't have the "walking on cloud" feeling.

I have a lot of problems with my feet because my arches like to tear plantar fasciitis , but with these shoes, it feels like I'm walking on a cloud. I use them almost daily to go on a walk with my dog, I work out in them, and sometimes I just wear them around the house because they are so comfortable. This is the second time I have purchased the Gel-Excite from Ascics last time I bought the Gel-Excite 7 and I am in love! These shoes are so comfortable that I don't want to take them off. They offer great support, good amount of cushion around the heel, and they are lightweight.

I have been working out for years. I also have very little arch in my foot. I have tried Nike running shoes, Brooks running shoes and these Ascis. The ASICS have the best support and cushion I have found in a running shoe.

size.issue_summary: 많은 구매자들이 사이즈가 작거나 좁아서 불편함을 겪고 있으며, 이는 착용 시 통증과 불만족으로 이어지고 있습니다.
size.strength_summary: 많은 리뷰에서 사이즈가 잘 맞고 발가락 공간이 넉넉하다는 긍정적인 피드백이 반복적으로 나타났습니다. 이는 구매자들에게 편안한 착용감을 제공합니다.

representative_reviews.text: Fits a little narrow. I ordered my normal size but have narrow feet so that wasn t an issue. Has nice support and looks good. I use these to workout in and have no issues. However, running is uncomfortable. Shins and knees were hurting almost immediately. Hopefully breaking them in more will help but I don t feel like these have enough support to run in.
This shoe does not fit or is defective. I find it very uncomfortable and feel like it has heel tilt issue
I run approximately 6 miles everyday, in less than a month after wearing this sneakers I got 2 injuries. One in my ankle and my groin, they are very slippery on wet road. Nearly fell twice with them
I had a hard time getting my foot into the shoe which is never a problem with the many running shoes I ve purchased over the past decade. The fit was off and they provided very little support.

I have very wide, flat feet and have always had trouble finding runners that fit me width wise. For reference I wear a D width... I was really hoping these would work but alas, not at all. edges of my feet were spilling over the sides. When I tried them on it was painful to even walk around the house. No amount of "breaking in" would help.
This pair has made me rethink Sacouny. I returned these. They look cheap and hard plasticky. Soles are hard.

I prefer the higher-end Asics for actual distance running but decided to get these as some easy kickbacks for walking, etc. Unfortunately, these started fraying the third time I wore them. I didn t start using them until the return window had almost closed and when they started to fray, it was too late to return. They are lightweight and very comfy, but I definitely would not expect them to hold up for actual running. Pretty sad they haven t held up well for walking but it is what it is. I always go a half size up to allow my feet room for swelling when running, so the fit was just as expected!
Everytime i wear these shoes it crushes my feet, worst pain ive ever had and Ive tried breaking into these shoes for months. the shoe is just too narrow

I previously ordered this shoe in 'white'. I liked them so much I ordered this pair in black. They are NOT the same shoe although they are advertised to be the same. The black shoe is more narrow and shorter.

I bought this same pair of gel excite in size 9 wide at Kohl s last summer and they fit good and I really like them. I wanted to get another pair and saw these on Amazon for a fair price. They do not fit the same. The right shoe was way too wide for me. I tried everything to make it fit better but just gave up and returned them. This is a very comfortable, supportive running shoe and I wish it would have fit better. I guess this is a problem with quality control in sizing. If you are lucky enough that they fit you, it s a great shoe. I am going to look for these in a store where I can try them on before I buy!
Shoe fits smaller than other shoes, I normally order 71 2, and ordered 71 2 in this shoe, and my foot would not even fit in this shoe.
This shoe fits very tight. I have a regular width foot. The biggest negative is the the shoelaces were too short on the pair I received and I wasn't able to tie the shoes.

I have worn ASICS for running, walking and working out for 15 years. I needed a new pair and these seemed comparable to my prior ASICS purchases. I tried them on and they felt great. When I went for a walk a few days later, I began to feel the shoe rubbing at the back of my heel - but low on the heel, inside the shoe. I thought it would get better as they loosened up but it got much worse. I ended up running on the balls of my feet to get back home because my heels were on fire. These shoes rubbed two blisters on each heel. The problem appears to be that the inner sole comes part way up the inner heel of the shoe, creating a stiff ridge that rips into the skin on the lower heel see photo - the yellow lines mark where the sole meets the back of the shoe, but then the sole goes almost 1 2" up the back . Not sure if this is a defect on this pair or a design flaw, but it's a no-go for me! And they can't be returned because I wore them outside one time!
Previous shoes from same maker fit fine. the new ones are so cheap, I could barely tie them. The sides are measurably smaller from soles to laces. Ridiculous! Cannot wear these!

I really wanted to like these, I ve been wearing the excites for several years, my favorites were the 6 and 7, I expected a similar fit with the 8 unfortunately they are narrower, the toe box is tight, and they re not comfortable like the past ones I ve had, they ll be my light errand day shoes but not good for runs or to work on my feet all day
I ordered a 1 2 size larger only because i need toe room and many of the shoes I have tried recently have a narrow toe box however these fit great
great shoe. fits perfectly, especially where needed for me which is at the heel and great arch support.

Color is just as pictured bright and pretty-- I always buy this brand so know I have to size up I usually buy 8 1 2 running shoes but for these, I always need a size 9-- these have a very high back so you need an ankle running sock otherwise the back of your heel will be sore--I like them but have a concern about how thin the top material on the sneakers is-- You can see here when I lift my toe it is very thin- I am worried they won't last long as I tend to pronate my toes but even if I didn't it would still be a concern about the life expectancy of these sneakers It is for this reason I rated them only 3 stars the quality could be an issue

If you take the time to read the reviews, as I do, most were on point regarding this style sneaker by Asics they run very narrow. For me, I have a narrow foot heel so the fit was fine but in reading the reviews I took the suggestions offered and ordered a half size up 10 - 10 1 2, I could have gone up one full size based on how they fit. Glad I did because my regular size 10 would never have fit me. Because they run very narrow this sneaker is not for a person with a medium wide foot. The sneaker itself is beautifully made styled and comfortable using an additional orthotic for arch and heel support. The reviews also pointed out the shoelaces were too short they were right. Just enough to tie without making it a double. Normally, I would return but since applying a gift card balance from previous order returned, decided to keep since they were comfortable enough at a very low price! Note Mist Blue not same pattern as the Rose knit
Excellent padding all the way from heel to toe. Bought the wide as I have slightly wide feet and found lots of room in toe box. Excellent arch support. Very stable.
The toe box in this shoe is built up to avoid toes breaking through the mesh. Put them on and walked my regular walk first day with no issues. I ordered my regular size and they fit perfectly

Glad I read the reviews and sized UP a half a size, toe box is generous . The white fabric just grabs dust and dirt so to keep them nice looking you will have to launder them often which will make them not last as long If you were only wearing in a gym setting you d be better off They are comfortable but anyone with high arches you may want a bit more support Nice shoes but not a perfect score

Ordered the wide, shoe size and width fit perfectly. Very comfortable. I only wear asics. That said these in particular feel very "flat". The soles. It doesnt feel like theres any cushioning whatsoever. So although I kept them, Ill probably have to add some gel inserts sooner than I would like
I usually need to break in new running shoes, due to having wide feet. These fit perfectly out of the box.

Generally nice shoes. Good room in the toe box, good fit and padding on the heel. No arch support, very little room for high arches in the tongue area, especially tight where the toe box meets the tongue on the vamp. Almost felt like the tongue had too much padding. For me the shoes are wearable and comfortable for walking if the laces are completely loose and not tied.

These sneakers hit all the right notes, it is hard to say about the sizing as I wear a size 8 in shoes or heels but 9.5 in sneakers and these fit perfect. They are gorgeous, have a great foot bed and are cushioned and very comfortable. I ordered another pair the day after I received the first ones.

I originally purchased this shoe at a local store. I wore the heck out of it on my mail route and knew this was the shoe for me! It fits great and doesn t make me feel weird. The comfort level is on point and I did honestly add a shoe insert for more comfort but that s not a poke at the shoe but my job which works the crap outta me.
Perfect fit. Great support and padding. Soles have perfect tread. Need them for dog walking. I have bad feet and theyre great. Will definitely get another pair.
These are very comfortable shoes. I would recommend them to everyone. I have a narrow foot and these fit very well but still have some room for a slightly wider foot as well.
I am very particular about my sneakers, these ticked every box for me. Stylish, great fit,all day wear! Yes, I'm good!

durability.issue_summary: 구매자들은 내구성 문제로 인해 신발이 빠르게 마모되거나 손상된다고 불만을 토로하고 있습니다.
durability.strength_summary: 구매자들은 내구성이 뛰어난 제품을 반복적으로 언급하며, 오랜 사용 기간과 우수한 지지력을 통해 긍정적인 경험을 하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: These shoes are extremely comfortable and lightweight-feels. They have a nice walking on clouds feel and good support for walking and jogging. Shoes are wide enough that toes do not feel scrunched on the sides or the tips -they fit to size. Unfortunately, one foot of mine is a size larger than the other which makes finding a pair of shoes that fit difficult. These fit pretty well-my larger foot doesn t touch the tip and the smaller foot doesn t move around too much. The laces are too small for the shoes as reported in other reviews but I have managed to use them and they stay they tied most of the time. Unfortunately a hole has formed on the top of the shoe where the rubber meets the fabric. To be clear, it s not from my toe hitting the edge. I have had the shoes since mid July of this year and the hole appeared at the end of October the same year . I only wore them a few times this summer- I wore sandals most of the time until late September. I use these for walking the dog and have jogged in them a few times. The rest of the shoes still look and feel pretty much brand new-but the hole is a big problem and once it formed it only is getting larger. Shoes don t last forever-but these did not last very long and are not cheap. I like them so much I am tempted to buy another pair but not going to risk wasting so much money.

I have worn ASICS for running, walking and working out for 15 years. I needed a new pair and these seemed comparable to my prior ASICS purchases. I tried them on and they felt great. When I went for a walk a few days later, I began to feel the shoe rubbing at the back of my heel - but low on the heel, inside the shoe. I thought it would get better as they loosened up but it got much worse. I ended up running on the balls of my feet to get back home because my heels were on fire. These shoes rubbed two blisters on each heel. The problem appears to be that the inner sole comes part way up the inner heel of the shoe, creating a stiff ridge that rips into the skin on the lower heel see photo - the yellow lines mark where the sole meets the back of the shoe, but then the sole goes almost 1 2" up the back . Not sure if this is a defect on this pair or a design flaw, but it's a no-go for me! And they can't be returned because I wore them outside one time!

I purchased these shoes about 2 months back and i wore them for about a month or more.As per the color and quality all looked fine, but then I started getting ankle pain, i changed to a different brand shoe and it s all fine I don t know wether it is their gel technology or wether the seller is not giving genuine product, but these goes were literally pain in the feet. It is sad that I cannot get a refund as the return date is over, a total waste of money .
This pair has made me rethink Sacouny. I returned these. They look cheap and hard plasticky. Soles are hard.

I don't know what happened with ASICS but these shoes last only for few months. It is just not a high standard what one can expect from Asics. Also, I found that it is really difficult to return or exchange them.

I love me some ASICS, but this pair hurts! I know that feet differ in size just like hands do, but this pair is significantly off. I had to switch to a lighter sock just to get the left one on, and then had to practically loosen the lace until there was nothing left to tie. I thought, okay, I just to need break them in, but holy cow, after 30 minutes my foot is asleep and cursing me! Seeing reviews how worn shoes have been returned to just go out to the next buyer, I'm not willing to do that to someone else. I'll just chalk this up to buying on the internet...you never know what you're going to get.

I have never been disappointed by a pair of Asics before, but I found these shoes to be so uncomfortable. The treads were wearing down on the soles of my Gel Flux 5 and I was unable to find those for sale anywhere, so I got these as a replacement. I wore them to work 10 hours shifts mostly on my feet for a couple of days to test out the comfort level and found the tops tongue of the shoe to be tight and uncomfortable. I wore them while running 3.5 miles yesterday and that part of the shoe irritated my feet even more and i had to stop multiple times to adjust the tongues. Today I noticed that my heels are very sensitive, so the shoes must not have as much padding inside as I'm used to in the Gel Flux 5. While running in the shoes again today to give them another chance, I decided I just can't put my feet through this much discomfort to potentially get used to the shoes. The quality seems good and the shoes look very nice, they just aren't comfortable or suitable for what I purchased them for. Unfortunately I am just outside the surprisingly short return window so I'll be storing them in my closet for now.
I searched for shoes that were slip resistant for work. Almost fell on my ass walking into the kitchen. Need better descriptions please. Not happy with these at all.
Wore these just 3 times and now the soles are bunched and gives blisters. Totally unacceptable. Always loved Asics but not now.

I have been an Asics running shoe wearer for over 15 years. Over the past two, the quality and consistency of their products have decreased consistently. This pair of Gel-Excite 8 has caused me to change to another brand. The fabric of the shoe no longer has an stretch to it but is rather a shiny, tight knit fabric. This causes the toe box to have no flexibility. Further, this shoe was easily 1 4 inch shorter than the Gel-Excite 7. Although I have always purchased a half size larger than my street shoes because Asics run small, I would have needed an entire size or size-and-a-half to wear this shoe. I returned the shoe the same day they arrived in the mail, and they arrived back with the seller six days later. Because they were sold directly through Asics, it is now 12 days since I returned them and still no credit back to my Amazon gift card account. Buyers should be aware of the extremely long time to get a refund processed through Asics.

I am mostly a five-star reviewer and have rarely came on here to give four stars or less. These shoes are horrible, hence the sale price. They are sitting in the box new with tags but I missed the return window so I cannot even exchange or get a store credit for them. Even Asics doesn't want them back. I am often on my feet for 12 hours and leave my shifts in pain. I need a shoe that fits accurately and gives me support. What happened to the excite? The 8 is so bad without even taking into consideration the over an inch too long in length. They look and feel like clown shoes, they feel cheaper and do not even come close to hugging my foot. Looks can be deceiving - the pictures look great - I'm Extremely disappointed that I mistakenly purchased 2 of this blunder before trying them on The price was great and I thought I was getting a deal and I wanted to set myself up for the next year. Really really disappointed that I will not get even one use out of these.
I had a hard time getting my foot into the shoe which is never a problem with the many running shoes I ve purchased over the past decade. The fit was off and they provided very little support.
Disappointed. The cushion gel comfort is just not what I am used to for an ASIC shoe. The shoe laces are too short to even tie them. I am not happy at all with this shoe. I won't buy online again.

Color is just as pictured bright and pretty-- I always buy this brand so know I have to size up I usually buy 8 1 2 running shoes but for these, I always need a size 9-- these have a very high back so you need an ankle running sock otherwise the back of your heel will be sore--I like them but have a concern about how thin the top material on the sneakers is-- You can see here when I lift my toe it is very thin- I am worried they won't last long as I tend to pronate my toes but even if I didn't it would still be a concern about the life expectancy of these sneakers It is for this reason I rated them only 3 stars the quality could be an issue
I still have not used it long enough to leave a good review. So far it is ok and very comfortable although i was sent a size half inch bigger. Still fits well.

These sneakers feel so good. I fell in love with the Asics Excite6 then of course new version came in new year disappointing . These Excite 8 are so similar to the excite 6. I am excited about wearing they feel great for my plantar fascitis. Will be buying multiples and hoarding them.
Purchased these shoes as I work retail on cement floor for 5-6 hours straight. Being older 65 I need more support and comfort. I would strongly recommend these to anyone.
Great shoes for working out and casual running. Above average confort and cushioning for the price point, excellent construction quality amd finish.
I love the shoes but I had to add my own inserts because I needed more of a thicker insert for comfort. But I also suffer from plantar fascias

I have a total of 19 years and counting in healthcare and I swear by ASICS being the best shoes for Nursing. If you re going to nursing school get you a pair of ASICS, if you re still having trouble finding a comfy pair- ASICS and compression socks- don t forget those too

I'm on my feet all day, and have been through MANY shoes. These are by far my favorite so far. When the time comes for a new pair. I will be sticking to these. I finally found comfort, support, durability all in one!

I liked the pair I bought in the local store, but they didn t have any left but ever faithful Amazon AND HERE WE ARE!! Excellent support for my high arches, more than proficient cushion to get me through a 9 hour busy Dr Office schedule, and cute to the max!!!

This is the second time I ve ordered this shoe it fits great it looks great but it s designed poorly because it always rips at my big toe. this one only lasted barely 6 months and there s a hole in the toe. I won t be purchasing them again I ve switched to Nike

I have been working out for years. I also have very little arch in my foot. I have tried Nike running shoes, Brooks running shoes and these Ascis. The ASICS have the best support and cushion I have found in a running shoe.
I m usually a Nike lover but I m glad I have expanded my options. Good support and nice color selections.
I always buy a half size bigger I m case I wear thick socks. These shoes last so long. I run an average of 5 miles a day and they last almost a year. I won t wear any other brand
I use this product for working in a restaurant. I like the shoe only it was advertised as being slip resistant and it is definitely not slip resistant
They are ok to wear for a little while, but not as comfy as my other ASICS, and I won t be wearing them for my 12 hour shifts.

representative_reviews.text: Great shoes for working out and casual running. Above average confort and cushioning for the price point, excellent construction quality amd finish.

product_name: Merrell Men's Encore Gust Slip-On Shoe

urgent_issues.summary: 사이즈 관련 문제로 인해 많은 구매자들이 불만을 토로하고 있으며, 적절한 착용감을 찾기 어려워 반품하는 경우가 많습니다.

comfort.issue_summary: 많은 구매자들이 착용감에 대한 불만을 토로하고 있으며, 특히 발이 아프거나 불편하다는 의견이 반복적으로 나타나고 있습니다.
comfort.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 발에 매우 편안하고 아치 지지력이 뛰어나며, 통증을 완화하는 데 효과적이라고 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Wanted so badly for these to work for me but the support is so hard my feet hurt until I had to stop wearing them altogether. I work in the OR Olin my feet all day, not walking just standing. These killed my feet. They hurt for days even after I stopped wearing them. Going back to Keen slip ons which we re awesome.

This is fake leather being sold as leather. The shoe is immediately hot to wear, the inside is not leather so wearing this without socks is not possible as leather is best with bare feet. Cheap junk for a 100 bucks. Get real.
Either my right foot is larger or the leather is tighter. Definitely hurts around the top. Hoping the leather stretches out soon. Definitely not non slip and not the most comfortable shoe I ve owned.

I loved my old Encore Grooves which I could wear to travel overseas, they were easy to slip on and off in airports, yet stayed on my feet and I could even do some pretty serious hiking in them. The leather uppers looked great, much classier than sneakers or "Jungle mocs." So they're worn out now and the Encore Gust is the only similar-appearing replacement it seems. I find that in the Gust my heel always feels like it's slipping out when walking, and I measure that my heel is almost 1 2" higher than with the Groove see pics, you can see a lot more of my sock with the Gust . The tread is still robust enough for hiking but I doubt the heel will keep out small rocks etc, possibly even when walking on city streets. The Gust has a narrower heel also, so less stable for hiking, and the foot opening is weird and more oblong. The sizing is also large, I usually go 8.5 but 8.0 was a better fit. It's a nice looking shoe but the Groove was better.

I've bought these shoes a couple times over the years and have always been pleased with them. This time, however... Not so much. I've had them for two months now. I'm on my feet all day at work, 45 hours a week. So you'd think they'd be broken in by now. But every day, within 30 minutes of putting them on, my feet end up aching and hurting all day. I just came off of a week long vacation and my feet felt fine. 10 minutes after putting these shoes on today, my feet started aching again. They'll be finding their way into the dumpster once I get off of work and I'll find something else to wear. I won't be ordering these again.

Purchased for my husband, who is a nurse and on his feet for 12 hour shifts. The mouth of the shoes were too narrow to be comfortable. We tried a few different sizes to see if that was the issue but it was the same for all of them. He is thin and definitely doesn t have large feet or ankles, so it seems strange to me that these shoes fit too narrow to wear. Returned them. The rest of the shoe felt good on his feet, so might work for someone else I guess.
The soles fell apart after light to moderate wear. Junk. Save your money or buy from a different company
It hurts my feet, I decoded to buy them becoz of their good reviews. I think it's just not meant for my style of feet. I'm returning them instead

These are by far the worst shoes I have ever ordered. I got them based off all the great reviews they have gotten but they are very uncomfortable and they slip even if the floor is barely wet. I would return if I didn't throw out the box and threw out my old work shoes. If you are buying these for work in a restaurant stay away.
These shoes were at least one size too big. Comfort was fair at best. The toe compartment was too box like. Poor fit.

Not sure what happened with Merrill on these shoes. I own several pairs of Merrill s. These don t have the cushion or comfort that is typical. The back half of the shoe is considerably narrower than the front half. They would work if you have narrow feet but still arent the comfort you are used to with Merrill s. Don t buy these.
Merrell has great quality shoes ... I own three pairs. However, this pair was so stinking tight I could never even get my foot inside the shoe. I had to return it.

Size 9 was good for length, but too narrow. Size 9.5 too long, and narrow. These are too narrow to be labeled D-width. Good arch support, but the soles are hard and uncomfortable. The style and leather are very nice, but for the price I expected better fit and more comfort. Disappointed I had to return them.

So just ignore all the sites touting these as the best kitchen shoes ever. They are actually some of the worst I have ever used. The grip is terrible and the don't stay on your feet very well. I hope this keeps a fellow cook from making the same mistake I did shelling out for these overhyped slip n slides.

I was excited to try this Merrell slip on shoe as I work in a hospital for long hours. Initially they were very comfortable and I was satisfied with the fit and shape of the shoe. However after 6 months of near daily use for 12-24hr use the black shoe inserts on the inside essentially disitegrated. This left a lip at the lateral edge that created a pressure sore on my foot. The shoe inserts has a design flaw or is not intended for intense use. I've reordered the shoe to give it another try because the first few months we're great. I would just be wary if the shoe starts to fall apart. I've owned many Merrell products and have always been satisfied with the quality. This model was disappointing especially for nearly 100 a pair.

I have purchased several pairs. They are great for my feet. I need wide, 8 1 2 with good support, no high rear to rub my heel spur and arthritis, and no 34 flip flop 34 hurting action as I walk, irritating my aging bunion.. That was a major concern when I ordered these years ago would they flop when walking and create even more issues with knee and foot pain Sorry to offend anyone, but I hate fip-flops and think there should be a health ban on them outside of the shower room! . In fact, in my first pair of these shoes, I put holes and grommets near the rear to lace them up my leg Iike ballet dancer's toe shoes to prevent any flopping. But with my second pair, I either started waling better or the design changed slightly and I did not need to be that drastic. However, these are not for serious, long distance walking for my feet. I can wear them all day for office work with plenty of standing and for running routine errands, but for two mile or more walks, even with my lacing technique, there is still enough flop action in these shoes to destroy my ankles and knees. So for my walking exercising shoes I must look elsewhere. The look of these is more casual than I would like, but my feet are more important than style. They do look better than the more expensive Birkenstock definitely too casual, expensive, and mostly sandal-like anyway and I've never tried on a Birkenstock that felt any better on first fit than these do. I wear the high gloss, smooth finish style with a suit. Again, sorry if I offend anyone, but they go on my feet with no pain all day--and I do wear orthotic inserts with them that fit well with the liner removed. They are also much more expensive than I would like, but my reasoning is the same--they are good for my feet. I have read that the newer version of this shoe does not hold up as well as the previous version. I have a rough brown finish and smooth brown finish pair that have worn well--more than two years for the smooth brown and going in four and a half years on the rough brown. I have been waiting for black to come in around 80 and they did. I have two pair of the Breeze style of this shoe, but only wear them as slippers around the house or for a quick trip out as with their open weave pattern, they look even more casual than the Gust. You can find Breeze version in the 50 60 range, although the men's version is getting harder to find. I just hope that the negative review I read is wrong and that this new black model will hold up as well as the older brown ones have and that the slight price drop does not reflect drop in quality. The negative review complained of upper and lower separation. My older pairs are still going strong. If these do hold up as well, I will buy more when needed. If they don't hold up as well, I will be greatly disappointed that I need to start looking for good office shoes again.
Well made and comfortable now that it broken in. The insert was a bit wonky and needed to be adjusted so it didn't place too much pressure opposite my arch.
Did not know what I had been missing arch support wise! These are for use indoors only. Merrell clogs was recommended by my podiatrist given my foot problems.

Once I tried this shoe I knew it would be my everyday general wear shoe. The most comfortable shoe I've owned and it shines up very nice but is also informal enough for everyday wear. I just love this shoe so much I own both brown and black leather but I have owned other models of the same shoe as well. Seriously it's a surprisingly wonderful shoe. Oh yeah, I have wide feet and this shoe is really comfortable for me.
A great O.R. shoe, easy on and off, and comfortable. The arch support is lacking a little bit and it would be amazing if they had a bit more soft cushioning. Overall, a good way to go for the money!
This is my fourth pair! Very comfortable to walk in. Just enough cushion makes walking a pleasure. The simple fact these are my fourth pair should tell you everything.
I am a nurse so I needed a really good pair of support shoes to keep my back, legs and feet from aching so bad and so far so good!

If I had to pick one pair of shoes to walk around the world in, it would be a pair of Merrill s. These clogs looks nice enough to wear in place of dress shoes and are casual enough that I wear them to the gym and then put on running shoes of course . They come from Merrill so you know they are good quality. Deep rich brown that can take a polish in a few months or just some mink oil to keep them looking nice. They fit as expected. I m usually a solid 11US when it comes to shoes and these are no exception. They were a little tight over the top I don t have a high arch, my foot is very average , but I expected them to stretch out a bit and they have.

I work in a rugged office type environment so in the fall winter I have by habit worn steel toe boots! After purchasing I decided to try them at work! The boots are no longer being worn after wearing this tremendously comfortable slip on. For me there is plenty of arch support and the width is right there as well with room to spare for my toes! Really, really nice fit!
Love these. I've had plantar fasciitis and I'm on my feet 12-16 hours a day. I'm always comfortable, I just wish I could send them off to have them resoled.
Wanted the Timberland version of this, however it no longer available. This Merrell version is really close, fits well and is very comfortable I have no problem recommending the product.

Advised by podiatrist to avoid flip flops, slides, etc. to deal with foot pain. These were on a list of best arch support shoes which is a little surprising because the arch is good but not great. Past reviewer advised going half size small because they run big and for me that bore out to be well taken advice. Wish the back enclosure was a bit higher.

Great for relieving painful pressure on back of heel. Interestingly they also revealed painful tightness in the arch of my right foot. Almost returned them, but instead used Wilson tennis ball to nuke my arch. After a week the pain and tightness is gone, after weeks of pain. I ve been limping for months. Not any more. These shoes plus tennis ball five stars.
I use the shoes for the comfort, I am on my feet all day and the shoes are awesome, the comfort and support are perfect and are very durable. These are my 4th pair guess I love them.

This is my second pair. I bought this as a 34 house-slipper 34 because I need the foot support for walking on hardwood floors. The first pair lasted over 5 years. I am completely happy with the purchase. I bought my husband a pair a couple of years ago. The numbness of his feet went away right after he started wearing them. I just bought another pair for my mom who is in her 80's. She needs the arch support. I just bought my husband a second pair for traveling. He forgot to pack the Merrells last time we stayed at the ski house. His feet hurt so much that it took several days to recover. Now that he has a second pair he wouldn't have to worry about his feet anymore.

representative_reviews.text: These shoes were at least one size too big. Comfort was fair at best. The toe compartment was too box like. Poor fit.
The soles fell apart after light to moderate wear. Junk. Save your money or buy from a different company

Size 9 was good for length, but too narrow. Size 9.5 too long, and narrow. These are too narrow to be labeled D-width. Good arch support, but the soles are hard and uncomfortable. The style and leather are very nice, but for the price I expected better fit and more comfort. Disappointed I had to return them.

I loved my old Encore Grooves which I could wear to travel overseas, they were easy to slip on and off in airports, yet stayed on my feet and I could even do some pretty serious hiking in them. The leather uppers looked great, much classier than sneakers or "Jungle mocs." So they're worn out now and the Encore Gust is the only similar-appearing replacement it seems. I find that in the Gust my heel always feels like it's slipping out when walking, and I measure that my heel is almost 1 2" higher than with the Groove see pics, you can see a lot more of my sock with the Gust . The tread is still robust enough for hiking but I doubt the heel will keep out small rocks etc, possibly even when walking on city streets. The Gust has a narrower heel also, so less stable for hiking, and the foot opening is weird and more oblong. The sizing is also large, I usually go 8.5 but 8.0 was a better fit. It's a nice looking shoe but the Groove was better.
Merrell has great quality shoes ... I own three pairs. However, this pair was so stinking tight I could never even get my foot inside the shoe. I had to return it.

Not sure what happened with Merrill on these shoes. I own several pairs of Merrill s. These don t have the cushion or comfort that is typical. The back half of the shoe is considerably narrower than the front half. They would work if you have narrow feet but still arent the comfort you are used to with Merrill s. Don t buy these.

Purchased for my husband, who is a nurse and on his feet for 12 hour shifts. The mouth of the shoes were too narrow to be comfortable. We tried a few different sizes to see if that was the issue but it was the same for all of them. He is thin and definitely doesn t have large feet or ankles, so it seems strange to me that these shoes fit too narrow to wear. Returned them. The rest of the shoe felt good on his feet, so might work for someone else I guess.
Fit ok. Developed a pressure point under left foot that I put up with as long as I could. After a year, I couldnt take it anymore and had to stop wearing. Disappointed.
Either my right foot is larger or the leather is tighter. Definitely hurts around the top. Hoping the leather stretches out soon. Definitely not non slip and not the most comfortable shoe I ve owned.
They don t seem to be a true size10. They are 1 2 size to large. I have owned at least 10 pair of Merrills

I ordered these for my husband, who is currently in rehab after brain surgery. He needs shoes he can slip into, but which still support him. I originally ordered size 10,which normally fits him, but they were too small, so I ordered a half size up. These also did not fit, because they seemed too narrow. These are generally wonderful shoes, but unfortunately they did not work for my husband at this time. No fault of the shoes!

I already owned a pair of Encore Rexton leather clogs and thought that these would be similar. The Encore Gust appear to be well made, but they are a good bit smaller than the Rextons in size 12M. They are tight to the point of being uncomfortable on my insteps, and they do not seem to have the cushioning in the soles that the Rextons have. I thought that they might become more comfortable with wear, but that has not been the case.

So just ignore all the sites touting these as the best kitchen shoes ever. They are actually some of the worst I have ever used. The grip is terrible and the don't stay on your feet very well. I hope this keeps a fellow cook from making the same mistake I did shelling out for these overhyped slip n slides.
Was a good shoe. Been using it for 2 years and 5 months and it finally broke. I expected it to last longer than this. 2 years is not really impressive.
It hurts my feet, I decoded to buy them becoz of their good reviews. I think it's just not meant for my style of feet. I'm returning them instead

This is a great shoe. At first I thought it would be too tight as initially had a hard time getting into the shoe. A couple of times getting in and out of the shoe and it fit perfectly. They fit my foot perfectly - can't speak for your foot. The are extremely comfortable when wearing all day. This is my sixth pair - enough said.
I got 1 2 size larger. Prior size was my size but for longer walks or uneven areas felt too tight on toe box. 1 2 size works best for me. Great shoes. Wore last ones almost daily.

This my second pair of these. The first pair lasted 3-4 years. They are close to true to size but I would order a half size smaller due to the large toe box. They are comfortable right out of the box. Satisfied customer!
I ordered the size 10.5 wide and they fit great . The shoes are extremely comfortable and they look great .
This was exactly what I wanted - shoe my husband likes to wear easy to order and delivered fairly quickly...good experience

I'm on my feet all day at work, 45 hours a week. So you'd think they'd be broken in by now. But every day, within 30 minutes of putting them on, my feet end up aching and hurting all day. I just came off of a week long vacation and my feet felt fine. 10 minutes after putting these shoes on today, my feet started aching again. They'll be finding their way into the dumpster once I get off of work and I'll find something else to wear. I won't be ordering these again.

These were very comfortable so I was happy until I got into the restaurant and quickly realized these are 100 not slip resistant, had to walk like I was on ice fell carrying hot soup, hurt pretty bad within an hour I realized these are awful for working chefs and went home to grab an old pair!

This is fake leather being sold as leather. The shoe is immediately hot to wear, the inside is not leather so wearing this without socks is not possible as leather is best with bare feet. Cheap junk for a 100 bucks. Get real.
Very tight on instep. I ll keep wearing and they should loosen up. I m a Merrill fan and always have several pairs in the closet. Don t think I ll order these again.

However after 6 months of near daily use for 12-24hr use the black shoe inserts on the inside essentially disitegrated. This left a lip at the lateral edge that created a pressure sore on my foot. The shoe inserts has a design flaw or is not intended for intense use. I've reordered the shoe to give it another try because the first few months we're great. I would just be wary if the shoe starts to fall apart. I've owned many Merrell products and have always been satisfied with the quality. This model was disappointing especially for nearly 100 a pair.

Since he likes working in the yard and walking through construction areas, having a sturdy sole and his toe covered is a must. He swears by these shoes and refuses to change to any other ones.

I m on my 2nd pair of these great shoes. My last pair are 8 years old and I still wear them for around the house and yard. The new pair are reserved for public events like shopping or sports events. The soles are very resistant to roll over and wearing down. I highly recommend them for the guys having a hard time bending over to tie laces.
Very good quality shoe. I'm a nurse and at the end of the day my feet aren't tired. Real leather and not pleather.

I have a EE E width for my two feet, which makes it difficult to find a shoe that isn t too tight on one foot while perfect on the other. This is my 4th pair of these shoes over the years and they are perfect for me. I need an easy on easy off shoe that looks okay shined up and doesn t require me to bend over to put on or off. The shoe stretches enough to accommodate the fact that my feet are wider than the size of the shoe and two different widths. I have worn my previous pairs throughout travels in Asia, SE Asia, Europe and US I travel with these and hiking boots and never had any issues with durability. They work great for restaurants that require shoes be taken off, great on long over seas flights, and double as my camp shoe for some longer backpack hiking trips they are not light weight though . With Prime Wardrobe option, you can get a couple sizes and see which fit so there is not much to lose if you want to check them out.
