representative_reviews.text: Product was fine until I walked in them for awhile, then a blister appeared on my right foot, apparently it doesn't have enough "give" in the toe area.

Normally after some walking, the sole of my feet would hurt. These shoes cushion the bottom really well, allowing me to walk further distances without pain. I want to love them but they rub against my ankle, heel and top of my feet. Not to mention they are sweat prone because of the material, despite all the holes. I tried wearing tiny socks but they kept slipping. I guess I'll have to wear full socks with these. I haven't tried them with full socks but feeling the breeze on the top of my feet was really nice. Thats why I love and hate them. If only it was made with material that wouldn't rub against my skin.
Way less comfortable than original crocs. Actually made my feet hurt and the squeaking was unbearable

They fit me too big. Very little arch support, nothing wrong with that I just need more being on my feet all day. I also strangely get a blister on my right toe every time I wear them. I really wish I liked them more because they re so lightweight.

Haven t even had these shoes a month and the rubber part where the laces go in broke so now it can not hold the laces. Very disappointed in the shoe. Not supportive at all and my feet hurt after walking in them for 12 hours as a nurse. Do not recommend.

These are prettier than your average Crocs clog, and light weight, but that's about it. I really like Crocs as a brand and own several pairs. I was pretty excited to try Literide and their sneakers. What I didn't like about it 1 Arch support is almost not there. The inside soles are also softer, so that combined with the lack of arch support makes it very unsupportive. 2 It is very hard to get these shoes on and off with socks on. Since the shoe is rubber and the sole has very prominent knobs, it creates a lot of friction against the sock. I tried wearing them with not socks. But it didn't work out either see number 3 . 3 If worn with no socks, they might cause blisters. The pair I got had some parts around the ankle where the thread on the interior fabric cuff felt almost like plastic thread, or as if it had been burned. It felt very coarse and within one minute I was hurting. If I had gone on a walk with them, I would have blisters for sure. Maybe it was just my pair, but in that case, QA failed, which is not good either. All in all, I love Crocs, but I will be returning this pair.

Bought these for a trip to Disney. Wore them to the park for one day and my feet had terrible blisters. Thought they would be perfect to keep my feet cool in the hot Florida sun but ruined my vacation. Would not recommend.

I was anxious to try these out for walking, but these weren't right for me. They had no support, gave me blisters the first time I went walking with them, and after a few uses, started wearing on the sole. I would not recommend these shoes.

I am on my feet all day In an animal shelter. I usually just wear my regular crocs. I got these because I needed another shoe that could get wet and easily be washed off. I can t wear these for more than 5 hrs or so without them giving me blisters. They have the means to be comfortable for sure- but if you have wider feet like me, I would tell you not to get these unless you want blisters on the side and back of your feet.

I was stocked when I saw these on Facebook the caption said great for people Who work 10 hours a day immediately I ordered them. When I got them I tried them On they re very comfortable and squishy but I have wider feet and these ran small so after an hour they began to Feel Uncomfortable. I thought well maybe I ll return these and get a size up! Well when I wore them The last day it was a hot day here in Texas and ughh I feel that these being a rubber material they shrunk on my feet and it felt like someone was cooking my Feet in a hot stove. Oh God I never wore these again and as soon as I got The chance I returned them! Save your time save your money!
The are GREY not White. Where the tounge is sewn on digs into the top of your foot and is very uncomfortable.

I purchased a pair of Lite Ride last summer. The first pair I ordered on Amazon , had a really great right foot shoe, and the left one was too tight, painful. So I returned and exchanged the item. The second pair I received had the same issue. This time, I measured and studied them carefully. The one that hurts on the top of the foot, right where the laces end, seems to be 1 2 inch less in diameter. The tongue of the left shoe is not properly stitched and cut. The comfortable shoe has the tongue cut out just below the stitches, the shoe that is too tight has fabric left around the tongue. That is pressing on the top of the foot. I would really like to find a pair that fits, I believe these could be good for my feet since the right shoe feels great. I am attaching pictures in support of my observations. It is difficult to take pictures inside the shoe, where the pressure occurs, so I am trying to use the tip of my finger to show where the good and the defect stitches are. The instep feeling is different where the left shoe allows less flexibility.

I got sweating and painful feet, back, and knee with these shoes. Too dad I can't return them. I love crocs but these are awful. No doubts the shoes were causing the back and knees pain. I wore then a few nights to work my 12hrs shift and in the middle of my night I had pain, so following night wore my other shoes and pain was almost gone. I'm not advertising but I decided to try the Hoka shoes instead, and Totally worth it. I will never again use this crocs shoes for work, I guess I gotta get rid of them not healthy for my back and knees!
I used them 1 time for work walking mostly for 8 hours . They are supposed to be comfortable but even with socks they gave me a blisters in the top of my foot.
I've one flat foot and the other is normal. I loved these sneakers because of the lightness and color but the insoles do not come out for me to place arch support. I do need to return these.
I've never found a shoe that allows me to have no foot pain during my 10 hour shift till this one. This is my first pair of Crocs, but I hope to be a repeat customer
Cool and comfortable I have a higher arch so it didn t give as much support as I would like . Great for running around town or walking not so much for working out .

I am a health care worker and during a pandemic these rubber shoes have been amazing for keeping clean from room to room and when coming home. If you have flat arches they do not provide much support but they are very comfortable!

I just unboxed these badboys and I am loving it. They look great. Generally shoes in my size 10 don't look very cute and end up looking more like flippers. I think part of it is the material that the upper portion is made out of have more structure and holds its form better than most shoe upper materials, giving the shoe an appearance incredibly close to the advertised image. There is also something to be admired in the lack of over branding. Yes, it says crocs on the tongue and bottom tread in roughly size 14 font, but theres no garish logo taking up sides or toe box. These are simply designed to be appreciated for their looks and comfort. As for comfort, 10 10, for sure. I can't speak to arch support because I've never needed it thus far in life half marathons included , but these are very light weight with a noticeable amount of cushion in the foot-bed. I'm not sure I'd like that much cushion on a run i'll give them a shot though, but for daily wear, errands, and even a workout class, absolutely.

I bought these shoes for a specific reason to tackle daily sandy daily trail walking in the FL woods. Regular Crocs kick up sand on the back end and provide scant resistance to evil fire ants. I have used these new shoes two days and while they don't provide the traction of a regular athletic shoe, they are cushiony and keep sand and ants out. I would have preferred a bungee or similar on top, but laces allow me to adjust the fit, looser for walking in the woods, snugger for wearing on errands. I wear them naked they would be too tight with socks. Best part I can wash them off after my walk and they're dry the next day. Regular sneakers never dry out in 99 nasty FL humidity, just mildew and smell like something died in your shoes. These were an investment, they are rubber shoes after all, so hopefully they will last a while.
I love this product. I don't know if it will last as long as my other Crocs, which last for years , but so far it is very comfy. No arch support though, but that can be remedied.
Definitely comfortable and squishy. Feet still hurt at the end of my shift but that s unavoidable. Good breathability

Love, love, love these shoes. Wore them all day when I first received them and no pain! If you cannot find a pair of shoes that are comfortable, these shoes are what you are looking for. I do wear them with diabetic ankle socks for extra padding but you don t need to. Very light weight but have great support. Because they are so soft and flexible, even bunion pain will be nonexistent in these shoes

This is a really comfortable shoe when it comes to just casual wear. There is really no arch support at all, which is the only problem. A little hard to out on with socks since they are made out of basically rubber, but they are very flexible and I honestly don't wear mine with socks because the little holes in them cause air to circulate around your foot, it feels great! Great for light walking or a cardio machine, would not run in them.
I was looking for a comfortable lightweight shoe for an upcoming trip. I wanted something easy to pack but comfortable on long walking tours. These were perfect!

I wanted to find this shoe to be perfect. It is cute, has a very comfortable broad toe box. However, I found the arch support inadequate and the plastic material to be sweaty and hot in spite of the perforations. I will not order again, but I will wear these shoes as my beach walking shoes since they will dry quickly.

Purchases in Sept. Awesome shoes sadly they dont come in all white for men. Our job requires all white shoes. Wife and I bought them yeah I bought the women's size equivalent for myself . I have Plantar pain and it has relieved a lot of the pain. I use them 40 hours a week. They are so flexible enough that I feel it allows my arch muscle to strengthen and hence reduced my pain. Sadly they are already wearing a bit after a months use but I walk 7000 to 10000 steps a day. If they wear out I will buy another set. They dirty quickly in the white but they wash super easily. Best feature is they get wet you wipe them out and put on a new sock and now you have dry feet again. Great for those who work in the Florida parks. I get lots of compliments and love my shoes great buy. Update 1 29 21 shoes finally wore a holes in them after 149 days and about 894 miles in them. Still love the shoes because of comfort and the fact it help build the strength in my feet and my plantar fasciitis has not hurt as bad since I got the shoes. Just wish the sole would have lasted longer. But I just got a new set and still love them. My wives shoes are still in good condition because she does not wear them as much as I did mine.
Comfortable shoes. Took a little work to break in with socks on but comfortable after same. Awesome shoes for medical professionals

These have been so comfortable! I have a bone spur and plantar fasciitis and I can walk in these. I have a regular pair of crocs that I am in all the time so I thought I would give these a try. So glad I did! I have spent hundreds of dollars trying to find a comfortable sneaker. These are the ticket and for 59.99 can t beat it!

I have bought so many of these LiteRide shoes. All are wonderful! I have serious foot issues and I need serious cushioning. These shoes have it. I can walk forever with no pain at all! Love these shoes!!!

representative_reviews.text: I bought these sneakers from my wife but we had to return them because they run big and they don't come in half sizes.

I have flat feet so unfortunately these hurt my feet even with inserts. I m sure they would be good for anyone with normal feet. I ll still hold onto them in case I wanna try them for anything else besides a work shoe though

These shoes were a bust. I was however impressed with how well they were made. It seems as if they had worked out, they would have lasted years! But, they were way to narrow... Left indentions on the top of my foot, and bruised! I bought them for work but through out the day my feet got extremely sweaty and despite how tight they were, my foot slipped around in the shoe! I read reviews that they stretched after wear but I couldn t handle it anymore. They were very sweaty and tight and I had to return them. I normally wear a 7W but ordered an 8 because I do have wide feet. A 9 would have been way too long. The toe box was fine though. They were very tight around the top where the shoe laces are. Disappointed, wish they offered wide sizes.
I bought this pair ofwatershoes to prepare for The Narrows. Sadly, they were at least a size larger.
I would have loved these shoes if they had my size! I'm usually a 5.5. the 5 was too small the 6 to big. Disappointed.

I have wide feet with high arches - Crocs are usually fine, so are typical tennis shoes that aren t even wide. if they re narrow at first I warm Crocs in the dryer then wear them with thick socks. But these pinch painfully around the ball of my foot even after that, and the tongue doesn t tuck into the shoe all the way even with thin no-see-em socks. They re quite the sweat factory, and rub uncomfortably where the fabric is sewn to the plastic. The soles are way too squishy in the heel-when walking my foot tilts backward. Love the color but one needs more from a shoe than that.
They look just like the pictures. They felt nice but def run large. Opted to break them in at Disneyland bad idea. Ended up with multiple blisters because the were too big. Will stick to my blocks.

They are not true to size i orderd a 10 in women s like the size I wear in all shoes and they are way to big causing them to be uncomfortable when wore the one time I wore. Can t even wear with thicker sock

They fit me too big. Very little arch support, nothing wrong with that I just need more being on my feet all day. I also strangely get a blister on my right toe every time I wear them. I really wish I liked them more because they re so lightweight.
One shoe was bigger than the other one. I have no use for one tight shoe and one that fits perfectly shame on you for selling this product.
I have bought this sneaker since it was created. They are now 1 4 narrower than before. Please bring back the ones that fit!!!

The 8 would have been too small, so I just returned them. I was hoping they would be my new favorite shoes, but it just didn't work out. I have several pairs of Crocs clogs and flip slops and I love them.

They looked great but they didn't fit my foot. I have short, wide feet. I bought the 7 and it was too tight. I normally wear, when I can find, a 6.5 wide. While the cushion seemed good inside the shoe, the insert does not come out and, therefore, it wouldn't work to add an arched support. I did like the material and the sole but I had to return them.

First off... Sizing. I have several pairs of crocs footwear including open toe sandals and closed toe shoes. In other shoe brands I am typically an 8.5. But crocs, to my deep chagrin, doesn't do half sizes and I always have to try two sizes and sometimes neither size works for me. I usually go for an 8 in crocs open toe sandals. In their citilane roka I had to go with a 9 my toes were hitting the front in the 8's . In these the 8's are just about perfect and the 9's are just a touch too long. These are cool shoes. Undoubtedly. If you don't look too closely they could pass for name brand sneakers. They're comfy with that really squishy footbed. They will be my go to for casual outfits.
I thought they d gave a bit more room in toe box area. Wanted them to wear on cruise. Will still use them, just wear for short time.
These are true to size and very comfortable and have held up very well. This is a shoe I would purchase multiple of!

Great shoe... fits to size...wore them for 12 hours straight and didn't get any blisters...I normally cant wear sneakers because I get blisters behind my ankles, but these comfortable sneakers didn't give me any issues... love them
Bought these for my wife. She says they fit and fell wonderful. She walked all over Mexico in these and said her feet never hurt. She is very happy with this purchase.

Love these so much! Simple design. Got a size 7 and fits perfectly with or without socks. I got these specifically because I work at a doggie day care and I was sick of my shoes smelling like wet dog lol. Also love the little messaging feature on the soles. Very comfortable and practical !

Nice shoes. Be aware of the long shipping time - obviously from overseas. The construction is well made and the fit is perfect after reordering a bit larger shoe. I earlier ordered a half size smaller, and it was a little short, so had to return and reorder. My advice would be to order a half size larger than you usually wear.

VIDEOID be1e84543a908eb52050855561ca93ef Comfortable and breathable. They fit extremely well as expected. Great shoes for busy day running around. Shoe laces are a little long but I just tied and cut them at the end.

I fell in love with these and HAD to order them. I read through the reviews. I am a fan of normal crocs, and wanted something better to wear to work I work in an animal hospital. I wear a true 8, so luckily I didn't need a half size. I ordered the 8 also, "Pearl White" is a light grey and white trim and I love them! . They fit a bit tight, but needed to be broken in. I wore them on a day off with ankle socks- do not recommend. There is a tiny trim of fabric on the inside lining that can rub your heel. I wore them for a 10 hour shift at work with crew socks and they did better. No heel pain. So you do need to break them in a bit. I also wear thin socks yes I know it's December... and it's a tight fit to get your foot into the shoe because of the inside of the shoe itself. The foam bottom is nice and feels great- but it's more effort to get your foot into. That may just be me, though. I loosened the shoelaces so it fits more to my foot. Overall, I do recommend these. They're light, airy. I don't mind the tiny holes, as I'm on my feet ALL DAY and I like to be cooled off. I gave 4 stars just for the tight fit and the lining of fabric around the ankle that kind of rubs your heel. I'm on day three of wearing them at work, and I do love them. I'll get another pair if these prove well over the next few months. Edit I wear them everyday! It's still a tight fit when you first put them on but after a few minutes they become comfortable. I did get the pearl white and I now have some blue staining on the shoes that I can't get off I wear blue scrubs!!! So walking in the rain yay curbside wet scrubs rubs the color on the shoes. It's not a dealbreaker though, since I just wear them for work. They're still light and comfortable, and my definite go-to shoe everyday for work. I do still recommend crew socks, since the fabric trim catches and pulls socks down into your shoe lol. It could still just be me though. 9 10!

I bought these shoes for our upcoming trip to Disney. These fit the bill perfectly. I have a high arch, wide foot. I'd say these fit pretty well considering they aren't marketed to either. Arch support isn't as good as the standard clog, but I didn't have any back pain after wearing them which is a win in my book. In fact, I just bought a pair in mens for my husband.

representative_reviews.text: I really wanted to love these shoes. I think they're a practical change from typical crocs and planned on using them when I wanted to look more "put together." Here's the problem the seams on the inside of the shoe are ROUGH. Some sort of adhesive was used in addition to the stitching, and I can feel it THROUGH socks. Wearing without socks is completely out of the question because of this which would have been ideally how I'd like to wear them . I really wish the seams or inside area was lined with something to prevent this. If I could return this at this point, I would. I thought they might "break in" and the adhesive would become less rough but no luck. Causes major blisters.

Haven t even had these shoes a month and the rubber part where the laces go in broke so now it can not hold the laces. Very disappointed in the shoe. Not supportive at all and my feet hurt after walking in them for 12 hours as a nurse. Do not recommend.

Product was fine until I walked in them for awhile, then a blister appeared on my right foot, apparently it doesn't have enough "give" in the toe area.
After a week of wearing them, I go to toe my shoe and the damn shoe busts and now I can t tie my shoe. For the price I m a bit pissed off!

I am normally a huge fan of crocs. This is my first pair of sneakers. The top hole on both sides of the sneaker broke and because of the rubber material cannot be fixed or laced. It happened after I had them for 2 weeks. It s now past the time to return them. I don t know if you can make an exception and replace them. That would be great but I am really disappointed and will not buy them again

Bought these for a trip to Disney. Wore them to the park for one day and my feet had terrible blisters. Thought they would be perfect to keep my feet cool in the hot Florida sun but ruined my vacation. Would not recommend.

I hoped these shoes would be comfortable and after a week and half of breaking them in I still have pain from them in addition to the pain of being on my feet all day. The 2nd day I wore them while tightening the laces I literally ripped a lace groove off of the shoe. I was shocked to say this least as I wasn't applying much force at all. They are aesthetically pleasing but that's about it.
I have two pairs of these and LOVE them but this pair arrived used, dirty and previously worn. Sent back. Disappointing.

A complete waste of money. After a week of wear the top loops that hold the laces have completely ripped through making the shoes useless. If you don't mind spending that amount of money for a few times of wear go for it but personally very upset to spend the money on junk.

I bought these shoes to wear without socks as my job is one were not only am I standing all day long but I also get wet. These shoes seemed like the perfect way to go as they are designed with holes for breathability and fast drying. The insides however have a small portion of fabric sewn to it and the edges rub the skin horrible. This makes the shoes very painful to wear

The whole inside as well as the outside is croc rubber material so trying to slip these on with a sock is nearly impossible. It s like a sock wedgie for your toes. Then I decided not to wear socks because of all the holes that leave the whole shoe open croc style i guess and I could feel the dirt between my toes start to build and it rubbed a sore spot in top of my toe from having no sock on. Also, I thought these were black with blue but they are navy with blue. Really disappointed in them.

Because these shoes have a somewhat rubber construction they will last a lifetime! I worked a boats kayaks canoe paddleboat operation position this summer and put these shoes through absolute hell! Besides the sole slipping out every so often they are in perfect condition. The soles slide right back into the shoe and stay put pretty well. I am a monster and will tie the shoes and then use them as slip-ons and the ankle has yet to fall apart! I am so glad I made this purchase and will surely be ordering more -IF- these ones die!
Cool and comfortable I have a higher arch so it didn t give as much support as I would like . Great for running around town or walking not so much for working out .

Who knew crocs made tennis shoes!? These are great. Comfortable and nice looking. I wear them to workout and to work. My feet no longer hurt after standing for hours at my job. I was looking for a nice shoe that would not irritate my Morton s Neuroma and these did the trick. No more pain! I would buy them again and again.

I m a mechanic who is allowed to wear normal shoes and I love these. I walk 10-20 thousand steps a day at work so I think they hold up. I have narrow feet and high arches though so I still needed my high arch insoles but man...once those were in, the combination of the cloud-like bottom layer of these and my firm insoles was like walking on a dream. No pain, breathable, and I can wipe the grease and dirt off of them at the end of shift and they look new. The only thing that concerns me is that the bottom is so plush if I step on something sharp I m done for haha so not perfect but they are everything I wanted in a simple work shoe. Super cute too, I got the gray and camouflage and I get compliments all the time.

this is my second pair, my first pair lasted about 2 1 2 years, I work at an animal Hospital boarding facility so they definitely get roughed up during the day. The holes are nice for when water or liquid gets in my shoes it s able to air out easier so I m not sitting in wet socks all day. good support, the inside is more of a rubber than a cloth which is a plus for me.

I bought these shoes for a specific reason to tackle daily sandy daily trail walking in the FL woods. Regular Crocs kick up sand on the back end and provide scant resistance to evil fire ants. I have used these new shoes two days and while they don't provide the traction of a regular athletic shoe, they are cushiony and keep sand and ants out. I would have preferred a bungee or similar on top, but laces allow me to adjust the fit, looser for walking in the woods, snugger for wearing on errands. I wear them naked they would be too tight with socks. Best part I can wash them off after my walk and they're dry the next day. Regular sneakers never dry out in 99 nasty FL humidity, just mildew and smell like something died in your shoes. These were an investment, they are rubber shoes after all, so hopefully they will last a while.

I m a hairdresser one my feet several hours a day at work and then a family to take care of after these shoes have been awesome especially with me being 7months pregnant. They support my feet great and are not too tight just Incase they start to swell. The ventilation is really helpful for the Texas heat too.
VIDEOID 261b3c3c933e1ed89fca3e720426818c Very comfortable so far. Only downfall is they are mostly all rubber so your socks kind of stick to them.

I love these shoes. Be careful with the loop holes. If you pull the strings too tight they will break. I love the way they fit. They are some of the most comfortable shoes I ve owned. This is my second pair.

I work in the medical field and love these!! They re super airy VERY comfortable. Usually tennis shoes only last about 6 months but I can get almost 7-8 months with these and I m always on my feet. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
Best sneakers I have ever brought. My last pair were sketchers memory foam thought these were the best. But they don't let your feet breathe. No need to break these in, they are love at first sight.
The most comfortable shoe I ve ever worn! The support comfort are beyond expected, so I got a 2nd pair! No breaking in phase, comfy from first lace up.

I did not know what to expect when I bought these. I absolutely love them. They provide much comfort and support. I got the white pair because I can never keep shoes white for very long but with this material I can!

Perfect for paddle boarding, kayaking and lake life. Pleasantly surprised with the amount of support and the quality of this water shoe! I didn t want to buy an expensive one and was worried that the cheap ones would be a waste of money so am extremely happy with this choice.
I am an RN, and on my feet all day. I previously have worn dansko s for the last 10 years. I love these just as much as danskos. Maybe more

design.strength_summary: 구매자들은 다양한 색상과 메쉬 소재로 인해 디자인에 만족하며, 시원한 착용감을 경험하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Ok, I'm going to start off by letting you know that I typically HATE Crocs. Of course, my husband owns every color of the croc sandals and because he loves to torture me he even owns leather Crocs his "fancy" Crocs . This man has been determined to get me wearing these ugly ass Crocs for years and I REFUSE...until, these tennis shoe Crocs. Not only are these Crocs the most comfortable shoes to grace my feet but they actually look cute, fit true to size, and you would never guess that they are Crocs brand. I still will not ever be purchasing the standard sandal Crocs because they're ugly AF but these shoes make me want to purchase every single color. GET THE SHOES!

I love croc sandles, have about every color made. Some look pretty ugly, but the fit and comfort outweigh the looks. Now I can say I love croc tennis shoes! Feel right on spec. They are made of a mesh material that will let water through, but keep my feet super cool.

price.issue_summary: 많은 고객들이 가격에 비해 품질이 낮아 실망하고 있으며, 구매 후 후회하는 경우가 많습니다.

representative_reviews.text: A complete waste of money. After a week of wear the top loops that hold the laces have completely ripped through making the shoes useless. If you don't mind spending that amount of money for a few times of wear go for it but personally very upset to spend the money on junk.

product_name: Skechers Women's On-The-go 600-Brilliancy Sport Sandal

urgent_issues.summary: 많은 구매자들이 사이즈가 작거나 넓은 문제를 겪고 있으며, 이로 인해 불만족스러운 경험을 하고 있습니다.

issue_keywords: made big bump to my little fingers
toe strap pinched my little toe
comfort.issue_summary: 구매자들은 착용감이 불편하고 통증을 유발하는 문제를 반복적으로 경험하고 있습니다. 특히 물집, 지지력 부족, 그리고 발가락 압박이 주요 문제로 지적되고 있습니다.
comfort.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 매우 편안하고 좋은 지지력을 제공한다고 반복적으로 언급했습니다. 특히 장시간 착용에도 발에 부담이 없다는 점이 긍정적으로 평가되었습니다.

representative_reviews.text: This sandals are definitely not made for walking, I wore them about 1 hour while I was running errands. I developed blisters behind the strap within 40 minutes. After I came home and took them off I also had blisters on the bottom of both heels, I never had blisters there all my life. The sandals should not be called on the go, they are not what they promise. Worse shoe's I have ever purchased. Sketchers should be ashamed to sell them.
Cheap material on soles, is already coming apart after minimal wear. Disappointing and cannot return

I had been looking through many reviews on many different shoes specifically related to comfort with plantar fasciitis. Unfortunately I did not find these to have enough support or cushion to be comfortable enough to wear. The footbed looks basically flat and I was surprised the footbed wasn t just a tad squishier. I have to say, they are a nice style and looked way more attractive than I had thought they would, but unfortunately I ll be returning them as I just couldn t wear them anywhere comfortably for any length of time.
I was hoping there was an adjustment strap for the little toe area... The rest of the shoe was great!! Just too tight across the top
Uncomfortable. The junction of the straps rubs on your toes. I added mole skin to cover it up. For some reason the bottoms of my heels hurt after wearing them. They are unwearable.

I rarely buy shoes online, because my feet are hard to fit. But I already have a pair of Skechers sandals that seemed to be identical to this pair, so I felt confident that they would be as great as the pair I have. I didn't notice that the pair I have is a 400 model and the ones that were delivered today are a 600 model. They are the same stated size, but the new pair are about 1 4 of an inch longer. The worst problem is that the soles of the new sandals are very smooth, not like the first pair I bought, which actually grip the floor and sometimes squeak. I have hardwood floors in my house, and walking down the hallway was scary. These sandals slipped all over the floor. Unfortunately, they were packaged in a plastic shipping bag, which had instructions as to how to pack the shoes to return. Before I saw the instructions, I cut the bag open, so I can't use it to return the sandals. I guess I'm stuck with them, but I don't feel safe walking in them. Update I figured out how to make the bag work to send these back. Back they go. So I ordered another pair of 400's.
I just got these, yesterday and already the strap is showing wear after only six hours on my feet. Very disappointed

I bought these after seeing all the rave reviews. I have a trip to Disneyland and Universal Studios coming up soon, so I know I'll be doing a lot of walking and standing in lines. Initially they felt ok, very lightweight. I decided to wear them to work to see how they felt for a normal workday. I am on my feet a few hours a day, broken into hour long chunks with sitting at a desk in between. After just one shift the balls of my feet were already hurting. These don't really have any arch support. I'm surprised these have gotten such high praise. I do have higher arches so maybe it's just because of my particular feet.

These were EXTREMELY comfortable when i first got them. I'm a SAHM and I'm on my feet all day chasing toddlers, I originally ordered these because I wanted something comfortable that I could wear everyday while I do household chores and take care of my kiddos. After a few months I started getting unbearable foot pain and could barely walk. After some trial and error, I discovered that it was these sandals that were causing my pain. I think I must have had a mild case of flat foot and or planter facetious. So if you are already suffering from foot problems I would stay away from these shoes

VIDEOID 5985399d4f8dadcb4148ddfb03d01272 Shoes look great and are very comfortable. But very disappointed in the seller for sending some shoes that were clearly used and still have someone else s foot gunk on them and It s too close to my trip to return and buy another pair so I ll have to disinfect them myself. The shoe itself feels great though, would buy again but brand new

I took this sandal to hike , when i first got it and tried them i though they were going to be soft to walk long distance . Then at the middle of my walking they made big bump to my little fingers and stay there For like 5 days. If you going to use it to hike or walk you have to put a pad to protect your fingers .

What I liked These sandals have great support and lots of cushion for your feet. What I didn't like The velcro area is very small and doesn't allow for extra needed room for your foot. I had to add my own velcro to make the shoe fit. Had I not needed this shoe right away for a beach vacation, I'd have returned it due to the velcro not being long enough to adjust the shoe as needed.

I don't like to write reviews until I've used the product for a while, but Amazon is asking, so... I have to have very cushioned shoes. Easier in the cooler seasons, because it's not too hard to add an insole to reasonably cushioned sneakers. But much more difficult to find comfortable enough sandals. Even when it seems I've found the right soles, the straps have some issue or another. My feet don't appear to be fat or particularly wide, but the toe straps are always too tight! Which was a problem with the "Medium" size of these, so I ordered them in a Wide. Well, the toe straps are too loose. Why Skechers doesn't make the toe straps adjustable is not within my realm of understanding. And, in spite of the footbed being the right cushiness for me, the arches of my feet hurt when I wear these! I'm not sure why. Back to the drawing board, I guess, but there isn't much to choose from that fulfills all my special needs. UPDATE I think my arches hurt because the sandals weren't snug enough. I ended up securing some craft foam to the underside of the straps, which helped, but isn't perfect, and not cute if you look at it from the wrong angle. I've been wearing these ever since my original review, though, and they've mostly worked. I did walk an extra lot the other day, and got a stubborn blister on the side of one of my toes. Maybe the straps have loosened or the added foam has compressed. I don't know. Still wish Skechers would make these with ADJUSTABLE TOE STRAPS!!!

I have had this Sketcher Sandal well worn, when new even today, 3 years later, is even better than barefoot! BUT as soon as I put on this newly designed model, off it came and back in the box it went...The toe strap pinched my little toe, the sole toe front was extremely slippery and the arch is there one???? made the sandal uncomfortable. The pattern on the sole that the material it is made of is slick. The size was fine. My original pair was a size 8 and this pair was the same. I am sooo dissapointed that I can no longer walk on air and silent they were too! . If it ain't broke, don't fix it! -
I can see why the average person likes these. But if you have foot problems, you re going to want something a bit more substantial. These are fairly cheap

I needed a pair of sandals that had arch support. I wear orthotics daily. These are very comfortable. I have not done any long walks wearing them yet, but around the house they are great. I do have two concerns. The strap across the toes has a triangle connection. The triangle gouges into your toes, round would be so much better. I wish the straps across the toes was adjustable. They are so comfortable I m not returning them. But there are issues. At least for me.

I ordered the 600 version before reading the 400 s have better traction on the bottom outer sole. So I ordered the 400 s to compare. Ultimately I returned the 600 s and kept the 400 s. There s not a huge difference between the two. Both are nice. But I attached pictures. The uppers are exactly the same. I did not find any difference in strap length or material. The bottoms are very different on bottom, and the 400 s definitely seem to have better traction. Other than that the design on the instep is a little different. 400 s have a dot texture, and 600 s a stripe texture. Not sure if over time one would feel better different if you were walking with a wet foot or not.
Super comfortable sport sandal. Straps didn t rub or dig in at all! Like walking on a yoga mat. Very happy with the purchase.
Good lord these are like walking on clouds. As a teacher, these are perfect. They feel like a really comfy tennis shoe. I got the gray, now I need them in tan and black
These are so comfortable. I spent an entire day walking in these they are more comfortable than my tennis shoes. Good support great cushion. My feet hurt in almost all shoes but I love these.

I purchased these for a trip to Disney and I'm so glad I did. Since Florida weather can be unpredictable read it will rain , it was nice to have shoes I didn't have to worry about getting wet. They also held up to the 11 miles of walking each day without my feet hurting too much. Would repurchase and would recommend

I got these hoping they'd be something like Skechers Shape Ups but I guess you get what you pay for. The arch support is almost nonexistent. They're nice durable all-weather sandals, they're just not cushy. Meh.

I bought these then wore them to knotts berry farm and walked 8 plus miles in one day, and they were very comfortable to me! I ve also worn them and climbed up a very steep hill and they did just fine. I spent about 35 dollars on them and I like them so much If they were at full price 50 I d buy them again.
These are my all time go to sandals. I live in these all spring, summer and fall. They are extremely comfortable and give great heel cushion if you suffer from plantar fasciitis.

This 600 Brilliancy Skechers sandal is a VAST improvement over prior models. The sole of this model is extremely cushy feeling with every step but also very supportive. I practically live in these all during the warm months. The only slight criticism would be that the straps over the ball of the foot can stretch a tiny little bit. I believe though that due to my 14 left leg surgeries resulting in that leg being shorter than the right leg I put probably 85-90 of my weight on my right leg which probably causes the right sandal front straps to very slightly stretch more. I can't prove it but I've owned 4 pairs of these Brilliancy sandals, I get a new pair every year, and only the right foot sandal stretches' that tiny bit. This is only due to my disability NOT anything about the sandal itself. These are the BEST !!!!! I literally feel like I'm walking on a Cloud , which is so important with constant continuous severe pain.

I'm so in love with these shoes!! I've had my heart set on a pair of Chacos for years. I was finally ready to make the splurge, but I hated the way the arch felt when I finally tried in a pair. That's when I discovered Tevas, and then, lo and behold, these Skechers. Cue angels singing from above I'm a teacher, and almost 40, so I'm done with sacrificing comfort. My mission was to find a pair of shoes that would be very comfy over the summer and while standing on my feet all day in the classroom, BUT I still wanted something stylish not willing to make the leap to unattractive orthotic shoes . These definitely fit the bill of comfy and attractive. The footbed is cushioned but also supportive. The ankle strap is velcro, so it's easily adjustable. Some reviewers had issues with the toe straps not being adjustable so the triangle dug into their feet , but I didn't have that problem. If you have larger feet, I do see how that could be a problem, though. These shoes are also very light. Mission Comfy Shoes was accomplished. As for appearance, they're sporty and casual. They're not meant to be dressy, but I still think they'll go well with some casual dresses. I definitely recommend, and will probably order additional colors.
Good comfort in these. Walked around Savannah for hours in these shoes no issues. Really felt comfortable. Very happy with the purchase.
Wear these shoes ever day around my house, in the yard and on my 4-5 miles daily walk. Very comfortable and have great support.

My Mom has very painful feet and can only wear this type of shoe. This sandal provided support and helped Mom balance herself. The part that fit across the toes was very soft and didn't irritate her feet at all.

Loved these! I wanted something that was versatile for my vacation. I found these and I will be living in them every summer for now on! They're comfortable, yet stylish enough to wear with a casual dress. I hiked and walked so much in these. When I first did some walking in them, the arch was a little uncomfortable, which made me nervous. They were the only sandals I packed. But after the first day, they were perfect on my feet. So glad I took a chance on these. Sizing was right on and I got lots of compliments.

size.issue_summary: 많은 구매자들이 사이즈가 작거나 넓은 문제를 겪고 있으며, 이로 인해 불만족스러운 경험을 하고 있습니다.
size.strength_summary: 많은 구매자들이 사이즈가 정확하다고 언급하며, 편안한 착용감을 경험했습니다.

representative_reviews.text: OMG the saga I went through to find some relatively inexpensive sport sandals ... The Skechers footbed is super comfortable and the price was on point, but the design of this 600 sandal is a no-go for anyone who wears a half size which, of course, they don't offer . I have a narrow foot and wear a solid size 8 but generally go up a half size in sandals. The size 8 technically fit my foot BUT the design of the heel of the footbed includes a lip to hold your heel, which I was standing on top of - super uncomfortable. The size 9 fit my actual foot better but then the straps were so loose that my feet flopped around every time I walked. Frustrating. All went back and I apologize for the carbon footprint. The design of the 400 series of this sandal is SO MUCH BETTER no lip and better grip soles for hiking and ultimately what I went with.

It seems that no one makes shoes anymore in different widths. Almost everything is a 34 one width fits all 34 , but most don't 34 fit all 34 . On these sketcher sandals there is no adjustment in the toe straps so they can't be tightened to fit my feet. Left toe strap fit better than the right shoe. I wore these inside my house for about an hour and my arches were already aching, because the arch support is basically nothing and partially because the shoes don't fit tightly enough. Very disappointed. Note, I normally wear a 8 medium. I found the length to be true to size for me, but the width seems more like a medium-wide.
I was hoping there was an adjustment strap for the little toe area... The rest of the shoe was great!! Just too tight across the top

I have purchased the exact shoe and size year ago but these are shorter in length. I travel in the winter and left these behind but upon returning I tried them on and they are short compared to my original shoe. Is it too late to return? Same shoe as I already own but this pair is short.

The description says the straps are adjustable for a secure fit, but the length of Velcro on the adjustable strap is not long enough to fit tightly if you have small ankles. If your ankle measures smaller than 8.5 inches, these probably won't work for you.

I wear a 7 or 7.5 in all shoes. Ordered 7 as reviews stated true size. Toe hangs over front. You cannot adjust the strap around your heel. Absolutely no arch support. Reached out to seller and never heard back. Had to cancel order to get response. Only tells me I can't swap them. Have to pay for return. Stay away from this seller.

This is the 3rd pair for me and the fit is not the same as others. The ankle strap is attached too far forward so my toes push off the shoe when I walk. I wore them walking so they are worn and can t be returned. So sad!

I have these sandals in black and I was so excited to get them in another color. I was extremely disappointed because they were way too small even through I looked at the pair I had and ordered the same size. I returned them and got a full size larger and they are still too small. I am now returning the second pair and getting a refund. So sad because I absolutely love the pair I have and wanted more.

The left sandal was not sized correctly - it was significantly smaller at least 1 2 size in width than the right sandal. In fact, the left sandal was so tight that I couldn't squeeze my foot into it, but the right one was a perfect fit. I wore the black sandal in same style and size last summer and they were wonderful, but I had to return the blue sandals that I am reviewing.
I wanted to love these! They feel so good on my feet except for the little toe .....the tops are snug....I've never ever worn a "wide shoe" so I bought my regular size 8....so disappointing....
I wear a size 7 and this is much shorter than a size 7, although the label says size 7. Quality is poor as well. Skechers have really slipped!
Did not like the soles. Looked like it would be slippery in wet areas. Also was too wide and too big. Returned.
Cushy and comfortable but the straps were much to wide across the toe area and non adjustable. Returned for the 400 s. I am a 7 medium.
I haven t had this shoe that long and I don t always wear them and they already wore out in the front and the strap to tie it broke to expensive for a low quality shoe
I liked the design and color they were comfortable but tight across the ankle strap for me. I checked the skechers website they didn t have the wide 6 size in blue color of that design.

Fits true to size. Feel like these will be comfortable when I use them for summer walks and biking. I have issues with my feet like Morton's neuroma and I get bone spurs in my heel so its important for me to find shoes that will be comfortable when doing outside activities

These are probably the best sandal I've ever owned. I have developed Plantar Fasciitis in my left heel. My Dr Scholls inserts have solved the issue but I want to take care of my feet from now on. Mr Dr told me that my flip flops were most likely what caused the pain. So from now on, I'm going to wear shoes with backs and the more cushion the better. These fit the bill perfectly. I can walk the dogs and shop in perfect comfort.

I have been looking for wide width sandals and never could find any. I would have to get a size nine for the width but they didn't fit my arch as well as I wanted. These are perfect! I just wore them on vacation and my feet never hurt once. I couldn't be more pleased

I had surgery on the joint in my toe. I git these so that my left sole would be equal to the surgery shoe. He let me wear these sooner than usual because they were so sturdy. Great fit and very comfortable

Another great shoe from Skechers! I wear a size 10. I bought a size 11 since I did that with a pair of Skecher flip flops and that worked out really well and the fit is perfect! My feet sit right in the middle, with no toe or heel hangover. The Velcro strap adjusts to make a snug fit, which makes walking long distances so comfortable, even over rocky terrain, although sand and gravel can and will get in the shoes. Bye bye Bass sandals! Skechers makes a much better product!

Really too bad that almost all sandles. and shoes come one width fits all . These are quality sandles but too much room inside straps and i have only medium to slightly narrow width feet. I was in need of of few types of shoes and all came too wide. I am keeping these since i dont feel like going through search process again. I will stick insert to sole or just wear as is, very disappointing for me.
These are great sandals! Just wore them at Disney World for a week and my feet never hurt! They run true to size. I wear a size 7 and that s what I ordered. Size was perfect.

Size was as expected. Very nice design and super comfortable. Was hesitant about buying a sandal with a strap around the heel because I've never found one that does not dig in and cause blisters. So far this has not been the case with these and I've worn them quite a bit since my purchase. Having a bit of room on the velcro to adjust size around the ankle is great. Having had ankle surgery in the past and with residual nerve damage from it, I'm grateful the inner strap doesn't sit directly across the ankle and gives the sandal flexibility.

Comfort I wear these Sketcher sandals all day. They are keeping my plantar fasciitis at bay, as opposed to walking around bare footed, which is the worst thing one can do with heel pain aka plantar fasciitis!!. I also have mobility some neuropathy issues, so finding sandals that don t hamper my walking abilities has been key! I initially ordered a regular width, but found it was a tight fit, so I ordered a wide width that was perfect!
Good lord these are like walking on clouds. As a teacher, these are perfect. They feel like a really comfy tennis shoe. I got the gray, now I need them in tan and black

My normal shoe size is a 7 or 7 1 2 C D. Having read the reviews, which said these shoes run large, I originally ordered 7W. Those were a bit shorter, than most 7s, and so wide that my feet slid right out the front and toes hung over. They were cute and nicely cushioned. Unfortunately, I had worn them, so couldn't return them. Thus I gave them away and ordered an 8 M. These fit well, shorter tan most 8s, though still a little wider than necessary. They are very comfortable, so I'm quite happy with them. However, take note - they do seem to run very wide. I haven't worn a medium shoe, since I was a child. These in an M width will do for an average wide foot, the W should fit those with very wide feet, who have a hard time finding any shoe wide enough. I have other Sketchers, which also have run a little shorter and wider, than most brands, but not to the extent of these sandals.

True to size and comfortable from day one. This is a great walking sandal and the only one comfortable enough to walk 22k steps at Disney World. Thes held up better than my Ecco sandals. Would say the front is a slightly wider fit and if you have a narrow foot they may be too large. I m a medium width with a high arch, but I do not require wides
I hate this kind of shoe but I have foot pain so I gave in and wow are these comfortable. I am in and out of the stream and they stay on well.

Amazingly comfortable and plenty wide for my huge feet. I wish they came in a 9.5 because they are just a bit too long but it s not a deal breaker. I normally wear a 10w, so they run a smidge big. Worth every penny I spent.

Such a good fit and very, very, very comfortable. Wore all day long looking for my granddaughters prom dress and shoes....never bothered me, and they were new! I have osteo arthritis, that has caused a very high instep, and these are perfect. I wear a 6m, and gave my daughter a 7W and both are perfect no blisters either...

durability.issue_summary: 구매자들은 내구성이 부족한 소재와 스트랩의 빠른 마모로 실망하고 있습니다. 이러한 문제로 인해 제품의 사용 기간이 짧아지고 있습니다.
durability.strength_summary: 구매자들은 내구성이 뛰어나고 오랜 사용에도 잘 견디는 신발에 대해 긍정적인 평가를 하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: Cheap material on soles, is already coming apart after minimal wear. Disappointing and cannot return

These took a while to ship and when I finally received them they were damaged. The rubber piece on the end of the strap was hanging off and look like the stitches didn t go through the strap itself. I was very excited for these because of all of the other great reviews, but I m quite disappointed since this was obviously a manufacturing issue since the box was fine.

I'm so disappointed in these sandals. I bought them six weeks ago, and at first they were great. But a week or so in I started having to tighten the strap to prevent the sandal from being too loose, and after six weeks that strap was so stretched that I ran out of velcro and couldn't tighten the strap enough to make them stay on at all. I noticed when I practically tripped down the stairs in them. Also, the top edge is flaking off. I wish I could return these sandals, but my return window closed two weeks ago. Awful quality. I bought these because I wanted a sturdy sandal they wouldn't slip off my feet. I got exactly the opposite
I just got these, yesterday and already the strap is showing wear after only six hours on my feet. Very disappointed

I rarely buy shoes online, because my feet are hard to fit. But I already have a pair of Skechers sandals that seemed to be identical to this pair, so I felt confident that they would be as great as the pair I have. I didn't notice that the pair I have is a 400 model and the ones that were delivered today are a 600 model. They are the same stated size, but the new pair are about 1 4 of an inch longer. The worst problem is that the soles of the new sandals are very smooth, not like the first pair I bought, which actually grip the floor and sometimes squeak. I have hardwood floors in my house, and walking down the hallway was scary. These sandals slipped all over the floor. Unfortunately, they were packaged in a plastic shipping bag, which had instructions as to how to pack the shoes to return. Before I saw the instructions, I cut the bag open, so I can't use it to return the sandals. I guess I'm stuck with them, but I don't feel safe walking in them. Update I figured out how to make the bag work to send these back. Back they go. So I ordered another pair of 400's.
I was so excited to get my new sandals i had to return then the strap was to short and would not go around my ankles

I ordered three pairs, 7, 7W, and 8. I usually wear a 7.5 in Skechers. None of them fit right. The 7 was really tight. The straps felt like they were cutting into my foot on the front strap. The 7W fit better but they way overcompensated on the ankle straps. I couldn t tighten it enough. There wasn t enough Velcro. The straps on the 8 fit good, but the length of the shoe was way too long. I could see myself tripping a lot. Overall, I don t know which to keep or return. They are cushy and comfortable but none fit well enough to wear long term. The downfall of these shoes is that they aren t made in half sizes. I need a 7.5.
I haven t had this shoe that long and I don t always wear them and they already wore out in the front and the strap to tie it broke to expensive for a low quality shoe

This is for the seller This pair is my second pair of these shoes. I lost the first pair in Portugal after wearing only them for 3 weeks and walking miles every day on a European trip. The second pair doesn't really fit as well as the first pair, and now after only one month of wearing them on and off, you're saying the window of return is closed? I'm not going to buy another pair of these from you. The quality is very inferior and they are wearing so much faster than the first pair. The sole is spliting and the treads are wearing down. What a disappointment. Please let me know if you are willing to take them back. I've worn sketchers for years and never had any problems with them.

VIDEOID 5985399d4f8dadcb4148ddfb03d01272 Shoes look great and are very comfortable. But very disappointed in the seller for sending some shoes that were clearly used and still have someone else s foot gunk on them and It s too close to my trip to return and buy another pair so I ll have to disinfect them myself. The shoe itself feels great though, would buy again but brand new

Seems like they are stretching in the area that can not be adjusted. This is my 4th pair and the first issue I have had. I can fit 4 fingers between the strap and my toes. Totally unusable and I've only had them one month. Only worn a few times. I've had my others for years.

I bought these because of the reviews and because I had bought a similar pair from Skechers a few years ago that I remember loving. I was shocked to try this new pair on and have the triangular plastic piece in the straps by my toes digging painfully into my foot! I've tried to tell myself that it will get better if I wear them in a bit, but it's too painful to even begin wearing them! I tried wearing them out on a quick trip to the grocery store and had to take them off when I got back to my car because of the pain. I wish there was a way I could adjust those straps. Please be aware this could be an issue for you.

I ordered these sandals, as I have at least 6 times before. I virtually can wear these all year long, they are so comfortable. This pair did not arrive in a Skechers box, just an Amazon box. Poorly wrapped, not the usual foam support inside each shoe. The minute I put them on, I felt the difference. None of the support nor comfy soles Skechers is known for. In all ways they looked almost identical. Then I noticed the logo on the heel was misspelled ! It said GOGA MAT , whereas all my other shoes and the photo in the ad , all say GOGA MAX. This is some cheap knockoff. BEWARE !!!! I am sending them back, will reorder and see if I get REAL Skechers!

Started to wear after a couple weeks. 4 months use of a pair of shoes is ridiculous when all one is doing is walking in an urban environment. You'd get similar wear time out of sandals from the Dollar Store and they'd be a lot cheaper.

I love the style of these sandals. I ordered the appropriate size and they also felt good on my feet. However, the forefoot strap lengths were disproportionate from one sandal to the other. The first pair I received, one of the straps on the left was longer while the straps on the right fit just fine. I exchanged the sandals for another pair of the same size which I promptly received. Thinking this pair would fit properly, I was wrong. Both of the forefoot straps on the right were too long while the left sandal straps fit as they should. I considered downsizing to an 8, but didn t want to take a chance on the 3rd pair not fitting. Since there is no way to adjust the forefoot straps, my only choice is to just return the sandals.

I ordered the 600 version before reading the 400 s have better traction on the bottom outer sole. So I ordered the 400 s to compare. Ultimately I returned the 600 s and kept the 400 s. There s not a huge difference between the two. Both are nice. But I attached pictures. The uppers are exactly the same. I did not find any difference in strap length or material. The bottoms are very different on bottom, and the 400 s definitely seem to have better traction. Other than that the design on the instep is a little different. 400 s have a dot texture, and 600 s a stripe texture. Not sure if over time one would feel better different if you were walking with a wet foot or not.

I have had these navy sandals for 5 years now. They are STILL going strong after almost daily wear every summer. I LOVE them. They have faded from the sun after so many years of wear, but other than that they are still totally functional and sturdy. I tried many other brands of sandals and ended up with this one for comfort. Glad I did! Great product.

I'm so in love with these shoes!! I've had my heart set on a pair of Chacos for years. I was finally ready to make the splurge, but I hated the way the arch felt when I finally tried in a pair. That's when I discovered Tevas, and then, lo and behold, these Skechers. Cue angels singing from above I'm a teacher, and almost 40, so I'm done with sacrificing comfort. My mission was to find a pair of shoes that would be very comfy over the summer and while standing on my feet all day in the classroom, BUT I still wanted something stylish not willing to make the leap to unattractive orthotic shoes . These definitely fit the bill of comfy and attractive. The footbed is cushioned but also supportive. The ankle strap is velcro, so it's easily adjustable. Some reviewers had issues with the toe straps not being adjustable so the triangle dug into their feet , but I didn't have that problem. If you have larger feet, I do see how that could be a problem, though. These shoes are also very light. Mission Comfy Shoes was accomplished. As for appearance, they're sporty and casual. They're not meant to be dressy, but I still think they'll go well with some casual dresses. I definitely recommend, and will probably order additional colors.

I purchased these for a trip to Disney and I'm so glad I did. Since Florida weather can be unpredictable read it will rain , it was nice to have shoes I didn't have to worry about getting wet. They also held up to the 11 miles of walking each day without my feet hurting too much. Would repurchase and would recommend

Very pleased. I have been wearing them for several days, and they don't rub my bunions. They have well-cushioned soles yet lightweight, and I am very glad to have found them. They arrived promptly and in good condition.
I'm 65 and my knees are shot. I have been looking for a pair of comfy sandals for a while. These don't have the sole thickness cush bounce as a good quality sneaker, but they do the job.

I wore these the day they arrived, and have worn them every day since. I walk several miles on city sidewalks daily, and these shoes are holding up beautifully. They are sturdy, well made, attractive and comfortable. These are my first pair of Skechers but they certainly will not be my last.

These are my quarantine shoes. As my quarantine ascends past day 100, I have given up the oppression of formal shoes. I needed a pair I can put on quickly and head into my yard which is filled with rocks. To my delighted surprise when they arrived, they proclaim that they're machine washable, even better! They go on and off quickly with their velcro connections. The support is excellent, and honestly these are as comfortable as my sneakers. They're in no way weird looking. These are my perfect summer shoes, and exactly the comfortable pair I wanted during my free-for-all fashion of the COVID-19 quarantine.
Good lord these are like walking on clouds. As a teacher, these are perfect. They feel like a really comfy tennis shoe. I got the gray, now I need them in tan and black

I had surgery on the joint in my toe. I git these so that my left sole would be equal to the surgery shoe. He let me wear these sooner than usual because they were so sturdy. Great fit and very comfortable

I'm normally a flip flop person but I broke my foot during the winter and am still trying to wear supportive shoes. Although these are not as supportive as gym shoes, they have a thick sole and a strap to keep my ankle from moving too much. They're light and cool, but give me a little more support than other sandals, which I definitely need!

I have worn this particular shoe for the last four years and it has worn extremely well. When I went to replace it the shoe store no longer carried it but checked on Amazon and said it was there. After having surgery I needed a shoe that wouldn t slip or fall off and this one is perfect. Also, I wear this shoe about 8 months of each year so it is a great price for a shoe that lasts so long. It s very comfortable too! I was worried about replacing it in the future so I purchased 2 pairs so I should be good for several years now!

I am now have 2 pairs as I liked the first one so much and a good friend has bought 3 pairs on my advice...you will love them too if you have sensitive feet and find it hard to find a comfortable and stylish sandal...rubber soles so you can rinse them off and no problem if they get wet!!
My last sketchers fit sandals lasted almost a decade. These are comfortable for walking and hiking long distances, exactly what I wanted.
Love these shoes! Bought them for my trip to universal studios last year and they were perfect! Held up through multiple days of being on my feet, and were comfortable. May order a 2nd pair!

I bought the same exact size, but the new ones are so much smaller than my old ones. There shouldn t be such a big inconsistency in manufacturing. I may try the next size up and see how it goes.

I have a black pair of the same shoe and wanted to order a pair in another color. The shoe is styled the same but very different to walk in primarily due to the quality of the sole of the shoe. My black pair are super comfortable and fit beautifully out of the box. Though they look the same the sole is flat and made from a different material. I returned them.

I previously ordered these sandals in gray. They are wonderful. I ordered another pair in navy. They suck. Same style, same size, except that I can hardly get the right shoe on. It is significantly narrower than the left shoe. This is the second time I have ordered identical Skecher shoes only to find out that the second pair is a totally different fit than the first pair. The only difference in the two orders was the color. This is a sad statement on the quality control exercised over the manufacture of the shoes. As much as I love the comfort of the shoes when they fit, I don't want to have to keep sending the shoes back that don't fit when I have ordered the exact same shoe except different color. Buyer beware. You may not get what you ask for.
I liked the design and color they were comfortable but tight across the ankle strap for me. I checked the skechers website they didn t have the wide 6 size in blue color of that design.

I returned them and got a full size larger and they are still too small. I am now returning the second pair and getting a refund. So sad because I absolutely love the pair I have and wanted more.
Good lord these are like walking on clouds. As a teacher, these are perfect. They feel like a really comfy tennis shoe. I got the gray, now I need them in tan and black

Bought a pair of these last year in beige. Love them so much, I'm back this year for a navy blue pair. So comfortable, you barely know you are waring them.

Fantastic sandals, very light and I walked on it for quite a while without hurting my feet. This was Vegas walking. I bought 8 W and it fitted perfectly. Of course I has another pair in my cart,but when I got back from Vegas, price had gone from 28 to 60. So not buying second pair.

I bought a natural color pair this time after wearing a dark gray on one foot and a navy on the other for several days! I thought I had the right pair.... These are Skechers comfy I can take walks in them and they are comfortable to wear all day. Good support, like the sneakers but in a sandal!

I love this shoe, but I'm disappointed in what I received. I had purchased this shoe before at a department store. I purchased two pairs, one blue pair and one beige pair. I had wanted a black pair but they didn't have one in my size so I was very happy to see the same shoe in black on Amazon. I purchased a black pair . . . However, I was disappointed when I received it because IT WAS BLUE!!!!! I decided to keep it because I used to use Kohl's for returns but during the pandemic, they're closed. I'm 79 years old and I'm in the "at risk" group, so I'm hesitant to go out shopping to find a black one. I'm so disappointed and I'm reluctant to try to purchase a "black" pair again online. It saddens me because there are few shoes that I can wear comfortably and this is one of them. I really love the shoe! . . . and I love shopping through Amazon!

Both comfortable and fashionable. I've walked for hours in these already and they feel great. I have wide and fat feet, and the only complaint I have is that I have to pull them a bit tight in order for them to latch to the velcro. Even as such, I hardly notice it and they are still very comfortable to walk in and wear for an extended period.

Love the fit. Love the feel. Love the comfort. My cousin recommended them and i love them. They are so "cushy" and comfy. I hope they last a long time. They are replacing my Adidas Super Cool flip flops, which they are not making any more. They are just as comfy. Comfort is everything. plus a little style!
These sandals are lightweight and very comfortable as other reviews have mentioned. I m very happy with the navy color as well.

I sadly only got to wear maybe 3 or four times, I am a healthcare worker and when I went back to work after four covid quarantines the rubber has been disconnecting slowly from sole of shoe. Comfortable, easy to slip on but I got a bad pair I guess and the seller won t help with an exchange. Hopefully others have better luck.

These shoes sounded like they would be super comfy, but they were soooooo uncomfortable! Length was ok, but very narrow thru the toe box. My feet ached terribly, no difference with the extra cushioning.

I started a new job standing and walking around on concrete all day, could barely walk at the end of the day my feet hurt so bad, so dissatisfied with these, after only one day I have to get some foam inserts.

I had very high expectations for this one but unfortunately they do not offer support for more than 3 hours on your feet. I worked a 12 hour shift was in pain a 4 hour shift was tolerable, last hour not so good. Probably good for someone who just wants a comfortable, cushioned sneaker for causal wear.

Just not for me. The feel was soft, but too low and made my heel feel like it was straining or splinting or something undesired. The top part felt like a shoe sock best way I can describe it . Returning these shoes.

My husband and I each bought these. Great comfort, BUT, about 3 weeks of wearing them we both began to experience sever leg pain resulting from the posture change in our legs caused by the angle the shoes force you to maintain. We have each STOPPED wearing them and our leg pain has reduced and getting better daily.
These shoes are awkward no ankle support and bulky and dont provide any type of relief for my plantar fasciitis.
Even after I put a extra insole on top of the one that was already in the shoe the shoe still was too long and slipped off my foot

These are more cushioned than regular shoes but if you have heel pain they're not what you want. I developed plantar fascitis and went to a podiatrist. She told me that the part of your shoe that fits the ball of your foot should not bend easily for good support. These bend very easily. I purchased Hoka and New Balance shoes that are much tougher to bend offer better support. Now my heel is not in pain every day. I also wear orthotics in my shoes which helps. So these Sketchers may be soft but spend a little more for a shoe that's actually good for your feet.

These shoes are exceptionally supportive and comfortable. However, after only 3 months of wearing them for 30 minutes a day, a piece of plastic is poking out and gauging my heal. Very disappointing for the price. Is there a warranty?
I tried to see if I could wear them a whole day before I tried to wear them to work. I could not they hurt my to feet much.

I've been trying to find shoes like hokas that are less expensive. These are "okay" but after wearing them for about a week for walks my feet are starting to hurt and the soles are shot. I feel like I wasted my money on these. I have extremely sensitive feet so I need a lot of cushion. I also have broken my left foot and have permanent nerve damage. Therefore, unfortunately, the quest for cheap cloud like shoes continues...
Supper comfortable. Wore these on 12 hr shifts for 4 days straight. They held up great. My feet were completely comfortable, and no back pain. Definitely recommend.

I ordered these shoes to hopefully help with plantar fasciitis. These are wonderful shoes. My heel pain has lessened and the shoes are very comfortable. They have a slight arch which also helps relieve the pressure in the heel. I am not disappointed in my purchase.
I wanted to find a comfortable shoe and this fits the bill! My feet hurt when I am on them for awhile. These shoes are like walking on a cloud! You won't be disappointed.

I was going to return these. Lots of cushioning but not alot of support. I've now changed my mind and ended up loving these. Just took some time to break in. Plus I added a very thin insert for arch support and made big difference. Will probably buy another pair!

Soft cushioning cloudy hugs on my feet is how I will describe these. I actually wore them for the first time when I hit the gym in the morning and I wasn't sure I even wanted to work out any more. They made me feel so relaxed that I felt like I had slippers on. Once I started my work out and got into my routine, I was fine. But just be aware that your feet are in a nice relaxed position. Imagine if you had a pair of toe spreaders on. That's how your feet feel. So, just wanted to give a heads up so people aren't expecting super strong support. I mean don't get me wrong, these are made structurally great. No complaints. But I wouldn't go hiking in them. These are 100 comfort.

Extremely comfortable and extra support for my feet. I especially got to try it on beforehand since I work at Skechers. I decided to purchase the GoRun Max Cushioning shoes after trying it on. The regular fit was too tight and didn't work out for me. Luckily, I got to try on the wide fit and it was perfect! Will be wearing it starting tomorrow due to having a long shift.

Comfortable while seated, but if you need arch support, there is none. So i can't walk far in these. Also, the insole cushions can't be removed, so you can't put your orthotics under them. Shoes are not supportive, just "cushy."

I stand and walk ALL DAY for work healthcare field , up to 12 hrs at a time. Like literally, there s not a single chair at work. These shoes have been an absolute life saver. The soles are super responsive so I feel like my knees must be happier, and the cushion so far has been great I ve only had a week, so I m hoping it stays this way . edit a month in, and the cushion is holding up very well so far! Support is generally pretty good, but I don t particularly need extra support to prevent rolling or anything like that so use your judgement there. I m an 8.5 in my previous Adidas the cloud foams, don t be tempted - cloud foam turns into concrete after a month and bought these in an 8.5 which is a great fit whether I m wearing normal or wool socks so I m very happy all around!

These affordable shoes have the soft cushioned comfort I need while giving me the support for my arch and foot so that I can walk or exercise without pain in my old age. Who needs those expensive shoe solutions with affordable high quality products like this available to all of us?

bought these on a friends recommendation - she loves hers and thought I would too. I have such trouble with foot pain if I need to do alot of walking - and these have been a lifesaver! So comfortable .... for hours on end....and my slim arch supports fit in if I need them. Highly recommended!

I wasn't sure I'd like this product b c of it's thickness of the sole. I have heal spurs as well as plantar fasciitis and most shoes don't offer arch support AND heal cushion but these Skechers do. The 10W fits perfect and I'm very happy with this shoe. The thick sole took a little bit to adjust to, but the comfort out weighs the bulky look.
This sneaker has max cushioning and are a great choice for professions where you are on your feet all day. Highly recommend.
Shoes are comfortable for wide feet however there's no arch support. The padding is soft and due to not having the arch support not using them for work just doing mini workouts with them
I have a slipped disc, so I need a good shoe. The Max Cushioning is perfect. My flat feet do not hurt at the end of the day.
Basic walking in good weather. I have trouble with my feet and these are very comfortable. Ordered my second pair because they are so great for my back and knee replacement. Support is wonderful.

I wanted to find a comfortable shoe and this fits the bill! My feet hurt when I am on them for awhile. These shoes are like walking on a cloud! You won't be disappointed.
