I will order again. Possibly go up a 1 2 size as the toe box isn't as roomy as some other athletic shoes.

I ordered these shoes to hopefully help with plantar fasciitis. These are wonderful shoes. My heel pain has lessened and the shoes are very comfortable. They have a slight arch which also helps relieve the pressure in the heel. I am not disappointed in my purchase.
Length was just right. Wide width was a tad more narrow than other shoes I have purchased. Cushioning is really good. Very bouncy in the heel area.

I wish the toe box was more rounded to allow more toe room and movement. Most athletic shoes have the tapered narrow toe box and it cause a corn to form on my little toe. Otherwise it s a very comfortable shoe.
Supper comfortable. Wore these on 12 hr shifts for 4 days straight. They held up great. My feet were completely comfortable, and no back pain. Definitely recommend.
Incredibly comfortable! I ordered a 7.5 normal sneaker size but in a wide to allow for extra room in the toe box, fits great!
Recently broke my ankle and was looking for extra support for my foot. These worked out very well for me. Sizing is perfect fit. Buy your regular size. Very comfortable and super light weight.

Great shoe, but I should have ordered wide width. The shoe is offered in wide width and I should have gotten it instead because it kinda digs the side of my foot. Other then that great shoe! I am a nurses assistant and on my feet ALL shift and my feet feel fine at the end of my shift.

I bought this shoe before a month long trip to Greece, I really wanted an all white shoe to wear with dresses and shorts but did not want to spend 180 on the Hokas. This shoe was super comfortable, enough support and cushion to get you through a full day of walking on cobble stones, ruins and other uneven surfaces. Fit was true to size.
Fit as expected Shoes fit like a glove. Very comfortable. I like that the shoes have extra cushioning which gives some height. It was exactly what I was looking for.

These shoes are so comfy for walks 5 Miles. Had metatarsal issues and these have plenty of room in the toe box and are very cushioned. Previously had Brooks shoes, which are great but the toe box isn t as wide as these sketchers. Very happy with this purchase.
I love this shoe!!! It s kinda short as they sent me a size 10 instead of the size 11 I had originally ordered. I was not going to go through the hassle of having to send them back!!!
I am SO GLAD I listened to the previous reviewers and went from my usual size 8 to 8.5.. they run small. They are also quite narrow, fine for my feet.

representative_reviews.text: These shoes lasted less than 3 months before the plastic in the back of the shoe broke in half, tore through the fabric and started cutting into the back of my heel on both shoes. I ended up having to take snippers to cut the plastic out.

These shoes are exceptionally supportive and comfortable. However, after only 3 months of wearing them for 30 minutes a day, a piece of plastic is poking out and gauging my heal. Very disappointing for the price. Is there a warranty?
Lack of support and bottom of feet hurt SKECHERS S SPORT MUCH BETTER AND YOU STOPPED MAKING THEM?????? THE SHOES THAT YOU ASK ABOUT ARE NOT USEABLE. I AM DISAPPOINTED

I'm super disappointed. These felt amazing for 4 weeks. Just after the window to return closes, my feet are killing me. I purchased two pairs, I alternate wearing them. And they both make my feet ache. Won't be purchasing them again
I've always loved skechers for work shoes but these ones just didn't work, I wore them 3 times on different days and my heels hurt pretty bad.
Even after I put a extra insole on top of the one that was already in the shoe the shoe still was too long and slipped off my foot

Loved theses shoes! I sadly only got to wear maybe 3 or four times, I am a healthcare worker and when I went back to work after four covid quarantines the rubber has been disconnecting slowly from sole of shoe. Comfortable, easy to slip on but I got a bad pair I guess and the seller won t help with an exchange. Hopefully others have better luck.

I have like this Skecher's Max Cushion shoe since it was first offered. This one, not as much. NOW, wide is no longer as wide as it was formerly AND the back has been made so much higher that it can dig into your Achilles tendon. What would it take for Skecher's to return to the original design.

I normally love skechers , but these shoes only lasted a month before the reinforced toe started to come loose. I was not real happy with the workmanship of these shoes. The cushioning was not that soft either

Purchase was mid January, they are already worn our. Sole is worn thin, inside foam around the heel is all the way thru-has collapsed. I am an average size person 5'7 170 lbs. Shoes were not worn daily, rotated with other Skechers thru out the work week. Very disappointed with these and they were the most expensive. So sorry to say, this was not a quality shoe at all. I have several pairs of Asics that have literally lasted years, going back to them for a serious shoe. Skechers will be only for casual shoes now.

I started a new job standing and walking around on concrete all day, could barely walk at the end of the day my feet hurt so bad, so dissatisfied with these, after only one day I have to get some foam inserts.
Don't like it at all doesn't fit right. It almost feels like somebody else has worn them and they're brand new. And I already starting to break down only had him 2 weeks
Supper comfortable. Wore these on 12 hr shifts for 4 days straight. They held up great. My feet were completely comfortable, and no back pain. Definitely recommend.
The shoe has plenty of support and looks great. Now Sketchers let's see you give us a nice plain white or blue in this shoe. Enough of the outlandish colors. Says grandma .

I ordered these shoes to hopefully help with plantar fasciitis. These are wonderful shoes. My heel pain has lessened and the shoes are very comfortable. They have a slight arch which also helps relieve the pressure in the heel. I am not disappointed in my purchase.

These Sketchers are the best I have had, they aren't my first pair... . These have been 100 more comfortable from the fit to sheer energy... . The fit is wonderful... . All parts of these Skechers can't be beat... .I truly have a sheer feeling of comfort. Plus I am 84 years old... . Garnette
So far so good. Hope they do not break down in six months. Very comfortable now. Teeny bit big but I like thicker socks anyway. Also great color with blue jeans!

Got these for running longer distances. Needed the extra cushion. First run out was 8 miles and they were AWESOME. No break in required. Very supportive. Fit is exactly as expected. Extra cushion is awesome. As good as some of the super expensive brands that have max cushioning, that cost more than twice as much. If you were thinking of giving them a shot...you should. Can't go wrong for the price.

This shoe is very comfortable but I am worried about how long the sole will last. I have only walked about 30 miles and already the sole is wearing rather significantly. The sole is very thick but this shouldn't be happening so soon.
I stand for long periods of time on cement floors. I was having problems and after I purchased these shoes quickly became the solution. 100 love. Sketches are my go to shoe now!

Cut shoe and super comfy. I wish Sketchers wasn't placing them out of stock. The problem is the soles wear out fast and although the shoes still look good, they act like sponges in the rain. But if you only need them to last 6 months to a year in sun rain conditions, they are fine. I scour the web for these since they are so comfy and have bought 4 pairs.
they fir great! I use to wear shape-ups but decided to change to these and I love that they have a BLACK sole!!! fit great and very cushy
I wanted to find a comfortable shoe and this fits the bill! My feet hurt when I am on them for awhile. These shoes are like walking on a cloud! You won't be disappointed.

Needed more support. I added my Men s Industrial standard ultra work, air-plus insoles. The insoles added to comfort as well. They are so close to Skechers shape-ups now!!! Sketchers shape ups were the best walking working shoes I ve ever worn!!! I m on my feet 12 hours a day and my feet and legs do not get tired as long as I m wearing sketchers shape-ups or the shoes that I have added my men s special insoles to!!! I buy at least a half size or whole size bigger when I add my insoles. I m so thankful you re coming back out with the extra thick cushion soles!!!

I stand and walk ALL DAY for work healthcare field , up to 12 hrs at a time. Like literally, there s not a single chair at work. These shoes have been an absolute life saver. The soles are super responsive so I feel like my knees must be happier, and the cushion so far has been great I ve only had a week, so I m hoping it stays this way . edit a month in, and the cushion is holding up very well so far! Support is generally pretty good, but I don t particularly need extra support to prevent rolling or anything like that so use your judgement there. I m an 8.5 in my previous Adidas the cloud foams, don t be tempted - cloud foam turns into concrete after a month and bought these in an 8.5 which is a great fit whether I m wearing normal or wool socks so I m very happy all around!
Had them a year, wear them daily for walking. Still going strong. Just now starting to get some breakdown in the inside heel.

Unbelievable how much nicer these are to wear than all my other shoes. After trying them on, I went back to my other shoes, which I thought were great tennis shoes, and decided to donate them as they are still new that's how often I wear closed, full coverage tennis shoes . I immediately bought a pair for my sister and we're both extremely happy with these shoes. The color is also our favorite as it's nice and subtle neutral. My heels had begun to hurt so that set me on a journey of finding all new shoes. This Max Cushion sole alleviates the pain and will prevent further damage while allowing my fascia to heal.

representative_reviews.text: I love this brand they are always great support. However the bands across your feet are like rubber bands and dig into your feet! I have awful blisters on back of both my feet! I would stay away from this style for comfort sake!!!
These shoes hurt my arch. It felt like their was hard plastic digging into my arch every time I walked. Not sure if it was the design of the shoe or just my arch was different.
Super disappointed I thought these would be comfy I have super wide bony feet and these rubbed so hard

Out of all the straps on this, the only one without any stretch at all is the heel. Any amount of walking would give me an instant blister. This is a terrible design flaw. It's a shame because the other straps are very soft and stretchy. Also, the memory foam on these isn't as thick and comfy as previous Skechers I've had. They went straight back.
The shoes are cute but the back strap after trying on for a few minutes is already causing a blister feeling on my heels. Such a shame because they're cute. I'll be returning them.

I love sketchers but this one was disappointing. The heal strap is quite rough resulting in blistering. I have another color that doesn t have this problem. Since I wore them, I can t return them so I m going to see if I can attach some soft material to cut down on the rubbing. Otherwise very comfortable and good arch support.

I really wish these were more narrow. So the padding of the shoe is soft, and I could have easily seen myself walking miles in them. The straps seemed soft too, not the sort that would painfully rub against your feet. The problem is, they are quite wide. So if you have narrow feet, this isn t the sandal for you. But if you have wider feet, I recommend grabbing these because I do think they d be quite comfortable for those with wider feet. Sadly I ll be returning these, but they are great quality for the right foot.

I wanted to love these. The sandals are super cute, sized well so your whole foot fits, and the footbed is incredibly comfortable. The straps around the top of the foot keep everything in place and prevent your foot from slipping around. I love the neutral color, and Skechers are a brand favorite of mine. The reason I m returning them is the design for the heel strap. The soft fabric inner lining is cut too closely on the seam line, so that rough edge rubs right against your heel. It s tolerable when you stand still, but it s going to cause a blister once you walk for a little while. No amount of break-in time will make this better. If you already have good calluses on your heels from daily, extensive walking in sandals heels flats, give them a go. Otherwise, skip this pair and go for something else.
It has an arch support that actually made walking hurt. It has a cushy feel but I couldnt get used to the arch, too intense even though you have to get used to the support. Sorry not for me.

Update, its been almost 20 days since I sent the sandals back and to get a refund, nothing yest and its impossible to get help to see why i haven't gotten my refund, really disappointed I really like the brand, but this sandals fit weird, and the hassle to return and get the refund its to long, I'll rather go to the store and buy them there to check the fit

I first thought my feet were just swollen at the end of the day, causing one shoe to feel tight. I tried them on again the next day and realized the right was still too tight. I compared the two and there was a visible difference in size!! Soooo frustrating! I bought these for a vacation to Key West. I had to rush down to the local store and find shoes the night before we left for Florida. Unfortunately, I didn t get the mismatched pair returned in time so I m stuck with h a 50 pair of shoes no one can wear!!! Sucks!
Loved these shoes, very comfortable Bought a new pair and one shoe broke with a week and was unwearable, had to return Poor quality for price

Please make half sizes. The 7 is too short my long 2nd toe hangs over the front edge , and the 8 is too big. With this style, the straps don't fit the shape of my foot. One of the X straps is too long and pops up rather than hugging my foot. The cushioning is great. It could use a bit more arch support.

I bought a 9, because reviews said they fit like running shoes and thats my regular size but they were a little too smal for me. Also the back strap was uncomfortable , and gave me a blister right away

It's too bad that Sketches can't seem to get their elasticity right when using "stretch" anything across the top of the foot. This particular pair and others like this that I have bought and have been unable to wear in the past do not allow the elastic straps to "give" as you walk. I am a classic size 9, and have very little problems with this size in all brands. I wanted to try one more pair. However, Sketches needs to stick with the "stick-on" straps or "slide-ins" because the "in place" ones are too cutting and painful to wear. Too tight ! My feet are normal and not prone to water retention, so no excuses for Sketches. So, cannot recommend these sandals.
I really like these sandals. They are very comfortable and have a an arch in them. I have plantar fasciatis and these are great for walking with no pain.

So yeah, my feet are HUGENORMOUS! I pulled these shoes out of the box and after one peek I just knew they would get sent back... but, I figure what the heck, might as well prove that I have the biggest fattest feet on the planet and slip my hunk-a-chunks into these GLORIOUS SHOES and ZOMG THEY FIT?!?!?!? REALLY REALLY REALLY FIT, and not in a "I crammed them on because the shoe is super cute and I will suffer with the pain" kind of fit, REAL FIT... they are so comfortable and cute and I AM IN LOVE WITH THIS SHOE Thank you Skechers! Stretchy even across the instep AND the toebox.... PERFECT!

This sandal is pretty darn comfy. The memory foam is nice. The straps make your feel feel hot sometimes. The heel strap is where most of my discomfort comes. Debated cutting it off when I first wore these.

These are excellent. Comfort is what I wanted and these don't dissapoint. I went up a half size to compensate for wide feet and they fit perfectly. I also love the cute style and plan to purchase the other colors.

I bought these last minute for a trip to Italy. They were comfortable out of the box, thank goodness, as I didn t have time to break them in before walking around all day in them. They are light weight and have arch support.

I'm 68 years old and can't wear heels at all anymore. I wanted a sandal for a dress or maxi dress or pretty capris in the summer. These shoes have satin stretch straps. They are very attractive on the foot. I feel confident going to any event in these, even dress nights on cruises, weddings, church, etc. With a pretty polish on the toes...heck you can rock these for anything.

The footbed is very cushiony, however there is no arch support. I had gh hopes for this shoe, it's so hard to find cute AND comfortable shoes when you have bunions.

I was having arch support issues, but I have a heat disorder so I can't wear shoes much, hence looking for some supportive sandals that look nice and aren't crazy expensive . I have been wearing these daily since I got them, even on long walks running around like at amusement parks, and they're still in good condition and definitely let me stay on my feet longer.

Passed the test. In this hot climate feet tend to swell but the soft elastic didn t bind or leave any marks on my skin. It didn t stretch out or lose its shape. Good support for long walks. Sturdy but light weight, perfect to pack in a suitcase.
Super comfortable!! Love the support. I can easily wear them all day and my feet don't get sore like other sandals have done.

As soon as I received my shoes, I put them on and wore them most of the day. I immediately felt relief for the arch support these shoes gave me. I was having a lot of pain in my hips and, as soon as I put these on, the pain was relieved!

I love the look of this shoe. It's strappy and feminine but still supportive. And the straps are soft and don't bind. The arch of the shoe is a little "off" for me... and little bit closer to the heel than my actual arch is, but they are still comfortable to walk around in. Might need to order the sketcher adjustable strap hiker for a shoe that will take me through the whole day.
I have bad knees and need cushioned shoes to walk in comfort. These sandals have great support and cush.

These sandals are supportive and comfortable! Good arch support! I have bunions and the straps do not pinch or put pressure! Feels like your walking on a cloud. I have worn these all day and honestly feels more comfortable than bedroom slippers! I highly recommend!!

Very comfy. They are true to size. They are memory foam so they kinda form to your arch. Lookin way classier than a flip flop. Can endure hiking and solid outdoor work just watch ya toes lol. 10 outta 10. Exactly what I was looking for. Will buy more.

The bands that surround your feet, stretch to snugly fit your foot. Very comfortable and run true to size.
Couldn t be happier with how these fit right out of the box. I have very wide feet that swell. Finding comfortable, cute shoes that fit seems highly unlikely. I am very happy with these so far.

After reading other reviews stating their shoe was too big, I went down a half size from my usual 6 1 2 med. The sandal arrived and when I tried them on, I am thrilled to take the time to write my review. I have had two bunion procedures on my left big toe with 3 screws and a plate down the outside. My second toe was shortened 1 4". I have not been able to wear any shoe other than Sketchers Go Walk. The pain of any shoe pressing against a screw was unbearable. Ordering this sandal was a chance taken. The elastic is soft to the skin yet sturdy it's actually cushioning to the screws. The footbed is not a ''sink down" soft, but a firm soft. Here are some facts My feet measure 9" from heel to toe. I ordered a size 6 sandal which measures 9 1 2 ". There is a 1 2" footbed showing to make a nice appearance without my toe hanging off the end. My personal advice is not to go up a half size, but down. I do hope this helps others to make a decision about sizing. Thanks, Sketchers, for creating this lovely sandal. I want another color!
These are really comfy and true to size. I wear a 9 so ordered that and they fit great. I was worried the ankle part would rub too much but so far so good! Would order again.
My pinky toe wants to escape out from below the strap. Wish the strap sat a bit lower so that wasn't an issue. I still love them and they are comfy.

Shoes are difficult to fit every foot. For my foot, the back strap moved around too much and I assumed a blister would form. Had to return them. But that's just my foot. Otherwise, it's a real cute sandal, and had a comfortable sole --really wish it would have worked out.

These sandals are extremely comfortable and are true to size. Top is elastic but they are not tight and don t squeeze your foot. But they have enough give in them to make these sandals a good choice for summer walks.
I like Clark's shoes. This looked cute but they were a 1 2 size small and the straps near the toes would cut in if you happen to have feet that swell during the day. I returned them.

Bought these for my mother in law who has foot problems and they worked out nicely because of the stretch straps. She says they are comfortable and do not smash her little toes. Looks to me like these sandals run a little narrow as she has narrow feet and they fit her perfectly

So cute!! Crazy comfortable. They go with everything, and there are absolutely no weird sandal issues i.e. straps to tight or loose, embarrassing suction noises when walking, sandal sliding around, straps rubbing, etc!! Yay! I'm a 9.5 in Skechers sneakers, and I ordered a 9 in these sandals - they fit fine!!

Sloppy sandals. No support, instantly irritating the back of my ankle just trying them on, the sole has a weird bump for someone with a arch like Cinderella s sisters, 55 or 5 I would never buy these again. It takes a second to take my money but over 30 days to refund ??
the strap on the rear of one of the sandals was too large and caused the item not to fit. Product was returned

I am a big sketchers fan!!!! Almost all my shoes are sketchers. If you re like me and believe there should NOT be a break in period for shoes, don t buy these!!! The back strap is leather so it rubs against your heel within 10 minutes. I don t know why they just didn t make it stretch material like the rest of the shoe?? Would have been fine! As a big sketchers fan . Don t buy these !

Out of all the straps on this, the only one without any stretch at all is the heel. Any amount of walking would give me an instant blister. This is a terrible design flaw. It's a shame because the other straps are very soft and stretchy. Also, the memory foam on these isn't as thick and comfy as previous Skechers I've had. They went straight back.
The shoes are cute but the back strap after trying on for a few minutes is already causing a blister feeling on my heels. Such a shame because they're cute. I'll be returning them.

I started wearing these in August purchased in July but didn't actually wear them until August . and loved them, I recommended them to people, they were the perfect shoe to walk to work at a barre studio and come home. so comfortable and great. Until today, when I was walking and the shoe suddenly became so loose. I looked down and realized they had broken. After 1 month. I am very disappointed and no longer recommend them.

It's too bad that Sketches can't seem to get their elasticity right when using "stretch" anything across the top of the foot. This particular pair and others like this that I have bought and have been unable to wear in the past do not allow the elastic straps to "give" as you walk. I am a classic size 9, and have very little problems with this size in all brands. I wanted to try one more pair. However, Sketches needs to stick with the "stick-on" straps or "slide-ins" because the "in place" ones are too cutting and painful to wear. Too tight ! My feet are normal and not prone to water retention, so no excuses for Sketches. So, cannot recommend these sandals.
These sandals are so cute and comfortable, but the straps are so itchy every time I put them on that they re kinda miserable to wear. I wore them out, so I can t return them now.

The heel strap is made of really hard leather that doesn t expand at all and it so uncomfortable. It s so stupid of a sandal because the rest of the straps are all elastic and comfortable I don t have a clue why they didn t use those soft straps for the back of the heel.

I have had a few pairs of Sketchers sandals and this is the first one I don t like. The way the back strap is sewn, it rubs my ankle roughly causing it to bleed. They have great cushion but they just hurt too much on the back to keep wearing.

Skechers are usually great and really comfortable but these sandals are an exception. The ankle strap was extremely sharp-edged and felt like razor blades! There was no way I could wear them so had to return them. Very disappointed.

I ordered these sandals in a size 7 usually I wear a 6.5 and have narrow feet, but reading through the reviews made me think they would fit okay, maybe a little loose. When they arrived, I put them on and was amazed by how wonderfully comfortable, soft, cushy they were. Felt great! Except - they were just too big. There was no way I could make them work, especially around the ankle area as there's no way to tighten or adjust the ankle strap. So, I had to return them. The seller took two days to get back to my return request. When they did, I found out they don't pay for return shipping. I had to take them to UPS to ship them back and UPS charged me 27 for postage. I paid 37 for the sandals. I should have just kept them and donated them to Good Will. That's what I get for buying sandals online from an unknown seller.

It's really cute, looked great on my feet and fit nicely BUT the back strap rubs on the side of my achilles tendon. I got a hot spot after walking around the house in them for 15 minutes. I think the cause of it is that the strap is not adjustable. They tend to shift and rub. I tried both the size 5 and the 5 wide. I'm so sad and disappointed-they're really cute!

I love these sandals! I'm actually on my second pair - the first pair lasted about 1 1 2 yrs. Living in Florida, I'm always in sandals and I need comfort as well as support. These hold up pretty well for Skechers, but I always get the light beige color which probably gets dirty faster than other colors. The straps are comfy because they are elastic and the insole is a soft suede over memory foam.

I'm 68 years old and can't wear heels at all anymore. I wanted a sandal for a dress or maxi dress or pretty capris in the summer. These shoes have satin stretch straps. They are very attractive on the foot. I feel confident going to any event in these, even dress nights on cruises, weddings, church, etc. With a pretty polish on the toes...heck you can rock these for anything.

This is exactly what I was looking for to give my skechers sports shoes a brake in the summer They're SO comfortable, the cris crossed pattern in the front helps people like me with thin feet that tend to extend beyond the front part of the shoe when there's only a horizontal constraint in the front part. Also, the back strip helps in keeping the sandal on place so it wont move around or flap like a flip flop. The soles are soft without being too hot in warm climates... Just perfect! I ordered the exact same size of other closed sketchers shoes that I previously had and fit perfectly.
At first I was worried about the straps hurting my feet as I walked ... 15 blocks and in the clear. The soles ar like clouds I feel like I am walking on air. Size very reliable.

I have wide feet. I m grateful for their solidity on the earth. They are not my most attractive feature though. Because I planned to walk many miles on vacation, I ordered several pairs of sandals. Because I found a great fit, I thought I d be just returning these - especially since they didn t arrive until after I myself returned to chilly weather. I was so surprised when I donned them by how flattering they were. I don t like overly cushy soles that don t make it easy to feel the ground, so am not personally enamored if that feature. And they re not durably designed like I d need to trek miles. For me they re keepers though, as I think they ll be lovely with the right summer dress!
My pinky toe wants to escape out from below the strap. Wish the strap sat a bit lower so that wasn't an issue. I still love them and they are comfy.

I loved that this looks nice to wear in casual and comfortable to wear in court and look very nice. I ve been buying from sketchers because they don t fall apart like most sandals. I also love their sneakers and really love the sandals with gemstones.
Purchased the first pair at Kohls. The puppy chewed up the back strap on one sandal at the end of the summer couldn t find a replacement pair at the store. So happy I found them on Amazon.
I like Clark's shoes. This looked cute but they were a 1 2 size small and the straps near the toes would cut in if you happen to have feet that swell during the day. I returned them.

So cute!! Crazy comfortable. They go with everything, and there are absolutely no weird sandal issues i.e. straps to tight or loose, embarrassing suction noises when walking, sandal sliding around, straps rubbing, etc!! NONE of that!! Perfect fit, and all the straps that go across your foot are stretchy so they adjust to your foot and keep the sandal in place. The strap in the back is a suede material, but it stays put and does not cause irritation. I am very pleased, they are simple, cute and comfy! You can put them on, walk all day and forget about them. Yay! I'm a 9.5 in Skechers sneakers, and I ordered a 9 in these sandals - they fit fine!!

I like the flexibility of the sandals, the way the elasticity in the straps hug the foot. Kind of wish the back heel strap was more elastic also. I like that there are no buckles to fasten. The sandals are easy to slip on and comfortable to wear. Very nice looking and good quality. Sketchers have always delivered a great shoe. I've owned several.

Mom on a budget here - I really searched for the perfect sandal for myself. Usually flip flops were my go to but this year I needed something comfier and safer to wear that also had a strap on the back for that extra support. I really love the style of these I however wish the sole lasted longer as they re very worn in after a couple months.

Took a similar pair for six months to Europe last year and loved them! Bought this style because I thought it just looked a bit less like a hiking sandal. Seems I like the hiking sandal better. These are pretty, but just a bit too many straps for me, makes my feet too hot.
I love them they are very comfortable, I like the fact that they have a rubber sole with a little heel they are not flat
Love these sandals. Not because they are vegan but because they are comfortable and have soles that that do not slip when walking on slick surfaces. Will definitely buy again.

representative_reviews.text: Took these on a trip and found them stylish while still being really practical to walk around in. Highly recommend! For the price this is a steal.

product_name: ASICS Women's Noosa Tri 13 Running Shoes

urgent_issues.summary: 많은 구매자들이 사이즈가 작고 좁아서 불편함을 호소하고 있습니다. 이로 인해 반품을 고려하는 경우가 많습니다.

comfort.issue_summary: 많은 구매자들이 착용감이 불편하고 통증을 유발한다고 보고했습니다. 이로 인해 장시간 착용이 어려워 불만이 많습니다.
comfort.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 뛰어난 지지력과 편안함을 제공하여 장시간 착용해도 통증이 없다고 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: These are probably the worst shoes I've ever worn. They are so cool looking and comfortable and bouncy at first, though a tighter fit. They did feel like rocker shoes, which I thought was a little weird but I gave them a try. However, after 5 minutes of wearing them around the house I had shin splints in both legs and severe hip pain in my right hip that felt suspiciously like an old episode of hip bursitis. Not good. These shoes murdered my gait. I put my Gel Cumulus back on-no shin splints and no hip pain! These were a hard pass for me!

I have never owned such an uncomfortable pair of shoes. I wore them to work they were uncomfortable. After an hour it felt like I was standing on pavement without a shoe on. Absolutely no support or cushion. I had to wear them for nine hours and it was pure misery. I have worn stilettos that are more comfortable. I would never recommend these shoes. They are going into the trash tonight. My feet are still sore!

This is the only Asics shoe, out of many many that I have purchased over the last 30 years, that has changed how I walk, and for the worse. It causes my feet to very noticeably pronate inward. Causes hip and popliteal pain. Color is amazing, but not at the expense of foot stability. Two thumbs down.

I wore these around the house for about 10 minutes and in that little bit of time the shoes made the insoles and inside of my knees start to hurt!! They turn your feet oddly so that it feels like you re walking on the inner parts of your feet. Other reviewers have mentioned this too. If I had completed one workout in the shoes, I suspect I would have sustained a mild to moderate injury to my knees. Returning immediately!!

I am a therapist and can tell you these shoes are not good. They lack in proper foot support, and makes my feet pronate very badly. They also fit at least 1 2 a size too small, and are narrow. I wanted to like them, because they are absolutely gorgeous. But, I ll be returning them.

What I had hoped for! I like shoes with a bounce to them. Wore Nike Air Max TN for a long time until they weren't available in womens anymore . Adidas bonce, boost, Mizuno new wave prphecys etc. I did lots of research and decided on these and was extremely disappointed! Little bounce and no cushioning! I bought like 4 pairs of expensive inserts and 1 worked ok for about a month and my legs , hip and body hurt worse than with any other new new to me ones I've tried. I've only had them about 2 months and switched inserts and they still feel worn and have like zero cushioning left! Last pair I bought Saucony Endorphines after reading how great they were! They were more cushioned for sure but had no stability but at least I switched inserts and got about 4 months out of those! Currently searching for something. If you don't need cushioning or have any aches, etc and aren't picky these might be ok Oh and they are filthy and look like I've had them forever and my Saucony were the same color and at 5 months didn't look like these at a month! Disappointed!
I didn t realize they where a more of a slip on no tongue shoe. I couldn t even get them on my feet and they where far too narrow.

I ve always liked ASICS was excited to try this shoe as I m training for a race. I wore them in my house and my feet were killing me in just 20 minutes. The rocker foot feel is super strange feeling and makes me hesitant to attempt running in them. There is no padding cushion like all of my other ASICS which is my favorite feature. The colors are really cool but I m not into the Japanese writing on the exterior of the shoe which is way more noticeable in person. They aren t light weight. They re more narrow than any of my other tennis shoes and I don t have a wide foot but these squeeze my foot uncomfortably and I even ordered up a size. I m not sure if Amazon is selling knock offs but this is nowhere near the quality of typical ASICS and I m so disappointed. I m really glad I wore them in my house before working out because I think my feet would ve been miserable!

Very light weight, however the middle of the sole was huge bulky and often caused me to trip. After wearing them for 20 minutes the arches in my feet ached? Strange. Never happened with any other shoe. They my look really great though!

I did not try the product only made it to revealing one shoe and knew it was not what I wanted. They're not real shoes...they're foam, or plastic something. I'm flat-footed, I can not wear these kind of shoes and definitely qoyld not pay that much for them

I love the aesthetic of the shoe, however, after reading the reviews I thought that this shoe would work. Not the case. They do not fit well. The "box" of the shoe was too narrow. it was very uncomfortable during a workout. I will be returning these ASiCS. Sad....
Comfortable, great looking shoe, work on my feet 12 hours a day, did not last 1 month. Hole in top of shoe in a month.

these are absolutely the coolest looking pair of shoes so i bought 4 different colors but i didnt wear one pair before buying all of them and sure wish i did cuz they kill the bottom of my feet they are awful dont buy them.

Unless you are actively looking for a different fit - stay away. This shoe is actually like a rocker shoe- your toes and heel cannot hit the ground at the same time. It s weird. I didn t like it. So buyer beware.
Very comfortable I am on my feet 8 hours a day and they offer great support. Also very stylish and I get apt of compliments.

I am not a runner at all but these shoes were absolutely amazing I was able to stay a head and just keep going through out my entire trip to Disney averaging over 20,000 steps a day!! Complete confront 0 foot pain! I m prone to heal spurs or blisters from shoes. I ve tried numerous sneakers, walking shoes nothing compares at all for long distance walking power walking. The arch support, shock absorbance I wish they would make a million other shoes that could feel like these!! I also rarely right a review but this time I figured I d there is someone like me very worried about how they will survive a trip like Disney it may help make all the difference!!
I use it for walking and support since I have no arch I walk six miles 3 times a week and weight 200 lbs
I am always looking for shoes that have great arch support. These shoes are the best supportive shoes. They also are so colorful.

I own Noosa, 8 years ago, but that was very heavy and no cushion but I loved design. Since then, I didn't buy it but this one, Amazed! Right after put in my feet! Fits like a glove. Very light and comfortable! No pain after 8 mile without brake in. Love this!

Gorgeous shoe! Comfortable! However after my first workout in them, the front of shoe by the big toe creased. I could feel the indention on my big toe during my workout. Disappointed that a running shoe at this price point would fold crease dent like this.

Was hesitant to try a new brand of shoes. But took a chance and so very glad I did! I am a nurse and work 12 hour shifts. Also have lupus and fibromyalgia so my knees and back hurt a lot. Bulging discs as well. I have ZERO pain when wearing these! I generally wear my New Balance V1080 with fresh foam every night I work so I was scared to wear something different. But SO GLAD I gave it a shot! VERY comfortable. Cushion and support is amazing. No pain at all in my 12-13 hour shifts this week! Don t walk, run to buy these! Add to cart NOW!
I suffer from plantar fasciitis and have been looking for shoes that are lightweight that don t no flare up my condition These are the best! So comfortable and springy!

I bought these to hike in but I don't because EVERYWHERE I go people fall in love with these shoes. I get stopped everywhere with people complimenting me on these. Doctor's office , grocery shopping and even pumping gas
Was accepting more cushion from an ASIC shoe. A flatter shoe. Yes light but didn t find the cushion what I expected

Have been using to walk 10 miles per day every other day. Very comfortable, not to mention how cute with those beautiful colors. I have been dealing with plantar fasciitis for months and these shoes are very supportive on a 10 mile trek!
These are easy to settle in. Great support without being too thick of a cushion pad. Running feels feather light. The colors are a bonus and fun. We ll worth it. Thanks.
The most comfortable shoe I ve ever wore! So supportive. Never leaves my feet sore after being on my feet all day.

I work on my feet 12 hours a day. I was fitted for Shoes many years ago and was told Asics will offer the most support. I ve been wearing them ever since. These however are hands down the best shoes I ve ever put on my feet! One week in and I ordered a second pair! I actually ordered a pair of Tri Noosa 14s after wearing these for a couple of days but immediately returned them and ordered a 2nd pair of 13 s! I no longer have swollen sore ankles and feet at the end of the day. I get home and forget to take them off! That s huge! I used to drive home barefoot! If you have higher arches and are on your feet or are a runner these are a MUST

I am a respiratory therapist in an 850 bed hospital. Needless to say, I m never in the same place for very long. I needed a shoe that was supportive and super comfortable. This shoe has all the comfort and support of a rocker without the less than desired outer design. These shoes are light and breathable so they don t feel like heavy clogs at the end of the day. Knee and back pain are non existent after a 12 hour shift even if I m doing multiple shifts back to back. Of all the shoes I ve used in my 20 years in healthcare, these are without a doubt, the MOST comfortable.

Fits my wife s foot perfectly! She loves them! That s why I bought two. I previously purchased two other styles of the same shoe earlier. Great comfort and support!
The heel support diminishes after a couple uses. I love the design, but I think I will stuck to the gel-kayano.

VIDEOID ed7698c766b22622a2d9adcd769f8c1 I am an essential worker, who is on my feet 10 hours a day , 5 days a week. I am 260lbs so there is alot of pressure on my feet and knees. These shoes however are amazing! They are light wait and super comfortable. I have 4 stars because of one small detail As seen in the video when walking and your foot presses forward there is a crease that pops in with the movement of your feet. I am a true size 9. But sized up because it kept bumping my big toe. I sized up and have no issues at all.

Perfect fit width length wise. Purchased Size 8 Beautiful detailing, very comfortable. Sturdy, yet lightweight. Good quality came with an alternative pair of laces. I'm particular about my shoes, so the fact I'm writing a review is a compliment.

Fit as expected and received what I ordered. These shoes are firm, with just the right amount of support if you have high arches, neutral heel roll and are on your feet all day. Made with partial recycled materials according to ASICS site . That s always a plus.

Shhh!!! Don t tell anyone how cute these sneakers are before I get my second pair. Review I wear a 6.5 and ordered a 6.5 the fit is true to size and comfortable box toe. Omg!!!! COMFORTABLE! COMFORTABLE! COMFORTABLE! Love them. I walk 7 miles once s a week and these sneakers make it feel like I was walking on air. I also run a little, trying to get back my stamina but the little bit of running that I do these sneakers are fabulous. Plus I get compliments every where I go.
These shoes are very very comfortable. Enough room in the toe box, cushioned pillowy feel on the step and super cute! Buy them!!
Super comfortable. I have a narrow heel and usually have a hard time finding shoes that fit well. These fit great.

I am in love with this shoe! It's lightweight and had great cushion. Asics tend to run long, so I ordered my true size and I still have room to spare! It's so nice to have an actual cool looking running shoe instead of these blah colors many brands have been putting out lately.

It's been a very long time since I've owned this brand. I purchased these primarily to walk my dog and if we decided to jog some, then I needed something even more cushioned than my Nike Pegasus. On first try I thought they were way too stiff. My feet are a little wide but not wide enough to wear a wide. The are a little tight on the top of my foot so I loosened the strings considerably. I generally wear 8 and that's what I ordered based on reviews but honestly if you are a runner, I recommend sizing half or maybe a whole size...you'll want a little room for those toes! The more I wore them the softer the walk became, so overall they've proven to be a good purchase....and love the color. I actually scored on the price...70.00ish. It was either these or the Hoka...I'm happy I gave these a shot first.

Fits perfectly. Bought my normal size. For running on my tread these shoes are absolutely amazing. First time in forever that my shins didn t hurt after I got done running. So happy with this purchase that I m buying another pair!!!
These are great shoes! I have a high arch and wide foot! They support my foot perfectly! I love all the cushion! The colors are a lot of fun also!

strength_keywords: durable and continued to stay comfortable
durability.strength_summary: 구매자들은 이 신발이 스트레스에도 잘 견디고, 오랜 사용에도 여전히 좋은 상태를 유지하며, 내구성이 뛰어나고 편안함을 지속적으로 제공한다고 반복적으로 언급하고 있습니다.

representative_reviews.text: I have stability and balance issues and these shoes greatly improve these conditions. The sole makes the bottom of my foot feel like it's being cradled and I feel safer and the comfort is amazing.

As a fluffy individual these shoes have held up well under stress at the gym, and everyday wear. I've also had bilateral knee repairs several times, ankle, and back surgery all from playing sports and natural wear and tear. These shoes have been both durable and continued to stay comfortable, I purchased a second pair shortly after these.

I wanted to try these shoes because I've purchased Asics in the past and have found that they have worked very well with my problem feet. Five surgeries, four broken bones, and a stress fracture. These shoes are so cute with the bright summer colors, even though it was early fall season, I went ahead and ordered them because I knew that if I waited, they would soon be gone in my size. When they arrived, I tried them with my custom orthotic inserts and they are the most comfortable athletic shoe I have ever worn! I'm saving these for the spring, but in the meantime I've ordered the Black Lilac Opal for fall and winter!

The new tri noosa will not last as long with the new sole. The sole use to be hard and solid bit now it is nothing but that crap foam. Bo worth the price but I do like the colors and patterns. Total bummer bc asics had a really good product.

I've been wearing these shoes for running on pavement 6 mi per day for a month now. They still look great and my feet are happy! I've had multiple bones broken in both my feet. I've had the Gel Excite shoes and older Tri Noosa ones. The soles of my older Tri Noosa shoes wore slick very quickly, the cushion got flat and hard, and they got holes on the insides at the back of my heels. They didn't last long. I'm loving these shoes so far! My feet do not hurt while running and I have no foot pain the next day! I ordered another pair in a different color but bought them from Public Lands for 30 less!

I ve owned ASICS sneakers before, love love the design colors of this sneaker. When it comes to comfort my feet are not happy. Not enough comfort in the toe area for me. The sneaker has a lot of sole towards the back which slants down to the toe area with not much.
Love these shoes. Perfect for workouts and walking. Very comfortable and supportive. Will buy this brand again when they wear out.

They are def. Worth the money. I wore them 10 hours strait. So comfortable and they actually propel ur feet forward when u walk, the soles bottom are curved. Theses shoes gave me lots of extra energy. They are perfect to me.

Have worn Gel Noosa ASICS for a long time for their comfort and for their crazy colors. The Tri 13 is the the most comfortable yet. The cushioning in the insole and outsoles is exceptional for running and walking. I always go up one full size in ASICS running shoes as they run a little short. Got the pink turquoise pair for Mother s Day as they last a lot longer than flowers. Got the green black pair for my birthday at the end of May because emerald is my birthstone. Two presents in May!!!

I am sooooo happy the Noosa is back. They fit live a leather glove. They hug your feet and the memory foam sole is so forgiving on your tired feet. Unlike previous generations they don t have the flat hard bottoms and they curve up so it takes a bit to get used when if have never used those kinds of running shoes. Just know they still run a bit small so I always buy up a half size and have never had a problem.
I do love are light they are, however I wish they had more of an arch I stuck Dr Sholl insoles in them

I think shoes should at least not fall apart after 1 year. Terrible craftsmanship. I will give them credit that they were very comfortable for the first month into wear.

These are the most comfortable shoes I ve ever had! I used them to walk the dog approx 1-2 miles daily and the soles wore through in just over 3 months!! I tried still wearing them, but small debris on the sidewalk pokes through - not worth what I paid and sub par quality from Skechers

I've had two other pairs of these in previous designs. Both of them had that nice bouncy support and thick sole. With this new design the bottom of the soles seem a lit thinner and flatter eventhough it looks thicker in the photos where the sole wraps up onto the edge. They do not offer the same support. A previous generation had some shock absorbing circles built into the bottom that really helped with fatigue. The elastic laces are a nice touch but I wish the tension was adjustable. I eneded up returning these.
Loved the shoes, but the right shoe was larger than the left. The left fit perfectly but the right was so large it I could not walk properly and keep the shoe on.

Too narrow for a supposedly wide width! Hadn t opened them figuring they were exactly like a previous pair I ordered to my surprise they r so narrow I needed a use a shoe stretcher they still r too narrow!?

These were similar to another Sketchers product recommended for comfortable walking shoes. The sizing is a bit small however, the soles have no traction. I would not recommend these for anyone at a risk of falls or those who live work in places with smooth flooring.

I have an older model of this same pair and this seems to be made a lot cheaper, it had fake elastic laces that I couldn t tighten and slipped around on my foot. The support didn t fee as good as my old pair either. I returned.

I had bought the exact same size that I had purchased in a different sketcher shoe but in this shoe, my toe hit the end. Too small. I don t appreciate having to pay to return them. Plus, I had to purchase a bag at the UPS store to return them in. They said they don t send as is. I am not pleased with the overall return experience.

I love these shoes. I wear them only around the house and to check the mail. So I was surprised that they started to split at one of the seams after only a week of wearing them. I m not heavy and work from home so I wanted something comfortable but not a slipper. These were really great but the quality is cheap. I expected better sine they cost 65.00. I don t think I ll purchase another pair. Too bad though.
these shoes are so comfortable I don't even care if I leave them on all day. Arch support is firm enough to not cause me pain while walking. Also my feet don't sweat!

So comfortable! I bought these for an upcoming 2 week trip in Europe and I already want a second pair. They are lightweight and perfect for travel. They even came with a free pair or those tiny socks that don t show.

SO COMFORTABLE! I am a teacher and I am also 6 months pregnant, so I was looking for something to wear day to day long days! that wouldn't kill my feet. I have worn Sperry's and while I like them, they don't come close to the level of comfort of these. The lining in these is really squishy and provides good support. The inside of my Sperry's feels flat and my feet end up aching by the end of the day. I purchased these back when they were the style with the laces that tie and was pleased with the quality and comfort then. I like the non-tie style even better! I have had several pairs of these through the last few years and they have held up extremely well. I can throw them in the washer in a laundry bag and they come out looking as good as new with their same shape. I don't recommend drying them in the dryer, however. My only wish is that they had more colors!

These are comfortable, sturdy shoes. I wore them for a 10 trip in Europe without breaking them in first. They did not disappoint. I'm a heavy heel walker, which leads to heel and knee pain. I didn't feel any pain in these shoes other than the day I walked more than five miles. While the shoes are supportive, go for something sturdier if you'll be walking more than five miles a day. I don't think these shoes are meant for that. I accidentally went for a muddy, steep hike in them my husband's fault . Clearly these shoes aren't meant for hiking. They worked very well for the city walking I did though. The soles are very grippy on wet cement and tile. They also paired well with several outfits as well as compacted down well enough for my suitcase.
Show looks great but support is lacking. Very little arch, minimum sole cushioning and side support. Returning them.

I wish I could ve loved these! Bought for myself but wound up giving them to my daughter. I need arch support and have been looking for a good shoe to teach in all day without having pain, that I can wear multiple days in a row. Sadly there is zero arch support in these. My adult daughter has flat feet and she thinks they re very comfortable she doesn t like their look but wears them anyway bc she thinks they re so comfortable .
I have bought several of this same shoe and very please with the comfort. Although I am flat footed it is still very comfortable

I bought these for a Europe trip with tons of planned walking. These shoes are really cute for casual wear. They are comfy enough for day wear around town, but not enough support for a full day walking. The soft foam is more pillowy than supportive for long walks. A whole day of walking 8 or so miles left my feet sore and ankles and legs tired. I'll use them around town instead.

While living in NY I wanted a pair of comfy casual walking shoes. These shoes are sooo comfy!!! I originally bought a 5.5 which is my normal size but with some no-show socks, I found that it was too tight so I had to go up to a 6 so that my feet didn't feel suffocated. Even the 6 with the socks sometimes after a long day does feel a bit tight around the top part of my foot, but not enough for me to increase to a 6.5. The heel size is perfect at the 6. I do love these shoes! I wish though, that the Sketchers logo wasn't so large prominent as I prefer less brand logo visibility. The gray goes with everything but it's a bit of a pain to wash when they get stained, especially when I walk in the NYC rain. Yuck..
These are super comfy and super light weight. Exactly what I was looking for for being on my feet for long hours
Love these shoes. These are very comfy and exactly as expected. I already own a different pair. If your looking for arch support, nada.
Been having plantar fasciitis pain from my New Balances for months. Finally decided to switch - took a chance on these and absolutely LOVE them!!! I will be buying a few more pairs for sure!
Lots of cushion in sole, they fit nice true to size. No tie shoes and I get compliments on them every time I wear them. I have recommended them to numerous people.

Like the look and feel. Shoe is providing some relief for my sore heel. It fits a soft heel cushion well. They are very lightweight and feel great. This is my second pair and I wear them about 70 of the time in house.
Love these shoes so much I bought another pair! Light weight, plenty of cushion, easy off on, most comfortable shoe I've found.

Unfortunately, although I have two pairs of Skechers sneakers which I love, I will have to return this boat shoe style.

I love the shoe other than the seam in the heel which causes heel blisters. I have another pair, same size, style and brand and wore them out. No problem. Sure hope this heel gets softer!

They don't have a great arch support, but sometimes you have to decide which is needed worse. To bad l can't get all three , arch support, wide toe box and accommodates a high instep, then the shoes would be perfect.

these shoes are amazing!! I work at a job where i have to stand up for 10 hrs at a time and these are so amazing!! i usually have some issues with my arches by the end of day but these have great support. have been comfortable from the minute i put them on... i have not bought them in another color and will most likely get a few others!

Even when I'm not doing walking or heavy trailing, the boot is painful in the ankles, the upper foot, because they are hard and stiff. Can't wear them for long periods. Wanted to get another brand because after this experience with Merrel shoes, just makes me doubt all of their products.
Toe box is very wide, unusually so a that is often the part that is too tight. good fit however on my narrow heels. Had to return - easy return process

Even though I wear a size 6 tennis shoe and got a size 7 in this boot they still pinched my toes so badly that after 2 weeks of hiking in Yellowstone I seem to have permanent yikes! numbness in 2 outside little toes on both feet. Also got blisters on top of blisters on the sides of both heels in spite of thick good quality hiking socks. It could be that the blisters were caused by pinching between boot and my orthotics so won't blame the boot for that but the toe numbness is ridiculous. They also ran hot.
Nice boots, but I had to return them because the arch support is in a really odd spot. Like not where your arch is.

I have purchased this particular shoe several times, and they have been very comfortable "out of the box". This pair, however, is quite uncomfortable, there must have been a production change? The ankles are stiffer and rub, and they are tight and uncomfortable over the toes creating pressure. I'm back to wearing my old ones for any hikes of distance. Disappointed.

Shoe was tight right foot only . I've never had this problem and I've owned a lot of Merrell shoes. I can't hike more than 6 miles without my right toes hurting. 2nd irritant is that I can't walk through a low grass field without my socks - and by extension my feet - being soaked. If you are looking for a water proof shoe... search on. I'm going back to Keen.

My previous Moab2s were my everyday shoe for work around my farm and hiking. Loved them! FYI the new insole is thin and not the one pictured in this description!

I'm a huge Merrell fan. Love my previous boots. This one was much larger than my previous hiking boot. Not sure if it's because this is 34 vented 34 material, but definitely does not provide the support I was expecting or have experienced in the past. The boot is 34 floppy 34 , looks and feels more like a slipper, which is fine except when trekking in the white mountains. After a serious hike, my foot was blistered on the bottom because I could not get the boot tight enough so it kept slipping on my foot. Used the same socks as I do with my previous boots.

So, I wear a 5.5 shoe for everything from heels to flip flops. However, in my running shoe, I have learned to size up 1 whole size and get wide. I was told by multiple people these fit large. I got the 5.5 wide. Well, the fit rue to size. However, the seam is sewn over the top of the bone in my pinky toe joint. OMG. The nerve pain shooting up my foot made me want to cry. Who sews a seam over any part where bone is prominent? I would seriously consider buying a different shoe. Also, the shoes, in the store come with 2 foot beds. These came with one. I have a flatter foot and the arch support that was in the boot caused an incredibly irritating rub on my arch. Pics to come Don t buy these.

I returned this boot because the top of the boot hit just at under my ankle and literally created a bruise and was sore for days afterwards. And the sole was weird, no arch support and raised in spots like the heel.

Anything more technical, stead clear.

I thought I'd love these. My mom and friend have this shoe and the love it. But for me, there was a hard part on the arch and it really hurt to step. Maybe my arch is too pronounced but it was very uncomfortable. Besides that, the rest was fine. But these were not for me. Looks they were on the bulky side, but I liked the color

So love the color! Size is spot on.plenty of toe room.HOWEVER the right shoe has a very high arch support that feels like wadding.i had 2 other people try these boots on without telling them anything.same conclusion, something is wrong on the right arch.going 2 send this pair back and re order

These are by far the most comfortable hiking boots I have ever owned...I"m on my second pair! If you have foot "issues", these are the perfect boot by Merrell. Obviously, Merrell makes many other models, but I've found THIS MODEL is the best for Plantar Fasciitis, arch support, heel pain, and general foot support. These are the one and only shoe that I can wear for HOURS without my feet hurting. I've gone many miles without foot issues, and they have EXCELLENT breathability. I was recommended these initially by a random stranger in REI. Thank God I listened....so now I'm paying it forward because these are truly the best boots!

So comfy! Returned the Ontario by Merrell and got these. Very happy with this decision. Great arch support and they are very comfortable. I wore for a hike in New York and had no discomfort whatsoever afterwards.

So far these have been extremely comfortable. As a long time wearer of Keens, I felt apprehensive about buying another brand. The second I put these on I could tell these were going to be good shoes. My ankles feel so supported in them. When I bought them, I had JUST bought a pair of Keens for work and had intended to use these specifically for hiking and disc golfing. Since receiving these, I've worn these to work more times than I have my Keen work shoes. I work on concrete floors for up to ten hours a day and haven't had any issues with my feet hurting at the end of the day. I think I made it about half way thought my work day in my Keens before I started noticing leg pain. Another thing to note, which was a big part of why I chose these boots, is that they have pretty decent arch support. I have high arches, so having good arch support is important to me. I like these so much that I'd definitely consider ordering the waterproof version before it snows next year

These hikers are very comfortable so far. Roomy toe box, good arch support, good cushioning and ankle support are all the features I was hoping for and found with these shoes. I ordered up a 1 2 size to be able to wear thick socks in the cooler weather.
Lots of room for my wide feet. Could use a bit more arch support for my high arches. Just right for hiking through the high desert for hours on end.
Finally a hiking boot that does not hurt! Arch a little odd at first. Wore them around the house for a day to break them in and love them!

Great arch support. Toe box excellent. Very sturdy boot. Hopefully will last me a long time. I have foot issues so I had to put my orthotics from my orthopedist in them. And the boot fit perfectly with them. I have Merrill sandals that I love so I thought i d give these a try. The brown purple colors go good together . Glad I bought these boots.

Got these for hiking trip out west. Felt good on feet even though I didn't break them in before the trip. Hiked over 10 miles per day for 1 week. Since i do have flat feet, my one foot had a little issue getting used to the arch support and the heel pocket. But that was only an issue for a day, then no longer an issue.
I'm a wildlife photographer and in the warmer months, this is my go to hiking boot for going out in nature. So comfortable

It fits the best in every way! For hiking, walking anywhere, everywhere! Great support for ankles, arch, all over! Exceedingly comfortable!! I bought 2 more pairs for when this pair can't be worn anymore, just in case they change the model Take care!

I am considering getting another pair for work as I stand and walk long hours on my feet indoors. I will definitely buy more!!!
I wish there was more padding on the back of the heel. But, overall I like the great durability and ruggedness.
I LOVE this hiking boot. Ventilated as advertised, comfortable right out of the box. Fit as expected. Taking them it to CO and UT for backpacking, and they get regular use on the trails here in MO.
I have a narrow foot and need good arch support or else my ankles become v. sore. These boots really fit the bill I can wear them all day with no problems at all. Highly recommended.

Fantastic hiking shoe. Stabilized my weak ankles and high arches. Perfect for hiking through lots of rocky creeks. Let's water flow in without weighing you down back on land and dried easily overnight beside campfire.

Because of wide feet, I bought the wide size. They fit just right! Appreciate being able to buy them online as they were not available in any of my local shoe stores. Thanks.

I was very impressed by this sole fact, so I did what I could to not get more blisters on the top of my foot by adding bandaids to protect from further breakdown, but it doesn't really help. The material has great support for top and bottom of the foot, unfortunately that same material kills your skin on the anterior aspect of the foot, as pictured.

Aside from the fit I have a narrow heel as well as width I did not like the material. I am waiting to see if I need an Amazon authorization return label to get my refund. Although the price is reasonable, the construction of the sandals seems to be of poor quality to me. Irene Butler. Henderson, NV
I love the comfort of these shoes but the back heal strap broke on me after 1 month. Do shoes have any warranty?

These shoes rubbed my toe raw within 20 minutes of wearing them. The piece that sticks out on the front part was rubbing against my toe and all day and as a teacher I was forced to be in pain all day from these shoes. I returned them and bought another pair.

I really wanted to love this sandal. The size of the foot bed is standard I'm normally a 7 in sandals and that is true of this one as well. The foot bed itself does have a decent amount of cushioning. However, after just 1 2 hour in these sandals, I was in more pain than I could handle. The elastic straps are not forgiving in the least. If you have bunions, you will absolutely want to steer clear of this sandal. The straps dig in so hard it feels like wrapping your feet with duct tape. Awful. The velcro strap in the back kept popping loose as well. I have very narrow feet and yet my toes were popping out the top of the sandal like dough escaping from a can of biscuits. I literally cannot believe such a well-known brand has produced such a horrible sandal. One positive though, they're not bad looking for a casual sandal.

These sandals looked like a good choice to wear for all day walking, wrong. Elastic straps are tight and unforgiving not allowing for any amount of foot swelling which can occur after a long day of walking. Could not wait to rip them off my feet at the end of the day. Would not recommend these sandals......

My shoes were defective. They were comfortable but had no arch support. Lack of arch support didn t work for me. My problem was with the back of the shoe strap at the heel. They didn t match. One strap was higher than the other. This meant that the strap at the heel on the one shoe dropped down. It was very uncomfortable. I sent them back.

I purchased a pair of black last year and loved them. So this spring I decided to get a blue pair. Even though I purchased the same size, they do not fit the same way. The right shoe squeezed the top of my foot so hard, it became impossible to walk. I attempted to stretch the foot, so it wouldn't squeeze, but after a couple of hours, it would begin to be painful again. I'm sorry to say, I wouldn't recommend these shoes unless you can try them on in the store.

The straps crossing the toe area is rough and scratchy. After wearing a short time my toes were bloody. One strap around the ankle is twisted and does not lay flat. HUGE DISAPPOINTMENT FOR A CLARKS SHOE. POOR QUALITY.
The straps on these irritated my feet the minute I put them on and I don't have wide feet. I sent them back.
These shoes were one of the most comfortable shoes I have ever worn! Also cute style. Unfortunately I had to return them because very slippery.

Very good quality, but due to the design and material I would say order one or two size up. The blue strips are all spandex which are very tight, you wouldn t very very uncomfortable when first putting them on but after a full day of wearing my feet was in lots of pain.!
I just got these today and was so disappointed as I love them but they just had to much room at the first row of elastic at the top of my foot the length was perfect but will have to send them back.

I have a high arch but nothing extraordinary and these shoes made my feet throb. I m so disappointed as Clark s as a rule of thumb are designed for comfort. In this case there was not enough stretch in the elastic and the seems on the heel are have hard edges and cause blisters.

I wore these for the first time for 8 hours straight. They are so so comfortable! My feet didn t get tired all day as the sole is very cushioned and soft. The cloth straps are comfortable too. They are very light weight and noiseless on the floor. They look somewhat dressy and that is what I bought them for, to wear with dresses. My feet are stable in them despite the fact that they are a little elevated....not too elevated. I m 70 years old so need safe shoes, but I don t have to look frumpy if shoes like these are available. I highly recommend.

This platform style gives me a comfortable footbed, and good stability. As a senior, with minor foot, and major knee problems, I was happy with this style right out of the box. It is extremely lightweight very important for walking , and adjusts easily to the shape of the foot. Proper alignment is critical for my knees.

So soft but has enough support. It is priced moderately. Fit is awesome. The stretchable material helps you walk comfortably while you land on softness but with support so it does not hurt your heel. I have plantar fasciitis. I ordered this at the same time as Dansko and Echo sandals which were more expensive -- more than 100 for each of these sandals Clarks were priced so much better and much better quality and support.
I walked all over Europe for a month when I was on vacation. Super comfortable with excellent support! LOVE THEM!!!!

These are so nice, and squishy. I have achilles tendonitis and have trouble with office appropriate shoes, 34 since my doctor tells me I can only wear tennis shoes w a high arch and heel support.
