I even think I could go hiking in these but I bought these ones for wearing around the office. Very comfortable, I would definitely recommend.
This is the very first comfortable pair of sandals I own. At 63 years of age I suffer with bunion pain. These shoes give me support, style and comfort. Well worth the price.
Very Comfortable and has ALOT of cushion. I have a bad hip and can never find nice sandals that have the cushion in their step as these Clark Sandals do. I HIGHLY recommend.

This shoe is exactly what I have been looking for. I wore out a pair of easy spirit that is no longer made and was so disappointed trying to find a similar shoe. I have painful knees and legs and walking long distances without support or cushion makes me so tired and painful if I don't have good shoes. And heels are definitely a thing of the past. But I need something that was soft, cushy, not stiff in the straps and preferably elastic to give with my every move, yet stylish too. These fit the bill. They are lightweight, a little bounce from the rubber sole, and elastic straps everywhere with no pressure points. Almost like being barefoot, but more supportive. I have finally found my new go to, go everywhere shoe! I am immediately ordering several more colors. Great for pants, crops, shorts, dresses, even semi dressy dresses. And it's not an old lady shoe but stylish too. I can say that cause I am an old lady... I love them.
Love Clark's new Cloud Stepper line. I have plantar Fasciitis and was able to walk for 5 hours on cement without any problems. Cute and comfortable!
Nice support for my foot, very comfortable. Clark's are very durable I have some pairs. Great quality

The material of the straps made me a bit hesitant about keeping them at first, so I wore them around the house before deciding to keep them and wear outside. I have very high arches, so the fabric straps have very little 'give', even with wear, so I had to be sure it would not cause swollen or blistered feet to wear for prolonged periods of time because I bought them for walking - both recreational and for sensible, stable shoes for leisurely outings of unknown terrain and situations that required standing for long periods. I I am very satisfied - they are truly like walking on air and the straps, though snug, are not uncomfortable and just add to the support. Highly recommend! PS my high arches are the only reason I rated them just under 'fit as expected', since that factor made them a bit snug at first

My main objective with shoes is comfort, and that was achieved with these sandals. The foot bed is very well cushioned and I can walk around in them with no pain. I need a wide toe box, but have a narrow heel, so just added some padding to the back strap. Very happy with my purchase.
Like another reviewer, I have knee issues and require good stability. I also need cushioning and arch support. This sandal does all that while also looking attractive for capris and skirts.
I like the adjustable strap and the cushiony sole which is very comfortable. Bottom could be slippery on wet surfaces as there is no tread as is often found on sneakers and many shoe soles.

I just wanted to say that I have back problems and its very hard to find a shoe that fits comfortable and I can't believe I actually found a sandal that looks nice and fits perfect and my back didn't hurt at all. I wear these all the time and love them.

size.issue_summary: 많은 구매자들이 사이즈가 작거나 발에 맞지 않는 문제를 경험했습니다. 이로 인해 불편함을 느끼고 반품하는 경우가 많았습니다.
size.strength_summary: 많은 구매자들이 사이즈가 정확하고 편안한 착용감을 제공한다고 언급했습니다. 이는 고객들이 신발을 쉽게 선택하고 만족할 수 있도록 도와줍니다.

representative_reviews.text: Aside from the fit I have a narrow heel as well as width I did not like the material. I am waiting to see if I need an Amazon authorization return label to get my refund. Although the price is reasonable, the construction of the sandals seems to be of poor quality to me. Irene Butler. Henderson, NV
Though I ordered a 7W, these shoes were too small short to be reliably comfortable. I was sorry that I had to return them.
Shoe fits very tight across the top. I have a regular width but had to return because they were not comfortable.
I returned them because they have a very tight ankle strap. If they are for wide feet how come the ankle strap are so tight and small? Bad design.

What an emotional rollercoaster. I got the wide width because I need a lot of extra give room around my ankle and the top of my foot. I was worried the elastic straps would have leather stitched to the underside, but the first 2 straps are 100 elastic! Unfortunately it seems all of the wide width is around the toes, not around my foot where I need it. The soles feel extremely comfortable but the upper is squeezing my feet so much I can't enjoy it. If I go a size up, there will be too much room in the toes. I'm very disappointed to say I'll have to return these.

I own a previous pair of these which fit perfect. I am returning this new pair because the top non-adjustable strap is too long and loose over the top of my arch. I wear a size 8 med. The top strap needs to be adjustable. Amazon is charging me 6 dollars to pick these up a my home address. Obviously Amazon has decided that there is no defect. Jeff Bozos needs the money.

These are narrow and rather short. Clark s don t generally fit this way so I was very surprised. They look cute on but the straps are so uncomfortable - I have an average width foot more narrow than wide and they were dreadfully tight. The 3rd straps cut into the side of my feet they already have a wide footbed so I didn t feel comfortable trying the wide size. I had to return them.

Very comfortable shoes HOWEVER straps are surprisingly tight. I wear a 7.5 and will go 7.5wide for a more comfortable fit but my feet aren t super wide. So when I ordered these in 7.5wide I was surprised that I really had to put effort in to getting my foot in there and adjusting side straps to get my foot in the right place - I assumed I could slip my feet in and go but that s not the case. Pictures attached show my feet bulging out of the elastic slightly. Still gave it a try though and have worn them over the past few day- it s a very comfortable shoe to walk around in so all the comments definitely got that right. My short pinky toe doesn t slip out the side which often happens in other sandals. The right elastic does a good job of making sure your foot doesn t wiggle or have a flip flop sensation of separating- that shoe isn t going anywhere and will not slip off even if you re walking in a river bed not attempted . Haven t worn for more than a few hours though but high hopes that it will be a good shoe for a full day walking as a tourist or at a theme park! Update I have a short pinky toe and while it didn t slide out of the straps like it often does with a teapot sandals- it was very close so instead my pinky toe ended up hurting after a whole day of walking from all the friction and tight straps. So wanted this to work but the narrow tight straps didn t work for my feet

The elastic part of this shoe cut into my flesh and cut off my circulation. I purchased for a trip and had to purchase different shows while I was there. I'm a size 6 and I've never had to wear wide shoes so I think these shoes just run narrow. The shoe looks good and the support is there. Unfortunately, I had to return mine.

I have a high arch but nothing extraordinary and these shoes made my feet throb. I m so disappointed as Clark s as a rule of thumb are designed for comfort. In this case there was not enough stretch in the elastic and the seems on the heel are have hard edges and cause blisters.
I just got these today and was so disappointed as I love them but they just had to much room at the first row of elastic at the top of my foot the length was perfect but will have to send them back.
Love the look but way too tight. Leaves my feet with really bad squeeze marks. If you have a very narrow foot they would be great.

These sandals are incredibly comfortable. The soles are wonderfully supportive and easy on the feet. They fit as expected length-wise so sizing appears to be correct however, the ankle hole is quite large and the velcro mechanism for strapping them on is not meant to be adjusted. I first purchased an 8.5, then sent them back and ordered an 8 hoping the ankle strap might fit tighter. No such luck. I sent back the second pair. The ankle straps are so large they don't touch my ankle anywhere around the back or sides of my heel, so they don't hold the sandal in place and they look loose. I was terribly sorry these didn't work out because everything else about them seems perfect.
I bought these for my daughter but a wide wasn t wide enough. She was so disappointed that she cried. I m returning these.

I bought these shoes for in-home wear and I expected the elastic straps to stretch. But one shoe was tighter than the other and never stretched out with wear. The rubber around the toes and sides became brittle and crumbled even though I only wore these shoes in the house never took them out on rough terrain.

I wore these for the first time for 8 hours straight. They are so so comfortable! My feet didn t get tired all day as the sole is very cushioned and soft. The cloth straps are comfortable too. They are very light weight and noiseless on the floor. They look somewhat dressy and that is what I bought them for, to wear with dresses. My feet are stable in them despite the fact that they are a little elevated....not too elevated. I m 70 years old so need safe shoes, but I don t have to look frumpy if shoes like these are available. I highly recommend.

I have bunions and hammer toes and these are awesome!!! Very light weight! I got the black and they will easily go with skirts and pants. They feel secure and so comfortable. I m going to order more colors if they don t look cheesy. I m not a wide size but because of my bunion I appreciate a loose fit through that area and because of the elastic these would work for just about anyone unless maybe you have an extremely narrow foot. I have a zillion pairs of shoes and these are definitely keepers!
this shoe fits good. it is snug, so my foot doesnt slide from side to side. i like it. next time i order different colors. good buy

These are absolutely wonderful! Great fit, so comfortable, got them fast, and price wise... well, I got them before the price went up lol I am flat footed, narrow heeled, and my sizes will vary between 7 1 2 - 8 usual Clark sizing , all the way up to 8 1 2 rarely... but hey, you may need the info . I ordered a size 8 in black and have plenty of room, sandal has nice comfortable strap adjustment, and I was able to wear right out of the box - I got compliments at work, even from my male counterparts! I only wish that the other color choices were solid colors rather than the 34 heathered 34 , which would make them more office friendly. You need these!
Fit perfect right from the box. Extremely comfortable. This is the second pair I have of this sandal.

I actually switched this for a smaller size because shoe fit my foot like it was supposed to! I usually have to order a size up for my wide feet but not with these shoes. These shoes were soooooo comfortable. I ordered another pair of sandals because they felt so good on my feet. I have bone spurs, high arches. and arthritis and these were a miracle for my painful feet.

I was looking forward to trying the Cloudstepper sandal, when I purchased this one. I have a long history with Clarks shoes,and most I liked very much, but a couple fell short. This platform style gives me a comfortable footbed, and good stability. As a senior, with minor foot, and major knee problems, I was happy with this style right out of the box. It is extremely lightweight very important for walking , and adjusts easily to the shape of the foot. Proper alignment is critical for my knees.

My main objective with shoes is comfort, and that was achieved with these sandals. The foot bed is very well cushioned and I can walk around in them with no pain. I need a wide toe box, but have a narrow heel, so just added some padding to the back strap. Very happy with my purchase.

I really liked these, they are well made, and very nice looking, but unfortunately even with WW width they didn't fit my sausage feet. - Not the fault of the shoes or the seller, just my luck that's all.
Very comfortable shoe. I have wider feet and this shoe ran too small in my usual size. So buy size up.
These offer the support I need but the bands are a little tight and leave marks on your foot. Correct size was ordered FYI

I love the shoes. Unfortunately I have to send them back because they are too wide in the toe area. Clark s medium usually fit me perfectly, but I m afraid not these and I don t want to take a chance on a smaller size. Nice shoe if you have a wider foot.

I struggle to find shoes that fit, both bunion surgery which widened my feet and a very high arch on the right foot. Finding a shoe that fits my right foot and doesn't slide off my left is a challenge. This shoe has elastic bands, and I worried about it being too tight for that high arch and not wide enough. I have had to go to a 9W shoe for many other brands just to accommodate my odd feet. I looked at the sizing before buying and it indicated that size 8 was best for me. I can actually go to a 7-1 2 in a more expensive wide shoe, but I worried about the width concerns. After having these about a week, I'm pleased to say that the fit has relaxed somewhat and the velcro at the back ensures that it won't fall off my left foot. The cushioned sole is extremely comfortable, and I'm delighted. I will possibly explore other colors if the need arises.
The size is true to what I ordered. The insole makes this sandle comfortable enough to wear all day and not have sore feet...try it you'll order all the colors.
I bought this shoe for my mom who has tender bottom feet... the size is perfect and the sole is nice soft and comfortable, she loves it

Got a pair awhile back on clearance at a store, then wanted to get a second pair in different color. Love the support they give.

I'm a sandal lover, but I'm kind of picky when it comes to getting a new pair. I've had a different pair of teva sandals for at least 5 years that I still love, but I just wanted something new and a little different. I like sandals with not a fabric sole, because a hole wears in the fabric and then your sandals don't look nice, and don't last as long, which these are a really comfy foamy sole. I really like the look and comfort of these ones. The only problem I had is the elastic on the top is barely to tight for my comfort. I had to order 1 2 size bigger just because of that, and they're still a little tighter than I like. I'm hoping they'll stretch out. Other than that, I really like them!
This is the second time I bought these shoes. The first pair after a year is still in great shape. When I can no longer wear them, I ll have a back up, yay!!!

absolute comfiest shoe i have purchased, nay, WORN, in my 26 years on this earth. accounting for the childhood years when I wore shoes that had been purchased by an actual adult, not myself Slightly grandma-esq vibes but that's fashionable here in Portland so I'm gettin' the best of both worlds
The color is good as well as the fit. No issues with this shoe. Might get another pair in a different color. Have only worn them one time, so don t know how durable the craftsmanship is yet.
Excellent...was just diagnosed with Plantar Fasciitis and thought with the shoe inserts would stop me from ever wearing sandals again. Fashionable and works for a great price.

Bought these last summer and they are STILL great! Quite comfy with the elastic straps. I have wide feet so this allows some give. Still getting compliments on them, too. And very comfortable. Not sure what I will do if I can't get them again.
I needed walking sandals for vacation walking which turns into miles. These are the best. The elastic really supports your foot.

I really liked these, they are well made, and very nice looking, but unfortunately even with WW width they didn't fit my sausage feet. - Not the fault of the shoes or the seller, just my luck that's all.
The shoes run short. I have bony and narrow feet, and the straps are still tight across the top. The sole has good cushion though. I suggest sizing up.

I received these sandals the afternoon before we left for vacation, so there was NO break-in period. The first time I wore them for an extended period besides trying them on and walking down our hallway was on a 5-mile urban hike in northern Europe--no blisters, no sore spots, just blissfully happy feet. I didn't even have the weird heel pain and inflammation I'd been experiencing. Additionally, they "expanded" to accommodate my swollen feet on two trans-Atlantic flights. I've worn them to walk nearly 200 miles as a tourist and teacher over the past 6 months. I'm back to order another pair or maybe 2 before they're not offered any longer. Can't wait for warmer weather to break them out again!

I like that it fitted as expected, like the color. When walking for over a mile they start to feel a bit heavy on your feet.

I have one in every color..they are so comfortable. I got the black style from the Clarks store last summer and have been hunting this brand since and was happy to find them, I get lots of compliments when I wear them.

They look like the photos - very nice. The wide width fit perfectly. They are soooooo comfortable. I also like the little platform, gives me an extra inch 1 2 in height! These sandals are hard to find in stores - they seem to sell out in the wide widths very quickly.
This is one of the most comfortable pair of shoes I ve ever worn! Compliments on merging style and comfort. Wear with casual and professional wear.
The color is good as well as the fit. No issues with this shoe. Might get another pair in a different color. Have only worn them one time, so don t know how durable the craftsmanship is yet.
Amazingly comfortable! It's like walking on pillows. I ordered a 10 wide and now I think I need an additional colors.
I love these sandals. I have them in 5 colors and these are a replacement for my old black ones that I've worn out. They truly make you feel like you're walming on a cloud.

I live the Clark brand anyway so had no hesitation in ordering these because they appeared to meet a need of support which I needed but as well fashionable. They were perfect in fit and comfort, so much so that I quickly ordered two additional pair for future use.
these are super stylish, might have to buy another pair in a different color. right out of the box I wore to work, on my feet all day....so comfortable.
I really like the look, feel and support of this sandal.. Was good in length and width but the back strap slid down on my ankle, so sadly I think they are going back.

These Clarks sandels are so comfortable and attractive that I ended up buying another color... and then bought 2 pair for my 84 year old mom. We both have the beige and the black. representative_reviews.text: I needed some new walking running shoes and did tons of research and determined these were the best option in my price range. I normally wear 8 or 8.5 depending on the shoe. I got the 8.5 since I d be wearing socks and they fit perfectly. Snug, but not constricting. However, the inside of these shoes are ridiculously stiff, I walked over 30 miles total in them to try and break them in and they re still stiff I guess kudos to it holding it s original form . They re so stiff, in fact, though, that it started giving me excruciating pain in my arches so much so that slow walking even hurt. I switched back and forth between these and my worn out tennis shoes to make sure and the problem went away when wearing my old shoes, letting me know it was these that were hurting me. Disappointed, but it has nothing to do with the quality of the shoes. I never have this problem, but I guess it s just not meant to be for me! Had to return.
No arch support at all. Not very cushioned. Got wide but it was too wide in the heel, not so much in the toe. I like a roomy toe. Returned them
In only two months of wearing, it has a hole on top, on both pairs, where the toe is located, cheap material!

I ordered these for my daughter for marching band. They need an all-black shoe Asics had been recommended by one of the other moms. Upon opening, the shoe has grey striping, not all black as pictured. And my daughter usually wears a women's 7, they are too small. Since she cut off the tags, I cannot return unless I only want 50 refund. I will use them since I have smaller feet but I'm disappointed with the purchase.
Not wide in the toe area. I wear an 8 1 2W always have my feet ache and hurt so bad after a day in these

I love ASICS. I have worn them for years as work shoes. 12 hr busy shifts and my feet, legs, back are good. I bought these in December, loved them! Now it s March and need to replace them. New foot pain after wearing these to work. I normally wear my ASICS 6-12 months as work shoes before they are demoted to yard shoes. 4 months and now I have sore feet. I keep buying ASICS because the arch fits, my heels don t get blisters, the price isn t too high, and normally pretty comfy. I ve tried Nike and Brooks and the arch was wrong. Maybe NewBalance is next, but for the price I ll probably get another pair of ASICS.
Fits me perfect, I just don t think the support is there. If you plan to work in them and you are on your feet all day get something more supportive

Hmm, I really like these shoes.. great out of the box even without socks... But the "right shoe" seems to have a different texture to it... Plus it came with this wrinkle.. I just got these. Walked around my apartment and they feel equal... What's odd,, when I went back and checked the photos most people had gotten "holes" in the right shoe.... I really like the fit.. I have neuropathy so it's difficult to find a comfortable shoe . Toe box is good too.. I'll keep them, from a close look at other photos they seem to come like this. I'll post an up date if there's any issues... UPDATE Wore them in my living room for a bit.. The big toe area was not good.. All in all these shoes are narrow for me even though I thought I had a regular width foot but even the wide width rubbed.. Also, on the "right" shoe that seemed wrinkled and off.. it did cause my foot to slide to the side.....
No wonder why they're so lightweight. Felt as if nothing was below my soles. My feet was hurting after my normal walk. Little arch support. If you want a shoe with spring...go elsewhere

I m sorry to say but I m disappointed in these shoes. They are not comfortable at all. The inside cushions are not as plush as described. The side rubs my ankle and hurts. I m returning these shoes. I ve purchased this brand for the last 3 years and this is the first time I ve been disappointed.

In one month the top side near the toe ripped. Upon examining with the other pair it appears that on one shoe the maker forgot to put the rubber lining so the foot contacts the outer mesh directly. I can't even return this for a replacement because that option is not showing up. I would like Amazon to take care of this issue.

I have been wearing Asics gel shoes for 10 years for work and walking due to the comfortable fit and support. But the last two models I ordered are very uncomfortable and feel tight around the toes. the sole is hard and the whole shoe is so stiff it is difficult to get into. I suspect a change in construction and quality of product. I will have to find another brand.
I really liked the style and color but they fit very narrow on the toe. Support was not as expected. I got my usual size and a 1 2 up would have been too big. Didn t work for me. Sent back.

I really love this so much I bought them twice. They re perfect except both times they prematurely showed where at the mesh top over the tow. I don t have long or on manicured toenails for this to happen , especially through my sock

I usually buy ASICS shoes, take out their insoles and replace them with Powerstep insoles, this usually works perfectly for my worn out feet. This particular version of ASICS shoe does not have their typical wide toe box. After wearing them for a couple of hours this became a painfully and obviously a problem. I ll take the shoes to the local thrift house and someone will probably be able to use them. Meantime, beware of narrow toe boxes if you have wide feet.

This shoe was comfortable out of the box, not super-cushy but my steps seemed light and they seemed to handle jogging at a decent pace. That said, the first time I wore them it started raining near the end of a long walk. I noticed how quickly the soles turned slippery and the grip wasn't so great. Soon after, I slid walking on the pavement and skinned my knee pretty badly, a rare occurrence. Another day it also rained while I was walking and once again I started slipping. So I will keep them, but they're only going to be for dry days only, which is sometimes not an easy feat in Oregon.
Comfortable, pretty, provides excellent support for the back. Amazing for walking or running. Highly recommended.

I am so pleased with these. My other asics were hurting my left foot due to what I suspect may be a bone spur but covid19 is making Drs visits difficult. These gave me the right cushion to keep walking.

I love these sneakers! I have so much trouble with my feet. They are flat and most sneakers don't give me any arch support. Some are comfortable because they are cushioned, but when I wear them for a while my feet hurt. These are comfortable with arch support and I can wear them all day. Love them!
I love the support it gives my feet. I didn t experience any pain or discomfort. I use it when I am working out. I will be purchasing some more colors!
Got these for my Zumba class. I have planters only got to wear them twice before we got quarantined but the arch helps. Love them
Out of the box this sneaker was comfortable. It is supportive and cradles my feet. I don't feel any sliding whilst walking. It's a great sneaker.

I have a big foot, bad ankles and knees. My feet tend to roll to the outside putting extra pressure on my little toe. The Ascis Gel Contend are the only shoes that give me the support I need. I've tried other brans, but keep coming back to these. This is my 3rd pair, usually replace yearly
Do 5 miles every day in these. Hold up well and comfortable. I have foot problems and buy a wide width.

Super comfy, great for short and long distance running, good arch support for high arches, and good fit for individuals with narrow heels. I have 2 pairs of these and LOVE them! So nice to finally have a shoe that fits my narrow heels well and doesn t rub cause blisters. Definitely recommend.

I have osteoarthritis in both feet and I spent years looking for comfortable shoes. I happened to find a pair of these, not realizing the comfort I was about to find. 2 years later and I've purchased 3 more pairs, in different colors. These are unbelievably comfortable for sore feet.
Comfortable right out of the box. I pronate and have plantar fasciitis, and these are very comfortable! I m always an 8.5, got an 8.5, and they fit great.

Love these! Super comfortable and great support. Did a good bit of research and so glad I picked these. I Use for running and HIT classes 4-5 days a week and they ve held up for many months. Just ordered a second pair! I have wider feet and they fit great.

I walk between five and seven miles on a typical 12 hour shift at my job in healthcare. Even with several foot issues Haglunds deformity, plantar fasciitis, Achilles tendinitis, heel spurs and over supination these shoes do an amazing job of giving support and comfort.

I liked it so much, I bought it in three colors. I walk on hard city pavement for eight hours straight five days a week. These replace a worn pair of another type bought eight months ago. My sore feet thank you. Solid cushioning in an inexpensive shoe. No bells or whistles. Value for money.

size.issue_summary: 많은 고객들이 사이즈가 작거나 좁아서 불편함을 겪고 있으며, 이로 인해 반품하는 경우가 많습니다.
size.strength_summary: 많은 구매자들이 사이즈가 정확하고 발가락 공간이 넉넉하다고 언급했습니다. 이는 편안한 착용감을 제공하여 만족도를 높였습니다.

representative_reviews.text: I love the look of this running shoe for winter. I have been running in ASICS shoes for several years and knew the size and style I need for my foot. This shoe however has a very tight shoe box at the toes- a different smaller width across the toes which I did not encounter in the other pairs. My feet hurt to run in it. I already knew to size up on their shoe- I wear a size 9 in normal shoes but a 10 in ASICS - still this particular shoe style is too small across the shoe box. Considering ordering a 10 1 2 wide or a different ASICS shoe. Generally I love their shoes for style and comfort.
It s a good looking shoe but they run extremely small. I would say a least a half maybe a whole size small. I had to return them because I m a womens 12B and there was no 12 1 2

In one month the top side near the toe ripped. Upon examining with the other pair it appears that on one shoe the maker forgot to put the rubber lining so the foot contacts the outer mesh directly. I can't even return this for a replacement because that option is not showing up. I would like Amazon to take care of this issue.
Ordered a 10W ladies and it was too short and narrow. Had to return. If size had worked, I would have liked it.
I really liked the style and color but they fit very narrow on the toe. Support was not as expected. I got my usual size and a 1 2 up would have been too big. Didn t work for me. Sent back.

Just wanted a running shoe that was not outrageous in price to wear everyday-so not my favorite, but did not have others that I normally get at a decent price and in a color I liked. My running shoes are great, but too expensive for everyday
My right foot is actually a hair smaller than my left one. I have another pair of this same shoe, that has the same problem. Other than that the shoes are really comfortable.

I ordered my usual size 8 and a half wide and at least a half of size to small and not wide enough. The shoes are a nice color black and pink but otherwise terrible fit and no support. The back of shoe also is cut to low and rubs on your ankle bone. Not a good shoe for me.

These shoes are comfortable and fit true to size. However, I have only had them for 3 months and by month 2 they already had holes in them on the top. I am not hard on my shoes. I only wear them to work where I sit at a desk and then for my daily walks which is 2 miles on a paved path. I am super disappointed because they are so comfortable and fit well.

I ordered these for my daughter for marching band. They need an all-black shoe Asics had been recommended by one of the other moms. Upon opening, the shoe has grey striping, not all black as pictured. And my daughter usually wears a women's 7, they are too small. Since she cut off the tags, I cannot return unless I only want 50 refund. I will use them since I have smaller feet but I'm disappointed with the purchase.

I needed some new walking running shoes and did tons of research and determined these were the best option in my price range. I normally wear 8 or 8.5 depending on the shoe. I got the 8.5 since I d be wearing socks and they fit perfectly. Snug, but not constricting. However, the inside of these shoes are ridiculously stiff, I walked over 30 miles total in them to try and break them in and they re still stiff I guess kudos to it holding it s original form . They re so stiff, in fact, though, that it started giving me excruciating pain in my arches so much so that slow walking even hurt. I switched back and forth between these and my worn out tennis shoes to make sure and the problem went away when wearing my old shoes, letting me know it was these that were hurting me. Disappointed, but it has nothing to do with the quality of the shoes. I never have this problem, but I guess it s just not meant to be for me! Had to return.
Not wide in the toe area. I wear an 8 1 2W always have my feet ache and hurt so bad after a day in these
These shoes did not have nearly enough support for what I needed them for so I returned them. The size was as expected.

I usually buy ASICS shoes, take out their insoles and replace them with Powerstep insoles, this usually works perfectly for my worn out feet. This particular version of ASICS shoe does not have their typical wide toe box. After wearing them for a couple of hours this became a painfully and obviously a problem. I ll take the shoes to the local thrift house and someone will probably be able to use them. Meantime, beware of narrow toe boxes if you have wide feet.
Didn't last very long..too snug to wear for a looong time. Probably won't buy shoes from Amazon again

This shoe was comfortable out of the box, not super-cushy but my steps seemed light and they seemed to handle jogging at a decent pace. That said, the first time I wore them it started raining near the end of a long walk. I noticed how quickly the soles turned slippery and the grip wasn't so great. Soon after, I slid walking on the pavement and skinned my knee pretty badly, a rare occurrence. Another day it also rained while I was walking and once again I started slipping. So I will keep them, but they're only going to be for dry days only, which is sometimes not an easy feat in Oregon.
I have purchased this brand and this particular shoe before. I knew it would fit. The fit is true to size.
I have a wide foot and ordered 1 2 size larger as recommended and they fit perfectly. Very comfortable
These sneakers are a perfect fit. Plenty of room in the toe box and support through the arch. I love the gray color. Goes well with most of my running clothes.

I picked these shoes based on reviews of great comfort, good support and fit as expected. I got 2 out of 3. I generally take either size 6 1 2 or 7 and i order a 7 online knowing if the shoes are a tad large i can add inserts. That's what i did with these, but even the 7 was too small, specifically in length. My toes were right up against the end of the toe box, and I knew that I couldn't get through an entire work day like that. So I exchanged for a 7 1 2, and now everything is just right.

I've owned about 5 pairs of this shoe because they just fit me well. They have a slightly wider toe box which I think is why I like them so much. I always take out the liner and replace it with an atheletic arch support Dr Scholls .
I was having terrible foot pain and my doctor recommend this brand of shoe. The fit is very comfortable and helps with my foot pain. I also really love the style.

I really like these shoes. They are wide enough in the toe box and narrow enough in the heel to perfectly accommodate my hard-to-fit foot. I use them every day for cardio, dance workouts, or elliptical trainer sessions. They provide all the support I need for forward, backward, and lateral movements. They feel great underfoot.

I need a shoe with a little bit wider front, but not a wider heel. Wide sizes don't work, but I've found this brand always is a perfect fit. With a wide array of colors from which to choose, I'm never disappointed in this shoe I use for walking. Very comfortable, and good value.
I like true to size. The comfort is good and I like the nonskid sole. The inside padding good be more comfortable. I bought a insert. Would buy again.
I have horrible bunions, so it is difficult to find shoes that fit properly. I purchased these in a wide size and they are perfect. Very cushiony and comfortable. Fashionable too.

In the age of COVID where we shouldn't go to stores unless absolutely necessary finding a great shoe for an amazing price while not having to leave my home. I was nervous about purchasing this because you never really know how it fits until you put it on and it fits great. I take walks daily and it has made them much more comfortable. I would totally recommend buying these. they fit exactly as they should.

Love the big toe box - I did order wides. I normally wear a size 8.5 regular in other shoes skeechers, under armour,etc. I had to get a 9.5 wide. I tried a 9 wide but they were too small in the toe box. The 9.5 are a little big but very comfortable to walk in and give my toes room to splay out without hurting as I walk. Several people have recommend these to me as my other shoes were hurting my feet after a few hours wear. These I walk a couple miles in in the morning then can wear all day. I'll more than likely get a 2nd pair for everyday use and keep one pair for the track Very happy with these. These are my first pair of Asics. I do suggest going to a local store that sell Asics to try them on first, I'm glad I did. Because the online sizing didn't match up, hence me getting a 9.5 wide. Over all I'm glad I got them.
Great fit. Good to be able to count on sizing and quality when ordering by mail. Asics did not disappoint. Took the code off my worm out shoes, plugged it in to order these and they are perfect.

Usually only need to go half size larger on running shoes to have sufficient toe space for running. These are smaller than expected in length. Next time I'll go a full size larger. Otherwise the width was good for my med wide feet. Good support and comfortable. Laces weren't too long either!

The material on the top is not good. I bought two pairs, the first pair after wear 2weeks, was broken. Then this pair is same.

But after a month of wearing my left foot started to hurt in different places and it took me awhile to realize that I've been wearing these sneakers every time since I bought it. Even my tendon started to hurt. They seem to be a knockoff, they don't even fit like other asics, are wider and very hard on the sole. It's too late to return them, so now I'm stuck with them. How to con a customer, make shoes comfy to start with and they can throw them out after a month.

I love ASICS. I have worn them for years as work shoes. 12 hr busy shifts and my feet, legs, back are good. I bought these in December, loved them! Now it s March and need to replace them. New foot pain after wearing these to work. I normally wear my ASICS 6-12 months as work shoes before they are demoted to yard shoes. 4 months and now I have sore feet. I keep buying ASICS because the arch fits, my heels don t get blisters, the price isn t too high, and normally pretty comfy. I ve tried Nike and Brooks and the arch was wrong. Maybe NewBalance is next, but for the price I ll probably get another pair of ASICS.

Hmm, I really like these shoes.. great out of the box even without socks... But the "right shoe" seems to have a different texture to it... Plus it came with this wrinkle.. I just got these. Walked around my apartment and they feel equal... What's odd,, when I went back and checked the photos most people had gotten "holes" in the right shoe.... I really like the fit.. I have neuropathy so it's difficult to find a comfortable shoe . Toe box is good too.. I'll keep them, from a close look at other photos they seem to come like this. I'll post an up date if there's any issues... UPDATE Wore them in my living room for a bit.. The big toe area was not good.. All in all these shoes are narrow for me even though I thought I had a regular width foot but even the wide width rubbed.. Also, on the "right" shoe that seemed wrinkled and off.. it did cause my foot to slide to the side.....

I really love this so much I bought them twice. They re perfect except both times they prematurely showed where at the mesh top over the tow. I don t have long or on manicured toenails for this to happen , especially through my sock

They are holding up incredibly well especially after everything I have put them through. I'm thoroughly surprised with the durability.
Got these for my Zumba class. I have planters only got to wear them twice before we got quarantined but the arch helps. Love them
The only thing not happy with is the lining inside the toe area it is not very durable seems like it may wear out very quickly
Super comfy! I got these to replace my contend 4s which I had for a couple of years. They fit perfectly and I am just as happy with these as I was with my older ones.
The price is good, the style is nice, they fit well. I'm tough on shoes and these stand up well. No complaints.
I sprained my ankle 2 yrs ago and have had trouble finding a shoes that offers comfort and support. These shoes fit the bill.
Wore fir first time on weekend trip. Comfortable and did not experience any break-in dis comfort. Still like the ASICS reliability!

I bounce back and forth between men's and women's Asics and Saucony black running shoes. I need to wear black shoes for work and these fit the bill. I don't ever slip on wet cement, they support my feet well, they're very breathable, and last a long time. I get between 6,000 and 14,000 steps on cement per day so I blow through shoes. I like that I can just throw them in the washing machine when they're grimy and they come out like new. I can tell when I need to replace them because my arches start to ache. The soles never wear out or fall off, it's the insides that break down. Then I just start up my Amazon app and order up another pair of whatever one is most readily available. In women's I wear a 9.5 and in men's I usually wear an 8. I grab wides if they're ever available. They're all made in China and of the same quality of materials.

I LOVE these shoes and keep buying the same type. No other shoe supports and fits my foot as well. However, I find the outer toe always wears through the shoe after 4-6 months. I really wish they would reinforce that area or use stronger material.
Nice shoes, the mesh is stretchy and helps with my bunion. And the soles are nice and soft. I wear 10 hrs a day at work on my feet 100percent, also use for tennis, their lightweight.

These shoes were comfortable right out of the box. They didn't need a "breaking in " period. I work retail, so I am on my feet all day. They helped remarkably. 9 months later I am replacing them after about 1,200 miles walking at work. I am impressed!

Bought for walking in the neighborhood. They are quite cushiony supportive under the inside ball-of-foot. I wear a 7.5 in regular shoes and always size up 1 full size and go wide for sneakers, so 8.5W fits perfectly. Will buy again. Only con is the shoelaces are boring. Bought fluorescent yellow to replace the navy ones they came with. Now they re cute sporty, as well as comfy.
Do 5 miles every day in these. Hold up well and comfortable. I have foot problems and buy a wide width.
This shoe is an 8 hr work standing on my feet all day. The price was fantastic!! Compared to what I ve bought for twice the price !!

representative_reviews.text: I was really surprised to open the box and find a completely different color than I ordered! They look nice, just not what I expected.

I've had almost every gel contend version of this shoe, but these new soft pink watershed rose ones are by far the prettiest pair I've owned!! It makes my gel contend 4's look so ugly....! Super happy the sizing fit hasn't changed at all over the years. For what it's worth, I am an 8 in Asics Nikes Brooks, including these, but typically about a full size or more smaller in boots sandals, etc 6.5 -7 . I always thought Nikes were more stylish, but I much prefer ASICS because of their comfort support, especially for exercise, so I am THRILLED they have such pretty shoes now.

great shoe for the price. I feel they are very comfortable and give me support I need. I would recommend this shoe

representative_reviews.text: They are made well but, they gave me blister within the first hour. Probably need to wear socks but, that's not really the point of water shoes

Sort of suck I bought these shoes and wore them so I could not return them because the right shoe has some kind of bump on the inner arch that destroys my foot and causes major pain if I wear them for even 10 minutes. I have tried adding insoles etc built there was no fix. Wasted a hundred f-ing dollars. So Merrell seems to be just going downhill if you read their reviews. Get it together Merrell.

This shoe has zero support. It has a nice grippy vibram sole but that's it. Flimsy, flimsy, flimsy! I would not want to walk across my yard in this shoe. Forget about hiking or bicycling. I used to sell outdoor footware at REI and this shoe is the worst value for money I have ever seen. 90.....are you kidding me? Sent them right back and bought a much more comfortable and way better make pair at Sam's Club for 30! Unfortunately still made in China but at least they are wearable.
I have put less than 225 miles exercise walking 4.3mph and the shoes need to be replaced- the soles have worn flat . Going back to Ascics.

I opened a box of new shoes and they appear used, or at least worn returned previously. They show indication of wear and have objects stuck in the sole. Very disappointed and will likely return. This was a gift for an anniversary, now I am left with nothing.

I m clearly in the minority based on the ratings for this shoe, but this shoe was absolutely awful for me. I bought these for a trip to Kauai where I knew I d need good water shoes that were also good for hikes. I have flat feet and thought the added arch might help. I was wrong. Beware if you have flat feet. These are not for you. There is a pronounced arch on these and they made the shoes so painful to wear that I had to give up on them after three hikes and one trip to the beach. My right foot was in so much pain around the arch it felt like I sprained it. I m still feeling discomfort in this spot two months later. Even sitting with these shoes on, my legs started to feel pain. These shoes also allow an inordinate amount of sand in them. It s too bad they re relatively good looking. But while many seem to love these shoes, they were absolutely horrible for me. I wound up buying Astral TR1 Mesh water shoes and they were everything I hoped these Merrell s would be.
In less than 2 months of wear I wore a hole in the right toe. I always wear thick wool socks with my shoes so I find it difficult to believe my toenail is responsible. Very disappointed!!

I've used them a total of maybe 6 times. The pull-up strap on one shoe has torn. A hole is worn on one shoe. The traction is not bad, but, lacking. The shoes allow sand in which rubs your skin raw is not acceptable.

The shoes are very comfy and have lots of grip. They are starting to fall apart and would think for the price they would last longer than 4 months. First pair from Merrell I've been disappointed with. Would not buy unless you don't plan to use them much.

These fit a little larger than normal, mostly because they're thin, so the Mediums fit like Wides, except for the toes the outer toe area is a little small compared to the rest of the shoe. They're great for summer use though. Unfortunately, the insole can't be removed for an after market insole, and I like a little more padding.

Lacks adequate forefoot control. I can't tie it as tight as I like because Merrell attached the 2nd pair of eyelets from the top to 2 elastic bands. These elastic bands stretch and run against each other in such a way it does not allow you to tighten it any further at that point. In shoes where none of the elastic bands are attached to eyelets, I can tighten the upper forefoot area an extra 1 8 of an inch or more. My feet fit fine in other brands such as Salomon and Adidas. I have widish feet that are not so wide near the bottom of the ankle. I only have a wide forefoot, but skinny ankles. If this sounds like you reconsider another model. If you have largish ankles you'll be able to lock your forefoot from sliding forward. It would have been a perfect shoe for me if Merrell just used non elastic eyelet attachments. All elastic wears out within weeks, so it's pointless why they decided to use it in the lacing system.

Right out of the box, I was sure they'd sent me a size 9 1 2. Every other type of shoe I own gives at least 1 2" room at my big toe, or more. With these, I have less than 1 4". They're very light and the overall support is adequate for several hours of moderate hiking and going through water several times. Grip was OK. From 1 to 10 I'd rate the grip between 7 and 8. My feet were a bit sore compared to wearing my Merrell Moab's the same amount of time. I might keep them but they'll be a problem if any hike includes too much downhill. For wearing during fairly level hikes like the Narrows at Zion, I think they'd be fine. I might try returning them for a 1 2 size larger if I can get a full refund. Seriously consider buying 1 2 size bigger or you may be disappointed like me.

This product was terrible. They caused horrible pain in my feet. One shoe was actually different. They sent me replacements. Not ones I ordered, some cheap ugly neon shoes. When I returned those, I was sent a pair of boots with a hole in them. They offered me 20 discount. Merrell lost a lot of business because of their treatment of customers

I've been wearing Merrell shoes for at least 5 years, Moab Ventilators, Capra Air Bolt, and most recently the Moab FST. I used to wear a 10 but switched to a 10.5 with the Capra Air Bolt and Moab FST for a slightly looser fit. I ordered the All Out Blaze in 10.5 and they were painful to wear. Even wearing them while sitting at a desk most of the day resulted in my feet hurting. Something wasn't right about the placement and size of the arch support. The shoes seemed to be the right size, but they were just the wrong shape. I tried wearing them around the house for a few days because I really wanted to like these shoes. The mesh was super breathable and that's what I was looking for to keep my feet dry on hot summer days, but these shoes just didn't work for me and they didn't feel anything like any other Merrells I've worn before.

I love these shoes! They're the most comfortable shoes I've ever worn and I do wear them practically every day. I'm on my third pair now and I'd recommend them to almost anyone, in a DRY climate or conditions. They're meant to be water shoes and I guess for sandy beaches, they might work ok. But they've used the worst possible sole material which tends to be overly slippery on all wet surfaces I've encountered. Sidewalks, streets, pavers, river stones, damp hiking trails etc. Walking on anything damp or wet, you run the risk of slipping! In dry conditions, I'd rate them a 5 star, but in wet, they only get a 1 star from me.

I've been wanting a pair of light hiking shoes that can also double as water shoes, being that I do light hikes a few times a year and typically take a trip to current river yearly and get tired of the flimsy water shoes that last one use then get thrown away because they're all tore up. I bought a pair of Merino wool socks to accompany these and think I'll buy a couple more pair after having tried the first. I am just breaking these in at the moment and they almost already feel as if they don't need anymore break-in. I will say these are probably not built for steep hill climbing as there isn't any ankle support but should work great on rough terrain. The mesh lets them breathe very well, which is what an experienced hiker told me to look for and the reasoning for getting the wool socks. The socks felt great in them. The soles are very rugged and super grippy yet very flexible to the foots natural motion. So far, I've put a few miles in them on the treadmill and been running around outside my house doing outside work. They feel great to my feet. I wear anywhere from a 10.5 to an 11 depending on the shoe and usually like my shoes a little wide. I bought these in a 10.5 and they fit excellent. Snug to my foot with socks on but not tight at all to where they're bothersome. I can say they've worked out great while breaking them in and can't wait to wear them on some expeditions. If you don't hear an update from me, it's because I love the shoes and have nothing more to say. If I run into a problem with them, I'll leave an update.

These are nice, light hikers and very comfortable. I like them a lot. But truth be told, I used them to tour Chicago last weekend and blew up both my knees. They are not made for all day cushioning and comfort and I paid for it. Not the shoes fault, mine. Just beware if you have knee and lower back issues, although light and exceptionally comfortable, your knees and lower back will pay the price if you decide to wear them all day while hiking, walking and standing in line for hours.

I was very happy with my purchase, I used it for walking on the trails, walking through water and swimming. The arch support can be better. Not recommended for longer hikes but great shoe for the water.

Was a little nervous, because I have another pair of Merrell shoes that are a little too tight.. I wear the exact 9 1 2, and this pair is exact. At first, I thought the toe box was going to be a little big, as others have said, but it s not. First weekend of owning them, we go to the Texas coast.. I wear them to the beach, in the water, and on a boat. These shoes have a nice firm feel, I ll have no problem walking on rocks along the Llano River, where I rock hunt, and then walking in to the water. The price was more than what I was hoping to spend, but after trying on other high rated brands, I felt that the cost was worth it. I am very pleased with these shoes, and happy I did the research and read reviews. I would recommend these to anyone that asks, and I ll buy them again when this pair wears out

I have peripheral neuropathy causing pain and numbness in my feet. I need to be very careful re shoe fit and support provided. Having said that these shoes are a godsend. They are extremely comfortable and provide excellent arch support. The sizing is spot on. I couldn't recommend these shoes more highly

In all likelihood the most comfortable mesh hiker water shoe I've had yet - and I've had plenty. Great arch support which I really like. I have a moderately wide foot and these feel great! The "shoulder" part of my foot just below the little toe is wide and a lot of shoes rub that area and that bothers me. These are perfect through there. Just know these are wide open mesh, so any water anywhere is going to get in - rain or puddles your feet will get wet. They are excellent warm - hot weather dry weather hikers.

I bought this shoe for a trip to Yosemite. Hiked up to Vernal Falls and RAN back down with these shoes. They have great support, plus just the right amount of cushion, and proper grip on all terrain. And they look very cool. My wife bought a pair too and she also loves them.
love this brand, comfortable, threw away a more expensive pair of shoes from these. I'm on my feel all day and these are geat

These are the best shoes ive ever owned. I hate for my feet to be hot and sweaty, these are as open as you can possibly get without wearing sandals. Im very hard on shoes. Converse only last me 1.5-2 months before falling apart. Ive had these for 6-7 months, wearing them every day no matter what im doing and theyve just recently stopped looking brand new. Ive worn them through swamps and mud. Theyre the most comfortable and breathable shoes made. Ive just replaced them with a pair of blaze vents because I feel funny about buying the exact same shoe back to back, but I plan on buying another pair the next time i need shoes. They fit similar to the vents. I tried the merrell seive, they fit the same, but feel more like crocs, so id definitely go with the aero if youre looking for breathability. The bottoms are extremely grippy on any possible surface.
Extremely comfortable after a few days of breakin. Very airy. Good grip whilst jumping around on rocks and fallen trees like an idiot to entertain my kids.
Comfortable shoe after having a few other brands. work and fit great, used to fish all day, hike, install docks, etc...

Got these prior to going to Disney for a week and they did not disappoint. Averaged 5 miles a day with 3 small kids. Good arch support. I had to go a 1 2 size larger than normal but not a big deal with free returns.
Best warm weather shoe I have ever owned. Bought about one size larger. Wish they made a wider width. Very good arch Really breathes well

I wear these everyday. On my feet 9 hours a day in a home improvement retail environment. I wear them with wool socks. Super comfortable and great traction. They felt like they were broke in from the first day. Would definitely recommend.
I love these shoes great tread perfect cushion and light weight perfect for walking, running on and off the trail.

representative_reviews.text: These fit a little larger than normal, mostly because they're thin, so the Mediums fit like Wides, except for the toes the outer toe area is a little small compared to the rest of the shoe. They're great for summer use though. Unfortunately, the insole can't be removed for an after market insole, and I like a little more padding.

I would love to say something wonderful about how the shoe feels or performs but I may never get the chance. I just returned a second pair to Amazon because they were WAY too big. I have been a solid size 10.5 for thirty years, so I ordered these in the same size. When I slid on the first pair the view was almost comical. My big toe was about a half mile from the toe pocket. The fit was not even close. I sent them back and ordered a half size down 10 . Same story. The new ones fit as poorly as the first pair. I almost thought a trick had been played on me and that the same shoes had been returned to my address. Nope. Either the Blaze Aero style runs large very large or perhaps an entire batch of size 13s were mislabeled and sent out. I will try one more time. For now my review is for 2 stars due to the frustration involved in trying to buy this shoe. I ll update if the third pair is the charm.

I've been wearing Merrell shoes for at least 5 years, Moab Ventilators, Capra Air Bolt, and most recently the Moab FST. I used to wear a 10 but switched to a 10.5 with the Capra Air Bolt and Moab FST for a slightly looser fit. I ordered the All Out Blaze in 10.5 and they were painful to wear. Even wearing them while sitting at a desk most of the day resulted in my feet hurting. Something wasn't right about the placement and size of the arch support. The shoes seemed to be the right size, but they were just the wrong shape. I tried wearing them around the house for a few days because I really wanted to like these shoes. The mesh was super breathable and that's what I was looking for to keep my feet dry on hot summer days, but these shoes just didn't work for me and they didn't feel anything like any other Merrells I've worn before.

Lacks adequate forefoot control. I can't tie it as tight as I like because Merrell attached the 2nd pair of eyelets from the top to 2 elastic bands. These elastic bands stretch and run against each other in such a way it does not allow you to tighten it any further at that point. In shoes where none of the elastic bands are attached to eyelets, I can tighten the upper forefoot area an extra 1 8 of an inch or more. My feet fit fine in other brands such as Salomon and Adidas. I have widish feet that are not so wide near the bottom of the ankle. I only have a wide forefoot, but skinny ankles. If this sounds like you reconsider another model. If you have largish ankles you'll be able to lock your forefoot from sliding forward. It would have been a perfect shoe for me if Merrell just used non elastic eyelet attachments. All elastic wears out within weeks, so it's pointless why they decided to use it in the lacing system.

Sort of suck I bought these shoes and wore them so I could not return them because the right shoe has some kind of bump on the inner arch that destroys my foot and causes major pain if I wear them for even 10 minutes. I have tried adding insoles etc built there was no fix. Wasted a hundred f-ing dollars. So Merrell seems to be just going downhill if you read their reviews. Get it together Merrell.

Right out of the box, I was sure they'd sent me a size 9 1 2. Every other type of shoe I own gives at least 1 2" room at my big toe, or more. With these, I have less than 1 4". They're very light and the overall support is adequate for several hours of moderate hiking and going through water several times. Grip was OK. From 1 to 10 I'd rate the grip between 7 and 8. My feet were a bit sore compared to wearing my Merrell Moab's the same amount of time. I might keep them but they'll be a problem if any hike includes too much downhill. For wearing during fairly level hikes like the Narrows at Zion, I think they'd be fine. I might try returning them for a 1 2 size larger if I can get a full refund. Seriously consider buying 1 2 size bigger or you may be disappointed like me.
looks like a nice shoe. but fit isn't great for me. I wear size 12 usually. these fit a little big in the 12. got a 11 and they were too narrow. bummer.

This product was terrible. They caused horrible pain in my feet. One shoe was actually different. They sent me replacements. Not ones I ordered, some cheap ugly neon shoes. When I returned those, I was sent a pair of boots with a hole in them. They offered me 20 discount. Merrell lost a lot of business because of their treatment of customers

I wear a 14 wide and these fit without issue. Update 19 July 2020. After just a couple of weeks, the toe tread rubber is peeling away from toe cap on right shoe. This will be my last pair of Merrell shoes. I have received three defective models from Merrell this year. Trail glove, sole was not glued and was separated new in box. Previous trail glove was two different colors and mesh was stitched into a bunch on top area of shoe. Chameleon not true to size. I tried to remain product loyal, not anymore.
Great fit, After a couple months I bought a couple more pairs knowing that the shoe wouldn t be made much longer
I'm a woman with wide feet, so I have to buy men's in order to get a comfy fit. These shoes are absolutely perfect! They fit like a glove! I will be ordering another pair!
Best warm weather shoe I have ever owned. Bought about one size larger. Wish they made a wider width. Very good arch Really breathes well

Ordered half size larger based on Amazon recommendation but had to send those back for my true size which did fit fine. Have a three year old pair that has held up fine. Toecap is just now starting to come unglued.

Almost perfect fit out of the box and only took about 20-30k steps to break them in. I love all the mesh and the sole is both firm and comfortable. They still have a firm, secure feel despite being so airy. Tread pattern is amazing, I haven't tried it in all conditions, but on Florida soil mostly sand they grip very well.

Perfect toe-box. Close to perfect midsole, stable due to low CG. Great grip and durability. Tops are a bit overly sitched, but they lasted a long time on my previous shoes. I haven't found a better hiking amphibious hot weather shoe. Ventilators hurt my sesamoids, can't wear them. This shoe has near perfect biomechanics, not too overbuilt, no too minimalistic. Just right. Please, don't discontinue this model evolve if you must, but don't mess with the perfect last.
Wow these shoes work really well and fit great. I normally wear a size 11.5 W. But the regular fits perfectly, even with thick socks on. Most comfortable hiking shoes I ve worn. Merrell shoes rock!
Comfortable shoe after having a few other brands. work and fit great, used to fish all day, hike, install docks, etc...
Great shoes, had to exchange mine for a size smaller, It was about 1 size bigger than normal shoe size. Exchange was quick and I have no complaints.

I love my water shoes and the fit is perfect! Super easy company to deal with for everything! I had to return due to my ordering a larger size expecting width to be small and return was super easy and simple! Would definitely order these again but next time will order normal size which was perfect!
Husband loves his shoes. Says they're really comfortable and breath well. Large toe box, yet still secure. Can't wait to try them out in Kauai!
Merrell shoes always fit me. A little pricey so I wait for a sale but they last years with normal use.

Purchase for my son and only wear a few days and found it shrink to a much smaller size under the sun. Can't believe brand like Crocs shoes shrink so much. waste of money.

They morphed and shrank near the foot entrance and sole see picture , causing blisters on my child. Maybe from the sun? Not sure. At first, I thought it was a singular issue with the first pair I ordered, but it is happening again with the replacement pair. This has not happened with the five other crocs we have had in the past but those were not purchased here.

I did not like crocs. I was not a crocs fan. After reading reviews and multiple family members brought crocs, I decided to buy my son his first crocs. I measured his feet and brought c10 using the measuring diagram on the website. Did not fit. Too big. Brought c9. Still too big and loose. I finally brought c8, and it "fit".The toes are too close to the tip of the shoes. It leaves little room for his toes. Im worry he might out grow them before next summer. My son has gotten these circular lesion on his feet. He has been wearing it for about 2 or 3 months. I gave the c10 to his cousin and she has these circle marks that peels her feet too. I'm super disappointed. What i like is that he can wear his shoes without much help from me. And it protect his feet from the sun. But it hurts my son's feet. Sizing are horrible and confusing.

We have owned crocs before that have lasted years and have needed to be replaced cos the kids have outgrown them not because of poor quality. I was confused by the sizing because "Big Kids" starts at a 4 and I assume that he is a "Big Kid". The sizes in order of the pull-down menu are "Little Kid 1, 2, 3, 6, 10, 11,12, Big Kid 4, 5, 6". But that is not the correct size order. I think the correct size order should be "Little Kid 6, 10, 11, 12, 1, 2, 3, Big Kid 4, 5, 6". So, a "Little Kid" 3 is larger than a "Little Kid" 12. After thinking they didn't have his size, I finally figured this out and bought the "Little Kid" 3. The shoes fit and are even a bit large. We are happy, but hope to help others who might be confused. What is called "Little Kid" 1, 2, and 3 are really "Big Kid" sizes - that is, they are larger than "Little Kid" 12.

Comfortable soles but if you have wide feet like me, your pinky toe and outer foot will rub against the sandal and cause irritation and pain. If you have wide feet, go for the in-between style. Sole is comfortable for long walks.

These are super cute shoes. They feel comfortable and supportive. HOWEVER, they make fart noises when you walk. My husband loved it... I did not. I tried everything I could think of to make it stop. I even called the croc store. Nothing helped. I returned them.
These were well made and the material they are made out of would be very comfy , but the top part of the sandal Was too loose on my foot I do have long thin feet for that I had to return them

I can tell that these sandals would be really comfortable, but they are HUGE. I typically wear a size 10 -- TEN! -- and I ordered a size 9 after looking at the reviews. They fall right off my feet. I'm sad about it because I know they would feel great, but I just cannot handle how loose they are. It looks like maybe an 8 would fit? But even then I don't think the strap on the heel would be secure. On the other hand, they're the only shoes in existence that don't make me feel like my feet are monstrous lol. An FYI to people who still want to buy them they will only look good if the straps are flush against your skin. If they're loose, they'll look hideous, so be careful when choosing a size!

These were really comfortable if all I had to do was stand in them. However, the strap around my heel was too large and I could step out of them. I have a narrow heel so these did not work for me. I would have kept them, otherwise. I ordered them in size 9. I returned them.
I like the color I bought it for work as I work outdoors but my feet are slender and they run right out of these sandals.

With the first pair, one fit and the other was at least two sizes too big. So Amazon sent me another pair and guess what? One fit and the other was too big. Too bad it was the right foot both times or I could have had a pair that fit! They were all marked as size 6 but clearly there's a quality control problem here. Darn! I have another pair of these and they're my favorite sandals!

These are very comfortable on the bottom of the foot. I do have rather skinny feet tho and the straps cannot be tightened so they are a little loose over my toe area. Because of that I have had near tripping when the front of the sandal folds under when I take a step. If the strap was tighter I don t think it would do that. If you have a thicker foot I think you would be ok with these.
I'm keeping these but was disappointed in how loose around the toes Crocs are making their sandals now. I mean, really loose, some of us do not have that huge of feet.

I really wanted to like these sandals! The support on my arch felt great, and my toes felt like they were strapped in well without being too tight or way too wide, but the back of the shoe just didn t come up high enough on my ankle heel and it felt so weird. If there was some kind of strap around the ankle, I think I would have kept them just for the comfort on my arch. For reference, I normally wear a 10W, and the width on these was perfect.

I searched high low for the "perfect" shoes for our trip to Disney Universal and these were the winner! I brought two other pairs with me a different style of Crocs another popular sandal brand and never even bothered switching from these sandals! I have very flat feet plantar fasciitis - these definitely don't offer a ton of arch support if that's what you're looking for, but too much arch support hurts my flat feet so these were perfect! My feet were sore at the end of the day I would have been surprised if they weren't but nothing a little epsom salt gel overnight couldn't fix! I found the sandals to be extremely comfortable no rubbing or chafing , very lightweight, and I never worried about them coming off my feet or my feet sliding around in them. When it rained I still had plenty of traction and they dried very quickly! Overall I'm extremely impressed and these sandals have made me a Crocs fan!
It appears it would be very comfortable to wear but it didn't give me enough support. I am a boot lover so this was a bit too flimsy for me.

I LOVE these sandals. Since they arrived, I've only taken them off to go to bed. I'm an 8B and the size 8 fit perfectly. So far I have worn them around the pool, to mow the lawn, to take a shower at the health club and with a sundress to go out to dinner. They're PERFECT!

This is my second pair and they are my all terrain vehicles. They are comfortable even for walking hours on city streets or unpaved roads, have good grip even when a little wet, and obviously are water proof, so are good to use if you're around water. I even do moderate hiking in them in a pinch.
Wow i finally found comfort since it's always a problem for me because i have wide feet.. and this are more than perfect!, i am buying and recommending them!

They're perfectly cushioned and perfect for all terrains I've worn them on this far. Beach, river walking, store, city walking 25,000 steps and no pain in feet just hips haha , round the house, chores etc. No rubbing. Highly recommend.

This sandal supports as well as the clonky looking sandals with the thick soles. More feminine and easy packers for travel. Would not use for a big hike, however. Would not use as water sandals. Urban walking and work, yes.

I can't wear flip flops and I wanted something lighter than chacos. These were awesome!! Surprisingly good arch support and cushion. I wore them to the zoo on a very hot day and my feet didn't hurt at all. That is extremely rare for me, especially because I have an old ankle injury. Only drawback is that these are a tad hard to pull on. I didn't mind though, it just took some getting used to.

These shoes are great! I m pregnant and it was the only thing I could wear until the weather got cold. Very supportive and flexible. I m a teacher and on my feet all day. My feet never hurt at the end of the day when I m wearing these. Love them!

I have American size 6.5 wide feet with a very high arch instep and bridge. It's so high that I've added arch support to these shoes. I cannot buy sandals usually because they tend to not be made to fit my type of foot. I took a chance on these due to the other reviews. They fit wonderfully, but if you have wide ankles you'll want to avoid them. I don't have wide ankles and I wish that area hole was a bit loser. I'm hoping it will loosen over time, but it's not so tight to be a deal breaker. It's just snug. The area across the bridge that I usually can't get over my foot even in sizes far too large for me fits extremely well. I don't care for the bumps on the bottom as I find them uncomfortable and I'm barefoot most of the time and wear barefoot shoes when I'm not. So I'm unsure if someone who tends to have cushion under their feet would like that part because I'm accustomed to feeling the textures I walk on and I don't like it. I did add a pair of silicone arch supports, but my arch is very high, so others might not need them. They fit well and are a comfortable addition. I'd recommend these shoes for wide footers looking for something of this style. Don't size up.
This is one of the most comfortable shoes you can put on. I have several pair in different styles. Love them all!

These shoes are sooo sooo comfortable. I have plantar fasciitis and I ve been living in these since they arrived. They feel slightly loose but they fit my feet well visually. The ankle strap sits rather low on the heel but you get used to it quickly. I would highly recommend them and would like them in other colors as they are so comfortable.
I love this sandals.I am living in Florida and this sandals is very comfortable for everyday in sunshine state.

These are all rubber so they won t get stinky after wearing everyday in the hot sweaty feet summer. I had a coworker tell me she thought they were made of leather .
Comfortable. Affordable. Simplest. Silicone feels nice and it's only matter of slipping your foot into them. No straps, strings, or ties.

They don't need breaking in. One of the zoo trainers liked them so much she asked where I got them so she can get a pair. They are durable with thicker soles so you can walk over mud and dirt while keeping your feet out if it unlike with flip flop type sandals. I have extra wide feet so most summer sandals are too tight. These stayed on my feet. No moving around. My feet didn't get sore in them and they look cute!

I was bummed knowing i wouldnt be able to stand that and started a return ...but then me and my husband decided to hit that part of the shoe with a heat gun for 10-15 seconds blow drier could be used also . While it was hot we bent that portion of the sandal up and I put my foot in to mold to it. Since then, no issues and these sandals are super comfortable and cute. Try it if you have experienced the same issue!
